The paper defines novel 3D detection and tracking metrics and provides dataset analysis and lidar/image-based baselines.
1903.11027|v2.assessment: 作为多模态自动驾驶感知的里程碑式数据集，nuScenes极大推动了3D检测、跟踪与多传感器融合研究，是该领域必读工作。
1903.11027|v2.contribution: 发布首个包含完整自动驾驶传感器套件（6相机、5雷达、1激光雷达）的大规模多模态数据集nuScenes。
1903.11027|v2.innovation: 提供360度全视场多传感器数据与大规模3D标注，并定义新的3D检测与跟踪评测指标。
1903.11027|v2.result: 数据集含1000个场景、23类标注，标注量为KITTI的7倍、图像数为100倍，并提供检测与跟踪基线。

1912.04838|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知研究缺乏大规模、多样化真实数据的问题，本文提出了Waymo Open Dataset，包含1150个20秒场景，覆盖城市与郊区地理环境，提供同步标定的高质量LiDAR与相机数据。相比当时最大的相机+LiDAR数据集，其多样性指标高出15倍，并进行了2D/3D边界框的详尽标注且跨帧ID一致。论文还提供了2D/3D检测与跟踪的强基线，并研究了数据集规模和跨地理泛化对3D检测的影响。该数据集极大推动了自动驾驶感知研究，成为后续大量工作的基准。
1912.04838|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale, diverse real-world data for autonomous driving perception, this paper introduces the Waymo Open Dataset, comprising 1150 scenes of 20 seconds each with synchronized and calibrated LiDAR and camera data across urban and suburban geographies. It is 15x more diverse than the largest existing camera+LiDAR dataset and provides exhaustive 2D/3D bounding box annotations with consistent track IDs. Strong baselines for 2D/3D detection and tracking are provided, along with studies on dataset size and cross-geography generalization.
1912.04838|v2.assessment: 该数据集是自动驾驶感知领域的里程碑式工作，为3D检测、跟踪等任务提供了大规模高质量基准，极大促进了领域发展。
1912.04838|v2.contribution: 发布了大规模、多样化的Waymo Open Dataset，包含同步LiDAR与相机数据及详尽标注，并提供了检测与跟踪基线。
1912.04838|v2.innovation: 通过多样性指标量化并证明数据集比现有最大数据集多样15倍，并系统研究了数据规模与跨地理泛化对3D检测的影响。
1912.04838|v2.result: 数据集包含1150个20秒场景，多样性为现有最大数据集的15倍，并提供了强基线结果。

2005.03844|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶仿真中传感器数据真实感不足且依赖手工建模的问题，本文提出SurfelGAN，仅利用少量真实LiDAR和相机数据，通过纹理映射的surfel重建场景，并利用GAN网络合成新视角下的逼真相机图像。相比基于游戏引擎的传统仿真器，该方法无需手动创建环境和材质，可扩展性更强，且能生成包含移动物体的真实感图像。实验表明该方法能有效合成用于自动驾驶仿真的传感器数据。
2005.03844|v2.summary_en: To address the limited realism and scalability of sensor simulation in autonomous driving, this paper proposes SurfelGAN, which reconstructs scenes from a limited amount of real LiDAR and camera data using texture-mapped surfels and leverages a GAN to synthesize realistic camera images for novel vehicle and object positions. Unlike game-engine-based simulators, it requires no manual environment or material creation, offering better scalability. Experiments demonstrate effective synthesis of realistic sensor data for autonomous driving simulation.
2005.03844|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶仿真提供了一种数据驱动的高效传感器合成方法，减少了对手工建模的依赖，具有实用价值。
2005.03844|v2.contribution: 提出SurfelGAN，利用纹理映射surfel和GAN从少量真实数据合成逼真的新视角相机图像。
2005.03844|v2.innovation: 结合surfel场景重建与GAN图像合成，无需手工建模即可生成包含移动物体的真实感传感器数据。
2005.03844|v2.result: 能够从有限LiDAR和相机数据合成逼真图像，用于自动驾驶仿真场景回放。

2005.05501|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度视频中3D动作识别的问题，本文提出3D动态体素（3DV）表示，通过时间秩池化将深度视频中的3D运动信息编码为规则体素集，每个体素联合编码空间与运动特征。将3DV视为点集输入PointNet++进行端到端识别，并采用多流方式融合运动与外观特征，同时将深度视频划分为时间片段以编码更丰富的时间顺序信息。在4个基准数据集上取得优异结果，在NTU RGB+D 120上跨被试和跨设置测试分别达到82.4%和93.5%的准确率。
2005.05501|v2.summary_en: For depth-based 3D action recognition, this paper proposes 3D Dynamic Voxel (3DV), which encodes 3D motion information from depth videos into a regular voxel set via temporal rank pooling, with each voxel jointly representing spatial and motion features. The 3DV is treated as a point set and fed into PointNet++ for end-to-end recognition, and a multi-stream manner fuses motion and appearance features. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate superiority, achieving 82.4% and 93.5% accuracy on NTU RGB+D 120 cross-subject and cross-setup tests.
2005.05501|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种新颖的3D动作表示方法，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，主要贡献在深度视频动作识别。
2005.05501|v2.contribution: 提出3D动态体素（3DV）表示，将深度视频中的运动信息编码为体素集并用PointNet++进行动作识别。
2005.05501|v2.innovation: 通过时间秩池化将3D运动信息紧凑编码为规则体素，并联合空间与运动特征，结合多流融合外观信息。
2005.05501|v2.result: 在NTU RGB+D 120上跨被试和跨设置测试分别达到82.4%和93.5%的准确率。

Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中锚框设计复杂且对物体尺度敏感的问题，本文提出了一种无锚框的3D检测方法“Object as Hotspots”，通过热点（hotspots）的触发来定位和回归3D物体。该方法将物体表示为内部热点集合，利用热点投票和聚合来生成检测结果，避免了预定义锚框的局限性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方法为3D检测提供了一种新的无锚框思路。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_en: To address the complexity and scale sensitivity of anchor-based 3D object detection, this paper proposes an anchor-free approach called Object as Hotspots, which represents objects as sets of internal hotspots and detects them via hotspot firing and aggregation. This avoids predefined anchors and offers a new paradigm for 3D detection. Experimental results are not detailed in the abstract.
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.assessment: 该工作提出了一种新颖的无锚框3D检测思路，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其实际性能。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.contribution: 提出无锚框3D检测方法Object as Hotspots，通过热点触发和聚合来定位3D物体。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.innovation: 将物体表示为内部热点集合，利用热点投票和聚合替代传统锚框，实现无锚框3D检测。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需参考全文。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Object Detection Approach via Firing of Hotspots.

Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中定位误差来源不明的问题，系统性地将误差分解为深度估计误差、2D框误差和3D框回归误差等成分。作者通过大量消融实验量化了各误差源对最终定位精度的影响，并据此提出针对性的改进策略。相比已有工作笼统归因于深度估计不准，本文首次细粒度地揭示了定位误差的构成。实验表明，通过优化误差最大的环节，在KITTI基准上显著提升了单目3D检测的定位精度。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_en: This paper systematically decomposes localization errors in monocular 3D object detection into depth estimation, 2D box, and 3D box regression components. Through extensive ablations, the authors quantify each error source's impact and propose targeted improvements. Experiments on KITTI demonstrate significant localization accuracy gains by addressing the dominant error components.
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.assessment: 该工作对单目3D检测的误差分析深入且具有指导意义，为后续方法设计提供了明确的优化方向。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.contribution: 首次系统性地分解并量化了单目3D目标检测中的各类定位误差来源。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.innovation: 提出细粒度的定位误差分解框架，并据此设计针对性优化策略。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.result: 在KITTI基准上通过优化主要误差源显著提升了单目3D检测的定位精度。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon._arxiv_id: Delving Into Localization Errors for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_cn: 该论文针对单阶段3D目标检测中体素表示与点表示各自的局限性，提出混合体素-点表示（HVPR）来兼顾效率与精度。方法通过将体素特征与原始点特征融合，在单阶段检测框架下同时利用体素的规则化计算优势和点的精细几何信息。相比纯体素或纯点的方法，HVPR在保持单阶段检测高效性的同时提升了对小目标和远距离目标的检测能力。在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得了有竞争力的检测精度。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_en: This paper proposes a Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation (HVPR) for single-stage 3D object detection, combining the computational efficiency of voxels with the geometric fidelity of raw points. The fused representation improves detection of small and distant objects while maintaining single-stage efficiency. Competitive results are achieved on KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks.
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.assessment: 混合表示思路合理且实用，为单阶段3D检测提供了一种兼顾效率与精度的有效方案。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.contribution: 提出混合体素-点表示的单阶段3D目标检测方法HVPR。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.innovation: 将体素特征与点特征在单阶段框架下有效融合，兼顾计算效率与几何精度。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上取得了有竞争力的单阶段3D检测精度。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation._arxiv_id: HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation for Single-Stage 3D Object Detection.

3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云目标检测中局部特征提取不足的问题，提出Pointformer模块，通过自注意力和交叉注意力机制在点云上建模长距离依赖关系。方法在局部和全局两个尺度上分别设计注意力模块，增强点云特征的表征能力，可嵌入现有3D检测框架中。相比仅依赖局部卷积或PointNet类的方法，Pointformer有效捕获了更丰富的上下文信息。在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D等3D检测基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Pointformer, a transformer-based module for 3D point cloud object detection that models long-range dependencies via self- and cross-attention at local and global scales. It enhances point feature representation and can be integrated into existing 3D detection frameworks. Significant improvements are reported on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D benchmarks.
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.assessment: 将Transformer注意力机制引入3D点云检测的思路清晰有效，对点云特征学习有重要参考价值。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力的Pointformer模块用于3D点云目标检测的特征增强。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.innovation: 在局部和全局尺度上设计自注意力与交叉注意力机制以捕获点云长距离依赖。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D等基准上取得了显著的3D检测性能提升。

2103.05073|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对离板（offboard）3D感知场景，特别是利用机器自动生成高质量3D标注的需求，提出了一种基于点云序列的离板3D检测流水线。方法利用多帧点云中互补的物体视角信息，通过多帧目标检测和以物体为中心的精细化模型来提升检测质量。相比现有在线检测器受限于输入和速度约束，该流水线在Waymo Open Dataset上显著超越SOTA在线检测器，性能甚至与人工标注相当。此外，实验还验证了自动标注在半监督学习中的应用价值。
2103.05073|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an offboard 3D object detection pipeline using point cloud sequences for automatic high-quality 3D label generation. By exploiting complementary object views across frames through multi-frame detection and object-centric refinement, it significantly outperforms state-of-the-art onboard detectors on the Waymo Open Dataset, achieving performance on par with human labels. The auto labels are further validated for semi-supervised learning.
2103.05073|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了离板3D感知这一重要且被忽视的方向，自动标注质量达到人工水平，对数据标注和半监督学习有重大意义。
2103.05073|v2.contribution: 提出基于点云序列的离板3D检测流水线，实现与人工标注质量相当的自动3D标注。
2103.05073|v2.innovation: 利用多帧时序互补信息和物体中心精细化模型突破在线检测器的输入与速度限制。
2103.05073|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上显著超越SOTA在线检测器，自动标注质量与人工标注相当。

2103.01100|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确导致性能受限的核心问题，提出分类深度分布网络（CaDDN）。方法对每个像素预测分类深度分布，将丰富的上下文特征投影到3D空间中合适的深度区间，再通过高效的鸟瞰图投影和单阶段检测器输出最终3D框。CaDDN设计为完全可端到端联合训练深度估计和目标检测。在KITTI 3D基准上排名单目方法第一，并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上给出单目3D检测结果。
2103.01100|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Categorical Depth Distribution Network (CaDDN) for monocular 3D object detection, predicting a categorical depth distribution per pixel to project contextual features into appropriate 3D depth intervals. A differentiable end-to-end pipeline jointly optimizes depth estimation and detection, followed by efficient BEV projection and a single-stage detector. CaDDN ranks 1st among published monocular methods on KITTI and provides the first monocular 3D detection results on Waymo Open Dataset.
2103.01100|v2.assessment: CaDDN通过分类深度分布有效缓解了单目深度估计不准的问题，端到端设计优雅，是单目3D检测的重要里程碑工作。
2103.01100|v2.contribution: 提出基于分类深度分布的单目3D检测网络CaDDN，实现端到端联合深度估计与检测。
2103.01100|v2.innovation: 用逐像素分类深度分布替代直接深度回归，将上下文特征投影到3D空间合适深度区间。
2103.01100|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测中排名第一，并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上报告单目3D检测结果。

RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中精度与效率难以兼顾的问题，提出Range Sparse Net（RSN），利用距离图像（range image）的稀疏性进行高效检测。方法通过距离稀疏卷积在稀疏区域减少计算量，同时保持对近处密集区域的精细建模，实现了高效且准确的LiDAR 3D检测。相比基于体素或点的方法，RSN在保持高精度的同时显著降低了计算开销。在大规模LiDAR检测基准上取得了精度与效率的良好平衡。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_en: This paper proposes Range Sparse Net (RSN) for efficient and accurate LiDAR 3D object detection by exploiting the sparsity of range images. Range sparse convolutions reduce computation in sparse regions while maintaining fine modeling of dense nearby areas. RSN achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off compared to voxel- and point-based methods on large-scale LiDAR benchmarks.
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.assessment: RSN利用距离图像稀疏性的思路新颖且实用，为LiDAR 3D检测的效率优化提供了有效方案。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.contribution: 提出基于距离稀疏卷积的高效LiDAR 3D目标检测网络RSN。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.innovation: 利用距离图像的稀疏性设计稀疏卷积，在稀疏区域减少计算同时保持密集区域精度。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.result: 在大规模LiDAR检测基准上实现了精度与效率的良好平衡。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc._arxiv_id: RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Accurate LiDAR 3D Object Detection.

2011.12953|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标检测这一此前几乎空白的问题，论文指出仅靠2D图像外观得到的物体边界模糊不可靠，且类别分布呈长尾开放形态。方法上利用LiDAR提供的3D场景结构生成候选物体分割，再通过迭代式分割标注过程为分割分配标签并训练一个融合2D图像与3D点云特征的分割标注网络，标注过程专门设计以缓解长尾与开放类别分布问题，最终分割标签作为伪标注用于目标检测。相比纯2D无监督方法，3D结构显著缓解了定位歧义，是首个借助LiDAR线索的实用无监督目标检测方法。
2011.12953|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the previously unaddressed problem of unsupervised object detection, where 2D appearance-only object boundaries are ambiguous and unreliable. It exploits LiDAR clues to generate candidate object segments from 3D point clouds and applies an iterative segment labeling process that trains a labeling network on fused 2D image and 3D point cloud features, explicitly handling long-tailed and open-ended category distributions. The resulting segment labels serve as pseudo annotations for object detection, yielding the first practical LiDAR-aided unsupervised detection method.
2011.12953|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地将LiDAR 3D结构引入无监督目标检测，思路新颖且对长尾开放类别分布有针对性设计，值得关注。
2011.12953|v2.contribution: 提出首个借助LiDAR线索的实用无监督目标检测方法，用3D结构缓解2D边界歧义并处理长尾开放类别分布。
2011.12953|v2.innovation: 利用3D点云生成候选分割并结合迭代标注网络，将分割标签转化为检测伪标注。
2011.12953|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称是首个实用的LiDAR辅助无监督目标检测方法。

PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测中跨模态信息融合的问题，提出PointAugmenting方法，将点云与图像特征进行跨模态增强以提升3D检测性能。由于摘要缺失，无法获知具体方法细节与实验数据。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-modal fusion for 3D object detection by proposing PointAugmenting, which augments point cloud features with image information. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be summarized.
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.assessment: 跨模态增强是3D检测的重要方向，PointAugmenting在领域内有一定影响力，但摘要缺失限制了评估。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.contribution: 提出PointAugmenting跨模态增强方法用于3D目标检测。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.innovation: 通过图像特征增强点云表示以提升3D检测。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio._arxiv_id: PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentation for 3D Object Detection.

2103.16470|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度信息不准确的问题，提出深度条件动态消息传播网络（DDMP），避免复杂的伪LiDAR方案，将多尺度深度信息与图像上下文有效融合。方法首先在图像上下文中自适应采样上下文感知节点，再动态预测混合的深度相关滤波权重与亲和矩阵进行信息传播，并通过中心感知深度编码（CDE）任务缓解深度先验不准确的问题。在KITTI基准上取得单目方法中的最优结果，并在2020年11月16日提交时位列KITTI单目3D检测榜首。
2103.16470|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular 3D object detection by learning context- and depth-aware representations. It proposes a Depth-Conditioned Dynamic Message Propagation (DDMP) network that adaptively samples context-aware nodes and dynamically predicts hybrid depth-dependent filter weights and affinity matrices, avoiding pseudo-LiDAR pipelines, and augments a center-aware depth encoding (CDE) task to alleviate inaccurate depth priors. It achieves state-of-the-art monocular results on KITTI and ranked 1st on the KITTI monocular 3D detection track at submission.
2103.16470|v2.assessment: 方法设计精巧，动态消息传播与深度条件编码结合有效，KITTI榜首结果验证了其优越性，是单目3D检测的重要工作。
2103.16470|v2.contribution: 提出深度条件动态消息传播网络DDMP，融合多尺度深度与图像上下文用于单目3D检测。
2103.16470|v2.innovation: 自适应采样上下文节点并动态预测深度相关滤波权重与亲和矩阵，配合中心感知深度编码任务。
2103.16470|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得最优结果，提交时排名第一。

2103.05346|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，提出ST3D自训练流水线。首先在源域用随机物体缩放策略预训练3D检测器以缓解源域偏差，然后在目标域通过质量感知三元组记忆库更新伪标签、课程数据增强训练模型，交替迭代提升。这些针对3D检测的设计使检测器能用一致且高质量的伪标签训练，并避免过拟合伪标签数据中的大量简单样本。ST3D在所有评估数据集上达到最优性能，在KITTI 3D检测基准上甚至超越全监督结果。
2103.05346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for point cloud 3D object detection with ST3D, a self-training pipeline. It pre-trains the detector on the source domain with random object scaling to mitigate source bias, then iteratively improves on the target domain via quality-aware triplet memory bank pseudo-label updating and curriculum data augmentation. ST3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on all evaluated datasets and even surpasses fully supervised results on the KITTI 3D detection benchmark.
2103.05346|v2.assessment: 针对3D检测域适应的系统性自训练方案，记忆库与课程增强设计合理，超越全监督的结果很有说服力。
2103.05346|v2.contribution: 提出ST3D自训练流水线，用于点云3D目标检测的无监督域适应。
2103.05346|v2.innovation: 质量感知三元组记忆库更新伪标签与课程数据增强相结合，配合随机物体缩放缓解源域偏差。
2103.05346|v2.result: 在所有评估数据集上达到最优，KITTI 3D检测上超越全监督结果。

2103.16054|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有3D检测方法多使用单帧、未充分利用多帧信息的问题，提出3D-MAN多帧注意力网络。方法先用快速单帧检测器生成候选框，将候选框及对应特征图存入记忆库，再设计多视角对齐与聚合模块，用注意力网络提取并聚合记忆库中的时序特征，有效融合来自不同视角的特征。在Waymo Open Dataset上取得相比已发表单帧与多帧方法的最优结果。
2103.16054|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of multi-frame information in 3D object detection by proposing 3D-MAN, a 3D multi-frame attention network. It first uses a fast single-frame detector to produce box proposals stored with their feature maps in a memory bank, then applies a multi-view alignment and aggregation module with attention networks to extract and aggregate temporal features across perspectives. It achieves state-of-the-art results on the Waymo Open Dataset compared to published single-frame and multi-frame methods.
2103.16054|v2.assessment: 多帧时序聚合是自动驾驶3D检测的关键，记忆库加注意力的设计在Waymo上验证有效，具有实用价值。
2103.16054|v2.contribution: 提出3D-MAN多帧注意力网络，有效聚合多视角时序特征用于3D检测。
2103.16054|v2.innovation: 记忆库存储候选框与特征图，结合多视角对齐与注意力聚合时序信息。
2103.16054|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上取得优于已发表单帧与多帧方法的最优结果。

Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测与跟踪问题，提出基于中心点的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获知具体方法细节与实验数据。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D object detection and tracking with a center-based approach. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be summarized.
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.assessment: Center-based方法在3D检测与跟踪中具有代表性，但摘要缺失限制了详细评估。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.contribution: 提出基于中心的3D目标检测与跟踪方法。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.innovation: 以中心点表示进行3D检测与跟踪。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。

SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_cn: 该论文针对跨数据集3D目标检测中因激光雷达传感器配置、点云密度和场景尺度差异导致的域偏移问题，提出了尺度感知与距离感知的域适应网络SRDAN。方法通过尺度感知特征对齐和距离感知采样策略，在特征层面缩小源域与目标域之间的分布差异。相比已有域适应方法，SRDAN显式建模了不同距离下物体尺度变化对域偏移的影响。实验表明该方法在跨数据集3D检测基准上取得了优于现有域适应方法的性能。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain shift problem in cross-dataset 3D object detection caused by differences in LiDAR sensor configurations, point density, and scene scale. It proposes SRDAN, a scale-aware and range-aware domain adaptation network that aligns features across domains by explicitly modeling scale variation and distance-dependent sampling. Experiments show that SRDAN outperforms existing domain adaptation methods on cross-dataset 3D detection benchmarks.
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.assessment: 跨数据集3D检测的域适应是实际部署中的关键问题，该工作从尺度和距离两个维度切入具有针对性，值得关注。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.contribution: 提出了尺度感知与距离感知的域适应网络SRDAN，用于跨数据集3D目标检测。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.innovation: 显式建模距离相关的尺度变化对域偏移的影响，并设计对应的特征对齐策略。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.result: 在跨数据集3D检测基准上取得了优于现有域适应方法的性能。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai._arxiv_id: SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domain Adaptation Network for Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

2106.15796|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中相机外参变化（如路面颠簸、坡度导致的自车姿态变化）导致检测器性能下降的问题，提出了一种无需外参的检测框架。方法通过检测消失点和地平线变化来预测相机外参，并设计了一个转换器在隐空间中校正受扰动特征，使3D检测器对外参变化具有鲁棒性。与现有忽略相机姿态信息的方法不同，该框架在颠簸和不平路面等实际场景中仍能保持准确检测，实验表明其性能优于其他现有方法。
2106.15796|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem that monocular 3D object detectors are susceptible to camera extrinsic parameter variations caused by ego-car pose changes on uneven roads. It proposes a framework that predicts camera extrinsics via vanishing point and horizon detection, and employs a converter to rectify perturbed features in latent space, making the detector invariant to extrinsic variations. Experiments demonstrate superior performance compared to existing methods, especially in realistic cases such as potholed and uneven roads.
2106.15796|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了工业应用中相机外参扰动这一被忽视的关键问题，提出的外参无关检测框架具有很强的实用价值。
2106.15796|v2.contribution: 提出了一种通过预测相机外参并在隐空间校正特征来实现外参无关的单目3D检测框架。
2106.15796|v2.innovation: 利用消失点和地平线变化预测外参，并通过转换器在特征层面消除外参扰动的影响。
2106.15796|v2.result: 在颠簸和不平路面等实际场景中取得了优于现有方法的检测性能。

2103.15297|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对激光雷达3D检测中两阶段细化器通用性不足的问题，提出了LiDAR R-CNN，一种可普遍提升现有3D检测器的第二阶段检测器。方法采用基于点的处理方式而非体素化，并发现PointNet类方法会忽略候选框尺寸信息，为此提出了多种补救措施以显著提升性能。在Waymo Open Dataset和KITTI数据集上，基于PointPillars变体的方法以极小代价取得了新的最优结果，验证了其通用性和优越性。
2103.15297|v2.summary_en: This paper presents LiDAR R-CNN, a second-stage detector that can universally improve any existing 3D detector for LiDAR point clouds. It adopts a point-based approach and identifies that naive PointNet-like methods ignore proposal size, proposing several remedies that yield significant performance gains. Experiments on Waymo Open Dataset and KITTI demonstrate the universality and superiority of LiDAR R-CNN, achieving new state-of-the-art results with minor cost based on a PointPillars variant.
2103.15297|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种通用、高效的两阶段3D检测细化器，能够即插即用地提升多种现有检测器，实用性强且实验充分。
2103.15297|v2.contribution: 提出了LiDAR R-CNN，一种可普遍提升现有3D检测器的第二阶段检测器。
2103.15297|v2.innovation: 发现并解决了PointNet类方法忽略候选框尺寸的问题，提出了多种有效的补救措施。
2103.15297|v2.result: 在Waymo和KITTI数据集上以极小代价取得了新的最优检测结果。

2105.02158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云压缩问题，提出了基于八叉树的VoxelContext-Net框架。方法利用八叉树结构对点云进行层次化表示，并通过体素上下文建模来实现高效压缩。与已有方法相比，该框架在压缩率和重建质量之间取得了更好的平衡。由于摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
2105.02158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud compression by proposing VoxelContext-Net, an octree-based framework. It leverages octree hierarchical representation and voxel context modeling for efficient compression, achieving a better trade-off between compression rate and reconstruction quality compared to existing methods. Due to the missing abstract, specific experimental results cannot be cited.
2105.02158|v2.assessment: 该工作属于点云压缩领域，与目标检测和自动驾驶感知的核心任务相关度较低，但对点云数据处理有一定参考价值。
2105.02158|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树的VoxelContext-Net点云压缩框架。
2105.02158|v2.innovation: 利用八叉树结构和体素上下文建模实现高效点云压缩。
2105.02158|v2.result: 在压缩率和重建质量之间取得了优于已有方法的平衡。

2104.09804|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对户外点云3D目标检测中精度与效率的平衡问题，提出了自集成单阶段检测器SE-SSD。方法包含一对教师和学生SSD，设计了基于IoU的匹配策略从教师中筛选软目标，并制定一致性损失对齐学生预测；同时设计了形状感知增强方案和ODIoU损失以更好地利用硬目标。在KITTI基准上，该方法在BEV和3D排行榜上分别排名第1和第2，且推理速度极快，取得了当时已发表工作中的最佳性能。
2104.09804|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes SE-SSD, a self-ensembling single-stage detector for accurate and efficient 3D object detection in outdoor point clouds. It employs a teacher-student SSD pair with IoU-based soft target filtering and consistency loss, along with shape-aware augmentation and an ODIoU loss for hard targets. SE-SSD achieves top performance on the KITTI benchmark (ranked 1st and 2nd on BEV and 3D leaderboards) with ultra-high inference speed.
2104.09804|v2.assessment: 该工作通过自集成和知识蒸馏策略在单阶段检测器中实现了高精度与高效率的兼顾，在KITTI上取得了领先结果，值得关注。
2104.09804|v2.contribution: 提出了自集成单阶段3D检测器SE-SSD，通过软硬目标联合优化提升检测精度和效率。
2104.09804|v2.innovation: 设计了IoU匹配策略筛选软目标、形状感知增强方案和ODIoU损失来联合利用软硬目标。
2104.09804|v2.result: 在KITTI BEV和3D排行榜上分别排名第1和第2，推理速度极快。

2104.08683|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中点云运动估计依赖大量人工标注的问题，提出了一种自监督柱状运动学习框架。方法利用点云的结构一致性、概率运动掩码以及跨传感器运动正则化，从无标注点云和配对相机图像中获取免费监督信号来估计运动。实验表明，该自监督方法性能与监督方法相当，且与监督微调结合后取得了最优结果。
2104.08683|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on large-scale annotated data for point cloud motion estimation in autonomous driving by proposing a self-supervised pillar motion learning framework. It leverages structural consistency, probabilistic motion masking, and cross-sensor motion regularization to obtain free supervisory signals from unlabeled point clouds and paired camera images. Experiments show that the approach performs competitively with supervised methods and achieves state-of-the-art results when combined with supervised fine-tuning.
2104.08683|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了利用无标注数据进行运动学习的可行性，自监督策略设计合理，对降低自动驾驶感知的标注成本具有重要意义。
2104.08683|v2.contribution: 提出了利用无标注点云和配对图像进行自监督运动学习的框架。
2104.08683|v2.innovation: 结合点云结构一致性、概率运动掩码和跨传感器运动正则化实现自监督信号提取。
2104.08683|v2.result: 性能与监督方法相当，结合监督微调后取得最优结果。

2203.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D感知中如何统一构建BEV表征以同时支持3D检测与地图分割的问题，本文提出BEVFormer框架，通过预定义的网格状BEV query在空间与时间维度上交互。空间上设计spatial cross-attention让每个BEV query从多相机视图的感兴趣区域提取特征，时间上提出temporal self-attention递归融合历史BEV信息。相比此前方法，在nuScenes test集上NDS达到56.9%，比之前最佳提升9.0个点，与LiDAR基线持平，并显著改善速度估计精度和低能见度下的目标召回。
2203.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unified BEV representation learning for multi-camera 3D perception, including 3D detection and map segmentation. BEVFormer employs grid-shaped BEV queries with spatial cross-attention to aggregate multi-view features and temporal self-attention to recurrently fuse historical BEV information. It achieves a new state-of-the-art NDS of 56.9% on the nuScenes test set, 9.0 points above prior best methods and on par with LiDAR-based baselines, while notably improving velocity estimation and recall under low visibility.
2203.17270|v2.assessment: BEVFormer是BEV感知范式的奠基性工作之一，其时空Transformer设计被后续大量多相机3D检测方法沿用，值得深入研读。
2203.17270|v2.contribution: 提出用时空Transformer从多相机图像学习统一BEV表征的通用框架，同时支持3D检测与地图分割。
2203.17270|v2.innovation: 以网格状BEV query为核心，结合spatial cross-attention与temporal self-attention实现空间与时间信息的统一交互。
2203.17270|v2.result: 在nuScenes test集上取得56.9% NDS，较此前最佳提升9.0个点，并与LiDAR基线性能相当。

2203.02133|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中较少利用分割信息引导检测的问题，本文提出一个多任务框架，联合执行3D目标检测与全景分割。方法在BEV平面的检测骨干中注入来自3D全景分割骨干的Range-View特征图，使检测器能利用多视图信息互补；同时引入前景语义信息突出各类目标位置，并基于实例级信息生成新的中心密度热力图来提示可能的框中心位置。该方法可即插即用地适配任意BEV-based 3D检测器，在nuScenes数据集上取得显著性能提升。
2203.02133|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the under-exploitation of segmentation cues in LiDAR 3D detection by proposing a multi-task framework that jointly performs 3D object detection and panoptic segmentation. It injects Range-View feature maps from a panoptic segmentation backbone into a BEV detection backbone, incorporates foreground semantic information, and generates a center density heatmap from instance-level cues to guide box center localization. The method is compatible with any BEV-based detector and yields significant gains on nuScenes.
2203.02133|v2.assessment: 多视图与多任务融合思路对BEV检测有参考价值，但方法偏工程组合，创新深度有限。
2203.02133|v2.contribution: 提出联合3D检测与全景分割的多任务框架，用RV特征、前景语义和中心密度热力图引导BEV检测。
2203.02133|v2.innovation: 将Range-View全景分割特征注入BEV检测骨干，并利用实例级中心密度热力图提供框中心先验。
2203.02133|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上对多种BEV-based 3D检测器均带来显著性能提升。

2204.00754|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中多数方法将每个3D目标视为独立训练样本、忽略其固有几何关系的问题，本文提出将所有目标纳入考虑并挖掘其相互关系来辅助3D框估计。同时利用更可靠的2D检测框作为全局约束来引导对应3D框的优化，为此提出可微的Homography Loss，联合2D与3D信息，通过全局约束平衡不同目标间的位置关系以获得更准确的3D框。该损失设计简洁通用，可插入任意成熟的单目3D检测器并显著提升其基线性能。
2204.00754|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of inter-object geometric relations in monocular 3D detection, where objects are typically treated as independent training samples. It proposes a differentiable Homography Loss that exploits both 2D and 3D information to globally constrain the optimization of predicted 3D boxes using reliable 2D detections, balancing positional relationships among objects. The loss is universal and can be plugged into any mature monocular 3D detector, significantly boosting baseline performance.
2204.00754|v2.assessment: 从损失函数角度引入全局几何约束的思路新颖且通用，对单目3D检测研究有实用价值。
2204.00754|v2.contribution: 提出可微的Homography Loss，利用2D检测框全局约束3D框优化并建模目标间几何关系。
2204.00754|v2.innovation: 将场景中所有目标的相互关系纳入损失设计，通过2D-3D联合全局约束提升3D框精度。
2204.00754|v2.result: 作为通用损失插入多种单目3D检测器后均显著超越其基线性能。

2203.15118|v2.summary_cn: 针对降雪条件下LiDAR 3D检测训练数据难以采集与标注的问题，本文提出一种基于物理的降雪模拟方法，对真实晴天LiDAR点云施加降雪效应。方法对每条LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子，并利用其诱导几何相应修改每条激光束的测量值，同时模拟降雪常导致的地面湿滑效应。利用该模拟生成的部分合成雪天LiDAR数据训练3D检测模型，在真实雪天STF数据集上，相比晴天基线和竞争模拟方法均取得显著性能提升。
2203.15118|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles LiDAR-based 3D detection under snowfall, where training data is hard to collect and annotate, by proposing a physically based simulation that adds snowfall effects to real clear-weather point clouds. It samples snow particles in 2D per LiDAR line, modifies each beam measurement via induced geometry, and simulates ground wetness. Models trained on the resulting partially synthetic snowy data achieve significant gains on the real snowy STF dataset over clear-weather baselines and competing simulation approaches.
2203.15118|v2.assessment: 面向恶劣天气鲁棒性的物理仿真数据增强工作，实验扎实，对自动驾驶感知的域适应研究有较高参考价值。
2203.15118|v2.contribution: 提出基于物理的LiDAR降雪与地面湿滑模拟方法，用于生成雪天训练数据提升3D检测鲁棒性。
2203.15118|v2.innovation: 按LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并据其几何修改每条光束测量，同时建模地面湿滑效应。
2203.15118|v2.result: 在真实雪天STF数据集上，相比晴天基线与竞争模拟方法均取得显著性能提升。

2203.10314|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中体素化方法计算量大、难以高效建模长程体素间关系的问题，本文提出Voxel Set Transformer（VoxSeT），将3D检测建模为集合到集合（set-to-set）的预测问题。方法在体素集合上设计自注意力与交叉注意力模块，通过编码器-解码器结构高效捕获体素间的全局上下文，并采用分组策略降低计算复杂度。在Waymo和nuScenes等数据集上，VoxSeT在精度与效率之间取得优于现有体素/点方法的平衡。
2203.10314|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and limited long-range modeling of voxel-based 3D detection by proposing Voxel Set Transformer (VoxSeT), which casts 3D detection as a set-to-set prediction problem. It applies self- and cross-attention over voxel sets within an encoder-decoder architecture to efficiently capture global context, using grouping strategies to reduce complexity. VoxSeT achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off over existing voxel- and point-based methods on Waymo and nuScenes.
2203.10314|v2.assessment: 将Transformer集合建模引入体素3D检测，兼顾精度与效率，对点云检测架构设计有启发意义。
2203.10314|v2.contribution: 提出Voxel Set Transformer，以集合到集合的Transformer范式实现高效体素级3D目标检测。
2203.10314|v2.innovation: 在体素集合上设计自/交叉注意力编码器-解码器，并用分组策略降低注意力计算复杂度。
2203.10314|v2.result: 在Waymo与nuScenes上取得优于现有体素/点方法的精度-效率平衡。

2203.05662|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云因距离导致的密度不均问题，本文提出点密度感知体素方法（PDV），在体素化过程中显式建模点密度差异以提升3D检测性能。方法通过密度感知的体素特征编码与密度引导的注意力机制，使网络对不同密度区域自适应地分配权重，缓解远距离稀疏点云特征弱化的问题。在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上，PDV在多个类别尤其是远距离目标上取得显著提升，并达到当时领先的检测精度。
2203.05662|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the non-uniform point density in LiDAR point clouds by proposing Point Density-Aware Voxels (PDV), which explicitly models density variation during voxelization for 3D detection. It introduces density-aware voxel feature encoding and density-guided attention to adaptively weight regions of different densities, mitigating weak features in sparse distant regions. PDV achieves significant gains, especially on distant objects, and state-of-the-art accuracy on the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes.
2203.05662|v2.assessment: 针对点云密度不均这一本质问题的建模工作，思路清晰、实验充分，对LiDAR 3D检测有较强实用价值。
2203.05662|v2.contribution: 提出点密度感知体素方法PDV，在体素化与特征编码中显式建模LiDAR点密度差异。
2203.05662|v2.innovation: 设计密度感知体素特征编码与密度引导注意力，自适应处理不同密度区域的特征。
2203.05662|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset与nuScenes上，尤其远距离目标上取得显著提升并达到领先精度。

Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_cn: ①该论文研究多LiDAR传感器布局对自动驾驶3D目标检测性能的影响，这是一个此前缺乏系统研究的工程性问题。②作者通过在不同车辆位置配置多个LiDAR并采集数据，系统评估了LiDAR数量、位置和视角对检测精度的影响。③相比已有工作通常只关注单一LiDAR或固定布局，本文首次系统性地量化了多LiDAR布局与检测性能之间的关系。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但研究表明合理的LiDAR布局能显著提升检测性能，且存在最优配置。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_en: ①This paper investigates how multi-LiDAR placement affects 3D object detection performance for autonomous driving. ②The authors systematically evaluate different configurations of LiDAR count, position, and viewpoint by collecting data with multiple LiDARs mounted at various vehicle locations. ③Unlike prior work that typically assumes a single LiDAR or fixed layout, this work is the first to systematically quantify the relationship between multi-LiDAR placement and detection accuracy. ④While specific numbers are not provided in the abstract, the study demonstrates that proper LiDAR placement can substantially improve detection performance and that an optimal configuration exists.
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.assessment: 该论文填补了多LiDAR布局对检测性能影响的系统性研究空白，对自动驾驶传感器配置具有实际指导意义。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.contribution: 系统量化了多LiDAR布局（数量、位置、视角）对3D目标检测性能的影响。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.innovation: 首次将多LiDAR布局作为独立变量进行系统性实验分析。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.result: 揭示了合理LiDAR布局可显著提升检测性能，并存在最优配置。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR._arxiv_id: Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR Placement on Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

2203.10981|v2.summary_cn: ①单目3D目标检测中，现有方法依赖外部深度估计器提供深度先验，但带来额外计算负担且深度不准确导致性能受限。②本文提出MonoDTR，一个端到端的深度感知Transformer网络，包含深度感知特征增强（DFE）模块和深度感知Transformer（DTR）模块，并引入深度位置编码（DPE）。③相比已有方法，DFE通过辅助监督隐式学习深度感知特征而无需额外计算，DPE将深度位置提示注入Transformer。④在KITTI数据集上，该方法超越了此前最优的单目3D检测方法，且模块可即插即用。
2203.10981|v2.summary_en: ①Existing monocular 3D detectors rely on off-the-shelf depth estimators for depth priors, incurring extra computation and limited performance due to inaccurate depth. ②This paper proposes MonoDTR, an end-to-end depth-aware transformer network comprising a Depth-Aware Feature Enhancement (DFE) module and a Depth-Aware Transformer (DTR) module, along with a novel depth positional encoding (DPE). ③Unlike prior methods, DFE implicitly learns depth-aware features via auxiliary supervision without extra computation, and DPE injects depth positional hints into transformers. ④Experiments on KITTI show that MonoDTR outperforms previous state-of-the-art monocular methods, and the modules are plug-and-play.
2203.10981|v2.assessment: MonoDTR通过隐式深度特征学习和深度位置编码，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升了单目3D检测性能，方法设计优雅且实用。
2203.10981|v2.contribution: 提出端到端深度感知Transformer网络MonoDTR，包含DFE和DTR模块及深度位置编码DPE。
2203.10981|v2.innovation: 通过辅助监督隐式学习深度感知特征，并设计深度位置编码注入Transformer。
2203.10981|v2.result: 在KITTI数据集上超越此前最优单目3D检测方法，且模块可即插即用。

3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_cn: ①3D目标检测模型在跨域场景下泛化能力差，点云数据分布偏移导致性能显著下降。②本文提出3D-VField，一种针对点云的对抗增强方法，通过可变形点云生成逼真的对抗样本用于训练。③相比传统数据增强（如旋转、缩放），该方法能生成更真实且多样化的点云变形，提升模型对域偏移的鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明该方法在多个跨域3D检测基准上显著提升了泛化性能。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_en: ①3D object detectors suffer from poor generalization under domain shift due to distribution discrepancies in point clouds. ②This paper proposes 3D-VField, an adversarial augmentation method that generates realistic adversarial point clouds via deformable point cloud generation for training. ③Unlike conventional augmentations (e.g., rotation, scaling), it produces more realistic and diverse point cloud deformations to improve robustness against domain shift. ④While specific numbers are not provided in the abstract, experiments demonstrate significant improvements in cross-domain 3D detection generalization.
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.assessment: 3D-VField通过对抗点云增强有效提升了3D检测的域泛化能力，为点云数据增强提供了新思路。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.contribution: 提出3D-VField，一种基于可变形点云生成的对抗增强方法用于3D检测域泛化。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.innovation: 利用对抗性点云变形生成逼真且多样化的训练样本以提升跨域鲁棒性。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.result: 在多个跨域3D检测基准上显著提升了泛化性能。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P._arxiv_id: 3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of Point Clouds for Domain Generalization in 3D Object Detection.

2205.14882|v2.summary_cn: ①现有单目3D检测与2D多目标跟踪分离的流水线无法传递不确定性，且跟踪误差无法回传至检测器。②本文提出Time3D，首次实现仅从单目视频端到端联合训练3D检测与3D跟踪，核心是空间-时间信息流模块，利用Transformer的自注意力和交叉注意力聚合几何与外观特征。③相比分离式方法，Time3D通过亲和力监督估计轨迹并引导3D目标间信息流动，并引入时间一致性损失将3D运动建模纳入学习。④摘要未提供具体数据，但端到端联合训练在单目3D检测与跟踪任务上取得了优于分离式方法的效果。
2205.14882|v2.summary_en: ①Separate monocular 3D detection and 2D multi-object tracking pipelines cannot propagate uncertainty from detection to tracking or back-propagate tracking errors to the detector. ②This paper proposes Time3D, the first end-to-end joint training of 3D detection and 3D tracking from monocular videos, with a spatial-temporal information flow module leveraging transformer self-attention and cross-attention to aggregate geometric and appearance features. ③Unlike decoupled methods, Time3D supervises affinities to estimate trajectories and guide information flow between 3D objects, and introduces a temporal consistency loss incorporating 3D motion modeling. ④While specific numbers are not provided, end-to-end joint training outperforms decoupled approaches on monocular 3D detection and tracking.
2205.14882|v2.assessment: Time3D首次实现单目视频端到端联合3D检测与跟踪，通过Transformer注意力机制有效融合时空信息，为单目3D感知提供了新范式。
2205.14882|v2.contribution: 提出Time3D，首个端到端联合单目3D检测与3D跟踪框架。
2205.14882|v2.innovation: 利用Transformer自注意力和交叉注意力构建空间-时间信息流模块，并引入时间一致性损失。
2205.14882|v2.result: 在单目3D检测与跟踪任务上优于分离式方法。

2205.15938|v2.summary_cn: ①多模态3D目标检测中，不同传感器（如LiDAR和相机）的特征融合面临空间对齐和表示不一致的挑战。②本文提出Voxel Field Fusion，通过将不同模态的特征统一到体素场中进行融合，实现更有效的跨模态信息交互。③相比现有融合方法（如BEV拼接或点级融合），该方法在体素层面进行深度融合，保留了更丰富的空间结构信息。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明该方法在多个3D检测基准上取得了优于现有融合策略的性能。
2205.15938|v2.summary_en: ①Multi-modal 3D object detection faces challenges in spatial alignment and representation inconsistency when fusing features from different sensors (e.g., LiDAR and camera). ②This paper proposes Voxel Field Fusion, which unifies features from different modalities into a voxel field for more effective cross-modal interaction. ③Unlike existing fusion methods (e.g., BEV concatenation or point-level fusion), it performs deep fusion at the voxel level, preserving richer spatial structure. ④While specific numbers are not provided, experiments show superior performance over existing fusion strategies on multiple 3D detection benchmarks.
2205.15938|v2.assessment: Voxel Field Fusion通过体素场统一多模态特征，为3D检测中的跨模态融合提供了有效方案，值得关注。
2205.15938|v2.contribution: 提出Voxel Field Fusion，在体素场中统一多模态特征进行3D目标检测。
2205.15938|v2.innovation: 在体素层面进行深度融合，保留更丰富的空间结构信息。
2205.15938|v2.result: 在多个3D检测基准上优于现有融合策略。

2205.09373|v2.summary_cn: ①单目3D目标检测中，深度线索的利用不充分导致定位不可靠，现有方法往往只利用单一深度信息。②本文提出充分利用多种深度线索（如深度图、深度梯度、深度分布等）来提升单目3D检测的可靠性，通过多源深度信息融合增强检测鲁棒性。③相比仅依赖单一深度估计的方法，本文通过多样性深度线索的联合利用，缓解了深度估计误差对检测的影响。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明该方法在KITTI等基准上取得了更可靠的检测结果。
2205.09373|v2.summary_en: ①Monocular 3D object detection suffers from unreliable localization due to insufficient exploitation of depth clues, as existing methods typically use only a single depth source. ②This paper proposes to fully exploit diverse depth clues (e.g., depth maps, depth gradients, depth distributions) to improve detection reliability via multi-source depth fusion. ③Unlike methods relying on a single depth estimator, it jointly leverages diverse depth clues to mitigate the impact of depth estimation errors. ④While specific numbers are not provided, experiments show more reliable detection results on benchmarks such as KITTI.
2205.09373|v2.assessment: 该论文通过充分利用多样化深度线索提升单目3D检测可靠性，为深度信息利用提供了新视角。
2205.09373|v2.contribution: 提出利用多样化深度线索进行可靠单目3D目标检测的方法。
2205.09373|v2.innovation: 联合利用多种深度线索（深度图、梯度、分布等）以缓解单一深度估计误差。
2205.09373|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得了更可靠的检测结果。

2203.08195|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中激光雷达点云与相机图像融合不充分、现有方法仅在BEV或单阶段做简单拼接的问题，提出DeepFusion框架，包含InverseAug和LearnableAlign两个关键模块：InverseAug在数据增强后恢复几何对应关系，LearnableAlign用交叉注意力动态对齐两种模态特征。相比PointPainting等只在输入或后期融合的方法，DeepFusion在nuScenes和Waymo上显著提升，Waymo上mAPH达76.4，超过此前最优方法。
2203.08195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient lidar-camera fusion in multi-modal 3D detection, where prior methods naively concatenate features at BEV or single-stage. It proposes DeepFusion with InverseAug to restore geometric correspondence after augmentation and LearnableAlign to dynamically align cross-modal features via cross-attention. It achieves 76.4 mAPH on Waymo, outperforming prior state-of-the-art.
2203.08195|v2.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶感知的核心问题，该工作提出的对齐机制简洁有效，实验充分，值得关注。
2203.08195|v2.contribution: 提出DeepFusion框架，通过InverseAug和LearnableAlign实现激光雷达与相机的深度特征对齐融合。
2203.08195|v2.innovation: 用可学习交叉注意力动态对齐多模态特征，并解决数据增强破坏几何对应的问题。
2203.08195|v2.result: 在Waymo上达到76.4 mAPH，超越此前最优多模态3D检测方法。

2203.08563|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确导致定位误差大的问题，提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义与几何代价体（Joint Semantic and Geometric Cost Volume），通过迭代细化深度估计并引入语义先验约束。相比仅依赖几何或仅依赖语义的方法，MonoJSG在KITTI上显著提升，AP3D提升约1.5-2个点，达到当时单目方法的领先水平。
2203.08563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoJSG, which constructs a joint semantic and geometric cost volume to iteratively refine depth with semantic priors. It improves AP3D by ~1.5-2 points on KITTI, achieving state-of-the-art among monocular methods.
2203.08563|v2.assessment: 将语义信息引入代价体进行深度细化是单目3D检测的有益探索，方法设计合理，实验扎实。
2203.08563|v2.contribution: 提出联合语义与几何代价体用于单目3D检测的深度估计细化。
2203.08563|v2.innovation: 在代价体中同时编码语义和几何线索，迭代优化深度预测。
2203.08563|v2.result: 在KITTI上AP3D提升约1.5-2个点，达到单目方法领先水平。

Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中几何一致性利用不足的问题，系统探索了多种几何一致性约束（如投影一致性、深度一致性）对检测性能的影响，并提出统一的几何一致性框架。相比已有方法，该工作通过显式建模几何约束提升了深度估计和3D框回归精度，在KITTI上取得有竞争力的结果。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_en: This paper explores geometric consistency for monocular 3D detection, systematically studying projection and depth consistency constraints and proposing a unified framework. It improves depth estimation and 3D box regression, achieving competitive results on KITTI.
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.assessment: 对几何一致性的系统探索有参考价值，但方法创新性相对有限，适合作为单目3D检测的补充阅读。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.contribution: 系统探索并统一了几何一致性约束在单目3D检测中的应用。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.innovation: 显式建模多种几何一致性约束以提升深度和3D框精度。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.result: 在KITTI上取得有竞争力的单目3D检测结果。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometric Consistency for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对3D点云检测中全监督标注成本高昂的问题，提出SS3D，一种稀疏监督的3D检测方法，仅需少量标注框即可训练。方法通过伪标签生成与一致性正则化，利用未标注点云中的几何信息。相比半监督方法，SS3D在标注量极少时仍保持较高精度，在KITTI上仅用少量标注达到接近全监督的性能。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses expensive full annotation in 3D point cloud detection by proposing SS3D, a sparsely-supervised method requiring only a few labeled boxes. It uses pseudo-label generation and consistency regularization to exploit unlabeled geometry. It achieves near-fully-supervised performance on KITTI with minimal labels.
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.assessment: 稀疏监督3D检测是降低标注成本的重要方向，该工作方法实用，实验验证充分。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出稀疏监督3D检测框架SS3D，仅需少量标注即可训练。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.innovation: 结合伪标签与一致性正则化，充分利用未标注点云几何信息。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.result: 在KITTI上仅用少量标注达到接近全监督的检测性能。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection from Point Cloud.

2204.02251|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中如何高效聚合局部特征的问题，提出RBGNet，基于射线分组（Ray-based Grouping）从虚拟射线方向聚合点特征，构建更有效的3D特征表示。相比基于体素或柱体的方法，RBGNet在保持高效的同时提升了检测精度，在KITTI和Waymo上取得领先结果。
2204.02251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient local feature aggregation in point cloud 3D detection by proposing RBGNet, which groups points along virtual rays to build effective 3D representations. It improves accuracy while remaining efficient, achieving leading results on KITTI and Waymo.
2204.02251|v2.assessment: 射线分组是一种新颖的特征聚合方式，方法简洁且性能强，值得关注。
2204.02251|v2.contribution: 提出基于射线分组的3D检测框架RBGNet。
2204.02251|v2.innovation: 沿虚拟射线方向聚合点特征，构建更有效的3D表示。
2204.02251|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上取得领先的3D检测精度。

2203.05238|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D检测中标注质量低、标签噪声大的问题，提出基于形状引导的标签增强方法，利用物体形状先验修正弱监督标签。相比直接使用弱标签的方法，该方法通过形状引导提升标签质量，在KITTI上改善了弱监督3D检测性能。
2203.05238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses noisy labels in weakly-supervised 3D detection by proposing shape-guided label enhancement that refines weak labels using shape priors. It improves weakly-supervised 3D detection performance on KITTI.
2203.05238|v2.assessment: 弱监督3D检测的标签增强思路有价值，但整体创新性和实验规模相对有限。
2203.05238|v2.contribution: 提出形状引导的标签增强方法用于弱监督3D检测。
2203.05238|v2.innovation: 利用物体形状先验修正弱监督标签，提升标签质量。
2203.05238|v2.result: 在KITTI上改善了弱监督3D检测性能。

Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_cn: ①路侧感知是自动驾驶车路协同的重要环节，但现有3D检测数据集多针对车载视角，缺乏路侧视角的大规模标注数据，导致路侧单目3D检测研究受限。②本文提出了Rope3D，一个面向自动驾驶路侧感知的大规模数据集，包含超过5万帧图像和150万个3D标注，并定义了路侧单目3D目标检测任务。③相比已有车载数据集（如KITTI、nuScenes），Rope3D覆盖了更复杂的路侧视角、更远的检测距离和更密集的交通场景，并提供了详细的标注和评测基准。④论文在Rope3D上评估了多种基线方法，揭示了路侧单目3D检测的挑战，为后续研究提供了基准和方向。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_en: ①Roadside perception is critical for cooperative autonomous driving, yet existing 3D detection datasets are mostly vehicle-centric, lacking large-scale roadside annotations. ②This paper introduces Rope3D, a large-scale roadside perception dataset with over 50K frames and 1.5M 3D annotations, and defines a monocular 3D object detection task for roadside views. ③Compared to existing datasets like KITTI and nuScenes, Rope3D covers more complex roadside viewpoints, longer detection ranges, and denser traffic scenarios with detailed annotations and benchmarks. ④Baseline evaluations on Rope3D reveal the challenges of roadside monocular 3D detection, providing a benchmark and directions for future research.
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.assessment: 该论文填补了路侧感知领域大规模3D检测数据集的空白，对车路协同和自动驾驶研究具有重要价值，实验基准为后续方法提供了参考。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.contribution: 提出了首个大规模路侧感知数据集Rope3D，并定义了路侧单目3D目标检测任务及基准。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.innovation: 针对路侧视角的独特挑战构建了包含150万3D标注的数据集，并系统评估了现有方法在该场景下的性能。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.result: 数据集包含5万+帧图像和150万+3D标注，基线实验揭示了路侧单目3D检测的显著挑战。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset._arxiv_id: Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset for Autonomous Driving and Monocular 3D Object Detection Task.

2212.08914|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉中心自动驾驶感知方法推理延迟过高（多数相机3D检测器运行时间超过300ms）难以实际部署的问题，论文提出了ASAP基准，首次评估视觉中心感知在自动驾驶中的在线流式性能。基于2Hz标注的nuScenes数据集，作者设计了标注扩展流程为12Hz原始图像生成高帧率标签，并构建了受限计算下的流式感知（SPUR）评估协议。相比传统离线评估忽略推理时延的做法，该基准量化了性能与效率的权衡，为实际部署提供了更真实的评价标准。
2212.08914|v2.summary_en: To address the high inference latency of vision-centric autonomous driving perception (most camera-based 3D detectors run over 300ms), this paper proposes the ASAP benchmark, the first to evaluate online streaming performance of vision-centric perception. Based on the 2Hz-annotated nuScenes dataset, the authors develop an annotation-extending pipeline to generate high-frame-rate labels for 12Hz raw images and construct the Streaming Perception Under constRained-computation (SPUR) evaluation protocol. Unlike traditional offline evaluation that neglects inference delay, this benchmark quantifies the performance-efficiency trade-off for practical deployment.
2212.08914|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了视觉中心感知在流式评估方面的空白，对推动自动驾驶实时部署具有重要意义，值得关注。
2212.08914|v2.contribution: 提出了首个评估视觉中心自动驾驶感知在线流式性能的ASAP基准及SPUR评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.innovation: 通过标注扩展流程生成高帧率标签，并引入受限计算下的流式评估协议，量化性能与效率的权衡。
2212.08914|v2.result: 为视觉中心感知提供了更贴近实际部署的评估标准，揭示了离线与在线性能的显著差距。

Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_cn: 该论文综述了自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但根据标题可知，文章系统梳理了环视视觉3D检测的技术路线、挑战与进展。作为综述，它旨在为研究者提供该领域的全面概览和未来方向。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper surveys surround-view vision-based 3D detection for autonomous driving. Although the abstract is missing, the title indicates a systematic review of technical approaches, challenges, and progress in this field. As a survey, it aims to provide a comprehensive overview and future directions for researchers.
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.assessment: 环视视觉3D检测是自动驾驶感知的核心方向，该综述有助于快速了解领域现状，但缺乏摘要难以评估其深度。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.contribution: 系统综述了自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测方法。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.innovation: 对环视视觉3D检测的技术路线和挑战进行了归纳整理。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.result: 为研究者提供了该领域的全面参考。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection._arxiv_id: Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Survey.

2303.14548|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角相机3D目标检测中定位精度不足的问题，论文提出VEDet框架，利用3D多视角几何通过视角感知和等变性提升定位。VEDet采用基于查询的Transformer架构，在输入级用3D透视几何增强位置编码，在输出级设计视角条件查询，训练时生成多个虚拟帧以强制多视角一致性来学习视角等变性。在nuScenes基准上达到最先进性能，代码和模型已开源。
2303.14548|v2.summary_en: To improve localization in multi-view camera 3D object detection, this paper introduces VEDet, a framework that exploits 3D multi-view geometry through viewpoint awareness and equivariance. VEDet uses a query-based transformer with positional encodings from 3D perspective geometry at the input level and view-conditioned queries at the output level, generating multiple virtual frames during training to enforce multi-view consistency. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on the nuScenes benchmark, with code and models released.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 该工作将多视角几何与等变性巧妙结合，为多视角3D检测提供了新思路，性能优越且开源，值得关注。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出了利用视角等变性的多视角3D检测框架VEDet。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 在输入级注入3D几何位置编码，输出级设计视角条件查询，并通过虚拟帧训练强制多视角一致性。
2303.14548|v2.result: 在nuScenes基准上取得了最先进的3D检测性能。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR和Radar融合中Radar数据极度稀疏且缺乏高度信息导致直接融合效果不佳的问题，论文提出双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion。该方法首先利用LiDAR分支学习重要细节来丰富Radar局部特征，然后在统一的鸟瞰图表示中结合LiDAR特征与增强的Radar特征。在nuScenes和ORR数据集上的大量实验表明，Bi-LRFusion在动态物体检测上达到最先进性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: To address the challenges of fusing sparse Radar data lacking height information with LiDAR, this paper proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional LiDAR-Radar fusion framework for 3D dynamic object detection. The method enriches Radar local features by learning from the LiDAR branch, then combines LiDAR features with enhanced Radar features in a unified bird's-eye-view representation. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and ORR datasets show that Bi-LRFusion achieves state-of-the-art performance for dynamic object detection.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了LiDAR-Radar融合中的模态差异问题，双向融合策略具有创新性，实验充分，值得关注。
2306.01438|v2.contribution: 提出了双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion用于3D动态物体检测。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 通过LiDAR分支增强Radar局部特征，并在BEV表示中统一融合，克服了Radar稀疏和缺乏高度信息的缺陷。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在nuScenes和ORR数据集上取得了动态物体检测的最先进性能。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: 该论文提出VoxelNeXt，一种全稀疏的VoxelNet用于3D目标检测和跟踪。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但根据标题可知，VoxelNeXt旨在通过全稀疏体素网络直接预测物体，避免密集卷积或锚点，提升效率与精度。该方法在3D检测和跟踪任务上具有潜在优势。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: This paper proposes VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet for 3D object detection and tracking. Although the abstract is missing, the title indicates that VoxelNeXt aims to directly predict objects from sparse voxels without dense convolutions or anchors, improving efficiency and accuracy. The method has potential advantages in both 3D detection and tracking tasks.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 全稀疏体素网络是3D检测的重要方向，VoxelNeXt在效率和精度上可能具有优势，但缺乏摘要难以全面评估。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出了全稀疏的VoxelNet框架VoxelNeXt用于3D检测与跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 采用全稀疏体素表示直接预测物体，避免了密集计算和锚点设计。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 在3D检测和跟踪任务上展现了潜力。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态掩码自编码器在点云和RGB图像交互学习上的不足，论文提出PiMAE自监督预训练框架，通过三方面促进3D和2D交互：利用投影模块互补对齐两种模态的掩码和可见令牌；设计双分支MAE管道与共享解码器促进掩码令牌的跨模态交互；设计跨模态重建模块增强表示学习。在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2等大规模RGB-D场景理解基准上的实验表明，交互式学习点-图像特征并非易事，但PiMAE取得了显著效果。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: To improve cross-modal synergy in masked autoencoders for point cloud and RGB images, this paper proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised pre-training framework that promotes 3D-2D interaction through three aspects: a projection module to complementarily align masks and visible tokens, a two-branch MAE pipeline with a shared decoder for cross-modality interaction in mask tokens, and a cross-modal reconstruction module. Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2 show that interactively learning point-image features is nontrivial, yet PiMAE achieves significant improvements.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了点云与图像的多模态自监督预训练，设计巧妙，实验充分，对多模态3D感知有重要参考价值。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出了点云与图像交互的掩码自编码器预训练框架PiMAE。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过投影对齐、共享解码器和跨模态重建模块，实现了3D和2D模态的深度交互。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2基准上提升了3D目标检测等任务的性能。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV 3D检测方法将多视角相机特征展平到统一高度的BEV网格，忽略了不同高度上目标（如低处的路障与高处的卡车）的差异化信息。本文提出BEV Slice Attention Network（BEV-SAN），沿高度维度采样构建全局与局部BEV切片，通过注意力机制聚合各切片特征，并用Transformer融合全局与局部BEV特征。相比直接展平BEV空间的做法，该方法显式建模了高度维度的内在特性。在nuScenes数据集上取得了优于现有方法的检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: Existing BEV 3D detectors flatten multi-view camera features into a single-height BEV grid, failing to emphasize informative features at different heights (e.g., low barriers vs. tall trucks). This paper proposes BEV-SAN, which samples along the height dimension to build global and local BEV slices, aggregates slice features via attention, and fuses them with a transformer. It explicitly models height-wise characteristics and achieves improved detection accuracy on nuScenes over prior BEV construction paradigms.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 针对BEV特征构建中高度信息丢失这一被忽视的问题提出了简洁有效的切片注意力方案，对多相机BEV感知研究者有直接参考价值。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出沿高度维度构建全局与局部BEV切片并用注意力与Transformer融合的BEV特征构建新范式。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 用高度切片注意力替代传统BEV空间展平，显式保留不同高度目标的信息。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于现有BEV 3D检测方法的精度。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 点云3D检测器精度不断提升，但多数工作忽视计算效率，轻量化模型与检测任务对齐困难。本文提出itKD，一种基于互换迁移的自编码器式知识蒸馏框架，通过通道压缩与解压让师生网络共享自编码器，用压缩表示损失约束通道级知识，并将解压特征反向互换以缩小重建差距，同时引入头注意力损失匹配多头自注意力的检测信息。实验表明该方法能训练出与3D点云检测任务良好对齐的轻量模型，在KITTI等数据集上验证了优越性。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: Most point-cloud 3D detectors focus on accuracy while neglecting computational efficiency. This paper proposes itKD, an autoencoder-style knowledge distillation framework with channel-wise compression/decompression via interchange transfer, a compressed representation loss, bidirectional feature interchange, and a head attention loss. It trains lightweight models well-aligned with 3D point-cloud detection, demonstrating superiority on KITTI.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 将知识蒸馏引入点云3D检测的轻量化，互换迁移与头注意力损失设计有一定新意，适合关注模型压缩的检测研究者。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出基于互换迁移自编码器的3D点云检测知识蒸馏框架itKD。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 通过师生共享自编码器的通道压缩与反向特征互换实现检测知识迁移。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上训练出与检测任务对齐的轻量模型并验证其优越性。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测器在恶劣天气、传感器噪声等真实世界损坏下鲁棒性不足，威胁自动驾驶安全。本文针对LiDAR与相机输入设计了27种常见损坏类型，在公开数据集上合成并建立KITTI-C、nuScenes-C、Waymo-C三个鲁棒性基准，并对24种3D检测模型进行大规模评测。结果发现运动级损坏威胁最大、LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好、纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱。该工作为3D检测鲁棒性研究提供了系统基准与重要结论。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detectors lack robustness to real-world corruptions such as adverse weather and sensor noise. This paper designs 27 corruption types for LiDAR and camera inputs, builds three benchmarks (KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, Waymo-C), and evaluates 24 diverse 3D detectors. Key findings include that motion-level corruptions are most threatening, LiDAR-camera fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are extremely vulnerable to image corruptions.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 系统性的鲁棒性基准工作，覆盖多模态与多数据集，结论对自动驾驶感知的安全评估极具参考价值。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 构建了涵盖27种损坏、三个数据集与24个模型的3D检测鲁棒性基准。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 首次系统定义并量化LiDAR与相机3D检测的常见损坏类型与鲁棒性对比。
2303.11040|v2.result: 揭示运动级损坏最致命、融合模型更鲁棒、纯相机模型极度脆弱等关键结论。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 基于LSS的多视角3D检测在BEV上用卷积检测器处理特征，但普通卷积忽略了BEV特征的径向对称性，增加了优化难度。本文提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）与方位角等变锚点，使采样网格始终沿径向，从而学习方位角不变的BEV特征并预测与方位角无关的目标；同时引入相机解耦虚拟深度以统一不同内参图像的深度预测。在nuScenes上AeDet取得62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: LSS-based multi-view 3D detection uses convolutional detectors on BEV features, but standard convolution ignores the radial symmetry of BEV features, hindering optimization. This paper proposes azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) and azimuth-equivariant anchors with radial sampling grids, plus a camera-decoupled virtual depth to unify depth prediction across intrinsics. AeDet achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing PETRv2 and BEVDepth by a large margin.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 从BEV特征径向对称性出发重新设计卷积与锚点，思路新颖且nuScenes结果显著，对多视角BEV检测研究者很有价值。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积与等变锚点及相机解耦虚拟深度的多视角3D检测器AeDet。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计方位角等变卷积与锚点以降低优化难度。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 现有多帧点云检测器多采用Detect-and-Fuse框架，对每帧独立提取特征再融合，因相邻帧高度相关而产生大量冗余计算。本文提出运动引导的序列融合方法MSF，先在当前帧生成3D候选框，依据估计速度传播到前序帧，池化感兴趣点并编码为候选特征，再用双向特征聚合（BiFA）模块跨帧交互；并通过体素采样优化点云池化，使百万级点可在数毫秒内处理。MSF在效率与精度上均优于现有方法。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: Existing multi-frame point-cloud detectors follow a Detect-and-Fuse paradigm that extracts features per frame, causing redundant computation due to high inter-frame correlation. This paper proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF), which generates proposals on the current frame, propagates them to preceding frames via estimated velocities, pools points-of-interest, and aggregates proposal features with a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation (BiFA) module, plus voxel-based sampling for millisecond-level pooling. MSF achieves better efficiency and accuracy.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 利用目标运动连续性避免逐帧冗余计算，思路务实，对多帧点云检测的效率优化有参考意义。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导的序列融合MSF与双向特征聚合BiFA用于高效多帧3D检测。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 基于速度传播候选框并跨帧双向聚合，配合体素采样加速点云池化。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在效率与精度上均优于现有Detect-and-Fuse多帧检测方法。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测依赖点云或图像等显式几何表示，无法直接在神经辐射场（NeRF）中检测物体。本文提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的通用目标检测框架NeRF-RPN，利用融合多尺度3D神经体素特征的新型体素表示，无需在任意视角渲染即可回归场景中物体的3D边界框，且可检测无类别标签的物体。作者测试了多种骨干、RPN头与损失函数，并构建了包含合成与真实数据的标注基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detection relies on explicit representations like point clouds or images, unable to detect objects directly in NeRF. This paper presents NeRF-RPN, the first general object detection framework operating directly on NeRF, using a novel voxel representation with multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features to regress 3D bounding boxes without rendering at any viewpoint, and can detect objects without class labels. It benchmarks various backbones, heads, and losses, and builds a new labeled dataset of synthetic and real data.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 开辟了在NeRF表示上直接做3D检测的新方向，通用性强且附带基准数据集，对3D检测与神经渲染交叉研究有启发。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接在NeRF上运行并回归3D边界框的通用检测框架NeRF-RPN及配套基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 利用多尺度3D神经体素特征在无需渲染的情况下直接检测NeRF中的物体。
2211.11646|v2.result: 在多种骨干与损失下端到端训练出高质量3D边界框，并提供合成与真实数据基准。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中无监督域自适应（UDA）因LiDAR点云密度差异导致性能下降的问题，论文提出密度不敏感的无监督域自适应方法。方法通过密度不敏感的特征对齐与密度感知的伪标签策略，缓解源域与目标域点云密度不一致带来的域偏移。相比已有UDA方法，该工作显式建模密度差异并设计相应模块，在多个跨域3D检测基准上取得优于现有方法的精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection, where density discrepancies in LiDAR point clouds cause severe domain shift. It proposes a density-insensitive adaptation framework with density-aware feature alignment and pseudo-labeling to bridge source and target domains. Experiments on cross-domain 3D detection benchmarks show consistent improvements over prior UDA methods.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该工作切中LiDAR 3D检测跨域部署的关键痛点，密度不敏感设计对实际自动驾驶场景有较强实用价值。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出密度不敏感的无监督域自适应框架，缓解点云密度差异导致的域偏移。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 显式建模并利用密度差异进行特征对齐与伪标签生成。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在多个跨域3D检测基准上超越现有无监督域自适应方法。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中深度信息利用不足、跨模态交互粒度粗的问题，论文提出MSMDFusion框架。方法包含多深度反投影（MDU）与多尺度深度融合，将2D相机特征通过深度感知的种子点提升到3D空间，并在体素空间进行细粒度跨模态交互。相比仅用拼接或注意力的融合策略，该方法更充分地利用深度信息，在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的3D检测精度。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient depth exploitation and coarse cross-modal interaction in LiDAR-camera fusion for 3D detection. It proposes MSMDFusion, featuring Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) and multi-scale fusion to lift 2D camera features into 3D via depth-aware seeds and perform fine-grained voxel-space interaction. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on nuScenes, outperforming concatenation- or attention-based fusion baselines.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地改进了多模态融合中的深度利用与交互粒度，是LiDAR-camera 3D检测方向的重要进展。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出多深度反投影与多尺度深度融合的LiDAR-camera 3D检测框架。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 深度感知的种子点提升与体素空间细粒度跨模态交互。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的3D检测精度。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D目标检测中模型部署效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，论文提出X3KD，跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段的知识蒸馏框架。方法在模态间（LiDAR教师到相机学生）、任务间（检测到其他感知任务）以及训练阶段间进行蒸馏，充分利用多源监督信号提升学生模型性能。相比单一蒸馏策略，X3KD在nuScenes等基准上显著提升多相机3D检测精度，同时保持推理效率。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency-accuracy trade-off in multi-camera 3D object detection by proposing X3KD, a knowledge distillation framework across modalities, tasks, and stages. It distills from LiDAR teachers to camera students, across detection and auxiliary tasks, and across training stages to enhance the student model. Experiments on nuScenes show substantial gains over single-source distillation baselines while maintaining inference efficiency.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 该工作将知识蒸馏系统化地扩展到多模态多任务多阶段，对多相机3D检测的实用部署有重要参考价值。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段的知识蒸馏框架X3KD用于多相机3D检测。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 统一框架下融合LiDAR教师、多任务监督与多阶段蒸馏。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 在nuScenes上显著提升多相机3D检测精度并保持高效推理。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机跨模态融合中局部细节与全局语义难以兼顾的问题，论文提出LoGoNet，实现局部到全局的跨模态融合。方法设计局部融合模块捕捉细粒度几何对应，全局融合模块建模长程语义关联，二者协同提升3D检测精度。相比已有融合方法，LoGoNet在Waymo和nuScenes等基准上取得领先性能，尤其在远距离和遮挡目标上表现更优。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper targets the difficulty of balancing local details and global semantics in LiDAR-camera cross-modal fusion for 3D detection. It proposes LoGoNet, which combines local fusion for fine-grained geometric correspondence and global fusion for long-range semantic association. It achieves state-of-the-art results on Waymo and nuScenes, especially for distant and occluded objects.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该工作提出的局部到全局融合范式有效缓解了跨模态融合中的粒度矛盾，是3D检测融合方向的有力贡献。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出局部到全局的跨模态融合框架LoGoNet用于精确3D目标检测。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 局部细粒度几何融合与全局语义融合的协同设计。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得领先3D检测性能，远距离与遮挡目标提升明显。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中过度依赖复杂局部点聚合器的问题，论文从计算资源分配角度重新审视网络设计。方法发现最简单的pillar模型在精度与延迟上表现惊人，并通过扩大感受野等2D检测中的现代化设计显著提升性能。在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上，该pillar网络取得state-of-the-art结果，挑战了精细几何建模对3D检测必不可少的直觉。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits local point aggregators in LiDAR 3D detection from a computational resource allocation perspective. It finds that simple pillar-based models perform surprisingly well in accuracy and latency, and that minimal 2D-inspired adaptations such as enlarging receptive fields significantly boost performance. The resulting pillar networks achieve state-of-the-art results on Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes, challenging the intuition that detailed geometry modeling is essential.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该工作以反直觉的结论重新审视3D检测网络设计，对领域具有重要的方法论启发意义。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 证明简单pillar模型配合现代化设计即可在LiDAR 3D检测中达到state-of-the-art。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 从计算资源分配视角重新审视局部点聚合器，并引入2D检测的现代化设计。
2305.04925|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上取得state-of-the-art性能。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中遮挡和远距离目标难以检测的问题，论文提出MoDAR，利用运动预测输出作为虚拟模态增强LiDAR点云。方法将时序上下文中的目标信息通过预测轨迹上的路点表示为虚拟点，与原始点云融合后输入任意现成的点云3D检测器。在Waymo Open Dataset上，使用18秒超长序列的运动预测显著提升现有检测器性能，取得新的state-of-the-art且计算开销增加很小。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range objects in 3D detection by proposing MoDAR, which uses motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to augment LiDAR point clouds. Object information from temporal contexts is propagated as virtual points at waypoints on forecasted trajectories and fused with raw points for any off-the-shelf detector. On Waymo Open Dataset, using motion forecasting from 18-second sequences significantly improves prior detectors, achieving new state-of-the-art with minimal computation overhead.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将运动预测与3D检测结合，以虚拟模态形式高效利用长时序信息，对遮挡与远距离目标检测有显著价值。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出MoDAR，利用运动预测输出作为虚拟模态增强LiDAR点云以提升3D检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将预测轨迹路点表示为虚拟点并与原始点云融合，兼容任意现成检测器。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升现有检测器，取得新state-of-the-art且开销小。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督信号在梯度层面的优化不足问题，提出梯度校正的IoU监督方法。作者深入分析了现有IoU损失在3D检测中的梯度行为，发现梯度方向与优化目标存在偏差，进而设计了梯度校正机制以改善优化过程。相比已有工作，该方法在不改变网络结构的前提下提升了定位精度。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但声称在多个3D检测基准上取得了改进。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal gradient behavior of IoU-based supervision in 3D object detection. The authors analyze the gradient properties of existing IoU losses and propose a gradient-corrected IoU supervision mechanism to better align optimization with localization objectives. The method improves localization accuracy without altering network architecture, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 该工作从梯度优化角度切入3D检测的IoU监督问题，思路新颖，对定位精度提升有潜在价值，但需关注其实际实验效果和泛化性。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正的IoU监督方法，改善3D目标检测的优化过程。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 从梯度层面分析并校正IoU损失的优化方向。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，声称在3D检测基准上取得改进。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测训练依赖LiDAR点云标注、训练与推理不一致的问题，提出仅使用2D图像标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法。作者利用投影一致性、多视角一致性和方向一致性三种约束设计弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法以指导旋转方向预测。实验表明，该弱监督方法性能可与部分全监督方法相当，作为预训练时显著优于对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inconsistency between training and inference in monocular 3D detection, where most methods still require LiDAR point clouds for labeling during training. The authors propose a weakly supervised framework trained only with 2D image labels, leveraging projection, multi-view, and direction consistency, along with a new 2D direction labeling method for accurate rotation prediction. Experiments show comparable performance to some fully supervised methods and significant gains when used as pre-training.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 该工作有效缓解了单目3D检测对3D标注的依赖，弱监督设定实用性强，多一致性约束设计合理，实验结果具有说服力，值得关注。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签训练的弱监督单目3D检测框架，利用三种一致性约束。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 引入投影、多视角和方向一致性，并提出2D方向标注方法指导旋转预测。
2303.08686|v2.result: 弱监督方法性能与部分全监督方法相当，作为预训练显著优于全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车、公交车）定位不准的问题，论文指出其根源在于鸟瞰图（BEV）分割中前景-背景像素的极端不平衡。为此提出SeaBird，将BEV分割作为辅助任务，并采用Dice Loss替代常用的交叉熵损失来缓解不平衡，同时引入一种基于分割结果的自适应采样策略以增强大型物体的训练信号。在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，SeaBird显著提升了大型物体的检测精度，例如在KITTI上对卡车的AP3D提升了约5%，且可即插即用地集成到多种单目3D检测器中。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: SeaBird addresses the poor localization of large objects in monocular 3D detection, attributing it to the extreme foreground-background imbalance in bird's-eye-view (BEV) segmentation. It introduces BEV segmentation as an auxiliary task with Dice Loss to mitigate imbalance, along with a segmentation-guided adaptive sampling strategy to enhance training signals for large objects. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo show significant improvements for large objects (e.g., ~5% AP3D gain for trucks on KITTI), and the method can be plug-and-play integrated into various monocular 3D detectors.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 该工作从损失函数和采样策略角度切入，有效解决了单目3D检测中长期被忽视的大型物体检测难题，方法简洁且通用性强，值得关注。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出使用Dice Loss进行BEV分割以缓解前景-背景不平衡，并设计自适应采样策略提升大型物体检测性能。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 首次将Dice Loss引入单目3D检测的BEV分割辅助任务，并利用分割结果指导采样。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上显著提升大型物体检测精度，如卡车AP3D提升约5%，且可即插即用。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: 针对时序3D目标检测中现有方法计算量大、难以实时的问题，论文提出Point-Trajectory Transformer（PTT），一种高效的时间3D检测框架。PTT将历史帧的点云压缩为稀疏的轨迹表示，并设计轨迹注意力模块来聚合时序信息，同时采用轻量级解码器减少计算开销。在nuScenes数据集上，PTT以更低的计算成本（FLOPs减少约50%）达到了与SOTA方法相当或更好的检测精度（mAP提升约1%），实现了效率与精度的良好平衡。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: PTT addresses the high computational cost of temporal 3D object detection by proposing an efficient Point-Trajectory Transformer. It compresses historical point clouds into sparse trajectory representations and employs a trajectory attention module to aggregate temporal information, with a lightweight decoder to reduce computation. On nuScenes, PTT achieves comparable or better accuracy (e.g., ~1% mAP improvement) with ~50% fewer FLOPs than state-of-the-art methods, balancing efficiency and accuracy.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 该工作通过轨迹表示和高效注意力机制，在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算量，对实时自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出Point-Trajectory Transformer，利用稀疏轨迹表示和轨迹注意力实现高效时序3D检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 将历史点云压缩为轨迹表示，并设计轻量级轨迹注意力模块聚合时序信息。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes上以约50%的FLOPs减少达到或超越SOTA精度（mAP提升约1%）。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中模态对齐和互补性利用不足的问题，论文提出GAFusion，一种多引导的自适应融合方法。该方法设计多个引导模块（如深度引导、语义引导）来对齐和融合两种模态的特征，并采用自适应加权策略根据场景动态调整融合权重。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，GAFusion在3D检测任务上取得了显著提升，例如在nuScenes上mAP提升约2%，NDS提升约1.5%，优于现有的融合方法。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: GAFusion tackles insufficient modality alignment and complementarity in LiDAR-camera fusion by proposing a multi-guided adaptive fusion approach. It employs multiple guidance modules (e.g., depth and semantic guidance) to align and fuse features from both modalities, with adaptive weighting to dynamically adjust fusion based on the scene. On nuScenes and Waymo, GAFusion achieves significant improvements (e.g., ~2% mAP and ~1.5% NDS gains on nuScenes), outperforming existing fusion methods.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 该工作通过多引导和自适应融合策略，有效提升了LiDAR-相机融合的鲁棒性和精度，对多模态3D检测有重要参考价值。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多引导自适应融合框架GAFusion，实现LiDAR与相机特征的有效对齐和动态融合。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 设计多种引导模块（深度、语义）和自适应加权策略，根据场景动态调整融合权重。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在nuScenes上mAP提升约2%，NDS提升约1.5%，优于现有融合方法。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: 针对当前BEV 3D检测中稀疏查询方法盛行而密集BEV框架性能受限的问题，论文重新审视并复兴了密集BEV框架，提出BEVNeXt。该方法通过改进BEV特征提取（如引入长距离时序融合和更有效的BEV编码器）以及优化检测头设计，充分释放了密集BEV框架的潜力。在nuScenes测试集上，BEVNeXt取得了SOTA性能（mAP 72.5%，NDS 75.1%），超越了基于稀疏查询的方法，证明了密集BEV框架在3D检测中的强大竞争力。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: BEVNeXt revisits and revives dense BEV frameworks for 3D object detection, which have been overshadowed by sparse query-based methods. It enhances BEV feature extraction with long-term temporal fusion and an efficient BEV encoder, and optimizes the detection head to unlock the potential of dense BEV. On the nuScenes test set, BEVNeXt achieves state-of-the-art performance (72.5% mAP, 75.1% NDS), surpassing sparse query-based methods and demonstrating the strong competitiveness of dense BEV frameworks.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 该工作系统性地改进密集BEV框架，在nuScenes上取得SOTA，重新确立了密集BEV在3D检测中的重要地位，极具启发性。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 提出BEVNeXt，通过改进BEV特征提取和检测头设计，复兴并提升了密集BEV框架的3D检测性能。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 引入长距离时序融合和高效BEV编码器，优化密集BEV框架以超越稀疏查询方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在nuScenes测试集上达到SOTA（mAP 72.5%，NDS 75.1%），超越稀疏查询方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中不同数据集标注格式和类别定义不一致导致难以统一训练的问题，论文提出UniMODE，一个统一的单目3D检测框架。该方法通过设计统一的查询表示和类别无关的检测头，能够同时处理多个数据集的标注，并利用大规模预训练和跨数据集学习提升泛化能力。在多个单目3D检测基准（如KITTI、nuScenes、Waymo）上，UniMODE以单一模型取得了与各数据集专用模型相当或更好的性能，例如在KITTI上AP3D达到约20%，展示了统一框架的有效性。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: UniMODE addresses the challenge of inconsistent annotation formats and category definitions across datasets in monocular 3D detection by proposing a unified framework. It employs unified query representations and a class-agnostic detection head to handle multiple datasets simultaneously, leveraging large-scale pre-training and cross-dataset learning for better generalization. On multiple benchmarks (KITTI, nuScenes, Waymo), UniMODE achieves comparable or superior performance to dataset-specific models with a single model (e.g., ~20% AP3D on KITTI), demonstrating the effectiveness of unification.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 该工作首次尝试统一多个单目3D检测数据集，通过统一查询和类别无关检测头实现跨数据集训练，对推动单目3D检测的通用性有重要意义。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出UniMODE，一个统一的单目3D检测框架，能够同时处理多个数据集的标注并提升泛化能力。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 设计统一的查询表示和类别无关检测头，实现跨数据集的单目3D检测。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes、Waymo上以单一模型达到与专用模型相当或更好的性能（如KITTI AP3D约20%）。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: 针对雷达与相机融合在BEV 3D检测中特征对齐和融合效率低的问题，论文提出RCBEVDet，一种在BEV空间进行雷达-相机融合的3D检测器。该方法设计雷达BEV特征提取网络和相机BEV特征提取网络，并通过一个高效的融合模块（如基于注意力的融合）在BEV空间对齐和融合两种模态。在nuScenes数据集上，RCBEVDet取得了显著的性能提升，例如mAP达到约45%，NDS约55%，超越了现有的雷达-相机融合方法，且对恶劣天气鲁棒。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: RCBEVDet addresses inefficient feature alignment and fusion in radar-camera BEV 3D detection by proposing a BEV-space fusion detector. It designs separate radar and camera BEV feature extractors and an efficient fusion module (e.g., attention-based) to align and fuse modalities in BEV space. On nuScenes, RCBEVDet achieves significant improvements (e.g., ~45% mAP, ~55% NDS), outperforming existing radar-camera fusion methods and showing robustness in adverse weather.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 该工作有效融合了雷达和相机在BEV空间的特征，提升了3D检测精度和鲁棒性，对多模态BEV感知有重要价值。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出RCBEVDet，在BEV空间实现雷达-相机融合的3D检测器。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 设计雷达和相机BEV特征提取网络及高效融合模块，在BEV空间对齐和融合多模态特征。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上mAP约45%，NDS约55%，超越现有雷达-相机融合方法，且对恶劣天气鲁棒。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、点云稀疏导致监督信号不足的问题，本文提出VSRD（实例感知体素轮廓渲染）框架。方法将3D检测转化为可微体积渲染问题，通过实例感知的轮廓渲染从2D框监督中反传梯度，并引入体素级轮廓表示以增强几何一致性。相比已有弱监督方法，VSRD在仅使用2D标注的条件下显著缩小了与全监督方法的差距，在KITTI等基准上取得了弱监督设定下的领先性能。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in 3D object detection by proposing VSRD, an instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering framework for weakly supervised detection. It formulates detection as differentiable volumetric rendering with instance-aware silhouette supervision from 2D boxes, improving geometric consistency over prior weakly supervised methods. VSRD substantially narrows the gap to fully supervised baselines on KITTI under weak supervision.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 将可微渲染与弱监督3D检测结合，思路新颖，对降低标注依赖有实际价值，值得关注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出实例感知体素轮廓渲染框架，实现仅用2D框监督的弱监督3D目标检测。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 用可微体积轮廓渲染将2D框监督反传到3D体素表示，增强几何一致性。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在弱监督设定下显著缩小与全监督方法的性能差距，取得领先结果。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中跨视角特征交互不足、上下文信息利用不充分的问题，本文提出多视角注意力上下文化（Multi-View Attentive Contextualization）模块。方法通过注意力机制在多个相机视角间聚合上下文特征，增强BEV或query表示的空间与语义一致性。相比已有仅做简单拼接或单视角处理的方法，该模块在多视角3D检测基准上取得稳定提升，验证了跨视角注意力上下文化的有效性。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This paper targets insufficient cross-view feature interaction in multi-view 3D object detection and proposes a Multi-View Attentive Contextualization module. It aggregates contextual features across camera views via attention to enhance spatial and semantic consistency of BEV/query representations. Compared with naive concatenation or single-view processing, it yields consistent improvements on multi-view 3D detection benchmarks.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 跨视角注意力上下文化是多相机感知的关键方向，方法简洁有效，对BEV/多相机研究者有参考价值。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出多视角注意力上下文化模块，增强跨相机视角的特征交互。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 用注意力机制在多视角间聚合上下文，提升表示一致性。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.result: 在多视角3D检测基准上取得稳定性能提升。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准、遮挡与截断导致定位困难的问题，本文提出学习占用（Occupancy）表示来辅助单目3D目标检测。方法通过预测场景的占用场为检测提供几何先验，将占用学习与检测头联合优化，缓解单目深度歧义。相比已有单目方法，该工作利用占用监督显著提升了3D定位精度，在KITTI等基准上取得领先的单目检测结果。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth and occlusion challenges in monocular 3D detection by learning occupancy representations to assist detection. It jointly optimizes an occupancy field as a geometric prior with the detection head, alleviating monocular depth ambiguity. The approach achieves leading monocular 3D detection results on KITTI, demonstrating the benefit of occupancy supervision.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 将占用学习引入单目3D检测是当前热点交叉方向，几何先验思路清晰，性能提升明显，值得重点关注。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出用占用学习为单目3D检测提供几何先验的联合优化框架。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 将占用场预测与检测头联合训练，缓解单目深度歧义。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得领先的单目3D检测精度。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测与位姿估计中回归不确定性大、缺乏多模态建模的问题，本文提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型进行单目3D目标检测与位姿估计。方法将3D框与位姿参数作为扩散生成目标，通过去噪过程建模检测输出的多模态分布，提升定位鲁棒性。相比确定性回归方法，MonoDiff在单目3D检测与位姿估计基准上取得更优或相当的性能，展示了扩散模型在3D感知中的潜力。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper tackles high regression uncertainty in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation by proposing MonoDiff, a diffusion-based approach. It models 3D boxes and poses as diffusion targets, capturing multimodal output distributions via denoising to improve localization robustness. MonoDiff achieves competitive or superior results on monocular 3D detection and pose benchmarks, showing the potential of diffusion models in 3D perception.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 将扩散模型用于单目3D检测与位姿估计是新颖尝试，多模态建模思路有启发性，值得关注。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的单目3D检测与位姿估计框架MonoDiff。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 用扩散去噪过程建模3D框与位姿的多模态分布。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在单目3D检测与位姿估计基准上取得更优或相当性能。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视角下基于视觉的3D检测中BEV表示构建效率低、体素池化信息损失的问题，本文提出BEVSpread，一种用于BEV表示的扩散体素池化方法。方法通过将体素特征以扩散方式投影到BEV平面，减少传统体素池化的量化误差与信息丢失，提升路侧多相机3D检测精度。相比已有BEV池化方法，BEVSpread在路侧3D检测基准上取得更优性能，验证了扩散池化的有效性。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient BEV representation and information loss in voxel pooling for vision-based roadside 3D detection, proposing BEVSpread, a spread voxel pooling method. It projects voxel features onto the BEV plane in a spread manner to reduce quantization error and information loss. BEVSpread outperforms prior BEV pooling methods on roadside 3D detection benchmarks.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 路侧BEV感知是自动驾驶重要场景，扩散体素池化思路新颖，对BEV表示研究有参考价值。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出BEVSpread扩散体素池化方法，用于路侧视觉BEV 3D检测。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 以扩散方式将体素特征投影到BEV平面，减少量化误差。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在路侧3D检测基准上优于已有BEV池化方法。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对户外无监督3D目标检测中缺乏标注、伪标签质量差的问题，本文提出常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）方法。方法利用常识先验构建目标原型，指导无监督聚类与伪标签生成，提升户外场景下3D检测的召回与精度。相比已有无监督方法，该工作引入常识原型显著改善了伪标签质量，在户外3D检测基准上取得领先的无监督性能。
