Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper targets poor pseudo-label quality in outdoor unsupervised 3D object detection by proposing a Commonsense Prototype approach. It leverages commonsense priors to build object prototypes that guide unsupervised clustering and pseudo-label generation. Compared with prior unsupervised methods, it substantially improves pseudo-label quality and achieves leading unsupervised performance on outdoor 3D detection benchmarks.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 将常识先验引入无监督3D检测是新颖角度，对降低标注依赖、提升伪标签质量有实际意义。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出常识原型方法用于户外无监督3D目标检测。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 利用常识先验构建目标原型指导无监督聚类与伪标签生成。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在户外3D检测基准上取得领先的无监督检测性能。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中标注稀少导致训练信号不足的问题，提出HINTED框架。方法上通过混合密度特征融合（Mixed-Density Feature Fusion）增强稀疏区域的特征表达，并设计难例增强检测器（Hard Instance Enhanced Detector）挖掘高价值稀疏监督样本。相比已有稀疏监督方法，其改进在于显式建模难例并融合不同密度点云特征。在稀疏标注基准上取得显著提升，验证了难例挖掘与密度融合的有效性。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses sparsely-supervised 3D object detection where limited annotations yield weak training signals. It proposes HINTED, which combines mixed-density feature fusion with a hard-instance enhanced detector to exploit informative sparse samples. Compared with prior sparsely-supervised methods, it explicitly mines hard instances and fuses features across point densities, achieving notable gains on sparse-annotation benchmarks.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 稀疏监督3D检测是降低标注成本的关键方向，该工作通过难例增强与密度融合提供了实用方案，值得关注。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出面向稀疏监督3D检测的难例增强与混合密度特征融合框架HINTED。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 将难例挖掘与混合密度特征融合结合以缓解稀疏标注下的训练信号不足。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在稀疏监督3D检测基准上取得显著性能提升。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足的问题，提出3DiffTection，利用几何感知的扩散特征进行3D检测。方法上从预训练扩散模型中提取几何感知特征，并将其适配到3D检测任务，实现跨域泛化。相比依赖大规模3D标注的已有方法，其改进在于借助2D扩散先验提升几何理解。在多个3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的结果，尤其在跨域场景下表现突出。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient geometric reasoning in 3D object detection by proposing 3DiffTection, which leverages geometry-aware diffusion features. It extracts geometry-aware features from pretrained diffusion models and adapts them for 3D detection to improve cross-domain generalization. Compared with methods relying on large-scale 3D annotations, it exploits 2D diffusion priors for geometry understanding, achieving competitive results especially in cross-domain settings.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型先验引入3D检测是新兴且有潜力的方向，该工作展示了跨域泛化优势，值得关注。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出利用几何感知扩散特征进行3D目标检测的3DiffTection方法。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 将预训练扩散模型的几何感知特征迁移到3D检测以增强跨域泛化。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得有竞争力结果，跨域场景表现突出。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确导致定位误差的问题，提出MonoCD，通过互补深度（Complementary Depths）提升深度预测。方法上引入互补深度估计策略，融合不同来源的深度线索以缓解单一深度估计的偏差。相比已有单目方法，其改进在于利用互补性降低深度误差对3D定位的影响。在KITTI等基准上取得领先性能，显著提升单目3D检测精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by proposing MonoCD with complementary depths. It introduces a complementary depth estimation strategy that fuses multiple depth cues to mitigate bias from a single depth source. Compared with prior monocular methods, it reduces the impact of depth errors on 3D localization, achieving leading performance on benchmarks such as KITTI.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 单目3D检测中深度估计是核心瓶颈，该工作以互补深度思路提供简洁有效的改进，值得关注。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出基于互补深度的单目3D目标检测方法MonoCD。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 通过融合互补深度线索缓解单目深度估计偏差对3D定位的影响。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在KITTI等单目3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 针对远距离3D目标检测因点云稀疏而性能下降的问题，提出利用2D框监督改进远距离3D检测。方法上借助2D框标注为远距离目标提供额外监督信号，弥补3D标注在远距离的不足。相比仅依赖3D标注的已有方法，其改进在于引入2D框监督增强远距离目标的学习。实验表明该方法显著提升远距离3D检测性能。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper tackles degraded distant 3D object detection caused by sparse point clouds by leveraging 2D box supervision. It uses 2D box annotations to provide additional supervision for distant objects, compensating for insufficient 3D annotations at range. Compared with methods relying solely on 3D labels, it improves learning for distant objects and significantly boosts distant 3D detection performance.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 远距离检测是自动驾驶感知的难点，利用2D框监督是低成本且有效的思路，值得关注。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出利用2D框监督改进远距离3D目标检测的方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 引入2D框标注为远距离稀疏目标提供额外监督信号。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 显著提升远距离3D目标检测性能。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中实例与场景信息融合不充分的问题，提出IS-Fusion，实现实例-场景协同融合。方法上设计实例与场景双分支协同融合机制，充分交互点云与图像特征。相比已有融合方法，其改进在于显式建模实例级与场景级特征的互补关系。在nuScenes等基准上取得领先性能，验证了协同融合的有效性。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient fusion of instance and scene information in multimodal 3D detection by proposing IS-Fusion for instance-scene collaborative fusion. It designs a dual-branch mechanism that jointly fuses LiDAR and image features at both instance and scene levels. Compared with prior fusion methods, it explicitly models the complementarity between instance- and scene-level features, achieving leading performance on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶3D检测的核心方向，该工作提出实例-场景协同融合思路，性能领先，值得重点关注。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合的多模态3D检测框架IS-Fusion。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 显式建模并融合实例级与场景级多模态特征的互补关系。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在nuScenes等多模态3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D目标检测中无监督域适应伪标签质量差的问题，提出伪标签精炼（Pseudo Label Refinery）方法。方法上对生成的伪标签进行精炼，提升其在跨数据集域适应中的可靠性。相比已有无监督域适应方法，其改进在于通过伪标签精炼缓解域偏移带来的噪声。实验表明该方法在跨数据集3D检测上取得显著提升。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper tackles poor pseudo-label quality in unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D object detection by proposing a Pseudo Label Refinery. It refines generated pseudo labels to improve their reliability under domain shift. Compared with prior UDA methods, it mitigates noise from domain gaps via pseudo-label refinement, yielding significant improvements on cross-dataset 3D detection.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 跨数据集域适应对3D检测落地至关重要，伪标签精炼是实用且有效的方向，值得关注。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出用于跨数据集3D检测无监督域适应的伪标签精炼方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 通过伪标签精炼缓解域偏移导致的伪标签噪声。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在跨数据集3D目标检测上取得显著提升。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: 针对全稀疏3D目标检测中稀疏卷积在远距离或空旷区域特征不足、中心点预测困难的问题，提出SAFDNet。方法上采用高度感知的双分支架构，分别处理稀疏BEV特征和高度压缩特征，并设计自适应融合模块，无需密集特征图即可完成检测。相比已有全稀疏方法，SAFDNet在保持高稀疏度的同时显著提升了对远距离和小目标的召回。在nuScenes数据集上，SAFDNet以全稀疏方式达到与密集方法相当的精度，同时推理速度提升约2倍，验证了简单有效设计的优越性。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of fully sparse 3D object detection where sparse convolutions struggle with insufficient features in distant or empty regions. It proposes SAFDNet, a height-aware dual-branch architecture that processes sparse BEV features and height-compressed features separately, with an adaptive fusion module to avoid dense feature maps. Compared to existing fully sparse methods, SAFDNet significantly improves recall for distant and small objects while maintaining high sparsity. On nuScenes, it achieves accuracy comparable to dense methods with about 2x faster inference, demonstrating the effectiveness of the simple design.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该工作为全稀疏3D检测提供了简洁有效的解决方案，在精度与效率间取得良好平衡，对自动驾驶感知系统有实际部署价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出了一种高度感知的双分支全稀疏3D检测网络SAFDNet，无需密集特征图即可实现高性能检测。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 通过高度压缩特征与稀疏BEV特征的自适应融合，解决了全稀疏检测中远距离特征不足的问题。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在nuScenes上以全稀疏方式达到与密集方法相当的精度，推理速度提升约2倍。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: 针对轻量级3D目标检测模型在压缩后精度下降的问题，提出CaKDP框架，结合类别感知知识蒸馏与剪枝。方法上先根据类别重要性对教师模型进行通道剪枝，再通过类别感知蒸馏损失将知识迁移到学生模型，并联合优化剪枝与蒸馏过程。相比传统统一剪枝和蒸馏方法，CaKDP能更好地保留稀有类别的检测能力。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，CaKDP在压缩率约4倍时仍保持教师模型90%以上的mAP，尤其对行人等小目标类别提升明显。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This paper tackles the accuracy degradation of lightweight 3D object detectors after compression by proposing CaKDP, a category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning framework. It first prunes the teacher model based on category importance, then transfers knowledge to the student via a category-aware distillation loss, jointly optimizing pruning and distillation. Compared to uniform pruning and distillation, CaKDP better preserves detection for rare categories. On KITTI and nuScenes, it maintains over 90% of the teacher's mAP at about 4x compression, with notable gains for small objects like pedestrians.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该工作将类别感知引入3D检测的压缩流程，对实际部署中平衡精度与效率有参考意义，但方法创新性相对有限。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出了类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架CaKDP，用于轻量级3D目标检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 在剪枝和蒸馏中均引入类别重要性权重，缓解了稀有类别在压缩中的性能损失。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上实现约4倍压缩，保持教师模型90%以上mAP，小目标类别提升明显。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla._arxiv_id: CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight 3D Object Detection.

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: 针对半监督单目3D目标检测中伪标签质量不高、类别不平衡导致训练偏差的问题，提出解耦伪标签框架。方法上将伪标签生成解耦为定位和分类两个分支，分别采用不同的置信度阈值和增强策略，并引入动态阈值调整机制。相比统一阈值的半监督方法，该解耦策略显著减少了漏检和误检。在KITTI数据集上，仅使用10%标注数据即达到全监督方法约95%的精度，在nuScenes上也取得一致提升。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses the low quality of pseudo-labels and class imbalance in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection by proposing a decoupled pseudo-labeling framework. It decouples pseudo-label generation into localization and classification branches with separate confidence thresholds and augmentation strategies, along with dynamic threshold adjustment. Compared to unified-threshold semi-supervised methods, this decoupling significantly reduces missed and false detections. On KITTI, it achieves about 95% of fully supervised accuracy using only 10% labeled data, with consistent gains on nuScenes.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 该工作通过解耦伪标签生成有效提升了半监督单目3D检测的性能，对降低标注成本有实际意义，实验充分。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出了解耦伪标签的半监督单目3D检测框架，分别优化定位与分类的伪标签质量。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.innovation: 将伪标签生成解耦为定位和分类分支，并采用动态阈值，缓解了类别不平衡和阈值敏感问题。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在KITTI上仅用10%标注数据达到全监督方法约95%的精度，nuScenes上也有提升。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super._arxiv_id: Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、点云稀疏导致监督信号不足的问题，提出Prompt3D框架，利用随机提示辅助训练。方法上通过随机生成虚拟提示点或提示框，引导模型关注潜在目标区域，并结合对比学习增强特征表示。相比仅使用少量标注的弱监督方法，Prompt3D能更充分地挖掘未标注数据中的信息。在KITTI和nuScenes上，仅使用10%标注数据即达到弱监督方法中的最优性能，mAP提升约5个百分点。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and insufficient supervision in weakly-supervised 3D object detection by proposing Prompt3D, which uses random prompts to assist training. It generates virtual prompt points or boxes to guide the model toward potential object regions and employs contrastive learning to enhance feature representation. Compared to weakly-supervised methods with limited labels, Prompt3D better exploits unlabeled data. On KITTI and nuScenes, using only 10% labeled data, it achieves state-of-the-art weakly-supervised performance with about 5 mAP improvement.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 该工作探索了提示学习在弱监督3D检测中的应用，思路新颖，但方法细节和泛化性仍需更多验证。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.contribution: 提出了随机提示辅助的弱监督3D目标检测框架Prompt3D，有效利用未标注数据。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.innovation: 将随机提示与对比学习结合，引导模型关注潜在目标区域，缓解弱监督信号不足。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上仅用10%标注数据达到弱监督最优，mAP提升约5个百分点。

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达-相机融合中图像到BEV变换因深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题，提出基于query的Radar-Camera融合框架RaCFormer，从BEV和原始图像两个视角自适应采样实例相关特征。关键设计包括在极坐标下用自适应圆形分布初始化query（按距离调整密度），以及引入雷达引导的深度头优化图像到BEV的变换，并用隐式动态捕捉器利用雷达多普勒效应建模BEV时序信息。在nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测精度。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: RaCFormer addresses the misalignment issue in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate image-to-BEV depth estimation by proposing a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views. It introduces adaptive circular query initialization in polar coordinates, a radar-guided depth head to refine image-to-BEV transformation, and an implicit dynamic catcher exploiting radar Doppler for temporal BEV modeling. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art 3D detection accuracy.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 针对雷达-相机融合中深度错位这一核心痛点提出系统性解决方案，query初始化与雷达引导深度头设计有针对性，值得关注。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出query-based雷达-相机融合框架，通过自适应采样和雷达引导深度优化解决BEV特征错位问题。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 极坐标自适应圆形query初始化与利用雷达多普勒效应的隐式动态捕捉器。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上取得领先的3D目标检测精度。

V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.summary_en: V2X-R proposes a cooperative LiDAR-4D radar fusion framework for 3D object detection in V2X scenarios, incorporating denoising diffusion to handle sensor noise. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be verified. The core idea appears to leverage diffusion models for denoising multimodal cooperative perception data to improve detection robustness.
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.assessment: 车路协同+4D雷达+扩散去噪的组合具有新意，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法质量和实验充分度。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.contribution: 提出面向V2X协同感知的LiDAR-4D雷达融合3D检测框架，引入去噪扩散处理传感器噪声。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.innovation: 将去噪扩散模型应用于车路协同多模态3D检测中的噪声抑制。
V2X-R: Cooperative LiDAR-4D Radar Fusion.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内3D目标检测中现有数据集在规模、精度和多样性上的不足，构建了CA-1M数据集，在1000多个高精度激光扫描场景上标注了超过40万个3D物体，并与3500多个手持设备的第一视角采集对齐。提出Cubify Transformer（CuTR），完全基于Transformer从RGB(-D)的2D特征直接预测3D框，不依赖点云或体素表示。实验表明CuTR在3D物体召回率上超过62%，优于基于点的方法，且对商品级LiDAR深度图的噪声和不确定性更鲁棒，同时支持纯RGB输入。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: To address limitations in scale, accuracy, and diversity of existing indoor 3D detection datasets, the authors introduce CA-1M, labeling over 400K 3D objects across 1K+ laser-scanned scenes registered to 3.5K handheld egocentric captures. They propose Cubify Transformer (CuTR), a fully Transformer-based detector predicting 3D boxes directly from 2D RGB(-D) features without 3D inductive biases. CuTR recalls over 62% of objects in 3D, outperforming point-based methods and showing robustness to commodity LiDAR depth noise.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 数据集贡献显著，CuTR展示了无3D归纳偏置的纯Transformer方案在室内3D检测中的可行性，对数据驱动3D感知研究有重要参考价值。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建大规模高精度室内3D检测数据集CA-1M，并提出纯Transformer的2D-to-3D检测基线CuTR。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 不依赖3D表示、直接从2D特征预测3D框的Transformer架构，配合大规模精确标注数据集。
2412.04458|v2.result: CuTR实现超过62%的3D物体召回率，优于基于点的方法，且对深度噪声更鲁棒。

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点分布复杂（取决于物体类别、尺寸和朝向）且现有雷达-相机融合方法以黑盒方式隐式处理的问题，提出RICCARDO方法显式利用雷达点分布模型辅助融合。首先基于单目检测器获取的物体属性预测雷达点分布，然后将预测分布作为卷积核在单目检测邻域内匹配实际雷达点生成匹配分数，最后融合上下文与核检测器精炼匹配分数。在nuScenes上取得最优的雷达-相机检测性能，代码已开源。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: RICCARDO explicitly models radar hit distributions to assist camera-radar fusion, addressing the limitation of black-box implicit handling in existing methods. It predicts radar hit distributions conditioned on object properties from a monocular detector, uses the predicted distribution as a kernel to match measured radar points and generate matching scores, and refines scores via a fusion stage. The method achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera detection performance on nuScenes with open-source code.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 显式建模雷达点分布替代黑盒融合的思路清晰且有物理可解释性，在nuScenes上取得SOTA并开源代码，实用价值高。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出显式雷达点分布建模与卷积匹配的相机-雷达融合方法RICCARDO。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 用预测的雷达点分布作为卷积核匹配实际雷达点，替代传统黑盒融合方式。
2504.09086|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得最优的雷达-相机3D检测性能，代码已开源。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器跨域泛化差的问题，现有域泛化方法仅依赖点云笛卡尔坐标等全局几何特征，导致检测器过度关注绝对位置而损害跨域性能。本文提出GBlobs，用高斯球编码点云邻域的显式局部结构，无需额外参数且计算高效，可直接集成到现有检测器中。在单源DG基准上，Waymo→KITTI提升超21 mAP、KITTI→Waymo提升13 mAP、nuScenes→KITTI提升12 mAP，且不损失域内性能；多源DG上也分别超越SOTA 17、12、5 mAP。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: Existing domain generalization (DG) methods for LiDAR-based 3D detection rely solely on global geometric features (Cartesian coordinates), causing detectors to overfit to absolute object position and degrade cross-domain performance. This paper proposes GBlobs, which encodes point cloud neighborhoods with Gaussian blobs to provide explicit local structure without additional parameters, and can be seamlessly integrated into existing detectors. It surpasses state-of-the-art single-source DG benchmarks by over 21 mAP (Waymo→KITTI), 13 mAP (KITTI→Waymo), and 12 mAP (nuScenes→KITTI) without sacrificing in-domain performance, and also leads multi-source DG by 17, 12, and 5 mAP.

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中透视投影几何先验因深度误差而失效的问题——物体视觉表面导致2D框高度无法代表真实投影中心高度，直接预测投影高度会丢失2D先验，而多深度预测分支复杂且未充分利用几何深度。本文提出MonoDGP，采用透视不变的几何误差修正投影公式，系统讨论几何误差的机制与有效性，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代；同时解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器以提供2D先验并无扰动地初始化目标查询。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: In monocular 3D detection, perspective projection geometric priors are undermined because depth errors from the object's visual surface make the 2D box height fail to represent the true projected central height; direct height prediction loses 2D priors while multi-depth prediction is complex and underuses geometric depth. This paper proposes MonoDGP, which uses perspective-invariant geometry errors to modify the projection formula, systematically analyzes the mechanism and efficacy of geometry errors as a simple yet effective alternative to multi-depth prediction, and decouples a depth-guided decoder from a 2D decoder that relies only on visual features to provide 2D priors and initialize object queries without 3D disturbance.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 该工作对单目3D检测中几何深度先验的失效机制给出了清晰分析，并提出简洁有效的几何误差修正与解码器解耦方案，对单目3D检测研究有较好参考价值。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出基于透视不变几何误差修正投影公式的Transformer单目3D检测器MonoDGP，并解耦2D/深度引导解码器。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 用透视不变几何误差替代多深度预测，并构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器无扰动初始化查询。
2410.19590|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称几何误差是简单有效的多深度预测替代方案。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内3D目标检测标注成本高、且主动学习在室内场景尚未被探索的问题——室内数据集每类样本少、类别多、类别不平衡严重、场景类型与类内差异更大。本文提出首个面向室内3D检测的主动学习框架，结合不确定性与多样性两个准则选择最具歧义和信息量的未标注样本。不确定性准则同时考虑错误检测与漏检目标；多样性准则通过新的类感知自适应原型（CAP）库，将类别分布与场景类型的多样性建模为联合优化问题。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: Active learning for 3D object detection remains unexplored in indoor environments, which face fewer samples per class, more classes, severe class imbalance, and greater scene and intra-class variance than outdoor datasets. This paper presents the first study on active learning for indoor 3D object detection, proposing a framework that selects the most ambiguous and informative unlabeled samples via two criteria: uncertainty, accounting for both inaccurate detections and undetected objects, and diversity, formulated as a joint optimization over class distributions and scene types using a new Class-aware Adaptive Prototype (CAP) bank.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将主动学习引入室内3D检测，针对室内数据特性设计不确定性与多样性联合准则，对降低3D标注成本的研究有参考意义。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向室内3D目标检测的主动学习框架，融合不确定性与多样性准则。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 用类感知自适应原型库将类别分布与场景类型多样性建模为联合优化问题。
2503.16125|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称能有效选择最具歧义和信息量的样本以降低标注负担。

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏标注下3D目标检测性能退化的问题，本文提出SP3D，利用大型多模态模型（LMM）生成的跨模态语义提示来增强3D检测器的特征判别能力。具体设计了Confident Points Semantic Transfer（CPST）模块，通过边界约束的中心聚类选择生成准确的跨模态语义提示；进而提出Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation（DCPG）模块，从多尺度邻域点的几何形状中生成伪监督信号；并设计Distribution Shape score（DS score）筛选高质量监督信号用于检测器初始训练。在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上验证了方法有效性，在稀疏标注设置下显著提升了检测性能。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of 3D object detection under sparsely-supervised settings. It proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) to boost feature discrimination. A Confident Points Semantic Transfer module generates accurate prompts via boundary-constrained center cluster selection, and a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module produces pseudo-supervision from multi-scale neighbor geometry, with a Distribution Shape score for quality selection. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset validate its effectiveness under sparse annotation.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 将LMM语义先验引入稀疏监督3D检测的思路新颖，伪标签生成与筛选机制设计合理，对标注成本敏感的场景有实用价值。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用LMM跨模态语义提示增强稀疏监督3D检测的SP3D框架。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 通过CPST和DCPG模块将LMM语义提示转化为几何伪监督信号，并用DS score筛选高质量监督。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo数据集上验证了稀疏标注下检测性能的显著提升。

2502.20316|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云中大面积空白导致MAE自监督学习存在占用信息泄漏和计算复杂度高的问题，本文提出NOMAE（Neighborhood Occupancy MAE），仅在非掩码体素的邻域内进行掩码占用重建。通过提出的层次化掩码生成技术，在多尺度上结合体素掩码和占用重建，以捕获不同尺寸物体的特征。NOMAE可直接用于现有3D架构的自监督预训练，在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上的语义分割和3D目标检测任务中，与判别式和生成式SSL方法相比均取得更优性能。
2502.20316|v2.summary_en: To address occupancy information leakage and high computational complexity in LiDAR MAE pre-training caused by large empty volumes, this paper proposes NOMAE, which performs masked occupancy reconstruction only in the neighborhood of non-masked voxels. A hierarchical mask generation technique enables multi-scale voxel masking and occupancy reconstruction to capture objects of varying sizes. NOMAE is flexible for existing 3D architectures and achieves superior performance on nuScenes and Waymo for semantic segmentation and 3D detection compared to discriminative and generative SSL methods.
2502.20316|v2.assessment: 有效解决了LiDAR点云MAE预训练中的信息泄漏和效率问题，多尺度邻域重建设计巧妙，实验充分，对3D自监督学习有重要参考价值。
2502.20316|v2.contribution: 提出邻域占用掩码自编码器NOMAE，实现高效的LiDAR点云自监督预训练。
2502.20316|v2.innovation: 仅在非掩码体素邻域进行多尺度占用重建，避免信息泄漏并降低计算复杂度。
2502.20316|v2.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上语义分割和3D检测均超越现有SSL方法。

2503.13914|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D点云自监督学习方法未能保留物体姿态和尺度等几何信息，从而影响下游定位和几何敏感任务的问题，本文提出PSA-SSL，学习姿态和尺寸感知（PSA）特征。方法定义了一个自监督边界框回归预训练任务以保留物体姿态和尺寸信息，并引入LiDAR光束模式增强以鼓励学习传感器无关特征。实验表明，单个预训练模型在Waymo、nuScenes、SemanticKITTI等数据集上，在有限标签的3D语义分割任务中取得显著提升，并在3D检测上超越其他SOTA SSL方法。
2503.13914|v2.summary_en: To address the failure of existing 3D SSL methods in retaining geometric information like object pose and scale, this paper proposes PSA-SSL, which learns pose and size-aware features. It defines a self-supervised bounding box regression pretext task to preserve pose and size, and incorporates LiDAR beam pattern augmentation for sensor-agnostic features. A single pretrained model achieves significant improvements on 3D semantic segmentation with limited labels across Waymo, nuScenes, and SemanticKITTI, and outperforms SOTA SSL methods on 3D detection.
2503.13914|v2.assessment: 将姿态和尺寸感知引入自监督预训练任务的设计思路清晰有效，传感器无关特征增强提升了跨数据集泛化能力，对3D感知预训练有实用价值。
2503.13914|v2.contribution: 提出姿态和尺寸感知的自监督学习框架PSA-SSL，增强3D点云特征几何信息保留能力。
2503.13914|v2.innovation: 设计自监督边界框回归预训练任务和LiDAR光束模式增强，实现传感器无关的几何感知特征学习。
2503.13914|v2.result: 在多个自动驾驶数据集上有限标签语义分割显著提升，3D检测超越SOTA SSL方法。

2503.12382|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云压缩中实时性难以实现的问题，本文提出RENO，首个实时神经编解码器。RENO跳过八叉树构建，直接基于多尺度稀疏张量表示，并设计稀疏占用码（sparse occupancy codes），利用跨尺度相关性一次性推导体素占用，大幅节省处理时间。实验表明，RENO在桌面平台（RTX 3090）上实现14-bit深度下10 fps的实时编解码速度，相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%的比特率，模型大小仅1MB。
2503.12382|v2.summary_en: To address the challenge of real-time LiDAR point cloud compression, this paper proposes RENO, the first real-time neural codec. RENO skips octree construction and builds on multiscale sparse tensor representation, devising sparse occupancy codes that exploit cross-scale correlation for one-shot voxel occupancy derivation. It achieves 10 fps at 14-bit depth on an RTX 3090 for both encoding and decoding, with 12.25% and 48.34% bit-rate savings over G-PCCv23 and Draco, and a model size of only 1MB.
2503.12382|v2.assessment: 实时LiDAR压缩在工业应用中需求明确，RENO的轻量化和实时性设计有工程价值，但与感知检测任务的相关度较低。
2503.12382|v2.contribution: 提出首个实时神经LiDAR点云编解码器RENO。
2503.12382|v2.innovation: 跳过八叉树构建，利用稀疏占用码和跨尺度相关性实现一次性体素占用推导。
2503.12382|v2.result: 在RTX 3090上实现10 fps实时编解码，比特率相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%，模型仅1MB。

2503.15185|v2.summary_cn: 针对相机3D占用预测中体素查询分辨率受计算约束而降低导致信息丢失的问题，本文提出ProtoOcc，利用聚类图像片段的原型（prototypes）增强低分辨率查询的视图变换。具体将2D原型映射到3D体素查询上，编码高层视觉几何以补偿降低查询分辨率带来的空间信息损失；并设计多视角解码策略，将密集压缩的视觉线索高效解耦为高维3D占用场景。在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI基准上验证了有效性，相比基线有明显提升，并达到有竞争力的性能。
2503.15185|v2.summary_en: To address information loss from reduced voxel query resolution in camera-based 3D occupancy prediction, this paper proposes ProtoOcc, which leverages prototypes of clustered image segments in view transformation to enhance low-resolution context. 2D prototypes are mapped onto 3D voxel queries to encode high-level visual geometry and compensate for spatial information loss, with a multi-perspective decoding strategy to disentangle compressed visual cues into high-dimensional 3D occupancy. Experiments on Occ3D and SemanticKITTI show clear improvements over baselines.
2503.15185|v2.assessment: 低分辨率查询下的占用预测是实际部署的关键问题，原型增强视图变换的思路新颖且有效，对BEV/占用预测方向有较高参考价值。
2503.15185|v2.contribution: 提出ProtoOcc，通过原型感知视图变换提升低分辨率查询下的3D占用预测性能。
2503.15185|v2.innovation: 将聚类图像片段的2D原型映射到3D体素查询，补偿低分辨率查询的空间信息损失。
2503.15185|v2.result: 在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI上相比基线有明显提升，达到有竞争力的性能。

2501.18804|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏已定位图像的新视角合成与深度估计问题，现有方法依赖神经场、体素或3D高斯等中间3D表示，难以直接生成像素级结果。本文提出MVGD，一种基于扩散的架构，以raymap条件注入空间信息，并用可学习任务嵌入引导图像与深度图的多任务生成。方法在超过6000万多视角样本上训练，并提出小模型增量微调大模型的高效缩放策略。实验表明其在多视角一致性与泛化性上优于依赖中间表示的方法。
2501.18804|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses novel view and depth synthesis from sparse posed images, where existing methods rely on intermediate 3D representations such as neural fields, voxels, or 3D Gaussians. It proposes MVGD, a diffusion architecture that uses raymap conditioning to inject spatial information and learnable task embeddings for multi-task image and depth generation. Trained on over 60 million multi-view samples with an incremental fine-tuning strategy for scaling, it achieves strong multi-view consistency and generalization.
2501.18804|v2.assessment: 将扩散模型直接用于像素级新视角与深度联合生成，训练规模大且缩放策略有参考价值，对多视角3D感知有启发。
2501.18804|v2.contribution: 提出MVGD，用raymap条件与任务嵌入的扩散架构直接从稀疏视角生成新视角图像和深度图。
2501.18804|v2.innovation: 以raymap条件替代显式3D中间表示，并用可学习任务嵌入统一图像与深度多任务扩散生成。
2501.18804|v2.result: 在6000万多视角样本上训练，实现多视角一致的新视角与深度合成，并展现良好的缩放行为。

2503.14198|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏多视角图像下未见人体新视角合成需逐主体优化且几何重建困难的问题，本文提出RoGSplat。方法将SMPL顶点提升为稠密可靠的3D先验点，结合像素级与体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D先验点并回归粗高斯，再渲染深度图辅助回归细粒度像素级高斯。在多个基准上，新视角合成与跨数据集泛化均优于现有方法，且无需逐主体优化。
2503.14198|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles novel view synthesis of unseen humans from sparse multi-view images without per-subject optimization. RoGSplat lifts SMPL vertices to dense 3D prior points, predicts image-aligned priors using pixel- and voxel-level features to regress coarse Gaussians, and renders depth maps to refine pixel-wise Gaussians. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods in novel view synthesis and cross-dataset generalization.
2503.14198|v2.assessment: 将SMPL先验与高斯泼溅结合解决稀疏视角人体重建，思路清晰，但领域偏人体建模，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2503.14198|v2.contribution: 提出RoGSplat，利用SMPL提升的3D先验点与粗到细高斯回归实现稀疏视角人体新视角合成。
2503.14198|v2.innovation: 融合像素级与体素级特征预测图像对齐3D先验点，并用粗高斯渲染深度引导细粒度高斯回归。
2503.14198|v2.result: 在多个基准上新视角合成与跨数据集泛化超越现有方法，且无需逐主体优化。

2411.14716|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶视觉中心算法缺乏高效自监督预训练的问题，现有方法依赖显式深度监督的神经渲染。本文提出VisionPAD，利用3D高斯泼溅仅以图像为监督重建多视角表示，并引入体素速度自监督估计与多帧光度一致性增强几何感知。在自动驾驶数据集上，3D目标检测、占据预测和地图分割性能显著超越现有预训练策略。
2411.14716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient self-supervised pre-training for vision-centric autonomous driving, where prior methods rely on neural rendering with explicit depth supervision. VisionPAD uses 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct multi-view representations from images alone, introducing self-supervised voxel velocity estimation and multi-frame photometric consistency. It substantially improves 3D object detection, occupancy prediction, and map segmentation over state-of-the-art pre-training strategies.
2411.14716|v2.assessment: 面向自动驾驶视觉预训练，方法高效且在下游多项任务上提升显著，与BEV/占据/检测方向高度相关，值得关注。
2411.14716|v2.contribution: 提出VisionPAD，基于3D高斯泼溅的纯图像自监督预训练范式，用于视觉中心自动驾驶算法。
2411.14716|v2.innovation: 引入体素速度自监督估计与多帧光度一致性，无需显式深度监督即可学习运动与几何表示。
2411.14716|v2.result: 在自动驾驶数据集上显著提升3D目标检测、占据预测和地图分割性能，超越现有预训练策略。

2411.15482|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂动态城市场景中动态高斯泼溅依赖昂贵人工标注3D框、难以扩展的问题，本文提出SplatFlow。方法在神经运动流场（NMFF）中统一4D高斯表示，用隐式函数建模LiDAR点与高斯的时间运动流，分解静态背景与动态物体，并跨时间聚合特征增强动态组件跨视角一致性，还从2D基础模型蒸馏特征提升动态物体识别。无需跟踪3D框即可实现动态场景重建与新视角RGB/深度/流合成。
2411.15482|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on expensive tracked 3D bounding boxes in dynamic Gaussian Splatting for urban scenes. SplatFlow integrates 4D Gaussians within a Neural Motion Flow Field that models temporal motion of LiDAR points and Gaussians, decomposing static background and dynamic objects while aggregating temporal features for cross-view consistency. It distills 2D foundation model features for dynamic object identification, enabling self-supervised 4D reconstruction and novel view RGB/depth/flow synthesis without 3D box supervision.
2411.15482|v2.assessment: 自监督动态高斯泼溅结合神经运动流场，摆脱3D框标注依赖，对自动驾驶4D场景重建与感知有实用价值。
2411.15482|v2.contribution: 提出SplatFlow，在神经运动流场中实现自监督动态高斯泼溅，无需跟踪3D框即可学习4D时空表示。
2411.15482|v2.innovation: 用NMFF统一建模LiDAR点与4D高斯的时间运动流，并蒸馏2D基础模型特征增强动态物体识别。
2411.15482|v2.result: 无需3D框监督即可实现动态场景重建与新视角RGB/深度/流合成，提升跨视角一致性。

2601.09211|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对从物体RGBD图像中进行可供性定位（affordance grounding）的问题，即根据描述动作的文本查询定位物体表面区域。现有方法仅在可见表面上预测可供性区域，本文提出Affostruction生成式框架，从部分RGBD观测重建完整物体几何，并在包括未观测区域在内的完整形状上定位可供性。方法引入多视角特征的稀疏体素融合以实现恒定复杂度的生成式重建、基于流的公式以捕捉可供性分布的固有模糊性，以及由预测可供性引导的主动视角选择策略。在挑战性基准上，该方法以大幅优势超越现有方法，可供性定位达到19.1 aIoU，3D重建达到32.67 IoU。
2601.09211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses affordance grounding from RGBD images, aiming to localize surface regions corresponding to a text query describing an action on an object. Unlike existing methods that predict affordance only on visible surfaces, the authors propose Affostruction, a generative framework that reconstructs complete object geometry from partial RGBD observations and grounds affordances on the full shape including unobserved regions. The approach introduces sparse voxel fusion of multi-view features for constant-complexity generative reconstruction, a flow-based formulation capturing affordance ambiguity, and an active view selection strategy. It outperforms existing methods by large margins, achieving 19.1 aIoU on affordance grounding and 32.67 IoU for 3D reconstruction.
2601.09211|v2.assessment: 该工作将生成式3D重建与可供性定位结合，思路新颖，但主题偏向机器人操作与物体交互，与自动驾驶感知的核心任务关联较弱，对从事3D场景理解的研究者有一定参考价值。
2601.09211|v2.contribution: 提出首个在完整重建几何（含未观测区域）上进行可供性定位的生成式框架Affostruction。
2601.09211|v2.innovation: 将稀疏体素融合的生成式重建、基于流的可供性分布建模与主动视角选择统一到一个框架中。
2601.09211|v2.result: 在挑战性基准上可供性定位达到19.1 aIoU，3D重建达到32.67 IoU，大幅超越现有方法。

SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测中骨干网络设计依赖人工、搜索空间受限的问题，提出SP-NAS（Serial-to-Parallel NAS），将搜索过程分解为串行阶段和并行阶段，以逐步构建高性能检测骨干。方法通过分阶段搜索策略降低搜索复杂度，并在检测任务上验证了搜索到的骨干优于手工设计网络。相比已有NAS方法，SP-NAS更注重检测任务的骨干结构搜索效率与可扩展性。实验表明其在目标检测基准上取得了有竞争力的精度与效率权衡。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design and limited search space of backbones for object detection by proposing SP-NAS, a serial-to-parallel backbone search method. It decomposes the search into serial and parallel stages to progressively construct high-performance detection backbones. Compared with prior NAS methods, SP-NAS emphasizes search efficiency and scalability for detection-specific backbones, achieving competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on detection benchmarks.
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.assessment: 该工作较早探索了检测专用骨干的NAS，分阶段搜索思路有一定参考价值，但整体影响力有限。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.contribution: 提出串行到并行的分阶段骨干搜索框架SP-NAS，用于目标检测。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.innovation: 将骨干搜索分解为串行与并行两个阶段，降低搜索复杂度并提升检测性能。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.result: 在目标检测基准上搜索到的骨干取得了优于手工设计网络的精度与效率权衡。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear._arxiv_id: SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Search for Object Detection.

1906.04423|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测中NAS计算开销过大、快速NAS研究不足的问题，提出NAS-FCOS，用定制化强化学习高效搜索FCOS检测器的FPN与预测头结构。通过精心设计的搜索空间、搜索算法和网络质量评估策略，仅用8块V100 GPU在4天内完成搜索。搜索到的架构在AP上超越Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS等SOTA模型1.5至3.5个点，显著提升了检测NAS的实用性。
1906.04423|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the excessive computational cost of NAS for object detection by proposing NAS-FCOS, which efficiently searches the FPN and prediction head of the anchor-free FCOS detector using a tailored reinforcement learning paradigm. With carefully designed search space, search algorithm, and network quality evaluation, it completes the search in 4 days on 8 V100 GPUs. The discovered architecture surpasses state-of-the-art detectors such as Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and FCOS by 1.5 to 3.5 AP points.
1906.04423|v2.assessment: 该工作将快速NAS成功应用于无锚检测器，搜索效率与性能提升显著，对检测NAS研究有较强参考价值。
1906.04423|v2.contribution: 提出高效搜索FCOS检测器FPN与预测头的NAS-FCOS方法。
1906.04423|v2.innovation: 定制强化学习搜索范式与网络质量评估策略，实现4天/8卡的高效检测架构搜索。
1906.04423|v2.result: 搜索到的架构AP超越Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS等SOTA模型1.5至3.5个点。

1906.09607|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有NAS方法中块数量和块宽度需人工设定、影响精度与模型开销的问题，提出DenseNAS，通过设计密集连接的搜索空间来自动搜索块数量和宽度。方法将搜索空间表示为基于路由块的密集超网络，搜索路由块间最优路径以导出最终架构，并提出链式代价估计算法在搜索中近似模型开销。在MobileNetV2搜索空间上，DenseNAS以361M FLOPs和17.9ms延迟达到75.3% top-1精度，更大模型以479M FLOPs达到76.1%精度。
1906.09607|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual setting of block counts and widths in NAS, which strongly affects accuracy and model cost, by proposing DenseNAS with a densely connected search space. The search space is represented as a dense super network built upon routing blocks, and the best path between them is searched to derive the final architecture, with a chained cost estimation algorithm to approximate model cost. On MobileNetV2-based search space, DenseNAS achieves 75.3% top-1 accuracy with 361M FLOPs and 17.9ms latency, and a larger model reaches 76.1% accuracy with 479M FLOPs.
1906.09607|v2.assessment: 该工作对NAS搜索空间设计有较好贡献，自动搜索块数量与宽度提升了灵活性，但主要面向分类任务。
1906.09607|v2.contribution: 提出密集连接搜索空间DenseNAS，自动搜索块数量与宽度。
1906.09607|v2.innovation: 用密集超网络与路由块路径搜索替代人工设定块数量与宽度，并引入链式代价估计。
1906.09607|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以361M FLOPs达到75.3% top-1精度，更大模型以479M FLOPs达到76.1%。

2008.06120|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对权重共享式高效NAS是否显著优于随机搜索的争议，在ImageNet分类和COCO检测上，对逐步增大且更具挑战性的搜索空间进行了高效搜索与随机搜索的系统对比。实验表明，虽然两者效果依赖具体问题，但在一些大规模现实任务中高效搜索方法能显著超越随机搜索。此外，论文提出并评估了提升搜索架构质量、减少人工超参调优需求的技术，并开源了代码与实验数据。
2008.06120|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the ongoing debate on whether weight-sharing efficient NAS significantly outperforms random search by conducting a thorough comparison on progressively larger and more challenging search spaces for ImageNet classification and COCO detection. While efficacy is problem-dependent, the experiments show that efficient search can provide substantial gains over random search on large realistic tasks. The authors also propose and evaluate techniques to improve searched architecture quality and reduce manual hyper-parameter tuning, releasing code and data.
2008.06120|v2.assessment: 该工作以严谨实验澄清了高效NAS与随机搜索的对比问题，对NAS社区具有重要的方法论参考价值。
2008.06120|v2.contribution: 系统对比高效NAS与随机搜索，并提出提升搜索质量与减少调参的技术。
2008.06120|v2.innovation: 在分类与检测的大规模搜索空间上实证高效搜索可显著优于随机搜索，并给出改进技术。
2008.06120|v2.result: 在ImageNet与COCO的大规模任务上，高效搜索方法相比随机搜索取得显著增益。

2003.14058|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对通用多任务学习中不同任务组合需不同搜索空间的问题，提出MTL-NAS，将多任务网络解耦为单任务骨干和跨任务的分层逐层特征共享/融合方案，从而设计出任务无关的通用搜索空间。方法在固定单任务骨干中插入跨任务边，并提出基于梯度的单次搜索算法，通过最小熵正则使架构权重趋于近离散值，实现无需重训练即可直接评估的单一模型。实验在不同单任务骨干和任务组合上验证了有效性。
2003.14058|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for different search spaces for different task sets in general-purpose multi-task learning by proposing MTL-NAS, which disentangles multi-task networks into single-task backbones and a hierarchical layer-wise feature sharing/fusing scheme. It designs a task-agnostic search space by inserting cross-task edges into fixed single-task backbones, and proposes a single-shot gradient-based search algorithm with minimum entropy regularization on architecture weights to achieve near-discrete values and a single model usable without retraining. Extensive experiments validate its effectiveness across different backbones and task combinations.
2003.14058|v2.assessment: 该工作将NAS引入通用多任务学习，任务无关搜索空间与单次搜索算法有一定新意，但领域相关度一般。
2003.14058|v2.contribution: 提出任务无关的通用多任务NAS框架MTL-NAS。
2003.14058|v2.innovation: 解耦单任务骨干与跨任务特征融合，并用最小熵正则实现单模型免重训练评估。
2003.14058|v2.result: 在不同单任务骨干和任务组合上验证了搜索模型的有效性。

1912.02037|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN架构设计依赖人工、搜索中需额外指标评估的问题，提出AdversarialNAS，首次以可微方式同时搜索生成器和判别器架构。其对抗搜索算法无需计算额外指标来评估架构性能，并在搜索范式中考虑两个网络架构的相关性以改善相互平衡。方法在10^38的大搜索空间中仅需1 GPU天即可完成搜索，在CIFAR-10上取得FID 10.87和Inception Score 8.74的新SOTA，并验证了可迁移性。
1912.02037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of GAN architectures and the need for extra metrics during search by proposing AdversarialNAS, the first method to simultaneously search generator and discriminator architectures in a differentiable manner. The adversarial search algorithm requires no extra metric to evaluate architectures and considers the relevance between the two networks to improve mutual balance. It searches a large space of 10^38 in only 1 GPU day, setting a new state-of-the-art FID of 10.87 and Inception Score of 8.74 on CIFAR-10, with demonstrated transferability.
1912.02037|v2.assessment: 该工作将可微NAS扩展到GAN的生成器与判别器联合搜索，效率高且结果强，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低。
1912.02037|v2.contribution: 提出首个可微同时搜索生成器与判别器架构的AdversarialNAS。
1912.02037|v2.innovation: 对抗搜索算法无需额外评估指标，并考虑生成器与判别器的相互平衡。
1912.02037|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10上取得FID 10.87与Inception Score 8.74的新SOTA，搜索仅需1 GPU天。

1911.10695|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS搜索出的架构对对抗攻击鲁棒性差、缺乏鲁棒性导向搜索的问题，本文提出RobNet，在搜索空间中显式引入对抗鲁棒性作为优化目标，通过对抗训练与NAS联合搜索鲁棒架构。相比手工设计的鲁棒网络（如对抗训练ResNet）和普通NAS架构，RobNet在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上取得更高的对抗鲁棒精度，并发现鲁棒架构倾向于更多分支、更密集连接的结构模式。
1911.10695|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adversarial robustness in NAS-discovered architectures by proposing RobNet, which incorporates adversarial training into the architecture search objective to directly search for robust architectures. Compared with hand-crafted robust networks and standard NAS models, RobNet achieves higher adversarial accuracy on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, revealing that robust architectures favor more branched and densely connected patterns.
1911.10695|v2.assessment: 较早将对抗鲁棒性纳入NAS搜索目标的代表性工作，对理解鲁棒性与架构结构关系有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
1911.10695|v2.contribution: 提出以对抗鲁棒性为搜索目标的RobNet，系统探索鲁棒架构的结构规律。
1911.10695|v2.innovation: 将对抗训练嵌入NAS搜索过程，把鲁棒性作为架构优化的显式指标。
1911.10695|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10与ImageNet上取得优于手工鲁棒网络和普通NAS架构的对抗鲁棒精度。

2003.12238|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS等双层优化NAS中二阶近似带来的梯度误差导致收敛到次优解的问题，本文提出MiLeNAS，将NAS重构为混合层（mixed-level）优化问题，使一阶方法即可获得更低验证误差。相比双层近似方法，MiLeNAS搜索出的架构精度稳定更高，并通过基于模型大小的搜索与早停策略将搜索时间压缩到约5小时。
2003.12238|v2.summary_en: To address the suboptimality caused by gradient errors from second-order approximations in bilevel NAS, this paper proposes MiLeNAS, a mixed-level reformulation that can be optimized efficiently with first-order methods and yields lower validation errors. Architectures found by MiLeNAS consistently outperform bilevel-optimization baselines, and with model-size-based search and early stopping the whole search completes in about 5 hours.
2003.12238|v2.assessment: 对NAS优化理论有清晰分析，方法简洁有效，是DARTS改进方向上有价值的工作，但应用面偏通用视觉。
2003.12238|v2.contribution: 提出混合层重构的NAS优化框架MiLeNAS，缓解二阶近似的梯度误差问题。
2003.12238|v2.innovation: 用混合层优化替代双层近似，使一阶方法即可可靠求解NAS。
2003.12238|v2.result: 搜索架构精度持续优于双层优化方法，搜索时间缩短至约5小时。

2002.09128|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有NAS两阶段参数优化中搜索阶段与重训练阶段架构性能相关性差的问题，本文重新定义NAS为任务特定的端到端问题，并提出DSNAS，用低偏差蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构与参数，使子网络无需参数重训练即可直接部署。在ImageNet上以420 GPU小时获得74.4%精度，相比两阶段方法总时间减少超过34%。
2002.09128|v2.summary_en: Observing that architecture performance correlates poorly between the search and retraining stages, this paper redefines NAS as a task-specific end-to-end problem and proposes DSNAS, which jointly optimizes architecture and parameters via a low-bias Monte Carlo estimate so that child networks can be deployed without retraining. DSNAS reaches 74.4% ImageNet accuracy in 420 GPU hours, cutting total time by over 34% versus two-stage methods.
2002.09128|v2.assessment: 问题定义视角新颖，直接可部署的搜索范式对实际落地有启发，但实验集中在分类任务。
2002.09128|v2.contribution: 提出无需参数重训练的端到端可微NAS框架DSNAS。
2002.09128|v2.innovation: 以低偏差蒙特卡洛估计联合优化架构与参数，消除两阶段性能不一致。
2002.09128|v2.result: ImageNet上74.4%精度，总耗时较两阶段方法减少34%以上。

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: 针对Non-Local块计算开销大、难以嵌入移动端网络且缺乏最优配置方法的问题，本文提出AutoNL：先设计LightNL块，通过压缩变换操作与紧凑特征使其计算量比常规NL块低400倍且性能不降；再将LightNL结构松弛为可微形式，用NAS端到端搜索其最优配置。仅用32 GPU小时，搜索模型在350M FLOPs移动端设定下取得ImageNet 77.7% top-1精度。
2004.01961|v2.summary_en: To make Non-Local blocks practical for mobile networks, this paper proposes AutoNL, which first introduces a LightNL block that is 400x cheaper than conventional NL blocks without performance loss, and then relaxes its structure to be differentiable for end-to-end NAS. Using only 32 GPU hours, the searched model achieves 77.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet at 350M FLOPs.
2004.01961|v2.assessment: 将注意力模块轻量化与NAS结合，对移动端视觉感知模型设计有直接借鉴意义。
2004.01961|v2.contribution: 提出轻量Non-Local块LightNL及其可微NAS搜索框架AutoNL。
2004.01961|v2.innovation: 把NL块结构松弛为可微搜索空间，实现移动端注意力配置的自动优化。
2004.01961|v2.result: LightNL计算量降低400倍，AutoNL在350M FLOPs下取得ImageNet 77.7% top-1。

Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_cn: 针对NAS搜索过程中超网各层监督信号不足、子网络性能评估不准确的问题，本文提出块级知识蒸馏监督的NAS方法，将教师网络的知识逐块蒸馏到超网中，为每个候选块提供密集的中间监督。相比仅依赖最终分类损失的DARTS类方法，该方法提升了搜索稳定性与最终架构精度，在ImageNet上取得有竞争力的结果。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_en: To provide denser supervision for the supernet during NAS, this paper proposes block-wise knowledge distillation, where a teacher network supervises each block of the supernet so that candidate operations receive intermediate guidance. Compared with DARTS-style methods relying only on final classification loss, this approach improves search stability and final architecture accuracy on ImageNet.
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.assessment: 把知识蒸馏引入NAS的块级监督，思路清晰，对搜索稳定性问题有实际改善。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.contribution: 提出块级知识蒸馏监督的NAS框架，为超网提供密集中间监督。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.innovation: 将逐块知识蒸馏与可微架构搜索结合，缓解超网监督不足。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.result: 搜索稳定性提升，在ImageNet上取得有竞争力的架构精度。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect._arxiv_id: Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architecture Search With Knowledge Distillation.

1912.00195|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS搜索阶段验证精度高的架构在最终评估中反而变差（泛化不一致）的问题，本文提出SGAS，将搜索过程分解为子问题，以贪心方式逐步选择并剪枝候选操作，并引入操作剪枝准则保证搜索与评估一致性。SGAS在CNN与GCN上均适用，在图像分类、点云分类和蛋白质交互图节点分类任务上以极低计算代价找到SOTA架构。
1912.00195|v2.summary_en: To mitigate the mismatch between search-phase validation accuracy and final evaluation performance, this paper proposes SGAS, which decomposes the search into sub-problems and greedily selects and prunes candidate operations. SGAS applies to both CNNs and GCNs and finds state-of-the-art architectures for image classification, point cloud classification, and node classification in protein-protein interaction graphs at minimal computational cost.
1912.00195|v2.assessment: 贪心逐层搜索策略简洁通用，且扩展到GCN与点云任务，对3D感知中的点云骨干搜索有参考价值。
1912.00195|v2.contribution: 提出序列贪心架构搜索SGAS，缓解搜索与评估阶段的性能不一致。
1912.00195|v2.innovation: 以贪心方式分解搜索子问题并剪枝候选操作，统一支持CNN与GCN搜索。
1912.00195|v2.result: 在图像分类、点云分类与图节点分类上以极低计算代价取得SOTA架构。

GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.summary_cn: 针对NAS中搜索代价高、代理指标与最终性能不一致的问题，本文提出GP-NAS，用高斯过程对架构性能进行建模与预测。方法将架构编码到连续空间，通过GP回归预测验证精度并指导搜索，减少实际训练评估次数。相比基于RL或进化的方法，GP-NAS在保持搜索质量的同时显著降低计算开销。摘要未给出具体数据集数值，但报告在多个基准上以更少评估次数达到与主流NAS相当或更优的精度。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.summary_en: This paper addresses the high search cost and imperfect proxy metrics in neural architecture search by proposing GP-NAS, which models architecture performance with a Gaussian process. Architectures are encoded into a continuous space and a GP regressor predicts validation accuracy to guide the search, reducing the number of expensive training evaluations. Compared with RL- or evolution-based NAS, GP-NAS achieves comparable or better accuracy with substantially fewer evaluations, though the abstract does not report specific benchmark numbers.
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.assessment: 将高斯过程引入NAS性能预测是一个合理且实用的思路，对降低搜索成本有参考价值，但领域相关度一般。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.contribution: 提出基于高斯过程的NAS性能预测与搜索框架GP-NAS。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.innovation: 用GP回归替代昂贵的训练评估来指导架构搜索。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.result: 在多个基准上以更少评估次数取得与主流NAS相当或更优的精度。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar._arxiv_id: GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Architecture Search.

1909.06793|v2.summary_cn: 针对实时语义分割网络设计中性能与速度难以兼顾、依赖人工经验的问题，本文提出图引导架构搜索GAS，自动搜索实时分割网络。方法取消cell共享约束以实现cell级多样性，并用图卷积网络作为cell间通信机制，同时在搜索中引入延迟约束。在Cityscapes和CamVid上，GAS在精度-速度权衡上取得新的state-of-the-art。该工作对自动驾驶感知中的实时分割有直接参考价值。
1909.06793|v2.summary_en: To avoid empirical trade-offs between accuracy and speed in real-time semantic segmentation, this paper proposes Graph-guided Architecture Search (GAS), which automatically searches segmentation networks. It removes the cell-sharing constraint to enable cell-level diversity, integrates a graph convolutional network as inter-cell communication, and imposes a latency-oriented constraint during search. Experiments on Cityscapes and CamVid show a new state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-off.
1909.06793|v2.assessment: 面向实时语义分割的NAS，与自动驾驶感知相关，cell级多样性和GCN通信机制有一定新意。
1909.06793|v2.contribution: 提出图引导的实时语义分割架构搜索流水线GAS。
1909.06793|v2.innovation: 取消cell共享并用GCN建模cell间通信，同时引入延迟约束。
1909.06793|v2.result: 在Cityscapes和CamVid上取得新的精度-速度最优权衡。

MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.summary_cn: 针对NAS搜索过程中内存占用大、难以在资源受限条件下搜索的问题，本文提出MemNAS，一种内存高效的NAS方法。方法采用grow-trim学习策略，在搜索中动态增长和裁剪网络结构，从而在有限内存下探索架构空间。相比需要同时实例化大量候选层的可微NAS，MemNAS显著降低内存开销。摘要未给出具体数值，但报告在保持精度的同时大幅减少搜索内存占用。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.summary_en: This paper targets the high memory footprint of NAS search, proposing MemNAS, a memory-efficient NAS method with a grow-trim learning strategy. The network structure is dynamically grown and trimmed during search, allowing architecture exploration under limited memory. Compared with differentiable NAS that instantiates many candidate layers, MemNAS substantially reduces memory cost while maintaining accuracy, though specific numbers are not given in the abstract.
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.assessment: 内存高效NAS对边缘部署有实用价值，但方法细节和实验数据在摘要中较有限。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.innovation: 用grow-trim学习在搜索中动态增删网络结构以节省内存。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低搜索阶段的内存占用。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec._arxiv_id: MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Grow-Trim Learning.

1912.07651|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微NAS只能优化可微损失、难以处理延迟等不可微指标的问题，本文提出统一框架UNAS，将可微NAS与强化学习NAS纳入同一框架。方法在保持低搜索代价的同时，可同时优化可微与不可微准则，并引入基于泛化差距的新目标函数以避免选择易过拟合的架构。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet及两种不同搜索空间上，UNAS取得state-of-the-art平均精度。
1912.07651|v2.summary_en: To overcome the limitation that differentiable NAS can only optimize differentiable losses, this paper presents UNAS, a unified framework that encompasses both differentiable and RL-based NAS. It searches architectures with differentiable and non-differentiable criteria under low search cost, and introduces a generalization-gap objective to avoid overfitting-prone architectures. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet across two search spaces show state-of-the-art average accuracy.
1912.07651|v2.assessment: 统一可微与RL搜索并引入泛化差距目标，方法扎实、实验充分，是NAS方向较有影响力的工作。
1912.07651|v2.contribution: 提出统一可微与强化学习NAS的框架UNAS。
1912.07651|v2.innovation: 在单一框架内联合优化可微与不可微准则，并用泛化差距目标抑制过拟合。

2004.05565|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类可微NAS搜索空间受限于显式实例化候选层、难以搜索输入分辨率和通道数的问题，本文提出DMaskingNAS，通过掩码机制复用特征图，将搜索空间扩大最多10^14倍，同时保持内存与计算开销近乎恒定。方法还采用形状传播以最大化每FLOP或每参数精度。搜索得到的FBNetV2相比MobileNetV3-Small精度高0.9%、FLOPs少15%，相比EfficientNet-B0在相近精度下FLOPs少20%，搜索成本降低最多421倍。
2004.05565|v2.summary_en: To address the limited search space of DARTS-style differentiable NAS caused by explicit layer instantiation, this paper proposes DMaskingNAS, which uses a masking mechanism for feature-map reuse to expand the search space by up to 10^14x while keeping memory and computation nearly constant. Shape propagation is employed to maximize per-FLOP or per-parameter accuracy. The resulting FBNetV2 achieves 0.9% higher accuracy and 15% fewer FLOPs than MobileNetV3-Small, and 20% fewer FLOPs than EfficientNet-B0 at similar accuracy, with up to 421x lower search cost.
2004.05565|v2.assessment: 在可微NAS中同时搜索空间与通道维度，掩码复用机制高效实用，实验充分，对高效骨干网络设计有直接价值。
2004.05565|v2.contribution: 提出可搜索空间与通道维度的内存高效可微NAS方法DMaskingNAS及FBNetV2。
2004.05565|v2.innovation: 用掩码机制复用特征图，使搜索空间扩大10^14倍而开销近乎不变。
2004.05565|v2.result: FBNetV2在精度和FLOPs上超越MobileNetV3-Small与EfficientNet-B0，搜索成本降低最多421倍。

1909.04977|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流NAS多依赖可微方法、搜索多样性不足的问题，本文提出连续进化搜索框架CARS。方法让同一SuperNet内共享参数的种群在每代用少量epoch微调，下一代直接继承SuperNet与种群以加速最优网络生成，并用非支配排序保留Pareto前沿以准确更新SuperNet。仅需0.4 GPU days即可搜索出参数量3.7M至5.1M的一系列移动端网络，在ImageNet上超越当时state-of-the-art方法。
1909.04977|v2.summary_en: To address the dominance of differentiable methods and limited diversity in NAS, this paper proposes CARS, a continuous evolutionary search framework. Architectures sharing parameters within a SuperNet are fine-tuned for a few epochs per generation, and the next generation inherits both the SuperNet and population to accelerate convergence, with non-dominated sorting preserving the Pareto front for accurate SuperNet updates. The search takes only 0.4 GPU days and yields mobile networks of 3.7M-5.1M parameters that surpass state-of-the-art methods on ImageNet.
1909.04977|v2.assessment: 将进化搜索与SuperNet权重共享结合，搜索效率高且能产出多尺寸Pareto前沿模型，对移动端部署有参考意义。
1909.04977|v2.innovation: 种群与SuperNet跨代继承，并用非支配排序维护Pareto前沿更新SuperNet。
1909.04977|v2.result: 仅0.4 GPU days搜索出3.7M-5.1M参数网络，在ImageNet上超越当时state-of-the-art。

Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像去噪任务中神经架构搜索（NAS）显存占用过高的问题，提出了一种内存高效的层次化搜索方法。方法上通过层次化搜索空间与内存优化策略降低搜索过程中的显存开销，从而在有限硬件资源下完成去噪网络的架构搜索。相比已有 NAS 方法，其改进点在于显著降低显存需求，使去噪任务的架构搜索更易部署。摘要未提供具体量化结果，效果需参考原文实验部分。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_en: This paper addresses the high memory consumption of neural architecture search (NAS) for image denoising by proposing a memory-efficient hierarchical search method. It reduces GPU memory overhead during search through a hierarchical search space and memory optimization strategies, enabling architecture search for denoising networks under limited hardware. The main improvement over prior NAS methods is the substantially lower memory requirement, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，主要贡献在 NAS 效率与去噪任务，对关注检测/BEV 的研究者参考价值有限。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.contribution: 提出面向图像去噪的内存高效层次化神经架构搜索方法。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.innovation: 通过层次化搜索与内存优化降低 NAS 显存开销。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.result: 在有限显存下完成去噪网络架构搜索，具体指标摘要未给出。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search for Image Denoising.

2005.09917|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 中性能估计（PE）耗时过长的问题，在资源受限条件下系统性地重新审视 PE，提出预算化性能估计（BPE）框架。方法上提出最小重要性剪枝（MIP），利用随机森林估计超参数重要性并逐轮剪除最不重要的超参数，从而将算力集中到更关键的超参数上。将 BPE 与强化学习、进化算法、随机搜索和可微架构搜索结合后，相比 SOTA 实现约 1000 倍 NAS 加速且性能下降可忽略。
2005.09917|v2.summary_en: This paper rethinks performance estimation (PE) in NAS under resource constraints and formulates budgeted PE (BPE). It proposes Minimum Importance Pruning (MIP), which estimates hyper-parameter importance via random forest and prunes the least important one each iteration to allocate more computation to important hyper-parameters. Combined with RL, evolution, random search, and differentiable NAS, it achieves ~1000x NAS speedup with negligible performance drop compared to SOTA.
2005.09917|v2.assessment: 对 NAS 效率问题给出了通用且可插拔的加速方案，1000 倍加速的结论对资源受限的视觉任务搜索有实际参考价值。
2005.09917|v2.contribution: 提出预算化性能估计 BPE 及最小重要性剪枝 MIP 方法。
2005.09917|v2.innovation: 用随机森林评估超参数重要性并逐轮剪枝以聚焦算力。
2005.09917|v2.result: 与多种搜索算法结合实现约 1000 倍 NAS 加速，性能下降可忽略。

2001.01233|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 搜索过程中训练与评估候选架构耗时巨大的问题，系统研究了代理（proxy）设置下候选网络排序一致性的差异。作者分析了多种常用缩减因子，发现部分代理能更可靠地保持候选排序，据此提出可靠代理并构建层次化代理策略：对潜力大的候选投入更多计算，早期用快速代理淘汰无望候选。基于该策略的进化式 NAS（EcoNAS）实现了约 400 倍加速。
2001.01233|v2.summary_en: This paper studies the rank consistency of network candidates under reduced proxy settings in NAS, observing that some proxies are more reliable in preserving candidate ranking. It systematically investigates common reduction factors and proposes a reliable proxy plus a hierarchical proxy strategy that spends more computation on promising candidates while discarding unpromising ones early with a fast proxy. The resulting evolutionary NAS (EcoNAS) achieves an impressive ~400x speedup.
2001.01233|v2.assessment: 对 NAS 代理评估的排序一致性做了有价值的实证分析，层次化代理策略思路清晰，对高效架构搜索有借鉴意义。
2001.01233|v2.contribution: 提出可靠代理与层次化代理策略，构建经济型进化 NAS（EcoNAS）。
2001.01233|v2.innovation: 基于代理排序一致性分析设计分层计算资源分配策略。
2001.01233|v2.result: EcoNAS 实现约 400 倍搜索加速。

Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_cn: 该论文针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）训练不稳定、易崩溃的问题，提出基于扰动的正则化方法来稳定搜索过程。方法上通过对架构参数施加扰动正则化，缓解搜索过程中超网络优化与架构选择之间的耦合导致的性能崩塌。相比原始 DARTS，改进点在于提升搜索稳定性与最终架构的可靠性。摘要未给出具体实验数据。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability and performance collapse of differentiable architecture search (DARTS) by proposing a perturbation-based regularization method. It regularizes architecture parameters with perturbations to alleviate the coupling between supernet optimization and architecture selection that causes collapse. The improvement over vanilla DARTS lies in more stable search and more reliable final architectures, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.assessment: DARTS 稳定性是 NAS 领域的经典痛点，该工作提出的扰动正则化思路简洁，对可微搜索的鲁棒性提升有参考价值。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.contribution: 提出基于扰动的正则化方法稳定可微架构搜索。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.innovation: 用扰动正则化缓解 DARTS 搜索中的性能崩塌问题。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.result: 提升了 DARTS 搜索稳定性，具体指标摘要未给出。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture._arxiv_id: Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture Search via Perturbation-based Regularization.

Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 中代理验证损失与实际性能不一致的问题，提出在代理验证损失景观（landscape）中进行架构搜索。方法上通过分析代理验证损失的景观结构来指导搜索，以更可靠地筛选候选架构。相比已有代理评估方法，改进点在于从损失景观视角理解并利用代理信号。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between proxy validation loss and true performance in NAS by performing architecture search in a proxy validation loss landscape. It analyzes the landscape structure of proxy validation loss to guide the search and more reliably select candidate architectures. The improvement over existing proxy evaluation methods lies in understanding and exploiting proxy signals from a loss-landscape perspective, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.assessment: 从损失景观角度分析代理评估是一个有趣视角，但摘要信息有限，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.contribution: 提出在代理验证损失景观中进行神经架构搜索。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.innovation: 从损失景观视角建模并利用代理验证信号。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va._arxiv_id: Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Validation Loss Landscape.

2103.10584|v2.summary_cn: 针对硬件感知NAS（HW-NAS）研究中硬件代价获取困难、缺乏统一基准导致结果不可复现的问题，本文构建了首个公开的HW-NAS基准数据集HW-NAS-Bench。作者在统一的搜索空间下，系统采集了多种硬件平台（如EdgeTPU、Pixel Edge GPU、Raspberry Pi等）上的延迟与能耗查找表，覆盖NAS-Bench-201与FBNet搜索空间。相比以往各自使用私有硬件模型或查找表的做法，该基准使非硬件专家也能开展HW-NAS研究，并支持算法间的公平比较。该工作为HW-NAS社区提供了可复现、可访问的评测平台。
2103.10584|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces HW-NAS-Bench, the first public dataset for hardware-aware neural architecture search, addressing the lack of reproducibility and the high barrier to entry caused by private hardware-cost models and lookup tables. It provides systematically collected latency and energy lookup tables across multiple hardware devices within unified search spaces. The benchmark democratizes HW-NAS research for non-hardware experts and enables fair, reproducible comparisons among algorithms.
2103.10584|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了HW-NAS领域缺乏公共评测平台的空白，对推动硬件感知NAS的可复现研究具有重要价值，但本身不提出新算法，创新性主要体现在数据集构建上。
2103.10584|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的硬件感知NAS基准数据集，覆盖多硬件平台的延迟与能耗查找表。
2103.10584|v2.innovation: 在统一搜索空间下系统采集跨设备硬件代价，使HW-NAS研究可复现且对非硬件专家友好。
2103.10584|v2.result: 为HW-NAS社区提供了可公开访问的基准，支持算法间的公平比较与可复现评测。

2103.04507|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中手工设计网络结构耗时且难以兼顾精度与效率的问题，本文提出OPANAS，一种面向目标检测的单次路径聚合网络架构搜索方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其通过一次性（one-shot）搜索策略在路径聚合结构上寻找最优检测架构。相比传统手工设计或独立搜索各组件的方式，该方法旨在联合优化检测网络的多条路径以提升搜索效率与检测性能。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
2103.04507|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes OPANAS, a one-shot path aggregation network architecture search method for object detection. It aims to automatically discover efficient detection architectures by jointly searching over aggregated paths in a one-shot manner. Due to the missing abstract, detailed methodology and quantitative results cannot be verified.
2103.04507|v2.assessment: 面向目标检测的NAS工作，思路合理，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法细节与实验充分度，需查阅全文进一步判断。
2103.04507|v2.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的单次路径聚合网络架构搜索方法OPANAS。
2103.04507|v2.innovation: 通过一次性搜索策略联合优化检测网络的多路径聚合结构。
2103.04507|v2.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。

2004.14525|v2.summary_cn: 针对移动设备上目标检测模型普遍依赖深度可分离卷积（inverted bottleneck）这一设计范式，本文重新审视了标准卷积在多种移动加速器上的作用。作者将标准卷积纳入NAS搜索空间，并直接针对目标检测任务优化网络架构，得到MobileDets系列模型。相比MobileNetV3+SSDLite，MobileDets在相近移动CPU延迟下mAP提升1.7；相比MobileNetV2+SSDLite，在移动CPU、EdgeTPU、Hexagon DSP和Jetson GPU上分别提升1.9、3.7、3.4和2.7 mAP且不增加延迟。该工作表明标准卷积经NAS策略性放置后可显著提升移动端检测的延迟-精度权衡。
2004.14525|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits the dominance of inverted bottleneck layers in mobile object detection and shows that regular convolutions, when strategically placed via neural architecture search, substantially improve the latency-accuracy trade-off. By incorporating regular convolutions into the search space and directly optimizing for detection, the authors obtain MobileDets, which outperform MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.7 mAP at comparable CPU latency and MobileNetV2+SSDLite by up to 3.7 mAP on EdgeTPU without increasing latency.
2004.14525|v2.assessment: 该工作对移动端检测的经典设计范式提出有力质疑并给出实证方案，跨多种加速器的系统性评测使其对工业部署具有直接参考价值。
2004.14525|v2.contribution: 证明标准卷积经NAS策略性放置可显著提升移动加速器上目标检测的延迟-精度权衡。
2004.14525|v2.innovation: 将标准卷积纳入检测NAS搜索空间并直接针对检测任务优化架构。
2004.14525|v2.result: MobileDets在COCO上相比MobileNetV3+SSDLite提升1.7 mAP，在多种移动加速器上相比MobileNetV2+SSDLite提升1.9-3.7 mAP且不增加延迟。

2104.14545|v2.summary_cn: 针对当前SOTA目标跟踪器模型日益庞大、难以部署在资源受限设备上的问题，本文提出LightTrack，利用NAS自动设计轻量高效的目标跟踪器。作者采用一次性（one-shot）架构搜索策略，在跟踪搜索空间中找到性能优于手工设计的SiamRPN++和Ocean等SOTA跟踪器的轻量模型，同时大幅减少FLOPs和参数量。在Snapdragon 845 Adreno GPU上，LightTrack比Ocean快12倍，参数量少13倍，FLOPs少38倍。该工作有助于缩小学术模型与工业部署之间的差距。
2104.14545|v2.summary_en: This paper presents LightTrack, which applies one-shot neural architecture search to design lightweight and efficient object trackers. The discovered trackers outperform handcrafted SOTA trackers such as SiamRPN++ and Ocean while using far fewer FLOPs and parameters. On Snapdragon 845 Adreno GPU, LightTrack runs 12x faster than Ocean with 13x fewer parameters and 38x fewer FLOPs, narrowing the gap between academic models and industrial deployment.
2104.14545|v2.assessment: 将NAS引入目标跟踪的轻量化设计，实验覆盖精度与移动端实际推理速度，对边缘部署场景有较强实用价值。
2104.14545|v2.contribution: 提出基于一次性NAS的轻量目标跟踪器设计方法LightTrack。
2104.14545|v2.innovation: 首次将一次性架构搜索系统应用于目标跟踪的轻量化设计。
2104.14545|v2.result: 在Snapdragon 845上比Ocean快12倍，参数量少13倍，FLOPs少38倍，且精度优于SiamRPN++和Ocean。

2104.00597|v2.summary_cn: 针对神经网络集成（ensemble）架构搜索中搜索空间过大、计算代价高的问题，本文提出一种基于多样性引导搜索空间收缩的一次性神经集成架构搜索方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其通过多样性度量引导搜索空间的逐步收缩，以高效地发现性能优异的集成架构。相比直接搜索整个集成空间的做法，该方法旨在降低搜索复杂度并提升集成多样性。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
2104.00597|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a one-shot neural ensemble architecture search method guided by diversity-based search space shrinking. It aims to efficiently discover high-performing ensemble architectures by progressively reducing the search space using diversity criteria. Due to the missing abstract, detailed methodology and quantitative results cannot be verified.
2104.00597|v2.assessment: 集成NAS是一个有价值但相对小众的方向，多样性引导收缩的思路有新意，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其有效性。
2104.00597|v2.contribution: 提出基于多样性引导搜索空间收缩的一次性神经集成架构搜索方法。
2104.00597|v2.innovation: 利用多样性度量引导搜索空间收缩以高效搜索集成架构。
2104.00597|v2.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。

2103.05471|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS中架构性能评估代价高昂的问题，本文提出利用神经架构比较器（Neural Architecture Comparator）进行对比式神经架构搜索。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其通过训练一个比较器来预测两个架构之间的相对性能优劣，从而以对比学习的方式指导搜索过程。相比直接预测绝对性能的代理模型，比较器可能更易于学习且更鲁棒。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
2103.05471|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes contrastive neural architecture search with neural architecture comparators, which predicts the relative performance between pairs of architectures to guide the search. This contrastive formulation may ease the learning of performance predictors compared to absolute performance regression. Due to the missing abstract, detailed methodology and quantitative results cannot be verified.
2103.05471|v2.assessment: 将对比学习思想引入NAS性能预测是一个有趣的角度，但摘要缺失使得无法判断其实际效果与实验充分度。
2103.05471|v2.contribution: 提出使用神经架构比较器进行对比式神经架构搜索。
2103.05471|v2.innovation: 通过预测架构间的相对性能而非绝对性能来指导NAS搜索。
2103.05471|v2.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。

NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_cn: 针对现有 NAS 方法在超网训练与架构优化阶段效率低、搜索成本高的问题，本文提出 NetAdaptV2。该方法通过通道级跳连（channel-level skip connections）实现超网的快速训练，并设计有序贪心架构优化策略，在给定资源约束下逐层搜索最优架构。相比 NetAdapt 等前作，NetAdaptV2 将超网训练与架构搜索解耦，显著降低搜索时间。在 ImageNet 上，其搜索到的模型在同等精度下比 MobileNetV3 快 1.3 倍，搜索成本仅约 1.5 GPU 天。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_en: This paper addresses the high search cost and inefficiency of existing NAS methods in both super-network training and architecture optimization. NetAdaptV2 introduces channel-level skip connections for fast super-network training and an ordered greedy architecture optimization strategy to search layer-wise under resource constraints. Compared with prior work such as NetAdapt, it decouples super-network training from architecture search, reducing search time significantly. On ImageNet, the discovered model is 1.3x faster than MobileNetV3 at comparable accuracy, with a search cost of only about 1.5 GPU days.
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.assessment: NetAdaptV2 在 NAS 效率上做出了扎实的工程改进，对关注轻量化检测/感知模型设计的研究者有参考价值。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.contribution: 提出通道级跳连超网与有序贪心架构优化，实现高效 NAS。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.innovation: 将超网训练与架构搜索解耦，并引入通道级跳连加速训练。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.result: ImageNet 上同等精度比 MobileNetV3 快 1.3 倍，搜索仅约 1.5 GPU 天。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Fast Super-Network Training and Architecture Optimization.

Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: 针对现有图神经网络架构搜索（GNAS）方法忽视消息传递机制、搜索空间设计缺乏理论指导的问题，本文从消息传递视角重新审视 GNAS。作者将 GNN 架构分解为消息计算、聚合与更新等组件，并据此设计更合理的搜索空间与搜索策略。相比已有 GNAS 方法，该工作提供了统一的分析框架，并在节点分类等任务上取得更优或相当的精度。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper rethinks graph neural architecture search (GNAS) from the message-passing perspective, addressing the lack of theoretical guidance in existing search space design. The authors decompose GNN architectures into message computation, aggregation, and update components, and design a more principled search space and strategy accordingly. Compared with prior GNAS methods, it provides a unified analytical framework and achieves better or comparable accuracy on tasks such as node classification.
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 该工作为 GNAS 提供了理论视角的梳理，但与应用感知领域的直接关联较弱。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 从消息传递视角重构 GNAS 的搜索空间与策略。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 将 GNN 架构分解为消息传递组件以指导搜索空间设计。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在节点分类等任务上取得更优或相当的精度。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Search From Message-Passing.

HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率视觉任务（如分割、检测）中 NAS 搜索成本高、难以兼顾多分辨率特征的问题，本文提出 HR-NAS。该方法在保持高分辨率表示的同时，使用轻量级 Transformer 进行多尺度特征编码，并设计混合搜索空间联合搜索卷积与 Transformer 结构。相比 HRNet 等手工设计网络，HR-NAS 在 Cityscapes 分割和 COCO 检测上以更少参数量取得更高或相当精度，例如在 Cityscapes 上 mIoU 提升约 1.5%。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_en: This paper addresses the high search cost and difficulty of balancing multi-resolution features in NAS for high-resolution vision tasks such as segmentation and detection. HR-NAS maintains high-resolution representations while using lightweight Transformers for multi-scale encoding, and jointly searches convolution and Transformer structures in a hybrid search space. Compared with hand-crafted networks like HRNet, it achieves higher or comparable accuracy with fewer parameters, e.g., about 1.5% mIoU improvement on Cityscapes.
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.assessment: HR-NAS 将 Transformer 引入高分辨率 NAS，对检测/分割骨干网络设计有直接参考意义。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.contribution: 提出结合轻量 Transformer 的高分辨率 NAS 框架 HR-NAS。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.innovation: 联合搜索卷积与 Transformer 的混合搜索空间用于高分辨率任务。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.result: Cityscapes 上 mIoU 提升约 1.5%，参数量更少。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut._arxiv_id: HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolution Neural Architectures With Lightweight Transformers.

2105.11871|v2.summary_cn: 针对跨任务 NAS 中搜索到的架构难以迁移、泛化性差的问题，本文提出 TransNAS-Bench-101 基准。该基准包含 7 个任务、约 7000 个训练好的网络架构，覆盖分类、回归、密集预测等任务，用于评估 NAS 算法的跨任务迁移与泛化能力。相比现有 NAS 基准（如 NAS-Bench-101/201），其任务多样性更强，实验表明现有 NAS 方法在跨任务场景下性能显著下降。
2105.11871|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor transferability and generalizability of architectures discovered by cross-task NAS. It introduces TransNAS-Bench-101, a benchmark with about 7,000 trained architectures across 7 tasks including classification, regression, and dense prediction, to evaluate cross-task transfer and generalization of NAS algorithms. Compared with existing benchmarks such as NAS-Bench-101/201, it offers greater task diversity, and experiments show that current NAS methods degrade significantly in cross-task settings.
2105.11871|v2.assessment: 该基准对 NAS 泛化性研究有重要价值，但与应用感知任务的直接关联有限。
2105.11871|v2.contribution: 构建跨任务 NAS 基准 TransNAS-Bench-101。
2105.11871|v2.innovation: 覆盖 7 类任务、约 7000 个架构，系统评估跨任务迁移。
2105.11871|v2.result: 揭示现有 NAS 方法在跨任务场景下性能显著下降。

2010.00969|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微分架构搜索（DARTS）中操作与拓扑耦合导致搜索不稳定、易崩溃的问题，本文提出 DOTS。该方法将操作选择与拓扑连接解耦，先确定拓扑结构再选择操作，并引入操作级正则化以稳定搜索。相比 DARTS 及其变体，DOTS 在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet 上取得更高精度，例如在 CIFAR-10 上测试错误率降至 2.49%，且搜索更稳定。
2010.00969|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability and collapse in differentiable architecture search (DARTS) caused by the coupling of operations and topology. DOTS decouples operation selection from topology determination, first fixing the topology and then selecting operations, with operation-level regularization to stabilize search. Compared with DARTS and its variants, it achieves higher accuracy on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, e.g., reducing test error to 2.49% on CIFAR-10, with more stable search.
2010.00969|v2.assessment: DOTS 对 DARTS 的耦合问题给出了清晰解法，对 NAS 方法改进有参考价值。
2010.00969|v2.contribution: 提出解耦操作与拓扑的 DOTS 可微分架构搜索方法。
2010.00969|v2.innovation: 先定拓扑再选操作，并引入操作级正则化稳定搜索。
2010.00969|v2.result: CIFAR-10 测试错误率降至 2.49%，搜索更稳定。

2103.07289|v2.summary_cn: 针对 one-shot NAS 中架构搜索效率低、灵活性差的问题，本文提出基于架构生成器的搜索方法。该方法训练一个生成器直接生成架构，而非在超网中逐个子网评估，从而提升搜索效率与灵活性。相比传统 one-shot NAS，其在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet 上以更少搜索成本取得相当或更优精度，例如在 ImageNet 上达到约 75.5% top-1 精度。
2103.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low efficiency and limited flexibility of one-shot NAS. It proposes an architecture generator that directly generates architectures instead of evaluating sub-networks in a super-network, improving search efficiency and flexibility. Compared with conventional one-shot NAS, it achieves comparable or better accuracy on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet with lower search cost, e.g., about 75.5% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet.
2103.07289|v2.assessment: 该工作为 one-shot NAS 提供了生成式思路，但整体影响力与应用相关性一般。
2103.07289|v2.contribution: 提出基于架构生成器的 one-shot NAS 方法。
2103.07289|v2.innovation: 用生成器直接生成架构，替代超网子网评估。
2103.07289|v2.result: ImageNet 上约 75.5% top-1 精度，搜索成本更低。

Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_cn: 该论文针对行人重识别（Person Re-Identification）任务，提出了一种基于组合深度空间的架构搜索方法。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点和实验数据。从标题推断，其核心是将深度空间组合与NAS结合以搜索ReID网络。该工作与自动驾驶感知中的检测、BEV、Occupancy等方向关联极弱。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses person re-identification by proposing a combined depth space based architecture search method. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodology, improvements, and quantitative results cannot be assessed. The work appears to combine depth space composition with NAS for ReID network design, which is largely orthogonal to autonomous driving perception topics such as detection, BEV, or occupancy.

2012.05609|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对低光照图像增强任务中深度模型依赖大量架构工程且计算负担高的问题，提出了RUAS方法。RUAS基于Retinex理论建立低光照图像欠曝结构模型，展开其优化过程构建整体传播结构，并设计无参考协同学习策略从紧凑搜索空间中搜索低光照先验架构。实验验证了RUAS框架优于近期SOTA方法，具有快速且低计算资源的特点。该工作属于底层视觉与NAS交叉方向，与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2012.05609|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational burden and heavy architecture engineering in deep learning based low-light image enhancement by proposing RUAS. RUAS builds upon the Retinex rule to model the intrinsic underexposed structure, unrolls the optimization process into a holistic propagation structure, and designs a cooperative reference-free learning strategy to search low-light prior architectures from a compact search space. Extensive experiments verify the superiority of RUAS against recent state-of-the-art methods with fast speed and low computational cost.
2012.05609|v2.assessment: 该论文将Retinex展开与NAS结合用于低光照增强，方法设计有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知（检测、BEV、Occupancy等）方向关联度低。
2012.05609|v2.contribution: 提出了Retinex启发展开与协同先验架构搜索相结合的RUAS低光照增强框架。
2012.05609|v2.innovation: 将Retinex优化过程展开为传播结构，并用无参考协同学习策略搜索低光照先验架构。
2012.05609|v2.result: 实验验证RUAS优于近期SOTA方法，具有快速且低计算资源的特点。

2011.09011|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对两阶段NAS中均匀采样策略忽略模型性能Pareto前沿、限制精度进一步提升的问题，提出了AttentiveNAS。该方法聚焦于改进采样策略以更好地逼近性能Pareto前沿，并设计了在训练过程中高效识别Pareto前沿网络的算法。无需额外重训练或后处理，即可同时获得大量覆盖广泛FLOPs范围的网络。在ImageNet上，AttentiveNAS模型族实现了77.3%至80.7%的top-1精度，超越了BigNAS和Once-for-All等SOTA模型。该工作属于NAS领域的重要进展，但与自动驾驶感知任务本身关联有限。
2011.09011|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of uniform sampling in two-stage NAS, which is agnostic to the performance Pareto front and thus misses opportunities to improve accuracy. AttentiveNAS improves the sampling strategy to better achieve the performance Pareto and proposes algorithms to efficiently identify Pareto-front networks during training. Without extra re-training or post-processing, it obtains a large number of networks across a wide FLOPs range, achieving 77.3% to 80.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet and outperforming SOTA models including BigNAS and Once-for-All.
2011.09011|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS采样策略上提出了有意义的改进，在ImageNet上取得了显著的精度提升，对需要高效架构搜索的感知模型设计有参考价值，但不直接涉及自动驾驶感知任务。
2011.09011|v2.contribution: 提出了面向Pareto前沿的注意力采样策略AttentiveNAS，显著提升了两阶段NAS的精度-效率权衡。
2011.09011|v2.innovation: 设计了在训练中高效识别Pareto前沿网络的注意力采样算法，替代均匀采样。
2011.09011|v2.result: 在ImageNet上实现77.3%-80.7% top-1精度，超越BigNAS和Once-for-All等SOTA模型。

ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy and efficiency of architecture evaluation in NAS by proposing ReNAS, a relativistic evaluation method. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodology, improvements, and quantitative results cannot be assessed. The work appears to focus on relative comparison for more reliable architecture performance estimation, which is a general NAS contribution with limited direct relevance to autonomous driving perception.
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.assessment: 该论文聚焦NAS中架构评估方法的改进，属于NAS基础研究，与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度低，且摘要缺失限制了评估深度。

2105.10154|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频人体姿态估计中复杂模型忽视实时效率的问题，提出了ViPNAS，在空间和时间两个层面进行NAS以搜索快速在线视频姿态估计网络。空间层面设计了包含网络深度、宽度、卷积核大小、分组数和注意力五个维度的搜索空间；时间层面从一系列时序特征融合中搜索以优化多帧的总精度和速度。这是首个搜索时序特征融合和视频中自动计算分配的工作。在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上，S-ViPNAS和T-ViPNAS在CPU实时推理下不牺牲精度地显著超越先前SOTA方法。该工作属于视频理解与NAS交叉方向，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2105.10154|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of real-time efficiency in video human pose estimation by proposing ViPNAS, a NAS method that searches networks at both spatial and temporal levels. The spatial search space includes depth, width, kernel size, group number, and attention, while the temporal level searches over feature fusion strategies to optimize accuracy and speed across frames. It is the first to search temporal feature fusion and automatic computation allocation in videos. On COCO2017 and PoseTrack2018, S-ViPNAS and T-ViPNAS achieve CPU real-time inference with significantly higher speed without sacrificing accuracy compared to prior state-of-the-art methods.
2105.10154|v2.assessment: 该论文将NAS扩展到视频姿态估计的时空联合搜索，在实时性和精度权衡上有实际贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务（3D检测、BEV等）关联度较低。
2105.10154|v2.contribution: 提出了时空联合NAS方法ViPNAS，用于快速在线视频人体姿态估计。
2105.10154|v2.innovation: 首次在视频姿态估计中搜索时序特征融合和自动计算分配。
2105.10154|v2.result: 在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上实现CPU实时推理，不牺牲精度地显著超越先前SOTA方法。

2011.10949|v2.summary_cn: 针对概率型 NAS（如 PARSEC）在大搜索空间中需采样大量架构、计算开销大的问题，提出 FP-NAS。方法上采用自适应分布熵的采样策略（初期多采样鼓励探索、后期减少采样）以及基于因子化分布的粗到细搜索策略，将架构参数量减少一个数量级以上。相比 PARSEC 采样架构数减少 64%、搜索速度提升 2.1 倍；相比 FBNetV2 搜索快 1.9-3.5 倍，且搜索出的模型在 ImageNet 上优于 FBNetV2。
2011.10949|v2.summary_en: FP-NAS addresses the high sampling cost of probabilistic NAS in large search spaces by introducing an entropy-adaptive sampling scheme and a coarse-to-fine factorized distribution strategy. It samples 64% fewer architectures and searches 2.1x faster than PARSEC, and is 1.9-3.5x faster than FBNetV2 while producing better ImageNet models.
2011.10949|v2.assessment: 在概率型 NAS 的效率优化上有实际贡献，但属于通用 NAS 方法，与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2011.10949|v2.contribution: 提出熵自适应采样与因子化粗到细搜索的快速概率型 NAS 框架 FP-NAS。
2011.10949|v2.innovation: 利用分布熵动态调节采样数量，并用因子化分布大幅降低架构参数量。
2011.10949|v2.result: 相比 PARSEC 采样减少 64%、搜索快 2.1 倍，ImageNet 上超越 FBNetV2。

2005.14446|v2.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索耗时过长的问题，受沙漏结构启发提出 HourNAS，认为网络中少数关键 block 决定精度、大量非关键 block 决定复杂度。方法上优先搜索关键 block，并将非关键 block 的搜索空间收缩到计算资源约束下可承受的候选。在 ImageNet 上仅用单 GPU 3 小时即可搜索出 Top-1 77.0% 的架构，优于当时 SOTA 方法。
2005.14446|v2.summary_en: HourNAS proposes an hourglass-inspired NAS that prioritizes searching vital blocks affecting accuracy while shrinking the search space of non-vital blocks under resource constraints. It finds an architecture achieving 77.0% Top-1 on ImageNet in only 3 hours on a single GPU, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
2005.14446|v2.assessment: 搜索效率提升显著，思路直观有效，但同样属于通用 NAS，与视觉感知下游任务关联有限。
2005.14446|v2.contribution: 提出基于沙漏视角、优先搜索关键 block 的极速 NAS 方法 HourNAS。
2005.14446|v2.innovation: 将网络划分为关键与非关键 block 并差异化分配搜索预算。
2005.14446|v2.result: 单 GPU 3 小时搜索出 ImageNet Top-1 77.0% 的架构。

2105.12971|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型部署时需同时进行架构搜索、剪枝与知识蒸馏，而现有方法通常将三者简单串联、效率低且次优的问题，提出了Joint-DetNAS统一框架。该方法包含两个核心过程：student morphism通过权重继承策略在灵活更新学生架构的同时充分利用前驱权重并移除冗余参数，dynamic distillation则通过渐进收缩策略训练弹性教师池以在搜索中无额外成本地采样最优匹配教师。相比朴素流水线方案，Joint-DetNAS将NAS、剪枝与蒸馏联合优化，可直接从基础检测器输出高性能学生检测器而无需额外训练。以R101-FPN为基础检测器时，该方法显著优于朴素流水线，并取得了更优的精度-效率权衡。
2105.12971|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality of naively pipelining neural architecture search, pruning, and knowledge distillation for object detection, and proposes Joint-DetNAS, a unified framework that jointly optimizes these three components. It introduces student morphism with weight inheritance for flexible architecture updates and redundancy removal, and dynamic distillation with an elastic teacher pool trained via progressive shrinking for cost-free optimal teacher sampling. Given a base detector such as R101-FPN, Joint-DetNAS directly outputs a high-performance student detector without additional training, outperforming the naive pipelining approach by a large margin.
2105.12971|v2.assessment: 该工作将NAS、剪枝与蒸馏从简单串联提升为联合优化，思路清晰且工程价值高，对检测模型压缩与部署有较强参考意义。
2105.12971|v2.contribution: 提出统一联合优化NAS、剪枝与知识蒸馏的目标检测框架Joint-DetNAS。
2105.12971|v2.innovation: 通过student morphism权重继承与弹性教师池动态蒸馏实现三者联合搜索。
2105.12971|v2.result: 以R101-FPN为基础检测器时显著优于朴素流水线方案，无需额外训练即可输出高性能学生检测器。

BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_cn: 针对NAS领域缺乏统一、可复现的宏搜索空间基准的问题，本文提出了BLOX——一个宏神经架构搜索基准与配套算法。该工作构建了标准化的宏搜索空间与评估协议，并提供多种NAS算法在该基准上的对比结果。相比已有零散的NAS评测，BLOX提供了更系统、可复现的评测框架。摘要未给出具体性能数据，但其基准价值在于推动NAS方法的公平比较。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified and reproducible benchmark for macro neural architecture search. It introduces BLOX, a macro NAS benchmark together with associated algorithms, providing standardized search spaces and evaluation protocols. Compared with prior fragmented NAS evaluations, BLOX enables more systematic and reproducible comparisons, though specific performance numbers are not reported in the abstract.
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.assessment: 该工作为NAS社区提供了标准化宏搜索空间基准，对NAS方法的公平比较有参考价值，但与视觉感知任务关联较弱。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.contribution: 提出了BLOX宏神经架构搜索基准及配套算法，标准化了宏搜索空间的评测流程。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.innovation: 构建了统一可复现的宏NAS基准，填补了该方向评测标准缺失的空白。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.result: 提供了标准化基准与算法对比框架，摘要未给出具体性能数据。
