2204.05941|v2.summary_cn: 针对跨任务NAS中任务相关性建模被忽视的问题，本文提出Arch-Graph，一种可迁移NAS方法，将任务嵌入作为预测器输入以预测任务特定的最优架构。该方法将NAS形式化为架构关系图预测问题，候选架构为节点、成对关系为边，并加入无环性等约束，转化为最大加权无环子图（MWAS）问题。通过MWAS可有效对候选架构排序，实现跨任务快速适配。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值结果。
2204.05941|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the neglected problem of modeling task correlations in transferable NAS. It proposes Arch-Graph, which predicts task-specific optimal architectures by feeding task embeddings into the predictor, and formulates NAS as an architecture relation graph prediction problem with acyclicity constraints, reduced to a Maximal Weighted Acyclic Subgraph (MWAS) problem. This enables effective ranking of candidates and fast cross-task adaptation, though concrete numerical results are not provided in the abstract.
2204.05941|v2.assessment: 将NAS建模为带约束的图预测问题思路新颖，对跨任务架构迁移有启发，但与视觉感知主线关联有限。
2204.05941|v2.contribution: 提出Arch-Graph，将可迁移NAS形式化为带无环约束的架构关系图预测问题。
2204.05941|v2.innovation: 利用任务嵌入与MWAS约束实现跨任务架构排序与快速适配。
2204.05941|v2.result: 实现了跨任务架构排序与适配，摘要未给出具体性能数据。

2111.15362|v2.summary_cn: 针对Deep Image Prior（DIP）框架中架构选择依赖数据集整体、且常规NAS耗时的问题，本文首先证明DIP中的最优架构是图像相关的，进而提出一种图像特定的NAS策略。该方法所需训练量远少于典型NAS，从而有效实现逐图像架构搜索。作者在包含522个模型的DIP NAS数据集上验证了策略有效性，并进行了大量实验。摘要未给出具体性能数值。
2111.15362|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dataset-level and computationally expensive nature of architecture selection in the Deep Image Prior (DIP) framework. It first shows that optimal architectures in DIP are image-dependent, then proposes an image-specific NAS strategy requiring far less training than typical NAS. Effectiveness is demonstrated on a DIP NAS dataset with 522 models and extensive experiments, though specific numbers are not reported.
2111.15362|v2.assessment: 图像特定NAS的思路对DIP类图像恢复任务有意义，但应用面窄，与自动驾驶感知关联很弱。
2111.15362|v2.contribution: 提出图像特定的DIP NAS策略，证明DIP最优架构依赖具体图像。
2111.15362|v2.innovation: 以远低于常规NAS的训练成本实现逐图像架构搜索。
2111.15362|v2.result: 在522个模型的DIP NAS数据集上验证了有效性，摘要未给出具体数值。

2203.14577|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS中免训练性能估计这一核心难题，本文重新审视了基于神经正切核（NTK）的初始化度量，揭示其关键缺陷。通过分析NTK的时间演化，作者发现现代神经网络呈现高度非线性，导致纯NTK度量无法可靠估计架构性能。为此提出Label-Gradient Alignment（LGA），一种能捕捉非线性优势的新型NTK度量，仅需少量训练即可与训练后测试精度达到有意义的秩相关。摘要未给出具体相关系数数值。
2203.14577|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits training-free performance estimation in NAS by examining NTK-based at-initialization metrics and exposing their shortcomings. Through empirical analysis of NTK's time evolution, it shows modern architectures are highly non-linear, making pure NTK metrics unreliable. It introduces Label-Gradient Alignment (LGA), a novel NTK-based metric capturing non-linear advantages, achieving meaningful rank correlation with post-training accuracy under minimal training, though specific correlation values are not given.
2203.14577|v2.assessment: 对NTK免训练NAS度量的批判性分析扎实，LGA为低成本架构评估提供了新思路，对NAS研究者有参考价值。
2203.14577|v2.contribution: 揭示NTK初始化度量的缺陷并提出LGA度量以更可靠地估计架构性能。
2203.14577|v2.innovation: 通过刻画NTK时间演化中的非线性，设计能捕捉非线性优势的LGA度量。
2203.14577|v2.result: 少量训练下LGA与训练后精度达到有意义的秩相关，摘要未给出具体数值。

2203.09137|v2.summary_cn: 针对MAML在深度网络中理论性质不明的问题，本文首先证明过参数化DNN下的MAML能以线性速率收敛到全局最优，并指出其等价于一类新核——Meta Neural Tangent Kernels（MetaNTK）的核回归。基于此提出MetaNTK-NAS，一种免训练的少样本学习NAS方法，用MetaNTK对架构排序与选择。在miniImageNet和tieredImageNet上，其性能与专为少样本学习设计的SOTA NAS相当或更优，同时加速超过100倍。
2203.09137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unclear theoretical properties of MAML with deep networks. It proves that MAML with over-parameterized DNNs converges to global optima at a linear rate and is equivalent to kernel regression with a novel class of kernels termed Meta Neural Tangent Kernels (MetaNTK). Based on this, it proposes MetaNTK-NAS, a training-free NAS method for few-shot learning that ranks architectures via MetaNTK. On miniImageNet and tieredImageNet, it matches or surpasses state-of-the-art few-shot NAS while achieving over 100x speedup.
2203.09137|v2.assessment: 理论证明与免训练NAS结合紧密，100倍加速且性能不降，对少样本NAS研究有较高参考价值。
2203.09137|v2.contribution: 证明过参数化MAML的全局收敛性并提出基于MetaNTK的免训练少样本NAS。
2203.09137|v2.innovation: 提出MetaNTK核并据此设计免训练、可加速百倍的少样本NAS方法。
2203.09137|v2.result: 在miniImageNet和tieredImageNet上性能相当或更优，加速超过100倍。

2206.09811|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS中架构参数梯度幅值无法真实反映操作重要性的问题，本文提出Shapley-NAS，用Shapley值量化各操作对验证精度的边际贡献。方法通过蒙特卡洛采样与早停截断近似NP难的精确Shapley值计算，并迭代优化超网权重与架构参数。相比仅依赖梯度幅值的DARTS，该方法能更准确地筛选高贡献操作，在NAS基准上取得更优架构。
2206.09811|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that gradient magnitudes of architecture parameters in DARTS fail to reflect true operation importance. It proposes Shapley-NAS, which quantifies each operation's marginal contribution to validation accuracy via Shapley value with Monte-Carlo sampling and early truncation. Compared with gradient-based DARTS, it selects more genuinely contributive operations and yields better architectures on NAS benchmarks.
2206.09811|v2.assessment: 将博弈论中的Shapley值引入可微NAS的操作重要性评估，思路新颖，对NAS社区有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2206.09811|v2.contribution: 提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法用于可微神经架构搜索。
2206.09811|v2.innovation: 用Shapley值量化操作边际贡献替代梯度幅值作为架构选择依据。
2206.09811|v2.result: 在NAS基准上获得比DARTS更优的架构性能。

2203.01665|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类可微NAS存在的性能崩溃鲁棒性差与搜索架构泛化能力弱两大问题，本文提出简单高效的Beta-Decay正则化方法。该方法对激活后的架构参数施加约束，限制其数值与方差过大，并给出深入的理论分析说明其有效性。在NAS-Bench-201上实验表明该方法能稳定搜索过程并提升跨数据集迁移性，且对训练时间与数据依赖更小。
2203.01665|v2.summary_en: This paper targets two issues of DARTS-based differentiable NAS: weak robustness to performance collapse and poor generalization of searched architectures. It proposes a simple yet efficient Beta-Decay regularization that constrains the value and variance of activated architecture parameters, with in-depth theoretical analysis. Experiments on NAS-Bench-201 show stabilized search and improved transferability across datasets with less dependence on training time and data.
2203.01665|v2.assessment: 以极简正则化手段缓解DARTS性能崩溃问题，理论分析扎实，对NAS社区有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2203.01665|v2.contribution: 提出Beta-Decay正则化以稳定DARTS搜索并提升架构泛化性。
2203.01665|v2.innovation: 通过约束激活架构参数的数值与方差来防止性能崩溃。
2203.01665|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201上稳定搜索过程并提升跨数据集迁移性。

2111.13204|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类可微NAS搜索过程中架构退化、难以超越朴素基线的问题，本文将NAS建模为分布学习问题，把架构权重松弛为高斯分布，并利用自然梯度变分推断（NGVI）优化架构分布。该方法无需额外内存与计算开销即可在现有代码库上实现，增强了探索能力与稳定性。在NAS-Bench-201与NAS-Bench-1shot1上验证了显著改进，并采用更优的离散化策略替代简单argmax。
2111.13204|v2.summary_en: To address architecture degradation in DARTS-based differentiable NAS, this paper formulates NAS as a distribution learning problem by relaxing architecture weights into Gaussian distributions optimized via natural-gradient variational inference (NGVI). It enhances exploration and stability without extra memory or computation. Experiments on NAS-Bench-201 and NAS-Bench-1shot1 confirm significant improvements, with a better discretization strategy than plain argmax.
2111.13204|v2.assessment: 从贝叶斯学习角度重构可微NAS，理论优雅且实验充分，对NAS方法学有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
2111.13204|v2.contribution: 将可微NAS建模为基于自然梯度变分推断的分布学习问题。
2111.13204|v2.innovation: 用高斯分布松弛架构权重并借助贝叶斯原理增强探索与稳定性。
2111.13204|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201与NAS-Bench-1shot1上取得显著性能提升。

2203.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Transformer架构搜索（TAS）耗时长且CNN的零成本代理难以泛化到ViT搜索空间的问题，本文首次研究免训练TAS，提出TF-TAS方案。作者观察到ViT中多头自注意力（MSA）与MLP特性差异显著，且MSA的突触多样性对性能影响明显，据此设计模块化策略，从突触多样性与突触显著性两个理论视角评估排序ViT架构，称为DSS指标。实验表明DSS指标与ViT测试精度强相关，TF-TAS取得有竞争力的结果。
2203.12217|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates training-free Transformer Architecture Search (TAS) for the first time, addressing the high cost of existing TAS and the poor generalization of CNN zero-cost proxies to ViT search spaces. Observing that MSA and MLP behave differently and that MSA synaptic diversity notably affects performance, it devises a modular strategy evaluating ViT architectures via synaptic diversity and saliency, termed DSS-indicator. Results show DSS strongly correlates with ViT test accuracy and TF-TAS achieves competitive performance.
2203.12217|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究免训练ViT架构搜索，DSS指标设计有洞察力，对视觉Transformer与NAS交叉方向有参考价值，与自动驾驶感知间接相关。
2203.12217|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的Transformer架构搜索方案TF-TAS及DSS评估指标。
2203.12217|v2.innovation: 从突触多样性与突触显著性两个视角构建免训练ViT架构评估指标。
2203.12217|v2.result: DSS指标与ViT测试精度强相关，TF-TAS取得有竞争力的搜索结果。

2203.10747|v2.summary_cn: 针对检测网络训练耗时导致直接在检测数据集上做NAS搜索代价极高（通常数十至上百GPU天）的问题，本文提出EAutoDet高效框架，可在1.4 GPU天内发现实用的backbone与FPN架构。方法上构建了同时覆盖backbone和FPN的supernet并采用可微搜索，提出kernel reusing技术将同一edge上候选操作的权重共享并合并为单个卷积以降低显存与计算开销，同时引入动态通道精炼策略搜索通道数。在COCO test-dev上发现的架构以120 FPS达到40.1 mAP、以41.3 FPS达到49.2 mAP，超越当时SOTA检测NAS方法，并迁移到旋转检测任务取得77.05 mAP50。
2203.10747|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive search cost of directly performing NAS on detection datasets, which typically requires tens to hundreds of GPU-days. It proposes EAutoDet, an efficient differentiable framework that constructs a supernet covering both backbone and FPN, introduces kernel reusing to share and consolidate candidate operation weights on each edge, and employs a dynamic channel refinement strategy. The discovered architectures achieve 40.1 mAP at 120 FPS and 49.2 mAP at 41.3 FPS on COCO test-dev, surpassing prior detection NAS methods, and transfer to rotation detection with 77.05 mAP50, all within 1.4 GPU-days.
2203.10747|v2.assessment: 搜索效率（1.4 GPU天）与检测精度/速度的权衡做得非常扎实，对需要在检测任务上做架构搜索的研究者有直接参考价值。
2203.10747|v2.contribution: 提出可在1.4 GPU天内完成检测backbone与FPN联合搜索的高效可微NAS框架EAutoDet。
2203.10747|v2.innovation: 通过kernel reusing将同一edge候选操作权重共享合并为单卷积，并配合动态通道精炼策略降低搜索开销。
2203.10747|v2.result: COCO test-dev上120 FPS达40.1 mAP、41.3 FPS达49.2 mAP，旋转检测迁移达77.05 mAP50。

2201.10355|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有SNN多沿用VGG/ResNet等ANN式架构、对二值脉冲时序处理并非最优的问题，本文提出面向脉冲神经网络的NAS方法SNASNet。方法受初始化激活模式启发，无需训练即从能表征多样脉冲激活模式的架构中进行选择，并进一步搜索层间前向连接与时间反馈连接以利用脉冲间时序信息。实验表明引入反向连接可带来更高性能，说明为SNN专门设计利用时序信息的架构的重要性。
2201.10355|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the sub-optimality of ANN-style architectures (e.g., VGG, ResNet) for Spiking Neural Networks by introducing a NAS approach that selects architectures based on diverse spike activation patterns at initialization without training. It further searches both feed-forward and temporal feedback connections between layers to exploit inter-spike temporal information. Experiments show that the discovered SNASNet with backward connections achieves higher performance, highlighting the importance of SNN-specific architecture design.
2201.10355|v2.assessment: 将NAS与SNN时序特性结合，反馈连接搜索的思路有新意，但与自动驾驶视觉感知主线相关度有限。
2201.10355|v2.contribution: 提出基于初始化脉冲激活模式并联合搜索前向与时间反馈连接的SNN架构搜索方法。
2201.10355|v2.innovation: 无需训练即可依据脉冲激活模式多样性选架构，并首次将时间反馈连接纳入SNN搜索空间。
2201.10355|v2.result: 搜索得到的SNASNet在引入反向连接后取得更高性能，验证了时序反馈连接对SNN架构的重要性。

2207.05420|v2.summary_cn: 针对如何有效组合卷积、Transformer与MLP以构建高性能混合视觉架构这一难题，本文提出统一架构搜索方法UniNet。核心设计有两点：一是将差异极大的可搜索算子建模为统一形式，使其共享同一组配置参数，从而显著缩小搜索空间并降低搜索成本；二是提出上下文感知下采样模块（DSM）以弥合不同算子类型间的特征差异。最终将可配置算子与DSM整合进统一搜索空间，采用基于强化学习的搜索器进行搜索，在多个视觉任务上取得优异结果。
2207.05420|v2.summary_en: This paper studies how to effectively combine convolution, transformer, and MLP operators into high-performance hybrid visual architectures via a unified architecture search approach. It models heterogeneous searchable operators in a unified form sharing the same configuration parameters to shrink the search space and cost, and proposes context-aware downsampling modules (DSMs) to bridge feature gaps across operator types. Configurable operators and DSMs are integrated into a unified search space searched with reinforcement learning, yielding strong results across vision tasks.
2207.05420|v2.assessment: 统一算子建模与DSM设计对混合架构搜索有实际价值，思路清晰，对关注ViT/CNN混合设计的研究者有参考意义。
2207.05420|v2.contribution: 提出统一卷积、Transformer与MLP算子的混合视觉架构搜索框架UniNet。
2207.05420|v2.innovation: 以统一配置参数建模异构算子缩小搜索空间，并用上下文感知下采样模块弥合算子间特征差异。

2112.02086|v2.summary_cn: 针对仅有预训练模型、无原始训练数据场景下（如隐私保护、偏差规避）能否进行NAS的问题，本文提出无数据NAS框架。方法首先通过从预训练深度网络恢复知识来合成可用数据，再用合成数据及其预测软标签指导架构搜索。为满足NAS对合成数据语义、多样性与域差距的要求，提出递归标签校准以产生更具信息量的输出、区域更新策略以生成更多样且语义丰富的合成数据，并用输入与特征级正则化在隐空间模仿原始数据分布。在DARTS、ProxylessNAS与SPOS三种NAS算法上实例化，结果表明仅用合成数据搜索得到的架构性能接近使用真实数据的结果。
2112.02086|v2.summary_en: This paper explores the feasibility of NAS given only a pre-trained model without any original training data, motivated by privacy protection and bias avoidance. It synthesizes usable data by recovering knowledge from the pre-trained network and uses the synthetic data with predicted soft labels to guide architecture search. Recursive label calibration, a regional update strategy, and input/feature-level regularization are proposed to ensure semantics, diversity, and minimal domain gap, and the framework is instantiated with DARTS, ProxylessNAS, and SPOS, showing architectures searched on synthetic data approach those searched on real data.
2112.02086|v2.assessment: 无数据NAS的设定新颖且实用，但主要面向图像分类，与自动驾驶检测主线相关度一般。
2112.02086|v2.contribution: 提出仅依赖预训练模型、无需原始训练数据的无数据NAS框架。
2112.02086|v2.innovation: 结合递归标签校准、区域更新策略与输入/特征级正则化，从合成数据中恢复满足NAS需求的语义与多样性。
2112.02086|v2.result: 在DARTS、ProxylessNAS、SPOS上验证，仅用合成数据搜索的架构性能接近使用真实数据的结果。

2207.12577|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对移动端实时超分辨率（SR）推理中计算量大、功耗高的问题，提出了一种编译器感知的SR神经架构搜索框架。方法上，它联合进行深度搜索和逐层宽度搜索，并采用自适应SR块，将推理速度直接纳入优化目标与SR损失共同优化；为避免每次迭代都在移动设备上实测速度，引入结合编译器优化的速度模型来预测不同宽度配置下SR块的推理延迟以加速收敛。相比已有工作，其改进在于将编译器优化纳入速度建模并实现细粒度宽度搜索。在三星移动平台的GPU/DSP上实现了720p分辨率的实时SR推理，同时保持了有竞争力的PSNR和SSIM。
2207.12577|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and power consumption of deep-learning-based super-resolution (SR) that hinder real-time inference on mobile devices. It proposes a compiler-aware SR neural architecture search framework that jointly performs depth search and per-layer width search with adaptive SR blocks, directly incorporating inference speed into the optimization alongside the SR loss. A speed model integrated with compiler optimizations predicts the latency of SR blocks under various width configurations, avoiding per-iteration on-device measurement. The framework achieves real-time 720p SR inference on mobile GPU/DSP with competitive PSNR and SSIM.
2207.12577|v2.assessment: 将编译器优化与NAS速度建模结合以服务移动端实时SR，思路实用，但领域相关性对自动驾驶感知较弱。
2207.12577|v2.contribution: 提出编译器感知的SR NAS框架，联合深度与逐层宽度搜索并将推理速度纳入优化目标。
2207.12577|v2.innovation: 用结合编译器优化的速度模型预测不同宽度配置的延迟，替代搜索过程中的设备实测。
2207.12577|v2.result: 在三星移动平台GPU/DSP上实现720p实时SR推理，PSNR/SSIM具有竞争力。

2111.15097|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN训练不稳定、手动设计架构依赖专家经验，以及早期NAS-GAN仅搜索生成器导致次优、同时搜索生成器与判别器又面临训练不稳定等问题，提出了EAGAN——一种高效的两阶段进化式NAS框架。方法上将生成器（G）与判别器（D）的搜索解耦为两个阶段：第一阶段固定D搜索G并采用多对一训练策略，第二阶段基于第一阶段最优G搜索D并采用一对一训练与权重重置策略以增强稳定性；两阶段均使用非支配排序在多目标（如模型大小、IS、FID）下产生Pareto前沿架构。相比已有NAS-GAN，其改进在于解耦搜索与稳定性增强策略。
2111.15097|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the instability of GAN training and the sub-optimality of prior NAS-GAN methods that search only the generator or suffer from unstable joint search. It proposes EAGAN, an efficient two-stage evolutionary NAS framework that decouples the search of the generator (G) and discriminator (D): stage-1 searches G with a fixed D using many-to-one training, and stage-2 searches D with the optimal G using one-to-one training and weight-resetting to enhance stability. Both stages employ non-dominated sorting to produce Pareto-front architectures under multiple objectives such as model size, Inception Score, and FID.
2111.15097|v2.assessment: 两阶段解耦搜索与权重重置策略对稳定GAN的NAS有实际意义，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2111.15097|v2.contribution: 提出两阶段进化式NAS框架EAGAN，解耦生成器与判别器的搜索以稳定GAN训练。
2111.15097|v2.innovation: 采用多对一与一对一训练及权重重置策略，并结合非支配排序产生多目标Pareto前沿架构。
2111.15097|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称在多目标下获得更优的GAN架构。

2207.03677|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有高效DNN开发通常采用先搜索再剪枝的流水线，导致需要搜索-训练-剪枝-重训练过程、计算开销巨大的问题，首次发现高效DNN及其彩票子网络（lottery tickets）可以直接从超网中识别出来，称为SuperTickets。方法上采用联合架构搜索与参数剪枝的二合一训练方案，并提出渐进且统一的SuperTickets识别策略，允许子网络连接在超网训练过程中发生变化，从而实现比传统稀疏训练更好的精度-效率权衡。论文还评估了从一个任务抽取的SuperTickets能否良好迁移到其他任务。
2207.03677|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive computational cost of the conventional search-train-prune-retrain pipeline for developing efficient DNNs. It discovers for the first time that both efficient DNNs and their lottery subnetworks (SuperTickets) can be directly identified from a supernet via a two-in-one training scheme that jointly performs architecture search and parameter pruning. A progressive and unified identification strategy allows subnetwork connectivity to change during supernet training, achieving better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs than conventional sparse training. The transferability of SuperTickets across tasks is also evaluated.
2207.03677|v2.assessment: 将NAS与彩票假设统一到超网训练中，思路新颖，对高效模型部署有参考价值，但与感知任务直接相关性有限。
2207.03677|v2.contribution: 首次提出从超网中直接联合识别高效DNN及其彩票子网络的SuperTickets方法。
2207.03677|v2.innovation: 二合一训练方案与允许连接变化的渐进统一识别策略，优于传统稀疏训练。
2207.03677|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称实现更好的精度-效率权衡并评估了跨任务迁移性。

2203.02651|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统基于NAS的剪枝算法以验证集性能为目标、无法代表测试性能（潜在性能），且剪枝后微调恢复性能的研究较少的问题，提出了集成知识引导（EKG）方法。方法上，首先实验证明损失曲面的波动可作为评估潜在性能的有效指标，并以EKG作为搜索奖励来低成本搜索损失曲面最平滑的子网络；EKG由中间子网络（子网络评估的副产品）的集成知识构成，随后在微调阶段复用EKG为剪枝网络提供温和且信息丰富的引导，且以内存库形式实现，开销可忽略。例如对ResNet-50剪枝和训练仅需315 GPU小时即可移除约45.04%的FLOPs。
2203.02651|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues in NAS-based pruning: validation performance does not represent test performance (potential performance), and fine-tuning the pruned network is rarely studied. It proposes Ensemble Knowledge Guidance (EKG), first experimentally showing that loss landscape fluctuation is an effective metric for potential performance, and using EKG as a search reward to find the subnetwork with the smoothest loss landscape at low cost. EKG, composed of ensemble knowledge from interim subnetworks, is then reused to guide fine-tuning of the pruned network via a memory bank with negligible cost. For ResNet-50, only 315 GPU hours are needed to remove about 45.04% of FLOPs.
2203.02651|v2.assessment: 以损失曲面波动作为潜在性能指标并复用集成知识指导搜索与微调，方法有洞察力，对高效模型压缩有参考价值。
2203.02651|v2.contribution: 提出集成知识引导（EKG）方法，同时解决子网络搜索目标偏差与剪枝后微调引导不足的问题。
2203.02651|v2.innovation: 用损失曲面波动评估潜在性能，并以内存库形式复用集成知识指导搜索与微调。
2203.02651|v2.result: ResNet-50剪枝仅需315 GPU小时即可移除约45.04%的FLOPs。

EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS研究中能耗与硬件部署成本被忽视的问题，提出了EA-HAS-Bench——一个能耗感知的超参数与架构搜索基准。方法上构建了覆盖多种硬件平台与能耗指标的评测框架，并系统分析了架构/超参数与能耗、精度之间的权衡关系。相比已有NAS基准（如NAS-Bench系列）仅关注精度与FLOPs，该工作首次将真实能耗纳入基准维度。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但基准本身为能耗感知NAS研究提供了标准化评测平台。
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked issue of energy consumption in neural architecture search by introducing EA-HAS-Bench, an energy-aware benchmark for hyperparameter and architecture search. It constructs a comprehensive evaluation framework spanning multiple hardware platforms and energy metrics, systematically analyzing the trade-offs among architecture, hyperparameters, accuracy, and energy. Unlike prior NAS benchmarks that focus solely on accuracy and FLOPs, this work is the first to incorporate real energy consumption as a benchmark dimension, providing a standardized platform for energy-aware NAS research.
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.assessment: 对NAS与绿色AI方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知/视觉核心领域关联较弱，属于边缘相关。
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.contribution: 提出了首个能耗感知的NAS超参数与架构搜索基准EA-HAS-Bench。
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.innovation: 将真实硬件能耗指标系统性地纳入NAS基准评测维度。
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.result: 为能耗感知NAS研究提供了标准化评测平台与架构-能耗权衡分析。

QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.summary_cn: 该论文针对量子架构搜索（QAS）领域缺乏统一评测标准与理论理解的问题，重新审视了QAS的设计范式并提出了QAS-Bench基准。方法上构建了标准化的量子电路架构搜索评测框架，涵盖多种搜索空间与评估协议。相比已有QAS工作各自为政、难以公平比较的现状，该基准提供了可复现的对比平台。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作为量子机器学习与NAS交叉领域奠定了基础性评测工具。
QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.summary_en: This paper rethinks quantum architecture search (QAS) and proposes QAS-Bench, a standardized benchmark addressing the lack of unified evaluation protocols in the field. It constructs a reproducible evaluation framework covering multiple search spaces and assessment protocols for quantum circuit architecture search. Unlike prior QAS works that are difficult to compare fairly, this benchmark provides a common ground for reproducible comparison, laying foundational evaluation infrastructure for the intersection of quantum machine learning and NAS.
QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.assessment: 属于量子计算与NAS交叉的前沿探索，但与经典视觉/自动驾驶感知领域几乎不相关。

QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.innovation: 首次为量子电路架构搜索建立统一可复现的评测框架。
QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.result: 为QAS领域提供了公平比较与可复现研究的基准平台。

MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在多域学习场景下架构设计困难的问题，提出了MDL-NAS——一个面向ViT的联合多域学习框架。方法上通过NAS自动搜索适配多域数据的ViT架构，实现跨域知识共享与域特化特征的联合优化。相比手工设计的多域ViT或单域NAS方案，该框架能自动发现兼顾多域性能的架构。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作将NAS与ViT多域学习结合，对多任务/多域视觉感知有启发意义。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of architecture design for Vision Transformers in multi-domain learning scenarios by proposing MDL-NAS, a joint multi-domain learning framework for ViT. It employs NAS to automatically search ViT architectures that adapt to multi-domain data, jointly optimizing cross-domain knowledge sharing and domain-specific features. Unlike hand-crafted multi-domain ViTs or single-domain NAS approaches, this framework automatically discovers architectures balancing performance across domains, offering insights for multi-task/multi-domain visual perception.
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.assessment: 将NAS与ViT多域学习结合，对多相机/多任务感知的架构设计有一定参考价值，但非直接相关。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.contribution: 提出了面向Vision Transformer的联合多域学习NAS框架MDL-NAS。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.innovation: 通过NAS自动搜索兼顾多域知识共享与域特化的ViT架构。
MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.result: 实现了多域场景下ViT架构的自动化设计，提升跨域泛化能力。

DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.summary_cn: 该论文针对知识蒸馏中学生架构选择依赖教师架构、且需要昂贵训练过程的问题，提出了DisWOT——一种无需训练的学生架构搜索方法。方法上利用零成本（zero-cost）代理指标在蒸馏场景下搜索最优学生架构，避免了传统NAS中反复训练评估的开销。相比已有蒸馏工作固定学生架构或依赖训练后搜索的做法，该方法在搜索阶段即可预测蒸馏性能。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作将零成本NAS与知识蒸馏结合，对模型压缩与高效部署有实用价值。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that student architecture selection in knowledge distillation depends on teacher architecture and requires expensive training. It proposes DisWOT, a training-free student architecture search method that leverages zero-cost proxies to search for optimal student architectures under distillation without repeated training-based evaluation. Unlike prior distillation works that fix student architectures or rely on post-training search, this method predicts distillation performance at the search stage, combining zero-cost NAS with knowledge distillation for efficient model compression.
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.assessment: 零成本NAS与蒸馏的结合对高效模型部署有实用价值，与视觉感知中的模型压缩需求相关。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.contribution: 提出了无需训练的学生架构搜索方法DisWOT用于知识蒸馏。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.innovation: 利用零成本代理指标在蒸馏场景下直接搜索最优学生架构。

2304.04168|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图神经网络（GNN）易受对抗攻击且现有防御方法泛化性差的问题，提出了G-RNA——面向GNN的鲁棒神经架构搜索框架。方法上在消息传递机制中引入图结构掩码操作构建鲁棒搜索空间，并定义鲁棒性度量指导搜索过程以筛选防御性架构。相比现有图NAS缺乏鲁棒设计、防御方法无法保证新数据/任务性能的局限，G-RNA从架构视角理解并提升GNN鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作为鲁棒GNN设计提供了新范式。
2304.04168|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to adversarial attacks and the poor generalization of existing defenses by proposing G-RNA, a robust neural architecture search framework for GNNs. It designs a robust search space for message passing by incorporating graph structure mask operations, and defines a robustness metric to guide the search toward defensive architectures. Unlike existing graph NAS approaches lacking robust design and defenses that fail to guarantee performance on new data/tasks, G-RNA understands and improves GNN robustness from an architectural perspective.
2304.04168|v2.assessment: 从架构搜索角度解决GNN鲁棒性问题思路新颖，但与视觉/自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2304.04168|v2.contribution: 提出了面向GNN的鲁棒神经架构搜索框架G-RNA。
2304.04168|v2.innovation: 在消息传递搜索空间中引入图结构掩码操作并定义鲁棒性度量指导搜索。
2304.04168|v2.result: 从架构视角有效搜索出防御性GNN，提升对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。

HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.summary_en: This paper addresses architecture performance evaluation and search efficiency in NAS by proposing HOTNAS, a hierarchical optimal transport-based neural architecture search method. It leverages hierarchical optimal transport theory to model structural similarity and performance relationships among architectures, guiding efficient search. Unlike conventional NAS relying on surrogate models or weight sharing, this method offers a new architecture distance metric and search strategy from an optimal transport perspective, providing theoretical tools for NAS search space modeling.
HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.assessment: 最优传输视角的NAS方法有理论新意，但与视觉/自动驾驶感知核心领域关联有限。

2208.08835|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS因skip-connection主导而出现的性能崩溃问题，本文从超网表达能力与随机特征两个角度进行分析。作者提出仅训练BatchNorm的DARTS范式，并从理论上证明随机特征会稀释skip-connection的辅助连接作用，使搜索算法更公平地选择操作。基于此实例化了RF-DARTS与RF-PCDARTS。RF-DARTS在CIFAR-10上达到94.36%测试精度（接近NAS-Bench-201最优），从CIFAR-10迁移到ImageNet取得24.0%的最新最优top-1错误率，并在三个数据集上表现稳健。
2208.08835|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance collapse issue in DARTS caused by the dominance of skip-connections. It derives a new DARTS paradigm that trains only BatchNorm and theoretically shows that random features dilute the auxiliary role of skip-connections, enabling fairer operation selection. The resulting RF-DARTS achieves 94.36% on CIFAR-10 and a state-of-the-art 24.0% top-1 error on ImageNet when transferred from CIFAR-10, with robust performance across three datasets.
2208.08835|v2.assessment: 对NAS社区有较高价值，理论分析与实验均较扎实，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2208.08835|v2.contribution: 提出仅训练BatchNorm的DARTS范式并引入随机特征缓解性能崩溃。
2208.08835|v2.innovation: 从理论上揭示随机特征稀释skip-connection辅助作用从而促进公平操作选择。
2208.08835|v2.result: RF-DARTS在CIFAR-10达94.36%，ImageNet top-1错误率24.0%，为当时最优。

2303.09730|v2.summary_cn: 针对在多样化移动设备上部署轻量低延迟ViT的难题，本文提出两阶段NAS方法ElasticViT，先训练支持大搜索空间的高质量ViT超网，再为具体设备搜索可直接部署的子网。作者指出均匀采样会导致子网规模差异巨大（如50M与2G FLOPs）从而产生梯度冲突，并提出复杂度感知采样与性能感知采样两种策略。复杂度感知采样限制相邻训练步采样子网的FLOPs差异，性能感知采样进一步选择精度好的子网以减少梯度冲突并提升超网质量。
2303.09730|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the challenge of deploying lightweight, low-latency ViTs on diverse mobile devices by proposing ElasticViT, a two-stage NAS approach that trains a high-quality ViT supernet over a large search space and then searches a deployable subnet. It identifies the gradient conflict issue caused by uniform sampling of subnets with vastly different sizes and introduces complexity-aware and performance-aware sampling to mitigate it. Complexity-aware sampling bounds FLOPs differences across adjacent steps, while performance-aware sampling selects accurate subnets to reduce conflicts and improve supernet quality.
2303.09730|v2.assessment: 面向移动端ViT部署的实用NAS工作，梯度冲突分析与采样策略有针对性，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
2303.09730|v2.contribution: 提出ElasticViT两阶段NAS及复杂度/性能感知采样以缓解超网训练梯度冲突。
2303.09730|v2.innovation: 通过复杂度感知与性能感知采样解决大搜索空间下子网规模差异导致的梯度冲突。
2303.09730|v2.result: 训练出支持广泛移动设备的高质量ViT超网并可直接部署最优子网。

2001.05887|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有两阶段NAS方法多局限于单路径搜索空间、难以高效搜索多路径结构的问题，本文提出训练一次性多路径超网以准确评估候选架构。作者发现多路径求和后的特征向量近似为单路径的倍数，这种差异会扰动超网训练与排序能力，因此提出Shadow Batch Normalization（SBN）来正则化不一致的特征统计。实验证明SBN能稳定优化并提升排序性能，MixPath在ImageNet上生成一系列达到最优结果的模型。
2001.05887|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of two-stage NAS methods to single-path search spaces by training a one-shot multi-path supernet for accurate architecture evaluation. It observes that summed multi-path features are nearly multiples of single-path features, perturbing supernet training and ranking, and proposes Shadow Batch Normalization (SBN) to regularize the disparate statistics. Experiments show SBN stabilizes optimization and improves ranking, with MixPath achieving state-of-the-art results on ImageNet.
2001.05887|v2.assessment: 对多路径一次性NAS有清晰的问题洞察与有效机制，实验较充分，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2001.05887|v2.contribution: 提出统一的多路径一次性NAS方法MixPath及Shadow Batch Normalization机制。
2001.05887|v2.innovation: 发现多路径特征统计差异并用SBN正则化以稳定超网训练与提升排序能力。
2001.05887|v2.result: MixPath在ImageNet上生成一系列达到最优结果的模型。

2308.15609|v2.summary_cn: 针对One-Shot NAS需从零训练超网、计算代价极高的问题，本文提出InstaTune，在微调阶段利用现成预训练权重生成超网。方法上避免预训练阶段重复训练，并采用多目标进化搜索抽取面向目标任务优化的子网。相比已有工作，其子网针对目标任务而非预训练目标优化，且可即插即用。摘要未给出具体精度/FLOPs数据，但强调显著降低NAS总体时间与算力。
2308.15609|v2.summary_en: InstaTune addresses the prohibitive cost of training super-networks from scratch in One-Shot NAS by constructing the super-network during fine-tuning from off-the-shelf pre-trained weights. Sub-networks are extracted via multi-objective evolutionary search and are optimized for the target task rather than the pre-training objective. The method is plug-and-play and reduces overall NAS time and compute, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.

PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_cn: 针对一次性（one-shot）NAS 中权重共享超网训练与最终子网性能不一致、搜索效率低的问题，提出 PreNAS，通过“偏好”机制引导超网训练，使超网权重更偏向于有潜力的子网。方法在超网训练阶段引入偏好采样与优化策略，缩小超网与独立训练子网之间的性能差距。相比已有 one-shot NAS，PreNAS 在保持搜索成本较低的同时提升了搜索到架构的精度。在多个基准上取得了优于或可比于主流 NAS 方法的结果，验证了偏好式一次性学习的有效性。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_en: PreNAS addresses the inconsistency between the shared supernet and the final searched subnet in one-shot NAS by introducing a preference mechanism that biases supernet training toward promising architectures. It improves the correlation between supernet weights and standalone subnet performance while keeping search cost low. Experiments on standard NAS benchmarks show competitive or superior accuracy compared with existing one-shot methods.
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.assessment: 面向 one-shot NAS 的训练偏差问题提出偏好式训练思路，对 NAS 效率与精度平衡有参考价值，但整体创新幅度中等。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.contribution: 提出偏好式一次性学习框架 PreNAS，缓解超网与子网性能不一致问题。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.innovation: 在超网训练中引入偏好机制，使权重共享更偏向高潜力子网。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.result: 在多个 NAS 基准上取得优于或可比于主流方法的精度，同时保持较低搜索成本。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa._arxiv_id: PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towards Efficient Neural Architecture Search.

QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_cn: 针对变分量子算法（VQA）中量子电路结构设计依赖人工、搜索空间离散且不可微的问题，提出 QuantumDARTS，将可微架构搜索（DARTS）思想迁移到量子电路搜索中。方法通过连续松弛与梯度优化实现量子架构的可微搜索，并适配量子门参数与结构参数的联合优化。相比人工设计或离散搜索方法，QuantumDARTS 能更高效地探索量子电路结构。在典型 VQA 任务上取得了更好的性能或更低的电路复杂度，展示了可微量子架构搜索的可行性。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_en: QuantumDARTS tackles the manual and discrete design of variational quantum circuits by adapting differentiable architecture search to quantum circuit structures. It jointly optimizes gate parameters and architecture parameters via continuous relaxation and gradient-based search. Experiments on representative VQA tasks demonstrate improved performance or reduced circuit complexity, showing the feasibility of differentiable quantum architecture search.
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.assessment: 将 DARTS 迁移到量子计算领域，交叉方向有新意，但与自动驾驶/视觉感知领域相关度很低。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.contribution: 提出可微分量子架构搜索方法 QuantumDARTS，用于变分量子算法电路设计。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.innovation: 把 DARTS 的连续松弛与梯度搜索思想引入量子电路结构搜索。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.result: 在典型 VQA 任务上取得更优性能或更低电路复杂度。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc._arxiv_id: QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search for Variational Quantum Algorithms.

Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_cn: 针对图神经网络（GNN）架构搜索中训练成本高、搜索空间冗余的问题，提出一种无需训练的线性 NAS 方法，通过线性代理指标直接评估 GNN 架构。方法利用图数据的线性特性构建可快速评估的代理，避免对每个候选架构进行完整训练。相比传统 GNN NAS，显著降低了搜索开销，同时保持有竞争力的性能。在多个图基准数据集上验证了该方法在效率和精度上的优势，为 GNN 架构搜索提供了轻量化方案。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_en: This paper proposes a training-free linear neural architecture search method for graph neural networks to reduce the high training cost of conventional GNN NAS. It leverages linear proxy metrics to evaluate candidate architectures without full training. Experiments on multiple graph benchmarks show competitive performance with substantially lower search overhead.
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.assessment: 面向 GNN 的免训练 NAS 思路清晰，对 NAS 效率研究有参考意义，但与视觉/自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.contribution: 提出一种免训练的线性 GNN 架构搜索方法。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.innovation: 利用线性代理指标替代完整训练来评估 GNN 架构。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.result: 在多个图基准上以更低搜索开销取得有竞争力的性能。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite._arxiv_id: Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Architecture Search of Graph Neural Networks.

EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索空间设计依赖专家经验、代码级架构修改困难的问题，提出 EvoPrompting，利用大语言模型（LLM）进行代码级神经架构搜索。方法将架构表示为代码，通过进化式提示（prompt）让 LLM 生成并迭代改进网络代码，结合进化搜索筛选更优架构。相比传统 NAS 或手工设计，EvoPrompting 能在代码层面灵活探索架构，减少人工先验依赖。在多个任务上取得了优于基线的手工/自动架构结果，展示了 LLM 驱动代码级 NAS 的潜力。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_en: EvoPrompting addresses the reliance on expert knowledge and rigid search spaces in NAS by using large language models for code-level architecture search. It represents architectures as code and employs evolutionary prompting to iteratively generate and refine network implementations. Experiments show improved performance over hand-designed and automated baselines, demonstrating the potential of LLM-driven code-level NAS.
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.assessment: 将 LLM 与进化搜索结合做代码级 NAS，方向新颖，对自动化架构设计有启发，但与视觉感知任务直接相关度有限。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.contribution: 提出 EvoPrompting，用 LLM 与进化提示实现代码级神经架构搜索。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.innovation: 以代码为架构表示，通过进化式提示驱动 LLM 迭代生成与优化网络。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.result: 在多个任务上取得优于手工与自动基线架构的性能。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L._arxiv_id: EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-Level Neural Architecture Search.

Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: 针对多任务图学习中任务间干扰与架构共享困难的问题，提出多任务图神经架构搜索方法，引入任务感知的协作与课程学习机制。方法通过任务感知模块建模任务间关系，并设计课程式搜索策略逐步优化共享与任务特定架构。相比单任务或简单共享的 GNN NAS，能更好平衡任务协作与特异性。在多个多任务图基准上取得性能提升，验证了任务感知协作与课程搜索的有效性。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper targets task interference and architecture sharing in multi-task graph learning by proposing a multi-task graph neural architecture search with task-aware collaboration and curriculum. It models inter-task relations and adopts a curriculum search strategy to balance shared and task-specific architectures. Experiments on multi-task graph benchmarks show performance gains over single-task and naive sharing baselines.
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 面向多任务图学习的 NAS 方法，任务感知与课程机制有一定新意，但与视觉/自动驾驶领域相关度低。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 提出任务感知协作与课程学习的多任务图神经架构搜索方法。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 将任务感知建模与课程式搜索引入多任务 GNN 架构搜索。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在多个多任务图基准上取得优于单任务与简单共享基线的性能。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Search with Task-aware Collaboration and Curriculum.

Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索空间设计缺乏统一形式化、难以系统生成分层结构的问题，提出基于上下文无关文法（CFG）构建分层神经架构搜索空间。方法用 CFG 形式化描述分层架构的生成规则，从而系统化地定义和采样搜索空间，支持更灵活的分层结构探索。相比手工定义的搜索空间，CFG 方法能更规范地覆盖分层架构组合，提升搜索空间的可解释性与可扩展性。在多个基准上验证了基于 CFG 的搜索空间能取得有竞争力的架构性能，为 NAS 搜索空间设计提供了通用框架。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified formalization for NAS search space design by constructing hierarchical search spaces based on context-free grammars. CFG rules formally describe hierarchical architecture generation, enabling systematic definition and sampling of search spaces. Experiments show that CFG-based search spaces yield competitive architectures, offering a general framework for NAS search space design.
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.assessment: 从形式化角度统一分层 NAS 搜索空间设计，方法学价值较高，对 NAS 搜索空间研究有参考意义，但与视觉感知任务直接关联有限。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.contribution: 提出基于上下文无关文法的分层神经架构搜索空间构建方法。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.innovation: 用 CFG 形式化描述并生成分层 NAS 搜索空间。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.result: 在多个基准上验证 CFG 搜索空间可取得有竞争力的架构性能。

Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_cn: 该论文针对知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing）任务中Transformer架构设计依赖人工经验、难以适配不同教育场景的问题，提出了一种面向Transformer的进化神经架构搜索方法。方法通过进化算法在搜索空间中自动优化Transformer的层数、注意力头数、嵌入维度等结构超参数，以提升知识追踪的预测性能。相比已有手工设计的知识追踪模型，该方法能够自动发现更适配具体数据集的架构。实验在多个知识追踪基准数据集上验证了搜索所得架构的优越性，但摘要未给出具体性能提升数据。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design burden of Transformer architectures for knowledge tracing by proposing an evolutionary neural architecture search method. The approach automatically optimizes structural hyperparameters such as layer count, attention heads, and embedding dimensions to better fit diverse educational datasets. Experiments on knowledge tracing benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the searched architectures, though specific quantitative gains are not reported in the abstract.
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.assessment: 该论文属于教育数据挖掘领域的NAS应用，与自动驾驶感知、3D检测、BEV等目标领域几乎无交集，仅NAS方法本身有微弱的方法论参考价值。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.contribution: 提出了一种面向知识追踪任务的进化Transformer架构搜索方法。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.innovation: 将进化神经架构搜索引入知识追踪领域的Transformer结构自动设计。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.result: 在知识追踪基准数据集上验证了自动搜索架构优于手工设计模型，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2501.03782|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在分布外（OoD）泛化场景下架构设计缺乏系统理解的问题，构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准OoD-ViT-NAS，包含3000个不同计算预算的ViT架构并在8个常见OoD数据集上评估。作者系统分析了影响OoD泛化的架构因素，并首次研究了9种免训练NAS方法在ViT OoD鲁棒性上的表现。关键发现包括：ViT架构设计显著影响OoD泛化；ID准确率往往是OoD准确率的糟糕指标，仅优化ID性能存在风险；现有免训练NAS方法虽擅长预测ID准确率，却基本无法预测OoD准确率，而Param或Flop等简单代理指标反而出人意料地优于复杂免训练NAS方法。
2501.03782|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OoD-ViT-NAS, the first systematic benchmark for ViT NAS targeting out-of-distribution generalization, comprising 3000 ViT architectures evaluated on 8 OoD datasets. It analyzes architectural factors affecting OoD generalization and conducts the first study of 9 training-free NAS methods for ViT OoD robustness. Key findings show that ID accuracy is often a poor indicator of OoD accuracy, and existing training-free NAS methods largely fail to predict OoD accuracy, with simple proxies like Param or Flop surprisingly outperforming complex ones.
2501.03782|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了ViT NAS在OoD泛化评估上的空白，基准规模大、结论对自动驾驶等安全敏感场景的架构选型具有直接警示意义，值得关注。
2501.03782|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准，并系统揭示了ID与OoD准确率脱节及免训练NAS方法失效的现象。
2501.03782|v2.innovation: 首次将NAS鲁棒性研究聚焦于ViT的OoD泛化，并发现简单代理指标优于复杂免训练NAS方法。
2501.03782|v2.result: 在3000个架构与8个OoD数据集上验证，表明ID准确率难以指示OoD准确率，现有免训练NAS方法预测OoD准确率基本无效。

SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习场景下设备端推理的神经架构搜索（NAS）计算与通信开销过大的问题，提出了 SuperFedNAS 方法。其核心思路是在联邦学习框架下进行权重共享的 NAS，通过超网（supernet）在客户端本地训练并聚合，从而在有限通信预算下搜索出适配异构设备的架构。相比传统联邦 NAS 需要多次独立训练候选架构，该方法显著降低了搜索成本。实验表明其在多个数据集和硬件平台上能以更低的通信与计算代价达到与标准 NAS 相当的精度。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computation and communication costs of neural architecture search (NAS) for on-device inference in federated learning settings. It proposes SuperFedNAS, a weight-sharing NAS approach that trains a supernet locally on clients and aggregates it, enabling architecture search under limited communication budgets for heterogeneous devices. Compared to conventional federated NAS requiring repeated independent training, it substantially reduces search cost while achieving comparable accuracy across datasets and hardware platforms.
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.assessment: 面向联邦学习与端侧推理的 NAS 工作，对边缘部署场景有参考价值，但与视觉感知核心任务关联较弱。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.contribution: 提出联邦权重共享 NAS 框架 SuperFedNAS，降低端侧架构搜索的通信与计算开销。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.innovation: 将超网权重共享机制引入联邦 NAS，实现有限通信预算下的高效架构搜索。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.result: 在多个数据集与硬件平台上以更低代价达到与标准 NAS 相当的精度。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne._arxiv_id: SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Neural Architecture Search for On-device Inference.

Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_cn: 该论文针对无训练（training-free）生成式架构搜索中代理指标（proxy）依赖人工设计、泛化性差的问题，提出 Auto-GAS 方法自动发现适用于生成任务的代理指标。方法通过自动化搜索流程从候选操作或度量空间中挖掘能有效预测生成模型性能的代理，避免了对特定任务的先验假设。相比手工设计的代理，Auto-GAS 在多个生成任务上实现了更稳定且更优的搜索性能，同时保持零训练开销。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on hand-crafted proxies and poor generalization in training-free generative architecture search. It proposes Auto-GAS, which automatically discovers effective proxies for generative tasks from candidate metric spaces without task-specific priors. Compared to manually designed proxies, Auto-GAS achieves more stable and superior search performance across generative tasks while maintaining zero training cost.
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.assessment: 自动化代理发现思路对无训练 NAS 有启发，但聚焦生成任务，与感知检测领域相关性有限。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.contribution: 提出自动代理发现方法 Auto-GAS，用于无训练生成式架构搜索。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.innovation: 以自动化搜索替代人工设计代理指标，提升跨生成任务的泛化性。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.result: 在多个生成任务上以零训练开销取得更稳定且更优的搜索性能。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for._arxiv_id: Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for Training-Free Generative Architecture Search.

Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_cn: 该论文针对无训练蒸馏感知架构搜索（distillation-aware NAS）中代理指标依赖人工设计、难以适配不同教师-学生配置的问题，提出 Auto-DAS 自动发现代理指标。方法通过自动化流程搜索能预测蒸馏后学生网络性能的代理，减少对任务和蒸馏设置的先验依赖。相比手工代理，Auto-DAS 在多种蒸馏场景下实现了更优且更鲁棒的搜索效果，同时保持无训练的高效性。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on hand-crafted proxies in training-free distillation-aware architecture search, which struggles to adapt across teacher-student configurations. It proposes Auto-DAS to automatically discover proxies that predict distilled student performance, reducing task- and distillation-specific priors. Compared to manual proxies, Auto-DAS achieves better and more robust search results across distillation settings while remaining training-free.
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.assessment: 与 Auto-GAS 同源的自动化代理发现工作，对蒸馏感知 NAS 有参考意义，但与视觉感知主线关联较弱。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.contribution: 提出自动代理发现方法 Auto-DAS，用于无训练蒸馏感知架构搜索。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.innovation: 自动化发现适配不同蒸馏配置的代理指标，提升搜索鲁棒性。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.result: 在多种蒸馏场景下以无训练方式取得更优且更鲁棒的搜索效果。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for._arxiv_id: Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for Training-Free Distillation-Aware Architecture Search.

Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.summary_cn: 该论文针对可微分神经架构搜索（DARTS）中忽略架构单元之间依赖关系、导致搜索次优的问题，提出依赖感知的可微分 NAS 方法。方法显式建模操作或单元之间的依赖结构，并将其融入可微分搜索的优化过程，从而更准确地评估架构组合。相比原始 DARTS 及其变体，该方法在多个图像分类基准上取得了更优的架构与精度，缓解了搜索坍塌与次优问题。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of dependencies among architectural components in differentiable architecture search (DARTS), which leads to suboptimal results. It proposes a dependency-aware differentiable NAS method that explicitly models dependencies between operations or cells and integrates them into the differentiable optimization. Compared to DARTS and its variants, it achieves better architectures and accuracy on multiple image classification benchmarks, mitigating search collapse and suboptimality.
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.assessment: 对 DARTS 依赖建模的改进思路清晰，属于 NAS 基础方法研究，对感知任务有间接借鉴价值。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.contribution: 提出依赖感知的可微分 NAS，显式建模架构组件间依赖关系。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.innovation: 将依赖结构融入可微分搜索优化，缓解 DARTS 的搜索坍塌与次优问题。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.result: 在多个图像分类基准上取得优于 DARTS 及其变体的架构与精度。

Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督 Transformer 架构搜索中缺乏有效监督信号、搜索效率低的问题，提出掩码蒸馏（masked distillation）方法来推进自监督 Transformer 的架构搜索。方法利用掩码建模与蒸馏相结合，为架构搜索提供更稳定的性能估计信号，从而在无标签数据上高效搜索 Transformer 架构。相比已有自监督 NAS 方法，该方法在多个下游任务上取得了更优的迁移性能与搜索效率。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of effective supervision and low efficiency in self-supervised Transformer architecture search. It proposes a masked distillation approach that combines masked modeling with distillation to provide more stable performance estimation signals for architecture search on unlabeled data. Compared to existing self-supervised NAS methods, it achieves better transfer performance and search efficiency on multiple downstream tasks.
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.assessment: 结合自监督与 Transformer 的 NAS 工作，对视觉 Transformer 与自监督方向有一定参考价值。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.contribution: 提出掩码蒸馏方法，推进自监督 Transformer 架构搜索。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.innovation: 将掩码建模与蒸馏结合，为无标签架构搜索提供稳定监督信号。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.result: 在多个下游任务上取得更优的迁移性能与搜索效率。

2403.07591|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无训练 NAS 中单一代理指标在不同任务上估计能力不稳定、且与真实性能存在差距的问题，提出 RoBoT 算法。方法一方面通过贝叶斯优化探索现有无训练指标的优化组合，构建在多样任务上更鲁棒且持续更优的指标；另一方面采用贪心搜索（利用）在新指标上缩小估计差距，从而提升搜索性能。相比仅用单一指标的无训练 NAS，RoBoT 在多个任务上实现了更鲁棒且更优的搜索表现。
2403.07591|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of single training-free proxies across tasks and the estimation gap between proxies and true architecture performance in training-free NAS. It proposes RoBoT, which (a) uses Bayesian optimization to explore an optimized combination of existing training-free metrics for a robust and consistently better proxy across diverse tasks, and (b) applies greedy search on the new metric to bridge the estimation gap and boost search performance. Compared to single-metric training-free NAS, RoBoT achieves more robust and superior search results on multiple tasks.
2403.07591|v2.assessment: 系统性解决无训练 NAS 的鲁棒性与估计差距问题，方法设计完整，对 NAS 方向研究者有较高参考价值。
2403.07591|v2.contribution: 提出 RoBoT 算法，通过指标组合与贪心搜索提升无训练 NAS 的鲁棒性与性能。
2403.07591|v2.innovation: 用贝叶斯优化组合现有无训练指标，并以贪心搜索缩小估计差距。
2403.07591|v2.result: 在多个任务上实现比单一指标无训练 NAS 更鲁棒且更优的搜索性能。

2402.03500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对含噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）时代变分量子算法（VQA）中电路架构选择困难的问题，指出现有量子架构搜索（QAS）研究忽视了硬件噪声对架构搜索本身的影响。作者提出了基于课程学习的强化学习量子架构搜索算法 CRLQAS，引入三维架构编码并限制环境动态以探索电路搜索空间。相比已有 QAS 工作，该方法显式建模噪声影响并采用课程式训练策略。摘要未给出具体性能数据，但声称能应对真实 VQA 部署中的挑战。
2402.03500|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the underexplored impact of hardware noise on quantum architecture search (QAS) for variational quantum algorithms in the NISQ era. It introduces CRLQAS, a curriculum-based reinforcement learning QAS algorithm that incorporates 3D architecture encoding and environment-dynamics restrictions to navigate the circuit search space. Unlike prior QAS methods that largely ignore noise during architecture search, CRLQAS explicitly targets realistic VQA deployment challenges, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2402.03500|v2.assessment: 该论文属于量子计算与强化学习交叉方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知研究领域完全无关，不建议本领域研究者关注。
2402.03500|v2.contribution: 提出面向噪声量子硬件的课程强化学习量子架构搜索算法 CRLQAS。
2402.03500|v2.innovation: 将课程学习与三维架构编码引入量子电路架构搜索以应对硬件噪声。
2402.03500|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅声称可应对真实 VQA 部署挑战。

2403.02484|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 中预测器性能高度依赖网络架构编码方式的问题，系统地将神经编码分为结构型、学习型和分数型三类，并提出统一编码（unified encodings）以将 NAS 预测器扩展到多个搜索空间。作者在 NASBench-101、NB201、NB301、NDS 和 TransNASBench-101 上对超过 150 万个网络架构进行了实验分析。基于这些发现提出预测器 FLAN（Flow Attention for NAS），整合了预测器设计、迁移学习和统一编码的关键经验。FLAN 将训练成本降低了一个数量级以上。
2403.02484|v2.summary_en: This paper systematically categorizes neural architecture encodings into structural, learned, and score-based types, and introduces unified encodings that extend NAS predictors across multiple search spaces. Experiments on over 1.5 million architectures across NASBench-101, NB201, NB301, NDS, and TransNASBench-101 inform the design of FLAN (Flow Attention for NAS), a predictor integrating insights on predictor design, transfer learning, and unified encodings. FLAN achieves more than an order-of-magnitude cost reduction for training.
2403.02484|v2.assessment: 该工作对 NAS 编码进行了大规模系统性研究，实验规模充分，FLAN 预测器在跨搜索空间泛化上有实用价值，但主要面向通用 NAS 而非视觉感知任务。
2403.02484|v2.contribution: 系统分类并扩展 NAS 架构编码，提出跨搜索空间的统一编码与 FLAN 预测器。
2403.02484|v2.innovation: 统一编码使 NAS 预测器可跨多个搜索空间迁移，并结合流注意力机制。
2403.02484|v2.result: 在 150 万+ 架构上验证，训练成本降低超过一个数量级。

2406.01414|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 过程碳排放高的问题，提出碳高效 NAS 框架 CE-NAS。该框架利用强化学习智能体根据时间序列 Transformer 预测的碳强度动态调整 GPU 资源，以平衡节能采样与耗能评估任务，并结合多目标优化器缩减搜索空间。在 HW-NasBench 上碳排放降低最多 7.22 倍且搜索效率与原始 NAS 相当；在 CIFAR-10 上以 1.68M 参数达到 97.35% top-1 精度，碳排放仅 38.53 磅 CO2，并在 ImageNet 上取得 SOTA。
2406.01414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high carbon cost of NAS by proposing CE-NAS, a carbon-efficient framework that uses a reinforcement-learning agent to dynamically adjust GPU resources based on carbon intensity predicted by a time-series transformer, balancing energy-efficient sampling and energy-intensive evaluation. A multi-objective optimizer further reduces the search space. CE-NAS reduces carbon emissions by up to 7.22x on HW-NasBench while maintaining search efficiency, and achieves 97.35% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10 with 1.68M parameters and 38.53 lbs CO2, with SOTA results on ImageNet.
2406.01414|v2.assessment: 该工作将碳排放纳入 NAS 优化目标，思路新颖且实验数据具体，但属于绿色 AI 与通用 NAS 方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知研究关联较弱。
2406.01414|v2.contribution: 提出碳高效的 NAS 框架 CE-NAS，通过碳强度感知的资源调度降低搜索碳排放。
2406.01414|v2.innovation: 将时间序列 Transformer 碳强度预测与强化学习资源调度结合到 NAS 流程中。
2406.01414|v2.result: HW-NasBench 上碳排放降低最多 7.22 倍，CIFAR-10 达 97.35% top-1 且仅 38.53 磅 CO2，ImageNet 上取得 SOTA。

2505.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对零成本NAS代理大多局限于卷积搜索空间、难以适用于Vision Transformer的问题，本文构建了基于Autoformer搜索空间、覆盖6个任务的基准，并提出L-SWAG——一种结合逐层逐样本激活与梯度信息的可泛化零成本代理，在14个任务上同时刻画卷积与Transformer架构。作者还提出LIBRA-NAS，用机器学习模型对多个代理进行低信息增益与偏差重对齐的组合。相比已有ZC代理，L-SWAG首次将零成本代理系统扩展到ViT搜索空间，并在基准上取得更优的排序相关性。
2505.07300|v2.summary_en: This work extends zero-cost (training-free) NAS proxies, which have largely been confined to convolutional search spaces, to Vision Transformers. It introduces a benchmark based on the Autoformer search space over 6 tasks and proposes L-SWAG, a generalizable proxy combining layer-sample-wise activations with gradient information, evaluated across 14 tasks. LIBRA-NAS is further introduced to combine complementary proxies via low-information-gain and bias re-alignment, improving zero-shot NAS performance.
2505.07300|v2.assessment: 将零成本NAS代理系统性地推广到ViT搜索空间，并给出跨14任务的评测，对NAS与ViT交叉方向有参考价值。
2505.07300|v2.contribution: 提出面向Vision Transformer的零成本NAS代理L-SWAG及代理组合方法LIBRA-NAS，并建立Autoformer搜索空间基准。
2505.07300|v2.innovation: 用逐层逐样本激活与梯度信息统一刻画卷积与Transformer架构，并用ML模型对多代理做偏差重对齐组合。
2505.07300|v2.result: 在6任务基准与14任务评测上验证了代理的泛化性，取得优于现有零成本代理的排序表现。

2503.10740|v2.summary_cn: 针对N-shot NAS中所有子网共用静态训练策略导致的两个问题——训练偏向低复杂度子网（不公平）和超网动量更新噪声大（噪声动量），本文提出子网感知的动态超网训练技术。具体包括复杂度感知学习率调度器CaLR，按子网复杂度自适应控制学习率衰减比例以缓解不公平；以及动量分离技术MS，将结构相似的子网分组并各自使用独立动量以抑制噪声。该方法可低成本地嵌入多种N-shot NAS方法，并显著提升搜索性能。
2503.10740|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues in N-shot NAS supernet training caused by a static training strategy shared by all subnets: bias toward low-complexity subnets (unfairness) and noisy momentum updates. It proposes a subnet-aware dynamic supernet training scheme with a complexity-aware LR scheduler (CaLR) and a momentum separation technique (MS) that groups structurally similar subnets. The approach is plug-and-play for various N-shot NAS methods at marginal cost and substantially improves search performance.
2503.10740|v2.assessment: 问题定位清晰、改动轻量且通用，对做NAS工程落地与超网训练的研究者有实用价值。
2503.10740|v2.contribution: 提出子网感知的动态超网训练方法，包含复杂度感知学习率调度与动量分离两项技术。
2503.10740|v2.innovation: 按子网复杂度自适应调整学习率衰减，并按结构相似性分组使用独立动量。
2503.10740|v2.result: 可低成本应用于多种N-shot NAS方法并大幅提升搜索性能。

2502.04975|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS需从头训练每个候选架构、计算代价极高的问题，本文提出一种基于Fisher信息的免训练代理，用于估计图像分类精度。该代理具有统计学理论支撑，可在不训练网络的情况下预测其期望分类精度，从而大幅降低标准NAS算法的计算开销。在三个公开数据集、两个搜索空间上，该代理在已有评价指标以及作者新提出的指标下均取得state-of-the-art结果。
2502.04975|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the prohibitive cost of training every candidate architecture in NAS, this paper proposes a training-free proxy for image classification accuracy based on Fisher Information. The proxy has a statistical theoretical foundation and estimates expected accuracy without training the network, greatly reducing NAS cost. It achieves state-of-the-art results on three public datasets and two search spaces under both existing and a newly proposed evaluation metric.
2502.04975|v2.assessment: 理论动机扎实、评测规范，是免训练NAS代理方向较扎实的一篇工作。
2502.04975|v2.contribution: 提出基于Fisher信息的免训练NAS精度代理。
2502.04975|v2.innovation: 用统计理论支撑的Fisher信息量来估计未训练网络的分类精度。
2502.04975|v2.result: 在三个数据集、两个搜索空间上取得state-of-the-art的代理排序表现。

2506.05869|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于预测器的NAS中损失函数选择缺乏系统研究的问题，本文首次对性能预测器的损失函数进行全面研究，将其分为回归、排序和加权三类。作者在5个搜索空间、13个任务上，用多种NAS相关指标评估了8种损失函数。结果显示特定类别的损失函数可以有效组合以提升基于预测器的NAS，并为实践提供指导。
2506.05869|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study of loss functions for performance predictors in NAS, categorizing them into regression, ranking, and weighted losses. Eight loss functions are evaluated with a range of NAS-relevant metrics on 13 tasks across five search spaces. The results show that certain categories can be effectively combined to improve predictor-based NAS and offer practical guidance.
2506.05869|v2.assessment: 属于扎实的实证性研究，为预测器NAS的损失设计提供了可复用的经验结论。
2506.05869|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究并分类NAS性能预测器的损失函数，给出组合使用建议。
2506.05869|v2.innovation: 在5个搜索空间13个任务上统一评测8种回归/排序/加权损失。
2506.05869|v2.result: 发现特定类别损失函数组合可有效提升基于预测器的NAS性能。

2402.18213|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标NAS中Pareto前沿刻画需为每个硬件约束重复搜索、计算代价高的问题，本文提出一种将用户偏好编码进搜索过程的NAS算法。方法上通过超网络参数化跨设备、多目标的联合架构分布，并以硬件特征和偏好向量为条件，实现单次搜索即可获得跨多设备的多样代表性架构，且可零样本迁移到新设备。相比将硬件约束直接并入目标函数的已有方法，本文避免了逐约束的昂贵重搜索。实验覆盖最多19种硬件设备和3个目标，验证了方法的有效性与可扩展性。
2402.18213|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of Pareto front profiling in multi-objective NAS, where prior methods require a separate expensive search per hardware constraint. It parameterizes a joint architectural distribution over devices and objectives via a hypernetwork conditioned on hardware features and preference vectors, enabling diverse architectures across devices in a single search run with zero-shot transfer to new devices. Experiments on up to 19 hardware devices and 3 objectives demonstrate effectiveness and scalability.
2402.18213|v2.assessment: 将偏好条件化超网络引入多目标NAS，单次搜索覆盖多设备Pareto前沿，工程实用性强，但摘要未给出具体性能数字。
2402.18213|v2.contribution: 提出偏好条件化的超网络NAS，单次搜索即可刻画跨多设备、多目标的Pareto前沿。
2402.18213|v2.innovation: 以硬件特征与偏好向量为条件的联合架构分布建模，实现新设备零样本迁移。
2402.18213|v2.result: 在最多19种硬件设备与3个目标上验证了有效性与可扩展性。

2004.00543|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测器易受对抗攻击、而现有对抗研究多局限于2D图像的问题，本文提出生成可物理实现的通用3D对抗物体以欺骗LiDAR检测器。方法将对抗物体置于目标车辆车顶，使其在点云表示下被检测器完全忽略，并在一系列使用不同点云输入表示的检测器上验证攻击效果。相比已有2D对抗工作，本文首次系统性地将对抗攻击拓展到3D LiDAR感知，攻击成功率达80%，并初步探索了数据增强作为防御手段。
2004.00543|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of LiDAR-based 3D object detectors to adversarial attacks, which has been far less explored than 2D image attacks. The authors generate universal, physically realizable 3D adversarial objects that, when placed on a vehicle rooftop, hide the vehicle from LiDAR detectors with an 80% success rate across detectors using various point cloud representations. They also conduct a pilot study on adversarial defense via data augmentation.
2004.00543|v2.assessment: 该工作将对抗攻击从2D拓展到3D LiDAR感知，攻击成功率高且具物理可实现性，对自动驾驶感知安全性研究有重要参考价值。
2004.00543|v2.contribution: 提出了一种可物理实现的通用3D对抗物体生成方法，能有效欺骗多种LiDAR 3D检测器。
2004.00543|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在3D LiDAR点云上实现通用对抗物体攻击，并验证其跨检测器与跨点云表示的迁移性。
2004.00543|v2.result: 在车顶放置对抗物体可使LiDAR检测器以80%成功率完全漏检目标车辆。

2005.07178|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云内存占用大、传输与存储成本高的问题，本文提出OctSqueeze深度压缩算法。方法先将点云编码为八叉树，再设计树结构条件熵模型对八叉树符号概率建模，从而编码为紧凑比特流。相比此前最先进方法，在相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，且在相同比特率下下游3D分割与检测任务表现更优。该算法可显著降低自动驾驶车辆（单车每日840亿点）的车载与离线存储需求。
2005.07178|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the large memory footprint of LiDAR point clouds by proposing OctSqueeze, a deep compression algorithm that encodes points into an octree and models symbol probabilities with a tree-structured conditional entropy model. It reduces bitrate by 10-20% at equal reconstruction quality over prior state-of-the-art, and outperforms other compressors on downstream 3D segmentation and detection at the same bitrate.
2005.07178|v2.assessment: 该工作将深度熵编码引入LiDAR压缩，兼顾压缩率与下游任务性能，对自动驾驶数据存储与传输有实用价值。
2005.07178|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树结构条件熵模型的LiDAR点云深度压缩算法OctSqueeze。
2005.07178|v2.innovation: 设计树结构条件熵模型对八叉树符号概率建模，实现高效稀疏点云压缩并保持下游任务性能。
2005.07178|v2.result: 相同重建质量下比特率降低10-20%，相同比特率下下游3D分割与检测优于其他压缩算法。

2003.06754|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中需同时可靠感知物体存在与运动行为的问题，本文提出MotionNet，从3D点云序列联合执行感知与运动预测。方法以LiDAR扫描序列为输入，输出编码物体类别与运动信息的BEV地图，骨干为新颖的时空金字塔网络，并引入空间与时间一致性损失正则化预测平滑性。实验表明该方法整体优于包括最新场景流和3D目标检测方法在内的现有技术，可作为基于边界框系统的备份并为运动规划器提供互补信息。
2003.06754|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MotionNet, an efficient deep model that jointly performs perception and motion prediction from LiDAR sweep sequences, outputting a BEV map encoding object category and motion per grid cell. Its spatio-temporal pyramid backbone with spatial and temporal consistency losses outperforms state-of-the-art scene-flow and 3D-detection-based methods, serving as a complement to bounding-box systems for motion planning.
2003.06754|v2.assessment: 该工作提出BEV地图上的联合感知与运动预测框架，时空金字塔与一致性损失设计合理，对自动驾驶感知与规划结合有较高参考价值。
2003.06754|v2.contribution: 提出了从LiDAR序列联合进行感知与运动预测的MotionNet，输出编码类别与运动的BEV地图。
2003.06754|v2.innovation: 设计时空金字塔网络与空间/时间一致性损失，实现BEV地图上平滑且一致的联合感知与运动预测。
2003.06754|v2.result: 整体性能优于最新场景流与3D目标检测方法，可作为边界框系统的备份并提供互补信息。

PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题推断，本文提出PhysGAN，旨在为自动驾驶生成具有物理世界鲁棒性的对抗样本。方法可能基于生成对抗网络生成在真实物理环境中仍能保持攻击效果的对抗样本，以应对自动驾驶感知模型的安全威胁。相比已有数字域对抗样本，其改进点在于强调物理世界鲁棒性，但具体方法与实验数据因摘要缺失无法评估。
PhysGAN: Generating Physical-World-Resil.summary_en: Based on the title alone (abstract unavailable), this paper proposes PhysGAN to generate physical-world-resilient adversarial examples for autonomous driving, likely using a GAN-based approach to produce attacks that remain effective in real physical environments. Specific methods and results cannot be assessed due to the missing abstract.

1911.10455|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有驾驶员注意力预测仅依赖人类注视信息而忽略场景语义的问题，本文提出语义增强注视（SAGE）检测方法，结合原始注视与驾驶特定上下文信息。基于SAGE设计完整显著性预测框架SAGE-Net，进一步引入物体距离（深度）、自车速度与行人过街意图等关键因素修正初始预测。在四个流行显著性算法上的实验表明，在49/56（87.5%）情况下SAGE优于现有技术，且训练过程无额外计算开销。
1911.10455|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses driver attention prediction that relies solely on human gaze while ignoring scene semantics, proposing a Semantics Augmented GazE (SAGE) approach that combines raw gaze with driving-specific contextual information. The SAGE-Net saliency framework further incorporates depth, ego speed, and pedestrian crossing intent, outperforming existing techniques in 49/56 (87.5%) cases without additional training overhead.
1911.10455|v2.assessment: 该工作将场景语义与驾驶上下文融入驾驶员注意力预测，对自动驾驶人机交互与安全研究有一定参考价值。
1911.10455|v2.contribution: 提出了结合场景语义与驾驶上下文的SAGE注视检测方法及SAGE-Net显著性预测框架。
1911.10455|v2.innovation: 将深度、自车速度与行人过街意图等驾驶关键因素融入注视增强的显著性预测。
1911.10455|v2.result: 在49/56（87.5%）情况下优于现有技术，且训练无额外计算开销。
