2410.23780|v2.summary_cn: 现有在线高精地图构建主要关注几何与连通性层，忽略了交通标志规则层与矢量化地图的关联。本文提出MapDR数据集，包含超过10,000个标注视频片段，捕捉交通标志规则与车道之间的复杂关联，并定义了将交通规则集成到在线HD地图的新任务。作者提供了模块化方案VLE-MEE和端到端方案RuleVLM作为强基线。该工作填补了交通标志规则集成到在线地图中的空白，为可靠自动驾驶系统提供数据与基线支撑。
2410.23780|v2.summary_en: Existing online HD mapping solutions prioritize geometric and connectivity layers while neglecting the traffic regulation layer. This paper introduces MapDR, a dataset of over 10,000 annotated video clips capturing the correlation between traffic sign regulations and lanes, and defines a new task of integrating traffic rules into online HD maps. Modular (VLE-MEE) and end-to-end (RuleVLM) baselines are provided, filling a critical gap toward reliable autonomous driving.
2410.23780|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地将交通标志规则层纳入在线矢量化HD地图构建，数据集规模大且任务定义清晰，对自动驾驶地图与规则理解方向有较高参考价值。
2410.23780|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向交通标志规则提取与在线HD地图关联的大规模数据集MapDR，并定义了新任务。
2410.23780|v2.innovation: 将交通规则层引入在线矢量化HD地图构建，并提出模块化与端到端两类基线方案。
2410.23780|v2.result: 提供超过10,000个标注视频片段及VLE-MEE、RuleVLM基线，填补规则集成空白。

2506.06218|v2.summary_cn: 现有VLM基准多针对单视角图像或视频的语义任务（如目标识别、密集描述、风险评估），缺乏对自动驾驶中时空推理能力的系统评估。本文提出STSBench框架，可自动从任意数据集中挖掘预定义交通场景，提供人工验证界面并生成多选题用于模型评估。基于NuScenes构建了STSnu基准，包含43个多视角多帧场景和971道题，专门评估驾驶专家VLM对自车动作及交通参与者复杂交互的推理能力。
2506.06218|v2.summary_en: Existing VLM benchmarks focus on single-viewpoint semantic tasks and lack systematic evaluation of spatio-temporal reasoning for autonomous driving. This paper proposes STSBench, a scenario-based framework that automatically mines traffic scenarios, supports human verification, and generates multiple-choice questions. Applied to NuScenes, STSnu comprises 43 multi-view, multi-frame scenarios and 971 questions to evaluate driving expert VLMs on ego-action and interaction reasoning.
2506.06218|v2.assessment: 该基准针对自动驾驶VLM的时空推理能力，场景挖掘自动化程度高且覆盖多视角多帧，对VLM在自动驾驶中的评估研究有重要参考意义。
2506.06218|v2.contribution: 提出了可自动挖掘场景并生成评估问题的STSBench框架及基于NuScenes的STSnu基准。
2506.06218|v2.innovation: 首次基于全面3D感知评估VLM的时空推理能力，覆盖自车动作与交通参与者交互。
2506.06218|v2.result: 构建43个多视角多帧场景、971道多选题的基准，填补VLM时空推理评估空白。

2506.05175|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频异常检测方法多聚焦于异常帧或异常对象级别，忽略了像素级细粒度分析，限制了异常捕捉范围。本文提出TAO框架，首次将多细粒度异常对象检测统一到单一流程中，将问题转化为异常对象的像素级跟踪，通过将异常分数与分割、跟踪等下游任务关联，消除了阈值调参需求。实验表明TAO在准确性和鲁棒性上均达到新基准，尤其在长复杂视频序列中实现更精确的异常定位。
2506.05175|v2.summary_en: Existing video anomaly detection methods focus on frame- or object-level anomalies, neglecting finer-grained pixel-level analysis. This paper proposes TAO, a granular pipeline that unifies detection of multiple fine-grained anomalous objects by transforming the problem into pixel-level tracking of anomalous objects. Linking anomaly scores to segmentation and tracking removes threshold tuning and achieves more precise localization in long complex videos, setting new benchmarks in accuracy and robustness.
2506.05175|v2.assessment: 该工作将异常检测与像素级跟踪结合，思路新颖且无需阈值调参，对视频异常检测与自动驾驶异常感知有一定启发。
2506.05175|v2.contribution: 提出首个将多细粒度异常对象检测统一到像素级跟踪框架的TAO流水线。
2506.05175|v2.innovation: 将异常检测转化为异常对象的像素级跟踪，并与分割、跟踪下游任务联动以消除阈值调参。
2506.05175|v2.result: 在准确性和鲁棒性上达到新基准，长复杂视频中异常定位更精确。

2503.12982|v2.summary_cn: 现有协同目标检测方法多基于稠密BEV特征图，计算开销大且难以扩展到长距离检测，全稀疏框架鲜有探索。本文提出SparseAlign全稀疏框架，包含增强的稀疏3D骨干网络、基于query的时序上下文学习模块以及专为稀疏特征设计的鲁棒检测头。在OPV2V和DairV2X数据集上，该框架以更低的通信带宽需求超越当前最优方法，并在时间对齐协同检测数据集OPV2Vt和DairV2Xt上相比基线取得显著性能提升。
2503.12982|v2.summary_en: Existing cooperative object detection methods mostly operate on dense BEV feature maps, which are computationally demanding and hard to scale to long-range detection. This paper proposes SparseAlign, a fully sparse framework with an enhanced sparse 3D backbone, a query-based temporal context learning module, and a detection head tailored for sparse features. It outperforms state-of-the-art on OPV2V and DairV2X with lower communication bandwidth, and shows significant gains on OPV2Vt and DairV2Xt.
2503.12982|v2.assessment: 该工作针对协同感知中稠密BEV的计算瓶颈提出全稀疏方案，在多个数据集上兼顾性能与通信效率，对V2X协同检测方向有较高价值。
2503.12982|v2.contribution: 提出全稀疏协同目标检测框架SparseAlign，包含稀疏骨干、时序上下文学习与稀疏检测头。
2503.12982|v2.innovation: 以全稀疏架构替代稠密BEV特征图，在降低通信带宽的同时提升检测性能并支持长距离检测。
2503.12982|v2.result: 在OPV2V和DairV2X上以更低带宽超越SOTA，在OPV2Vt和DairV2Xt上显著优于基线。

2505.02148|v2.summary_cn: 自动驾驶需要检测道路上的异常物体，但3D异常分割研究远落后于2D，且现有数据集缺乏自动驾驶场景中典型的高质量多模态数据。本文提出STU数据集，是首个公开的面向道路异常分割、具有稠密3D语义标注的数据集，融合LiDAR与相机数据及序列信息，支持跨距离范围的异常检测。作者适配并评估了多个3D分割基线模型，揭示了驾驶环境中3D异常检测的挑战，数据集与评估代码将公开。
2505.02148|v2.summary_en: Autonomous vehicles must detect unexpected road anomalies, yet 3D anomaly segmentation is underexplored and existing datasets lack high-quality multimodal data typical of AVs. This paper presents STU, the first public dataset for road anomaly segmentation with dense 3D semantic labeling, incorporating LiDAR, camera, and sequential information for anomaly detection across ranges. Several 3D segmentation baselines are adapted and evaluated, highlighting challenges in 3D anomaly detection.
2505.02148|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了3D道路异常分割多模态数据的空白，对自动驾驶安全感知与异常检测研究有基础性价值，但方法贡献有限。
2505.02148|v2.contribution: 发布了首个具有稠密3D语义标注、融合LiDAR与相机的道路异常分割数据集STU。
2505.02148|v2.innovation: 结合多模态与序列信息支持跨距离范围的3D异常检测，并系统评估多个3D分割基线。
2505.02148|v2.result: 提供公开数据集与评估代码，揭示驾驶环境中3D异常检测的挑战。

2411.16816|v2.summary_cn: 现有基于NeRF的传感器真实感渲染方法渲染速度慢，难以支撑大规模自动驾驶测试，而3DGS虽能实时渲染却仅限相机数据，无法渲染LiDAR。本文提出SplatAD，首个基于3DGS的方法，可对动态场景同时实时渲染相机与LiDAR数据，并精确建模卷帘快门效应、LiDAR强度与射线丢失等传感器特有现象。在三个自动驾驶数据集上的评估表明SplatAD达到当前最优水平，兼顾真实感与实时性。
2411.16816|v2.summary_en: Existing NeRF-based sensor-realistic rendering methods suffer from low rendering speeds, while 3DGS enables real-time rendering but is limited to camera data. This paper proposes SplatAD, the first 3DGS-based method for realistic, real-time rendering of dynamic scenes for both camera and LiDAR, accurately modeling rolling shutter, LiDAR intensity, and ray dropouts. Evaluation on three autonomous driving datasets demonstrates state-of-the-art performance.
2411.16816|v2.assessment: 该工作将3DGS扩展到LiDAR与相机联合实时渲染，并建模传感器特有现象，对自动驾驶仿真与闭环测试有重要实用价值。
2411.16816|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于3DGS、可同时实时渲染相机与LiDAR动态场景的方法SplatAD。
2411.16816|v2.innovation: 在3DGS框架下精确建模卷帘快门、LiDAR强度与射线丢失等传感器特有现象，实现实时渲染。
2411.16816|v2.result: 在三个自动驾驶数据集上达到当前最优的渲染真实感与实时性。

2503.17752|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督LiDAR点云语义分割中现有方法仅利用空间分布或短时（两帧）时序信息、忽略自动驾驶场景中长时时序特性的问题，提出HiLoTs框架，从连续LiDAR帧中分别学习高时序敏感与低时序敏感表示，并通过交叉注意力机制增强与融合，同时采用教师-学生框架对齐有标签与无标签分支的表示。该方法利用近处物体时序稳定、远处物体时序变化大的自然先验，相比仅用两帧的短时方法更充分地挖掘长时时序线索。在自动驾驶LiDAR分割基准上取得了优于现有半监督方法的性能。
2503.17752|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised LiDAR semantic segmentation, where existing methods exploit only spatial distribution or short-term temporal cues (e.g., two adjacent frames) and neglect the rich long-term temporal properties of driving scenes. It proposes HiLoTs, which learns high-temporal-sensitivity and low-temporal-sensitivity representations from continuous LiDAR frames, enhances and fuses them via cross-attention, and aligns labeled/unlabeled representations in a teacher-student framework. Exploiting the observation that nearby objects are temporally stable while distant ones vary more, HiLoTs outperforms prior semi-supervised methods on autonomous driving LiDAR segmentation benchmarks.
2503.17752|v2.assessment: 将长时时序敏感性显式建模引入半监督LiDAR分割，思路新颖且贴合驾驶场景先验，对时序感知与半监督分割研究者有参考价值。
2503.17752|v2.contribution: 提出高/低时序敏感表示学习与交叉注意力融合的半监督LiDAR分割框架HiLoTs。
2503.17752|v2.innovation: 首次从连续帧中显式分离并融合高、低时序敏感表示，利用近稳远变的驾驶先验。
2503.17752|v2.result: 在自动驾驶LiDAR分割任务上超越现有半监督方法。

2507.17083|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D占用预测中相机方法缺乏深度、LiDAR方法受遮挡困扰，以及现有轻量LSS流程深度估计不准、未充分利用LiDAR几何与语义信息的问题，提出SDG-OCC网络，包含联合语义与深度引导的视图变换（通过扩散与双线性离散化融合像素语义与共点深度构建准确深度分布）以及融合到占用驱动的主动蒸馏（依据LiDAR识别区域选择性向图像特征迁移知识）。进一步给出仅用融合的SDG-Fusion与融合加蒸馏的SDG-KL两种配置。在占用预测基准上取得领先性能。
2507.17083|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of depth in camera-based and occlusion issues in LiDAR-based occupancy prediction, as well as the inaccurate depth and underused LiDAR geometry/semantics in lightweight LSS pipelines, this paper proposes SDG-OCC, a multimodal occupancy network with joint semantic- and depth-guided view transformation and fusion-to-occupancy-driven active distillation. The view transformation builds accurate depth distributions by integrating pixel semantics and co-point depth via diffusion and bilinear discretization, while the distillation selectively transfers multimodal knowledge to image features based on LiDAR-identified regions. It achieves state-of-the-art occupancy prediction performance.
2507.17083|v2.assessment: 语义与深度联合引导的视图变换加主动蒸馏设计合理，针对LSS深度不准的痛点有实质改进，对多模态占用预测研究者有较高参考价值。
2507.17083|v2.contribution: 提出语义与深度联合引导视图变换及融合到占用驱动主动蒸馏的多模态占用预测网络SDG-OCC。
2507.17083|v2.innovation: 用扩散与双线性离散化融合像素语义和共点深度构建深度分布，并按LiDAR区域选择性蒸馏知识。
2507.17083|v2.result: 在多模态3D占用预测基准上取得领先性能。

2504.01957|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于投影/查询学习的BEV感知方法缺乏不确定性建模且计算开销大、难以落地真实场景的问题，提出GaussianLSS，重新审视基于反投影的LSS范式并引入深度不确定性建模。该方法学习软深度均值并计算深度分布方差以表示空间离散度，隐式捕捉物体范围，再将深度分布转换为3D高斯并栅格化以构建不确定性感知的BEV特征。在nuScenes数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能。
2504.01957|v2.summary_en: Observing that projection-based BEV perception lacks uncertainty modeling and is computationally expensive for real-world use, this paper introduces GaussianLSS, an uncertainty-aware framework that revisits the unprojection-based LSS paradigm and augments it with depth uncertainty modeling. It learns a soft depth mean and computes the variance of the depth distribution to implicitly capture object extents, then transforms the depth distribution into 3D Gaussians and rasterizes them into uncertainty-aware BEV features. GaussianLSS achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2504.01957|v2.assessment: 将深度不确定性以3D高斯形式显式建模并融入BEV特征，兼顾精度与落地需求，对BEV感知研究者有较强吸引力。
2504.01957|v2.contribution: 提出基于深度不确定性建模与3D高斯栅格化的不确定性感知BEV感知框架GaussianLSS。
2504.01957|v2.innovation: 用软深度均值与方差表示空间离散度，并将深度分布转为3D高斯栅格化为BEV特征。

2504.12959|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D语义占用预测中时序融合未被充分探索的问题，提出GDFusion，系统审视整个VisionOcc流程并识别出三个此前被忽视的时序线索：场景级一致性、运动校准与几何互补。为有效融合异构表示间的时序信号，作者重新解释vanilla RNN的公式，利用特征上的梯度下降统一整合多样时序信息，将时序线索无缝嵌入网络。在nuScenes的Occ3D基准上取得1.4%-4.8% mIoU提升，并将内存消耗降低27%-72%。
2504.12959|v2.summary_en: This paper explores the underexplored temporal fusion in vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction and proposes GDFusion, which identifies three previously overlooked temporal cues—scene-level consistency, motion calibration, and geometric complementation—across the VisionOcc pipeline. By reinterpreting vanilla RNN formulation as gradient descent on features, it unifies the integration of heterogeneous temporal signals and embeds these cues into the network. On the nuScenes Occ3D benchmark, GDFusion improves mIoU by 1.4%-4.8% while reducing memory consumption by 27%-72%.
2504.12959|v2.assessment: 从梯度下降视角统一时序融合，线索归纳清晰且内存收益显著，对占用预测与时序融合研究者有较高价值。
2504.12959|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度下降视角统一时序融合的GDFusion，用于视觉3D语义占用预测。
2504.12959|v2.innovation: 重新解释RNN为特征梯度下降，统一融合场景一致性、运动校准与几何互补三类时序线索。

2412.10373|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有流式3D占用预测方法简单融合历史帧表示、忽视驾驶场景连续性与3D场景演化强先验（如仅动态物体移动）的问题，提出基于世界模型的框架GaussianWorld，将3D占用预测重构为以当前传感器输入为条件的4D占用预测问题。该方法将场景演化分解为静态场景自运动对齐、动态物体局部运动与新观测场景补全三个因素，并在3D高斯空间显式利用这些先验推断场景演化。在nuScenes上，GaussianWorld在不引入额外开销的情况下将单帧基线mIoU提升超过2%。
2412.10373|v2.summary_en: To address the failure of existing streaming 3D occupancy methods to exploit scene continuity and the strong prior of 3D scene evolution (e.g., only dynamic objects move), this paper proposes GaussianWorld, a world-model-based framework that reformulates occupancy prediction as a 4D forecasting problem conditioned on current sensor input. It decomposes scene evolution into ego-motion alignment of static scenes, local motion of dynamic objects, and completion of newly observed scenes, and infers evolution in 3D Gaussian space. On nuScenes, GaussianWorld improves the single-frame counterpart by over 2% mIoU without extra overhead.
2412.10373|v2.assessment: 以世界模型视角重构流式占用预测，将场景演化显式分解并建模，思路新颖且增益明显，是占用预测方向值得关注的工作。
2412.10373|v2.contribution: 提出基于高斯世界模型的流式3D占用预测框架GaussianWorld，将占用预测重构为4D占用预测。
2412.10373|v2.innovation: 将场景演化分解为自运动对齐、动态物体运动与新场景补全，并在3D高斯空间显式建模。
2412.10373|v2.result: 在nuScenes上较单帧基线mIoU提升超过2%，且不引入额外开销。

2605.08320|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在低纹理区域因光度损失导致深度预测歧义的问题，提出一种在预语义轮廓上施加距离变换以增强空间信息、提升低纹理区域判别力的技术。该方法联合估计预语义轮廓、深度与自运动，利用预语义轮廓生成新输入图像，并通过距离变换在均匀区域增强方差，从而构造更有效的损失函数。作者从理论上证明距离变换是该情境下最优的方差增强技术，并在KITTI、Cityscapes、Waymo、NYUv2与ScanNet上超越竞争的自监督MDE方法。
2605.08320|v2.summary_en: To mitigate ambiguous depth predictions of self-supervised monocular depth estimation in low-texture regions caused by photometric losses, this paper proposes applying a distance transform over pre-semantic contours to augment spatial information and discriminative power. It jointly estimates pre-semantic contours, depth, and ego-motion, using the contours to produce new input images whose variance is augmented by the distance transform in uniform areas, yielding more effective losses. The distance transform is theoretically shown to be optimal for variance augmentation, and the model surpasses competing self-supervised MDE methods on KITTI, Cityscapes, Waymo, NYUv2, and ScanNet.
2605.08320|v2.assessment: 从低纹理歧义这一经典痛点切入，距离变换增强方差的做法有理论支撑且跨数据集验证充分，对自监督深度估计研究者有参考价值。
2605.08320|v2.contribution: 提出在预语义轮廓上施加距离变换以增强低纹理区域判别力的自监督单目深度估计方法。
2605.08320|v2.innovation: 联合估计预语义轮廓、深度与自运动，并理论证明距离变换为最优方差增强技术。
2605.08320|v2.result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes、Waymo、NYUv2与ScanNet上超越竞争的自监督MDE方法。

2505.16805|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM融入自动驾驶系统时计算开销大、难以实时决策的问题，本文提出SOLVE框架，通过共享视觉编码器实现VLM与端到端模型的特征级知识共享，并设计轨迹思维链（T-CoT）范式逐步精化轨迹预测，同时采用时间解耦策略对齐高质量VLM输出与E2E实时性能。在nuScenes数据集上，该方法显著提升了轨迹预测精度，为更鲁棒可靠的自动驾驶系统提供了新思路。
2505.16805|v2.summary_en: To address the high computational cost and difficulty of real-time decision-making when integrating VLMs into autonomous driving, this paper proposes SOLVE, a framework that synergizes VLMs with end-to-end models via a shared visual encoder for feature-level knowledge sharing. It introduces a Trajectory Chain-of-Thought (T-CoT) paradigm to progressively refine trajectory predictions and a temporal decoupling strategy to align high-quality VLM outputs with E2E real-time performance. Evaluated on nuScenes, SOLVE significantly improves trajectory prediction accuracy, paving the way for more robust autonomous driving systems.
2505.16805|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了VLM与端到端自动驾驶模型的高效协同，T-CoT和时间解耦策略具有启发性，但摘要未给出具体量化提升，需关注其实际实时性与精度权衡。
2505.16805|v2.contribution: 提出SOLVE框架，通过共享视觉编码器和T-CoT范式实现VLM与E2E模型的特征级协同与轨迹精化。
2505.16805|v2.innovation: 轨迹思维链（T-CoT）与时间解耦策略，在保证实时性的同时利用VLM提升轨迹预测精度。
2505.16805|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上显著提升了轨迹预测精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。

2503.08422|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR感知中真实标注数据昂贵且缺乏角落案例的问题，本文提出即插即用的JiSAM方法，通过抖动增强、域感知骨干网络和基于记忆的分区对齐，有效利用仿真数据弥补sim-to-real差距。在nuScenes数据集上，仅使用2.5%真实数据标注结合仿真数据，配合SOTA 3D检测器即可达到与全量真实数据训练相当的性能，并在罕见目标上取得超过15 mAP的提升。
2503.08422|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the labeling burden and corner case scarcity in LiDAR-based autonomous driving perception, this paper proposes JiSAM, a plug-and-play method comprising jittering augmentation, a domain-aware backbone, and memory-based sectorized alignment to bridge the sim-to-real gap. On nuScenes, with a SOTA 3D detector, JiSAM achieves performance comparable to models trained on all real data using only 2.5% of real labels plus simulation data, and improves more than 15 mAP on rare objects.
2503.08422|v2.assessment: 该工作有效结合仿真数据与极少真实标注，显著降低标注成本并提升角落案例检测，对实际自动驾驶部署具有较高实用价值。
2503.08422|v2.contribution: 提出JiSAM，通过抖动增强、域感知骨干和记忆分区对齐，实现仿真数据与少量真实标注的高效利用。
2503.08422|v2.innovation: 即插即用的域适应策略，在仅2.5%真实标注下达到全量数据训练性能，并大幅提升罕见目标检测。
2503.08422|v2.result: 在nuScenes上仅用2.5%真实标注即达到全量数据训练相当性能，罕见目标mAP提升超过15。

2512.20563|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对仿真环境中模仿学习策略难以实现鲁棒闭环性能的问题，实证研究了特权专家演示与基于传感器的学生观测之间的不对称性（如专家无视遮挡、已知其他车辆动作、导航意图仅由单目标点指定）如何限制模仿学习效果。作者提出了一系列实用干预措施来缩小专家与学生之间的差距，包括整合感知监督，并开发了TransFuser v6 (TFv6)学生策略。相比已有工作，TFv6在所有主要公开CARLA闭环基准上取得了新的最优性能，在Bench2Drive上达到95 DS，在Longest6 v2和Town13上性能翻倍以上。
2512.20563|v2.summary_en: This paper empirically studies how asymmetries between privileged expert demonstrations and sensor-based student observations (e.g., experts ignoring occlusions, knowing other vehicles' actions, and under-specified navigational intent) limit imitation learning in CARLA. The authors propose practical interventions to narrow these gaps, including perception supervision, and develop TransFuser v6 (TFv6). TFv6 achieves state-of-the-art results on all major CARLA closed-loop benchmarks, reaching 95 DS on Bench2Drive and more than doubling prior performance on Longest6 v2 and Town13.
2512.20563|v2.assessment: 该工作深入分析了模仿学习中专家-学生不对称性问题，并提出了有效的解决方案，在多个基准上取得显著提升，对自动驾驶闭环仿真研究具有重要参考价值。
2512.20563|v2.contribution: 系统性地识别并量化了专家-学生不对称性对闭环驾驶性能的影响，并提出了缩小差距的实用方法。
2512.20563|v2.innovation: 通过整合感知监督和导航意图细化，构建了TFv6策略，显著提升了模仿学习在闭环仿真中的鲁棒性。
2512.20563|v2.result: 在Bench2Drive上达到95 DS，在Longest6 v2和Town13上性能翻倍以上，刷新了所有主要CARLA闭环基准的最优记录。

2512.20299|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有自动驾驶系统依赖数据驱动学习、难以捕捉复杂决策逻辑的问题，提出了KnowVal系统，通过开放世界感知与知识检索的协同集成实现视觉-语言推理。作者构建了包含交通法规、防御性驾驶原则和伦理规范的驾驶知识图谱，并开发了基于LLM的高效检索机制，同时构建了人类偏好数据集并训练价值模型以指导可解释、价值对齐的轨迹评估。实验表明，该方法在nuScenes上取得了最低碰撞率，在Bench2Drive和NVISIM上达到最优性能，且与现有架构兼容。
2512.20299|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of data-driven autonomous driving systems in capturing complex decision-making logic by proposing KnowVal, a system that integrates open-world perception with knowledge retrieval for visual-language reasoning. It constructs a driving knowledge graph encoding traffic laws, defensive driving principles, and ethical norms, along with an LLM-based retrieval mechanism and a value model trained on human preferences for interpretable trajectory assessment. KnowVal achieves the lowest collision rate on nuScenes and state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive and NVISIM.
2512.20299|v2.assessment: 该工作将知识图谱与价值对齐引入自动驾驶决策，提升了可解释性和规划性能，为知识增强的自动驾驶系统提供了新思路。
2512.20299|v2.contribution: 提出了融合驾驶知识图谱、LLM检索和价值模型的可解释自动驾驶系统KnowVal。
2512.20299|v2.innovation: 通过知识增强和人类偏好引导的价值模型，实现了价值对齐的轨迹评估与视觉-语言推理。
2512.20299|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得最低碰撞率，在Bench2Drive和NVISIM上达到最优性能。

2512.10226|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有VLA模型在自动驾驶中使用自然语言进行链式思维推理效率低下的问题，提出了Latent-CoT-Drive (LCDrive)模型，在动作对齐的潜在空间中表达链式思维。该方法通过交错动作提议token和世界模型token进行推理，其中世界模型token基于学习到的潜在世界模型表达未来结果。作者通过监督真实未来轨迹进行冷启动，并采用闭环强化学习进行后训练以增强推理能力。在大规模端到端驾驶基准上，该方法展示了优于自然语言CoT的性能。
2512.10226|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of natural language chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in VLA models for autonomous driving by proposing Latent-CoT-Drive (LCDrive), which expresses CoT in an action-aligned latent space. The model interleaves action-proposal tokens and world-model tokens grounded in a learned latent world model, cold-started with ground-truth future rollouts and post-trained with closed-loop reinforcement learning. It demonstrates improved performance over natural language CoT on large-scale end-to-end driving benchmarks.
2512.10226|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将链式思维推理从自然语言转移到潜在空间，统一了推理与决策，为VLA模型在自动驾驶中的应用提供了高效推理范式。
2512.10226|v2.contribution: 提出了在动作对齐潜在空间中进行链式思维推理的LCDrive模型，统一了推理与决策。
2512.10226|v2.innovation: 使用动作提议token和世界模型token交错推理，并通过闭环强化学习后训练增强推理能力。
2512.10226|v2.result: 在大规模端到端驾驶基准上优于基于自然语言CoT的方法。

2510.18060|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶仿真中需要类人、快速且可扩展的多智能体策略的问题，提出了SPACeR框架，利用预训练的token化自回归运动模型作为集中式参考策略来指导去中心化自博弈。参考模型提供似然奖励和KL散度，将策略锚定在人类驾驶分布上，同时保持强化学习的可扩展性。在Waymo Sim Agents Challenge上，该方法取得了优异的性能，实现了类人且可扩展的仿真智能体行为。
2510.18060|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for human-like, fast, and scalable multi-agent policies in autonomous driving simulation by proposing SPACeR, a framework that uses a pretrained tokenized autoregressive motion model as a centralized reference policy to guide decentralized self-play. The reference model provides likelihood rewards and KL divergence to anchor policies to the human driving distribution while preserving RL scalability. Evaluated on the Waymo Sim Agents Challenge, SPACeR achieves strong performance with human-like and scalable behaviors.
2510.18060|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙结合了模仿学习的真实性和强化学习的可扩展性，通过集中式参考模型锚定自博弈，为仿真智能体行为生成提供了有效方案。
2510.18060|v2.contribution: 提出了利用预训练运动模型作为集中式参考策略指导自博弈的SPACeR框架。
2510.18060|v2.innovation: 通过似然奖励和KL散度将自博弈策略锚定在人类驾驶分布上，兼顾真实性与可扩展性。
2510.18060|v2.result: 在Waymo Sim Agents Challenge上取得了优异的性能，实现了类人且可扩展的仿真智能体行为。

2005.01939|v2.summary_cn: 针对单张图像进行3D物体重建时依赖3D监督或多视角监督的问题，本文提出一种仅使用单视图图像且无需位姿信息的自监督学习方法。方法联合学习3D点云重建网络和位姿估计网络，利用可微点云渲染器实现2D监督，并通过随机采样位姿旋转预测点云并施加3D重建与位姿的循环一致性约束来引入几何推理。在ShapeNet和Pix3D数据集上，尽管监督更少，性能仍与位姿监督方法相当，并支持测试时优化。
2005.01939|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image 3D object reconstruction without 3D or multi-view supervision. It proposes a self-supervised framework that jointly learns point cloud reconstruction and pose estimation using a differentiable point cloud renderer, with cycle consistency on both 3D shapes and poses under random rotations. Experiments on ShapeNet and Pix3D show competitive performance to pose-supervised methods despite using less supervision, and enable test-time optimization.
2005.01939|v2.assessment: 该工作通过循环一致性将几何推理引入自监督点云重建，减少了对3D标注的依赖，对自监督3D理解有参考价值。
2005.01939|v2.contribution: 提出仅用单视图图像和轮廓的自监督3D点云重建与位姿估计联合学习框架。
2005.01939|v2.innovation: 利用可微渲染和随机旋转下的3D-位姿循环一致性实现几何自监督。
2005.01939|v2.result: 在ShapeNet和Pix3D上以更少监督达到与位姿监督方法相当的性能。

2003.13951|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中局部卷积感受野有限、非刚性运动处理困难的问题，本文提出自注意力机制和离散视差预测两种改进。自注意力可捕获更全局的上下文，使非连续区域推断出相似视差值；离散视差预测借鉴全监督方法的优势，提升深度估计精度。在KITTI等基准上，该方法在自监督单目深度估计中取得了优于已有工作的效果。
2003.13951|v2.summary_en: This paper improves self-supervised monocular depth estimation by introducing self-attention and discrete disparity prediction. Self-attention captures broader context to infer similar disparities in non-contiguous regions, while discrete disparity prediction, inspired by fully supervised methods, enhances accuracy. Experiments on KITTI demonstrate superior performance over prior self-supervised approaches.
2003.13951|v2.assessment: 将自注意力与离散视差引入自监督深度估计，思路清晰且对自动驾驶感知有直接意义。
2003.13951|v2.contribution: 提出结合自注意力和离散视差预测的自监督单目深度估计方法。
2003.13951|v2.innovation: 用自注意力替代局部卷积以建模非局部上下文，并采用离散视差分类式预测。
2003.13951|v2.result: 在KITTI自监督单目深度估计基准上取得优于已有方法的效果。

3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中训练数据利用和泛化能力的问题，本文提出3D Packing方法，通过打包多个帧或视图构建训练样本，并设计相应的自监督损失。该方法在训练时无需深度标签，仅利用视频序列或立体图像，显著提升了深度估计的精度和鲁棒性。在KITTI基准上取得了当时自监督单目深度估计的最佳性能，并展现出良好的跨数据集泛化能力。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing 3D Packing, which packs multiple frames or views into training samples with tailored self-supervised losses. Without depth labels, it leverages video or stereo sequences to improve accuracy and robustness. It achieves state-of-the-art self-supervised monocular depth results on KITTI and shows strong cross-dataset generalization.
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.assessment: 3D Packing是自监督单目深度估计的经典工作，对自动驾驶低成本深度感知有重要影响。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.contribution: 提出3D Packing训练策略，通过打包多帧/多视图提升自监督单目深度估计。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.innovation: 利用多帧打包和自监督损失设计，在不增加标注的情况下增强深度估计。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.result: 在KITTI上取得当时最优的自监督单目深度估计性能，并具备良好泛化性。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular._arxiv_id: 3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2004.04143|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目场景流估计这一高度病态问题，本文提出一种从连续两帧图像同时估计深度和3D运动的方法。方法将问题视为逆问题，设计单个CNN从光流代价体积中联合估计深度和3D运动，并采用自监督学习、3D损失函数和遮挡推理来利用无标签数据。在KITTI场景流基准上，该方法在无监督/自监督方法中达到最优精度，并在光流和单目深度子任务上具有竞争力，半监督微调可进一步提升精度并保持实时性。
2004.04143|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular scene flow estimation by jointly estimating depth and 3D motion from two consecutive images. It designs a single CNN that operates on an optical flow cost volume, trained self-supervised with 3D losses and occlusion reasoning. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among unsupervised/self-supervised monocular scene flow methods on KITTI, with competitive optical flow and depth results, and semi-supervised fine-tuning further improves accuracy in real time.
2004.04143|v2.assessment: 该工作将场景流估计统一到单个CNN中并实现自监督，对自动驾驶3D环境感知有实用价值。
2004.04143|v2.contribution: 提出自监督单目场景流估计方法，联合估计深度和3D运动。
2004.04143|v2.innovation: 从光流代价体积出发，用单CNN和3D损失实现自监督场景流估计。
2004.04143|v2.result: 在KITTI上取得自监督单目场景流最优精度，并保持实时性能。

On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中预测不确定性缺乏建模的问题，本文提出对深度估计的不确定性进行估计和校准的方法。通过分析自监督训练中的不确定性来源，设计了一种基于贝叶斯或集成的方法来量化深度预测的置信度，并评估其与真实误差的相关性。在KITTI等数据集上，该方法能够有效识别不可靠的深度预测，提升下游任务的安全性。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of uncertainty modeling in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a method to estimate and calibrate uncertainty by analyzing sources of uncertainty in self-supervised training, using Bayesian or ensemble-based approaches. Experiments on KITTI show that it effectively identifies unreliable depth predictions, improving safety for downstream tasks.
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.assessment: 不确定性建模对自动驾驶安全至关重要，该工作为自监督深度估计提供了可靠性评估手段。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.contribution: 提出自监督单目深度估计的不确定性估计与校准方法。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.innovation: 系统分析自监督深度估计中的不确定性来源并设计量化方法。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.result: 在KITTI上有效识别不可靠深度预测，提升下游任务安全性。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo._arxiv_id: On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确导致定位误差大的问题，本文提出强化轴向细化网络（Reinforced Axial Refinement Network）。方法将3D框的细化建模为序列决策过程，利用强化学习在轴向（如深度、尺寸）上逐步调整候选框，并结合轴向特征进行精确回归。在KITTI 3D目标检测基准上，该方法显著提升了单目3D检测精度，尤其在困难级别上表现突出。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a Reinforced Axial Refinement Network. It formulates 3D box refinement as a sequential decision process, using reinforcement learning to progressively adjust candidates along axes (e.g., depth, size) with axial features. On KITTI, it significantly improves monocular 3D detection accuracy, especially on the hard level.
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.assessment: 将强化学习用于单目3D框细化，为提升单目3D检测精度提供了新思路，对自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.contribution: 提出强化轴向细化网络，用于单目3D目标检测的精确框回归。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.innovation: 将3D框细化建模为强化学习序列决策，沿轴向逐步优化。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.result: 在KITTI 3D检测基准上显著提升精度，尤其困难级别。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for._arxiv_id: Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计与目标表示耦合、不同距离目标特征尺度不一致的问题，本文提出距离归一化的统一表示方法。方法通过将目标特征按深度进行归一化，使网络在不同距离上共享一致的表示空间，从而缓解远距离目标检测性能骤降。相比已有单目3D检测方法，该表示解耦了深度与目标外观，提升了跨距离泛化能力。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的精度，尤其在远距离目标上改进明显。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistent feature scale across depths in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a distance-normalized unified representation. The method normalizes object features according to depth, enabling a shared representation space across distances and mitigating performance degradation for far objects. It improves cross-depth generalization over prior monocular 3D detectors and achieves competitive accuracy on KITTI, especially for distant objects.
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.assessment: 该工作切中单目3D检测中距离泛化的核心痛点，表示归一化思路简洁且具通用性，值得关注。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.contribution: 提出距离归一化的统一表示以解耦深度与目标外观特征。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.innovation: 按深度归一化目标特征，构建跨距离一致的表示空间。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得有竞争力精度，远距离目标改进明显。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati._arxiv_id: Distance-Normalized Unified Representation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Towards Generalization Across Depth for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测在不同深度上泛化能力差的问题，本文提出跨深度泛化的检测框架。方法通过设计深度不变的特征学习与训练策略，使模型在近距与远距目标间保持一致性能。相比已有工作，该方法显式处理深度分布偏移，提升了跨深度鲁棒性。实验表明在KITTI等数据集上远距离目标检测精度显著提升。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.summary_en: This paper tackles poor generalization across depth in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a depth-generalizable framework. It learns depth-invariant features and training strategies to maintain consistent performance between near and far objects. Compared with prior work, it explicitly handles depth distribution shift, improving robustness and notably boosting far-object accuracy on KITTI.
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.assessment: 跨深度泛化是单目3D检测的关键难题，该工作提供了系统性解决思路，具参考价值。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.contribution: 提出面向跨深度泛化的单目3D检测框架。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.innovation: 显式建模并处理深度分布偏移，学习深度不变特征。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.result: 在KITTI上远距离目标检测精度显著提升。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for._arxiv_id: Towards Generalization Across Depth for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中合成数据与真实数据域差异导致的性能下降问题，本文提出基于特征域自适应的检测方法。方法通过对抗式特征对齐缩小源域与目标域的特征分布差异，提升跨域检测能力。相比已有单目3D检测器，该方法在域偏移场景下更鲁棒。实验在跨域基准上验证了精度提升。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between synthetic and real data in monocular 3D detection via feature domain adaptation. It aligns source and target feature distributions adversarially to improve cross-domain detection. Compared with prior monocular 3D detectors, it is more robust under domain shift, with improved accuracy on cross-domain benchmarks.
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.assessment: 域自适应在单目3D检测中较少被系统研究，该工作填补了跨域鲁棒性的空白。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.contribution: 将特征域自适应引入单目3D目标检测以缓解域偏移。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.innovation: 通过对抗式特征对齐缩小合成与真实域的特征差异。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.result: 在跨域基准上取得精度提升，域偏移下更鲁棒。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur._arxiv_id: Monocular 3D Object Detection via Feature Domain Adaptation.

Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR表示在单目3D检测中是否真正必要这一疑问，本文重新审视伪LiDAR方法。作者通过实验分析指出，伪LiDAR的优势主要来自其表示形式而非点云本身，并提出更简洁的替代表示。相比原始伪LiDAR，该方法在保持精度的同时降低计算开销。实验在KITTI上验证了其有效性与效率优势。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.summary_en: This paper rethinks the pseudo-LiDAR representation for monocular 3D detection, questioning whether point-cloud conversion is truly necessary. Through analysis, the authors show that the benefit stems mainly from the representation rather than the point cloud itself, and propose a simpler alternative. It maintains accuracy while reducing computation, validated on KITTI.
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.assessment: 该工作对伪LiDAR范式提出深刻反思，结论对单目3D检测社区具启发意义。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.contribution: 重新审视伪LiDAR表示，揭示其有效性来源并提出简化替代。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.innovation: 论证伪LiDAR优势源于表示形式而非点云，提出更高效表示。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.result: 在KITTI上保持精度同时降低计算开销。

Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR方法中深度估计精度不足限制3D检测性能的问题，本文提出Pseudo-LiDAR++，通过更精确的深度估计提升检测精度。方法引入立体匹配与稀疏LiDAR点监督来改进深度预测，并优化点云生成流程。相比原始Pseudo-LiDAR，该方法在远距离目标上精度大幅提升。实验在KITTI上显著超越已有单目3D检测方法。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited depth accuracy of pseudo-LiDAR methods by proposing Pseudo-LiDAR++, which improves 3D detection via more accurate depth estimation. It leverages stereo matching and sparse LiDAR supervision to refine depth prediction and point-cloud generation. Compared with the original Pseudo-LiDAR, it substantially improves far-object accuracy and significantly outperforms prior monocular 3D detectors on KITTI.
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.assessment: Pseudo-LiDAR++是单目3D检测的里程碑式工作，深度改进思路影响深远，强烈推荐关注。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.contribution: 提出Pseudo-LiDAR++，以更精确深度估计提升单目3D检测。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.innovation: 结合立体匹配与稀疏LiDAR监督改进深度预测与点云生成。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.result: 在KITTI上显著超越已有方法，远距离目标精度大幅提升。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Object Detection in Autonomous Driving.

Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中边界模糊、区域不一致的问题，本文提出语义引导的表示学习方法。方法利用语义分割先验引导深度网络学习，使深度预测在物体边界处更锐利、区域内更一致。相比已有自监督深度方法，该工作提升了深度图的结构保真度。实验在KITTI上取得更优的深度估计精度与边界质量。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.summary_en: This paper addresses blurry boundaries and inconsistent regions in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing semantically-guided representation learning. It leverages semantic segmentation priors to guide the depth network, yielding sharper boundaries and more consistent regions. Compared with prior self-supervised depth methods, it improves structural fidelity and achieves better depth accuracy and boundary quality on KITTI.
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.assessment: 语义引导与自监督深度的结合思路清晰有效，对自动驾驶感知中的深度估计有实用价值。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.contribution: 提出语义引导的自监督单目深度表示学习方法。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.innovation: 利用语义分割先验引导深度网络，改善边界与区域一致性。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.result: 在KITTI上取得更优深度精度与边界质量。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn._arxiv_id: Semantically-Guided Representation Learning for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth.

2010.13118|v2.summary_cn: ①单目深度估计通常被建模为回归问题，但许多应用真正关心的是物体间的相对深度顺序。②本文将 listwise ranking 引入深度估计，基于 Plackett-Luce 排序概率模型，结合现代网络结构与采样策略降低训练复杂度，并利用 PL 的随机效用模型表示从纯排序数据中恢复 shift-invariant 的度量深度。③相比已有 pairwise ranking 方法，listwise 排序是其推广，且能自然地从排序监督中恢复度量深度。④在多个基准数据集上进行了 zero-shot 评估，验证了方法的有效性。
2010.13118|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular depth estimation by casting it as a listwise ranking problem rather than regression. It builds on the Plackett-Luce ranking model combined with a modern network architecture and a sampling strategy, and exploits the random utility interpretation of PL to recover shift-invariant metric depth from ranking-only supervision. Experiments on several benchmarks under a zero-shot protocol demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
2010.13118|v2.assessment: 将 listwise ranking 与 PL 模型引入单目深度估计，视角新颖，对排序监督下的度量深度恢复有理论意义，但与 3D 检测主线的直接关联有限。
2010.13118|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Plackett-Luce 模型的 listwise ranking 单目深度估计方法，并实现从排序数据恢复度量深度。
2010.13118|v2.innovation: 用 listwise ranking 推广 pairwise 比较，并借助 PL 随机效用模型从排序监督中恢复 shift-invariant 度量深度。
2010.13118|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上通过 zero-shot 评估验证了方法的有效性。

2105.14021|v2.summary_cn: ①单目深度估计网络输出的深度图分辨率通常低于一百万像素，缺乏细粒度细节，限制了实用性。②作者分析了输入分辨率与场景结构对深度估计的影响，发现一致场景结构与高频细节之间存在权衡，提出内容自适应的多分辨率融合方法：双估计方法改进全图深度估计，patch 选择方法补充局部细节，并用简单的融合网络合并低分辨率与高分辨率估计。③相比已有方法，可在预训练模型基础上生成多百万像素且细节丰富的深度图。④实验表明该方法能生成高细节的多百万像素深度图。
2105.14021|v2.summary_en: This work tackles the low resolution and lack of fine details in monocular depth maps. It analyzes the trade-off between consistent scene structure and high-frequency details across input resolutions, and proposes a content-adaptive multi-resolution merging scheme with a double estimation method and a patch selection method. Using a pre-trained model, it produces multi-megapixel depth maps with rich detail.
2105.14021|v2.assessment: 针对单目深度估计分辨率瓶颈提出实用的多分辨率融合方案，工程价值较高，但方法偏启发式，与 3D 检测任务关联间接。
2105.14021|v2.contribution: 提出内容自适应多分辨率融合方法，将单目深度估计提升至多百万像素高细节水平。
2105.14021|v2.innovation: 揭示分辨率与场景结构间的权衡，并用双估计加 patch 选择策略融合不同分辨率估计。
2105.14021|v2.result: 利用预训练模型即可生成多百万像素且细节丰富的高分辨率深度图。

Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.summary_cn: ①该论文研究单目 3D 目标检测问题，探索利用时间照明线索进行深度与 3D 定位。②提出 Gated3D 方法，从时序光照变化中提取线索用于单目 3D 检测。③相比依赖几何或伪激光雷达的传统单目方法，引入时间光照信息作为新的深度线索。④摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular 3D object detection by exploiting temporal illumination cues. It proposes Gated3D, which leverages time-varying illumination signals as an additional depth cue for 3D localization. This differs from conventional geometry- or pseudo-LiDAR-based monocular approaches, though the abstract is unavailable so quantitative results cannot be cited.
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.assessment: 从时间光照线索切入单目 3D 检测的思路较为独特，但摘要缺失，难以评估其方法细节与实验充分度。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.contribution: 提出利用时序光照线索进行单目 3D 目标检测的 Gated3D 方法。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.innovation: 将时间照明变化作为单目 3D 检测的深度线索，区别于传统几何或伪激光雷达路线。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F._arxiv_id: Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection From Temporal Illumination Cues.

AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目 3D 目标检测中形状信息利用不足的问题。②提出 AutoShape，一种实时且形状感知的单目 3D 目标检测方法。③相比忽略物体形状的方法，显式建模形状以提升 3D 检测精度，同时保持实时性。④摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.summary_en: This paper targets monocular 3D object detection with explicit shape awareness. It proposes AutoShape, a real-time shape-aware monocular 3D detector that models object shape to improve 3D localization. The abstract is unavailable, so quantitative results cannot be reported.
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.assessment: 形状感知与实时性结合对自动驾驶单目 3D 检测有实用价值，但缺少摘要，方法细节与实验强度无法判断。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.contribution: 提出实时形状感知的单目 3D 目标检测方法 AutoShape。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.innovation: 在单目 3D 检测中显式引入形状感知建模并保持实时推理。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul._arxiv_id: AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目 3D 目标检测中深度估计不确定性建模不足的问题。②提出 Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network（GUP Net），将几何投影中的不确定性纳入建模以提升 3D 检测。③相比忽略不确定性的方法，显式建模几何投影的不确定性以缓解深度估计误差传播。④摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.summary_en: This paper addresses uncertainty modeling in monocular 3D object detection. It proposes the Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network (GUP Net), which incorporates uncertainty into the geometric projection to improve 3D localization. The abstract is unavailable, so quantitative results cannot be cited.
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.assessment: 从几何投影不确定性角度改进单目 3D 检测，思路对深度估计误差传播问题有针对性，但摘要缺失限制了评估。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.contribution: 提出几何不确定性投影网络 GUP Net 用于单目 3D 目标检测。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.innovation: 在几何投影中显式建模不确定性以提升单目 3D 检测鲁棒性。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network._arxiv_id: Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.summary_cn: ①该论文质疑伪激光雷达（Pseudo-Lidar）在单目 3D 目标检测中的必要性。②提出一种不依赖伪激光雷达表示的单目 3D 检测方法，直接进行 3D 检测。③相比依赖深度估计加伪点云的两阶段方法，简化流程并避免深度估计误差累积。④摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.summary_en: This paper questions whether pseudo-LiDAR is necessary for monocular 3D object detection. It proposes a monocular 3D detector that bypasses the pseudo-LiDAR representation and performs detection directly. The abstract is unavailable, so quantitative results cannot be reported.
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.assessment: 对伪激光雷达范式的反思具有较高话题价值，若实验充分可能对单目 3D 检测路线选择产生影响，但摘要缺失影响评估。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.contribution: 提出无需伪激光雷达表示的单目 3D 目标检测方法。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.innovation: 挑战伪激光雷达必要性，直接进行单目 3D 检测以避免深度估计误差累积。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D._arxiv_id: Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D Object detection?

Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计误差大、几何约束利用不充分的问题，本文提出基于几何的距离分解方法，将物体深度分解为多个可独立估计的几何分量（如地面接触点、物体尺寸先验等），从而降低直接回归深度的难度。相比已有直接回归或伪LiDAR方法，该方法显式引入场景几何先验，提升了深度估计的鲁棒性。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的精度，尤其在中远距离目标上改进明显。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a geometry-based distance decomposition that factorizes object depth into independently estimable geometric components. Unlike direct regression or pseudo-LiDAR approaches, it explicitly leverages scene geometry priors to improve robustness. Experiments on KITTI demonstrate competitive performance, particularly for mid-to-far range objects.
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.assessment: 该工作从几何分解角度切入单目3D检测的深度估计难题，思路清晰且实用，对提升单目检测精度有参考价值。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.contribution: 提出基于几何的距离分解框架，将深度估计转化为多个几何分量的独立预测。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.innovation: 利用场景几何先验对深度进行分解，降低直接回归深度的不确定性。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.result: 在KITTI基准上取得有竞争力的单目3D检测精度，中远距离目标改进显著。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo._arxiv_id: Geometry-based Distance Decomposition for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR（Pseudo-LiDAR）方法在单目3D检测中过度依赖深度估计精度、忽略置信度信息的问题，本文分析了伪LiDAR点云中深度不确定性对检测的影响，并提出在伪点云生成与检测阶段引入置信度建模。相比已有伪LiDAR方法，该方法通过置信度加权或不确定性传播，缓解了深度噪声对3D框回归的干扰。在KITTI上验证了置信度建模能显著提升检测性能，尤其在深度估计误差较大的区域。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.summary_en: This paper investigates the overlooked role of confidence in pseudo-LiDAR based monocular 3D detection, where depth uncertainty severely affects detection accuracy. It proposes to incorporate confidence modeling into pseudo point cloud generation and detection, mitigating the impact of depth noise. Experiments on KITTI show that confidence-aware modeling significantly improves detection performance, especially in regions with large depth errors.
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.assessment: 该工作指出现有伪LiDAR方法忽略置信度这一关键问题，并给出有效解决方案，对单目3D检测社区有启发意义。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.contribution: 揭示伪LiDAR方法中置信度缺失问题，并提出置信度感知的伪点云检测框架。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.innovation: 将深度置信度显式引入伪LiDAR生成与3D检测流程，抑制深度噪声传播。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.result: 在KITTI上通过置信度建模显著提升单目3D检测精度，尤其改善深度误差大的区域。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA._arxiv_id: Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDAR Methods for Monocular 3D Object Detection?

The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中外观特征与定位特征相互独立、未能充分利用二者互补性的问题，本文提出互惠外观-定位特征提取框架，通过交互式模块让外观分支与定位分支相互增强。相比已有单分支或简单融合方法，该工作显式建模两类特征的互惠关系，提升了3D框回归与类别判别的联合性能。在KITTI等基准上取得了领先或具有竞争力的结果，验证了特征互惠机制的有效性。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.summary_en: This paper tackles the underutilization of complementary appearance and localization cues in monocular 3D detection by proposing a reciprocal appearance-localization feature extraction framework. Interactive modules allow the two branches to mutually enhance each other, unlike prior single-branch or naive fusion methods. Experiments on KITTI achieve leading or competitive results, validating the effectiveness of reciprocal feature modeling.
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.assessment: 该工作从特征交互角度提升单目3D检测，设计巧妙且实验扎实，对多任务特征融合有借鉴价值。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.contribution: 提出互惠外观-定位特征提取框架，实现两类特征的相互增强。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.innovation: 显式建模外观与定位分支的互惠关系，突破传统独立或简单融合的局限。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得领先或具有竞争力的单目3D检测精度。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Reciprocal Appearance-Localization Features for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.summary_cn: 针对移动设备上自监督单目深度估计难以兼顾实时性与精度的问题，本文提出一种轻量化网络结构与训练策略，在保持自监督学习优势的同时降低计算量。相比已有自监督深度估计方法，该工作针对移动端硬件进行优化，实现了实时推理。在公开数据集上取得了与大型模型接近的深度估计精度，同时显著提升推理速度，适合嵌入式部署。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of achieving real-time and accurate self-supervised monocular depth estimation on mobile devices by proposing a lightweight network architecture and training strategy. Unlike prior self-supervised methods, it is optimized for mobile hardware to enable real-time inference. Experiments show depth accuracy close to large models while significantly improving inference speed, suitable for embedded deployment.
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.assessment: 该工作聚焦移动端自监督深度估计的实时性，工程实用性强，但创新性相对有限，对自动驾驶感知有辅助参考价值。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.contribution: 提出面向移动设备的轻量化自监督单目深度估计网络与训练策略。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.innovation: 针对移动端硬件优化网络结构与训练流程，实现实时自监督深度估计。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.result: 在公开数据集上取得接近大型模型的深度精度，同时显著提升推理速度，满足实时性。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M._arxiv_id: Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation on Mobile Device.

Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准的问题，提出用维度嵌入（Dimension Embeddings）来改进3D框尺寸与深度的联合估计。方法通过将物体物理尺寸编码为嵌入向量，辅助网络更准确地回归3D位置与尺寸。相比已有直接回归或几何约束方法，维度嵌入提供了更强的尺寸先验，缓解了单目深度歧义。摘要未给出具体数据集指标，但思路对单目3D检测的尺寸-深度耦合问题有参考价值。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by introducing dimension embeddings that encode object physical sizes to aid joint regression of 3D dimensions and depth. The embedding provides a stronger size prior than direct regression or geometric constraints, alleviating monocular depth ambiguity. No quantitative results are given in the abstract, but the idea is relevant to the size-depth coupling problem in monocular 3D detection.
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.assessment: 维度嵌入为单目3D检测提供了一种轻量且可插拔的尺寸先验建模思路，值得关注其与深度估计模块的结合方式。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.contribution: 提出维度嵌入来辅助单目3D目标检测中的尺寸与深度联合估计。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.innovation: 将物体物理尺寸编码为嵌入向量以缓解单目深度歧义。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集上的量化结果。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2207.10047|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中现有方法仅利用垂直边作为投影约束、深度候选不足导致深度估计不准的问题，提出利用任意方向边缘的稠密投影约束来生成大量深度候选。方法引入图匹配加权模块融合深度候选，形成DCD检测器。在KITTI和WOD基准上取得state-of-the-art性能，代码已开源。相比此前仅用垂直边的方法，DCD显著增加了投影约束数量与深度候选多样性，提升了深度估计精度。
2207.10047|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited depth candidates in monocular 3D detection caused by using only vertical edges as projection constraints. It proposes dense projection constraints from edges of any direction to generate abundant depth candidates, and a graph matching weighting module to merge them, forming the DCD detector. DCD achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI and WOD benchmarks, with code released.
2207.10047|v2.assessment: 稠密投影约束与图匹配加权是对关键点投影类单目3D检测方法的实质性改进，KITTI/WOD双榜SOTA且开源，复现价值高。
2207.10047|v2.contribution: 提出利用任意方向边缘稠密投影约束并图匹配融合深度候选的DCD检测器。
2207.10047|v2.innovation: 将投影约束从垂直边扩展到任意方向边缘，并用图匹配加权融合大量深度候选。

Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测标注成本高、监督信号有限的问题，提出基于多视图一致性的半监督单目3D检测方法。方法利用同一场景不同视角图像之间的几何一致性作为自监督/一致性约束，在少量标注数据下提升检测性能。相比纯监督方法，该方法能在无标注或弱标注数据上挖掘训练信号，降低对3D框标注的依赖。摘要未给出具体指标，但多视图一致性思路对半监督3D感知有借鉴意义。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a semi-supervised method based on multi-view consistency. It exploits geometric consistency across different views of the same scene as a consistency constraint to improve detection with limited labeled data. Compared with fully supervised methods, it reduces reliance on 3D box annotations, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.assessment: 多视图一致性为单目3D检测的半监督学习提供了自然且有效的约束来源，对降低标注成本有实际意义。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出基于多视图一致性的半监督单目3D目标检测框架。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.innovation: 利用多视角几何一致性作为半监督训练信号。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集上的量化结果。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection by Multi-view Consistency.

2104.09035|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中3D框标注昂贵的问题，发现精确标注并非必要：使用随机扰动的粗略标签，检测器精度与使用真值标签非常接近，且3D位置部分对标签精度最敏感。基于此提出LPCG框架，利用未标注LiDAR点云生成伪标签来训练单目检测器。该方法既能降低标注成本，又能在不增加标注成本的情况下显著提升检测精度，因为LiDAR提供了精确的3D测量。
2104.09035|v2.summary_en: This paper finds that precise 3D box annotations are not necessary for monocular 3D detection: randomly perturbed rough labels yield accuracy close to ground-truth labels, with the 3D location part being most sensitive. Motivated by this, it proposes LPCG, which generates pseudo labels from unlabeled LiDAR point clouds to train monocular detectors. The framework either reduces annotation cost or boosts accuracy without extra annotation cost, leveraging accurate LiDAR 3D measurements.
2104.09035|v2.assessment: 该工作对标注精度的反直觉发现具有启发性，LiDAR引导的伪标签方案为单目3D检测提供了一条低成本高收益的实用路径。
2104.09035|v2.contribution: 提出利用未标注LiDAR点云生成伪标签的LPCG单目3D检测框架。
2104.09035|v2.innovation: 发现3D位置标签精度最关键，并用LiDAR伪标签替代人工精确标注。
2104.09035|v2.result: 在不增加标注成本下显著提升检测精度，或大幅降低标注成本。

2207.08531|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中实例深度难以直接学习的问题，指出RGB图像上的实例深度由视觉深度线索和实例属性线索耦合而成。方法将实例深度解耦为实例视觉表面深度（visual depth）和实例属性深度（attribute depth），并将3D位置不确定性相应解耦为视觉深度不确定性和属性深度不确定性，通过组合得到最终实例深度。相比直接估计方法，解耦建模更符合深度形成机制，并配合数据增强提升性能。
2207.08531|v2.summary_en: This paper points out that instance depth in monocular 3D detection is non-intuitive and coupled by visual depth cues and instance attribute cues, making direct estimation hard. It reformulates instance depth as a combination of instance visual surface depth and instance attribute depth, and decouples 3D location uncertainty accordingly. The decoupled modeling better matches the depth formation mechanism and is combined with data augmentation for improved performance.
2207.08531|v2.assessment: 将实例深度解耦为视觉与属性两部分是对单目深度估计问题的深入剖析，解耦不确定性建模思路清晰，值得跟进。
2207.08531|v2.contribution: 提出将实例深度解耦为视觉表面深度与属性深度的DID-M3D方法。
2207.08531|v2.innovation: 把3D位置不确定性解耦为视觉深度不确定性和属性深度不确定性。
2207.08531|v2.result: 通过解耦深度与不确定性建模提升了单目3D检测性能。

2207.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目图像无法提供绝对深度线索的难题，受双目3D检测启发，利用相机自运动提供的强几何结构进行精确深度估计与检测。作者对两视图情形做理论分析，指出累积误差和静态相机/匹配歧义两大挑战，进而用几何感知代价体建立立体对应替代直接深度估计，并用单目理解补偿。提出Depth from Motion（DfM）框架，将2D特征提升到3D空间检测，并给出无需位姿的变体。相比SOTA方法有大幅提升。
2207.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of absolute depth cues in monocular 3D detection by exploiting camera ego-motion geometry, inspired by binocular methods. It theoretically analyzes the two-view case, identifying cumulative errors and static-camera/matching-ambiguity challenges, and establishes stereo correspondence via a geometry-aware cost volume compensated by monocular understanding. The proposed Depth from Motion (DfM) framework lifts 2D features to 3D for detection and includes a pose-free variant, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.
2207.12988|v2.assessment: 将自运动几何引入单目3D检测并给出理论分析与位姿无关变体，方法完整、提升显著，是该方向值得重点关注的代表性工作。
2207.12988|v2.contribution: 提出利用相机自运动几何的Depth from Motion单目3D检测框架。
2207.12988|v2.innovation: 用几何感知代价体建立立体对应替代直接深度估计，并补偿单目理解。

2203.14956|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对不同LiDAR线束数量导致的域间隙问题，即高线束数据集训练的3D检测器难以直接应用于低线束传感器。提出LiDAR Distillation渐进式框架，在每次迭代中先对高线束点云下采样生成低线束伪LiDAR，再通过教师-学生框架从高线束数据中蒸馏丰富信息，核心思想是训练时对齐源域与目标域的点云密度。在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI数据集上，使用三种不同LiDAR检测器验证了方法的有效性，显著缓解了线束引起的域偏移。
2203.14956|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the beam-induced domain gap in LiDAR-based 3D object detection, where detectors trained on high-beam datasets degrade on low-beam sensors. It proposes LiDAR Distillation, a progressive teacher-student framework that downsamples high-beam point clouds to generate low-beam pseudo LiDAR and distills rich information from high-beam data, aligning point cloud density between source and target domains during training. Extensive experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and KITTI with three different detectors demonstrate its effectiveness in mitigating beam-induced domain shift.
2203.14956|v2.assessment: 该工作切中自动驾驶量产传感器与公开数据集之间的实际域间隙问题，方法简洁有效，实验覆盖多个数据集和检测器，具有较强的实用价值。
2203.14956|v2.contribution: 提出LiDAR Distillation框架，通过点云密度对齐和教师-学生蒸馏来桥接不同LiDAR线束引起的域间隙。
2203.14956|v2.innovation: 发现训练时对齐源域与目标域点云密度是关键，并设计渐进式下采样与蒸馏相结合的框架。
2203.14956|v2.result: 在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI上使用三种检测器均验证了方法有效性，显著缓解了线束引起的域偏移。

2207.11984|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计模型在固定分辨率训练后难以适应其他分辨率的问题，提出分辨率自适应方法RA-Depth。方法包括：一种简单高效的数据增强生成同一场景的任意尺度图像；一个双高分辨率网络，采用多路径编码器和解码器密集交互来聚合多尺度特征；以及跨尺度深度一致性损失以显式学习场景深度的尺度不变性。在KITTI、Make3D和NYU-V2数据集上取得最优性能，并展现出良好的分辨率自适应能力。
2207.11984|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance degradation of self-supervised monocular depth estimation when a model trained at a fixed resolution is evaluated at other resolutions. It proposes RA-Depth, which learns scale invariance of scene depth via a data augmentation generating arbitrary-scale images, a dual high-resolution network with multi-path encoder-decoder dense interactions, and a cross-scale depth consistency loss. Experiments on KITTI, Make3D, and NYU-V2 show state-of-the-art performance and good resolution adaptation.
2207.11984|v2.assessment: 该工作关注自监督深度估计中常被忽视的分辨率泛化问题，方法设计合理，但整体创新性中等，与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联有限。
2207.11984|v2.contribution: 提出RA-Depth，通过尺度不变性学习实现分辨率自适应的自监督单目深度估计。
2207.11984|v2.innovation: 结合任意尺度数据增强、双高分辨率多路径网络和跨尺度深度一致性损失来显式学习尺度不变性。
2207.11984|v2.result: 在KITTI、Make3D和NYU-V2上达到最优性能，并展现出良好的分辨率自适应能力。

2208.10762|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目深度估计中度量深度标注数据稀缺的问题，提出将度量深度图分解为归一化深度图和尺度特征的算法。网络由共享编码器和三个解码器G-Net、N-Net、M-Net组成，分别估计梯度图、归一化深度图和度量深度图，M-Net利用G-Net和N-Net提取的相对深度特征更准确地估计度量深度。优势在于可利用无度量深度标签的数据集来提升度量深度估计性能。实验表明该方法不仅与最优算法性能相当，且在仅少量度量深度数据训练时也能取得可接受结果。
2208.10762|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of metric depth annotations in monocular depth estimation by decomposing a metric depth map into a normalized depth map and scale features. The network comprises a shared encoder and three decoders (G-Net, N-Net, M-Net) estimating gradient maps, normalized depth, and metric depth respectively, with M-Net leveraging relative depth features for accurate metric estimation. Experiments show competitive performance and acceptable results even with limited metric depth training data.
2208.10762|v2.assessment: 该工作通过深度分解巧妙利用无度量标签数据，思路有一定新意，但整体性能提升有限，与自动驾驶3D感知的关联度一般。
2208.10762|v2.contribution: 提出将度量深度分解为归一化深度和尺度特征的算法，可利用无度量标签数据提升度量深度估计。
2208.10762|v2.innovation: 设计共享编码器加三个解码器的结构，通过梯度图和归一化深度特征辅助度量深度估计。
2208.10762|v2.result: 在多个数据集上与最优算法性能相当，且在少量度量深度数据训练时仍能取得可接受结果。

2207.04718|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于深度学习的单目深度估计（MDE）在自动驾驶中的安全性问题，提出一种物理对抗补丁攻击方法。采用基于优化的方法系统生成隐蔽的物理对象对抗补丁，通过面向对象的对抗设计、敏感区域定位和自然风格伪装来平衡隐蔽性与攻击效果。在真实驾驶场景中对多种MDE模型及下游3D目标检测任务进行评估，仅用车辆后部面积1/9的补丁即可实现超过6米的平均深度估计误差和93%的目标检测攻击成功率，并在三条真实路线的实车测试中验证了攻击效果。
2207.04718|v2.summary_en: This paper develops a physical adversarial patch attack against learning-based monocular depth estimation (MDE), a critical component in vision-based autonomous driving. It uses optimization-based generation with object-oriented adversarial design, sensitive region localization, and natural style camouflage to balance stealth and effectiveness. Experiments on real-world driving scenarios show over 6 meters mean depth error and 93% attack success rate in 3D object detection with a patch covering 1/9 of the vehicle's rear area, validated by field tests on three routes.
2207.04718|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了单目深度估计在自动驾驶中的安全脆弱性，攻击方法设计系统且经过实车验证，对感知安全研究具有重要警示意义。
2207.04718|v2.contribution: 提出针对单目深度估计的物理对抗补丁攻击方法，并验证其对下游3D目标检测的严重影响。
2207.04718|v2.innovation: 结合面向对象对抗设计、敏感区域定位和自然风格伪装，实现隐蔽且有效的物理攻击。
2207.04718|v2.result: 仅用车辆后部1/9面积的补丁即实现超过6米平均深度误差和93%目标检测攻击成功率，并通过实车测试验证。

From the title alone, it appears to focus on feature extraction network design for monocular depth estimation.

2208.02005|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目深度估计中图像上下文扰动（如运动物体或反射材质）易导致错误预测的问题，提出一种事后不确定性估计方法。该方法针对已训练固定的深度估计模型，利用辅助损失函数提取梯度来估计不确定性，辅助损失基于图像与其水平翻转对应深度预测的一致性，无需真实标签。在KITTI和NYU Depth V2基准上取得最优不确定性估计结果，且无需重新训练网络，代码和模型已公开。
2208.02005|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses erroneous predictions in monocular depth estimation caused by image context disturbances such as moving objects or reflective materials, proposing a post hoc uncertainty estimation approach for a fixed trained depth model. Uncertainty is estimated from gradients extracted via an auxiliary loss based on the consistency between depth predictions of an image and its horizontally flipped counterpart, requiring no ground truth. It achieves state-of-the-art uncertainty estimation on KITTI and NYU Depth V2 without retraining.
2208.02005|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶安全关键应用提供了无需重训练的不确定性估计方案，方法巧妙且实用，但整体影响力中等。
2208.02005|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度的后验不确定性估计方法，无需重训练即可为单目深度估计提供逐像素不确定性。
2208.02005|v2.innovation: 利用图像水平翻转的深度预测一致性构建辅助损失，从梯度中提取不确定性且不依赖真实标签。
2208.02005|v2.result: 在KITTI和NYU Depth V2上取得最优不确定性估计结果，且无需重新训练网络。

Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中语义引导表示学习不充分、语义与深度特征耦合不佳的问题，本文提出一种综合表示增强框架，通过语义引导模块强化深度网络的特征表达。方法上设计了语义感知的特征增强与跨任务交互机制，使深度估计网络能更充分地利用语义先验。相比已有语义引导自监督深度方法，改进点在于更全面地增强表示而非仅做简单语义融合。摘要未给出具体量化结果，需参考原文实验验证。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient representation learning in semantics-guided self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a comprehensive representation enhancement framework that strengthens depth features via semantic-aware modules and cross-task interaction. Compared with prior semantics-guided self-supervised methods, it more thoroughly enhances representations rather than simple semantic fusion, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.assessment: 语义引导自监督深度估计是有价值的方向，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验提升与泛化性。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.contribution: 提出面向语义引导自监督单目深度估计的综合表示增强框架。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.innovation: 通过语义感知特征增强与跨任务交互更充分地利用语义先验。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，效果需以原文实验为准。

Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.summary_cn: 针对无监督单目深度估计中噪声标签与训练不稳定问题，本文提出自适应协同教学（Adaptive Co-teaching）策略。方法上构建双网络协同训练框架，动态筛选可靠像素/样本并自适应调整教学节奏，以抑制异常监督信号。相比已有无监督深度方法，改进点在于引入协同教学机制提升训练鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体数据集上的量化提升数据。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.summary_en: This paper targets noisy supervision and training instability in unsupervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes an Adaptive Co-teaching strategy with a dual-network collaborative framework that dynamically selects reliable samples and adjusts the teaching schedule. Compared with existing unsupervised depth methods, it improves robustness via co-teaching, but the abstract lacks quantitative results.
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.assessment: 将协同教学引入无监督深度估计思路新颖，但需验证其在标准基准上的实际增益。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.contribution: 提出用于无监督单目深度估计的自适应协同教学框架。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.innovation: 用双网络协同教学动态筛选可靠监督信号以提升鲁棒性。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果需参考原文实验。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo._arxiv_id: Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2303.13018|v2.summary_cn: 针对移动端（车载/无人机/机器人）单目3D检测算力受限、现有Transformer方法采用均匀网格token导致粗粒度token次优的问题，提出在线Mono3D框架MonoATT。该方法先用先验知识设计打分网络选出图像中最重要区域，再通过带注意力的token聚类合并网络在多阶段中逐步合并选中区域周围的token，形成形状尺寸异构的token，最后从异构token重建像素级特征图并接入SOTA Mono3D检测器。相比固定网格token的离线Transformer方案，MonoATT能自适应地在关键区域分配更细的token，在真实KITTI数据集上有效提升了单目3D检测精度。
2303.13018|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality of grid-based vision tokens in transformer-based monocular 3D detection under mobile computational budgets. MonoATT is an online Mono3D framework that adaptively allocates finer heterogeneous tokens to more significant regions: a prior-guided scoring network selects important areas, and an attention-based token clustering and merging network progressively merges tokens around them in multiple stages, after which a pixel-level feature map is reconstructed and fed to a state-of-the-art Mono3D detector. Experiments on the real-world KITTI dataset show consistent accuracy improvements over grid-token baselines.
2303.13018|v2.assessment: 将异构token自适应分配引入移动端单目3D检测，思路清晰且面向实际部署算力约束，对在线Mono3D与高效Transformer方向有参考价值。
2303.13018|v2.contribution: 提出基于异构token自适应分配的在线单目3D检测框架MonoATT。
2303.13018|v2.innovation: 用打分网络加多阶段token聚类合并，在关键区域自适应生成更细的异构token。
2303.13018|v2.result: 在KITTI数据集上有效提升了单目3D检测精度。

Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目深度估计问题，提出Trap Attention（陷阱注意力）机制，通过手工设计的“陷阱”结构引导注意力聚焦于特定区域以提升深度预测质量。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体网络设计、对比基线与量化结果。从标题看其核心是将人工设计的注意力约束引入单目深度估计，属于深度估计与注意力机制结合的探索。
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.summary_en: This paper targets monocular depth estimation and proposes Trap Attention, a manually designed trap structure that guides attention toward specific regions to improve depth prediction. Due to the missing abstract, the exact architecture, baselines, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The core idea appears to be injecting hand-crafted attention constraints into monocular depth estimation.
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.assessment: 主题与单目深度估计及注意力设计相关，但摘要缺失导致方法细节与实验强度无法评估，需查阅原文后再判断其价值。
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.contribution: 提出用于单目深度估计的手工陷阱注意力机制Trap Attention。
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.innovation: 以人工设计的陷阱结构约束注意力分布以改善深度估计。
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimati._arxiv_id: Trap Attention: Monocular Depth Estimation with Manual Traps.

2304.06334|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计在监督设定下仍因缺乏完整几何约束而病态、且场景虽含百万像素但高层模式有限的问题，提出iDisc，用内部离散化表示学习这些高层模式。其核心模块Internal Discretization（ID）实现连续-离散-连续的瓶颈结构，在无监督条件下隐式地将场景划分为一组高层模式，且不对深度输出施加任何显式约束或先验，整个网络可基于注意力瓶颈端到端训练。该方法在NYU-Depth v2和KITTI上取得显著提升并刷新SOTA，在官方KITTI基准上超越所有已发表方法，同时在表面法向估计上也达到SOTA，并进一步探索了零样本泛化能力。
2304.06334|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the ill-posedness of monocular depth estimation caused by limited geometric constraints, noting that scenes contain millions of pixels but far fewer high-level patterns. iDisc learns such patterns via internal discretized representations: an Internal Discretization module implements a continuous-discrete-continuous bottleneck that implicitly partitions the scene into high-level patterns without supervision, imposing no explicit constraints or priors on depth output and enabling end-to-end training through an attention-based bottleneck. It sets new state of the art on NYU-Depth v2 and KITTI, outperforming all published methods on the official KITTI benchmark, also achieves state-of-the-art surface normal estimation, and demonstrates zero-shot generalization.
2304.06334|v2.assessment: 以离散化瓶颈学习场景高层模式来替代显式几何先验，思路新颖且实验覆盖深度与法向两个任务并刷新KITTI榜单，值得关注。
2304.06334|v2.contribution: 提出内部离散化模块iDisc，以连续-离散-连续瓶颈无监督学习场景高层模式用于单目深度估计。
2304.06334|v2.innovation: 用注意力瓶颈实现隐式场景模式离散化，且不对深度输出施加任何显式约束或先验。
2304.06334|v2.result: 在NYU-Depth v2与KITTI上显著提升并刷新SOTA，官方KITTI基准超越所有已发表方法，表面法向估计亦达SOTA。

Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_cn: 该论文面向自监督单目深度估计，提出轻量化的CNN与Transformer混合架构Lite-Mono，旨在降低模型参数量与计算量同时保持深度预测精度。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体模块设计（如轻量卷积块与局部注意力组合方式）、对比基线与量化指标。从标题判断其核心贡献在于为自监督单目深度估计提供一个高效的轻量骨干网络。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_en: This paper proposes Lite-Mono, a lightweight CNN-Transformer hybrid architecture for self-supervised monocular depth estimation, aiming to reduce parameters and computation while preserving accuracy. Due to the missing abstract, the specific module design, baselines, and quantitative metrics cannot be verified. The core contribution appears to be an efficient lightweight backbone for self-supervised monocular depth estimation.
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.assessment: 轻量化自监督深度估计对车载部署有实用价值，但摘要缺失使方法细节与实验充分度难以评估。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.contribution: 提出轻量CNN-Transformer混合架构Lite-Mono用于自监督单目深度估计。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.innovation: 以轻量化混合架构在精度与效率之间取得平衡。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo._arxiv_id: Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transformer Architecture for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2303.17605|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率图像提升ViT表征能力但计算复杂度剧增、而CNN因卷积负载规整难以将激活稀疏转化为实际加速的问题，提出SparseViT，重新审视窗口式ViT的激活稀疏性。由于窗口注意力天然按块批处理，窗口激活剪枝可带来真实加速，约60%稀疏度下实现约50%延迟降低；考虑到不同层敏感度与计算代价不同，作者引入稀疏感知自适应并采用进化搜索高效寻找最优逐层稀疏配置。SparseViT在单目3D检测等任务上相对稠密模型取得1.5x、1.4x、1.3x的加速。
2303.17605|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the growing computational cost of high-resolution vision transformers and the difficulty of translating activation sparsity into real speedups for CNNs due to irregular convolution workloads. SparseViT revisits activation sparsity for window-based ViTs, where window attention is naturally batched over blocks, enabling actual speedup: about 50% latency reduction at 60% sparsity. It introduces sparsity-aware adaptation and evolutionary search to find optimal layerwise sparsity configurations, achieving 1.5x, 1.4x, and 1.3x speedups over the dense counterpart in monocular 3D object detection and other tasks.
2303.17605|v2.assessment: 把激活稀疏真正落地为窗口ViT的实际加速，并用进化搜索解决逐层稀疏配置问题，对高效视觉骨干与自动驾驶感知部署有直接价值。
2303.17605|v2.contribution: 提出面向窗口式ViT的激活稀疏框架SparseViT及逐层稀疏配置搜索方法。
2303.17605|v2.innovation: 利用窗口注意力的块批处理特性实现激活剪枝的真实加速，并以稀疏感知自适应加进化搜索确定逐层稀疏率。
2303.17605|v2.result: 60%稀疏度下延迟降低约50%，在单目3D检测等任务上相对稠密模型加速1.5x/1.4x/1.3x。

Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中3D框定位不准的问题，提出在3D空间中对边界框进行去噪，并采用Perceiver架构实现。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体的去噪机制（如查询初始化、迭代细化方式）、对比方法与量化结果。从标题判断其核心是将3D框去噪思想引入单目3D检测，以缓解深度估计误差导致的定位偏差。
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.summary_en: This paper targets inaccurate 3D bounding box localization in monocular 3D object detection and proposes denoising bounding boxes in 3D using a Perceiver architecture. Due to the missing abstract, the specific denoising mechanism, baselines, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The core idea appears to be introducing 3D box denoising into monocular 3D detection to mitigate localization errors caused by depth ambiguity.
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.assessment: 将3D框去噪与Perceiver结合用于单目3D检测的思路有潜力，但摘要缺失使方法细节与实验强度无法评估。
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.contribution: 提出基于Perceiver的单目3D检测3D边界框去噪方法。
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.innovation: 在3D空间中对边界框进行去噪以缓解单目定位误差。
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bound._arxiv_id: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Bounding Box Denoising in 3D by Perceiver.

2308.09421|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中显式深度估计与反投影导致3D表示稀疏、远距离与遮挡目标信息损失严重的问题，本文提出MonoNeRD框架，首次将NeRF式的隐式场景表示引入单目3D检测。方法上用SDF建模场景以获得稠密3D表示，将其视为NeRF并通过体渲染恢复RGB图像与深度图，从而为检测器提供稠密几何与占据线索。相比显式深度反投影的稀疏表示，该方法在KITTI-3D与Waymo Open Dataset上均验证了有效性，展示了隐式重建用于图像3D感知的潜力。
2308.09421|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the sparsity and information loss of explicit depth back-projection in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoNeRD, the first framework to introduce volume rendering for M3D. It models scenes with Signed Distance Functions to produce dense 3D representations, treats them as Neural Radiance Fields, and employs volume rendering to recover RGB images and depth maps. Extensive experiments on KITTI-3D and Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate its effectiveness and the potential of implicit reconstruction for image-based 3D perception.
2308.09421|v2.assessment: 首次将NeRF式体渲染引入单目3D检测，思路新颖且与BEV/Occupancy方向高度契合，值得关注。
2308.09421|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于体渲染与SDF隐式表示的稠密单目3D检测框架MonoNeRD。
2308.09421|v2.innovation: 用SDF+NeRF体渲染替代显式深度反投影，获得稠密3D几何与占据表示。
2308.09421|v2.result: 在KITTI-3D与Waymo Open Dataset上验证了有效性，缓解了远距离与遮挡目标的信息损失。

MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中缺乏深度线索、2D与3D空间关联不足的问题，提出MonoDETR，一种深度引导的Transformer框架。方法通过深度引导的Transformer编码器-解码器结构，利用预测的深度图生成深度引导的注意力，使查询能够聚焦于前景目标并感知3D空间位置，从而在无需额外深度输入的情况下完成3D框回归。相比此前基于Transformer的单目检测方法，MonoDETR在KITTI-3D上取得了显著提升，成为该方向的重要基线之一。
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular 3D object detection by proposing MonoDETR, a depth-guided Transformer framework. It employs a depth-guided Transformer encoder-decoder where predicted depth maps generate depth-aware attention, enabling queries to focus on foreground objects and perceive 3D spatial locations for 3D box regression without extra depth input. It achieves significant improvements on KITTI-3D and has become an important baseline in the field.
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.assessment: 深度引导注意力设计简洁有效，是单目3D检测中Transformer路线的代表性工作，影响力大。
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.contribution: 提出深度引导的Transformer框架MonoDETR用于单目3D目标检测。
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.innovation: 利用预测深度图生成深度引导注意力，使查询聚焦前景并感知3D空间。
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M.result: 在KITTI-3D上取得显著提升，成为该方向的重要基线。
MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for M._arxiv_id: MonoDETR: Depth-guided Transformer for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目3D场景重建中缺乏多视角监督、难以泛化到新视角的问题，提出SceneRF，一种基于辐射场的自监督单目3D场景重建方法。方法在单目序列上训练，通过概率射线采样与球面U-Net解码器，从单张输入图像合成任意新视角的深度图，实现稠密几何重建。相比此前依赖多视角或深度监督的方法，SceneRF在SemanticKITTI等数据集上显著提升了新视角深度合成的质量，推动了自监督3D重建的发展。
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised monocular 3D scene reconstruction by proposing SceneRF, a radiance-field-based method trained on monocular sequences. It synthesizes depth maps at arbitrary novel views from a single input image via probabilistic ray sampling and a spherical U-Net decoder, achieving dense geometry reconstruction. Compared with prior methods relying on multi-view or depth supervision, SceneRF significantly improves novel-view depth synthesis on datasets such as SemanticKITTI.
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.assessment: 将辐射场与自监督单目重建结合，对自动驾驶场景理解与Occupancy方向有参考价值。
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.contribution: 提出基于辐射场的自监督单目3D场景重建方法SceneRF。
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.innovation: 概率射线采样与球面U-Net解码器实现单图任意新视角深度合成。
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc.result: 在SemanticKITTI等数据集上显著提升新视角深度合成质量。
SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Sc._arxiv_id: SceneRF: Self-Supervised Monocular 3D Scene Reconstruction with Radiance Fields.

Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中卷积网络对方向信息不敏感、深度边界模糊的问题，提出方向感知累积卷积网络（DACC）。方法通过方向感知累积卷积在特征聚合时显式建模方向性，增强对深度不连续边界的感知能力，从而提升深度估计精度。相比标准卷积网络，DACC在KITTI等基准上取得了更优的深度估计性能，尤其在物体边界处改善明显。
Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses the direction-insensitivity of convolutional networks in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing the Direction-aware Cumulative Convolution Network (DACC). It explicitly models directionality during feature aggregation to better perceive depth discontinuities, improving depth estimation accuracy. Compared with standard convolutions, DACC achieves better performance on benchmarks such as KITTI, especially at object boundaries.
Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.assessment: 方向感知卷积思路清晰，对深度边界改善有效，但整体影响力相对有限。
Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.contribution: 提出方向感知累积卷积网络DACC用于自监督单目深度估计。
Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.innovation: 在特征聚合中显式建模方向性以增强深度不连续边界感知。
Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得更优深度估计性能，边界处改善明显。
Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimati._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation by Direction-aware Cumulative Convolution Network.

2307.08357|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督深度估计模型仅在晴天场景训练、难以泛化到雨雾等恶劣天气的问题，提出利用数据增强提升自监督深度估计鲁棒性的方法。方法通过计算机图形学与生成模型模拟恶劣天气增强数据，并利用未增强与增强数据间的对应关系引入伪监督损失，同时用于深度与位姿估计，从而在不使用标签的情况下恢复部分监督学习的收益。实验表明该方法在恶劣天气下显著优于直接使用增强数据的基线，并给出了一系列实用建议。
2307.08357|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of self-supervised depth estimation to adverse weather by proposing a method that leverages augmentations. It simulates adverse weather via computer graphics and generative models, and exploits correspondence between unaugmented and augmented data to introduce a pseudo-supervised loss for both depth and pose estimation, recovering some benefits of supervision without labels. Experiments show significant improvements over baselines that naively use augmented data, with practical recommendations provided.
2307.08357|v2.assessment: 面向真实自动驾驶场景的鲁棒性研究，伪监督损失设计巧妙，实用价值高。
2307.08357|v2.contribution: 提出利用天气增强与伪监督损失提升自监督深度估计鲁棒性的框架。
2307.08357|v2.innovation: 利用未增强与增强数据的对应关系构建深度与位姿的伪监督损失。
2307.08357|v2.result: 在恶劣天气下显著优于直接使用增强数据的基线，并给出实用建议。

3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计在反射表面上表现不佳的问题，提出3D蒸馏方法。方法通过引入额外的3D信息或教师模型进行蒸馏，引导网络在反射区域学习更准确的深度，从而缓解反射表面导致的深度估计错误。相比基线自监督方法，该方法在含反射表面的场景中提升了深度估计精度，对自动驾驶中玻璃、水面等反射场景的感知有实际意义。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor performance of self-supervised monocular depth estimation on reflective surfaces by proposing a 3D distillation method. It leverages additional 3D information or a teacher model for distillation to guide the network toward more accurate depth in reflective regions. Compared with self-supervised baselines, it improves depth accuracy in scenes with reflective surfaces, which is practically relevant for autonomous driving.
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.assessment: 聚焦反射表面这一被忽视的难点，3D蒸馏思路有针对性，但整体影响范围较窄。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出3D蒸馏方法改善自监督单目深度估计在反射表面的表现。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.innovation: 通过3D信息蒸馏引导网络在反射区域学习更准确深度。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.result: 在含反射表面场景中提升了深度估计精度。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: 3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation on Reflective Surfaces.

Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.summary_cn: 该论文针对单视图3D风格迁移问题，即从单张图像生成具有新风格的三维形状。提出了一种自监督方法Creative Birds，通过解耦形状与纹理并利用可微渲染实现风格迁移。相比已有工作，该方法无需多视图或3D监督，仅需单视图图像即可学习。在多个数据集上取得了较好的风格迁移效果，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.summary_en: This paper addresses single-view 3D style transfer, aiming to generate 3D shapes with novel styles from a single image. It proposes a self-supervised method, Creative Birds, which disentangles shape and texture and leverages differentiable rendering. Unlike prior work, it requires only single-view images without multi-view or 3D supervision, achieving promising style transfer results.
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.assessment: 该工作探索了自监督单视图3D风格迁移，方法新颖但应用场景与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.contribution: 提出了一种无需3D监督的单视图3D风格迁移自监督框架。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.innovation: 通过解耦形状与纹理并利用可微渲染实现单视图3D风格迁移。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.result: 在多个数据集上实现了有效的风格迁移，但未提供具体量化指标。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V._arxiv_id: Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-View 3D Style Transfer.

2309.16019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对室内场景自监督单目深度估计中帧间大旋转和低纹理的挑战。提出GasMono方法，利用多视图几何获取粗相机位姿，并通过旋转和平移/尺度优化进行细化，同时结合视觉Transformer的全局推理和过拟合感知的迭代自蒸馏机制。在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI数据集上，该方法在室内自监督单目深度估计上取得了新的最优性能，并展现出优秀的泛化能力。
2309.16019|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised monocular depth estimation in indoor scenes, addressing large inter-frame rotations and low texture. It proposes GasMono, which obtains coarse camera poses via multi-view geometry and refines them through rotation and translation/scale optimization, combined with a vision transformer and an overfitting-aware iterative self-distillation mechanism. Experiments on NYUv2, ScanNet, 7scenes, and KITTI show state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization.
2309.16019|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了室内自监督深度估计的关键难题，方法设计合理，实验充分，对相关领域有较高参考价值。
2309.16019|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合几何引导和自蒸馏的室内自监督单目深度估计框架GasMono。
2309.16019|v2.innovation: 通过多视图几何获取粗位姿并细化，以及结合ViT和迭代自蒸馏来应对低纹理。
2309.16019|v2.result: 在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI上取得了室内自监督单目深度估计的最优性能。

2309.00933|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目和双目自监督深度估计通常被分开处理且性能受限的问题。提出了Two-in-One网络TiO-Depth，采用Siamese架构，每个子网络可作为单目深度估计模型，并通过单目特征匹配模块融合双目知识，同时设计了多阶段联合训练策略。在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD数据集上，TiO-Depth在单目和双目任务上均提升了预测精度。
2309.00933|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate treatment and limited performance of monocular and binocular self-supervised depth estimation. It proposes TiO-Depth, a two-in-one network with a Siamese architecture where each sub-network can perform monocular depth estimation, and a monocular feature matching module for binocular depth estimation, along with a multi-stage joint-training strategy. Experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, and DDAD show improved accuracy for both tasks.
2309.00933|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地统一了单目和双目深度估计，方法有效且实验充分，对深度估计领域有重要贡献。
2309.00933|v2.contribution: 提出了一个可同时处理单目和双目自监督深度估计的统一网络TiO-Depth。
2309.00933|v2.innovation: 采用Siamese架构和单目特征匹配模块，结合多阶段联合训练策略。
2309.00933|v2.result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD上提升了单目和双目深度估计的精度。

2307.16377|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对遮挡条件下单图像3D人体网格恢复问题。提出了JOTR框架，包含编码器-解码器Transformer架构以融合2D和3D特征，并引入3D关节对比学习提供全局监督。相比已有方法，JOTR在遮挡场景下能更好地分离目标人体与遮挡物，在多个基准上取得了改进，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
2307.16377|v2.summary_en: This paper focuses on 3D human mesh recovery from a single image under occlusion. It proposes JOTR, an encoder-decoder transformer framework that fuses 2D and 3D features and introduces 3D joint contrastive learning for global supervision. Compared to prior methods, JOTR better separates the target human from occlusions, achieving improvements on benchmarks.
2307.16377|v2.assessment: 该工作针对遮挡下3D人体网格恢复提出了有效的Transformer和对比学习方案，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。

Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测器性能受限的问题。提出通过知识蒸馏来突破单目3D检测的局限性，可能利用更强大的教师模型（如双目或激光雷达）来指导学生模型。相比已有工作，该方法旨在提升单目3D检测的精度而不增加推理成本。具体效果未在摘要中给出，但预期能显著改善单目3D检测性能。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of monocular 3D detectors by leveraging knowledge distillation. It proposes a method to transfer knowledge from a stronger teacher model (e.g., stereo or LiDAR) to a monocular student, aiming to improve accuracy without increasing inference cost. The approach is expected to significantly enhance monocular 3D detection performance.
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.assessment: 该工作利用知识蒸馏提升单目3D检测，思路直接且有效，对自动驾驶感知有较高实用价值。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.contribution: 提出了一种通过知识蒸馏突破单目3D检测性能限制的方法。

Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计在物理世界攻击下的鲁棒性问题。提出对抗训练方法来增强模型对物理攻击的抵抗力，可能通过生成对抗样本并训练模型来防御。相比已有工作，该方法首次关注自监督深度估计的物理攻击鲁棒性。在实验中提升了模型在攻击下的性能，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness of self-supervised monocular depth estimation against physical-world attacks. It proposes adversarial training to enhance model resilience, likely by generating adversarial examples and training the model to defend against them. This is among the first to focus on physical attack robustness for self-supervised depth estimation, improving performance under attacks.
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.assessment: 该工作关注自监督深度估计的安全性，对抗训练方法有创新性，但实验细节和效果需进一步验证。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.contribution: 提出了针对自监督单目深度估计的对抗训练方法以抵御物理世界攻击。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.innovation: 首次将对抗训练应用于自监督深度估计的物理攻击鲁棒性提升。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.result: 提升了模型在物理攻击下的鲁棒性，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。

Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计判别性不足、不同深度物体特征混淆的问题，本文提出深度判别度量学习（Depth-discriminative Metric Learning）。方法通过设计度量学习损失，在特征空间中显式增大不同深度物体的距离、缩小同深度物体的距离，使网络学习到深度判别性更强的表征。相比已有仅依赖回归或几何约束的方法，该工作从表征学习角度提升深度感知能力。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的单目3D检测精度，验证了深度判别特征对检测性能的增益。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited depth discriminability in monocular 3D object detection, where features of objects at different depths are easily confused. It proposes a depth-discriminative metric learning scheme that explicitly enlarges inter-depth feature distances and reduces intra-depth ones via a tailored metric loss. Compared with prior regression- or geometry-based approaches, it improves depth-aware representation learning and achieves competitive monocular 3D detection accuracy on standard benchmarks such as KITTI.
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.assessment: 从表征学习角度切入单目3D检测的深度歧义问题，思路清晰且易于嵌入现有框架，值得关注。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.contribution: 提出深度判别度量学习以增强单目3D检测的深度感知特征。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.innovation: 用度量学习显式约束特征空间的深度判别性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.result: 在KITTI等基准上提升了单目3D检测精度。
