2103.17115|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类细粒度特征易被忽略的问题，本文提出DCNet，包含密集关系蒸馏模块和上下文感知聚合模块。密集关系蒸馏以feed-forward方式将支持特征与查询特征在所有空间位置进行密集匹配，充分利用引导信息应对外观变化和遮挡；上下文感知聚合自适应融合不同尺度特征以捕获尺度感知特征。在少样本检测基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。
2103.17115|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot object detection where fine-grained features of novel objects are easily overlooked with scarce annotations. It proposes DCNet, comprising a Dense Relation Distillation module that densely matches support and query features across all spatial locations in a feed-forward manner, and a Context-aware Aggregation module that adaptively fuses multi-scale features. The method handles appearance changes and occlusions and outperforms existing approaches on few-shot detection benchmarks.
2103.17115|v2.assessment: 密集匹配与多尺度聚合的结合对少样本检测有实用价值，思路清晰且实验较充分，值得关注。
2103.17115|v2.contribution: 提出DCNet，通过密集关系蒸馏和上下文感知聚合充分挖掘支持特征与查询特征的细粒度对应关系。
2103.17115|v2.innovation: 以feed-forward方式在所有空间位置密集匹配支持与查询特征，并自适应聚合多尺度特征。
2103.17115|v2.result: 在少样本目标检测基准上取得优于已有方法的检测性能。

2103.04612|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出少样本目标检测中新类分类与表示之间存在被忽视的隐含矛盾：准确分类需要基类分布彼此远离（max-margin），而精确表示新类又需要基类分布靠近（min-margin）。为此提出类边界均衡（CME）方法，先用全连接层解耦定位特征将检测转为分类问题，再引入类边界损失为新类保留边界空间，并通过对抗扰动特征追求边界均衡。在少样本检测基准上验证了有效性。
2103.04612|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies an implicit contradiction in few-shot object detection between novel-class classification (requiring max-margin between base classes) and representation (requiring min-margin). It proposes Class Margin Equilibrium (CME), which decouples localization features via a fully connected layer, introduces a class margin loss to reserve margin space for novel classes, and pursues margin equilibrium by adversarially disturbing novel-class features. Experiments validate its effectiveness on few-shot detection benchmarks.
2103.04612|v2.assessment: 从margin角度系统分析少样本检测的矛盾并提出均衡方案，理论视角新颖，值得关注。
2103.04612|v2.contribution: 提出类边界均衡（CME）方法，系统优化特征空间划分与新类重建。
2103.04612|v2.innovation: 揭示并解决新类分类与表示之间的max-margin/min-margin矛盾，引入类边界损失与对抗扰动。
2103.04612|v2.result: 在少样本目标检测基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2103.04224|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督域自适应目标检测中现有对抗训练方法仅做类别无关对齐、导致负迁移的问题，本文提出MeGA-CDA，将类别信息引入域自适应过程。方法采用类别判别器实现类别感知的特征对齐，由于目标域无类别标签，提出生成记忆引导的类别特定注意力图，将特征路由到对应类别判别器。在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
2103.04224|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles category-agnostic domain alignment in unsupervised domain adaptive object detection, which causes negative transfer. It proposes MeGA-CDA, which employs category-wise discriminators for category-aware feature alignment and generates memory-guided category-specific attention maps to route features to the corresponding discriminators, since target labels are unavailable. It outperforms existing approaches on several benchmark datasets.
2103.04224|v2.assessment: 将类别信息与记忆引导注意力引入域自适应检测，有效缓解负迁移，方法设计合理且实验充分。
2103.04224|v2.contribution: 提出MeGA-CDA，通过记忆引导的类别特定注意力实现类别感知的域自适应目标检测。
2103.04224|v2.innovation: 用记忆引导的类别特定注意力图将特征路由到类别判别器，实现类别感知对齐。
2103.04224|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上优于现有域自适应检测方法。

2011.10678|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测扩展类别需成比例增加边界框标注、成本高昂的问题，本文提出开放词汇目标检测这一更通用实用的新范式。方法利用有限类别的边界框标注以及覆盖更广物体、成本更低的图像-文本对来训练检测器，使其能检测训练中未提供边界框标注的物体。相比零样本方法，对未标注类别检测精度显著更高，同时有标注类别的检测精度几乎不受影响。
2011.10678|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of scaling object detectors to more categories, which requires proportionally more bounding box annotations. It formulates open-vocabulary object detection and trains detectors using bounding boxes for a limited set of categories plus image-caption pairs covering a much larger variety of objects. The method detects objects without bounding box annotations at significantly higher accuracy than zero-shot approaches, while maintaining nearly the same accuracy on annotated categories.
2011.10678|v2.assessment: 开放词汇检测是重要且影响深远的新范式，利用caption监督的思路实用，值得高度关注。
2011.10678|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇目标检测范式，并给出利用图像-文本对训练检测器的方法。
2011.10678|v2.innovation: 将caption监督引入检测训练，使检测器能定位训练中无边界框标注的物体。
2011.10678|v2.result: 对未标注类别的检测精度显著高于零样本方法，有标注类别精度几乎不受影响。

2105.01294|v2.summary_cn: 针对极少样本（少于3个）场景下训练数据缺乏变化的问题，本文提出从基类迁移类内变化来为新类构建更好的变化模型。方法引入hallucinator网络，在RoI特征空间生成额外的有用训练样本并融入现代检测模型。在两种不同候选框生成流程的先进少样本检测器上均取得显著提升，并在COCO基准的极端少样本场景下达到新的最优。
2105.01294|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the extremely-few-shot regime (fewer than three examples) where training data lacks variation. It introduces a hallucinator network that learns to generate additional useful training examples in the RoI feature space by transferring shared within-class variation from base classes, and integrates it into a modern detector. It improves two state-of-the-art few-shot detectors and achieves new state of the art in the extremely-few-shot regime on COCO.
2105.01294|v2.assessment: 在特征空间做幻觉增强以缓解数据稀缺，思路简洁有效，在极端少样本下表现突出。
2105.01294|v2.contribution: 提出hallucinator网络，在RoI特征空间生成额外训练样本以增强少样本检测。
2105.01294|v2.innovation: 从基类迁移共享的类内变化，在特征空间为新类合成有用样本。
2105.01294|v2.result: 在COCO极端少样本场景下达到新的最优，并提升两种先进少样本检测器。

2103.01903|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本检测中新类数据稀缺导致性能受限的问题，本文利用新类与基类之间不随数据量变化的语义关系，将显式关系推理引入新类检测学习。方法用从大规模文本语料学到的语义嵌入表示每个类别概念，训练检测器将物体图像表示投影到该嵌入空间，并针对直接使用原始嵌入与启发式知识图谱的问题，提出用动态关系图增强嵌入。所得SRR-FSD在不同shot数下鲁棒稳定，在低显式和隐式shot下性能显著更优。
2103.01903|v2.summary_en: This paper leverages the semantic relation between novel and base classes, which is invariant to data availability, for few-shot object detection. It represents each class concept by a semantic embedding learned from a large text corpus, trains the detector to project object image representations into this space, and augments embeddings with a dynamic relation graph instead of raw embeddings with a heuristic knowledge graph. The resulting SRR-FSD is robust to shot variation and significantly better under low explicit and implicit shots.
2103.01903|v2.assessment: 将语义关系推理与动态关系图引入少样本检测，提升shot稳定性，思路有启发性。
2103.01903|v2.contribution: 提出SRR-FSD，将语义关系推理与动态关系图引入少样本目标检测。
2103.01903|v2.innovation: 用动态关系图增强文本语义嵌入，并让检测器将图像表示投影到语义嵌入空间。
2103.01903|v2.result: 在不同shot数下鲁棒稳定，低显式与隐式shot下性能显著优于已有方法。

2111.11656|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类特征空间分散、类间可分性差的问题，论文提出FADI两阶段微调框架。方法先在关联步骤中让每个新类显式模仿某个特定基类的特征空间以构建紧凑的新类特征，再在判别步骤中增强类间可分性。相比传统整体微调隐式利用多个基类导致特征分散的做法，FADI显式约束新类特征空间结构。在PASCAL VOC和COCO少样本基准上取得优于已有方法的效果。
2111.11656|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scattered feature space and poor inter-class separability in few-shot object detection caused by holistic fine-tuning. It proposes FADI, a two-step fine-tuning framework that first associates each novel class with a specific base class to build a compact feature space and then enforces discrimination. Compared with implicit multi-base-class fine-tuning, FADI yields a more discriminative novel-class feature space and improves few-shot detection performance on standard benchmarks.
2111.11656|v2.assessment: 该工作对少样本检测中的特征空间结构问题给出了清晰的两阶段解决方案，思路简洁有效，对低数据场景检测研究有参考价值。
2111.11656|v2.contribution: 提出FADI两阶段微调框架，通过显式关联与判别构建紧凑且可分的新类特征空间。
2111.11656|v2.innovation: 用显式模仿特定基类特征空间替代隐式利用多基类知识，缓解新类特征分散问题。
2111.11656|v2.result: 在少样本目标检测基准上取得优于已有方法的检测精度。

2110.14191|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测依赖大规模全标注数据的问题，论文研究混合监督检测，利用基类全标注辅助新类弱标注学习。方法从基类迁移掩码先验以提升目标检测能力，并迁移基类学到的语义相似性来去噪新类的伪全标注。相比仅迁移类无关objectness的已有工作，该方法进一步缩小了新类与基类之间的差距。在三个基准数据集上验证了方法优于现有方法。
2110.14191|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles mixed-supervised object detection, where novel categories are learned from weak annotations with the help of fully annotated base categories. It transfers mask priors and semantic similarity from base categories to upgrade and denoise pseudo full annotations for novel categories. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing mixed-supervision methods.
2110.14191|v2.assessment: 该工作通过迁移掩码先验与语义相似性提升弱监督新类检测质量，思路合理，对降低标注成本的检测研究有借鉴意义。
2110.14191|v2.contribution: 提出迁移掩码先验与语义相似性的混合监督目标检测框架。
2110.14191|v2.innovation: 在objectness迁移之外引入掩码先验和语义相似性来去噪新类伪标注。
2110.14191|v2.result: 在三个基准数据集上优于现有混合监督检测方法。

2203.14911|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放集目标检测中未知类别目标常被误分为已知类的问题，本文基于未知目标通常分布在隐空间低密度区域的假设，提出OpenDet检测器。方法包含两个学习器：对比特征学习器（CFL）通过实例级对比学习使已知类特征更紧凑，从而为未知类留出更多低密度区域；未知概率学习器（UPL）基于预测不确定性优化未知概率，进一步在已知类簇周围划分低密度区域。相比仅依赖阈值、低密度区域覆盖有限的传统方法，OpenDet能更完整地覆盖未知目标，在开放集检测基准上取得显著提升。
2203.14911|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set object detection (OSOD), where unknown-category objects are often misclassified into known classes. It proposes OpenDet, which separates high/low-density regions in latent space based on the consensus that unknown objects lie in low-density regions. Two learners, a Contrastive Feature Learner (CFL) and an Unknown Probability Learner (UPL), compact known-class features and optimize unknown probability to expand low-density regions, outperforming threshold-based methods that only maintain limited low-density regions.
2203.14911|v2.assessment: 该工作从隐空间密度角度切入开放集检测，思路清晰且与自动驾驶中未知障碍物检测需求高度契合，实验充分，值得关注。
2203.14911|v2.contribution: 提出通过扩展低密度隐区域来识别未知目标的OpenDet开放集检测框架。
2203.14911|v2.innovation: 用对比特征学习与未知概率学习协同扩展低密度区域，突破传统阈值方法的覆盖局限。
2203.14911|v2.result: 在开放集检测基准上显著提升未知类识别能力，同时保持已知类检测性能。

2112.02413|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP这类2D图文预训练模型能否泛化到3D识别的问题，本文提出PointCLIP，将点云投影为多视角深度图并用CLIP编码，与3D类别文本对齐，通过聚合各视角零样本预测实现2D到3D的知识迁移。此外设计跨视角适配器以更好提取全局特征并自适应融合少样本3D知识，仅微调轻量适配器即可大幅提升性能。实验还发现PointCLIP与经典3D监督网络具有互补性，简单集成即可提升基线性能。
2112.02413|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether 2D image-text pre-trained CLIP can generalize to 3D recognition and proposes PointCLIP, which aligns CLIP-encoded point clouds with 3D category texts by projecting point clouds into multi-view depth maps and aggregating view-wise zero-shot predictions. An inter-view adapter extracts global features and fuses few-shot 3D knowledge, and the method is shown to be complementary to classical 3D-supervised networks.
2112.02413|v2.assessment: 将视觉语言预训练迁移到3D理解的开创性尝试，为多模态3D感知提供了新范式，对自动驾驶中的开放词汇3D识别有启发。
2112.02413|v2.contribution: 提出首个将CLIP零样本能力迁移到点云理解的PointCLIP框架。
2112.02413|v2.innovation: 通过多视角深度图投影与跨视角适配器实现2D图文知识向3D的迁移与少样本融合。
2112.02413|v2.result: 少样本微调适配器即可大幅提升性能，且与3D监督网络集成可提升基线表现。

2205.13384|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉搜索中图库集增量增长、现有方法依赖全量数据训练且模型更新后需对全库重提特征导致计算开销大的问题，本文提出一种具有后向一致特征嵌入的持续学习方法。通过跨会话数据一致性、邻会话模型一致性和会话内判别性三种损失构建持续学习器，并支持在类别边界模糊、新类不断加入的场景下工作。这是首个同时解决后向一致特征嵌入并允许新会话出现新类的持续学习方法，在多个基准上验证了有效性。
2205.13384|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-term visual search where the gallery set grows incrementally and model updates would otherwise require re-extracting features for the entire gallery. It introduces a continual learning approach with backward-consistent feature embedding, enforced via inter-session data coherence, neighbor-session model coherence, and intra-session discrimination losses. It is the first CL method to handle both backward-consistent embedding and novel classes appearing in new sessions.
2205.13384|v2.assessment: 面向视觉搜索的持续学习问题定义新颖，后向一致性思路对实际部署有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度一般。
2205.13384|v2.contribution: 提出首个兼顾后向一致特征嵌入与新类出现的视觉搜索持续学习框架。
2205.13384|v2.innovation: 用跨会话数据、邻会话模型与会话内判别三重损失实现后向一致的特征嵌入。
2205.13384|v2.result: 在多个基准上验证了方法在增量图库场景下的有效性。

2203.06953|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中新类样本稀缺且需不遗忘旧类的问题，现有方法多采用回顾式策略使更新模型接近旧模型，本文提出前瞻式的ForwArd Compatible Training（FACT）。方法通过分配虚拟原型压缩已知类嵌入空间，为未来新类预留空间，并预测可能的新类为更新过程做准备；虚拟原型在推理时作为代理构建更强分类器。FACT能高效整合新类，在FSCIL基准上取得领先性能。
2203.06953|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) by proposing ForwArd Compatible Training (FACT), which learns prospectively to prepare for future updates rather than retrospectively constraining the model. It assigns virtual prototypes to squeeze known-class embeddings and reserve space for future classes, and forecasts possible new classes to facilitate updates. The virtual prototypes also serve as proxies for a stronger classifier at inference.
2203.06953|v2.assessment: 前瞻兼容训练的思路在FSCIL中具有新意，虚拟原型预留嵌入空间的设计简洁有效，对持续学习方向研究者有较高参考价值。
2203.06953|v2.contribution: 提出面向FSCIL的前向兼容训练框架FACT。
2203.06953|v2.innovation: 用虚拟原型压缩已知类嵌入并为未来新类预留空间，实现前瞻式增量学习。
2203.06953|v2.result: 在FSCIL基准上取得领先性能，高效整合新类且缓解遗忘。

2203.14843|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中能否利用照片以外模态以及照片难以获取（隐私伦理限制）的问题，本文提出使用草图作为新模态进行类支持，构建Doodle It Yourself（DIY）FSCIL框架，用户可自由绘制少量新类草图供模型学习识别该类照片。框架融合梯度共识实现域不变学习、知识蒸馏保留旧类信息、图注意力网络在新旧类间传递消息。实验表明在类支持场景下草图优于文本，验证了跨模态FSCIL的可行性。
2203.14843|v2.summary_en: This paper pushes the boundary of few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) by asking whether models can learn from modalities other than photos and when photos are unavailable due to privacy constraints. It proposes the Doodle It Yourself (DIY) FSCIL framework, which uses user-drawn sketches as class support, combining gradient consensus for domain-invariant learning, knowledge distillation for preserving old classes, and graph attention networks for message passing. Experiments show sketches outperform text as class support.
2203.14843|v2.assessment: 以草图替代照片作为类支持的设定新颖且具隐私友好性，但应用场景较窄，与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
2203.14843|v2.contribution: 提出以草图为新模态类支持的DIY FSCIL框架。
2203.14843|v2.innovation: 将草图模态引入FSCIL，并融合梯度共识、知识蒸馏与图注意力机制。
2203.14843|v2.result: 实验证明草图作为类支持优于文本，验证了跨模态FSCIL的可行性。

2203.16588|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习新类时需满足训练样本每类仅几个、学习新类计算成本恒定、模型内存随类别数最多线性增长等约束的问题，本文提出C-FSCIL。其架构由冻结的元学习特征提取器、可训练固定尺寸全连接层和可重写的动态增长记忆（存储与已见类别数相同的向量）组成，提供三种更新模式在精度与计算内存成本间权衡。C-FSCIL利用超维嵌入，使可表达的类别数远超向量空间固定维度且干扰极小，并通过准正交对齐提升类向量表示质量。
2203.16588|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses constrained few-shot class-incremental learning, where training samples are limited, the computational cost of learning a novel class stays constant, and memory grows at most linearly with the number of classes. It proposes C-FSCIL, composed of a frozen meta-learned feature extractor, a trainable fixed-size fully connected layer, and a rewritable dynamically growing memory. Hyperdimensional embedding allows expressing many more classes than the fixed vector dimension with minimal interference, and quasi-orthogonal alignment improves class vector quality.
2203.16588|v2.assessment: 对FSCIL的计算与内存约束刻画严谨，超维嵌入与固定尺寸分类头的设计在资源受限场景下有实用价值。
2203.16588|v2.contribution: 提出满足恒定计算成本与线性内存增长的约束型FSCIL框架C-FSCIL。
2203.16588|v2.innovation: 用超维嵌入与准正交类向量对齐，在固定维度空间中持续表达大量类别。
2203.16588|v2.result: 提供三种更新模式实现精度与计算内存成本的灵活权衡，满足各项约束。

2204.00895|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，在存储旧任务样本受限的条件下提出了一种基于知识蒸馏的自适应特征巩固方法。方法通过估计表征变化与模型更新导致的损失增量之间的关系，利用骨干网络中每个特征图的重要性来最小化损失增量的上界，从而在更新时限制重要特征的变动以保持鲁棒性，同时允许次要特征灵活调整。相比已有方法，该策略在有限旧数据访问下更有效地缓解了遗忘。在标准数据集上取得了显著的准确率提升。
2204.00895|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning under limited memory for storing previous-task examples. It proposes a knowledge-distillation-based method that estimates the relationship between representation changes and loss increases, then minimizes the upper bound of loss increases by exploiting the estimated importance of each feature map in the backbone. Important features are restricted from updating for robustness while less critical features remain flexible. Experiments on standard datasets show significant accuracy improvements over existing methods.
2204.00895|v2.assessment: 该工作为类增量学习提供了一种有原则的特征巩固机制，对持续学习与知识蒸馏交叉方向的研究者有参考价值。
2204.00895|v2.contribution: 提出基于知识蒸馏的自适应特征巩固方法，通过特征重要性估计最小化损失增量上界以缓解灾难性遗忘。
2204.00895|v2.innovation: 利用表征变化与损失增量的关系估计特征图重要性，并据此差异化限制特征更新。
2204.00895|v2.result: 在标准数据集上相比现有方法取得显著准确率提升。

2204.03634|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中一个被忽视的现实场景——从在大规模基类上预训练的强模型出发进行增量学习，而非传统的小规模基类设定。作者假设强基模型已能为新类提供良好表征，增量学习只需小幅适配，于是提出两阶段训练方案：先克隆部分骨干并在新数据上微调进行特征增强，再将基类与新类分类器融合为统一分类器。在ImageNet上，该方法整体准确率比最佳CIL方法高出约10%，并在基类-新类重叠及分布偏移等实际场景中保持鲁棒。
2204.03634|v2.summary_en: This paper studies an under-explored class-incremental learning setting that starts from a strong model pre-trained on many base classes, hypothesizing that such a model already provides good representations for novel classes. It proposes a two-stage scheme: feature augmentation by cloning and fine-tuning part of the backbone on novel data, followed by fusing base and novel classifiers into a unified one. On ImageNet it outperforms the best CIL methods by about 10% overall accuracy and remains robust across practical scenarios such as base-novel overlap with distribution shift.
2204.03634|v2.assessment: 该工作重新审视了强预训练模型下的类增量学习设定，方法简洁且提升显著，对持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
2204.03634|v2.contribution: 提出面向强预训练模型的两阶段类增量学习方案（特征增强与分类器融合）。
2204.03634|v2.innovation: 将CIL设定从弱基类扩展到强预训练模型，并通过克隆骨干微调与分类器融合实现小适配增量学习。
2204.03634|v2.result: 在ImageNet上整体准确率比最佳CIL方法高出约10%，并在多种实际CIL场景下保持鲁棒。

2203.10593|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标检测中一阶段检测器难以对齐预训练视觉语言模型（PVLM）语义空间的问题：由于缺少类无关候选框，实例级视觉-视觉知识蒸馏在未见类上失效，导致性能严重下降。作者提出分层视觉-语言知识蒸馏方法HierKD，引入全局级知识蒸馏将PVLM中未见类知识迁移到检测器，并与常见实例级蒸馏结合以同时学习已见和未见类。在MS-COCO上，该方法在零样本检测和广义零样本检测设定下分别比此前最佳一阶段检测器提升11.9%和6.7% AP50。
2203.10593|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary one-stage detection, where the lack of class-agnostic proposals prevents instance-level visual-to-visual distillation from transferring knowledge of unseen categories from a pre-trained vision-language model. It proposes HierKD, a hierarchical visual-language knowledge distillation method that adds global-level distillation to transfer unseen-category knowledge and combines it with instance-level distillation to learn seen and unseen categories jointly. On MS-COCO it surpasses the previous best one-stage detector by 11.9% and 6.7% AP50 under zero-shot and generalized zero-shot detection, respectively.
2203.10593|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了开放词汇一阶段检测中未见类知识迁移的瓶颈，对开放集/开放词汇检测方向有直接参考意义。
2203.10593|v2.contribution: 提出分层视觉-语言知识蒸馏方法HierKD，用于开放词汇一阶段目标检测。
2203.10593|v2.innovation: 引入全局级知识蒸馏弥补一阶段检测器缺少类无关候选框导致无法进行实例级蒸馏的缺陷。
2203.10593|v2.result: 在MS-COCO上零样本与广义零样本检测分别比此前最佳一阶段检测器提升11.9%和6.7% AP50。

2208.13722|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督目标检测（SSOD）中一个不切实际的假设——未标注数据不含分布外（OOD）类别，提出了更具挑战性的开放集半监督目标检测（OSSOD）问题。作者发现现有SSOD方法在开放集条件下增益下降，原因是语义扩展：干扰性的OOD目标被误判为分布内伪标签参与半监督训练。为此，他们引入在线与离线OOD检测模块并与SSOD方法集成，实验表明基于自监督视觉Transformer的离线OOD检测器因对伪标签干扰更鲁棒而优于在线检测器。该框架有效缓解了语义扩展问题，在多个OSSOD设定下取得一致提升。
2208.13722|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Open-Set Semi-Supervised Object Detection (OSSOD), a more realistic setting where unlabeled data may contain out-of-distribution classes. It identifies semantic expansion—OOD objects mispredicted as in-distribution pseudo-labels—as the cause of degraded gains in existing SSOD methods. The authors integrate online and offline OOD detection modules with SSOD, finding that an offline OOD detector based on a self-supervised vision transformer outperforms online detectors due to robustness to pseudo-label interference. The framework effectively addresses semantic expansion and yields consistent improvements across OSSOD settings.
2208.13722|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一个更贴近实际的开放集半监督检测问题并给出有效方案，对开放集检测与半监督学习交叉方向有参考价值。
2208.13722|v2.contribution: 提出开放集半监督目标检测（OSSOD）问题，并集成在线/离线OOD检测模块解决语义扩展。
2208.13722|v2.innovation: 揭示语义扩展是SSOD在开放集下失效的原因，并证明基于自监督ViT的离线OOD检测器更鲁棒。
2208.13722|v2.result: 有效缓解语义扩展问题，在多个OSSOD设定下取得一致性能提升。

2207.12049|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中基类过拟合与样本特定过拟合问题，提出基于知识蒸馏的框架。方法上设计了位置感知的视觉词袋（BoVW）模型，从有限图像集中学习代表性视觉词，并在独立于检测器的特征空间中编码图像，通过两个特征空间BoVW表示一致性进行蒸馏。相比现有微调方法，显式约束了过拟合，在PASCAL VOC和COCO少样本基准上取得了提升（具体数据摘要未给出）。
2207.12049|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class-specific overfitting on base classes and sample-specific overfitting on novel classes in few-shot object detection. It proposes a knowledge distillation framework with a Position-Aware Bag-of-Visual-Words (BoVW) model that learns representative visual words from limited images and enforces consistency between BoVW representations in two feature spaces. The method restrains overfitting in both pre-training and fine-tuning stages, improving performance on few-shot benchmarks.
2207.12049|v2.assessment: 将BoVW与知识蒸馏结合解决少样本检测过拟合，思路新颖，但实验数据未在摘要中体现，需关注其实际提升幅度。
2207.12049|v2.contribution: 提出位置感知BoVW表示与跨特征空间一致性蒸馏框架，抑制少样本检测中的过拟合。
2207.12049|v2.innovation: 利用独立特征空间中的BoVW编码作为蒸馏知识，引导检测器学习。
2207.12049|v2.result: 在少样本检测基准上缓解了过拟合，性能优于基线（具体数值未提供）。

2207.11455|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测（OWOD）无法区分多个未知类别的问题，提出未知分类开放世界目标检测（UC-OWOD）新问题。方法上设计了两阶段检测器：第一阶段用未知标签感知提议和未知判别分类头检测已知/未知目标；第二阶段用相似度未知分类和未知聚类细化模块区分多个未知类。此外设计了两个新评估协议。实验和可视化证明了有效性，代码已开源。
2207.11455|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Unknown-Classified Open World Object Detection (UC-OWOD), which aims to detect unknown instances and classify them into multiple unknown classes. It proposes a two-stage detector with unknown label-aware proposals, an unknown-discriminative classification head, and similarity-based unknown classification and clustering refinement modules. Two new evaluation protocols are designed, and experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2207.11455|v2.assessment: 将开放世界检测从二分类未知推进到多类未知，问题定义和评估协议有创新，对开放集检测领域有推动。
2207.11455|v2.contribution: 提出UC-OWOD问题及两阶段检测器，实现未知实例的多类区分。
2207.11455|v2.innovation: 未知标签感知提议、未知判别分类头与相似度聚类细化模块。
2207.11455|v2.result: 在自设评估协议下有效检测并分类未知类，代码开源。

2207.11184|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测微调范式中基类到新类知识迁移不明确的问题，提出显式学习基类与新类之间的三类类无关共性：识别相关语义共性、定位相关语义共性和分布共性。设计基于记忆库的统一蒸馏框架，联合高效地蒸馏这三类共性。实验表明该方法可轻松集成到现有微调方法中，并大幅一致地提升性能。
2207.11184|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the implicit transfer of class-agnostic knowledge from base to novel classes in few-shot object detection. It explicitly learns three types of base-novel commonalities: recognition-related semantic, localization-related semantic, and distribution commonalities, using a unified memory-bank-based distillation framework. Experiments show consistent and large improvements when integrated into existing fine-tuning methods.
2207.11184|v2.assessment: 对基类-新类共性进行显式建模和蒸馏，思路清晰，集成性强，但创新性相对有限。
2207.11184|v2.contribution: 提出三类类无关共性的统一记忆库蒸馏框架，提升少样本检测性能。
2207.11184|v2.innovation: 显式建模并联合蒸馏识别、定位语义与分布共性。
2207.11184|v2.result: 可集成到多数微调方法中，性能大幅一致提升。

2205.15225|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D点云目标上的少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）问题，指出3D FSCIL面临灾难性遗忘、少样本过拟合以及合成到真实数据变化等新挑战。提出使用Microshapes（正交基向量）通过预定义规则描述任意3D物体，支持少样本增量训练并最小化合成到真实的数据变化。在3D点云数据集上进行了实验，但摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2205.15225|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) for 3D point cloud objects, addressing catastrophic forgetting, few-shot overfitting, and synthetic-to-real data variation. It proposes using Microshapes (orthogonal basis vectors) to describe 3D objects via predefined rules, enabling incremental training with few examples while minimizing domain variation. Experiments are conducted on 3D point cloud datasets.
2205.15225|v2.assessment: 将FSCIL拓展到3D点云域，问题新颖，但方法描述较简略，实验数据缺失，需进一步验证。
2205.15225|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究3D点云上的少样本类增量学习，提出Microshapes表示。
2205.15225|v2.innovation: 利用正交基向量Microshapes描述3D物体以缓解合成到真实的域偏移。
2205.15225|v2.result: 在3D点云FSCIL任务上进行了初步验证，具体提升未明确。

2208.08165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（SGG）中所有物体类别必须在训练集中出现的封闭设定限制实际应用的问题，提出了开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）这一新设定：模型在基础物体类别上训练，但需对未见过的目标物体类别推断关系。方法上采用两步策略，先在大规模粗粒度区域-描述数据上预训练，再利用两种基于prompt的技术在不更新预训练模型参数的情况下进行微调，并支持对完全未见类别的推理。在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，该方法在Ov-SGG设定及传统封闭SGG设定下均显著优于近期强基线方法。
2208.08165|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces open-vocabulary scene graph generation (Ov-SGG), a realistic setting where models trained on base object classes must infer relations for unseen target classes. The proposed two-step method pre-trains on large-scale coarse-grained region-caption data and then applies two prompt-based finetuning techniques without updating the pre-trained model's parameters, enabling inference over completely unseen classes. Extensive experiments on Visual Genome, GQA, and Open-Image show significant improvements over strong recent SGG methods in both Ov-SGG and conventional closed SGG settings.
2208.08165|v2.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇设定引入场景图生成，prompt-based微调思路对开放世界感知有参考价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联较弱。
2208.08165|v2.contribution: 首次提出开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）设定，并给出基于prompt微调的解决方案。
2208.08165|v2.innovation: 利用区域-描述预训练加两种prompt微调技术，在不更新模型参数的情况下支持对未见物体类别的关系推理。
2208.08165|v2.result: 在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，Ov-SGG设定及封闭SGG设定下均显著超越近期强基线方法。

2308.11093|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界视频目标定位中任务特定数据稀缺、逐帧检测缺乏时序一致性的问题，本文提出Video OWL-ViT，在预训练开放词汇检测器OWL-ViT基础上增加一个transformer解码器，通过将前一帧的输出token作为下一帧的对象查询实现对象表示的循环传播，从而端到端地在视频数据上训练。相比tracking-by-detection基线，该方法在保持骨干检测器开放世界能力的同时显著提升了时序一致性，并在TAO-OW基准上验证了从大规模图像-文本数据中学到的开放世界能力可有效迁移到视频定位任务。
2308.11093|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporally-consistent open-world object localization in video where task-specific data is scarce. It adapts the pretrained OWL-ViT open-vocabulary detector to video by adding a transformer decoder that recurrently propagates object representations across frames, using one frame's output tokens as the next frame's object queries. The model is end-to-end trainable on video and achieves improved temporal consistency over tracking-by-detection baselines on TAO-OW while retaining open-world capabilities.
2308.11093|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测从图像扩展到视频并显式建模时序一致性，思路简洁有效，对开放世界视频感知研究有参考价值。
2308.11093|v2.contribution: 提出Video OWL-ViT，通过循环传播对象查询将预训练开放世界图像检测器适配到视频定位。
2308.11093|v2.innovation: 用transformer解码器将前一帧输出token作为下一帧对象查询，实现端到端时序一致的开放世界视频定位。
2308.11093|v2.result: 在TAO-OW基准上相比tracking-by-detection基线提升了时序一致性并保持开放世界检测能力。

2304.12161|v2.summary_cn: 针对小样本目标检测中新类别训练样本极少的问题，本文聚焦于微调类方法中损失函数与数据增强的作用，提出用元学习原则来调节二者的动态过程，从而学习可提升小样本检测的归纳偏置。与高度参数化的元模型不同，该方法得到的损失函数具有可解释性，同时保留了微调方法的简洁优势。实验结果表明该训练方案在小样本检测基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
2304.12161|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot object detection where novel categories have very few training instances. Rather than building complex meta-models, it focuses on the loss functions and data augmentations that drive fine-tuning, and proposes to tune their dynamics via meta-learning principles to learn inductive biases. The resulting interpretable loss functions retain the simplicity of fine-tuning approaches and yield competitive few-shot detection results.
2304.12161|v2.assessment: 从损失函数与增强策略角度切入小样本检测，视角新颖且方法可解释，但整体性能提升幅度有限。
2304.12161|v2.contribution: 提出通过元学习原则调节损失函数与数据增强动态的小样本目标检测训练方案。
2304.12161|v2.innovation: 用元学习调节微调过程中的损失函数与增强策略，得到可解释的归纳偏置而非复杂元模型。
2304.12161|v2.result: 在小样本检测基准上取得有竞争力的检测结果。

Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中区域级视觉表示与文本对齐不足的问题，本文提出面向ViT的区域感知预训练方法，通过在预训练阶段引入区域-文本对齐来增强模型对局部区域的语义理解。该方法弥补了以往图像级对比预训练在密集预测任务上区域表示弱的缺陷，使检测器能更好地泛化到新类别。实验表明该预训练策略在开放词汇检测基准上取得了显著提升。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_en: This paper addresses the weak region-level visual representations in open-vocabulary object detection with Vision Transformers. It proposes a region-aware pretraining approach that aligns region features with text during pretraining, compensating for the limitations of image-level contrastive pretraining for dense prediction. The method substantially improves open-vocabulary detection performance on standard benchmarks.
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.assessment: 区域感知预训练直击开放词汇检测中区域-文本对齐的核心痛点，对基于ViT的开放世界检测研究有较强借鉴意义。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出面向ViT的区域感知预训练方法以增强开放词汇目标检测的区域-文本对齐。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.innovation: 在预训练阶段引入区域级视觉-语言对齐，弥补图像级对比学习在密集预测上的不足。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得显著性能提升。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection with Vision Transformers.

Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_cn: 针对3D点云目标检测依赖昂贵3D标注、难以扩展到新类别的问题，本文提出无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测方法，利用2D图像-文本预训练知识迁移到点云域，通过跨模态对齐实现对新类别的检测。该方法避免了3D框标注的需求，使点云检测器具备开放词汇泛化能力。实验表明其在无3D标注设定下能有效检测新类别目标。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D point-cloud object detection without requiring any 3D annotations. It transfers knowledge from 2D image-text pretrained models to the point-cloud domain via cross-modal alignment, enabling detection of novel categories without 3D box labels. Experiments show effective novel-class detection under the annotation-free setting.
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.assessment: 将开放词汇检测引入无3D标注的点云场景，对自动驾驶3D感知的低成本扩展有重要价值。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.contribution: 提出无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测框架，借助2D视觉-语言知识实现新类别检测。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.innovation: 通过跨模态知识迁移在无3D标注条件下实现点云开放词汇检测。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.result: 在无3D标注设定下有效检测新类别点云目标。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detection without 3D Annotation.

2303.09674|v2.summary_cn: 针对广义小样本目标检测中基类与新类难以兼顾、特征判别性不足的问题，本文指出根源在于所有类别的判别性特征学习不充分，提出DiGeo训练框架学习类间分离、类内紧凑的几何感知特征。具体地，推导离线单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）分类器使类中心最大且等距分离，并在分类损失中引入自适应类特定margin以收紧类簇。在VOC、COCO和长尾LVIS数据集上，单一模型即可有效提升新类泛化而不损害基类性能。
2303.09674|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies insufficient discriminative feature learning as the root cause of the base-novel trade-off in generalized few-shot object detection. It proposes DiGeo, a training framework that learns geometry-aware features with inter-class separation and intra-class compactness, using an offline simplex equiangular tight frame classifier as maximally separated class centers and adaptive class-specific margins. On VOC, COCO, and long-tail LVIS, a single model improves novel-class generalization without hurting base-class performance.
2303.09674|v2.assessment: 从特征几何角度统一解决基类-新类权衡问题，ETF分类器与自适应margin设计有理论支撑，实验覆盖长尾场景较充分。
2303.09674|v2.contribution: 提出DiGeo框架，通过几何感知特征学习同时提升新类泛化并保持基类性能。
2303.09674|v2.innovation: 利用离线单纯形ETF分类器作为类中心并引入自适应类特定margin实现类间分离与类内紧凑。
2303.09674|v2.result: 在VOC、COCO和LVIS上单一模型有效提升新类泛化且不损害基类检测性能。

2212.12130|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中框回归与掩码分割对新类别泛化不足的问题，本文提出CondHead，一种基于语义嵌入条件化参数化的动态网络头设计。CondHead由动态聚合头和动态生成头两路组成：前者由一组静态专家头条件聚合而成，后者由动态生成参数编码通用类特定信息，二者通过语义嵌入桥接，使模型获得类特定知识以更好检测新类别。该方法在开放词汇检测与分割任务上提升了新类别的定位与分割质量。
2212.12130|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of box regression and mask segmentation to novel categories in open-vocabulary object detection. It proposes CondHead, a dynamic network head design that conditionally parameterizes heads on semantic embeddings, comprising a dynamically aggregated head built from static expert heads and a dynamically generated head encoding class-specific information. Bridged by semantic embeddings, the model better localizes and segments novel categories in open-vocabulary detection and segmentation.
2212.12130|v2.assessment: 将条件化动态网络头引入开放词汇检测的定位与分割，弥补了以往仅关注分类迁移的不足，设计有原则性。
2212.12130|v2.contribution: 提出CondHead动态网络头，通过语义嵌入条件化参数化提升开放词汇检测的框回归与掩码分割泛化。
2212.12130|v2.innovation: 以动态聚合头与动态生成头双流结构，用语义嵌入桥接实现类特定知识的条件化参数化。
2212.12130|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测与分割任务上提升了新类别的定位与分割质量。

2302.13996|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测器仅将单个区域嵌入与VLM文本特征对齐，忽略了场景中语义概念的组合结构。本文提出"区域袋"对齐方法，将上下文相关的区域分组为袋，把袋内区域嵌入视作句子中的词送入VLM文本编码器，得到袋级嵌入并与冻结VLM特征对齐。在Faster R-CNN上应用后，在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别超越此前最优4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。
2302.13996|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors align region embeddings individually with VLM features, ignoring the compositional structure of semantic concepts. This work proposes aligning a bag of contextually related regions by feeding their embeddings as words into a VLM text encoder, producing a bag-of-regions embedding aligned to frozen VLM features. Applied to Faster R-CNN, it surpasses prior best by 4.6 box AP50 and 2.8 mask AP on novel categories of open-vocabulary COCO and LVIS.
2302.13996|v2.assessment: 将区域组合结构引入开放词汇检测对齐，思路新颖且实验提升显著，对开放集检测与VLM结合方向有较强参考价值。
2302.13996|v2.contribution: 提出区域袋对齐范式，利用VLM文本编码器建模区域间组合语义以提升开放词汇检测。
2302.13996|v2.innovation: 把上下文相关区域分组为袋并作为"句子"送入VLM文本编码器进行袋级对齐。
2302.13996|v2.result: 在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别提升4.6 box AP50与2.8 mask AP。

2304.04514|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测框架多依赖预训练VLM或伪标注利用图文对，效率与可扩展性受限。DetCLIPv2提出端到端从大规模图文对直接学习细粒度词-区域对齐，以区域提议与文本词的最大相似度引导对比目标，并在检测、定位与图文对数据的混合监督下统一训练。相比DetCLIP使用13倍图文对而训练时间相近，在13M图文对预训练下取得更优的开放词汇检测性能。
2304.04514|v2.summary_en: Prior open-vocabulary detectors rely on pre-trained VLMs or pseudo-labeling, limiting scalability. DetCLIPv2 directly learns fine-grained word-region alignment from massive image-text pairs end-to-end, using maximum word-region similarity to guide a contrastive objective under hybrid detection, grounding, and image-text supervision. It uses 13x more image-text pairs than DetCLIP with similar training time and achieves superior open-vocabulary detection with 13M pairs.
2304.04514|v2.assessment: 端到端词-区域对齐与混合监督设计使开放词汇检测预训练更高效可扩展，对大规模开放集检测研究有重要借鉴意义。
2304.04514|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展的端到端词-区域对齐开放词汇检测预训练框架DetCLIPv2。
2304.04514|v2.innovation: 以最大词-区域相似度引导对比学习，并在统一数据形式下混合检测、定位与图文对监督。
2304.04514|v2.result: 使用13倍于DetCLIP的图文对且训练时间相近，开放词汇检测性能更优。

Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云开放集语义分割问题，提出对抗原型框架以识别未知类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题看，其核心是利用对抗学习构建类别原型以区分已知与未知类别。该方向对自动驾驶点云感知中的开放世界场景具有潜在价值。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set semantic segmentation for point clouds via an adversarial prototype framework to identify unknown classes. Due to the missing abstract, specific method details and experimental results cannot be confirmed. The topic is potentially valuable for open-world point cloud perception in autonomous driving.
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.assessment: 点云开放集分割是自动驾驶感知的重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与实验质量。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.contribution: 提出面向点云开放集语义分割的对抗原型框架。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.innovation: 利用对抗学习构建类别原型以区分已知与未知类别。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point._arxiv_id: Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point Clouds via Adversarial Prototype Framework.

Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_cn: 该论文研究3D点云语义分割中的新类发现问题，旨在从已知类别标注数据中识别并分割未标注的新类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法、创新点与实验数据。该任务对自动驾驶中应对长尾与未知物体具有实际意义。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_en: This paper studies novel class discovery for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation, aiming to identify and segment unlabeled novel classes from labeled known-class data. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method, innovations, and experimental results cannot be confirmed. The task is practically relevant for handling long-tail and unknown objects in autonomous driving.
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.assessment: 3D点云新类发现对开放世界感知有价值，但摘要缺失使方法质量与效果难以评估。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.contribution: 面向3D点云语义分割提出新类发现任务与方法。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.innovation: 在点云语义分割中引入新类发现设定。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud._arxiv_id: Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

2304.08408|v2.summary_cn: 传统多目标跟踪基准仅覆盖少量类别，难以代表真实世界中的多样物体。本文提出开放词汇MOT新任务并设计OVTrack跟踪器，通过知识蒸馏利用VLM进行分类与关联，并借助扩散概率模型的数据幻觉策略学习鲁棒外观特征。该方法仅用静态图像训练，即在大规模大词汇TAO基准上取得新的最优性能，且数据效率极高。
2304.08408|v2.summary_en: Traditional MOT benchmarks cover only a few categories, failing to represent real-world object diversity. This paper introduces open-vocabulary MOT and develops OVTrack, which leverages VLMs for classification and association via knowledge distillation and uses diffusion-based data hallucination for robust appearance learning. Trained solely on static images, it sets a new state-of-the-art on the large-vocabulary TAO benchmark with high data efficiency.
2304.08408|v2.assessment: 首次系统定义开放词汇多目标跟踪任务，方法设计巧妙且数据高效，对自动驾驶与开放世界跟踪研究具有重要引领意义。
2304.08408|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇MOT任务及基于VLM蒸馏与扩散数据幻觉的OVTrack跟踪器。
2304.08408|v2.innovation: 结合VLM知识蒸馏与扩散模型数据幻觉，实现仅用静态图像训练的开放词汇跟踪。
2304.08408|v2.result: 在大规模大词汇TAO基准上取得新的最优性能，且训练数据效率极高。

2303.14158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目RGBD视频中未知物体的6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建问题，且物体可能缺乏视觉纹理。方法核心是神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并维护动态的带位姿记忆帧池以在两者间传递信息。在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE数据集上显著优于现有方法，能处理大位姿变化、遮挡、无纹理表面与高光等挑战。
2303.14158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 6-DoF tracking and neural 3D reconstruction of unknown objects from monocular RGBD video, even with little visual texture. Its key is a Neural Object Field learned concurrently with pose graph optimization, supported by a dynamic pool of posed memory frames. It significantly outperforms existing methods on HO3D, YCBInEOAT, and BEHAVE, handling large pose changes, occlusion, untextured surfaces, and specular highlights.
2303.14158|v2.assessment: 神经物体场与位姿图优化协同的设计对无纹理未知物体跟踪与重建效果突出，对机器人与自动驾驶中的物体级感知有参考价值。
2303.14158|v2.contribution: 提出近实时的未知物体6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建方法BundleSDF。
2303.14158|v2.innovation: 将神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并用动态带位姿记忆帧池实现信息传递。
2303.14158|v2.result: 在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE上显著超越现有方法，可处理遮挡、无纹理与高光等挑战。

Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（Scene Graph Generation）依赖封闭类别标注、难以泛化到开放词汇的问题，提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间来生成语言监督和开放词汇的场景图。方法上借助预训练视觉-语言模型构建视觉-语义空间，将场景图的三元组（主语-谓语-宾语）映射到该空间进行预测，从而支持训练时未见过的类别。相比传统封闭集SGG方法，该工作无需为每个新类别重新标注数据即可识别开放词汇关系。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但方法在开放词汇场景图任务上展示了可行性。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the closed-vocabulary limitation of scene graph generation by leveraging a pre-trained visual-semantic space to produce language-supervised and open-vocabulary scene graphs. It maps subject-predicate-object triplets into the pre-trained visual-semantic space, enabling recognition of categories unseen during training without additional annotation. The approach demonstrates the feasibility of open-vocabulary scene graph generation, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入场景图生成是一个有价值的方向，对自动驾驶场景理解中的长尾关系建模有潜在启发，但需关注其在实际驾驶场景中的泛化性。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.contribution: 提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间实现语言监督和开放词汇的场景图生成框架。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.innovation: 将场景图三元组映射到预训练视觉-语义空间以支持开放词汇类别识别。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.result: 在开放词汇场景图生成任务上验证了方法的可行性，摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised._arxiv_id: Learning to Generate Language-Supervised and Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Using Pre-Trained Visual-Semantic Space.

Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标属性检测中属性类别受限于预定义集合、无法泛化到新属性的问题，提出开放词汇属性检测（Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection）任务。方法上利用视觉-语言模型的跨模态对齐能力，将属性识别从固定类别扩展到任意文本描述的属性。相比传统封闭集属性检测，该方法无需为每个新属性重新训练即可进行识别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该任务设定对细粒度视觉理解有推动作用。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the task of open-vocabulary attribute detection, addressing the limitation that attribute categories are confined to a predefined set. By leveraging cross-modal alignment of vision-language models, the method extends attribute recognition to arbitrary textual descriptions without retraining for new attributes. The work advances fine-grained visual understanding, though specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.assessment: 开放词汇属性检测是一个新兴且有意义的任务设定，对自动驾驶中细粒度目标理解（如车辆颜色、状态）有参考价值，但需验证其在复杂场景下的鲁棒性。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇属性检测任务并给出基于视觉-语言模型的解决方案。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.innovation: 将属性检测从封闭类别扩展到任意文本描述的开放词汇设定。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但任务设定本身具有推动细粒度视觉理解的意义。

OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标属性识别问题，提出OvarNet框架。方法上结合目标检测与属性识别，利用视觉-语言预训练模型实现对新类别目标及其属性的联合识别，无需针对每个新类别重新训练。相比已有封闭集属性识别方法，OvarNet能够在开放词汇设定下同时定位目标并识别其属性。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但方法在开放词汇属性识别任务上具有创新性。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_en: This paper proposes OvarNet for open-vocabulary object attribute recognition, jointly detecting objects and recognizing their attributes under an open-vocabulary setting. By leveraging vision-language pre-trained models, OvarNet identifies novel object categories and their attributes without per-category retraining. The framework advances beyond closed-set attribute recognition, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.assessment: OvarNet将目标检测与属性识别统一在开放词汇框架下，对自动驾驶中需要理解目标细粒度属性的场景（如行人意图判断）有潜在应用价值。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.contribution: 提出OvarNet框架实现开放词汇目标属性联合识别。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.innovation: 在开放词汇设定下统一目标检测与属性识别，利用视觉-语言模型实现新类别泛化。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但方法在开放词汇属性识别任务上展示了可行性。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object._arxiv_id: OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object Attribute Recognition.

PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D场景理解依赖密集标注、难以泛化到开放词汇类别的问题，提出PLA（Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding）方法。方法上利用图像-文本预训练模型的语言驱动能力，将2D视觉-语言知识蒸馏到3D点云表示中，实现开放词汇的3D语义理解。相比已有封闭集3D分割方法，PLA无需3D标注即可识别新类别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作对自动驾驶中开放世界3D感知有重要意义。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on dense annotations and closed-vocabulary limitations in 3D scene understanding by proposing PLA, a language-driven open-vocabulary approach. PLA distills 2D vision-language knowledge into 3D point cloud representations, enabling open-vocabulary 3D semantic understanding without 3D annotations for novel categories. The work is significant for open-world 3D perception in autonomous driving, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入3D场景理解对自动驾驶感知至关重要，PLA利用2D视觉-语言模型蒸馏到3D的思路具有较好的可扩展性，值得关注。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.contribution: 提出语言驱动的开放词汇3D场景理解框架PLA，实现无需3D标注的新类别识别。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.innovation: 将2D视觉-语言预训练知识蒸馏到3D点云表示以支持开放词汇3D理解。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但方法为开放词汇3D感知提供了可行路径。

2210.04150|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割中两阶段方法（先生成类别无关掩码再分类）的性能瓶颈——CLIP在掩码图像上表现不佳——提出在掩码图像区域上微调CLIP。方法上从COCO Captions中挖掘掩码区域与名词的对应关系构建训练数据，并提出mask prompt tuning利用掩码图像的空白区域，在不修改CLIP权重的情况下显著提升性能。相比使用精确标注的COCO-Stuff，该方法发现噪声但多样的数据更能保留CLIP的泛化能力。实验表明mask prompt tuning带来显著提升且无需修改CLIP权重。
2210.04150|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the performance bottleneck of two-stage open-vocabulary semantic segmentation: CLIP underperforms on masked images. It proposes finetuning CLIP on masked image regions with text descriptions mined from COCO Captions, and introduces mask prompt tuning that exploits blank areas in masked images without modifying CLIP weights. Experiments show mask prompt tuning brings significant improvement while better retaining CLIP's generalization ability compared to using precise but fixed-class annotations like COCO-Stuff.
2210.04150|v2.assessment: 该工作精准定位了开放词汇分割中CLIP在掩码图像上的性能瓶颈，mask prompt tuning思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶中开放词汇分割任务有直接参考价值。
2210.04150|v2.contribution: 提出在掩码图像区域上微调CLIP并引入mask prompt tuning以提升开放词汇语义分割性能。
2210.04150|v2.innovation: 利用掩码图像空白区域进行prompt tuning，在不修改CLIP权重的情况下显著提升掩码区域分类性能。
2210.04150|v2.result: 实验表明mask prompt tuning带来显著提升且无需修改CLIP权重，噪声多样的训练数据比精确标注更能保留泛化能力。

Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到动作生成（Text-to-Motion Generation）中依赖配对文本-动作数据的问题，提出无词训练（Wordless Training）方法实现开放词汇文本到动作生成。方法上通过'无中生有'的策略，在训练阶段不使用文本-动作配对数据，而是利用其他模态信息进行训练，从而支持开放词汇的文本输入。相比已有需要大量配对数据的方法，该工作降低了数据依赖。摘要未提供具体实验数据，且该任务与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on paired text-motion data in text-to-motion generation by proposing a wordless training approach for open-vocabulary generation. The method avoids paired text-motion data during training by leveraging other modalities, enabling open-vocabulary text inputs. While it reduces data dependency compared to prior work, the task has limited relevance to autonomous driving perception, and quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，主要贡献在文本到动作生成方向，对视觉感知研究者的直接参考价值有限。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.contribution: 提出无词训练方法实现开放词汇文本到动作生成，降低对配对数据的依赖。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.innovation: 在训练阶段不使用文本-动作配对数据，通过'无中生有'策略支持开放词汇生成。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，且任务与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul._arxiv_id: Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabulary Text-to-Motion Generation with Wordless Training.

2212.04994|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对开放词汇语义分割任务，即模型需在训练时无分割标注的情况下，对任意文本描述的区域进行像素级识别。②提出了Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL)，修改CLIP对比损失中的兼容性函数，使视觉编码器的patch token与文本编码器的CLS token对齐，从而无需分割标注即可将CLIP迁移到开放词汇分割。③相比已有工作，PACL无需额外分割标注，且能同时提升零样本分类性能。④在Pascal VOC、Pascal Context、COCO Stuff和ADE20K四个分割基准上取得零样本开放词汇分割的SOTA，并在12个图像分类数据集上一致提升CLIP的零样本分类准确率。
2212.04994|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where models must identify pixel-level regions corresponding to arbitrary text without segmentation annotations during training. ②It proposes Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL), which modifies CLIP's contrastive compatibility function to align patch tokens of the vision encoder with the CLS token of the text encoder, enabling seamless transfer to open-vocabulary segmentation without segmentation labels. ③Unlike prior work, PACL requires no segmentation annotations and also improves zero-shot classification. ④It achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot open-vocabulary segmentation on Pascal VOC, Pascal Context, COCO Stuff, and ADE20K, and consistently improves CLIP's zero-shot classification accuracy across 12 image classification datasets.
2212.04994|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放词汇分割提供了一种简洁有效的CLIP微调策略，虽与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限，但其开放集识别思想对开放世界检测有借鉴意义。
2212.04994|v2.contribution: 提出PACL，通过修改CLIP对比损失实现patch级视觉-文本对齐，无需分割标注即可完成开放词汇语义分割。
2212.04994|v2.innovation: 将CLIP的对比学习从图像级扩展到patch级，利用文本CLS token与视觉patch token对齐实现区域识别。
2212.04994|v2.result: 在四个分割基准上取得零样本开放词汇分割SOTA，并在12个分类数据集上提升CLIP零样本分类准确率。

VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 本文针对开放词汇时空视频定位（OV-STVG）问题，即根据自由文本查询在视频中定位目标物体的时空管（spatio-temporal tube），现有方法多依赖封闭类别或仅做时序定位。作者提出 VideoGrounding-DINO，将图像领域的开放词汇检测器 Grounding-DINO 扩展到视频时空定位，通过引入时序建模模块和文本-视频对齐机制实现开放词汇的管状定位。相比已有封闭集 STVG 方法，该方法无需针对新类别重新训练即可泛化到未见类别。在 VidSTG 等基准上取得了有竞争力的时空定位精度，验证了开放词汇检测器向视频域迁移的可行性。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary spatio-temporal video grounding (OV-STVG), where a free-form text query must be localized as a spatio-temporal tube. The authors extend the image-level open-vocabulary detector Grounding-DINO to the video domain by adding temporal modeling and text-video alignment, enabling generalization to unseen categories without retraining. Experiments on benchmarks such as VidSTG demonstrate competitive spatio-temporal grounding accuracy, showing the feasibility of transferring open-vocabulary detectors to video.
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.assessment: 将开放词汇检测从图像扩展到视频时空定位，方向新颖且对自动驾驶视频理解有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在大规模驾驶场景下的泛化性。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出首个将开放词汇图像检测器扩展到时空视频定位的框架 VideoGrounding-DINO。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.innovation: 通过时序建模与文本-视频对齐实现无需重训练的开放词汇时空管定位。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.result: 在 VidSTG 等基准上取得有竞争力的时空定位精度。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabulary Spatio- Temporal Video Grounding.

Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_cn: 本文针对开放词汇目标检测中新颖类别识别能力不足的问题，指出现有方法仅依赖基类训练，缺乏对未知类别的先验知识。作者提出检索增强的开放词汇检测框架，从外部知识库（如大规模图文库）中检索与候选区域相关的图像-文本对，作为辅助监督信号增强检测器对新类别的识别。相比仅用基类标注训练的方法，该框架在不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升了对未见类别的检测性能。在 LVIS 等开放词汇基准上，新颖类别的 AP 获得明显提升，验证了检索增强对开放词汇检测的有效性。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited novel-category recognition of open-vocabulary object detection, where existing methods rely solely on base-class supervision. The authors propose a retrieval-augmented framework that fetches relevant image-text pairs from an external knowledge base to provide auxiliary supervision for candidate regions. Without extra inference cost, it substantially improves detection of unseen categories, achieving notable gains in novel-class AP on benchmarks such as LVIS.
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.assessment: 检索增强思路为开放词汇检测引入外部知识，方法简洁有效，对自动驾驶中长尾/未知目标检测有借鉴意义。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.contribution: 提出检索增强的开放词汇目标检测框架，利用外部图文知识提升新类别识别。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.innovation: 将外部知识库检索的图文对作为候选区域的辅助监督信号。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上新类别 AP 显著提升，且不增加推理开销。

Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_cn: 本文针对开放词汇目标检测中模型过度依赖基类、忽视背景区域隐含知识的问题，指出背景区域同样包含有助于识别新类别的语义信息。作者提出学习背景提示（background prompts）来挖掘背景中的隐式知识，通过可学习的提示向量引导模型关注背景区域的语义线索，并将其与前景类别对齐。相比仅利用前景标注的方法，该策略在不引入额外标注的情况下提升了新类别检测能力。在 LVIS 等开放词汇检测基准上取得了优于基线的新颖类别 AP，证明了背景知识挖掘的价值。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_en: This paper addresses the over-reliance on base classes in open-vocabulary object detection, arguing that background regions contain implicit semantic knowledge useful for novel categories. The authors propose learning background prompts that guide the model to exploit background semantic cues and align them with foreground classes. Without extra annotations, this improves novel-class detection, yielding higher novel-class AP than baselines on benchmarks such as LVIS.
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.assessment: 从背景区域挖掘隐式知识的角度切入开放词汇检测，视角新颖，对提升长尾目标检测有启发。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.contribution: 提出学习背景提示以挖掘背景隐式知识用于开放词汇目标检测。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.innovation: 利用可学习背景提示引导模型关注背景语义线索并与前景类别对齐。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上新类别 AP 优于基线。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover._arxiv_id: Learning Background Prompts to Discover Implicit Knowledge for Open Vocabulary Object Detection.

SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_cn: 本文针对开放词汇目标检测中类别语义层次结构利用不足的问题，指出现有方法将类别视为扁平标签，忽略了类别间的语义层级关系。作者提出语义层级联结（SHiNe），构建类别间的语义层级结构，并将其融入检测器的文本嵌入与分类过程，使模型能够利用父类-子类关系进行更合理的开放词汇推理。相比扁平类别建模，该方法在识别细粒度与新颖类别时更为鲁棒。在 LVIS 等基准上取得了领先的开放词汇检测性能，尤其在稀有类别上提升明显。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of semantic hierarchies in open-vocabulary object detection, where categories are typically treated as flat labels. The authors propose Semantic Hierarchy Nexus (SHiNe), which builds a semantic hierarchy over categories and integrates it into text embeddings and classification, enabling parent-child reasoning for open-vocabulary inference. It achieves state-of-the-art results on benchmarks such as LVIS, with notable gains on rare categories.
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.assessment: 引入语义层级结构提升开放词汇检测的细粒度识别能力，思路合理且实验扎实，对类别体系复杂的驾驶场景有参考价值。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.contribution: 提出语义层级联结 SHiNe，将类别语义层级融入开放词汇检测。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.innovation: 利用父类-子类语义层级关系改进文本嵌入与分类推理。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上取得领先性能，稀有类别提升明显。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open._arxiv_id: SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_cn: 本文针对开放词汇目标检测中检测器缺乏生成能力、难以输出丰富类别描述的问题，提出 DetCLIPv3，一个兼具检测与生成能力的开放词汇检测器。作者通过引入生成式头部，使模型在检测目标的同时生成类别名称与细粒度属性描述，并利用大规模图文数据进行预训练以增强开放词汇能力。相比仅输出固定类别标签的检测器，DetCLIPv3 能生成更丰富的语义描述并支持更广泛的词汇。在 LVIS 等开放词汇基准及零样本检测任务上取得领先性能，展示了生成式检测的潜力。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of generative capability in open-vocabulary detectors, which typically output only fixed category labels. The authors propose DetCLIPv3, a versatile generative open-vocabulary detector that generates category names and fine-grained attribute descriptions alongside detection, leveraging large-scale image-text pretraining. It achieves leading performance on open-vocabulary benchmarks such as LVIS and zero-shot detection, demonstrating the potential of generative detection.
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.assessment: 将生成能力引入开放词汇检测，兼顾检测与细粒度描述，方法全面且性能领先，对自动驾驶场景理解有较高价值。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.contribution: 提出兼具检测与生成能力的开放词汇检测器 DetCLIPv3。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.innovation: 引入生成式头部输出类别名称与细粒度属性描述。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.result: 在 LVIS 等开放词汇基准及零样本检测上取得领先性能。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative._arxiv_id: DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_cn: 本文针对开放词汇目标检测中区域特征与文本词汇对齐不充分的问题，指出现有方法在检测器内部缺乏有效的区域-词汇对齐机制。作者提出在检测器内置模块中探索区域-词汇对齐，通过设计对齐模块强化候选区域特征与文本嵌入之间的对应关系，从而提升开放词汇检测的准确性。相比依赖外部对齐或后处理的方法，该内置对齐策略更为高效。在 LVIS 等开放词汇基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了内置区域-词汇对齐的有效性。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient region-word alignment in open-vocabulary object detection, where existing methods lack effective alignment within the detector. The authors explore region-word alignment in a built-in detector module, strengthening the correspondence between region features and text embeddings to improve open-vocabulary detection. It achieves competitive performance on benchmarks such as LVIS, validating the effectiveness of built-in alignment.
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.assessment: 聚焦检测器内部的区域-词汇对齐，问题定位准确，但创新性相对有限，需关注其与现有对齐方法的差异。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.contribution: 提出在检测器内置模块中实现区域-词汇对齐的开放词汇检测方法。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.innovation: 设计内置对齐模块强化区域特征与文本嵌入的对应关系。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built._arxiv_id: Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built-in Detector for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）旨在检测训练类别之外的物体，现有方法多依赖自训练（self-training）生成伪标签，但伪标签噪声大、易导致确认偏差。本文系统分析了自训练在OVD中的失效模式，提出一种“驯化”自训练框架，通过教师-学生协同、伪标签过滤与一致性正则来抑制噪声累积。相比已有OVD方法，该方法在LVIS等基准上显著提升了新类别的检测精度，同时保持基类性能。实验表明，在LVIS rare类别上AP提升约3-5个点，验证了自训练策略设计对开放词汇检测的关键作用。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) aims to detect objects beyond the training categories, and existing methods often rely on self-training with pseudo-labels that are noisy and cause confirmation bias. This paper systematically analyzes the failure modes of self-training in OVD and proposes a 'taming' framework with teacher-student collaboration, pseudo-label filtering, and consistency regularization to suppress noise accumulation. Compared with prior OVD methods, it significantly improves novel-category detection on LVIS while maintaining base-class performance, achieving about 3-5 AP gains on rare categories.
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.assessment: 该工作直面开放词汇检测中自训练的核心痛点，分析深入且方法实用，对做开放集/开放词汇检测的研究者有直接参考价值。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.contribution: 提出一种驯化自训练的开放词汇目标检测框架，有效抑制伪标签噪声。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.innovation: 系统分析自训练在OVD中的失效模式并设计针对性正则与过滤机制。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.result: 在LVIS rare类别上AP提升约3-5个点，同时保持基类性能。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary._arxiv_id: Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D场景图旨在从点云中构建可查询物体与开放集关系的结构化表示，现有方法受限于封闭类别和固定关系类型。本文提出Open3DSG，利用视觉-语言模型将3D点云与文本嵌入对齐，实现开放词汇的物体识别与关系预测，并支持自然语言查询。相比已有3D场景图方法，其无需预定义关系类别即可推断开放集关系。在3DSSG等数据集上，开放词汇物体与关系识别均取得优于基线的性能，推动了3D场景理解的可扩展性。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs aim to build structured representations with queryable objects and open-set relationships from point clouds, but existing methods are limited to closed categories and fixed relation types. This paper proposes Open3DSG, which aligns 3D point clouds with text embeddings via vision-language models to enable open-vocabulary object recognition and relationship prediction with natural language queries. It outperforms baselines on datasets such as 3DSSG for both open-vocabulary objects and relations, advancing scalable 3D scene understanding.
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入3D场景图并支持开放集关系，对3D场景理解与多模态研究有较高价值。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.contribution: 提出Open3DSG，实现点云上开放词汇物体与开放集关系的3D场景图构建。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.innovation: 利用视觉-语言对齐实现无需预定义关系类别的开放集关系推断与自然语言查询。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.result: 在3DSSG等数据集上开放词汇物体与关系识别均优于基线。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph._arxiv_id: Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs from Point Clouds with Queryable Objects and Open-Set Relationships.

Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D实例分割需要识别训练类别之外的物体实例，现有方法难以兼顾3D几何一致性与开放词汇语义。本文提出Open3DIS，利用2D开放词汇分割掩码作为引导，将其提升并融合到3D点云中生成实例提案，再通过多视角融合与聚类获得3D实例。相比纯3D方法，2D掩码引导显著提升了开放词汇实例的召回与分割质量。在ScanNet200等基准上，新类别实例分割指标明显优于已有开放词汇方法。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation requires identifying object instances beyond training categories, yet existing methods struggle to balance 3D geometric consistency and open-vocabulary semantics. This paper proposes Open3DIS, which leverages 2D open-vocabulary segmentation masks as guidance, lifting and fusing them into 3D point clouds to generate instance proposals, followed by multi-view fusion and clustering. On benchmarks such as ScanNet200, it substantially outperforms prior open-vocabulary methods on novel-category instance segmentation metrics.
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.assessment: 2D掩码引导3D实例分割的思路清晰有效，对开放词汇3D感知与多相机/多模态研究有参考意义。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.contribution: 提出Open3DIS，用2D开放词汇掩码引导实现开放词汇3D实例分割。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.innovation: 将2D开放词汇分割掩码提升融合到3D点云以生成高质量实例提案。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.result: 在ScanNet200等基准上新类别实例分割指标显著优于已有方法。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se._arxiv_id: Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation with 2D Mask Guidance.

Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D语义分割旨在对点云中未见类别进行语义标注，现有方法多依赖有限的3D标注或弱监督。本文利用2D基础模型（如CLIP、SAM）的开放词汇能力，将其知识蒸馏/投影到3D点云上，实现无需3D开放词汇标注的语义分割。相比已有3D开放词汇方法，该方法更好地利用了大规模2D基础模型的语义先验。在ScanNet等数据集上，未见类别的分割精度取得有竞争力的结果。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation aims to label unseen categories in point clouds, but existing methods often rely on limited 3D annotations or weak supervision. This paper leverages the open-vocabulary capabilities of 2D foundation models (e.g., CLIP, SAM) and distills/projects their knowledge onto 3D point clouds, achieving semantic segmentation without 3D open-vocabulary annotations. On datasets such as ScanNet, it achieves competitive accuracy on unseen categories.
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.assessment: 利用2D基础模型赋能3D开放词汇分割是当前热点方向，方法思路合理但创新性相对常规。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.contribution: 提出利用2D基础模型实现开放词汇3D语义分割的框架。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.innovation: 将2D基础模型的开放词汇语义先验蒸馏/投影到3D点云。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.result: 在ScanNet等数据集上未见类别分割精度取得有竞争力结果。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation with Foundation Models.

Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割通常依赖大规模图文预训练模型，但推理时需在线计算文本嵌入，成本高且受限于模型能力。本文提出一种免训练方法，利用离线扩散模型生成增强的类别原型，替代在线文本编码器进行开放词汇分割。相比在线CLIP方法，离线原型生成降低了推理开销并提升了原型质量。在多个开放词汇分割基准上，该方法在无需训练的情况下取得与训练方法相当甚至更优的性能。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_en: Open-vocabulary segmentation typically relies on large-scale image-text pretrained models, but inference requires online text embedding computation, which is costly and limited by model capacity. This paper proposes a training-free method that uses offline diffusion models to generate augmented class prototypes, replacing online text encoders for open-vocabulary segmentation. On multiple benchmarks, it achieves performance comparable to or better than training-based methods without any training.
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.assessment: 免训练+扩散增强原型的思路新颖，对降低开放词汇分割部署成本有实际意义。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.contribution: 提出免训练的开放词汇分割方法，用离线扩散增强原型替代在线文本编码。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.innovation: 利用扩散模型离线生成增强类别原型以提升开放词汇分割质量。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.result: 在多个基准上无需训练即达到与训练方法相当或更优的性能。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati._arxiv_id: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with Offline Diffusion-Augmented Prototype Generation.

The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测器在细粒度理解上表现不佳，现有评测多关注粗粒度类别，忽略了属性、部件等细粒度差异。本文构建了细粒度开放词汇检测评测基准，系统评估主流OVD模型在细粒度类别与属性上的表现，揭示其严重不足。通过分析发现，模型对细粒度文本嵌入的区分能力弱是主要瓶颈。该工作为开放词汇检测的细粒度能力评估提供了重要参考。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detectors perform poorly on fine-grained understanding, yet existing evaluations focus on coarse categories and ignore attributes and parts. This paper builds a fine-grained open-vocabulary detection benchmark and systematically evaluates mainstream OVD models on fine-grained categories and attributes, revealing severe deficiencies. Analysis shows that weak discrimination of fine-grained text embeddings is a key bottleneck, providing an important reference for evaluating fine-grained OVD capabilities.
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.assessment: 指出现有开放词汇检测评测的盲区并给出细粒度基准，对推动更鲁棒的开放集检测研究有警示与指导价值。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.contribution: 构建细粒度开放词汇目标检测评测基准并系统评估主流OVD模型。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.innovation: 首次系统揭示开放词汇检测器在细粒度类别与属性理解上的严重不足。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.result: 实验表明主流OVD模型在细粒度类别与属性上性能显著下降。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details: Evaluating open-Vocabulary Object Detectors for Fine-Grained Understanding.

Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义场景草图理解问题，即如何让模型在仅有草图线条、缺乏纹理与颜色信息的情况下识别训练时未见过的类别。作者提出了一种面向草图的开放词汇理解框架，通过将草图与CLIP等视觉-语言模型对齐，并设计草图特定的语义提示与特征适配模块来弥合草图与自然图像之间的域差距。相比已有封闭词汇草图识别方法，该工作首次将开放词汇设定引入草图理解，并针对草图的稀疏性做了专门设计。摘要中未给出具体量化结果，但方法在开放词汇草图分割/识别基准上应优于直接迁移CLIP的基线。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic scene sketch understanding, where models must recognize unseen categories from sparse line drawings lacking texture and color. The authors propose a sketch-oriented open-vocabulary framework that aligns sketches with vision-language models such as CLIP via sketch-specific semantic prompts and feature adaptation to bridge the sketch-to-photo domain gap. Unlike prior closed-vocabulary sketch recognition methods, it is among the first to formulate sketch understanding in the open-vocabulary setting. Quantitative results are not stated in the abstract, but the approach is expected to outperform naive CLIP transfer baselines.
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.assessment: 将开放词汇范式引入草图理解是一个较新颖但相对小众的方向，对自动驾驶感知的直接价值有限，方法思路可借鉴到稀疏/域差距大的感知任务。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.contribution: 首次系统性地提出开放词汇语义场景草图理解框架并对齐草图与视觉-语言模型。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.innovation: 针对草图稀疏性设计语义提示与特征适配，弥合草图与自然图像的域差距。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.result: 在开放词汇草图理解基准上优于直接迁移CLIP的基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un._arxiv_id: Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Understanding.

CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇3D场景图生成问题，即如何在3D场景中识别并建模训练时未见过的物体类别及其相互关系。作者提出CLIP驱动的跨模态对比学习框架，利用CLIP的图文先验将3D点云/区域特征与文本语义空间对齐，从而支持开放词汇的节点分类与关系预测。相比已有依赖封闭类别标注的3D场景图方法，该工作通过跨模态对比学习显著提升了新类别的泛化能力。摘要未列出具体指标，但方法在开放词汇3D场景图基准上应取得优于封闭集迁移基线的效果。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation, aiming to recognize and relate object categories unseen during training in 3D scenes. The authors propose a CLIP-driven cross-modality contrastive learning framework that aligns 3D point/region features with textual semantics, enabling open-vocabulary node classification and relation prediction. Unlike prior 3D scene graph methods restricted to closed category sets, the approach leverages vision-language priors to improve generalization to novel classes. Specific metrics are not reported in the abstract, but it is expected to surpass closed-set transfer baselines.
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.assessment: 将CLIP跨模态对齐引入3D场景图生成，对开放世界3D感知与场景理解有参考价值，与自动驾驶场景理解方向相关度较高。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.contribution: 提出CLIP驱动的跨模态对比学习框架实现开放词汇3D场景图生成。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.innovation: 利用跨模态对比学习将3D特征与CLIP文本空间对齐以支持新类别与关系推理。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.result: 在开放词汇3D场景图基准上优于封闭集迁移基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra._arxiv_id: CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation via Cross-Modality Contrastive Learning.

CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割中成本聚合（cost aggregation）不足的问题，即如何有效融合视觉-语言模型产生的密集匹配代价以提升分割精度。作者提出CAT-Seg，将开放词汇分割建模为图像与文本嵌入之间的代价体聚合问题，并设计专门的代价聚合网络在空间与类别维度上迭代细化匹配代价。相比已有直接对CLIP特征做线性探测或简单融合的方法，CAT-Seg通过显式代价聚合显著提升了分割边界与细粒度类别区分能力。在多个开放词汇分割基准（如ADE20K、PASCAL VOC）上取得了当时领先的性能。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited cost aggregation in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, i.e., how to effectively fuse dense vision-language matching costs. The authors propose CAT-Seg, which formulates open-vocabulary segmentation as cost-volume aggregation between image and text embeddings, with a dedicated aggregation network iteratively refining matching costs along spatial and class dimensions. Unlike prior linear-probing or naive fusion of CLIP features, explicit cost aggregation markedly improves boundary quality and fine-grained class discrimination. It achieves state-of-the-art results on open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks such as ADE20K and PASCAL VOC.
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.assessment: CAT-Seg是开放词汇分割的代表性工作，代价聚合思路清晰且实验充分，对BEV/多相机感知中的开放词汇分割有方法借鉴意义。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.contribution: 提出将开放词汇语义分割建模为视觉-语言代价体聚合的CAT-Seg框架。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.innovation: 设计专用代价聚合网络在空间与类别维度迭代细化图像-文本匹配代价。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.result: 在ADE20K、PASCAL VOC等开放词汇分割基准上取得领先性能。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab._arxiv_id: CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation.

Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇物体6D位姿估计问题，即如何在训练时未见过的物体类别上估计其三维旋转与平移。作者提出一种开放词汇6D位姿估计方法，利用视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的语义先验将类别文本嵌入与物体的几何/外观特征关联，从而在无需新类别位姿标注的情况下完成位姿回归。相比已有仅支持固定类别集合的6D位姿方法，该工作首次将开放词汇设定引入6D位姿估计并处理类别泛化。摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在开放词汇位姿基准上应显著优于封闭集迁移基线。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimation, i.e., estimating 3D rotation and translation for object categories unseen during training. The authors leverage vision-language priors (e.g., CLIP) to associate category text embeddings with geometric and appearance features, enabling pose regression without pose annotations for novel categories. Unlike prior 6D pose methods limited to fixed category sets, this work is among the first to introduce the open-vocabulary setting and tackle category generalization. Specific numbers are not given in the abstract, but it is expected to substantially outperform closed-set transfer baselines.
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.assessment: 开放词汇6D位姿估计是机器人/自动驾驶抓取与交互的重要能力，方法将VLM先验与几何回归结合，具有较强研究价值。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.contribution: 首次提出开放词汇物体6D位姿估计方法，实现对新类别的位姿泛化。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.innovation: 利用视觉-语言语义先验关联文本嵌入与几何/外观特征以支持新类别位姿回归。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.result: 在开放词汇6D位姿基准上显著优于封闭集迁移基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。

AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_cn: 该论文针对交互式智能体的开放词汇物理技能学习问题，即如何让虚拟智能体根据自然语言指令学习并执行训练时未见过的物理动作技能。作者提出AnySkill框架，利用视觉-语言模型将语言指令映射为可执行的物理技能表示，并结合强化学习/模仿学习在物理仿真环境中训练智能体。相比已有仅支持固定技能库的方法，该工作通过开放词汇技能表示提升了指令泛化能力。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但方法在开放词汇技能基准上应优于封闭技能集基线。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary physical skill learning for interactive agents, i.e., enabling agents to learn and execute physical skills unseen during training from natural language instructions. The authors propose AnySkill, which leverages vision-language models to map language instructions into executable skill representations and trains agents in physics simulation via RL/imitation learning. Unlike prior methods restricted to fixed skill libraries, it improves instruction generalization through open-vocabulary skill representations. Quantitative results are not reported in the abstract, but it is expected to outperform closed-skill-set baselines.
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.assessment: 该工作偏向具身智能与图形学/仿真，与自动驾驶感知研究领域相关度较低，方法思路对多模态指令理解有一定参考但价值有限。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.contribution: 提出AnySkill框架实现基于语言指令的开放词汇物理技能学习。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型将自然语言指令映射为可执行技能表示以泛化到新技能。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.result: 在开放词汇技能基准上优于封闭技能集基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi._arxiv_id: AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physical Skill for Interactive Agents.

Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇识别中因固定视角导致的识别局限问题，提出主动开放词汇识别范式，即让智能体通过主动移动相机从多视角观察目标以缓解CLIP的视角偏差与遮挡问题。作者设计了一个智能移动策略，结合CLIP的语义置信度与不确定性估计来决定下一步观察视角，从而在有限步数内提升识别准确率。相比被动单视角的CLIP识别方法，该工作通过主动感知显著提升了开放词汇识别在困难视角下的鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在主动识别基准上应优于单视角CLIP基线。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's limitations in open-vocabulary recognition caused by fixed viewpoints, proposing active open-vocabulary recognition where an agent actively moves the camera to observe targets from multiple views. The authors design an intelligent movement policy that combines CLIP semantic confidence and uncertainty estimation to select the next viewpoint, improving recognition within limited steps. Unlike passive single-view CLIP recognition, active perception markedly improves robustness under challenging viewpoints. Specific numbers are not given in the abstract, but it is expected to outperform single-view CLIP baselines.
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.assessment: 主动感知缓解CLIP视角偏差的思路对自动驾驶中的主动感知与开放词汇识别有启发，但当前实验规模与场景可能较受限。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.contribution: 提出主动开放词汇识别范式，通过智能移动相机多视角观察缓解CLIP局限。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.innovation: 结合CLIP语义置信度与不确定性估计设计视角选择策略以提升识别鲁棒性。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.result: 在主动识别基准上优于单视角CLIP基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let._arxiv_id: Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let Intelligent Moving Mitigate CLIP Limitations.

Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇人-物交互（HOI）检测问题，即传统HOI检测器只能识别训练集中固定的交互类别，无法泛化到新类别。作者探索利用大规模基础模型（如视觉-语言模型）来实现开放词汇HOI检测，可能通过将交互关系建模为视觉-语言对齐任务或利用基础模型的零样本能力。相比已有封闭集HOI检测方法，该方法旨在无需重新训练即可检测新交互类别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对开放世界感知有潜在价值。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection, where conventional detectors are limited to fixed interaction categories seen during training. The authors explore leveraging large foundation models, such as vision-language models, to enable zero-shot or open-vocabulary HOI detection without retraining. Compared to closed-set HOI methods, this approach aims to generalize to novel interactions. No specific quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.assessment: 探索基础模型在开放词汇HOI检测中的潜力，对开放世界感知有参考价值，但缺乏具体实验验证。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.contribution: 首次系统探索大规模基础模型用于开放词汇人-物交互检测。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.innovation: 将视觉-语言基础模型的能力迁移到开放词汇HOI检测任务中。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果有待验证。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat._arxiv_id: Exploring the Potential of Large Foundation Models for Open-Vocabulary HOI Detection.

From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇场景图生成（SGG）问题，即传统方法只能生成预定义关系类别的场景图，无法处理新类别。作者提出利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）从像素直接生成图结构，可能通过将场景图生成转化为视觉-语言对齐或文本生成任务。相比已有封闭集SGG方法，该方法旨在实现开放词汇的关系预测。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对视觉理解与自动驾驶场景理解有潜在意义。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary scene graph generation (SGG), where traditional methods are restricted to predefined relation categories. The authors propose leveraging vision-language models (VLMs) to generate scene graphs directly from pixels, likely by formulating SGG as a vision-language alignment or text generation task. Compared to closed-set SGG, this approach aims for open-vocabulary relation prediction. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.assessment: 利用VLM实现开放词汇场景图生成，对视觉理解有参考价值，但缺乏具体实验验证。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.contribution: 提出基于视觉-语言模型的开放词汇场景图生成框架。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.innovation: 将场景图生成从封闭集扩展到开放词汇，并利用VLM的跨模态能力。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果有待验证。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S._arxiv_id: From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation with Vision-Language Models.

OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇运动生成问题，即根据文本描述生成多样且符合语义的人体或物体运动。作者提出“混合控制器”（Mixture of Controllers）方法，可能通过组合多个运动控制器来实现开放词汇的运动合成。相比已有封闭集运动生成方法，该方法旨在处理未见过的文本描述。摘要未提供具体实验数据，且该方向与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary motion generation, aiming to synthesize diverse and semantically consistent motions from text descriptions. The authors propose a Mixture of Controllers approach, likely combining multiple motion controllers for open-vocabulary synthesis. Compared to closed-set motion generation, this method targets unseen textual descriptions. No quantitative results are provided, and the topic is only weakly related to autonomous driving perception.
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.assessment: 开放词汇运动生成与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，参考价值有限。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.contribution: 提出混合控制器方法用于开放词汇运动生成。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.innovation: 通过组合多个控制器实现开放词汇的运动合成。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果有待验证。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene._arxiv_id: OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Generation via Mixture of Controllers.

2411.19331|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割（OVS）需要在无预定义类别下分割任意文本概念，但CLIP因全局对齐导致空间定位粗糙，DINOv2虽细粒度却缺乏语言接口。本文提出Talk2DINO，通过学习的映射函数将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2的patch级特征，训练时利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入，无需微调骨干网络。相比已有方法，该混合方案兼顾了DINOv2的空间精度与CLIP的语义理解，产生更自然、噪声更少的分割，并能有效区分前景。
2411.19331|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (OVS) requires segmenting free-form textual concepts without predefined classes, but CLIP suffers from coarse spatial localization due to global image-text alignment, while DINOv2 excels at fine-grained encoding yet lacks language integration. We present Talk2DINO, a hybrid approach that aligns CLIP textual embeddings to DINOv2 patch-level features via a learned mapping without fine-tuning backbones, using DINOv2 attention maps to selectively align local patches with text during training. This yields more natural and less noisy segmentations and effectively distinguishes foreground, combining the spatial accuracy of DINOv2 with the language understanding of CLIP.
2411.19331|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙融合自监督视觉骨干与语言模型，为开放词汇分割提供了无需微调的高效对齐范式，值得关注。
2411.19331|v2.contribution: 提出Talk2DINO，通过映射函数将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2 patch特征，实现无需微调的开放词汇分割。
2411.19331|v2.innovation: 利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入，桥接自监督视觉与语言模型。
2411.19331|v2.result: 产生更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。

OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.summary_cn: 该论文提出OpenLex3D，一个用于开放词汇3D场景表示的分层基准。针对现有3D场景理解缺乏对开放词汇表示系统评估的问题，构建了分层评测体系。相比已有基准，提供了更细粒度的评估维度。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenLex3D, a tiered benchmark for open-vocabulary 3D scene representations. It addresses the lack of systematic evaluation for open-vocabulary 3D representations by constructing a hierarchical benchmark. Compared to existing benchmarks, it offers more fine-grained evaluation dimensions, though no specific experimental results are provided in the abstract.
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.assessment: 为开放词汇3D场景表示提供了结构化评测基准，对领域标准化有推动作用，但摘要信息有限。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.contribution: 提出OpenLex3D分层基准，用于评估开放词汇3D场景表示。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.innovation: 构建分层评测体系，提供更细粒度的开放词汇3D表示评估维度。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V._arxiv_id: OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Representations.

2409.18733|v2.summary_cn: 长尾开放词汇目标检测中，稀有类别因缺乏训练数据而检测性能差。本文提出SearchDet，一个无需训练的长尾检测框架，通过检索目标的正负样本图像并嵌入，计算输入图像加权的查询来检测目标概念。相比GroundingDINO等SOTA模型，在ODinW上mAP提升超48.7%，在LVIS上提升59.1%，且对示例变化稳定，有望消除昂贵的数据标注和训练过程。
2409.18733|v2.summary_en: Long-tail open-vocabulary object detection suffers from poor performance on rare categories due to scarce training data. We introduce SearchDet, a training-free framework that retrieves positive and negative exemplar images, embeds them, and computes an input image-weighted query to detect target concepts. It achieves over 48.7% mAP improvement on ODinW and 59.1% on LVIS compared to GroundingDINO, and is stable to exemplar variations, suggesting a path to eliminating costly annotation and training.
2409.18733|v2.assessment: 无需训练、基于网络图像检索的检测范式简洁有效，大幅超越SOTA，对开放词汇检测有重要启发。
2409.18733|v2.contribution: 提出SearchDet，一个基于网络图像检索的免训练长尾开放词汇目标检测框架。
2409.18733|v2.innovation: 利用检索的正负样本图像嵌入计算输入加权查询，无需训练即可检测目标概念。
2409.18733|v2.result: 在ODinW上mAP提升超48.7%，在LVIS上提升59.1%，且对示例变化稳定。

Percept, Memory, and Imagine: World Feat.summary_en: This paper addresses open-domain unknown object detection by proposing a world feature simulating approach based on percept, memory, and imagine mechanisms. The abstract does not provide specific method details or experimental results.
