2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在GPU硬件上部署困难、加速研究不足的问题，提出GPUSQ-ViT压缩方案，最大化利用GPU友好的2:4细粒度结构化稀疏与量化：先用2:4结构化剪枝将稠密模型稀疏化（FP16），再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化感知训练转为定点模型（整数张量可获额外加速），过程中采用混合策略知识蒸馏，支持监督与无监督学习。实验表明模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，实现30.3-62倍加速，达到SOTA压缩水平。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: To address the difficulty of deploying ViTs on GPU hardware, this paper proposes GPUSQ-ViT, a compression scheme that maximally exploits GPU-friendly 2:4 fine-grained structured sparsity and quantization. A dense model is first pruned into a 2:4 sparse one (FP16), then quantized into a fixed-point model via sparse-distillation-aware quantization-aware training, with mixed-strategy knowledge distillation throughout. It achieves state-of-the-art compression, reducing model size by 6.4-12.7× and delivering 30.3-62× speedup, while supporting both supervised and unsupervised learning.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 面向GPU实际加速的稀疏+量化联合压缩方案工程性强，压缩与加速数据亮眼，对ViT部署有实用价值。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出结合2:4结构化稀疏与量化的GPU友好ViT压缩方案GPUSQ-ViT。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 将2:4结构化稀疏、稀疏蒸馏感知量化与混合策略知识蒸馏统一到GPU加速框架中。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，实现30.3-62倍加速，达到SOTA压缩水平。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT剪枝方法不可解释、忽略内部单元与目标类别关系而导致性能下降的问题，提出可解释剪枝框架X-Pruner：设计可解释性感知掩码，端到端学习以衡量每个可剪单元对预测各目标类别的贡献；再基于掩码值自适应搜索逐层阈值，区分剪除与保留单元并学习逐层剪枝率。在DeiT和Swin Transformer上验证，取得优于现有方法的剪枝效果。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: To address the unexplainable nature of existing ViT pruning methods that overlook the relationship between internal units and target classes, this paper proposes X-Pruner, an explainable pruning framework. It learns an explainability-aware mask end-to-end to measure each prunable unit's contribution to predicting each target class, then adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds based on mask values to determine pruning rates. Evaluated on DeiT and Swin Transformer, it outperforms existing pruning methods.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 从可解释性角度设计剪枝准则的思路新颖，将类别贡献纳入单元重要性度量，对ViT压缩方向有启发意义。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出可解释剪枝框架X-Pruner，用可解释性感知掩码衡量单元对目标类别的贡献。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 将可解释性引入剪枝准则，端到端学习掩码并自适应搜索逐层阈值。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin Transformer上取得优于现有剪枝方法的效果。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督语义分割中标注数据稀缺、伪标签质量不高的问题，提出密度引导的对比学习框架。方法通过估计像素级密度来区分稀疏与密集区域，并设计密度引导的对比损失，使模型在稀疏区域也能学到判别性表征。相比已有半监督分割方法，其改进在于将密度先验显式融入对比学习，缓解了类别不平衡与边界模糊问题。在标准半监督分割基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，验证了密度引导策略的有效性。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotations and noisy pseudo-labels in semi-supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a density-guided contrastive learning framework. It estimates pixel-wise density to distinguish sparse and dense regions and designs a density-guided contrastive loss that learns discriminative representations even in sparse areas. Compared with existing semi-supervised segmentation methods, it explicitly incorporates density priors into contrastive learning, alleviating class imbalance and boundary ambiguity, and achieves superior performance on standard benchmarks.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 将密度先验与对比学习结合用于半监督分割，思路新颖，对标注稀缺场景有参考价值。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导的对比学习框架，用于半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用像素级密度估计引导对比损失，缓解稀疏区域表征学习不足。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 在标准半监督分割基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中旧类样本受限于内存预算只能保存少量样本（few-shot）的问题，提出通过压缩样本突破这一限制。方法利用类激活图（CAM）生成0-1掩码，仅保留判别性像素，从而在固定内存下保存更多压缩样本（many-shot）。为解决CAM阈值在覆盖度与样本数量间的权衡以及不同类别最优阈值不同的问题，提出类增量掩码模型（CIM），并与CIL模型通过双层优化交替训练。实验表明该方法在多个CIL基准上有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，提升了增量学习性能。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the few-shot exemplar limitation in class-incremental learning (CIL) by compressing exemplars to store many-shot compressed samples within a fixed memory budget. It generates 0-1 masks on discriminative pixels from class activation maps (CAM) without manual annotation, and proposes a class-incremental masking (CIM) model to resolve the trade-off between discriminative coverage and exemplar quantity as well as class-specific optimal thresholds. The CIM model is optimized alternatively with the CIL model via bilevel optimization, and extensive experiments demonstrate improved incremental learning performance.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 通过样本压缩突破内存限制的思路巧妙，双层优化设计合理，对增量学习研究有启发。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出基于CAM的样本压缩方法，在固定内存下实现many-shot类增量学习。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 用类增量掩码模型自适应生成判别性像素掩码，并通过双层优化与CIL模型联合训练。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个CIL基准上有效缓解灾难性遗忘，性能优于现有方法。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝中参数分组模式因架构而异、现有方法难以泛化到新架构的问题，提出通用的任意结构剪枝方法DepGraph。核心挑战是结构耦合，即不同层需同时剪枝且被移除参数需一致地不重要。方法通过依赖图（Dependency Graph）显式建模层间依赖关系，自动全面地对耦合参数分组，无需人工设计分组方案。在ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet、Vision Transformer等多种架构和任务上验证了方法的通用性与有效性，剪枝后性能下降小。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of generalizability in structural pruning, where parameter-grouping patterns vary across architectures and architecture-specific pruners fail on new models. It proposes Dependency Graph (DepGraph), a general and fully automatic method that explicitly models inter-layer dependencies to comprehensively group coupled parameters for pruning, tackling the structural coupling problem. Extensive experiments on ResNe(X)t, DenseNet, MobileNet, and Vision Transformer across multiple tasks demonstrate its generality and effectiveness with minimal performance degradation.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: 通用结构化剪枝的重要工作，DepGraph建模优雅且跨架构验证充分，实用性强。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出通用的依赖图方法DepGraph，实现任意架构的自动结构化剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 用依赖图显式建模层间耦合关系，自动分组参数，无需架构特定设计。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在CNN、RNN、GNN、Transformer等多种架构上实现有效剪枝，性能下降小。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有通道剪枝方法主要面向2D CNN、难以直接应用于3D点云网络（PNN）的问题，提出CP3——一种面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件。方法设计了坐标增强的通道重要性度量，反映维度信息与通道特征的相关性，并回收PNN采样过程中丢弃的点以利用其潜在独有信息增强剪枝鲁棒性。实验在多种PNN架构上验证了CP3的有效性，表明其能在保持精度的同时显著降低计算与内存开销。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of applying 2D CNN channel pruning methods to 3D point-based neural networks (PNNs), which suffer from representation and architecture disparities. It proposes CP3, a channel pruning plug-in for PNNs that introduces a coordinate-enhanced channel importance metric to capture the correlation between dimensional information and channel features, and recycles discarded points during sampling to enhance pruning robustness. Experiments on various PNN architectures demonstrate its effectiveness in reducing computation and memory while maintaining accuracy.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 将通道剪枝拓展到点云网络，坐标增强度量与点回收设计有针对性，对3D感知部署有实用价值。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件CP3。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 设计坐标增强的通道重要性度量，并回收采样丢弃点以增强剪枝鲁棒性。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种PNN架构上有效降低计算与内存开销，同时保持精度。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: 该论文针对特征匹配中对应关系剪枝（correspondence pruning）问题，提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法。方法通过逐步挖掘邻域一致性来区分内点与外点，提升匹配鲁棒性。相比已有方法，其改进在于渐进式策略能更充分地利用局部邻域结构信息。实验在标准对应关系剪枝基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses correspondence pruning in feature matching by proposing progressive neighbor consistency mining. The method progressively mines neighbor consistency to distinguish inliers from outliers, improving matching robustness. Compared with existing methods, the progressive strategy better exploits local neighborhood structural information, achieving competitive results on standard correspondence pruning benchmarks.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 邻域一致性挖掘思路合理，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关度较低。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 采用渐进式策略充分挖掘局部邻域一致性以区分内外点。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 在标准对应关系剪枝基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络中虚假相关性导致的偏见问题，提出通过对比权重剪枝训练去偏子网络。方法利用对比学习指导权重剪枝，识别并移除与偏见相关的权重，从而得到更公平的子网络。相比已有去偏方法，其改进在于从权重剪枝角度而非数据重加权来处理偏见。实验表明该方法在保持精度的同时有效降低了模型偏见。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses bias caused by spurious correlations in neural networks by training debiased subnetworks via contrastive weight pruning. It leverages contrastive learning to guide weight pruning, identifying and removing bias-related weights to obtain fairer subnetworks. Unlike existing debiasing methods based on data reweighting, it tackles bias from a weight pruning perspective, and experiments show it reduces model bias while maintaining accuracy.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 从权重剪枝角度处理去偏问题较新颖，但摘要信息有限，与感知领域相关度一般。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝方法训练去偏子网络。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 用对比学习指导权重剪枝以移除偏见相关权重。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在保持精度的同时有效降低模型偏见。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督学习在分布外（OOD）数据下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出了一种基于语义剪枝的框架。方法通过识别并剪除与分布内语义无关的特征通道，抑制OOD样本对伪标签生成的干扰。相比已有半监督方法，该工作首次将语义剪枝引入OOD鲁棒性场景，提升了模型在分布偏移下的泛化能力。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness in semi-supervised learning under out-of-distribution (OOD) data by proposing a semantic pruning framework. The method identifies and prunes feature channels irrelevant to in-distribution semantics, thereby suppressing OOD interference in pseudo-label generation. Unlike existing semi-supervised approaches, it is the first to introduce semantic pruning for OOD robustness, improving generalization under distribution shifts. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 将剪枝与半监督OOD鲁棒性结合的思路较新颖，但缺乏实验数据支撑，需关注其实际有效性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出了一种面向分布外数据的语义剪枝半监督学习框架。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 首次将语义剪枝用于抑制OOD样本对半监督伪标签的干扰。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据，效果有待验证。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算量大的问题，提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法。方法将剪枝参数与网络权重联合优化，通过双层优化框架实现结构化剪枝，在保持分割精度的同时显著降低计算量。相比传统剪枝方法，该工作更适配边缘部署场景。摘要未给出具体精度与加速比数据。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper targets the high computational cost of semantic segmentation on edge devices by proposing a pruning parameterization with bi-level optimization. The method jointly optimizes pruning parameters and network weights within a bi-level framework for structured pruning, reducing computation while preserving segmentation accuracy. Compared with conventional pruning, it better suits edge deployment. No specific accuracy or speedup numbers are reported in the abstract.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 双层优化剪枝用于语义分割边缘部署具有一定实用价值，但需实验数据验证其优越性。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法用于边缘语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 将剪枝参数与网络权重通过双层优化联合学习。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 摘要未提供具体精度与加速比数据。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: 该论文针对超高分辨率图像与视频抠图计算量巨大的问题，提出了一种时空稀疏性方法。方法利用视频帧间与空间上的稀疏性，仅在关键区域进行高分辨率计算，从而大幅降低内存与计算开销。相比已有抠图方法，该工作首次将时空稀疏性引入超高分辨率场景。摘要未给出具体指标数据。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive computation of ultrahigh-resolution image and video matting by exploiting spatio-temporal sparsity. The method performs high-resolution computation only in key regions based on inter-frame and spatial sparsity, greatly reducing memory and computation. Unlike existing matting approaches, it is the first to introduce spatio-temporal sparsity for ultrahigh-resolution matting. No quantitative metrics are provided in the abstract.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 时空稀疏性用于超高分辨率抠图思路合理，但缺乏实验数据，实际收益需进一步确认。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出了一种基于时空稀疏性的超高分辨率图像/视频抠图方法。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 首次将时空稀疏性引入超高分辨率抠图以降低计算开销。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 摘要未报告具体性能数据。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习在系统异构性下通信与计算效率低的问题，提出了自适应通道稀疏化方法。方法根据各客户端的计算能力动态调整通道稀疏度，在保证模型精度的同时减少通信与计算负担。相比固定稀疏度方法，该工作更适应异构设备环境。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper tackles communication and computation inefficiency in federated learning under system heterogeneity by proposing adaptive channel sparsity. The method dynamically adjusts channel sparsity per client based on computational capacity, reducing communication and computation while maintaining accuracy. Compared with fixed-sparsity approaches, it better adapts to heterogeneous devices. No quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 自适应通道稀疏化用于联邦学习异构场景具有一定新意，但需实验验证其有效性。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出了一种面向系统异构联邦学习的自适应通道稀疏化方法。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据客户端计算能力动态调整通道稀疏度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频超分辨率模型计算量大的问题，提出了结构化稀疏学习方法。方法通过结构化剪枝去除冗余通道与层，在保持超分辨率质量的同时显著降低计算量。相比非结构化稀疏，该工作更利于硬件加速。摘要未给出具体加速比与质量指标。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of video super-resolution by proposing structured sparsity learning. The method removes redundant channels and layers via structured pruning, significantly reducing computation while preserving super-resolution quality. Compared with unstructured sparsity, it is more hardware-friendly. No specific speedup or quality metrics are reported in the abstract.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 结构化稀疏用于视频超分辨率具有实用价值，但缺乏实验数据支撑。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出了一种面向视频超分辨率的结构化稀疏学习方法。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 通过结构化剪枝实现视频超分辨率模型的硬件友好加速。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 摘要未报告具体加速比与质量数据。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中知识蒸馏效果有限的问题，提出了判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法。方法利用判别器的中间特征图作为额外监督信号，指导学生生成器学习更丰富的表示。相比仅使用生成器特征的传统蒸馏，该工作提升了压缩后GAN的生成质量。摘要未提供具体FID等指标数据。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited effectiveness of knowledge distillation in GAN compression by proposing discriminator-cooperated feature map distillation. The method leverages intermediate feature maps from the discriminator as additional supervision to guide the student generator in learning richer representations. Compared with conventional distillation using only generator features, it improves the generation quality of compressed GANs. No specific FID or other metrics are provided in the abstract.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 利用判别器特征图进行蒸馏的思路较新颖，但需实验数据验证其压缩效果。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出了一种判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 将判别器中间特征图作为额外监督信号指导学生生成器。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 摘要未报告具体生成质量指标数据。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对紧凑型3D检测器知识蒸馏（KD）中教师与学生中间特征表示差异过大的问题展开研究，指出该差异主要源于3D点云固有的稀疏性与不规则性，导致现有KD方法在极端紧凑3D检测器上效果不佳。作者提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法，从信息瓶颈（IB）视角出发，在特征与logits两个层面最小化师生proposal区域对之间的差异。在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，在仅占42% FLOPs的情况下甚至超越教师模型性能，优于现有KD方法。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the representation disparity issue in knowledge distillation for compact 3D detectors, which arises from the intrinsic sparsity and irregularity of 3D point clouds and limits the effectiveness of off-the-shelf KD methods. The authors propose a novel representation disparity-aware distillation (RDD) method built upon an information bottleneck perspective, which minimizes the disparity of proposal region pairs between student and teacher in both features and logits. Extensive experiments show that RDD raises the mAP of CP-Voxel-S to 57.1% on nuScenes, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该工作切中3D检测蒸馏中师生表示差异这一被忽视的关键问题，IB视角的建模具有理论新意，且在nuScenes上以极少FLOPs超越教师，实用价值高，值得3D检测与模型压缩方向研究者关注。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD），从信息瓶颈视角缓解师生proposal区域对在特征与logits上的表示差异。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 首次将信息瓶颈理论引入3D检测蒸馏，针对点云稀疏不规则导致的表示差异进行显式建模与最小化。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，仅用42% FLOPs即超越教师模型。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大、现有token剪枝方法忽视多模态特性导致性能下降的问题，提出MADTP框架。该方法通过多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝，利用跨模态对齐信息评估token重要性并动态分配剪枝率。相比静态或单模态剪枝方法，MADTP在多个视觉-语言任务上实现了更高的压缩率与精度保持。实验表明在保持99%以上性能的同时减少约50%的FLOPs，显著加速推理。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of Vision-Language Transformers (VLTs) and the limitations of existing token pruning methods that overlook multimodal characteristics. It proposes MADTP, a multimodal alignment-guided dynamic token pruning framework that evaluates token importance via cross-modal alignment and dynamically allocates pruning ratios. Compared to static or unimodal pruning, MADTP achieves higher compression with better accuracy retention, reducing FLOPs by ~50% while maintaining over 99% performance on multiple vision-language tasks.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 该工作将动态token剪枝与多模态对齐结合，为VLT加速提供了有效方案，实验充分，值得关注。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架MADTP，实现VLT的高效压缩。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 利用跨模态对齐信息动态评估token重要性并分配剪枝率。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个视觉-语言任务上减少约50% FLOPs，性能保持99%以上。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉-语言模型剪枝方法依赖特定任务或架构、难以泛化的问题，提出MULTIFLOW任务无关的剪枝框架。该方法通过多模态流形学习与结构化剪枝，在无需下游任务微调的情况下实现通用压缩。相比任务特定剪枝，MULTIFLOW在多个视觉-语言任务上展现出更好的泛化性和压缩效率。实验表明在相同压缩率下，零样本和微调性能均优于基线方法。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: This paper tackles the task- and architecture-specific limitations of existing vision-language model pruning methods. It proposes MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic pruning framework that leverages multimodal manifold learning and structured pruning to achieve general-purpose compression without downstream fine-tuning. Compared to task-specific pruning, MULTIFLOW demonstrates better generalization and compression efficiency, outperforming baselines in both zero-shot and fine-tuned settings at equal compression rates.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝对多模态模型部署有实际价值，方法设计合理，实验覆盖多任务，值得关注。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的视觉-语言模型剪枝框架MULTIFLOW。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 通过多模态流形学习实现无需下游微调的通用结构化剪枝。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在多个视觉-语言任务上，相同压缩率下零样本和微调性能均优于基线。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）结构化剪枝中缺乏有效误差度量导致压缩后性能下降的问题，提出MoPE-CLIP方法。该方法引入模块级剪枝误差度量（Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric），量化各模块对剪枝的敏感度，并据此进行结构化剪枝。相比传统基于权重幅度的剪枝，MoPE-CLIP在CLIP等模型上实现了更优的精度-效率权衡。实验表明在相同压缩率下，零样本分类性能显著优于现有方法。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of effective error metrics in structured pruning of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which leads to performance degradation. It proposes MoPE-CLIP, which introduces a module-wise pruning error metric to quantify each module's sensitivity to pruning and guide structured pruning. Compared to magnitude-based pruning, MoPE-CLIP achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off on CLIP, significantly outperforming existing methods in zero-shot classification at equal compression rates.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 模块级误差度量思路新颖，为VLM结构化剪枝提供了更精细的指导，实验扎实。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量并用于VLM结构化剪枝的MoPE-CLIP方法。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 引入模块级剪枝误差度量量化各模块敏感度以指导剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.result: 在CLIP等模型上相同压缩率下零样本分类性能显著优于现有方法。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: 针对多模态数据集规模庞大、训练成本高的问题，提出Sieve数据集剪枝方法。该方法利用图像描述模型（Image Captioning Models）评估样本质量与多样性，筛选出信息量高的子集用于训练。相比随机采样或基于损失的剪枝，Sieve在保持下游任务性能的同时大幅减少训练数据量。实验表明在多个多模态基准上，使用剪枝后的子集训练可达到与全量数据相当甚至更好的性能。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost of large-scale multimodal datasets by proposing Sieve, a dataset pruning method. It leverages image captioning models to assess sample quality and diversity, selecting an informative subset for training. Compared to random sampling or loss-based pruning, Sieve maintains downstream performance while significantly reducing training data. Experiments show that training on the pruned subset achieves comparable or better performance than full-data training on multiple multimodal benchmarks.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 利用图像描述模型进行数据集剪枝的思路实用，对降低多模态训练成本有参考价值。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述模型的多模态数据集剪枝方法Sieve。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用图像描述模型评估样本质量与多样性以筛选高信息量数据。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 在多个多模态基准上，剪枝后子集训练性能与全量数据相当或更优。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer压缩中重要性搜索与稀疏度搜索分离导致次优压缩的问题，提出Once for Both框架。该方法在单阶段内联合搜索层重要性与稀疏度，实现端到端的结构化压缩。相比两阶段方法，Once for Both在相同压缩率下获得更高的精度，且搜索效率更高。实验表明在ImageNet上，压缩后的ViT在FLOPs减少约50%时精度损失小于1%。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal compression in Vision Transformer compression caused by separate importance and sparsity searches. It proposes Once for Both, a single-stage framework that jointly searches layer importance and sparsity for end-to-end structured compression. Compared to two-stage methods, it achieves higher accuracy at the same compression rate with better search efficiency. Experiments show that on ImageNet, the compressed ViT loses less than 1% accuracy while reducing FLOPs by ~50%.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 单阶段联合搜索简化了压缩流程并提升性能，对ViT高效部署有实际意义。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合搜索重要性与稀疏度的ViT压缩框架Once for Both。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 在单阶段内联合搜索层重要性与稀疏度，实现端到端结构化压缩。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.result: 在ImageNet上FLOPs减少约50%时精度损失小于1%。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer压缩在少样本场景下难以有效进行的问题，提出少样本密集ViT压缩方法。该方法通过密集连接与少样本学习策略，在仅有少量训练样本时实现高效压缩。相比需要大量数据的传统压缩方法，该方法在少样本条件下仍能保持较高精度。实验表明在仅使用少量样本时，压缩后的ViT在多个基准上达到与全数据压缩相近的性能。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of Vision Transformer compression in few-sample scenarios. It proposes a dense ViT compression method that leverages dense connections and few-shot learning strategies to achieve efficient compression with only a small number of training samples. Compared to traditional compression methods requiring large datasets, it maintains high accuracy under few-sample conditions. Experiments show that with only a few samples, the compressed ViT achieves performance comparable to full-data compression on multiple benchmarks.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本压缩对实际部署中数据稀缺场景有重要价值，方法设计有针对性。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本场景下的密集视觉Transformer压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 结合密集连接与少样本学习策略实现低数据量下的高效压缩。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 在仅使用少量样本时，压缩后ViT性能与全数据压缩相近。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像压缩模型在持续学习新数据/新码率时容易遗忘旧知识、且难以保持与已有解码器向后兼容的问题，提出了一种向后兼容的持续学习图像压缩框架。方法上通过约束潜在表示与旧模型的一致性并引入正则化/蒸馏式机制，使新压缩模型在提升压缩性能的同时仍可被旧解码器解码。相比已有持续学习压缩工作，其改进点在于显式处理编解码器版本兼容性而非仅防止灾难性遗忘。实验在多个数据集与码率设置下验证了兼容性与压缩效率的平衡，具体指标摘要未给出。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses backward-compatible continual learning for image compression, where models must adapt to new data or rates without forgetting and while remaining decodable by legacy decoders. It enforces latent consistency with the old model and introduces regularization/distillation-style constraints so that updated encoders stay compatible with existing decoders. Compared with prior continual compression work, it explicitly targets codec version compatibility rather than only catastrophic forgetting, and experiments demonstrate a favorable trade-off between compatibility and compression efficiency.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 选题切中实际部署中压缩模型迭代的兼容性痛点，思路对持续学习与压缩交叉方向有参考价值，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）关联较弱。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出面向图像压缩的向后兼容持续学习框架，兼顾新模型性能与旧解码器可用性。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将向后兼容约束显式引入持续学习压缩，缓解版本迭代导致的解码失效问题。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 在保持与旧解码器兼容的同时取得压缩效率与遗忘抑制的平衡（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: 该论文针对StyleGAN压缩中通道剪枝容易破坏生成多样性、导致模式坍塌或风格退化的问题，提出了多样性感知的通道剪枝方法。方法通过设计多样性度量/正则项来指导剪枝重要性评估，在压缩生成器的同时保留潜在空间到图像的多样映射能力。相比仅以重构误差或FID为导向的剪枝，其改进在于显式优化生成多样性。实验在StyleGAN系列上验证了压缩后图像质量与多样性指标的改善，具体数值摘要未提供。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles channel pruning for StyleGAN compression, where naive pruning degrades generation diversity and causes mode/style collapse. It proposes a diversity-aware pruning criterion that incorporates a diversity measure/regularizer into channel importance estimation, preserving the diverse latent-to-image mapping under compression. Unlike reconstruction- or FID-only pruning, it explicitly optimizes generation diversity, and experiments on StyleGAN variants show improved quality-diversity trade-offs.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 把多样性保持引入生成模型剪枝是有意义的切入点，对生成式模型压缩研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性有限。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法用于StyleGAN压缩。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 在剪枝重要性评估中显式建模并优化生成多样性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 在压缩StyleGAN的同时改善了图像质量与生成多样性的权衡（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离、剪枝策略难以随训练动态调整的问题，提出通过可学习智能体引导与对齐来联合训练和剪枝CNN。方法引入强化学习/智能体式控制器生成剪枝决策，并通过引导与对齐机制使剪枝过程与训练目标协同优化。相比两阶段或启发式剪枝，其改进在于端到端联合优化与更稳定的策略学习。实验在标准分类基准上取得优于或可比于SOTA剪枝方法的精度-压缩比，具体数值摘要未给出。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation between training and pruning in CNN compression by jointly learning to train and prune via learnable agent guidance and alignment. An agent/controller produces pruning decisions that are aligned with the training objective, enabling end-to-end co-optimization instead of two-stage or heuristic pipelines. Experiments on standard classification benchmarks show competitive or superior accuracy-compression trade-offs.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 联合训练-剪枝与智能体引导的思路对模型压缩方向有方法学价值，但属于通用压缩技术，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出基于可学习智能体引导与对齐的CNN联合训练与剪枝框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 用智能体决策与对齐机制将剪枝策略学习与网络训练端到端耦合。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 在分类基准上取得优于/可比于现有剪枝方法的精度-压缩权衡（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习中各客户端设备算力与资源异构、统一剪枝模型难以适配所有设备的问题，提出了设备级（device-wise）联邦网络剪枝方法。方法在联邦训练过程中为不同设备生成/选择差异化子网络，并通过聚合与一致性约束协调异构剪枝结构。相比统一剪枝或仅服务器端剪枝，其改进在于按设备资源定制压缩率并保持全局模型可用性。实验在联邦基准上验证了通信/计算开销降低与精度保持，具体数值摘要未给出。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper targets heterogeneous device resources in federated learning, where a single pruned model cannot fit all clients, and proposes device-wise federated network pruning. It derives or selects device-specific subnetworks during federated training and coordinates heterogeneous pruned structures via aggregation and consistency constraints. Compared with uniform or server-only pruning, it customizes compression per device while preserving global model utility, with experiments showing reduced communication/computation and maintained accuracy.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 设备级异构剪枝对边缘联邦部署有实际意义，但主题偏系统与压缩，与自动驾驶感知算法研究关联较弱。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出面向异构设备的联邦网络剪枝方法。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 在联邦训练中为不同设备定制差异化子网络并协调聚合。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 在降低通信与计算开销的同时保持联邦模型精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态剪枝（输入相关）与静态剪枝（结构固定）各有优劣、难以统一的问题，提出BilevelPruning双层优化框架统一动态与静态通道剪枝。方法将通道剪枝建模为双层优化问题，上层学习剪枝策略/结构，下层更新网络权重，从而同时获得静态结构压缩与动态推理时的通道选择能力。相比单一动态或静态方法，其改进在于统一建模并兼顾推理效率与精度。实验在分类/检测等基准上验证了FLOPs降低与精度保持，具体数值摘要未给出。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper unifies dynamic (input-dependent) and static channel pruning via a bilevel optimization framework, BilevelPruning. It formulates pruning as a bilevel problem where the upper level learns the pruning policy/structure and the lower level updates network weights, yielding both a compact static structure and dynamic channel selection at inference. Compared with purely dynamic or static methods, it jointly optimizes efficiency and accuracy, with experiments on classification/detection benchmarks showing FLOPs reduction with maintained accuracy.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 双层优化统一动静态剪枝在方法上有一定新意，对高效网络设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务本身关联有限。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出统一动态与静态通道剪枝的双层优化框架BilevelPruning。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 用双层优化同时学习剪枝策略与网络权重，融合动静态剪枝优势。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 在降低计算量的同时保持精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: 该论文针对CapsNet计算冗余、路由机制效率低且特征冗余的问题，提出OrthCaps：一种带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet。方法通过正交约束提升胶囊表示的解耦性，用稀疏注意力路由替代传统动态路由以降低开销，并引入剪枝去除冗余胶囊/通道。相比原始CapsNet及其变体，其改进在于效率与表示质量的兼顾。实验在标准识别基准上取得精度与效率的提升，具体数值摘要未给出。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational redundancy and inefficient routing of CapsNets by proposing OrthCaps, an orthogonal CapsNet with sparse attention routing and pruning. It enforces orthogonality for disentangled capsule representations, replaces conventional dynamic routing with sparse attention routing to cut cost, and prunes redundant capsules/channels. Compared with vanilla CapsNets and variants, it improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on standard recognition benchmarks.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 对CapsNet的效率与表示改进有一定方法价值，但胶囊网络在主流感知中应用有限，与自动驾驶视觉主线相关性较低。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet（OrthCaps）。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 结合正交约束、稀疏注意力路由与剪枝以提升胶囊网络效率与表示质量。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 在识别基准上改善了精度与效率的权衡（摘要未给出具体数值）。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: 联邦学习场景下，客户端设备内存受限，动态剪枝虽能降低计算量但会带来额外内存开销。本文提出 FedMef，通过内存高效的动态剪枝机制在联邦训练中同时压缩模型与降低峰值内存。相比已有联邦剪枝方法，FedMef 在保持精度的同时显著减少客户端内存占用。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: Federated learning on memory-constrained clients suffers from the overhead of dynamic pruning. FedMef proposes a memory-efficient federated dynamic pruning scheme that reduces both computation and peak memory during federated training. It improves over prior federated pruning methods in memory efficiency while maintaining accuracy, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 面向联邦学习的内存高效剪枝，对边缘端部署有参考价值，但与视觉感知主线关联较弱。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架 FedMef。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 在联邦训练中联合优化剪枝与峰值内存开销。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 在保持精度的同时降低客户端内存占用（摘要未给出具体数值）。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: 大模型微调阶段计算与存储开销巨大，现有剪枝方法多针对预训练或推理阶段。本文提出面向微调的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法，在微调过程中动态削减冗余参数。相比常规微调，该方法在降低资源消耗的同时保持下游任务性能。摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: Finetuning large Transformer models is resource-intensive, and existing pruning methods mainly target pretraining or inference. This paper proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning approach tailored to the finetuning stage, reducing redundant parameters during finetuning. It maintains downstream performance while lowering resource consumption, though the abstract lacks quantitative results.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 关注大模型微调效率，方法思路实用，但与自动驾驶视觉感知的直接相关性有限。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向大模型微调的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 将剪枝嵌入微调过程以降低资源开销。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.result: 在保持下游性能的同时减少微调资源消耗（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: 彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）中寻找稀疏子网络通常依赖昂贵的迭代训练。本文提出基于数据驱动谱前瞻的剪枝方法，在视觉模型中高效定位彩票子网络。相比传统迭代幅度剪枝，该方法利用谱信息减少搜索成本。摘要未给出具体精度与压缩率数据。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: Finding lottery tickets in vision models typically requires expensive iterative training. This paper proposes a data-driven spectral foresight pruning method to efficiently identify winning tickets. It reduces search cost compared to conventional iterative magnitude pruning by leveraging spectral information, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 为彩票假设提供更高效的剪枝视角，对模型压缩研究有启发，但与感知任务关联间接。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动谱前瞻剪枝以寻找视觉模型中的彩票子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用谱信息前瞻性定位稀疏子网络，降低搜索成本。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 在视觉模型上更高效地找到彩票子网络（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: RGB-D 6DoF 物体位姿估计中，表面编码与对应关系匹配的精度和效率是关键瓶颈。本文提出 HiPose，采用分层二值表面编码与对应关系剪枝来提升位姿估计精度与速度。相比已有基于对应关系的方法，HiPose 通过分层编码与剪枝减少错误匹配。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值结果。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation is bottlenecked by surface encoding and correspondence matching. HiPose introduces hierarchical binary surface encoding and correspondence pruning to improve both accuracy and efficiency. It reduces mismatches compared to prior correspondence-based methods, though the abstract does not report quantitative results.
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 面向机器人抓取与 AR 的 6DoF 位姿估计，方法设计细致，对 3D 感知研究者有参考价值。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出分层二值表面编码与对应剪枝的 RGB-D 6DoF 位姿估计方法 HiPose。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 用分层二值编码结合对应剪枝提升匹配精度与效率。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在位姿估计精度与效率上优于已有对应关系方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: 源无关（source-free）场景下模型知识产权保护缺乏有效手段。本文提出 MAP，利用掩码剪枝在源无关条件下嵌入水印以保护模型知识产权。相比传统水印方法，MAP 无需访问源数据即可验证模型归属。摘要未给出具体验证精度与鲁棒性数据。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: Protecting model intellectual property in source-free settings is challenging. This paper proposes MAP, a mask-pruning-based watermarking method for source-free model IP protection. Unlike conventional watermarking, MAP verifies ownership without access to source data, though the abstract lacks quantitative robustness results.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 将剪枝用于模型版权保护，角度新颖，但与视觉感知任务关联较弱。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出基于掩码剪枝的源无关模型知识产权保护方法 MAP。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 在无源数据条件下通过掩码剪枝嵌入可验证水印。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 实现源无关场景下的模型归属验证（摘要未给出具体数值）。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: ViT 推理中 token 数量庞大导致计算开销高，现有 token 剪枝多需微调或额外训练。本文提出 Zero-TPrune，利用预训练 Transformer 的注意力图实现零样本 token 剪枝。相比需要再训练的方法，Zero-TPrune 无需微调即可加速推理。摘要未给出具体加速比与精度损失数据。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: Vision Transformers suffer from high inference cost due to numerous tokens, and existing token pruning methods often require finetuning. Zero-TPrune performs zero-shot token pruning by leveraging the attention graph of pretrained Transformers. It accelerates inference without finetuning, though the abstract does not report specific speedup or accuracy numbers.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 零样本 token 剪枝思路简洁实用，对 ViT 高效推理与感知骨干网络优化有参考价值。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出利用注意力图的零样本 token 剪枝方法 Zero-TPrune。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 无需微调，直接基于预训练注意力图进行 token 剪枝。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.result: 在无微调条件下加速 ViT 推理（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: 针对现有网络剪枝方法依赖预训练权重、难以从零训练（from scratch）的问题，本文提出 Auto-Train-Once（ATO），用控制器网络引导自动剪枝。方法在训练过程中由控制器网络动态决定各层的剪枝结构，实现端到端的从零训练剪枝。相比需要预训练再剪枝的两阶段方法，ATO 省去了预训练开销并保持结构自适应。摘要未给出具体数据集与压缩率/精度数据。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that most network pruning methods rely on pre-trained weights and cannot prune from scratch. It proposes Auto-Train-Once (ATO), which employs a controller network to guide automatic pruning during training. Unlike two-stage prune-after-pretrain pipelines, ATO removes the pre-training requirement and adapts the pruned structure end-to-end. No specific accuracy or compression numbers are reported in the abstract.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 从零训练剪枝是实用方向，控制器引导思路有一定新意，但需看实验是否覆盖主流骨干网络。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出控制器网络引导的从零训练自动剪枝框架 Auto-Train-Once。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 将剪枝结构搜索嵌入训练过程，由控制器网络动态决定剪枝结构。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: 针对数据集剪枝（dataset pruning）中样本重要性评估不充分的问题，本文提出 Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring（TDDS），从训练进程的时间维度与网络深度维度双重评估样本价值。方法跨越训练过程采集打分信号，兼顾浅层与深层特征，从而更准确地筛选核心样本子集。相比单时刻或单深度的打分策略，TDDS 在保持精度的同时提升训练效率。摘要未给出具体加速比与精度数据。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper targets the insufficient sample-importance estimation in dataset pruning and proposes Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS), which scores samples along both the temporal training progress and the network depth axes. By spanning training progress and combining shallow and deep cues, TDDS selects more informative coresets. It improves over single-time or single-depth scoring, though the abstract omits concrete speedup and accuracy figures.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 数据集剪枝对大规模训练有实际价值，双维度打分思路合理，但需验证在检测/分割等任务上的泛化性。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出时间-深度双维度样本打分的数据集剪枝方法 TDDS。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 跨越训练进程并从多网络深度联合评估样本重要性。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: 针对深度补全（depth refinement）中稀疏深度输入与稠密预测之间的适配问题，本文提出 Masked Spatial Propagation Network（MSPN），实现稀疏度自适应的深度补全。方法利用掩码空间传播机制，根据输入稀疏程度自适应地传播与聚合深度信息。相比固定传播策略的已有方法，MSPN 能更好处理不同稀疏度的深度输入。摘要未给出具体 RMSE 等指标数据。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses sparsity-adaptive depth refinement, where sparse depth inputs must be completed into dense depth maps. It proposes the Masked Spatial Propagation Network (MSPN), which uses masked spatial propagation to adaptively aggregate depth cues according to input sparsity. Compared with fixed propagation schemes, MSPN better handles varying sparsity levels, though no quantitative RMSE figures are given in the abstract.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 深度补全对自动驾驶 3D 感知有支撑作用，稀疏度自适应传播机制值得关注。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出掩码空间传播网络 MSPN 用于稀疏度自适应深度补全。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 以掩码空间传播实现随输入稀疏度自适应的深度细化。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: 针对结构化稀疏对抗攻击迁移性不足的问题，本文提出通过精确组稀疏训练获得可迁移的结构化稀疏对抗扰动。方法在训练阶段引入精确组稀疏约束，使生成的稀疏扰动在结构上更具泛化性，从而提升跨模型迁移攻击成功率。相比逐像素稀疏攻击，组稀疏约束更符合结构化扰动的物理特性。摘要未给出具体攻击成功率数据。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited transferability of structural sparse adversarial attacks and proposes an exact group sparsity training scheme to generate transferable structural sparse perturbations. By enforcing exact group sparsity during training, the perturbations generalize better across models. It improves over pixel-wise sparse attacks by respecting structural sparsity, but the abstract lacks concrete attack success rates.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 对抗攻击与检测鲁棒性相关，组稀疏训练思路对稀疏扰动研究有参考价值。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构化稀疏对抗攻击方法。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 用精确组稀疏约束提升结构化稀疏扰动的跨模型迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: 针对 N:M 稀疏（如 2:4 结构化稀疏）中固定稀疏模式限制模型表达能力的问题，本文提出 MaxQ，一种多轴查询（Multi-Axis Query）的 N:M 稀疏网络。方法通过多轴查询机制在保持硬件友好的 N:M 稀疏约束下，更灵活地选择保留权重。相比固定模式的 N:M 稀疏方法，MaxQ 在同等稀疏率下提升模型精度。摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited expressiveness of fixed N:M sparsity patterns and proposes MaxQ, a multi-axis query mechanism for N:M sparsity networks. MaxQ flexibly selects retained weights while preserving hardware-friendly N:M constraints. It improves accuracy over fixed-pattern N:M sparsity at equal sparsity ratios, though the abstract provides no concrete accuracy or speedup numbers.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: N:M 稀疏是硬件加速的重要方向，多轴查询机制对稀疏模式优化有启发。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询的 N:M 稀疏网络 MaxQ。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 以多轴查询机制在 N:M 约束下实现更灵活的权重保留选择。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: 针对后训练稀疏化（post-training sparsity）方法各自为政、缺乏统一框架的问题，本文提出 UniPTS，一个统一的后训练稀疏化框架。方法将多种后训练稀疏化策略纳入统一表述，在无需重训练或仅需少量校准的情况下实现高效稀疏化。相比单一策略方法，UniPTS 提供更通用的稀疏化范式并保持竞争力精度。摘要未给出具体压缩率与精度数据。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of post-training sparsity methods and proposes UniPTS, a unified framework for proficient post-training sparsity. It formulates diverse post-training sparsification strategies under a common paradigm, achieving efficient sparsification with little or no retraining. Compared with individual strategies, UniPTS offers a more general recipe with competitive accuracy, though no concrete compression or accuracy numbers appear in the abstract.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 统一后训练稀疏化框架对部署友好，若实验充分则对模型压缩社区有实用价值。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的后训练稀疏化框架 UniPTS。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 将多种后训练稀疏化策略统一到同一范式下。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时计算和存储开销大的问题，提出DeepCompress-ViT压缩框架。方法结合结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，在保持精度的前提下减少参数量和FLOPs。相比已有压缩方法，该工作更强调边缘部署的实用性，在多个ViT骨干上取得较好的精度-效率折中。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory cost of deploying Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing DeepCompress-ViT, a compression framework combining structured pruning and knowledge distillation. It achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off across multiple ViT backbones, emphasizing practical edge deployment.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: 对边缘端ViT部署有一定参考价值，但方法组合较为常规，创新性有限。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出面向边缘部署的ViT压缩框架，结合剪枝与蒸馏实现精度-效率折中。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 将结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏联合用于ViT边缘压缩。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 在多个ViT骨干上实现参数量和FLOPs显著降低且精度损失可控。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: 现有目标检测方法多基于ISP压缩后的sRGB输入，在复杂光照和天气下会丢失关键信息。本文提出AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率真实RAW图像、135,601个标注实例、62个类别，覆盖9种光照和天气条件。基于该数据集建立RAW与sRGB检测基准，发现sRGB预训练因域差距限制RAW检测性能，进而提出直接在RAW域预训练并蒸馏sRGB预训练模型知识。方法在多样和恶劣条件下取得显著提升，且无需额外预处理模块。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces AODRaw, a large-scale real RAW object detection dataset with 7,785 high-resolution images, 135,601 instances, and 62 categories across 9 lighting and weather conditions. It shows that sRGB pre-training limits RAW detection due to domain gap, and proposes direct RAW-domain pre-training with knowledge distillation from an sRGB-pretrained model, achieving substantial gains under diverse and adverse conditions without extra pre-processing modules.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: 数据集贡献扎实，RAW域检测问题定义清晰，对自动驾驶感知在恶劣条件下的鲁棒性研究有重要价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建大规模真实RAW目标检测数据集AODRaw并建立基准，提出RAW域预训练加sRGB知识蒸馏的检测方案。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地研究RAW域目标检测，揭示sRGB预训练的域差距问题并提出蒸馏辅助RAW预训练。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样和恶劣条件下取得显著检测性能提升，无需额外预处理模块。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）中计算效率被忽视的问题，提出基于剪枝的高效CTTA-OD方法。观察到并非所有源域特征都有益，部分域敏感通道会损害目标域性能，因此提出敏感度引导的通道剪枝策略，在图像和实例级别量化通道对域差异的敏感度，并通过加权稀疏正则化抑制和剪枝敏感通道。同时引入随机通道重激活机制恢复被剪枝通道，避免过早剪枝的风险。在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的效果。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked computational efficiency in continual test-time adaptive object detection (CTTA-OD) by proposing a sensitivity-guided channel pruning method. It quantifies channel sensitivity to domain discrepancy at image and instance levels, applies weighted sparsity regularization to prune sensitive channels, and introduces stochastic channel reactivation to recover useful features. Experiments on three benchmarks show superior performance.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 将剪枝引入CTTA-OD以提升效率的思路新颖，对资源受限场景下的持续自适应检测有实用价值。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出敏感度引导通道剪枝与随机重激活机制，实现高效持续测试时自适应目标检测。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 从域敏感通道角度出发，用剪枝替代全参数自适应以降低计算开销。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的性能，同时提升计算效率。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云属性压缩中熵模型概率估计不够准确的问题，提出广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更精确估计隐变量概率。同时指出现有方法在算术编码中使用固定似然区间限制性能，提出均值误差判别器（MED）判断熵参数估计是否准确并动态调整似然区间。在三个基于VAE的点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能，并可推广至图像和视频压缩任务。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a generalized Gaussian entropy model with a shape parameter to more accurately estimate latent probabilities in point cloud attribute compression. It also introduces a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) to dynamically adjust likelihood intervals during arithmetic coding. Experiments on three VAE-based models show significant rate-distortion improvements, with applicability to image and video compression.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，但熵模型改进对压缩任务有通用价值。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出广义高斯熵模型和动态似然区间调整机制，提升点云属性压缩的率失真性能。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 引入形状参数控制尾部形状并动态调整算术编码似然区间。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在三个VAE-based点云属性压缩模型上显著提升RD性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: 针对八叉树结构点云几何压缩中的占用预测问题，提出TopNet，一种基于Transformer的高效占用预测网络。方法利用Transformer建模八叉树节点间的上下文依赖，提升几何压缩效率。相比已有方法，TopNet在保持压缩率的同时降低计算复杂度，适用于点云几何压缩场景。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network for octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. It leverages Transformer to model contextual dependencies among octree nodes, improving compression efficiency while reducing computational complexity compared to existing methods.
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关度有限，但对点云压缩方向有参考意义。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的高效八叉树占用预测网络TopNet用于点云几何压缩。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.innovation: 将Transformer用于八叉树节点上下文建模以提升压缩效率。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.result: 在保持压缩率的同时降低计算复杂度。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: 针对文本驱动3D场景编辑中2D扩散模型缺乏多视图信息导致多视图不一致，以及3DGS编辑优化效率低的问题，提出EditSplat框架。方法包含多视图融合引导（MFG）和注意力引导修剪（AGT）：MFG将多视图信息融入扩散过程，利用无分类器引导和3DGS几何结构保证多视图一致性；AGT利用3DGS显式表示选择性修剪和优化3D高斯，提升优化效率并支持精确的局部语义编辑。通过大量定性和定量实验验证了方法的有效性。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes EditSplat, a text-driven 3D scene editing framework integrating Multi-view Fusion Guidance (MFG) and Attention-Guided Trimming (AGT) to address multi-view inconsistency and inefficient optimization in 3DGS-based editing. MFG incorporates multi-view information into the diffusion process for consistency, while AGT selectively prunes and optimizes 3D Gaussians for efficient and precise local editing. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate its effectiveness.
2412.11520|v2.assessment: 多视图一致性与3DGS编辑效率的结合有创新性，对3D场景编辑和AR/VR应用有参考价值。
2412.11520|v2.contribution: 提出EditSplat框架，通过多视图融合引导和注意力引导修剪实现视图一致的3DGS场景编辑。
2412.11520|v2.innovation: 将多视图信息融入扩散过程并利用3DGS显式表示进行选择性修剪优化。
2412.11520|v2.result: 在多视图一致性和编辑效率上优于现有方法，支持精确局部语义编辑。

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM在高分辨率图像下视觉编码器token数多、延迟高的问题，论文提出FastVLM，通过系统分析分辨率、视觉延迟、token数与LLM规模之间的权衡关系，设计了混合视觉编码器FastViTHD，仅通过缩放输入图像即可在视觉token数与分辨率之间取得最优平衡，无需额外的token剪枝。相比已有方法，FastVLM简化了模型设计并显著降低高分辨率编码时间，在延迟、模型大小与精度之间实现了更优的折中。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: FastVLM addresses the inefficiency of ViT-based visual encoders at high resolutions by introducing FastViTHD, a hybrid encoder that outputs fewer tokens and reduces encoding latency. Through a comprehensive efficiency analysis of resolution, latency, token count, and LLM size, it achieves an optimal trade-off between latency, model size, and accuracy solely by scaling the input image, eliminating extra token pruning. This simplifies the design while improving high-resolution performance.
2412.13303|v2.assessment: 该工作对VLM视觉编码效率进行了系统性的实证分析，提出的混合编码器设计简洁有效，对多模态感知系统的实时部署有参考价值。
2412.13303|v2.contribution: 提出FastVLM及FastViTHD混合视觉编码器，通过缩放输入图像实现token数与分辨率的最优平衡。
2412.13303|v2.innovation: 无需额外token剪枝，仅靠输入缩放即可在高分辨率下同时降低编码延迟与视觉token数。
2412.13303|v2.result: 在延迟、模型大小与精度之间取得优于已有方法的折中，显著降低高分辨率图像的编码时间。

2503.17142|v2.summary_cn: 论文探究VLM的视觉嵌入空间是否也像文本空间一样具有组合性结构，针对视觉数据噪声大、稀疏导致组合性分析困难的问题，提出几何可分解嵌入（GDE）框架，用几何感知的组合结构近似图像表示。实验表明预训练VLM的视觉嵌入确实呈现组合性排列，GDE在组合分类上优于假设线性几何的对照方法，在组鲁棒性任务上取得更高结果。
2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This work investigates whether visual embeddings of pre-trained VLMs exhibit compositional structure, addressing noise and sparsity challenges with a geometry-aware framework called Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE). GDE approximates image representations with compositional structures in latent space and outperforms linear-geometry counterparts in compositional classification, notably improving group robustness.
2503.17142|v2.assessment: 该工作从表征几何角度分析VLM视觉嵌入的组合性，为理解多模态特征空间提供了新视角，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
2503.17142|v2.contribution: 提出GDE框架，证明预训练VLM视觉嵌入具有组合性几何结构。
2503.17142|v2.innovation: 用几何感知的可分解嵌入替代线性假设来建模视觉表征的组合结构。
2503.17142|v2.result: 在组合分类上优于线性几何方法，在组鲁棒性任务上取得更高性能。

2501.02955|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM基准缺乏细粒度运动理解评估的问题，论文提出MotionBench，涵盖六类运动导向问题类型并采集多源真实视频数据。实验显示现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现很差，为此作者系统研究了面向视频特征压缩的VLM架构，提出高效的Through-Encoder（TE）融合方法。结果表明更高帧率输入与TE融合能提升运动理解，但仍有较大提升空间。
2501.02955|v2.summary_en: MotionBench is proposed as a comprehensive benchmark for fine-grained motion comprehension in video VLMs, covering six motion-oriented question types from diverse real-world sources. Experiments reveal poor performance of existing VLMs, and the authors propose an efficient Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion method, showing that higher frame rates and TE Fusion improve motion understanding while leaving substantial room for improvement.
2501.02955|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了视频VLM细粒度运动理解评测的空白，基准设计与架构改进实验对视频感知研究有实用价值。
2501.02955|v2.contribution: 提出MotionBench基准及TE Fusion方法，系统评估并改进VLM的细粒度运动理解能力。
2501.02955|v2.innovation: 构建六类运动导向问题的多源基准，并提出Through-Encoder融合以在有限序列长度下增强运动感知。
2501.02955|v2.result: 现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现不佳，高帧率输入与TE融合带来提升但仍存在显著改进空间。

2409.14485|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM处理小时级长视频时受限于上下文长度与计算成本的问题，论文提出Video-XL，利用MLLM固有的KV稀疏化能力压缩视觉输入，为每段视频引入特殊的视觉摘要token（VST）将其视觉信息总结为关联KV。VST模块通过指令微调训练，采用课程学习与复合数据策展两种优化策略，并结合动态压缩提升压缩质量。该方法在长视频理解任务上取得良好效果，支持小时级视频理解。
2409.14485|v2.summary_en: Video-XL tackles hour-scale long video understanding under MLLM context and cost constraints by leveraging inherent KV sparsification. It introduces a Visual Summarization Token (VST) per video interval to summarize visual information as associated KV, trained via instruction fine-tuning with curriculum learning and composite data curation, plus dynamic compression. This enables efficient long-video understanding.
2409.14485|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用KV稀疏化进行视觉压缩，课程学习与数据策展策略设计合理，对长视频多模态理解有较强参考价值。
2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL，通过视觉摘要token与KV稀疏化实现小时级长视频的高效理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 引入VST将视频区间视觉信息压缩为关联KV，并结合课程学习与复合数据策展训练。
2409.14485|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务上取得良好性能，支持小时级视频的高效处理。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM对图像和视频采用不同token压缩策略、难以统一处理的问题，论文提出渐进式视觉token压缩（PVC），将每张图像扩展为静态视频，逐帧渐进编码并自适应压缩token，以补充前帧未提取的信息。视频token利用时序冗余高效压缩，图像则通过多帧逐步补充空间细节，每帧默认仅64个token即可保留空间细节与时序变化。实验表明该模型在多种视频理解任务上达到SOTA。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: PVC addresses the lack of a unified token compression strategy for images and videos in VLMs by extending each image into a static video and progressively encoding and adaptively compressing frame tokens to supplement prior frames. Exploiting temporal redundancy, it preserves spatial details and temporal changes with only 64 tokens per frame, achieving state-of-the-art performance across various video understanding tasks.
2412.09613|v2.assessment: 该工作提出统一的图像-视频token压缩框架，设计简洁且token预算极低，对多模态高效感知有实用价值。
2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出渐进式视觉token压缩PVC，统一图像与视频的token压缩策略。
2412.09613|v2.innovation: 将图像视为静态视频，通过逐帧渐进编码与自适应压缩在极少token下保留空间与时序信息。
2412.09613|v2.result: 每帧仅64个token即在多种视频理解任务上达到SOTA性能。

Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理时视觉token冗余严重、现有剪枝方法忽视重要性与冗余度权衡的问题，提出Libra-Merging框架，将重要性评估与冗余度合并统一建模为剪枝-合并的权衡优化。方法通过可插拔的加速模块在剪枝与合并之间动态平衡，减少信息损失。相比已有仅依赖重要性或仅依赖相似度的剪枝策略，该方法在保持精度的同时实现更高压缩率。摘要未给出具体加速与精度数据。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_en: This paper addresses the redundancy of visual tokens in large vision-language models and the lack of a principled trade-off between importance and redundancy in existing pruning methods. It proposes Libra-Merging, a plug-in acceleration framework that jointly models importance-redundancy and pruning-merging trade-offs. Compared with prior importance-only or similarity-only pruning, it better preserves information under aggressive compression, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.assessment: 该工作将剪枝与合并统一为可插拔加速模块，思路对VLM推理效率研究有参考价值，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑其有效性。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.contribution: 提出Libra-Merging，将重要性与冗余度、剪枝与合并的权衡统一建模为LVLM加速插件。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.innovation: 把剪枝-合并的权衡显式建模为优化问题，而非单一启发式准则。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.result: 摘要未提供具体加速比与精度数据。

2503.18278|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM推理中视觉token过多导致计算开销大、现有剪枝方法依赖贪心启发式且与FlashAttention和KV cache不兼容的问题，提出TopV，将token剪枝形式化为推理时优化问题，无需额外训练或微调。方法在prefilling阶段仅执行一次剪枝，从而有效减小KV cache，并引入视觉感知代价函数（特征相似度、相对空间关系等）。相比依赖注意力分数的方案，TopV与FlashAttention兼容且更准确识别重要视觉token。摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据。
2503.18278|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high inference cost of VLMs caused by numerous visual tokens and the incompatibility of prior pruning methods with FlashAttention and KV cache. It proposes TopV, which formulates token pruning as an inference-time optimization problem without additional training, performing pruning once during prefilling to reduce KV cache size. A visual-aware cost function incorporating feature similarity and relative spatial relations is used, achieving better compatibility and token selection than attention-score-based heuristics, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2503.18278|v2.assessment: 将token剪枝建模为优化问题并兼容FlashAttention与KV cache，工程实用性强，对VLM高效推理有较高参考价值。
2503.18278|v2.contribution: 提出TopV，一种无需训练、兼容FlashAttention与KV cache的推理时优化token剪枝方法。
2503.18278|v2.innovation: 用优化问题替代贪心注意力启发式，并在prefilling阶段一次性剪枝以压缩KV cache。
2503.18278|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体精度与加速数据。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: 针对LVLM中长视觉token导致计算开销大、现有剪枝方法使用固定或预定义剪枝比例而忽视不同LLM层与不同实例差异的问题，提出ATP-LLaVA，自适应地为每个LLM层和每个输入实例确定token剪枝比例。方法引入Adaptive Token Pruning模块，基于输入实例自适应计算重要性分数与剪枝阈值，可无缝插入任意两层LLM之间且开销可忽略，并设计Spatial Augmented Pruning增强空间信息保留。相比固定比例剪枝，该方法在计算成本与模型性能之间取得更好平衡。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
2412.00447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive cost of long visual tokens in LVLMs and the limitation of fixed pruning ratios that ignore layer-wise and instance-wise variation. It proposes ATP-LLaVA, which adaptively determines instance-specific pruning ratios for each LLM layer via an Adaptive Token Pruning module computing importance scores and thresholds on the fly, plus a Spatial Augmented Pruning scheme. Compared with fixed-ratio pruning, it better balances computation and performance, though quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
2412.00447|v2.assessment: 层自适应与实例自适应的剪枝策略切中固定比例剪枝的痛点，模块化设计易于集成，对LVLM效率研究有实用价值。
2412.00447|v2.contribution: 提出ATP-LLaVA，实现层自适应与实例自适应的视觉token剪枝。
2412.00447|v2.innovation: 基于输入实例动态计算剪枝阈值，并引入空间增强剪枝保留空间信息。
2412.00447|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体精度与加速数据。

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM处理高分辨率图像和视频时受限于上下文窗口与高计算成本、现有视觉压缩方法依赖外部模块导致视觉信息损失的问题，提出VoCo-LLaMA，首个利用LLM自身压缩视觉token的方法。方法在视觉指令微调阶段引入Vision Compression token，并通过注意力蒸馏让LLM将理解视觉token的方式迁移到处理VoCo token上。相比外部压缩模块，该方法充分利用LLM的理解范式，在576倍压缩率下性能损失极小，FLOPs减少最多94.8%，推理时间加速69.6%。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the context-window and computational bottlenecks of VLMs on high-resolution images and videos, and the visual information loss caused by external compression modules. It proposes VoCo-LLaMA, the first approach to compress vision tokens using the LLM itself, introducing Vision Compression tokens during vision instruction tuning and leveraging attention distillation to transfer the LLM's comprehension of vision tokens. It achieves minimal performance loss at a 576x compression ratio, with up to 94.8% fewer FLOPs and 69.6% inference speedup.
2406.12275|v2.assessment: 利用LLM自身进行视觉压缩的思路新颖，576倍压缩下仍保持性能且加速显著，对VLM长上下文与视频理解有重要价值。
2406.12275|v2.contribution: 提出VoCo-LLaMA，首个用LLM自身压缩视觉token的视觉压缩方法。
2406.12275|v2.innovation: 引入Vision Compression token并通过注意力蒸馏将LLM对视觉token的理解迁移到压缩token。
2406.12275|v2.result: 576倍压缩率下性能损失极小，FLOPs减少最多94.8%，推理加速69.6%。

2503.16843|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM通过LoRA适配下游任务时引入大量有害冗余参数、加剧通用知识遗忘并降低下游性能的问题，提出LoRASculpt，通过消除有害冗余参数来协调通用与专用知识。方法在理论保证下向LoRA引入稀疏更新以丢弃冗余参数，并提出Conflict Mitigation Regularizer优化LoRA更新轨迹以缓解与预训练权重的知识冲突。实验表明即使在极高稀疏度（≤5%）下，该方法仍能同时提升泛化能力与下游任务性能，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
2503.16843|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the harmful redundancy introduced by LoRA during visual instruction tuning of MLLMs, which exacerbates forgetting of general knowledge and degrades downstream performance. It proposes LoRASculpt, which introduces sparse updates into LoRA under theoretical guarantees to discard redundant parameters, plus a Conflict Mitigation Regularizer to refine the LoRA update trajectory and mitigate conflicts with pretrained weights. Experiments show that even at very high sparsity (≤5%), it simultaneously improves generalization and downstream performance, mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
2503.16843|v2.assessment: 从稀疏化与冲突缓解角度解决LoRA微调中的知识遗忘问题，理论保证与实验结合，对MLLM持续学习与高效适配有参考价值。
2503.16843|v2.contribution: 提出LoRASculpt，通过稀疏更新与冲突缓解正则协调MLLM的通用与专用知识。
2503.16843|v2.innovation: 在理论保证下向LoRA引入稀疏更新，并设计Conflict Mitigation Regularizer优化更新轨迹。
2503.16843|v2.result: 在≤5%稀疏度下同时提升泛化与下游任务性能，缓解灾难性遗忘。

2503.02175|v2.summary_cn: 针对LMM中大量视觉token导致推理延迟高、现有剪枝方法需大量校准微调或依赖次优重要性度量导致保留token冗余的问题，提出DivPrune，将token剪枝形式化为最大-最小多样性问题（MMDP），目标是选取多样性最大的token子集。方法通过求解MMDP选出子集并剪除其余token，从而降低保留token间的冗余并最大化多样性。相比依赖重要性度量的方法，DivPrune无需大量校准且保留token多样性最高，摘要未给出具体加速与精度数据。
2503.02175|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference latency of LMMs caused by numerous visual tokens and the limitations of existing pruning methods that require extensive calibration or rely on suboptimal importance metrics leading to redundant retained tokens. It formulates token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem (MMDP) and proposes DivPrune, which selects the subset maximizing diversity among retained tokens and prunes the rest. Compared with importance-based methods, it reduces redundancy without heavy calibration, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2503.02175|v2.assessment: 从多样性最大化角度重新定义token剪枝，视角新颖且无需大量校准，对LMM高效推理有较好参考价值。
2503.02175|v2.contribution: 提出DivPrune，将视觉token剪枝形式化为最大-最小多样性问题并求解。
2503.02175|v2.innovation: 以最大化保留token多样性为目标替代传统重要性度量，降低冗余。
2503.02175|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体精度与加速数据。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型（LMM）在低比特压缩方面研究不足的问题，论文发现多模态输入的冗余性导致注意力矩阵高度稀疏，并从理论和实验上证明注意力稀疏度约束了Query/Key权重矩阵的压缩误差。据此提出CASP：对Q/K权重做数据感知的低秩分解，再基于最优比特分配进行全层量化。CASP可与任意量化方法兼容，在图像和视频语言基准上将SOTA 2-bit量化方法（AQLM、QuIP#）平均提升21%。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the under-explored problem of low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models. It theoretically and experimentally shows that the sparsity of the attention matrix bounds the compression error of Query/Key weight matrices, and proposes CASP, which performs data-aware low-rank decomposition on Q/K weights followed by optimal bit-allocation quantization across layers. CASP is compatible with any quantization method and improves state-of-the-art 2-bit methods (AQLM, QuIP#) by 21% on average on image- and video-language benchmarks.
2503.05936|v2.assessment: 将注意力稀疏性这一多模态特有性质与量化误差界建立理论联系，为LMM压缩提供了新视角，且与现有量化方法正交可插拔，实用价值较高。
2503.05936|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力稀疏性的LMM极端压缩框架CASP，包含数据感知低秩分解与最优比特分配量化。
2503.05936|v2.innovation: 从理论上证明注意力矩阵稀疏度约束Q/K权重压缩误差，并据此设计压缩策略。
2503.05936|v2.result: 在图像与视频语言基准上平均提升SOTA 2-bit量化方法21%。

2501.08282|v2.summary_cn: 现有MLLM难以同时处理时间与空间定位，原因在于坐标组合爆炸导致语言-视觉坐标对齐困难，以及视频特征压缩中细粒度时空信息难以保留。论文提出LLaVA-ST：用Language-Aligned Positional Embedding将文本坐标特殊token嵌入视觉空间以简化对齐，用Spatial-Temporal Packer将时间与空间分辨率的特征压缩解耦为两条point-to-region注意力流，并构建含4.3M样本的ST-Align数据集。
2501.08282|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLMs struggle to jointly handle temporal and spatial localization due to the combinatorial explosion of coordinates and the difficulty of preserving fine-grained spatio-temporal cues during video feature compression. The paper proposes LLaVA-ST, featuring a Language-Aligned Positional Embedding that embeds textual coordinate tokens into visual space, a Spatial-Temporal Packer that decouples temporal and spatial feature compression into two point-to-region attention streams, and the 4.3M-sample ST-Align dataset for fine-grained spatio-temporal understanding.
2501.08282|v2.assessment: 针对视频MLLM细粒度时空定位这一实际痛点提出系统性方案，配套大规模数据集，对视频理解与多模态定位研究有参考价值。
2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出面向细粒度时空理解的MLLM框架LLaVA-ST及4.3M规模的ST-Align数据集。
2501.08282|v2.innovation: 语言对齐位置嵌入与时空解耦的point-to-region特征压缩流设计。
2501.08282|v2.result: 在细粒度时空多模态理解任务上取得优于现有方法的表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: 论文指出基于梯度的解释方法在Transformer上表现不佳，根源是梯度流不平衡违反了FullGrad完备性这一归因忠实性的关键性质。为此提出LibraGrad，一种后处理式方法，通过剪枝和缩放反向传播路径来校正梯度不平衡，不改变前向计算也不增加推理开销。在8种架构、4种模型规模和4个数据集上，LibraGrad在Faithfulness、Completeness Error和Segmentation AP三类指标上全面超越现有白盒方法，包括Transformer专用方法。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies gradient flow imbalances in Transformers that violate FullGrad-completeness, a key property for attribution faithfulness. It proposes LibraGrad, a theoretically grounded post-hoc method that corrects gradient imbalances by pruning and scaling backward paths without altering the forward pass or adding overhead. Across 8 architectures, 4 model sizes, and 4 datasets, LibraGrad universally improves gradient-based attribution methods and outperforms existing white-box approaches on Faithfulness, Completeness Error, and Segmentation AP.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 为Transformer可解释性提供了有理论依据的通用改进，实验覆盖面广，但属于可解释性方向，与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 提出校正Transformer梯度流不平衡的后处理归因方法LibraGrad。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 揭示Transformer梯度流不平衡违反FullGrad完备性，并通过反向路径剪枝与缩放加以修正。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在8种架构、4个数据集上于三类指标全面超越现有白盒归因方法。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: 3D Gaussian Splatting场景常包含数百万高斯点，存储与显存开销大，而现有剪枝压缩方法依赖启发式组合，高压缩比下视觉保真度和前景细节严重退化。论文提出基于敏感度的剪枝分数，用重建误差对每个高斯空间参数的二阶近似来度量重要性，并设计多轮prune-refine流程，可应用于任意预训练3D-GS模型而无需改动训练管线。相比已有方法，在显著更高压缩比下仍能保持视觉保真度与前景细节。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes often contain millions of Gaussians, causing high storage and memory costs, while existing pruning heuristics severely degrade visual fidelity and foreground details at high compression ratios. This paper proposes a principled sensitivity pruning score computed as a second-order approximation of the reconstruction error on training views with respect to each Gaussian's spatial parameters, together with a multi-round prune-refine pipeline applicable to any pretrained 3D-GS model without changing its training pipeline. It preserves fidelity and foreground detail at substantially higher compression ratios than prior methods.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 将剪枝重要性度量建立在重建误差的二阶近似上，替代启发式规则，方法原理清晰且即插即用，对3D场景表示压缩与部署有实用意义。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出基于二阶重建误差近似的3D-GS敏感度剪枝分数与多轮prune-refine压缩流程。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 用重建误差对高斯空间参数的二阶近似作为有原则的剪枝重要性度量。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在显著高于现有方法的压缩比下仍保持视觉保真度与前景细节。

2511.05832|v2.summary_cn: 全局自注意力在计算和内存上的二次复杂度严重限制了其在高分辨率图像上的应用，而现有局部注意力虽降低了复杂度，却因窗口内 token 在 1D 序列中不连续，难以利用块稀疏核获得实际加速。本文提出基于 Hilbert 曲线的窗口与邻域构建方法：先沿 Hilbert 曲线重排图像 token，再在重排后的 1D 序列上形成窗口与邻域，从而显著提升块稀疏性，并可结合现有块稀疏核加速 2D 局部注意力。实验表明，Hilbert Window Attention 与 Hilbert Slide Attention 分别将窗口注意力和滑窗注意力加速约 4 倍和 18 倍，并实例化为 Hilbert Window Transformer 与 Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer，取得端到端效果。
2511.05832|v2.summary_en: Global self-attention's quadratic compute and memory costs limit its use on high-resolution images, while conventional local attention patterns fail to yield significant speedups because tokens within a window are not contiguous in the 1D sequence. This work proposes constructing windows and neighborhoods along a Hilbert curve: image tokens are reordered by the Hilbert curve and windows/neighborhoods are formed on the reordered 1D sequence, substantially increasing block sparsity and enabling combination with existing block-sparse kernels. Experiments show about 4x and 18x acceleration for window and slide attention respectively, instantiated as the Hilbert Window Transformer and Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer.
2511.05832|v2.assessment: 该工作从块稀疏角度重新审视局部注意力的效率瓶颈，Hilbert 曲线重排的思路简洁且与现有稀疏核兼容，对高分辨率视觉 Transformer 的实用加速有参考价值，但整体偏通用视觉骨干改进，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2511.05832|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Hilbert 曲线重排 token 的窗口与邻域构建策略，显著提升局部注意力的块稀疏性并实现大幅加速。
2511.05832|v2.innovation: 利用 Hilbert 曲线的空间局部性保持特性，将 2D 局部注意力转化为 1D 序列上高块稀疏度的注意力模式。
2511.05832|v2.result: 窗口注意力与滑窗注意力分别加速约 4 倍和 18 倍，并成功实例化为两种端到端 Transformer 架构。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: 多视角3D点云配准通常采用两阶段流程：先做成对初始对齐，再做全局一致性优化，但相邻点云重叠度低、场景对称和重复结构会导致初始对齐歧义。本文提出首个端到端可学习的多视角配准算法，将两阶段联合学习，利用多扫描间的循环一致性来消解歧义。在标准基准上显著超越当时SOTA，且端到端可训练、计算开销更低，并给出消融验证各新组件。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: Multiview 3D point cloud registration is typically solved in two stages: pairwise initial alignment followed by globally consistent refinement, where the former is ambiguous due to low overlap, symmetries, and repetitive structures. This paper proposes the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly learns both stages, exploiting cyclic consistency across scans to resolve ambiguity. It outperforms the state of the art by a significant margin on standard benchmarks while being end-to-end trainable and computationally cheaper, with ablations validating each component.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 把多视角配准的两阶段流程统一为端到端可学习框架，思路清晰且工程价值高，对多传感器/多帧融合感知有借鉴意义。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端联合学习成对对齐与全局一致性优化的多视角3D点云配准算法。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 用可微的全局循环一致性约束把两阶段配准耦合进单一网络联合训练。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在标准基准上大幅超越SOTA，同时计算开销更低并开源代码与预训练模型。

End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_cn: 该论文关注3D点云的局部多视角描述子学习问题，目标是让描述子对视角变化和点云局部结构更具判别力。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体网络设计与实验设置，但从标题看应提出端到端学习局部多视角描述子的方法。其潜在改进在于相比单视角或手工描述子提升匹配/配准鲁棒性。具体效果数据无法从现有信息核实。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_en: This work targets local multi-view descriptor learning for 3D point clouds, aiming at view-robust and locally discriminative representations. As the abstract is unavailable, the exact architecture and experimental protocol cannot be verified, but the title indicates an end-to-end approach to learning local multi-view descriptors. The claimed benefit is improved matching/registration robustness over single-view or hand-crafted descriptors, though quantitative results cannot be confirmed.
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.assessment: 主题与3D点云配准/匹配相关，但缺少摘要信息，难以判断方法质量与实际增益，需查阅全文后再评估。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.contribution: 提出面向3D点云的端到端局部多视角描述子学习方法。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.innovation: 将局部描述子学习扩展到多视角设定以增强视角鲁棒性。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.result: 摘要缺失，具体性能提升无法核实。

Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_cn: 论文研究多视角物体识别，试图利用视角之间的线索进行自监督与正则化学习，以减少对大量标注数据的依赖。由于摘要缺失，具体方法（如跨视角一致性约束、正则化项设计）与实验细节无法确认。其思路与自监督/对比学习中的多视角一致性范式一致，潜在改进在于提升视角变化下的识别鲁棒性。具体效果数据无法从现有信息核实。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This paper studies multiview object recognition and exploits cross-view clues for self-supervised and regularized learning to reduce reliance on labeled data. As the abstract is unavailable, the exact formulation (e.g., cross-view consistency or regularization terms) and experiments cannot be verified. The idea aligns with multi-view consistency paradigms in self-supervised/contrastive learning, with the potential benefit of improved robustness under viewpoint change; quantitative results cannot be confirmed.
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.assessment: 自监督+多视角一致性的思路与当前视觉表征学习趋势一致，但信息不足，需看全文判断创新度。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.contribution: 提出利用视角线索进行自监督与正则化的多视角物体识别方法。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.innovation: 将跨视角线索同时用于自监督预训练与识别正则化。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.result: 摘要缺失，具体识别精度提升无法核实。

GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_cn: 论文提出GeoGraph，一个基于图结构、端到端利用几何线索的多视角物体检测框架，目标是在多相机/多视角设定下提升检测一致性。由于摘要缺失，图节点/边定义、几何线索注入方式与端到端训练细节无法确认。其潜在改进在于显式建模视角间几何关系而非简单特征拼接。具体效果数据无法从现有信息核实。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_en: This paper proposes GeoGraph, a graph-based framework for multi-view object detection that end-to-end exploits geometric cues. As the abstract is unavailable, the graph construction, geometric cue injection, and end-to-end training details cannot be verified. The potential improvement lies in explicitly modeling inter-view geometric relations rather than naive feature concatenation; quantitative results cannot be confirmed.
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.assessment: 多视角+几何图建模与多相机BEV感知思路相近，若几何线索利用得当对自动驾驶多相机检测有参考价值。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.contribution: 提出端到端利用几何线索的图结构多视角物体检测框架GeoGraph。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.innovation: 用图网络显式建模视角间几何关系以融合多视角信息。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.result: 摘要缺失，具体检测性能提升无法核实。

Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_cn: 论文研究多视角动作识别，提出通过跨视角视频预测来学习视角间对应关系，从而提升动作识别性能。由于摘要缺失，预测目标设计、跨视角对齐方式与实验设置无法确认。其思路属于自监督视频预测与多视角表征学习的结合，潜在改进在于利用视角间的时空一致性。具体效果数据无法从现有信息核实。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view action recognition by learning cross-view video prediction to capture inter-view correspondences. As the abstract is unavailable, the prediction objective, cross-view alignment, and experimental setup cannot be verified. The approach combines self-supervised video prediction with multi-view representation learning, potentially improving recognition via spatio-temporal cross-view consistency; quantitative results cannot be confirmed.
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.assessment: 跨视角视频预测用于动作识别，与视频理解/自监督方向相关，但缺少细节，需全文评估其实际贡献。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.contribution: 提出基于跨视角视频预测的多视角动作识别方法。

Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_cn: 论文研究图数据的多视角表示学习，提出对比式多视角框架，通过构造图的不同视角（如节点特征与拓扑结构、不同子图采样）并最大化视角间互信息来学习节点/图表示。由于摘要缺失，具体视角构造与对比目标设计无法确认，但该工作是把对比多视角学习从图像推广到图结构数据的重要代表。其潜在改进在于无需标签即可获得可迁移的图表示。具体效果数据无法从现有信息核实。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_en: This paper studies multi-view representation learning on graphs and proposes a contrastive framework that constructs multiple views of a graph (e.g., node features vs. topology, or different subgraph samplings) and maximizes mutual information across views. As the abstract is unavailable, the exact view construction and contrastive objective cannot be verified, but the work is a representative extension of contrastive multi-view learning from images to graph-structured data, potentially yielding transferable label-free graph representations; quantitative results cannot be confirmed.
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.assessment: 对比多视角学习在图上的经典工作，方法范式对多模态/多视角自监督表征有迁移价值，值得关注。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.contribution: 提出面向图数据的对比式多视角表示学习框架。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.innovation: 将图像领域的对比多视角互信息最大化范式系统迁移到图结构数据。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.result: 摘要缺失，具体下游任务性能提升无法核实。
