Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中因物体遮挡导致的深度估计误差问题，提出用混合指数分布（MED）概率体积来建模深度分布，从而在训练中显式处理遮挡区域的不确定性。方法在自监督框架下用概率体积替代传统的点估计或简单分布假设，使网络能更好地推断被遮挡像素的深度。相比已有自监督深度估计方法，其改进点在于对遮挡的鲁棒性建模，而非依赖LiDAR真值。摘要中未给出具体量化结果，但声称在标准基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses depth estimation errors caused by occlusions in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing Mixture of Exponential Distributions (MED) probability volumes to model depth distributions. The method explicitly handles uncertainty in occluded regions within a self-supervised framework, replacing point estimates or simple distribution assumptions. Compared to existing self-supervised depth estimators, it improves robustness to occlusions without relying on LiDAR ground truth, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该工作将概率建模引入自监督深度估计以处理遮挡，思路有一定新意，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，且与自动驾驶中多相机/3D检测的直接关联有限。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出用混合指数分布概率体积建模自监督单目深度估计中的遮挡不确定性。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 将MED概率体积引入自监督深度估计框架以显式处理遮挡区域。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称在标准基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角多人物3D姿态估计问题，提出基于平面扫描立体（plane sweep stereo）的方法。通过在多视角间构建平面扫描代价体来聚合跨视角信息，从而在3D空间中定位多人关节。相比已有方法，该方法更好地处理了遮挡和跨视角对应问题。在多个基准数据集上取得了有竞争力的3D姿态估计精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by leveraging plane sweep stereo to aggregate cross-view information. It constructs plane sweep cost volumes across views to localize joints in 3D space, better handling occlusion and cross-view correspondence than prior work. Competitive accuracy is reported on standard benchmarks.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 多视角3D姿态估计与自动驾驶中多相机感知有一定关联，但应用场景偏人体姿态，对BEV/3D检测的直接参考价值有限。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角多人3D姿态估计框架。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 将平面扫描立体引入多视角人体3D姿态估计以聚合跨视角信息。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.result: 在多个基准上取得有竞争力的3D姿态估计精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati._arxiv_id: Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With Plane Sweep Stereo.

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: 该论文研究跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数问题，即在一个场景训练、在未见场景测试。提出跨视角跨场景的计数框架以提升泛化能力。相比已有单场景方法，该方法在跨场景设定下显著降低误差。实验表明其在多个跨场景基准上优于现有方法。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This paper studies cross-view cross-scene multi-view crowd counting, where models trained on one scene are tested on unseen scenes. It proposes a framework to improve generalization across views and scenes. Experiments show clear error reduction over prior methods on cross-scene benchmarks.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 人群计数与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，但其跨场景泛化思路对多相机感知的域适应有间接启发。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数框架。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 面向未见场景的跨视角泛化计数设定与方法。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.result: 在跨场景基准上优于现有方法。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角聚类问题，提出COMPLETER框架，通过对比预测恢复缺失视角信息。方法利用对比学习在视角间进行预测与对齐，从而在不完整数据下获得一致的聚类表示。相比已有方法，其在多个不完整多视角数据集上取得更优聚类性能。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper tackles incomplete multi-view clustering with COMPLETER, a contrastive prediction framework that recovers missing views. It aligns and predicts across views via contrastive learning to obtain consistent representations under incompleteness. It outperforms prior methods on several incomplete multi-view datasets.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 属于多视角聚类方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知关联较弱，但对比预测思路对多模态/多视角表示学习有参考意义。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出基于对比预测的不完整多视角聚类框架COMPLETER。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 用对比预测恢复缺失视角以实现一致聚类。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.result: 在不完整多视角数据集上取得更优聚类性能。

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: 该论文研究未知通用反射率下无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建问题。提出方法在未知反射率条件下恢复光滑表面几何。相比已有依赖已知反射率或纹理的方法，其适用性更广。实验在合成与真实数据上验证了重建精度。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown generic reflectance. It proposes a method to recover geometry without assuming known reflectance or texture. Experiments on synthetic and real data demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy over prior approaches.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 属于多视角几何重建方向，与自动驾驶3D感知关联有限，但对无纹理表面重建有方法参考价值。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出未知反射率下无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 在未知通用反射率条件下联合恢复表面几何。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.result: 在合成与真实数据上验证了重建精度。

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频流上的在线多视角深度预测问题，提出DeepVideoMVS。方法在轻量编码器-解码器基础上，于瓶颈层引入ConvLSTM，并利用上一时刻深度将隐藏状态warp到当前相机平面以传播时空信息。相比已有MVS方法，其仅增加少量计算与内存开销，却在数百个室内场景的大多数指标上超越SOTA并保持实时性。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DeepVideoMVS for online multi-view depth prediction on posed video streams. It places a ConvLSTM at the bottleneck of a lightweight encoder-decoder and warps the previous hidden state into the current camera plane using the previous depth prediction to propagate spatio-temporal information. It outperforms state-of-the-art MVS methods on most metrics across hundreds of indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance with minimal overhead.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 面向视频的多视角深度估计与自动驾驶多相机/3D感知高度相关，其时空状态传播与warp机制对BEV/时序融合有直接借鉴价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出基于循环时空融合的在线视频多视角深度预测方法DeepVideoMVS。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 用上一时刻深度将ConvLSTM隐藏状态warp到当前相机平面以传播时空信息。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在数百个室内场景大多数指标上超越SOTA并保持实时性。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无监督非刚性表面配准问题，提出循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net。方法用逐点刚性变换组合表示非刚性变换以约束解空间，并引入基于多视角2D深度图投影的可微损失实现无真值端到端训练。相比已有方法，其在多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration with a Recurrent Multi-View Alignment Network (RMA-Net). It represents non-rigid transformations as point-wise combinations of rigid transformations to constrain the solution space, and introduces a differentiable loss on projected multi-view 2D depth images for end-to-end training without ground-truth supervision. It outperforms prior state-of-the-art by a large margin on several datasets.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 属于非刚性配准方向，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，但其多视角可微投影损失对自监督3D学习有方法启发。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出无监督非刚性表面配准的循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 用逐点刚性变换组合表示非刚性变换并结合多视角深度投影可微损失。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越此前SOTA。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图稠密深度估计中稀疏点扩散到深度图质量差的问题，提出可微扩散（differentiable diffusion）方法，将点建模为带解析透射率的高斯并通过可微splatting同时优化点位置、深度和权重，使扩散后的深度图最小化多视图重投影误差。开发了可同时优化5万+点的高效优化流程，在真值数据上验证了高重建质量，并在光场与宽基线图像上通过自监督训练，相比从稀疏点扩散的基线在平均误差和离群误差上均有改善。与图像处理和深度学习方法进行了定性与定量比较。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by optimizing a sparse set of points whose diffusion into a depth map minimizes multi-view reprojection error under RGB supervision. It optimizes point positions, depths, and weights via differentiable splatting that models points as Gaussians with analytic transmittance, with an efficient routine handling 50k+ points. Experiments on ground-truth data and self-supervised light-field/wide-baseline images show improved average and outlier depth errors over diffusing inaccurate sparse points, with comparisons to image processing and deep learning baselines.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 将经典稀疏点扩散与可微优化结合，思路新颖，但更偏重建/渲染而非自动驾驶感知核心任务，相关度中等。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架，通过可微splatting联合优化稀疏点的位置、深度与权重以生成高质量稠密深度图。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 用带解析透射率的高斯建模点并实现可同时优化5万+点的高效可微扩散优化流程。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在真值数据上取得高重建质量，自监督下相比稀疏点扩散基线在平均与离群误差上均有改善。

Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_cn: 该论文提出极线时空网络（Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks）用于多视图深度估计，针对多视图立体中跨视图匹配与时间信息利用的问题。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其核心是利用极线几何约束结合时空特征进行深度推断。改进点与效果需查阅原文确认。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.summary_en: This paper proposes Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks for multi-view depth estimation, targeting cross-view matching and temporal information exploitation in multi-view stereo. As the abstract is missing, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be confirmed; the title suggests epipolar geometry constraints combined with spatio-temporal features for depth inference.
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.assessment: 标题指向多视图深度估计的时空建模，与自动驾驶多相机感知有一定关联，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.contribution: 提出结合极线几何与时空信息的网络用于多视图深度估计。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.innovation: 将极线约束与时空特征融合用于多视图深度推断。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipol._arxiv_id: Multi-view Depth Estimation using Epipolar Spatio-Temporal Networks.

2103.07738|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度多视图聚类中朴素对齐视图表示分布带来的问题，指出其导致表示空间聚类可分性下降并抑制模型对视图的优先级排序能力。提出一个避免表示对齐的简单基线模型，性能与当前SOTA相当或更优；进一步加入对比学习组件实现选择性对齐，保留视图优先级能力。实验表明对比学习组件显著提升基线，在多个数据集上大幅超越当前SOTA。
2103.07738|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies drawbacks of naively aligning view representation distributions in deep multi-view clustering, showing it reduces cluster separability and inhibits view prioritization. It proposes a simple baseline that avoids representation alignment altogether, matching or surpassing state of the art, and augments it with a contrastive learning component that performs selective alignment while preserving view prioritization. Experiments show the contrastive component substantially improves the baseline, surpassing the state of the art by a large margin on several datasets.
2103.07738|v2.assessment: 属于多视图聚类而非自动驾驶感知，与用户研究领域相关度低，但方法分析扎实。
2103.07738|v2.contribution: 揭示表示对齐在多视图聚类中的缺陷，并提出避免对齐的基线及选择性对齐的对比学习扩展。
2103.07738|v2.innovation: 用对比学习实现选择性对齐，在提升聚类的同时保留模型对视图的优先级排序能力。
2103.07738|v2.result: 基线模型与SOTA相当或更优，加入对比学习后在多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA。

2012.01411|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率多视图立体中3D代价体正则化方法计算与内存开销大的问题，提出PatchmatchNet，一种可学习的级联Patchmatch公式。首次在端到端可训练架构中引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch，并用可学习的自适应传播与评估方案改进Patchmatch核心算法。在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上取得极具竞争力的性能与泛化能力，且效率显著更高：比现有最优方法至少快2.5倍，内存占用减半。
2012.01411|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computation and memory cost of 3D cost volume regularization in high-resolution multi-view stereo by proposing PatchmatchNet, a learnable cascade formulation of Patchmatch. It introduces, for the first time, an iterative multi-scale Patchmatch in an end-to-end trainable architecture and improves the Patchmatch core with a learned adaptive propagation and evaluation scheme per iteration. Experiments on DTU, Tanks & Temples, and ETH3D show competitive performance and generalization while being at least 2.5x faster with half the memory of state-of-the-art methods.
2012.01411|v2.assessment: 将经典Patchmatch与可学习级联结合，效率优势明显，对多视图深度/3D感知有实用价值。
2012.01411|v2.contribution: 提出可学习的级联Patchmatch网络，在端到端架构中实现迭代多尺度Patchmatch用于高分辨率多视图立体。
2012.01411|v2.innovation: 首次在端到端可训练架构中引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch，并设计可学习的自适应传播与评估方案。
2012.01411|v2.result: 在DTU、Tanks & Temples、ETH3D上性能有竞争力，比SOTA至少快2.5倍且内存减半。

2102.13090|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂场景新视图合成问题，提出IBRNet，通过插值稀疏邻近视图合成新视图。核心是一个包含MLP和ray transformer的网络架构，在连续5D位置（3D空间位置+2D视角方向）估计辐射与体密度，并实时从多个源视图提取外观信息。与逐场景优化的神经场景表示不同，该方法学习通用的视图插值函数，可泛化到新场景，仅用多视图位姿图像监督训练。实验表明其优于近期同样追求泛化的新视图合成方法，逐场景微调后可与SOTA单场景神经渲染方法竞争。
2102.13090|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses novel view synthesis of complex scenes by interpolating a sparse set of nearby views. IBRNet uses an MLP and ray transformer to estimate radiance and volume density at continuous 5D locations, drawing appearance from multiple source views on the fly, and learns a generic view interpolation function that generalizes to novel scenes using only multi-view posed images as supervision. Experiments show it outperforms recent generalizable novel view synthesis methods and, when fine-tuned per scene, is competitive with state-of-the-art single-scene neural rendering.
2102.13090|v2.assessment: 通用化神经渲染的代表工作，ray transformer设计有启发性，对多视图感知与BEV/NeRF方向有参考价值。
2102.13090|v2.contribution: 提出IBRNet，学习可泛化到新场景的通用视图插值函数，实现稀疏视图的高分辨率新视图合成。
2102.13090|v2.innovation: 用MLP加ray transformer在连续5D位置估计辐射与密度，并实时从多源视图提取外观信息。
2102.13090|v2.result: 优于近期泛化型新视图合成方法，逐场景微调后可与SOTA单场景神经渲染竞争。

Self-Supervised Learning of Depth Infere.summary_en: This paper studies self-supervised learning of depth inference for multi-view stereo, targeting depth network training without ground-truth depth. As the abstract is missing, the specific method, improvements, and experimental results cannot be confirmed; the title suggests a self-supervised learning paradigm for MVS depth inference.

2106.06856|v2.summary_cn: 多相机多目标跟踪（MC-MOT）中的数据关联问题在光照不一致、运动模式变化和跨相机轨迹遮挡等实际条件下仍极具挑战。本文提出动态图模型 DyGLIP，将轨迹与检测构建为图节点，通过链接预测进行跨相机数据关联，并能在相机切换时恢复丢失轨迹。相比已有方法，DyGLIP 提供更好的特征表示且不依赖相机重叠比例，在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有 MC-MOT 算法，并支持在线与增量式设置。
2106.06856|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-camera multi-object tracking (MC-MOT), which remains challenging under inconsistent lighting, varying motion patterns, and cross-camera occlusions. It proposes DyGLIP, a dynamic graph model with link prediction that performs association over graph-structured tracklets and detections, and can recover lost tracks during camera transitions. The model achieves better feature representations and works regardless of camera overlap ratios, outperforming existing MC-MOT algorithms by a large margin on several practical datasets while supporting online and incremental settings.
2106.06856|v2.assessment: 将图链接预测引入多相机跟踪的数据关联，思路清晰且对在线/增量场景友好，对多相机感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2106.06856|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态图与链接预测的多相机多目标跟踪数据关联框架 DyGLIP。
2106.06856|v2.innovation: 用图链接预测统一建模跨相机轨迹关联，并显式支持相机切换时的轨迹恢复。
2106.06856|v2.result: 在多个实际 MC-MOT 数据集上大幅优于现有算法，且不依赖相机重叠比例。

2104.08568|v2.summary_cn: 大范围宽基线场景（如工地、体育场、公共空间）中相机网络的三维位姿估计困难，因为跨视角同一三维关键点难以检测与匹配，标准 SfM 流程失效。本文提出利用行人作为“关键点”，先用 person re-ID 方法跨相机关联人体检测框，再将框对应关系转换为点对应关系，最后通过多视图几何与 bundle adjustment 求解相机位姿。该方法无需专用标定物，仅依赖可见行人，适用于需要频繁重新标定的场景，并在多个不同场景数据集上进行了大量实验。
2104.08568|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles wide-baseline multi-camera pose estimation in large environments where standard structure-from-motion fails due to the difficulty of matching 3D keypoints across very different views. It proposes using people as keypoints: a person re-identification method associates human bounding boxes across cameras, these correspondences are converted into point correspondences, and camera poses are solved via multi-view geometry and bundle adjustment. Requiring no specialized calibration targets beyond visible people, the method suits scenarios needing frequent recalibration and is extensively evaluated on datasets from diverse scenes.
2104.08568|v2.assessment: 把 re-ID 用于宽基线相机标定是一个实用且新颖的交叉思路，对多相机系统部署与维护有实际意义。
2104.08568|v2.contribution: 提出利用行人 re-ID 对应关系进行宽基线多相机标定的方法。
2104.08568|v2.innovation: 将 person re-ID 的检测框关联转化为点对应，从而在无标定物条件下求解相机位姿。
2104.08568|v2.result: 在多个不同场景的采集数据集上验证了方法的有效性，无需专用标定目标。

2101.01602|v2.summary_cn: 神经辐射场类方法能将多视角场景压缩为可渲染的隐式表示，但一旦场景中物体运动就完全失效。本文提出 STaR，在多视角 RGB 视频上以自监督方式同时进行动态场景的跟踪与重建：将场景分解为静态背景与单个刚体运动物体两个神经辐射场，并联合优化两个场参数与逐帧对齐的刚体位姿。在合成与真实数据集上，该方法无需任何人工标注即可渲染出时空维度上均具新视角的逼真图像。
2101.01602|v2.summary_en: Neural radiance field methods compress multi-view scenes into renderable implicit representations but fail once objects move. This paper presents STaR, a self-supervised method that jointly tracks and reconstructs dynamic scenes with rigid motion from multi-view RGB videos by decomposing the scene into two neural radiance fields (static background and a single moving rigid object) and jointly optimizing both fields and per-frame rigid poses. On synthetic and real datasets, it renders photorealistic novel views in both spatial and temporal dimensions without any manual annotation.
2101.01602|v2.assessment: 将刚体运动建模与神经辐射场结合，是动态场景自监督重建方向的重要一步，对视频理解与自监督视觉研究者有启发。
2101.01602|v2.contribution: 提出自监督联合跟踪与重建刚体运动物体的神经渲染方法 STaR。
2101.01602|v2.innovation: 用两个神经辐射场加刚体位姿联合优化，实现无标注的动态场景分解与重建。
2101.01602|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上实现时空新视角的逼真渲染，无需人工标注。

2110.04361|v2.summary_cn: 自监督学习在图像、音频、文本上成效显著，主要依赖数据中的空间、时间或语义结构进行增强，但表格数据通常缺乏此类结构，难以设计有效增强，阻碍了表格场景下的自监督进展。本文提出 SubTab 框架，将表格输入特征划分为多个子集，把表格学习转化为多视图表示学习问题，并主张在自编码器设定下从特征子集重建数据比从损坏版本重建更能捕获潜在表示。测试时通过聚合各子集隐变量的协同推理得到联合表示，实验表明 SubTab 达到当时最优水平。
2110.04361|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised learning has been highly effective on images, audio, and text by exploiting spatial, temporal, or semantic structure for augmentation, but tabular data often lacks such structure, hindering similar progress. This paper introduces SubTab, which turns tabular learning into a multi-view representation learning problem by dividing input features into multiple subsets, arguing that reconstructing data from feature subsets rather than corrupted versions better captures the underlying latent representation. At test time, a collaborative inference aggregates subset latent variables, and experiments show SubTab achieves state-of-the-art results.
2110.04361|v2.assessment: 将多视图自监督思想迁移到表格数据，方法简洁有效，但与自动驾驶/视觉感知领域关联很弱。
2110.04361|v2.contribution: 提出面向表格数据的多视图自监督表示学习框架 SubTab。
2110.04361|v2.innovation: 通过特征子集划分与子集重建构建多视图，并引入协同推理聚合子集表示。
2110.04361|v2.result: 在表格数据自监督基准上达到当时最优性能。

2203.14712|v2.summary_cn: 针对程序性活动理解缺乏大规模多视角数据的问题，论文构建了Assembly101数据集，包含4321段拆装101种玩具车的视频，同时采集8路静态视角与4路第一视角，并标注超10万段粗粒度、100万段细粒度动作片段及1800万个3D手部姿态。论文在动作识别、预测、时序分割三个任务上建立基准，并提出错误检测这一新任务。该数据集支持对新玩具泛化、跨视角迁移、长尾分布及姿态与外观对比等研究，为活动理解提供了新的挑战性平台。
2203.14712|v2.summary_en: Assembly101 is a large-scale multi-view procedural activity dataset comprising 4321 videos of assembling and disassembling 101 take-apart toy vehicles, with 8 static and 4 egocentric views, over 100K coarse and 1M fine-grained action segments, and 18M 3D hand poses. It benchmarks recognition, anticipation, and temporal segmentation, and introduces a novel mistake detection task. The dataset enables studies on generalization to new toys, cross-view transfer, long-tailed distributions, and pose vs. appearance.
2203.14712|v2.assessment: 该数据集规模大、标注丰富且多视角同步，为程序性活动理解提供了重要基准，对视频理解与多模态感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2203.14712|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模多视角程序性活动数据集Assembly101，并定义了错误检测新任务。
2203.14712|v2.innovation: 同时采集静态与第一视角、提供百万级细粒度动作标注和千万级3D手部姿态，支持多维度泛化研究。
2203.14712|v2.result: 在识别、预测、时序分割及错误检测任务上建立了基准，展示了跨视角与长尾分布等挑战。

SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_en: SpatialDETR addresses multi-view camera-based 3D object detection by proposing a transformer-based method with global cross-sensor attention. It fuses multi-view features in a scalable manner for robust 3D detection. While quantitative results are not available in the abstract, the approach emphasizes global attention and cross-sensor fusion to improve accuracy and generalization.
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.assessment: 该工作将Transformer与全局跨传感器注意力引入多视角3D检测，思路新颖，对自动驾驶感知研究者有较高参考价值。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.contribution: 提出了基于全局跨传感器注意力的可扩展Transformer多视角3D检测框架SpatialDETR。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.innovation: 利用全局跨传感器注意力在BEV空间融合多视角特征，增强3D检测的鲁棒性与可扩展性。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在架构上旨在提升多视角3D检测性能。

2203.16317|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签和一致性训练忽略检测特性导致无标签数据学习效率低的问题，论文提出PseCo。对于伪标签，现有方法仅关注分类分数而忽略定位精度，PseCo设计噪声伪框学习（NPL），包括预测引导标签分配（PLA）和正样本一致性投票（PCV），使模型对粗糙伪框鲁棒并利用回归一致性反映定位质量。对于一致性训练，提出多视角尺度不变学习（MSL），在特征级和标签级同时保证尺度不变性。该方法在SSOD基准上取得了显著提升。
2203.16317|v2.summary_en: PseCo tackles semi-supervised object detection by improving pseudo labeling and consistency training. It introduces Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL) with Prediction-guided Label Assignment (PLA) and Positive-proposal Consistency Voting (PCV) to handle coarse pseudo boxes, and Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL) for feature-level and label-level consistency. The method achieves significant improvements on SSOD benchmarks.
2203.16317|v2.assessment: 该工作深入分析了SSOD中伪标签与一致性训练的关键缺陷，提出的NPL和MSL模块针对性强，实验充分，对半监督检测研究者有重要参考价值。
2203.16317|v2.contribution: 提出了PseCo框架，通过NPL和MSL解决半监督目标检测中伪标签噪声和尺度不变性问题。
2203.16317|v2.innovation: 结合预测引导标签分配与正样本一致性投票提升伪框质量，并引入多视角尺度不变学习实现特征级一致性。
2203.16317|v2.result: 在SSOD基准上取得了显著性能提升，具体数值未在摘要中给出。

2203.05625|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D目标检测中如何将3D位置信息有效融入图像特征的问题，论文提出位置嵌入变换（PETR）。PETR将3D坐标的位置信息编码到图像特征中，生成3D位置感知特征，使目标查询能够感知3D位置并执行端到端检测。在nuScenes数据集上，PETR取得了50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP的最优性能，并在基准测试中排名第一。该方法简单而强大，可作为未来研究的基线。
2203.05625|v2.summary_en: PETR addresses multi-view 3D object detection by encoding 3D position information into image features via position embedding transformation, producing 3D position-aware features for end-to-end detection. It achieves state-of-the-art 50.4% NDS and 44.1% mAP on nuScenes, ranking first on the benchmark. The method is simple yet strong, serving as a baseline for future research.
2203.05625|v2.assessment: PETR以简洁有效的位置嵌入变换实现了多视角3D检测的SOTA，对自动驾驶感知领域具有重要影响，值得深入关注。
2203.05625|v2.contribution: 提出了位置嵌入变换（PETR），将3D坐标编码到图像特征中实现端到端多视角3D检测。
2203.05625|v2.innovation: 通过3D位置感知特征使目标查询直接感知3D位置，无需复杂后处理。
2203.05625|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP，排名第一。

2203.03949|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督多视图立体（MVS）中非朗伯表面和遮挡导致跨视图对应关系模糊的问题，本文提出 RC-MVSNet，通过神经渲染引入深度渲染一致性损失约束物体表面附近的几何特征以缓解遮挡，并引入参考视图合成损失为非朗伯表面生成一致监督。相比已有无监督 MVS 方法，该方法在 DTU 和 Tanks&Temples 基准上达到无监督框架的 SOTA，并与许多监督方法性能相当。
2203.03949|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the correspondence ambiguity in unsupervised multi-view stereo caused by non-Lambertian surfaces and occlusions. It proposes RC-MVSNet, which imposes a depth rendering consistency loss to constrain geometry features near object surfaces and a reference view synthesis loss to provide consistent supervision for non-Lambertian surfaces. Experiments on DTU and Tanks&Temples show state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised MVS frameworks and competitive results against many supervised methods.
2203.03949|v2.assessment: 将神经渲染引入无监督 MVS 以解决遮挡与非朗伯表面的对应歧义，思路新颖且实验充分，对多视图几何感知有参考价值。
2203.03949|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经渲染的无监督多视图立体框架 RC-MVSNet，用深度渲染一致性与参考视图合成损失解决跨视图对应歧义。
2203.03949|v2.innovation: 将神经渲染的深度渲染一致性损失与参考视图合成损失结合，用于缓解遮挡和非朗伯表面带来的监督不一致。
2203.03949|v2.result: 在 DTU 和 Tanks&Temples 上达到无监督 MVS 的 SOTA，并与多种监督方法性能相当。

2207.14287|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有几何推理架构依赖任务特定设计、域泛化差的问题，本文提出 Depth Field Networks（DeFiNe），学习隐式的多视图一致场景表示，并引入一系列三维数据增强作为几何归纳先验以增加视图多样性，同时将视图合成作为辅助任务提升深度估计。该方法无需显式几何约束，在立体和视频深度估计上达到 SOTA，并大幅提升零样本域泛化能力。
2207.14287|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor domain generalization of task-specific geometric reasoning architectures by proposing Depth Field Networks (DeFiNe), which learn an implicit multi-view consistent scene representation. It introduces 3D data augmentation as a geometric inductive prior and uses view synthesis as an auxiliary task to improve depth estimation. Without explicit geometric constraints, DeFiNe achieves state-of-the-art stereo and video depth estimation and substantially improves zero-shot domain generalization.
2207.14287|v2.assessment: 以隐式多视图一致表示替代显式几何约束，并用数据增强与视图合成辅助，思路清晰且泛化提升显著，值得关注。
2207.14287|v2.contribution: 提出 Depth Field Networks，学习隐式多视图一致场景表示，无需显式几何约束即可完成深度估计。
2207.14287|v2.innovation: 用三维数据增强作为几何归纳先验，并将视图合成作为辅助任务提升深度估计与域泛化。
2207.14287|v2.result: 在立体和视频深度估计上达到 SOTA，零样本域泛化能力大幅提升。

2207.14067|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角图像中头发几何与外观难以联合建模的问题，提出了Neural Strands框架。方法上，它用神经头皮纹理在每texel位置编码单根发丝的几何与外观，并设计了基于发丝光栅化的神经渲染框架，实现发丝级精确且抗锯齿的渲染。相比体素化方法，该工作首次从多视角输入中联合学习外观与显式头发几何，并支持实时渲染与直观的形状/风格控制。实验在多种发型上验证了其保真度与效率优势。
2207.14067|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the joint modeling of hair geometry and appearance from multi-view images. It proposes Neural Strands, a neural scalp texture representation encoding per-strand geometry and appearance, together with a strand-accurate anti-aliased neural rasterization renderer. It is the first to jointly learn appearance and explicit hair geometry from multi-view setups, enabling real-time view-dependent rendering and intuitive style control with high fidelity across various hairstyles.
2207.14067|v2.assessment: 将显式发丝表示与神经渲染结合，在实时性与可控性上优于体素方案，对神经渲染与数字人方向有参考价值。
2207.14067|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经头皮纹理的显式发丝表示与发丝级神经光栅化渲染框架。
2207.14067|v2.innovation: 首次从多视角输入联合学习外观与显式头发几何，并支持实时、可编辑渲染。
2207.14067|v2.result: 在多种发型上实现高保真、视角一致且实时的渲染，并具备直观的形状与风格控制。

2208.08580|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对细粒度3D形状分割中标注稀缺的问题，提出将2D自监督技术迁移到3D分割任务。方法上，对3D形状多视角渲染，在对比学习框架内构建稠密对应学习任务，使学到的2D表示具备视角不变性与几何一致性。相比仅在2D或3D做自监督的方案，该方法在有限标注下泛化更好。在RenderPeople与PartNet上，其细粒度部件分割优于现有方法，且在稀疏视角或带纹理形状上提升更明显。
2208.08580|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles fine-grained 3D shape segmentation under limited labels by leveraging 2D self-supervision. It renders 3D shapes from multiple views and performs dense correspondence learning within a contrastive framework, yielding view-invariant and geometrically consistent 2D representations. It outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives on RenderPeople and PartNet, with larger gains under sparse views or textured shapes.
2208.08580|v2.assessment: 将多视角稠密对应自监督用于3D部件分割，思路清晰且实验对比充分，对自监督与3D理解交叉方向有借鉴意义。
2208.08580|v2.contribution: 提出MvDeCor，用多视角稠密对应对比学习提升细粒度3D形状分割。
2208.08580|v2.innovation: 在对比学习框架内构建跨视角稠密对应，兼顾2D语义与3D几何一致性。
2208.08580|v2.result: 在RenderPeople和PartNet上细粒度部件分割超越SOTA，稀疏视角与带纹理场景提升更大。

2203.11397|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角3D重建缺乏真实世界基准的问题，构建了一个包含998个桌面物体3D模型及847,000张真实RGB-D图像的数据集。方法上采用半自动化方式对每张图像的相机位姿与物体位姿进行精确标注，并提供标注工具与评测基线源码。相比合成数据集，该数据集填补了真实场景多视角3D重建基准的空白。数据集与工具已公开，可用于形状重建、物体位姿估计与形状检索等任务。
2203.11397|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real-world benchmarks for multi-view 3D reconstruction by introducing a dataset of 998 tabletop object 3D models with 847,000 real RGB-D images. Camera and object poses are annotated semi-automatically, and annotation tools plus evaluation baselines are released. It fills the gap of real-world multi-view reconstruction benchmarks, supporting shape reconstruction, object pose estimation, and shape retrieval.
2203.11397|v2.assessment: 数据集规模与标注质量对多视角重建和位姿估计研究有实用价值，但方法创新有限，属于资源型贡献。
2203.11397|v2.contribution: 发布含998个物体模型与84.7万张真实RGB-D图像的多视角3D重建数据集及工具。
2203.11397|v2.innovation: 以半自动流程提供精确相机与物体位姿标注，填补真实世界多视角重建基准空白。
2203.11397|v2.result: 提供可支撑形状重建、位姿估计与形状检索等任务的公开数据集与评测基线。

2204.07346|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角立体中2D语义与3D空间关联融合效率低的问题，提出MVSTER。方法上设计极线Transformer，利用可拆卸单目深度估计器增强2D语义，并通过cross-attention沿极线构建数据相关的3D关联；同时采用级联结构，用熵正则化最优传输在各阶段传播更精细的深度估计。相比MVSNet与CasMVSNet，在DTU基准上分别取得34%与14%的相对提升，且效率显著更高。
2204.07346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient fusion of 2D semantics and 3D spatial associations in multi-view stereo, proposing MVSTER. It introduces an epipolar Transformer that enhances 2D semantics via a detachable monocular depth estimator and builds data-dependent 3D associations along epipolar lines using cross-attention, combined with a cascade structure and entropy-regularized optimal transport for depth propagation. It achieves 34% and 14% relative improvements over MVSNet and CasMVSNet on DTU with significantly higher efficiency.
2204.07346|v2.assessment: 极线Transformer与最优传输级联设计兼顾精度与效率，对多视角几何与3D感知方向有较强参考价值。
2204.07346|v2.contribution: 提出MVSTER，用极线Transformer高效融合2D语义与3D空间关联。
2204.07346|v2.innovation: 以cross-attention沿极线构建数据相关3D关联，并用熵正则化最优传输做级联深度传播。
2204.07346|v2.result: 在DTU上较MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别提升34%和14%，同时效率显著更高。

Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角域适应问题，提出通过通道增强与知识迁移的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体技术细节与实验设置。从标题看，其核心在于处理部分视角缺失下的跨域特征对齐与知识迁移。整体信息不足，难以评估其改进幅度与实际效果。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_en: This paper targets incomplete multi-view domain adaptation via channel enhancement and knowledge transfer. Due to the missing abstract, the technical details and experimental setup cannot be verified. Based on the title, it focuses on cross-domain feature alignment and knowledge transfer under missing views, but its improvements and results remain unclear.
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.assessment: 摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度，仅从标题判断相关性有限，建议获取全文后再评估。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.contribution: 提出面向不完整多视角域适应的通道增强与知识迁移方法（细节待确认）。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.innovation: 可能在于结合通道增强与知识迁移处理视角缺失下的域适应（待确认）。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.result: 因摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果与数据。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation._arxiv_id: Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation via Channel Enhancement and Knowledge Transfer.

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统多视角光度立体分阶段处理导致误差累积的问题，提出基于隐式表示的神经逆渲染方法PS-NeRF。方法上先用多光照图像估计每视角表面法线以正则化NeRF法线，再基于阴影感知的可微渲染层联合优化表面法线、空间变化BRDF与光照。相比现有MVPS与神经渲染方法，其形状重建精度显著更高，并支持新视角渲染、重光照与材质编辑。实验在合成与真实数据集上验证了有效性。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses error accumulation in traditional multi-view photometric stereo caused by disjoint stages, proposing PS-NeRF, a neural inverse rendering method based on implicit representation. It estimates per-view normal maps from multi-light images to regularize NeRF normals, then jointly optimizes normals, spatially-varying BRDFs, and lights via a shadow-aware differentiable rendering layer. It achieves far more accurate shape reconstruction than existing MVPS and neural rendering methods, supporting novel-view rendering, relighting, and material editing.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 将神经逆渲染与多视角光度立体统一优化，在形状精度与材质/光照分解上表现突出，对逆渲染方向有较高参考价值。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出PS-NeRF，用隐式表示联合估计几何、材质与光照的多视角光度立体逆渲染方法。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 以多光照法线正则化NeRF并结合阴影感知可微渲染层联合优化法线、BRDF与光照。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上形状重建精度显著优于现有MVPS与神经渲染方法，并支持重光照与材质编辑。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: 该论文针对购物场景下多视角非模态（amodal）实例分割缺乏大规模基准的问题，构建了 MUVA 数据集。方法上提供了多视角图像与完整物体掩码标注，覆盖遮挡场景下的可见与不可见区域。相比已有 amodal 分割基准，MUVA 强调多相机、真实购物环境与遮挡关系。摘要未给出具体性能数据，主要贡献在于数据规模与任务设定。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale benchmarks for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping scenarios by introducing MUVA. It provides multi-camera images with amodal masks covering occluded regions. The main contribution is the dataset scale and task formulation rather than a novel algorithm, with no quantitative results reported in the abstract.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 对多相机感知与遮挡理解有参考价值，但与自动驾驶 3D 感知的直接关联有限。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 提出了面向购物场景的大规模多视角非模态实例分割基准 MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 将 amodal 分割扩展到多视角真实购物场景并强调遮挡关系。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，主要提供数据集与任务设定。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu._arxiv_id: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario.

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 V2V 协同感知中车辆传感器模态异构、难以统一协作的问题，提出 HM-ViT 框架。方法设计异构 3D 图 Transformer，联合推理 agent 间与 agent 内的交互，融合多视角图像与 LiDAR 点云。相比已有同构协同感知方法，HM-ViT 支持不同数量与类型 agent 的动态协作。在 OPV2V 数据集上优于 SOTA 异构模态协同感知方法。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles hetero-modal cooperative perception in V2V settings where agents carry different sensor modalities. It proposes HM-ViT, a unified framework with a heterogeneous 3D graph transformer that jointly reasons inter-agent and intra-agent interactions to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR. Experiments on OPV2V show it outperforms state-of-the-art cooperative perception methods.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 首次系统解决异构模态 V2V 协同感知，图 Transformer 设计对多模态融合有启发。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出首个统一的多智能体异构模态协同感知框架 HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 设计异构 3D 图 Transformer 联合建模 agent 间与 agent 内交互。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在 OPV2V 上超越现有 SOTA 异构模态协同感知方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对域偏移下目标检测性能下降的问题，指出现有域对抗学习忽略共同特征中的非因果因素。方法提出多视角对抗判别器 MAD，包含虚假相关生成器 SCG 与多视角域分类器 MVDC，通过多潜在空间映射净化域不变特征。相比单视角 DAL，MAD 能更有效去除非因果因素。摘要未给出具体数据集数值，但声称提升未见域检测性能。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses domain shift in object detection, arguing that prior domain adversarial learning ignores non-causal factors hidden in common features. It proposes MAD with a Spurious Correlations Generator and a Multi-View Domain Classifier to purify domain-invariant features across multiple latent spaces. The method improves generalization to unseen domains compared with single-view DAL, though no specific numbers are given in the abstract.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 从因果视角改进域泛化检测，思路新颖，对鲁棒感知有参考意义。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出基于多视角对抗判别的域泛化目标检测模型 MAD。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多潜在空间对抗训练去除共同特征中的非因果因素。
2304.02950|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，声称优于单视角域对抗学习方法。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对纯视觉 3D 检测深度估计不准的问题，提出多智能体协同的 CoCa3D 框架。方法通过通信共享互补信息并筛选最具信息量的线索，利用多视角消息消歧单 agent 深度估计并补全遮挡与远距离区域。在 DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+、CoPerception-UAVs+ 上 AP@70 分别提升 44.21%、30.60%、12.59%。初步结果表明相机协同可超越 LiDAR 方案。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: This paper improves camera-only 3D detection by introducing multi-agent collaboration to address inaccurate depth estimation. CoCa3D shares complementary information among agents and selects the most informative cues to disambiguate depth and complement occluded and long-range regions. It improves prior SOTA by 44.21% on DAIR-V2X, 30.60% on OPV2V+, and 12.59% on CoPerception-UAVs+ in AP@70.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 证明协同相机可超越 LiDAR，对纯视觉协同 3D 检测有重要推动。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出协同纯视觉 3D 检测框架 CoCa3D。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 通过多智能体通信与信息筛选提升单目深度估计与遮挡补全。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角点云配准在低重叠与噪声下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出可靠位姿图初始化与历史重加权方法。方法通过构建可靠位姿图进行初始化，并在优化中引入历史重加权以抑制异常边。相比已有配准方法，强调对错误匹配与低重叠场景的鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体数值，主要贡献在优化策略。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: This paper addresses robust multi-view point cloud registration under low overlap and noise. It proposes reliable pose graph initialization and history reweighting to suppress outlier edges during optimization. The contribution lies in the optimization strategy rather than a new representation, with no quantitative results reported in the abstract.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 对点云配准与 SLAM 有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出可靠位姿图初始化与历史重加权的多视角点云配准方法。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 结合可靠初始化与历史重加权提升低重叠场景鲁棒性。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio._arxiv_id: Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registration with Reliable Pose Graph Initialization and History Reweighting.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: 该论文针对纯视觉自动驾驶中感知与预测联合建模的时序信息利用不足问题，提出 TBP-Former。方法学习时序鸟瞰图金字塔，在 BEV 空间构建多尺度时序表示以联合进行感知与预测。相比已有 BEV 方法，强调时序金字塔对运动与遮挡的建模能力。摘要未给出具体数值，但面向 vision-centric 自动驾驶联合任务。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: This paper targets joint perception and prediction in vision-centric autonomous driving, where temporal information is underutilized. It proposes TBP-Former, which learns a temporal bird's-eye-view pyramid for multi-scale temporal BEV representation. The method emphasizes temporal pyramid modeling for motion and occlusion, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.assessment: 时序 BEV 金字塔对联合感知预测有潜力，值得关注。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出时序 BEV 金字塔 TBP-Former 用于联合感知与预测。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.innovation: 在 BEV 空间构建多尺度时序金字塔表示。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye._arxiv_id: TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid for Joint Perception and Prediction in Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving.

Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_cn: 该论文针对从多视角图像进行3D-4D视图合成的问题，提出神经像素合成方法。方法通过神经渲染与像素级组合实现新视角生成，可能改进了传统基于几何的方法在复杂场景下的合成质量。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作对多视角3D重建与视图合成有参考价值。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D-4D view synthesis from multi-view images by proposing a neural pixel composition approach. The method likely combines neural rendering with pixel-level composition to improve synthesis quality in complex scenes. While specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, the work is relevant to multi-view 3D reconstruction and view synthesis.
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.assessment: 该工作探索了神经像素合成在多视角视图合成中的应用，对3D重建与渲染方向有潜在启发，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑其优势。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.contribution: 提出了一种基于神经像素组合的多视角3D-4D视图合成方法。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.innovation: 将神经像素合成引入多视角视图合成，可能克服传统几何方法的局限。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，效果需进一步验证。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View._arxiv_id: Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View Synthesis from Multi-Views.

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视图聚类（IMVC）中样本缺失导致聚类性能下降的问题，提出跨视图部分样本与原型对齐网络（CPSPAN）。方法采用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号，并解决原型偏移问题，以提升不完整多视图下的聚类融合效果。相比现有对比学习方法，该方法更灵活地处理视图差异，但具体实验数据未在摘要中给出。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) where missing samples degrade performance, proposing a Cross-view Partial Sample and Prototype Alignment Network (CPSPAN). It uses pair-observed data alignment as proxy supervision and addresses prototype shift to improve clustering fusion. Compared to existing contrastive methods, it handles view discrepancy more flexibly, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 该工作针对不完整多视图聚类提出了新的对齐策略，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，且缺乏实验数据支撑。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出了跨视图部分样本与原型对齐网络CPSPAN用于不完整多视图聚类。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 采用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号，并解决原型偏移问题。
2303.15689|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，效果需进一步验证。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态场景下多帧深度估计中多视图几何一致性被破坏的问题，提出一种无需启发式掩码的跨线索融合（CCF）模块，学习融合多视图与单目线索。方法将多视图线索编码为代价体，单目线索编码为特征体，通过跨线索融合让静态区域的多视图几何信息传播到动态区域的单目表示，同时用单目线索增强多视图代价体。相比依赖显式掩码的方法，该工作避免了掩码质量不佳的限制，在动态场景深度估计上取得了更优效果（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the violation of multi-view geometric consistency in dynamic scenes for multi-frame depth estimation, proposing a cross-cue fusion (CCF) module that learns to fuse multi-view and monocular cues without heuristic masks. It encodes multi-view cues as cost volumes and monocular cues as feature volumes, enabling geometric information from static areas to propagate to monocular representations in dynamic areas, and vice versa. Compared to mask-based methods, it avoids mask quality limitations and achieves improved depth estimation in dynamic scenes (specific numbers not provided in the abstract).
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 该工作针对自动驾驶动态场景下的深度估计提出了有效的跨线索融合方案，无需显式掩码，思路新颖且实用性强。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出跨线索融合模块CCF，实现多视图与单目线索在动态场景深度估计中的自适应融合。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 无需启发式掩码，通过代价体与特征体的跨线索融合传播几何信息。
2304.08993|v2.result: 在动态场景深度估计上优于依赖掩码的方法，具体数值未在摘要中给出。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对城市多层级多视角图像理解缺乏统一数据集的问题，构建了OmniCity数据集，包含多视角卫星图像、街景全景和单目图像，覆盖纽约市25K地理位置的超过100K像素级标注图像。方法提出利用卫星视图标签图和不同视图间变换关系的街景图像标注流水线，以降低标注成本。相比现有基准，OmniCity提供更多图像、更丰富标注类型和更多视图，并引入街景全景图像细粒度建筑实例分割新任务，为城市理解提供了多任务基准。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified dataset for multi-level and multi-view city understanding by constructing OmniCity, containing multi-view satellite, street-level panorama, and mono-view images with over 100K pixel-wise annotations from 25K geo-locations in New York City. It proposes an efficient street-view annotation pipeline leveraging satellite label maps and view transformations to reduce annotation cost. Compared to existing benchmarks, OmniCity offers more images, richer annotation types, and more views, and introduces a novel fine-grained building instance segmentation task on street-level panoramas.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: OmniCity为城市多层级多视角理解提供了大规模、多任务基准数据集，对自动驾驶与遥感交叉领域有重要价值。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 构建了OmniCity多层级多视角城市理解数据集，并提供多个基准任务。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 利用卫星标签与视图变换实现高效街景标注，并引入细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。
2208.00928|v2.result: 数据集包含超过100K像素级标注图像，覆盖25K地理位置，提供多任务基准。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图3D表面重建缺乏多传感器多模态数据集的问题，构建了一个包含智能手机、Intel RealSense、Microsoft Kinect、工业相机和结构光扫描仪等多种传感器配准RGB与深度数据的大规模数据集。数据集涵盖107个场景、约140万张图像，采集自100个视角和14种光照条件，场景选择强调对现有算法具有挑战性的多样材质属性。该数据集可用于3D重建算法的评估与训练，但未提供具体算法性能数据。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of multi-sensor multi-modal datasets for multi-view 3D surface reconstruction by presenting a large-scale dataset with registered RGB and depth data from smartphones, Intel RealSense, Microsoft Kinect, industrial cameras, and structured-light scanners. It includes about 1.4 million images of 107 scenes from 100 viewing directions under 14 lighting conditions, emphasizing diverse material properties challenging for existing algorithms. The dataset is useful for evaluation and training of 3D reconstruction algorithms, though no specific algorithm performance is reported.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 该数据集为多视图3D重建提供了多传感器多模态的大规模基准，对3D重建与传感器融合研究有参考价值。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 构建了多传感器大规模多视图3D表面重建数据集。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 涵盖多种传感器模态和挑战性材质，提供丰富的视角与光照变化。
2203.06111|v2.result: 数据集包含约140万张图像，覆盖107个场景、100个视角和14种光照条件。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多视图聚类方法忽略所有样本结构关系的问题，提出全局与跨视图特征聚合网络（GCFAggMVC）。方法通过跨样本和跨视图特征聚合获得共识表示，并利用结构引导对比学习模块对齐共识表示与视图特定表示，使结构关系强的不同样本的视图特定表示相似。该模块可灵活嵌入不完整多视图聚类任务，但摘要未提供具体实验数据。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing multi-view clustering methods ignore structural relationships among all samples, proposing a Global and Cross-view Feature Aggregation network (GCFAggMVC). It obtains consensus representation via cross-sample and cross-view feature aggregation and aligns consensus and view-specific representations using a structure-guided contrastive learning module. The module can be flexibly embedded into incomplete multi-view clustering, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了新的多视图聚类特征聚合策略，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关性低，且缺乏实验数据支撑。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出了全局与跨视图特征聚合网络GCFAggMVC用于多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 通过跨样本跨视图聚合和结构引导对比学习对齐表示。
2305.06799|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，效果需进一步验证。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: 该论文针对高分辨率新视角合成中辐射场重建质量受限的问题，提出将多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化进行交叉引导的联合框架。方法通过超分辨率网络与NeRF类辐射场之间的双向引导，使低分辨率输入也能重建出高频细节的高分辨率新视角图像。相比先超分再重建或先重建再超分的串行方案，该交叉引导策略缓解了误差累积与不一致问题。摘要未提供具体量化指标，但该思路对自动驾驶中高保真场景重建与仿真数据生成有潜在价值。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited fidelity of radiance field reconstruction for high-resolution novel view synthesis by proposing a cross-guided optimization framework that jointly couples multi-view image super-resolution with radiance field training. The super-resolution network and the radiance field mutually guide each other, allowing high-frequency details to be recovered from low-resolution inputs. Unlike sequential super-resolution-then-reconstruction pipelines, this cross-guided scheme mitigates error accumulation and cross-stage inconsistency. The abstract reports no quantitative results, but the approach is potentially useful for high-fidelity scene reconstruction and simulation data generation in autonomous driving.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 将超分辨率与辐射场优化耦合的思路对高保真场景重建有参考价值，但缺少量化结果，且与检测/BEV主线的直接关联较弱。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化的交叉引导联合框架，用于高分辨率新视角合成。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 以双向交叉引导替代传统串行的超分与重建流程，缓解跨阶段误差累积。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，仅声称可提升高分辨率新视角合成质量。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角视觉任务中3D几何信息常被压缩进2D特征、几何感知能力不足的问题，提出POEM方法，直接在嵌入多视角立体空间的3D点上重建手部网格。方法设计了基于点的特征融合与跨集合点注意力两种操作，使一组环绕手部的3D点携带多视角图像特征并表征复杂手部网格。在三个具有挑战性的多视角数据集上，POEM在手部网格重建上超越现有最优方法。该工作对多视角几何特征融合具有方法学借鉴意义，但应用场景为手部重建而非自动驾驶感知。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited geometric awareness of multi-view vision models that typically encode 3D stereo information into 2D features, and proposes POEM, which directly operates on 3D points embedded in the multi-view stereo to reconstruct hand meshes. Two operations, point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention, allow a set of points encircling the hand to carry multi-view image features and represent a complex 3D hand mesh. POEM outperforms state-of-the-art methods for hand mesh reconstruction on three challenging multi-view datasets. The methodology is instructive for multi-view geometric feature fusion, though the application domain is hand reconstruction rather than autonomous driving perception.
2304.04038|v2.assessment: 以3D点作为跨视角特征融合媒介的思路对多视角3D感知有方法学启发，但任务域（手部重建）与自动驾驶检测主线距离较远。
2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出直接在多视角立体嵌入的3D点上重建手部网格的POEM方法。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 设计点基特征融合与跨集合点注意力，使3D点同时承载多视角特征并表征手部网格。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个多视角数据集上手部网格重建性能超越现有最优方法。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角立体匹配在弱纹理区域易失效的问题，提出自适应块变形（Adaptive Patch Deformation）策略以增强对无纹理区域的鲁棒性。方法通过对匹配块进行自适应形变，使其更好地适应局部几何与纹理变化，从而在低纹理场景下保持匹配稳定性。相比固定形状匹配块的经典MVS方法，该策略提升了弱纹理区域的重建完整性。摘要未提供具体量化结果，且与自动驾驶检测/BEV主线的直接关联有限。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of multi-view stereo matching in textureless regions by proposing an adaptive patch deformation strategy that improves robustness to low-texture areas. The matching patch is adaptively deformed to better accommodate local geometric and textural variations, thereby maintaining matching stability in weakly textured scenes. Compared with classical MVS methods using fixed-shape patches, this strategy improves reconstruction completeness in textureless regions. The abstract provides no quantitative results, and the connection to autonomous driving detection/BEV pipelines is limited.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 弱纹理鲁棒性是MVS的经典难题，自适应块变形思路合理，但缺少量化验证且与检测主线关联较弱。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出自适应块变形策略以提升多视角立体匹配在无纹理区域的鲁棒性。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.innovation: 以自适应形变匹配块替代固定形状块，适应局部几何与纹理变化。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，仅声称提升弱纹理区域的重建效果。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中检测与关联分离、依赖后处理启发式匹配的问题，提出ADA-Track端到端框架，通过交替执行检测与关联并引入可学习的注意力关联模块，使检测与跟踪相互增强。相比此前基于跟踪查询或两阶段匹配的方法，该工作将关联嵌入检测解码过程，在nuScenes跟踪基准上取得显著提升，AMOTA等指标优于同期端到端方法。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation between detection and association in multi-camera 3D multi-object tracking, which typically relies on heuristic post-hoc matching. It proposes ADA-Track, an end-to-end framework that alternates detection and association with a learnable attention-based association module, enabling mutual reinforcement between the two tasks. On the nuScenes tracking benchmark, it outperforms prior end-to-end and tracking-query-based methods in AMOTA and related metrics.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 该工作将检测与关联统一到端到端多相机3D跟踪中，思路清晰且实验扎实，对自动驾驶多相机感知与跟踪方向具有较高参考价值。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架ADA-Track。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 用可学习注意力关联模块替代启发式匹配，使检测与关联在解码过程中交替互增强。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.result: 在nuScenes跟踪基准上AMOTA等指标超越同期端到端方法。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: 针对多视角图像进行室内3D目标检测时几何建模不足的问题，提出CN-RMA，将射线行进（ray marching）聚合与组合网络结合，从多视角图像中重建并检测3D室内物体。相比基于点云或体素的方法，该工作直接从多视角图像出发，利用射线采样聚合多视角特征以增强几何一致性，在室内3D检测数据集上取得有竞争力的精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient geometric modeling for 3D indoor object detection from multi-view images by proposing CN-RMA, which combines a combined network with ray marching aggregation. Unlike point-cloud or voxel-based pipelines, it aggregates multi-view features along rays to improve geometric consistency. It achieves competitive accuracy on indoor 3D detection benchmarks.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 将ray marching引入多视角室内3D检测具有一定新意，但整体影响力偏中等，适合关注多视角几何聚合的研究者参考。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.contribution: 提出结合射线行进聚合的多视角图像室内3D目标检测网络CN-RMA。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.innovation: 用ray marching沿射线聚合多视角特征以增强3D几何建模。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.result: 在室内3D检测数据集上取得有竞争力的检测精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi._arxiv_id: CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marching Aggregation for 3D Indoor Object Detection from Multi-View Images.

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: 针对无参考点云质量评估（NR-PCQA）中标注数据稀缺、特征表达不足的问题，提出结合多视角融合的对比预训练方法，通过自监督对比学习获取质量感知表征。相比直接监督回归的方法，该工作利用多视角投影融合与对比预训练提升特征判别力，在多个点云质量评估数据集上取得优于基线的相关性指标。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This paper addresses limited labeled data and weak feature representation in no-reference point cloud quality assessment by proposing contrastive pre-training with multi-view fusion. It learns quality-aware representations via self-supervised contrastive learning over multi-view projections. It improves correlation metrics over baselines on several PCQA datasets.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低，但自监督对比预训练与多视角融合思路对表征学习方向有一定借鉴意义。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出面向无参考点云质量评估的多视角融合对比预训练方法。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 将多视角融合与对比预训练结合以学习质量感知表征。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在多个点云质量评估数据集上相关性指标优于基线。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View._arxiv_id: Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View Fusion for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: 针对帕金森病运动症状评估依赖主观量表、缺乏客观量化的问题，提出TULIP多相机3D精度评估系统，利用多相机重建进行3D运动学测量。相比单相机或可穿戴传感器方案，该系统通过多视角几何提升3D定位精度，在临床场景中实现了对帕金森症状的客观量化评估。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: This paper targets subjective rating scales in Parkinson's disease assessment by proposing TULIP, a multi-camera 3D system for objective precision evaluation. It uses multi-view reconstruction to obtain 3D kinematic measurements, improving over single-camera or wearable-based approaches. It enables objective quantification of Parkinsonian symptoms in clinical settings.
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.assessment: 属于医学应用型多相机3D工作，与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限，但多相机3D精度评估方法可作跨领域参考。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.contribution: 提出用于帕金森病客观评估的多相机3D精度测量系统TULIP。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.innovation: 将多相机3D重建用于临床运动症状的客观量化。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.result: 实现对帕金森症状的客观3D运动学量化评估。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm._arxiv_id: TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessment of Parkinson's Disease.

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: 针对多人多视角3D姿态估计依赖大量3D标注的问题，提出SelfPose3d自监督框架，利用多视角几何一致性与可微分三角化进行自监督训练。相比需要3D真值的监督方法，该工作仅用多视角2D关键点即可学习3D姿态，在Human3.6M等基准上接近甚至达到监督方法的精度。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on 3D annotations in multi-person multi-view 3D pose estimation by proposing SelfPose3d, a self-supervised framework leveraging multi-view geometric consistency and differentiable triangulation. It learns 3D poses from multi-view 2D keypoints only, approaching supervised accuracy on benchmarks such as Human3.6M.
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.assessment: 自监督多视角3D几何一致性建模思路对多相机3D感知有方法层面的启发，值得关注自监督3D方向的研究者阅读。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.contribution: 提出基于多视角几何一致性的自监督多人多视角3D姿态估计框架SelfPose3d。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.innovation: 用可微分三角化与多视角一致性实现无需3D标注的自监督训练。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.result: 在Human3.6M等基准上接近监督方法的3D姿态精度。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person._arxiv_id: SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person Multi-View 3d Pose Estimation.

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: 针对实际多视角场景中视图噪声导致自监督聚类性能下降的问题，系统研究了噪声视图的副作用并提出缓解策略。相比假设视图干净的传统多视角聚类方法，该工作分析了噪声视图对对比学习目标的影响，并设计鲁棒聚合与加权机制，在含噪多视角数据集上提升了聚类指标。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates the side effects of noisy views in practical multi-view self-supervised clustering and proposes mitigation strategies. Unlike methods assuming clean views, it analyzes how noisy views degrade contrastive objectives and designs robust aggregation and weighting. It improves clustering metrics on noisy multi-view datasets.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低，但噪声视图鲁棒性分析对多模态/多视角自监督学习有间接参考价值。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 系统研究并缓解多视角自监督聚类中噪声视图的副作用。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 分析噪声视图对对比目标的负面影响并提出鲁棒聚合加权机制。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.result: 在含噪多视角数据集上提升自监督聚类指标。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中像素级深度监督的两个问题：LiDAR点云深度仅分布在物体表面、缺乏3D物体中心深度，且远距离物体细粒度深度估计困难。提出OPEN检测器，通过object-wise depth encoder以像素级深度图为先验估计物体级深度，并用object-wise position embedding将物体深度信息注入transformer decoder。相比已有像素级深度监督方法，显式引入物体级深度（3D中心）信息，更契合DETR式检测器需求。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在远距离物体检测上取得改进。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues in multi-view 3D detection with pixel-wise depth supervision: LiDAR-derived depth lies on object surfaces and lacks 3D center depth, and fine-grained depth for distant objects is hard. It proposes OPEN, which uses an object-wise depth encoder taking pixel-wise depth maps as prior to estimate object-wise depth, and injects it into the transformer decoder via object-wise position embedding. Unlike prior pixel-wise depth supervision, it explicitly leverages object-level depth (3D center), better matching DETR-based detectors.
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 针对多视角3D检测中深度监督的关键缺陷提出物体级位置嵌入，思路清晰且与DETR框架契合，值得关注。

2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（LLM）在核心视觉感知能力上缺乏评估的问题，提出Blink基准，将14类经典CV任务（如相对深度估计、视觉对应、取证检测、多视角推理）重构为3,807道多选题，配以单/多图和视觉提示。人类平均准确率95.70%，而最佳GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%，仅比随机猜测高13.17%和7.63%，表明这些感知能力尚未在现有多模态LLM中涌现。分析还指出专用CV模型表现更好，为未来改进指明方向。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: To evaluate core visual perception abilities missing in prior benchmarks, this paper introduces Blink, which reformats 14 classic CV tasks (e.g., relative depth estimation, visual correspondence, forensics, multi-view reasoning) into 3,807 multiple-choice questions with single/multiple images and visual prompting. Humans average 95.70% accuracy, while the best GPT-4V and Gemini achieve only 51.26% and 45.72%, just 13.17% and 7.63% above random guessing, showing such perception abilities have not emerged in current multimodal LLMs. Analysis also shows specialist CV models perform much better, suggesting future improvement pathways.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: Blink揭示了多模态LLM在核心视觉感知上的显著短板，对VLM与视觉感知交叉研究有重要参考价值，虽非直接检测方法但相关度高。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 构建Blink基准，系统评估多模态LLM的核心视觉感知能力。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 将14类经典CV任务重构为多选题并配视觉提示，量化LLM感知短板。
2404.12390|v2.result: 人类95.70% vs GPT-4V 51.26%、Gemini 45.72%，仅略高于随机猜测。

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对微小目标异常检测缺乏大规模多视角与视觉-文本联合基准的问题，提出了MANTA数据集。视觉部分包含38个类别、超13.73万张图像（其中8.6K张有像素级异常标注），每张图像从5个视角采集；文本部分包含875个描述异常的词条（含what/why/how解释）和2K道多难度选择题。作者还提出了视觉-文本任务基线并进行了广泛基准测试，揭示了现有先进方法在该数据集上的挑战。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MANTA, a large-scale multi-view and visual-text anomaly detection dataset for tiny objects, comprising over 137.3K images across 38 categories with 8.6K pixel-level anomaly annotations and five viewpoints per image. The text component includes 875 declarative knowledge words and 2K constructivist multiple-choice questions. A visual-text baseline and extensive benchmarking experiments are provided, highlighting challenges for advanced methods.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了微小目标异常检测中多视角与视觉-文本联合评测的空白，对开放集检测和多模态理解研究者有参考价值。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模多视角视觉-文本微小目标异常检测数据集MANTA及配套基线。

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云补全中解空间大且图像-部分点云配对数据难以获取的问题，提出了PCDreamer方法。它利用大模型中的多视角扩散先验生成目标形状的新视角图像，编码全局与局部形状线索；设计了形状融合模块从图像和点云多模态输入生成初始完整形状，并用形状巩固模块丢弃扩散先验不一致导致的不可靠点。实验表明其在恢复精细细节方面具有优越性能。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud completion by proposing PCDreamer, which leverages multi-view diffusion priors from large models to generate novel views encoding global and local shape cues, avoiding the need for paired image-partial point cloud data. A shape fusion module produces an initial complete shape from multimodal inputs, and a shape consolidation module removes unreliable points from diffusion inconsistencies. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance, especially in recovering fine details.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 将多视角扩散先验引入点云补全的思路新颖，对3D生成与感知交叉领域有启发，但与自动驾驶BEV/检测主线关联较弱。
