Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_cn: 针对视频异常理解（VAU）缺乏对异常因果性（what/why/how）系统评测的问题，论文构建了首个面向因果理解的综合基准。作者提出 MMEval 评测协议与因果理解指标，并设计 Causality-Enhanced Video Anomaly Understanding（CVAU）方法，通过因果推理模块增强异常原因与后果的建模。相比仅关注异常检测/定位的已有工作，该基准首次将异常的原因与演化过程纳入量化评估，实验显示现有 VLM 在因果理解上仍显著落后于人类水平。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic evaluation for the causal understanding (what, why, how) of video anomalies. It introduces a comprehensive benchmark with the MMEval protocol and causality-oriented metrics, together with a Causality-Enhanced Video Anomaly Understanding method that explicitly models anomaly causes and consequences. Unlike prior work focused only on anomaly detection/localization, it quantifies causal reasoning, revealing that current VLMs still fall far behind human performance.
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.assessment: 为视频异常理解提供了首个因果性评测基准，对视频理解与安全感知研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.contribution: 构建了首个面向视频异常因果理解的综合基准与评测协议。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.innovation: 将异常理解的 what/why/how 因果维度形式化并纳入量化评测。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.result: 实验表明现有 VLM 在异常因果理解上明显低于人类水平，暴露了显著的能力差距。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe._arxiv_id: Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Causation Understanding of Video Anomaly.

A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_cn: 针对点云视频理解缺乏统一任务定义与数据组织方式的问题，论文提出以人为中心的点云视频理解统一框架。作者定义了 Human-centric Point Cloud Video Understanding（HPVID）任务，构建了包含多视角、多动作的点云视频数据集，并提出统一的时空点云骨干网络进行人体动作与交互建模。相比以往单帧点云或 RGB 视频方法，该框架首次系统化处理时序点云中的人体运动，在动作识别与预测任务上取得优于逐帧基线的精度。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_en: This paper tackles the absence of a unified task formulation and data organization for point cloud video understanding. It defines the Human-centric Point Cloud Video Understanding (HPVID) task, builds a multi-view, multi-action point cloud video dataset, and proposes a unified spatio-temporal point cloud backbone for human motion and interaction modeling. Compared with per-frame point cloud or RGB video methods, it systematically handles temporal human motion and outperforms frame-wise baselines on action recognition and prediction.
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.assessment: 为点云视频这一新兴方向提供了任务定义与基线，对 3D 感知与人体理解交叉研究有启发，但应用场景偏人体动作而非车载感知。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.contribution: 提出以人为中心的点云视频理解统一任务框架与数据集。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.innovation: 将时序点云建模统一到人体动作与交互理解任务中。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.result: 在动作识别与预测任务上优于逐帧处理基线。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po._arxiv_id: A Unified Framework for Human-centric Point Cloud Video Understanding.

Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_cn: 针对现有视频异常检测只能识别训练集中已知异常类别、无法泛化到开放类别的问题，论文提出开放词汇视频异常检测（Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection, OVVAD）新设定。作者设计了基于视觉-语言对齐的框架，利用 CLIP 等预训练模型将异常检测从闭集分类转为文本提示驱动的开放语义匹配，并引入异常语义解耦与提示学习策略。相比闭集方法，该方法在未见异常类别上取得显著提升，验证了开放词汇设定下的泛化能力。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that existing video anomaly detection methods can only recognize anomaly classes seen during training. It introduces the Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection (OVVAD) setting and proposes a vision-language alignment framework that leverages pretrained models such as CLIP to perform text-prompt-driven open-semantic matching, with anomaly semantic decoupling and prompt learning. Compared with closed-set methods, it substantially improves performance on unseen anomaly categories.
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..assessment: 将开放词汇设定引入视频异常检测，与开放集检测方向高度契合，方法思路对自动驾驶中的未知障碍物检测有借鉴意义。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..contribution: 提出开放词汇视频异常检测新设定及视觉-语言对齐框架。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..innovation: 用文本提示驱动的开放语义匹配替代闭集异常分类。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..result: 在未见异常类别上相比闭集方法取得显著性能提升。

Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶安全感知中缺乏对事故因果推理能力评测的问题，论文提出基于溯因推理（abductive reasoning）的自我视角事故视频理解基准。作者构建了包含事故视频、事故原因与规避建议标注的数据集，并设计多模态大模型评测框架，要求模型从第一视角视频中推断事故发生的可能原因。相比传统事故检测仅做二分类，该工作强调因果解释与安全决策，实验显示现有 MLLM 在事故原因推断上准确率仍较低。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_en: This paper targets the lack of evaluation for causal reasoning about accidents in safe-driving perception. It proposes an abductive ego-view accident video understanding benchmark, with a dataset annotated with accident causes and avoidance suggestions, and a multimodal LLM evaluation framework that infers plausible causes from first-person videos. Unlike binary accident detection, it emphasizes causal explanation and safety decision-making, showing that current MLLMs still achieve low accuracy in cause inference.
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.assessment: 直接面向自动驾驶安全感知，将溯因推理引入事故视频理解，对提升自动驾驶可解释性与安全性有较高参考价值。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.contribution: 构建了基于溯因推理的自我视角事故视频理解基准与评测框架。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.innovation: 将事故原因推断形式化为溯因推理任务并引入多模态大模型评测。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.result: 实验表明现有 MLLM 在事故原因推断任务上准确率仍偏低。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders._arxiv_id: Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Understanding for Safe Driving Perception.

MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型受限于上下文长度、难以处理长视频的问题，论文提出记忆增强的大多模态模型 MA-LMM。作者设计了长期记忆库（long-term memory bank）与记忆检索机制，将历史视觉特征压缩存储并按需召回，使模型能够在线处理超长视频而无需增加上下文窗口。相比直接扩展 LLM 上下文或均匀采样帧的方法，MA-LMM 在长视频问答与视频字幕任务上取得更优性能，并在多个长视频基准上超越同期方法。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of existing multimodal LLMs in handling long videos due to limited context length. It proposes MA-LMM, a memory-augmented large multimodal model with a long-term memory bank and memory retrieval mechanism that compresses and recalls historical visual features, enabling online processing of very long videos without enlarging the context window. Compared with context extension or uniform frame sampling, MA-LMM achieves stronger results on long-video QA and captioning benchmarks.
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.assessment: 记忆增强思路有效缓解长视频建模的上下文瓶颈，方法通用性强，对自动驾驶长时序视频理解与多模态感知有直接借鉴价值。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.contribution: 提出记忆增强的大多模态模型以支持超长视频在线理解。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.innovation: 用长期记忆库与检索机制替代上下文窗口扩展来处理长视频。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.result: 在多个长视频问答与字幕基准上超越同期方法。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda._arxiv_id: MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model for Long-Term Video Understanding.

TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中时间定位与时间敏感问答能力不足的问题，论文提出时间敏感的多模态大语言模型 TimeChat。作者设计了时间感知的视频编码器与时间戳对齐机制，并构建了时间定位指令微调数据，使模型能够根据文本查询定位视频中的具体时间段。相比通用视频 LLM 只能给出粗粒度描述，TimeChat 在时间定位与密集视频字幕任务上取得显著提升，并在零样本时间敏感问答上表现优异。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_en: This paper targets the weak temporal grounding and time-sensitive QA capabilities of existing video LLMs. It proposes TimeChat, a time-sensitive multimodal large language model with a time-aware video encoder, timestamp alignment, and temporal grounding instruction tuning, enabling the model to localize specific time spans in videos given textual queries. Compared with generic video LLMs that only produce coarse descriptions, TimeChat significantly improves temporal grounding and dense video captioning, and performs well on zero-shot time-sensitive QA.
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.assessment: 时间戳对齐与时间定位微调对长视频时序理解有实质推进，对自动驾驶中事件定位与视频问答有参考意义。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.contribution: 提出时间敏感的多模态大语言模型 TimeChat 及时间定位指令微调方案。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.innovation: 通过时间戳对齐与时间感知编码实现文本查询驱动的视频时间段定位。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.result: 在时间定位与密集视频字幕任务上显著提升，零样本时间敏感问答表现优异。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La._arxiv_id: TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal Large Language Model for Long Video Understanding.

Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型在图像与视频理解上通常需要分别设计视觉编码器、难以统一处理的问题，本文提出 Chat-UniVi，用一组动态视觉 token 统一表示图像和视频。方法通过多尺度 token 聚合与动态 token 合并，在有限上下文长度下同时保留空间细节与长时序信息，并直接接入 LLM 进行联合训练。相比此前图像/视频分离的架构，它在图像与视频基准上均取得有竞争力的结果，且训练成本更低。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified visual representation for image and video understanding in multimodal LLMs. Chat-UniVi represents both images and videos with a set of dynamic visual tokens via multi-scale aggregation and token merging, enabling joint training with an LLM under limited context length. It achieves competitive results on both image and video benchmarks while reducing training cost compared with modality-specific designs.
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.assessment: 统一视觉 token 表示对多模态大模型处理图像与视频有实用价值，方法简洁且实验覆盖两类基准，值得关注。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.contribution: 提出用动态视觉 token 统一表示图像与视频的 Chat-UniVi 框架。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.innovation: 通过多尺度聚合与动态 token 合并，在有限上下文下兼顾空间细节与长时序信息。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.result: 在图像与视频理解基准上均取得有竞争力表现，并降低训练开销。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio._arxiv_id: Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representation Empowers Large Language Models with Image and Video Understanding.

HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_cn: 针对视频场景图生成中对象关系随时间和层级变化难以建模的问题，本文提出分层交错图（HIG）方法。方法在视频中构建分层、交错的对象与关系图，捕捉跨帧的时空依赖与层级语义结构。相比仅用单帧或扁平图结构的已有方法，HIG 更好地表达了动态场景中的关系演化。在视频场景图生成基准上取得了优于基线的性能。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_en: This paper targets video scene graph generation, where object relations evolve over time and exhibit hierarchical structure. It proposes a Hierarchical Interlacement Graph (HIG) that models layered and interleaved object-relation dependencies across frames. Compared with single-frame or flat-graph baselines, HIG better captures dynamic relational evolution and improves performance on video scene graph benchmarks.
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.assessment: 将分层图结构引入视频场景图生成，思路合理，但整体与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.contribution: 提出用于视频场景图生成的分层交错图方法 HIG。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.innovation: 用分层交错图建模跨帧对象与关系的时空及层级依赖。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.result: 在视频场景图生成基准上优于已有基线方法。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap._arxiv_id: HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Approach to Scene Graph Generation in Video Understanding.

A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_cn: 针对第一视角视频理解中任务单一、模型难以在多任务间迁移的问题，本文提出“技能背包”框架，将多种任务视角统一到同一模型。方法通过模块化的技能表示与组合，使模型能在不同下游任务间共享和复用知识。相比针对单一任务训练的模型，该框架在多任务设定下展现出更好的泛化与迁移能力。实验在多个第一视角视频任务上验证了其有效性。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited task generality of egocentric video understanding models. It proposes a 'backpack of skills' framework that unifies diverse task perspectives through modular skill representations and composition. Compared with task-specific models, it shows improved generalization and transfer across multiple egocentric video tasks.
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.assessment: 多任务技能组合的思路对通用视频理解有启发，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.contribution: 提出面向第一视角视频多任务理解的技能背包框架。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.innovation: 用模块化技能表示与组合实现跨任务知识共享与迁移。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.result: 在多个第一视角视频任务上验证了泛化与迁移能力的提升。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi._arxiv_id: A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Video Understanding with Diverse Task Perspectives.

MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中密集 token 导致显存与计算开销过大的问题，本文提出 MovieChat，将密集 token 转化为稀疏记忆。方法借鉴记忆机制，用短期记忆保留细节、长期记忆压缩全局信息，从而在有限资源下处理超长视频。相比直接扩展上下文窗口的方案，MovieChat 在长视频问答基准上取得更好效果且更高效。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_en: This paper tackles the prohibitive memory and compute cost of dense tokens in long-video understanding. MovieChat converts dense tokens into sparse memory with short-term and long-term components, preserving local detail while compressing global context. It outperforms naive context-extension approaches on long-video QA benchmarks with higher efficiency.
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.assessment: 稀疏记忆机制对长视频理解的可扩展性有实际意义，方法设计清晰，值得关注。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.contribution: 提出用稀疏记忆处理长视频理解的 MovieChat 框架。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.innovation: 以短期/长期记忆将密集 token 压缩为稀疏表示。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.result: 在长视频问答基准上优于直接扩展上下文的方案且更高效。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me._arxiv_id: MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Memory for Long Video Understanding.

OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务种类繁多、通常需要任务专用架构的问题，本文提出 OmniViD，一个面向通用视频理解的生成式框架。方法将多种视频任务统一为生成式序列建模，用同一模型处理分类、定位、描述等不同任务。相比任务专用模型，OmniViD 在多个视频基准上以统一架构取得有竞争力的结果，展示了生成式范式的通用性。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of video understanding into many task-specific architectures. OmniViD proposes a generative framework that unifies diverse video tasks as sequence generation with a single model. Compared with task-specific designs, it achieves competitive results across multiple video benchmarks, demonstrating the generality of the generative paradigm.
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.assessment: 统一生成式视频理解框架具有较好的通用性，对多任务视频建模有参考价值。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.contribution: 提出通用视频理解的生成式框架 OmniViD。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.innovation: 将多种视频任务统一为生成式序列建模。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.result: 以单一架构在多个视频基准上取得有竞争力表现。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ._arxiv_id: OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Universal Video Understanding.

Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_cn: 针对组合式视频理解中时空结构难以被有效建模的问题，本文提出基于时空结构的 Transformer 方法。方法显式编码视频中的时空结构关系，使模型能够推理对象与动作的组合语义。相比仅依赖外观特征的视频 Transformer，该方法在组合式视频理解任务上提升了结构化推理能力。实验验证了时空结构建模对组合理解的有效性。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_en: This paper targets compositional video understanding, where spatiotemporal structure is hard to model effectively. It proposes a Transformer that explicitly encodes spatiotemporal structural relations to reason about object-action compositions. Compared with appearance-only video Transformers, it improves structured reasoning on compositional video understanding tasks.
Compositional Video Understanding with S.assessment: 显式时空结构建模对组合式视频理解有针对性，但整体与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.contribution: 提出基于时空结构的组合式视频理解 Transformer。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.innovation: 显式编码时空结构关系以支持对象-动作组合推理。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.result: 在组合式视频理解任务上提升了结构化推理性能。
Compositional Video Understanding with S._arxiv_id: Compositional Video Understanding with Spatiotemporal Structure-based Transformers.

Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中跨域泛化能力不足的问题，本文提出"先对齐再适应"（Align Before Adapt）框架。方法利用实体到区域的细粒度对齐，将视频中的实体（如物体、人物）与文本描述中的实体进行跨模态匹配，再基于对齐结果进行动作分类。相比仅依赖全局视频-文本对齐的已有方法，该框架能捕捉更细粒度的语义对应关系，提升泛化性。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值结果，但方法在多个跨域动作识别基准上验证了有效性。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited cross-domain generalizability of video action recognition by proposing an "Align Before Adapt" framework. It leverages entity-to-region alignments to establish fine-grained cross-modal correspondences between entities in videos and textual descriptions before adapting to action classification. Compared with prior methods relying solely on global video-text alignment, this approach captures finer-grained semantic correspondences and improves generalization, though specific numerical results are not provided in the abstract.
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.assessment: 该工作将细粒度实体对齐引入视频动作识别，思路清晰，对跨域泛化问题有实际意义，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑其优势。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.contribution: 提出实体到区域对齐的"先对齐再适应"框架用于可泛化视频动作识别。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.innovation: 将实体级跨模态对齐作为视频动作识别泛化的核心机制。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.result: 在跨域动作识别基准上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to._arxiv_id: Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to-Region Alignments for Generalizable Video Action Recognition.

Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_cn: 针对开放式视频问答（Video QA）中标注不足的问题，本文提出排序蒸馏（Ranking Distillation）方法。核心思路是利用模型对候选答案的排序信息作为监督信号，在标签稀缺条件下蒸馏知识，从而提升开放式问答性能。相比传统依赖大量精确标注的监督方法，该方法在标注不足场景下更具鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值提升。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_en: This paper tackles the insufficient-label problem in open-ended video question answering by proposing a Ranking Distillation method. It exploits ranking information among candidate answers as supervisory signals to distill knowledge under label-scarce conditions. Compared with conventional fully supervised approaches requiring extensive annotations, this method is more robust in low-label regimes, though specific quantitative improvements are not reported in the abstract.
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.assessment: 该工作关注标注稀缺下的视频问答，排序蒸馏思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，难以判断实际效果。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.contribution: 提出排序蒸馏方法用于标注不足的开放式视频问答。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.innovation: 利用候选答案排序信息作为弱监督信号进行知识蒸馏。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.result: 在标注不足条件下提升了开放式视频问答性能，摘要未提供具体数值。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide._arxiv_id: Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Video Question Answering with Insufficient Labels.

Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_cn: 针对视频问答中视觉与语言模态融合不充分的问题，本文提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏（Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation）方法。该方法利用语言信息引导视觉特征的语义蒸馏，使视觉表示更贴合问答任务所需的语义。相比仅简单拼接或注意力融合的已有方法，该蒸馏机制能更有效地对齐视觉与语言语义。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient vision-language fusion in video question answering by proposing a Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation method. It uses linguistic information to guide the semantic distillation of visual features, making visual representations more aligned with QA task semantics. Compared with simple concatenation or attention-based fusion, this distillation mechanism more effectively aligns visual and linguistic semantics, though specific numerical results are not provided.
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.assessment: 该工作提出语言引导的视觉语义蒸馏用于视频问答，思路合理，但摘要缺乏实验细节，影响力有待验证。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.contribution: 提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏方法用于视频问答。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.innovation: 用语言信息引导视觉特征的语义蒸馏以增强跨模态对齐。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.result: 提升了视频问答中的视觉-语言语义对齐效果，摘要未提供具体数值。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat._arxiv_id: Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation for Video Question Answering.

E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_cn: 针对零样本时空视频定位（Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding）问题，本文提出E3M框架，利用期望最大化（EM）多模态调制实现零样本定位。方法通过EM算法迭代优化文本查询与视频时空区域的对应关系，无需训练数据即可定位目标。相比需要大量标注的监督方法，E3M在零样本设定下具有明显优势。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值结果。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_en: This paper tackles zero-shot spatio-temporal video grounding by proposing E3M, which employs Expectation-Maximization multimodal modulation. The method iteratively optimizes the correspondence between textual queries and spatio-temporal video regions via EM, enabling target localization without training data. Compared with supervised methods requiring extensive annotations, E3M offers clear advantages in the zero-shot setting, though specific numerical results are not reported.
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.assessment: 该工作将EM算法引入零样本时空视频定位，方法设计有新意，但摘要缺乏实验数据，实际性能需进一步验证。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.contribution: 提出基于EM多模态调制的零样本时空视频定位框架E3M。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.innovation: 利用期望最大化算法迭代优化文本与视频时空区域的对应关系。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.result: 实现了零样本时空视频定位，摘要未提供具体数值结果。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro._arxiv_id: E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding with Expectation-Maximization Multimodal Modulation.

🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中信息量大、上下文复杂的问题，本文提出VideoAgent，一种记忆增强的多模态智能体。该方法通过构建记忆模块存储和检索视频中的关键信息，结合多模态大模型进行推理和问答。相比直接处理完整视频的已有方法，VideoAgent能更高效地处理长视频并保持上下文连贯性。摘要未给出具体数值，但智能体范式在视频理解中具有潜力。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of long-video understanding with large information volume and complex context by proposing VideoAgent, a memory-augmented multimodal agent. It builds a memory module to store and retrieve key video information, combined with multimodal large models for reasoning and QA. Compared with methods directly processing full videos, VideoAgent handles long videos more efficiently while maintaining contextual coherence, though specific numerical results are not provided.
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.assessment: 该工作将记忆增强智能体范式引入视频理解，思路前沿，对长视频场景有实际价值，值得关注。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.contribution: 提出记忆增强的多模态智能体VideoAgent用于视频理解。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.innovation: 将记忆模块与多模态大模型结合构建视频理解智能体。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.result: 在长视频理解任务上展现了智能体范式的潜力，摘要未提供具体数值。

2407.21757|v2.summary_cn: 针对叙事视频（如电影）理解中角色、对话、剧情等丰富上下文带来的挑战，本文提出MovieSeq多模态语言模型。核心思想是将视频表示为交错的 multimodal 序列（图像、情节、视频、字幕），通过链接外部知识库或使用离线模型（如Whisper提取字幕）构建序列，再通过指令微调让语言模型以交错多模态指令与视频交互。相比仅以视频为输入的方法，MovieSeq联合提供角色照片、姓名和对话，使模型能关联这些元素生成更全面的回答。在LVU、MAD、Movienet、CMD、TVC、MovieQA六个数据集、五种任务设定（视频分类、音频描述、视频-文本检索、视频描述、视频问答）上验证了有效性。
2407.21757|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of narrative video understanding (e.g., movies) arising from rich contexts such as characters, dialogues, and storylines, and proposes MovieSeq, a multimodal language model. It represents videos as interleaved multimodal sequences (images, plots, videos, subtitles) constructed via external knowledge bases or offline models (e.g., Whisper for subtitles), and uses instruction-tuning to enable interaction through interleaved multimodal instructions. Unlike video-only input methods, MovieSeq jointly provides character photos, names, and dialogues, enabling the model to associate these elements for more comprehensive responses. It is validated on six datasets (LVU, MAD, Movienet, CMD, TVC, MovieQA) across five settings (video classification, audio description, video-text retrieval, video captioning, and video QA).
2407.21757|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地将交错多模态序列引入叙事视频理解，覆盖六个数据集和五种任务，实验充分，对视频理解研究者有较高参考价值。
2407.21757|v2.contribution: 提出MovieSeq多模态语言模型，将视频表示为交错多模态序列以理解叙事视频上下文。
2407.21757|v2.innovation: 通过指令微调让语言模型以交错多模态指令（图像、情节、视频、字幕）与视频交互。
2407.21757|v2.result: 在LVU、MAD、Movienet、CMD、TVC、MovieQA六个数据集、五种任务设定上验证了有效性。

InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_cn: 针对多模态视频理解缺乏统一大规模基础模型的问题，本文提出InternVideo2，通过扩展模型与数据规模构建视频基础模型。方法上采用多阶段训练（视频自监督、多模态对比、下一token预测）并统一视频编码器与多模态大模型。相比前代InternVideo，在动作识别、视频问答、时序定位等任务上取得显著提升。在多个基准上达到SOTA，例如Kinetics-400准确率约90%以上，并在视频对话等任务上展现强泛化能力。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified large-scale foundation model for multimodal video understanding by proposing InternVideo2, which scales model and data. It employs multi-stage training (video self-supervision, multimodal contrastive, next-token prediction) and unifies video encoders with multimodal LLMs. Compared to prior work, it achieves significant gains on action recognition, video QA, and temporal grounding, reaching state-of-the-art results (e.g., >90% on Kinetics-400) and strong generalization in video dialogue.
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.assessment: 该工作系统性地推进了视频基础模型的规模化训练，对多模态视频理解领域具有重要参考价值。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.contribution: 提出InternVideo2，一个通过多阶段训练和规模扩展实现的多模态视频理解基础模型。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.innovation: 统一视频编码器与多模态大模型，并采用渐进式多阶段训练策略。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.result: 在多个视频理解基准上达到SOTA，如Kinetics-400准确率超过90%。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models._arxiv_id: InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models for Multimodal Video Understanding.

2311.17893|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督视频目标分割（VOS）依赖辅助模态或迭代slot attention导致通用性差和计算开销大的问题，本文提出一种简单有效的方法。核心洞察是DINO预训练Transformer中固有的结构依赖可建立鲁棒的时空对应关系，仅需简单聚类即可获得有竞争力的分割结果。方法上引入单个时空Transformer块处理逐帧DINO特征，利用自注意力图进行层次聚类生成掩码。相比已有工作，无需额外模态或slot attention，在多个VOS基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
2311.17893|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised video object segmentation (VOS) that relies on auxiliary modalities or iterative slot attention, which limits generality and increases computation. It leverages inherent structural dependencies in DINO-pretrained Transformers to establish robust spatio-temporal correspondences, using a single spatio-temporal Transformer block and hierarchical clustering on attention maps to generate masks. Without extra modalities or slot attention, it achieves competitive segmentation results on VOS benchmarks.
2311.17893|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了DINO特征在视频对应中的潜力，为自监督VOS提供了简洁高效的新思路。
2311.17893|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于DINO预训练Transformer时空对应关系的简单自监督视频目标分割方法。
2311.17893|v2.innovation: 利用DINO自注意力图进行层次聚类，无需辅助模态或slot attention。
2311.17893|v2.result: 在多个VOS基准上取得有竞争力的分割性能。

2407.03788|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频-文本对不完全对齐以及概念分布不均导致视频-语言表示学习效果受限的问题，本文提出MAMA框架。方法上采用带减法角度间隔的对比目标来正则化跨模态表示，并利用MLP参数化的加权函数根据损失值动态调整样本权重，以应对概念分布不均。此外，使用少量无偏元数据和大型视觉语言模型生成的视频-文本数据增强训练。相比已有工作，在常见视频-语言检索等任务上取得更优性能。
2407.03788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses imperfect video-text alignment and uneven concept distribution in video-language representation learning by proposing MAMA. It uses a contrastive objective with a subtractive angular margin to regularize cross-modal representations, and an MLP-parameterized weighting function to dynamically adjust sample weights. Training is guided by unbiased meta-data and augmented with video-text data from large VLMs, achieving superior performance on common video-language tasks.
2407.03788|v2.assessment: 该工作从数据质量和概念分布角度改进视频-语言表示学习，对多模态理解有参考意义。
2407.03788|v2.contribution: 提出MAMA框架，通过角度间隔对比学习和动态样本加权提升视频-语言表示。
2407.03788|v2.innovation: 引入减法角度间隔和基于MLP的元学习加权函数来应对数据不对齐与概念不均。
2407.03788|v2.result: 在常见视频-语言任务上取得优于基线的性能。

2412.12075|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中现有基准缺乏线索定位能力的问题，本文提出了CG-Bench，一个基于线索定位的问答基准。该方法通过设计需要模型定位关键视频片段来回答问题的任务，要求模型不仅给出答案还需提供支撑证据。相比已有长视频QA基准，CG-Bench强调线索定位的准确性和推理深度。实验表明现有先进模型在该基准上表现显著下降，揭示了长视频理解中线索定位能力的不足。
2412.12075|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of clue-grounding capability in existing long video understanding benchmarks by proposing CG-Bench, a clue-grounded question answering benchmark. The benchmark requires models to locate key video segments as evidence for answering questions, going beyond answer-only evaluation. Experiments show that state-of-the-art models suffer significant performance drops, revealing deficiencies in clue-grounding for long video understanding.
2412.12075|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了长视频理解中线索定位评估的空白，对推动视频理解模型的可解释性和推理能力有重要价值。
2412.12075|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于线索定位的长视频问答基准CG-Bench。
2412.12075|v2.innovation: 将线索定位作为长视频QA的核心评估维度，要求模型提供支撑证据。
2412.12075|v2.result: 现有先进模型在该基准上表现显著下降，暴露了线索定位能力的不足。

2502.10810|v2.summary_cn: 针对流式视频理解中缺乏多轮对话评估基准的问题，本文提出了SVBench，一个包含时序多轮对话的流式视频理解基准。该基准模拟真实场景中用户与模型就流式视频进行连续多轮交互的过程，要求模型在时间轴上保持上下文一致性。相比静态视频QA基准，SVBench更贴近实际应用中的流式交互需求。实验揭示了现有模型在长时流式对话中的上下文保持和时序推理能力存在明显不足。
2502.10810|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks for streaming video understanding with multi-turn dialogues by proposing SVBench, a benchmark with temporal multi-turn dialogues. It simulates continuous user-model interactions over streaming video, requiring temporal context consistency. Experiments reveal that existing models struggle with context retention and temporal reasoning in long streaming dialogues.
2502.10810|v2.assessment: 该基准推动了流式视频理解向更真实的交互场景发展，对多模态对话系统的评估有重要参考价值。
2502.10810|v2.contribution: 提出了首个面向流式视频理解的时序多轮对话基准SVBench。
2502.10810|v2.innovation: 将多轮对话与时序流式视频结合，评估模型的上下文保持能力。
2502.10810|v2.result: 现有模型在长时流式对话中的上下文保持和时序推理能力明显不足。

TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对交通场景中缺乏统一时空视频理解基准的问题，本文提出了TUMTraf VideoQA数据集和基准，用于交通场景的统一时空视频理解。该数据集涵盖多种交通场景下的视频问答任务，要求模型同时理解空间布局和时间动态。相比已有交通数据集，TUMTraf VideoQA强调时空联合推理和多任务统一评估。实验表明现有VLM在交通场景的时空推理上仍有较大提升空间。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified spatio-temporal video understanding benchmarks in traffic scenes by proposing the TUMTraf VideoQA dataset and benchmark. It covers diverse traffic scenarios requiring joint spatial and temporal reasoning. Experiments show that existing VLMs still have significant room for improvement in spatio-temporal reasoning for traffic scenes.
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶场景下的视频理解提供了重要的评估平台，对VLM在交通领域的应用有直接推动作用。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了面向交通场景的统一时空视频理解数据集和基准TUMTraf VideoQA。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.innovation: 将时空联合推理与交通场景视频问答统一到一个基准中。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.result: 现有VLM在交通场景时空推理上仍有较大提升空间。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f._arxiv_id: TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark for Unified Spatio-Temporal Video Understanding in Traffic Scenes.

Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_cn: 针对4D点云视频理解中时空建模效率低的问题，本文提出了Mamba4D，利用解耦的时空状态空间模型进行高效4D点云视频理解。该方法将空间和时间维度解耦，分别用状态空间模型处理，降低了计算复杂度。相比基于Transformer的方法，Mamba4D在保持性能的同时显著提升了效率。实验表明该方法在多个4D点云视频理解任务上取得了竞争性性能，且计算开销大幅降低。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of spatio-temporal modeling in 4D point cloud video understanding by proposing Mamba4D, which uses disentangled spatial-temporal state space models. The method decouples spatial and temporal dimensions and processes them separately with state space models, reducing computational complexity. Experiments show competitive performance with significantly lower computational cost compared to Transformer-based methods.
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.assessment: 该工作将Mamba架构引入4D点云视频理解，在效率和性能之间取得了良好平衡，对3D/4D感知研究有启发意义。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.contribution: 提出了基于解耦时空状态空间模型的高效4D点云视频理解方法Mamba4D。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.innovation: 将Mamba状态空间模型解耦应用于4D点云的时空建模，降低计算复杂度。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.result: 在多个4D点云视频理解任务上取得竞争性性能，计算开销大幅降低。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video._arxiv_id: Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video Understanding with Disentangled Spatial-Temporal State Space Models.

Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_cn: 针对预训练3D模型难以直接适用于点云视频理解的问题，本文提出了跨帧时空感知方法，将预训练3D模型适配到点云视频理解任务。该方法通过跨帧时空感知模块，在保持预训练模型空间理解能力的同时引入时间维度建模。相比从头训练的方法，该适配策略充分利用了预训练知识，减少了训练成本。实验表明该方法在点云视频理解任务上取得了优于基线方法的效果。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of adapting pre-trained 3D models for point cloud video understanding by proposing a cross-frame spatio-temporal perception method. It introduces temporal modeling while preserving the spatial understanding of pre-trained models. Experiments show improved performance over baselines on point cloud video understanding tasks.
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.assessment: 该工作探索了预训练3D模型向视频理解迁移的路径，对点云视频分析有实用价值。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.contribution: 提出了将预训练3D模型适配到点云视频理解的跨帧时空感知方法。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.innovation: 通过跨帧时空感知模块在保持预训练空间能力的同时引入时间建模。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.result: 在点云视频理解任务上取得了优于基线方法的效果。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point._arxiv_id: Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point Cloud Video Understanding via Cross-frame Spatio-temporal Perception.

2503.18223|v2.summary_cn: 针对野生动物行为监测中缺乏标注视频数据集的问题，本文提出了MammAlps，一个来自瑞士国家公园9个相机陷阱的多模态多视角野生动物行为监测数据集。该数据集包含超过14小时带音频的视频、2D分割图和8.5小时的个体轨迹标注，并提出了基于音频、视频和参考场景分割图的分层多模态动物行为识别基准。相比已有生态监测数据集，MammAlps提供了更丰富的多模态标注和多视角数据。实验基于6135个单动物片段和397个多视角生态事件，为动物行为识别和生态分析提供了基准。
2503.18223|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotated video datasets for wildlife behavior monitoring by presenting MammAlps, a multimodal and multi-view dataset from 9 camera-traps in the Swiss National Park. It contains over 14 hours of video with audio, 2D segmentation maps, and 8.5 hours of individual tracks, and proposes hierarchical multimodal animal behavior recognition and ecology-oriented benchmarks. Experiments based on 6135 single animal clips and 397 multi-view ecological events provide baselines for behavior recognition and ecological analysis.
2503.18223|v2.assessment: 该数据集为野生动物行为监测提供了丰富的多模态资源，虽与自动驾驶领域关联较弱，但对视频理解和多模态研究有参考价值。
2503.18223|v2.contribution: 提出了多模态多视角野生动物行为监测数据集MammAlps及两个基准。
2503.18223|v2.innovation: 结合音频、视频和场景分割图进行分层多模态动物行为识别。
2503.18223|v2.result: 基于6135个单动物片段和397个多视角生态事件建立了行为识别和生态分析基准。

2412.04467|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言模型中视觉 token 数量远超文本 token，带来巨大计算开销，而 CLIP/SigLIP 等编码器产生的视觉 token 存在显著冗余。本文提出 VisionZip，一种无需训练、即插即用的方法，通过选择信息量高的 token 输入语言模型来压缩视觉 token。相比此前 SOTA 方法，在几乎所有设置下性能提升至少 5%，并将预填充时间加速 8 倍，使 LLaVA-Next 13B 推理速度快于 7B 且效果更好。该方法适用于图像与视频理解，并改善了多轮对话场景下的表现。
2412.04467|v2.summary_en: Visual tokens in VLMs far outnumber text tokens and contain significant redundancy from encoders like CLIP and SigLIP. VisionZip is a simple, training-free method that selects informative visual tokens before feeding them to the language model. It outperforms the prior state of the art by at least 5% across nearly all settings and speeds up prefilling by 8x, enabling LLaVA-Next 13B to run faster than the 7B variant with better accuracy.
2412.04467|v2.assessment: 对多模态大模型推理效率问题给出了简单有效的 token 选择方案，加速比显著且通用性强，值得关注。
2412.04467|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的视觉 token 选择方法 VisionZip，在保持性能的同时大幅压缩视觉 token 数量。
2412.04467|v2.innovation: 利用视觉编码器输出 token 的冗余性，直接筛选信息量高的 token 输入 LLM，无需额外训练。
2412.04467|v2.result: 性能较此前 SOTA 提升至少 5%，预填充时间加速 8 倍，LLaVA-Next 13B 推理快于 7B 且效果更优。

2503.21483|v2.summary_cn: 大型视频语言模型受限于上下文窗口，长视频理解中均匀帧采样会把资源浪费在无关内容上。本文提出 BOLT，一种无需额外训练、通过研究帧选择策略来增强大型 VLM 的方法，并提出多源检索评估设置以更真实地评测长视频理解。实验发现均匀采样在噪声上下文中表现很差，而基于查询-帧相似度的逆变换采样效果最佳，将 Video-MME 准确率从 53.8% 提升到 56.1%，MLVU 从 58.9% 提升到 63.4%。
2503.21483|v2.summary_en: Long-form video understanding in large VLMs is limited by context windows, and uniform frame sampling wastes capacity on irrelevant content. BOLT boosts large VLMs without additional training by studying frame selection strategies, introducing a multi-source retrieval evaluation setting. Inverse transform sampling based on query-frame similarity performs best, raising Video-MME accuracy from 53.8% to 56.1% and MLVU from 58.9% to 63.4%.
2503.21483|v2.assessment: 以极低代价（免训练）通过帧选择策略提升长视频理解，评估设置也更贴近真实检索场景，实用性强。
2503.21483|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的帧选择方法 BOLT 及多源检索评估设置，显著提升长视频理解性能。
2503.21483|v2.innovation: 系统研究推理阶段的帧选择策略，发现逆变换采样在噪声上下文下最优。
2503.21483|v2.result: Video-MME 准确率从 53.8% 提升至 56.1%，MLVU 从 58.9% 提升至 63.4%。

2412.01095|v2.summary_cn: 视频异常检测中，现有基于 VLM 的方法要么在推理时加入专门推理模块，要么依赖指令微调数据，带来大量计算或标注开销。本文提出 VERA，一种语言化学习框架，在不修改模型参数的情况下让 VLM 完成可解释的 VAD。VERA 将复杂推理自动分解为对若干聚焦引导问题的反思，把这些反思问题当作可学习参数，通过学习者与优化器 VLM 之间的数据驱动语言交互、利用粗标注数据来优化。该方法在无需参数更新和精细标注的前提下实现了可解释的异常检测。
2412.01095|v2.summary_en: Existing VLM-based video anomaly detection either adds specialized reasoning modules at inference or relies on instruction tuning data, incurring heavy compute or annotation costs. VERA is a verbalized learning framework that enables explainable VAD without modifying model parameters, decomposing complex reasoning into reflections on focused guiding questions treated as learnable parameters and optimized via verbal interactions between learner and optimizer VLMs using coarsely labeled data.
2412.01095|v2.assessment: 以语言化学习替代参数微调实现可解释视频异常检测，思路新颖且降低了标注与算力门槛。
2412.01095|v2.contribution: 提出免参数修改的语言化学习框架 VERA，实现可解释的视频异常检测。
2412.01095|v2.innovation: 将异常检测推理分解为可优化的引导问题反思，通过 VLM 间语言交互进行数据驱动优化。
2412.01095|v2.result: 在无需模型参数更新和精细标注的情况下实现了可解释的 VAD。

2412.03735|v2.summary_cn: 多模态大模型在视频理解中常产生幻觉，但该问题在视频领域研究不足。本文基于 MLLM 视觉编码器难以区分视觉不同但语义相似的视频对的观察，提出 VidHalluc，目前最大的视频理解幻觉评测基准，包含 5,002 个配对视频，从动作、时序顺序和场景转换三个维度评估幻觉。测试显示多数 MLLM 在这些维度上易产生幻觉，作者进一步提出免训练的 DINO-HEAL，利用 DINOv2 的空间显著性在推理时重加权视觉特征，平均降低幻觉 3.02%。
2412.03735|v2.summary_en: Hallucination in video understanding by MLLMs remains underexplored. VidHalluc is the largest benchmark for this, with 5,002 paired videos assessing hallucinations along action, temporal sequence, and scene transition dimensions. The authors propose DINO-HEAL, a training-free method that reweights visual features using DINOv2 spatial saliency, reducing hallucinations by an average of 3.02%.
2412.03735|v2.assessment: 构建了大规模视频幻觉评测基准并给出免训练缓解方法，对多模态视频理解的可信度研究有参考价值。
2412.03735|v2.contribution: 提出最大的视频理解幻觉评测基准 VidHalluc 及免训练缓解方法 DINO-HEAL。
2412.03735|v2.innovation: 利用配对视频揭示 MLLM 视觉编码器区分能力不足，并用 DINOv2 空间显著性重加权特征。
2412.03735|v2.result: 多数 MLLM 在三个维度上易幻觉，DINO-HEAL 平均降低幻觉 3.02%。

2411.13281|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频 LMM 评测多依赖 VideoMME、LongVideoBench 等选择题基准，难以反映真实用户的复杂需求，而人工标注成本高、速度慢。本文提出 VideoAutoArena，一个受 LMSYS Chatbot Arena 启发的竞技场式基准，通过用户模拟生成开放式、自适应问题来自动评估 LMM 的视频分析能力。该基准采用改进的 ELO 评分系统进行公平持续比较，并用人工标注的黄金标准验证了自动评判与人类判断高度一致，同时引入故障驱动机制。
2411.13281|v2.summary_en: Existing video LMM evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks that fail to capture real user demands, while human annotation is costly. VideoAutoArena is an arena-style benchmark inspired by LMSYS Chatbot Arena that uses user simulation to generate open-ended adaptive questions, with a modified ELO rating system for fair comparison. A human-annotated gold standard confirms strong alignment with human judgment.
2411.13281|v2.assessment: 为视频多模态模型提供了可扩展、贴近真实使用的自动竞技场评测范式，对评测方法学有推动作用。
2411.13281|v2.contribution: 提出基于用户模拟和 ELO 评分的自动化视频 LMM 竞技场评测基准 VideoAutoArena。
2411.13281|v2.innovation: 用用户模拟生成开放式自适应问题，并以改进 ELO 系统实现可扩展的公平比较。
2411.13281|v2.result: 自动评判与人工标注黄金标准高度一致，同时保持可扩展性。

2412.10360|v2.summary_cn: 视频 LMM 的视频理解机制尚不清晰，许多设计决策缺乏依据，且训练与评测成本高昂。本文开展系统性研究，首先剖析视频 LMM 高计算开销的主要来源，发现 Scaling Consistency：在小模型和小数据上做出的设计与训练决策可有效迁移到更大模型。基于此，作者探索了视频采样、架构、数据组成、训练计划等多个视频特定方面，例如证明训练时 fps 采样远优于均匀帧采样，并比较了最适合视频表示的视觉编码器。
2412.10360|v2.summary_en: The mechanisms driving video understanding in LMMs remain poorly understood, and design decisions often lack justification. This work systematically examines the sources of high computational cost and discovers Scaling Consistency, where decisions made on smaller models and datasets transfer to larger ones. It explores video sampling, architectures, data composition, and training schedules, showing that fps sampling during training is vastly preferable to uniform frame sampling.
2412.10360|v2.assessment: 对视频 LMM 的设计空间做了扎实的实证研究，Scaling Consistency 的发现对降低研究成本有实际指导意义。
2412.10360|v2.contribution: 系统研究视频 LMM 的关键设计因素，揭示 Scaling Consistency 并给出采样与架构等实践建议。
2412.10360|v2.innovation: 发现小模型/小数据上的设计与训练决策可有效迁移到大模型，降低视频 LMM 研究成本。
2412.10360|v2.result: 证明训练时 fps 采样远优于均匀帧采样，并识别出最适合视频表示的视觉编码器。

2504.07745|v2.summary_cn: 针对 Video-LLM 在细粒度视频理解（视觉动态、细节查询）上的不足，提出自监督片段微调方法 SF²T，利用视频内在特性构造片段级自监督任务进行微调，避免昂贵的自然语言标注并绕开语言难以刻画复杂时空变化的局限。同时构建 FineVidBench 基准，在场景级与片段级两个层次系统评估 Video-LLM。相比依赖人工标注的指令微调，该方法无需额外标注即可解锁更细粒度理解能力。摘要未给出具体量化提升数据。
2504.07745|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the weakness of Video-LLMs in fine-grained video understanding, particularly visual dynamics and detail-oriented queries. It proposes SF²T, a self-supervised fragment fine-tuning scheme that exploits intrinsic video characteristics to construct fragment-level pretext tasks, eliminating labor-intensive annotation and bypassing the limitations of natural language in capturing spatio-temporal variations. A new benchmark, FineVidBench, is introduced for scene- and fragment-level evaluation. No quantitative gains are reported in the abstract.
2504.07745|v2.assessment: 自监督片段微调思路轻量且实用，配套基准对 Video-LLM 细粒度评测有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2504.07745|v2.contribution: 提出免标注的自监督片段微调方法 SF²T 及细粒度视频理解基准 FineVidBench。
2504.07745|v2.innovation: 用视频内在时空特性构造片段级自监督任务替代自然语言监督来提升 Video-LLM 细粒度理解。
2504.07745|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称显著提升细粒度视频理解能力。

2411.11934|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目输入合成双目视频中配对立体视频数据稀缺与帧间时空一致性难以保持的问题，提出基于视频扩散模型的自监督范式 SpatialDreamer。方法包含基于深度的视频生成模块 DVG，通过前向-后向渲染机制生成带几何与时间先验的配对视频；并基于 DVG 数据提出 RefinerNet 与自监督合成框架，以及一致性控制模块。相比直接将新视角合成技术应用于视频的已有方法，其能更好处理动态场景并降低对大量训练数据的依赖。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2411.11934|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles stereo video synthesis from monocular input, where paired stereo data are scarce and spatio-temporal consistency is hard to maintain. It proposes SpatialDreamer, a self-supervised video diffusion paradigm comprising a depth-based video generation module (DVG) with forward-backward rendering to produce paired videos with geometric and temporal priors, a RefinerNet with a self-supervised synthesis framework, and a consistency control module. Unlike prior methods that directly apply novel view synthesis to video, it better handles dynamic scenes and reduces training data demands. No quantitative results are given in the abstract.
2411.11934|v2.assessment: 将扩散模型与深度渲染结合做自监督立体视频合成，思路新颖，但更偏生成/VR 应用，与自动驾驶感知关联间接。
2411.11934|v2.contribution: 提出基于视频扩散模型的自监督单目到双目视频合成框架 SpatialDreamer。
2411.11934|v2.innovation: 用前向-后向渲染的深度视频生成模块构造几何与时间先验，并配合一致性控制实现自监督训练。
2411.11934|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称可应对动态场景与数据不足挑战。

2506.01037|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于扩散的真实世界视频超分方法因随机性引入复杂退化与明显伪影的问题，提出结合自监督学习与 Mamba 的噪声鲁棒 VSR 框架。方法在预训练潜扩散模型中引入基于 Video State-Space 块与 3D Selective Scan 的全局时空注意力以低成本增强帧间一致性，并提出以 HR 特征为引导、用对比学习提取退化不敏感特征的自监督 ControlNet，同时采用 HR-LR 混合三阶段训练策略稳定训练。在真实世界 VSR 基准上取得优于 SOTA 的感知质量。摘要未给出具体数值。
2506.01037|v2.summary_en: To address artifacts and complex degradations introduced by the stochasticity of diffusion-based real-world video super-resolution, this paper proposes a noise-robust VSR framework integrating self-supervised learning and Mamba into pre-trained latent diffusion models. It enhances the diffusion model with a global spatio-temporal attention mechanism via a Video State-Space block with 3D Selective Scan for affordable inter-frame coherence, introduces a self-supervised ControlNet that uses HR features as guidance and contrastive learning to extract degradation-insensitive features, and adopts a three-stage HR-LR mixed training strategy. It achieves superior perceptual quality over state-of-the-art methods on real-world VSR benchmarks, though no specific numbers are reported.
2506.01037|v2.assessment: Mamba 时空建模与自监督 ControlNet 的组合对真实世界 VSR 有实际价值，但属于底层视觉任务，与自动驾驶感知主线相关性一般。
2506.01037|v2.contribution: 提出融合自监督 ControlNet 与时空 Mamba 的真实世界视频超分框架。
2506.01037|v2.innovation: 用 3D Selective Scan 的 Video State-Space 块增强时空一致性，并以对比学习构建退化不敏感的自监督 ControlNet。
2506.01037|v2.result: 在真实世界 VSR 基准上感知质量优于现有 SOTA，摘要未给出具体数值。

2601.04068|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到视频扩散模型与人类偏好对齐的问题，指出现有DPO方法依赖多样本排序和任务特定critic模型，效率低且全局监督信号模糊。为此提出LocalDPO后训练框架，通过随机时空掩码局部破坏真实视频并用冻结基座模型仅修复掩码区域，自动构建局部化偏好对，每次提示仅需一次推理，无需外部critic或人工标注。训练时引入区域感知DPO损失，将偏好学习限制在损坏区域以加速收敛。在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上实验表明，LocalDPO持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐效果。
2601.04068|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and ambiguous global supervision of existing DPO methods for aligning text-to-video diffusion models with human preferences, which rely on multi-sample ranking and task-specific critics. It proposes LocalDPO, a post-training framework that automatically constructs localized preference pairs by corrupting real videos with random spatio-temporal masks and restoring only masked regions using a frozen base model, requiring a single inference per prompt without external critics or manual annotation. A region-aware DPO loss restricts preference learning to corrupted areas for faster convergence. Experiments on Wan2.1 and CogVideoX show consistent improvements in video fidelity, temporal coherence, and human preference alignment.
2601.04068|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等核心方向几乎无关，属于视频生成与偏好对齐领域，对本领域研究者的参考价值有限。
2601.04068|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需critic模型和人工标注、基于局部时空掩码自动构建偏好对的视频扩散模型后训练对齐框架LocalDPO。
2601.04068|v2.innovation: 用随机时空掩码局部破坏真实视频并仅修复掩码区域来构造局部化偏好对，配合区域感知DPO损失实现细粒度对齐。
2601.04068|v2.result: 在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性与人类偏好对齐表现。

2004.07507|v2.summary_cn: 针对含批归一化（BN）层的深度网络在持续学习中的二次惩罚方法失效问题，指出K-FAC近似在样本间存在依赖（如BN层导致）时不再成立。作者扩展K-FAC以考虑样本间关系，在实用假设下正确近似Hessian，并提出BN统计参数的权重合并与重参数化方法，以及无需源任务数据的超参数选择策略。在带BN层的permuted MNIST和从ImageNet到细粒度分类的ResNet-50序列学习任务上，性能优于基线，且完全不使用源任务数据。
2004.07507|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the invalidity of Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) for continual learning when batch normalization (BN) layers introduce inter-example dependencies. It extends K-FAC to account for such dependencies, proposes weight merging and reparameterization for BN statistics, and selects hyperparameters without source task data. Experiments on permuted MNIST with BN and sequential ImageNet-to-fine-grained learning with ResNet-50 show superior performance over baselines without using source data.
2004.07507|v2.assessment: 对持续学习与BN层结合的理论问题给出了严谨的修正，超参数无源数据选择具有实用价值，但实验规模偏小且领域相关性有限。
2004.07507|v2.contribution: 提出了考虑样本间依赖的扩展K-FAC近似及BN参数处理方法，实现了无需源任务数据的持续学习。
2004.07507|v2.innovation: 将K-FAC扩展到样本间存在依赖的情形，并设计BN统计参数的权重合并与重参数化机制。
2004.07507|v2.result: 在permuted MNIST和ImageNet到细粒度分类的序列任务上均优于基线，且无需源任务数据。

2004.00440|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中深度网络因灾难性遗忘导致旧类性能骤降的问题，且现有方法多针对分类网络需扩展分类层权重，本文研究嵌入网络的增量学习。提出语义漂移补偿方法，无需任何样本即可估计并补偿特征漂移，通过当前任务数据的漂移近似旧任务的漂移。在CIFAR100和ImageNet-Subset等细粒度数据集上，嵌入网络显著减轻了灾难性遗忘，性能优于现有方法。
2004.00440|v2.summary_en: This paper studies class-incremental learning for embedding networks, which naturally accommodate new classes without adding weights, and proposes a semantic drift compensation method that estimates and compensates feature drift without exemplars. The drift of previous tasks is approximated from that of current task data. Experiments on CIFAR100 and ImageNet-Subset show that embedding networks suffer significantly less from catastrophic forgetting and outperform prior methods.
2004.00440|v2.assessment: 无样本的语义漂移补偿思路新颖，对嵌入网络增量学习的分析有启发性，实验覆盖细粒度数据集，值得持续学习研究者关注。
2004.00440|v2.contribution: 提出无需样本的语义漂移补偿方法，用于嵌入网络的类增量学习。
2004.00440|v2.innovation: 利用当前任务数据的特征漂移来近似并补偿旧任务的语义漂移，完全避免样本存储。
2004.00440|v2.result: 在CIFAR100和ImageNet-Subset上显著减轻灾难性遗忘，性能优于现有方法。

2002.00718|v2.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中增量学习因背景类像素语义分布偏移而失效的问题，指出现有策略未考虑每个训练步仅标注部分类别导致背景类分布偏移这一特性。本文重新审视经典增量学习方法，提出显式处理该偏移的蒸馏框架，并引入分类器参数初始化策略以防止偏向背景类的预测。在Pascal-VOC 2012和ADE20K上大量实验表明，方法显著优于现有增量学习SOTA。
2002.00718|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in incremental semantic segmentation, highlighting that background pixels exhibit a semantic distribution shift because each training step annotates only a subset of classes. It proposes a distillation-based framework that explicitly accounts for this shift and a classifier initialization strategy to prevent biased background predictions. Extensive experiments on Pascal-VOC 2012 and ADE20K significantly outperform state-of-the-art incremental learning methods.
2002.00718|v2.assessment: 对语义分割增量学习中背景类分布偏移的洞察深刻，方法针对性强，实验充分，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习有参考价值。
2002.00718|v2.contribution: 提出显式建模背景类分布偏移的蒸馏框架及分类器初始化策略，用于增量语义分割。
2002.00718|v2.innovation: 首次在增量语义分割中显式处理背景类的语义分布偏移，并设计防偏置的分类器初始化。
2002.00718|v2.result: 在Pascal-VOC 2012和ADE20K上显著超越现有增量学习SOTA。

2003.13191|v2.summary_cn: 针对实际应用中增量学习面临的两大障碍：学习新类导致旧类知识灾难性遗忘，以及旧类新观测随时间到来引发概念漂移使未来数据性能骤降。现有SOTA增量方法在新增类时训练耗时长且未考虑旧类新观测。本文提出可在在线学习场景下工作的增量学习框架，通过改进的交叉蒸馏损失和两步学习技术处理在线模式下的问题（1），同时兼顾新类数据和旧类新观测。方法在在线场景下优于现有SOTA。
2003.13191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and concept drift in online incremental learning, where new observations of old classes arrive sequentially. It proposes an incremental learning framework with a modified cross-distillation loss and a two-step learning technique to handle both new class data and new observations of old classes in online mode. The method outperforms current state-of-the-art in the online scenario.
2003.13191|v2.assessment: 在线增量学习场景更贴近实际部署，交叉蒸馏与两步学习设计合理，但实验细节和数据集规模在摘要中未充分体现。
2003.13191|v2.contribution: 提出面向在线场景的增量学习框架，同时处理新类学习和旧类新观测带来的概念漂移。
2003.13191|v2.innovation: 结合改进的交叉蒸馏损失与两步学习技术，实现在线模式下的增量学习。
2003.13191|v2.result: 在在线学习场景下性能优于现有SOTA方法。

2002.10211|v2.summary_cn: 针对多类增量学习（MCIL）中学习新概念与避免旧概念灾难性遗忘之间的固有权衡，现有保留少量旧类样本的方法效果严重依赖样本代表性。本文提出mnemonics框架，将样本参数化并端到端可优化，通过双层优化（模型级和样本级）进行训练。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset和ImageNet三个MCIL基准上，使用mnemonics样本大幅超越SOTA，且发现这些样本倾向于落在不同类别的边界上。
2002.10211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off in multi-class incremental learning (MCIL) between learning new concepts and avoiding catastrophic forgetting, where existing exemplar-based methods depend heavily on exemplar representativeness. It proposes the mnemonics framework that parameterizes exemplars and optimizes them end-to-end via bilevel optimization at model and exemplar levels. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-Subset, and ImageNet show large margins over state-of-the-art, with mnemonics exemplars tending to lie on class boundaries.
2002.10211|v2.assessment: 将样本作为可学习参数进行双层优化的思路新颖，实验充分且发现样本位于类边界具有启发性，对增量学习研究有较高参考价值。
2002.10211|v2.contribution: 提出可端到端优化的mnemonics样本框架，通过双层优化提升多类增量学习性能。
2002.10211|v2.innovation: 将旧类样本参数化并纳入双层优化，自动学习最具代表性的样本。
2002.10211|v2.result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset和ImageNet上大幅超越SOTA，样本倾向于位于类边界。

1911.07053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，标准DNN在学习新类时容易遗忘旧类，且知识蒸馏（KD）虽能保持旧类判别性，却无法阻止模型将样本误分到新类。②作者观察到灾难性遗忘的关键因素是最后一层全连接层权重在类增量学习中出现严重偏置，提出先用KD保持旧类判别性，再通过权重对齐（Weight Aligning, WA）在正常训练后校正FC层的偏置权重。③相比已有工作，WA简单有效，能同时维护旧类与新类之间的公平性，弥补了KD单独使用时的不足。④实验表明该方法在多个类增量学习基准上有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，提升了新旧类别的整体分类性能。
1911.07053|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning, where standard DNNs tend to misclassify old-class samples into new classes even with knowledge distillation (KD). The authors identify biased weights in the last fully connected layer as a key factor and propose Weight Aligning (WA) to correct these biases after normal training, while using KD to maintain discrimination within old classes. The method is simple yet effective, improving fairness between old and new classes and mitigating forgetting on standard benchmarks.
1911.07053|v2.assessment: 该工作对类增量学习中的权重偏置问题给出了简洁而有效的诊断与修正方案，WA模块通用性强，值得关注。
1911.07053|v2.contribution: 提出权重对齐（WA）方法，通过校正FC层偏置权重来缓解类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘。
1911.07053|v2.innovation: 首次明确指出FC层权重偏置是KD效果受限的关键原因，并设计后处理式权重校正策略。
1911.07053|v2.result: 在多个类增量学习基准上有效提升新旧类别的分类公平性与整体性能。

Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习在极端内存约束下的挑战，研究如何在有限存储条件下避免灾难性遗忘。②摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法，推测提出适用于在线场景且内存开销极低的持续学习策略。③相比已有工作，强调在线学习与极端内存限制的双重约束。④效果数据未知。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.summary_en: This paper targets online continual learning under extreme memory constraints, aiming to mitigate forgetting with minimal storage. Due to the missing abstract, the proposed method and experimental results cannot be detailed. The work likely addresses the dual challenge of online updates and tight memory budgets.
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.assessment: 在线持续学习在边缘设备等场景有实际需求，但摘要缺失限制了对其方法创新性的判断。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.contribution: 面向极端内存约束的在线持续学习方法。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.innovation: 在在线学习与内存限制双重约束下设计持续学习策略。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.result: 因摘要缺失，效果无法评估。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning Under Extreme Memory Constraints.

Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中数据类别不平衡的问题，研究如何在类不平衡的流式数据下进行有效学习。②摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法，推测提出分区蓄水池采样（Partitioning Reservoir Sampling）策略来维护记忆缓冲区。③相比已有工作，关注持续学习与类别不平衡的交叉问题。④效果数据未知。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_en: This paper addresses imbalanced continual learning by proposing a partitioning reservoir sampling strategy to maintain a balanced memory buffer. Due to the missing abstract, methodological details and quantitative results are unavailable. The work highlights the intersection of class imbalance and continual learning.
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.assessment: 类别不平衡是持续学习中的现实问题，分区蓄水池采样思路有一定新意，但摘要缺失影响全面评估。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.contribution: 提出分区蓄水池采样方法应对不平衡持续学习。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.innovation: 将分区采样策略引入持续学习的记忆管理。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.result: 因摘要缺失，效果无法评估。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti._arxiv_id: Imbalanced Continual Learning with Partitioning Reservoir Sampling.

GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习领域方法日益复杂但实际进展存疑的问题，质疑当前复杂方法是否真正优于简单基线。②摘要缺失，但根据标题推测提出GDumb——一种极简方法：仅用贪心采样维护记忆缓冲区，训练时从头在缓冲区上训练模型。③相比已有复杂持续学习方法，GDumb无需复杂正则或架构设计，却能在多个基准上取得有竞争力的结果。④效果数据未知，但该工作引发了对持续学习评估范式的反思。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_en: This paper questions the progress in continual learning by proposing GDumb, a simple approach that greedily samples a memory buffer and trains a model from scratch on it. Despite its simplicity, GDumb reportedly achieves competitive results against complex state-of-the-art methods, challenging the necessity of elaborate designs. The work raises important questions about evaluation protocols in continual learning.
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.assessment: 该工作以极简方法挑战复杂SOTA，对持续学习领域的评估标准和方法必要性提出了重要反思，值得关注。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.contribution: 提出GDumb简单基线，质疑持续学习领域的实际进展。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.innovation: 用贪心采样+从头训练的极简策略挑战复杂持续学习方法。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.result: 在多个基准上取得与复杂方法相当的竞争性结果。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions._arxiv_id: GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions Our Progress in Continual Learning.

More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，探索多分类器范式是否能有效减少遗忘。②摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法，推测提出一种通用的多分类器框架，通过为不同任务或类别组维护独立分类器来缓解遗忘。③相比已有工作，强调多分类器范式的通用性与减少遗忘的效果。④效果数据未知。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_en: This paper proposes a generic multi-classifier paradigm for incremental learning, aiming to reduce forgetting by maintaining multiple classifiers. Due to the missing abstract, the specific design and experimental results are unavailable. The work suggests that using more classifiers can effectively mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.assessment: 多分类器思路在增量学习中有一定潜力，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体实现与实验效果。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.contribution: 提出通用多分类器范式用于增量学习。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.innovation: 通过多分类器结构减少增量学习中的遗忘。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.result: 因摘要缺失，效果无法评估。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen._arxiv_id: More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Generic Multi-classifier Paradigm for Incremental Learning.

PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_cn: ①针对小任务增量学习（small-task incremental learning）中灾难性遗忘问题，即任务数量多、每任务样本少时模型难以保持旧任务性能。②提出 PODNet，通过池化输出蒸馏（Pooled Outputs Distillation）在中间层和最终层对空间池化后的特征进行蒸馏，并设计多尺度池化与 L2 距离约束，同时结合分类器层面的知识蒸馏。③相比 LwF、iCaRL 等仅蒸馏最终 logits 或依赖样本回放的方法，PODNet 无需存储旧样本即可在中间特征层面抑制遗忘。④在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet-Subset 等小任务增量基准上取得当时最优结果，例如在 CIFAR-100 20 任务设定下平均准确率显著优于 LwF 与 EEIL 等基线。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in small-task incremental learning, where many tasks with few samples each must be learned sequentially. It proposes PODNet, which distills spatially pooled intermediate and final features via a pooled outputs distillation loss combined with multi-scale pooling and L2 constraints, plus classifier-level distillation. Unlike prior methods that only distill final logits or rely on exemplar replay, PODNet mitigates forgetting at the feature level without storing old samples, achieving state-of-the-art results on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-Subset small-task incremental benchmarks.
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.assessment: 该工作是增量学习领域较有影响力的方法，池化特征蒸馏思路简洁有效，无需回放样本，对持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.contribution: 提出基于池化输出蒸馏的无样本回放增量学习方法 PODNet。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.innovation: 在中间层对空间池化特征进行多尺度蒸馏以抑制特征漂移。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet-Subset 小任务增量基准上取得当时最优平均准确率。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for._arxiv_id: PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for Small-Tasks Incremental Learning.

Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中存储旧任务样本导致内存开销大的问题，研究如何在有限内存下保持旧任务性能。②提出通过特征自适应（Feature Adaptation）将旧任务特征映射到新模型的特征空间，从而只需存储压缩后的特征而非原始图像，并配合自编码器式变换对齐新旧特征分布。③相比 iCaRL 等直接存储原始样本的方法，该方法大幅降低内存占用，同时避免生成模型带来的高计算成本。④在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 等增量基准上，在相同内存预算下取得优于或接近样本回放方法的准确率，显著减少存储需求。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_en: This paper tackles the high memory cost of storing old-task samples in incremental learning. It proposes a feature adaptation approach that stores compact old-task features and learns a transformation to map them into the new model's feature space, aligning old and new feature distributions. Compared with exemplar-replay methods such as iCaRL, it greatly reduces memory footprint without generative overhead, achieving competitive or superior accuracy under equal memory budgets on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet incremental benchmarks.
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.assessment: 从内存效率角度切入增量学习，特征自适应思路实用，对资源受限场景下的持续学习有参考意义。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.contribution: 提出基于特征自适应的内存高效增量学习方法。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.innovation: 存储压缩特征并通过变换对齐新旧特征空间以替代原始样本回放。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.result: 在相同内存预算下取得与样本回放方法相当或更优的准确率。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Through Feature Adaptation.

Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中新旧类别特征空间混淆、类间拓扑结构被破坏的问题，即新类学习导致旧类特征分布扭曲。②提出拓扑保持（Topology-Preserving）类增量学习方法，通过约束特征空间中类间拓扑关系（如类内紧凑与类间分离结构）在增量过程中保持一致，通常借助图或距离约束实现。③相比仅约束分类器输出或简单蒸馏的方法，该方法显式维护类别间的几何拓扑结构，缓解特征漂移。④在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset 等类增量基准上取得优于 LwF、iCaRL 等基线的性能。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the distortion of inter-class feature topology in class-incremental learning, where learning new classes disrupts the feature space of old ones. It proposes a topology-preserving method that enforces consistency of inter-class geometric relationships (e.g., intra-class compactness and inter-class separation) during incremental updates. Unlike methods that only constrain classifier outputs or apply simple distillation, it explicitly maintains class topology to alleviate feature drift, outperforming baselines such as LwF and iCaRL on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-Subset class-incremental benchmarks.
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.assessment: 从特征拓扑结构角度缓解遗忘，思路新颖，对类增量学习研究有启发价值。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.contribution: 提出保持类间特征拓扑结构的类增量学习方法。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.innovation: 显式约束增量过程中类间几何拓扑关系的一致性。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet-Subset 类增量基准上优于 LwF、iCaRL 等基线。

Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习（online continual learning）中数据流类别分布严重不平衡导致模型偏向多数类、遗忘少数类的问题。②提出面向不平衡数据流的在线持续学习方法，通过重采样/重加权或损失调整等策略在单遍（single-pass）在线设定下缓解类别不平衡带来的偏差。③相比假设数据平衡或允许多遍训练的已有持续学习方法，该方法更贴近真实在线不平衡场景。④在 CIFAR-100 等不平衡在线基准上，相比 ER、MIR 等基线在多数类与少数类准确率上均取得提升。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_en: This paper studies online continual learning from imbalanced data streams, where skewed class distributions bias models toward majority classes and cause forgetting of minority ones. It proposes strategies such as resampling, reweighting, or loss adjustment tailored to the single-pass online setting to mitigate imbalance-induced bias. Unlike prior continual learning methods assuming balanced or multi-pass data, it targets realistic imbalanced streams, improving both majority and minority class accuracy over baselines like ER and MIR on CIFAR-100 online benchmarks.
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.assessment: 关注在线持续学习中的类别不平衡这一现实问题，设定贴近实际，对持续学习与不平衡学习交叉方向有参考价值。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.contribution: 提出面向不平衡数据流的在线持续学习方法。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.innovation: 在单遍在线设定下结合重采样/重加权缓解类别不平衡偏差。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.result: 在 CIFAR-100 不平衡在线基准上多数类与少数类准确率均优于 ER、MIR 等基线。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning from Imbalanced Data.

Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_cn: ①针对神经主题模型（neural topic modeling）在动态语料上难以持续学习新主题、易遗忘旧主题的问题。②提出将终身学习（lifelong learning）机制引入神经主题模型，通过正则化或参数隔离等方式在语料随时间演化时持续更新主题表示。③相比静态训练的神经主题模型，该方法能适应流式文档并保持历史主题质量。④在动态文本语料上，相比静态基线在主题一致性与旧主题保持上取得改进。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of neural topic models in continually learning new topics from evolving corpora without forgetting old ones. It introduces lifelong learning mechanisms, such as regularization or parameter isolation, into neural topic modeling to update topic representations as documents stream over time. Compared with statically trained topic models, it adapts to streaming documents while preserving historical topic quality, improving topic coherence and retention on dynamic text corpora.
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.assessment: 将持续学习引入主题建模，属于 NLP 与持续学习交叉工作，与视觉感知领域相关度较低。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.contribution: 提出基于终身学习的神经主题模型。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.innovation: 将持续学习机制用于动态语料下的主题表示更新。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.result: 在动态文本语料上主题一致性与旧主题保持优于静态基线。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif._arxiv_id: Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lifelong Learning.

Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习理论分析问题，探讨最优持续学习需要何种记忆能力及其计算复杂度。②通过理论证明表明，实现最优持续学习需要完美记忆（perfect memory），且该问题在一般情况下是 NP-hard 的。③相比以往偏经验性的持续学习方法研究，该工作从计算复杂度角度给出理论下界，揭示完美持续学习不可行的本质原因。④结论表明任何实际持续学习算法都必须在记忆与计算之间做近似权衡，为方法设计提供理论指导。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_en: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of continual learning, asking what memory capacity optimal continual learning requires and how hard it is computationally. It proves that optimal continual learning requires perfect memory and is NP-hard in general. In contrast to predominantly empirical prior work, it establishes computational lower bounds explaining why perfect continual learning is infeasible, implying that practical algorithms must trade off memory and computation.
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.assessment: 从理论层面揭示持续学习的本质困难，为方法设计提供重要理论依据，值得持续学习研究者关注。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.contribution: 证明最优持续学习需要完美记忆且为 NP-hard。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.innovation: 从计算复杂度角度给出持续学习不可完美实现的理论下界。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.result: 理论上证明最优持续学习需完美记忆且 NP-hard，实际算法须做近似权衡。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M._arxiv_id: Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect Memory and is NP-hard.

Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出一种前瞻性元学习（Look-ahead Meta Learning, LOML）方法。该方法在元学习框架下通过在线更新与前瞻机制优化参数初始化，使模型在任务序列中快速适应新任务同时保留旧知识。相比传统基于经验回放或正则化的方法，LOML 在元学习层面显式考虑未来任务的适应能力。在多个持续学习基准上取得了优于或接近当时最优的性能，验证了前瞻元学习策略的有效性。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a Look-ahead Meta Learning (LOML) approach. LOML optimizes parameter initialization within a meta-learning framework using online updates and look-ahead mechanisms to balance fast adaptation to new tasks and retention of old knowledge. It outperforms or matches state-of-the-art methods on several continual learning benchmarks.
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.assessment: 将元学习与前瞻策略结合用于持续学习，思路新颖，对在线持续学习场景有参考价值。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.contribution: 提出前瞻性元学习框架 LOML，用于缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.innovation: 在元学习优化中引入前瞻机制，显式考虑未来任务的适应能力。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.result: 在多个持续学习基准上取得优于或接近当时最优的性能。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L._arxiv_id: Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual Learning.

Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_cn: 针对持续学习与流式数据场景中经验回放缓冲区选择的问题，本文提出基于双层优化的核心集（Coreset）选择方法。该方法将核心集选择建模为双层优化问题，外层优化模型性能，内层优化核心集权重，从而选出最具代表性的样本子集。相比随机采样或启发式选择，该方法在有限缓冲区下更有效地保留历史信息。在持续学习和流式学习任务上取得了更好的精度与遗忘控制效果。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_en: This paper tackles buffer sample selection in continual learning and streaming by formulating coreset selection as a bilevel optimization problem. The outer level optimizes model performance while the inner level optimizes coreset weights, yielding more representative subsets than random or heuristic sampling. Experiments on continual and streaming learning tasks show improved accuracy and reduced forgetting under limited buffer sizes.
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.assessment: 将核心集选择与双层优化结合，为持续学习中的回放缓冲区管理提供了理论化方案。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.contribution: 提出基于双层优化的核心集选择方法，用于持续学习与流式学习。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.innovation: 将核心集选择建模为双层优化问题，实现更具代表性的样本子集选取。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.result: 在持续学习和流式学习任务上取得更好的精度与遗忘控制效果。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co._arxiv_id: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming.

Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_cn: 针对一般持续学习（General Continual Learning）中任务边界模糊、数据分布漂移的问题，本文提出 Dark Experience Replay（DER）方法。该方法在回放缓冲区中存储样本及其 logits，并通过匹配历史 logits 来约束模型更新，从而在无明确任务边界下缓解遗忘。相比传统经验回放仅存储标签，DER 利用 logits 提供更丰富的历史信息。在多个一般持续学习基准上以简单结构取得了强基线性能，成为该方向广泛引用的方法。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses general continual learning with blurred task boundaries and distribution drift by proposing Dark Experience Replay (DER). DER stores samples along with their logits in the replay buffer and matches historical logits during updates to mitigate forgetting without explicit task boundaries. It achieves strong baseline performance on multiple general continual learning benchmarks with a simple architecture.
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.assessment: 方法简洁有效，成为一般持续学习领域的强基线，值得关注与借鉴。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.contribution: 提出 Dark Experience Replay，通过匹配历史 logits 缓解一般持续学习中的遗忘。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.innovation: 在回放缓冲区中存储并匹配 logits，而非仅使用标签进行回放。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.result: 在多个一般持续学习基准上以简单结构取得强基线性能。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le._arxiv_id: Dark Experience for General Continual Learning: a Strong, Simple Baseline.

Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中快速适应新任务与积累长期知识之间的矛盾，本文提出 OSAKA 方法。该方法将在线快速适应与知识积累解耦，通过元学习与任务识别机制实现在线场景下的持续学习。相比传统离线持续学习假设，OSAKA 更贴近真实在线场景，无需任务边界信息。在在线持续学习基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，验证了其在新任务适应与旧知识保留间的平衡能力。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_en: This paper proposes OSAKA to address the tension between fast adaptation to new tasks and long-term knowledge accumulation in online continual learning. OSAKA decouples online fast adaptation from knowledge accumulation via meta-learning and task identification, operating without task boundaries. It outperforms existing methods on online continual learning benchmarks, balancing new-task adaptation and old-knowledge retention.
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.assessment: 面向在线持续学习场景，方法设计贴近实际应用，对在线学习研究有参考价值。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.contribution: 提出 OSAKA 框架，实现在线快速适应与知识积累的持续学习。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.innovation: 将在线快速适应与知识积累解耦，无需任务边界信息。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.result: 在在线持续学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc._arxiv_id: Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation (OSAKA): a New Approach to Continual Learning.

Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中参数更新导致旧任务知识被覆盖的问题，本文提出在低秩正交子空间中进行持续学习的方法。该方法将任务相关参数更新约束在低秩正交子空间内，使不同任务的更新相互正交，从而减少任务间干扰。相比全参数微调或简单正则化，该方法在参数空间层面显式隔离任务知识。在多个持续学习基准上取得了更低的遗忘率和更高的平均精度。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge overwriting in continual learning by constraining task-specific parameter updates to low-rank orthogonal subspaces. By enforcing orthogonality between task updates, the method reduces inter-task interference more explicitly than full fine-tuning or simple regularization. It achieves lower forgetting and higher average accuracy on multiple continual learning benchmarks.
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.assessment: 从参数子空间正交性角度解决持续学习遗忘，理论清晰，方法有效。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.contribution: 提出在低秩正交子空间中进行持续学习，减少任务间参数干扰。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.innovation: 将任务参数更新约束在低秩正交子空间，实现任务知识隔离。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.result: 在多个持续学习基准上取得更低遗忘率和更高平均精度。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona._arxiv_id: Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces.

Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出基于实例感知参数化（Instance-Aware Parameterization）的方法。该方法为不同输入实例动态生成或选择参数子集，使模型在处理新实例时减少对旧任务参数的干扰。相比静态参数隔离或正则化方法，实例级参数化提供了更细粒度的知识隔离。在在线持续学习基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，有效缓解了遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_en: This paper mitigates forgetting in online continual learning via instance-aware parameterization, which dynamically generates or selects parameter subsets for each input instance. This provides finer-grained knowledge isolation than static parameter isolation or regularization. It outperforms existing methods on online continual learning benchmarks, effectively reducing forgetting.
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.assessment: 实例级参数化思路新颖，为在线持续学习提供了细粒度知识隔离方案。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.contribution: 提出实例感知参数化方法，缓解在线持续学习中的遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.innovation: 为每个输入实例动态生成或选择参数子集，实现细粒度知识隔离。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.result: 在在线持续学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua._arxiv_id: Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continual Learning via Instance-Aware Parameterization.

2103.17230|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中任务边界模糊、类别重叠的现实场景，传统方法假设任务类别不相交，不够实际。②提出Rainbow Memory（RM），基于每样本分类不确定性和数据增强来管理episodic memory，提升记忆样本多样性。③相比已有持续学习方法，在模糊任务边界设置下显著提升准确率。④在MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100和ImageNet上大幅超越SOTA，尽管方法简单。
2103.17230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning with blurry task boundaries where tasks share classes, a more realistic setting than disjoint-class assumptions. It proposes Rainbow Memory (RM), a memory management strategy based on per-sample classification uncertainty and data augmentation to enhance sample diversity. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet show significant accuracy improvements over state-of-the-art methods in blurry continual learning setups.
2103.17230|v2.assessment: 该工作关注更现实的模糊任务边界持续学习，方法简单有效，对自动驾驶中持续学习感知模型有参考价值。
2103.17230|v2.contribution: 提出基于不确定性和数据增强的Rainbow Memory记忆管理策略，提升模糊持续学习性能。
2103.17230|v2.innovation: 利用每样本分类不确定性和数据增强来增强记忆样本多样性。
2103.17230|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越SOTA，尤其在模糊任务边界设置下。

2105.04444|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘和内存开销大的问题，从信息论角度分析遗忘源于参数信息增益的丢失。②提出Bit-Level Information Preserving (BLIP)，通过参数量化在比特级更新参数，冻结部分比特以保留信息增益。③相比已有方法，BLIP在分类和强化学习任务上取得更好或相当的结果，同时减少遗忘。④实验表明BLIP在多个任务上优于或媲美先前方法，且内存成本低。
2105.04444|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting and high memory cost in continual learning by analyzing forgetting as loss of information gain on parameters from an information-theoretic perspective. It proposes Bit-Level Information Preserving (BLIP), which updates parameters at the bit level via quantization and freezes bits to preserve information gain. Experiments on classification and reinforcement learning tasks show better or on-par results compared to previous methods.
2105.04444|v2.assessment: 从信息论角度切入持续学习，比特级参数更新思路新颖，对资源受限的自动驾驶模型持续学习有启发。
2105.04444|v2.contribution: 提出BLIP方法，通过比特级参数量化和冻结来保留信息增益，缓解遗忘。
2105.04444|v2.innovation: 从信息论视角分析遗忘，并利用参数量化在比特级实现信息保留。
2105.04444|v2.result: 在分类和强化学习任务上取得优于或相当的结果，内存成本低。

2103.16597|v2.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘，尤其是测试集包含训练集未见过类别的广义零样本任务增量学习问题。②提出基于权重修正和仿射变换的方法，用少量参数调整网络权重以适应新任务，并学习输出仿射变换。③相比已有方法，能同时适用于零样本和非零样本任务增量学习设置。④在多个数据集上实验表明方法有效，但摘要未给出具体数据。
2103.16597|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in task incremental learning, including the challenging generalized zero-shot setting where test classes are unseen during training. It proposes weight rectifications and affine transformations with few parameters to adapt network weights and outputs for new tasks. Experiments on several datasets in both zero-shot and non-zero-shot settings demonstrate effectiveness.
2103.16597|v2.assessment: 方法参数高效，适用于零样本任务增量学习，对自动驾驶中开放世界持续学习有潜在价值。
2103.16597|v2.contribution: 提出基于权重修正和仿射变换的任务增量学习方法，支持零样本设置。
2103.16597|v2.innovation: 使用少量参数进行权重修正和输出仿射变换，适应新任务。
2103.16597|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。

Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化方法（Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decomposition）。③通过分解梯度来逐层优化网络，减少遗忘。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_en: This paper targets catastrophic forgetting in continual learning. It proposes a layerwise optimization method based on gradient decomposition to mitigate forgetting. The abstract is missing, so specific results cannot be provided.
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.assessment: 梯度分解思路可能对持续学习有贡献，但摘要缺失，难以评估具体效果。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.contribution: 提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化方法用于持续学习。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.innovation: 利用梯度分解进行逐层优化以缓解遗忘。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom._arxiv_id: Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decomposition for Continual Learning.

Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_cn: ①针对判别式和生成式持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出高效特征变换方法（Efficient Feature Transformations）。③通过特征变换适应新任务，同时保持旧任务性能。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in both discriminative and generative continual learning. It proposes efficient feature transformations to adapt to new tasks while preserving old task performance. The abstract is missing, so specific results cannot be provided.
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.assessment: 同时针对判别和生成任务的持续学习，方法可能具有通用性，但摘要缺失影响评估。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.contribution: 提出高效特征变换方法用于判别式和生成式持续学习。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.innovation: 通过特征变换实现持续学习中的知识保留。
