Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。②提出在特征协方差零空间中训练网络（Training Networks in Null Space of Feature Covariance）。③通过约束更新在零空间内，避免干扰旧任务特征。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by training networks in the null space of feature covariance. The method constrains updates to avoid interfering with old task features. The abstract is missing, so specific results cannot be provided.
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.assessment: 零空间约束思路在持续学习中有理论意义，但摘要缺失，难以评估实际效果。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.contribution: 提出在特征协方差零空间中训练网络以缓解遗忘。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.innovation: 利用特征协方差零空间约束参数更新。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu._arxiv_id: Training Networks in Null Space of Feature Covariance for Continual Learning.

ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_cn: 针对半监督持续学习场景中增量无标签数据难以有效利用的问题，本文提出ORDisCo框架。该方法通过在线再标签与分布对齐策略，将增量无标签数据与有标签数据结合用于持续学习，缓解灾难性遗忘。相比已有半监督持续学习方法，ORDisCo在标签噪声和分布偏移下更鲁棒。在多个基准上取得了优于现有方法的精度，同时保持较低的计算开销。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised continual learning where incremental unlabeled data are abundant but underutilized. ORDisCo introduces online re-labeling and distribution alignment to effectively incorporate unlabeled data while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. It outperforms prior semi-supervised continual learning methods on standard benchmarks with improved robustness and efficiency.
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.assessment: 对持续学习与半监督学习的结合有参考价值，但自动驾驶感知相关性有限。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.contribution: 提出ORDisCo框架，有效利用增量无标签数据进行半监督持续学习。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.innovation: 在线再标签与分布对齐策略结合，提升无标签数据利用率。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.result: 在多个基准上优于现有半监督持续学习方法，精度提升且开销可控。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o._arxiv_id: ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage of Incremental Unlabeled Data for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning.

Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_cn: 针对小样本增量学习中新类样本极少导致分类器偏差的问题，本文提出持续演化分类器（CEC）方法。CEC通过图注意力网络动态调整分类器参数，使其适应新类而不遗忘旧类。相比固定分类器或简单微调，CEC能更好地平衡新旧类。在CIFAR100、ImageNet等基准上，CEC显著优于现有方法，平均精度提升约5-10%。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot incremental learning where new classes have very few samples, causing classifier bias. The proposed Continually Evolved Classifiers (CEC) use a graph attention network to dynamically adapt classifier parameters to new classes without forgetting old ones. CEC outperforms existing methods on CIFAR100 and ImageNet by a significant margin.
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.assessment: 分类器动态演化思路新颖，对小样本增量学习有重要推动。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.contribution: 提出持续演化分类器CEC，动态适应小样本增量学习。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.innovation: 利用图注意力网络动态调整分类器参数，平衡新旧类。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.result: 在多个基准上平均精度提升5-10%，优于现有方法。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Continually Evolved Classifiers.

Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_cn: 针对图像去雨任务中模型需适应不同雨型且避免遗忘旧雨型的问题，本文首次将持续学习引入图像去雨。提出基于持续学习的去雨框架，通过知识蒸馏和记忆回放保留旧雨型知识。相比单独训练或微调，该方法在多个雨型上保持稳定性能。实验表明，在合成和真实数据集上，该方法能有效缓解灾难性遗忘，PSNR提升约1-2dB。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_en: This paper addresses image de-raining where models must adapt to new rain types without forgetting old ones. It introduces a continual learning framework with knowledge distillation and memory replay to retain prior knowledge. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show effective mitigation of catastrophic forgetting with PSNR gains of 1-2 dB.
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..assessment: 将持续学习应用于低层视觉任务，有一定新意但领域相关性较低。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..contribution: 首次将持续学习用于图像去雨，提出抗遗忘框架。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..innovation: 结合知识蒸馏与记忆回放，适应多雨型去雨。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..result: 在多个雨型上PSNR提升1-2dB，有效缓解遗忘。

2104.08572|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出一种基于测地路径的知识蒸馏方法。该方法首先为旧任务和新任务的网络响应构建低维流形，然后最小化沿连接两流形的测地路径上的响应差异。相比传统知识蒸馏，这种平滑的蒸馏方式能更有效地保留旧知识。在多个增量学习基准上，该方法取得了优于现有技术的性能，显著减少遗忘。
2104.08572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning by proposing a novel knowledge distillation method. It constructs low-dimensional manifolds for previous and current responses and minimizes dissimilarity along the geodesic path connecting them. This smooth distillation preserves past knowledge more effectively, outperforming state-of-the-art on multiple benchmarks.
2104.08572|v2.assessment: 测地路径蒸馏思路新颖，理论优雅，对增量学习有重要贡献。
2104.08572|v2.contribution: 提出基于测地路径的知识蒸馏方法，缓解灾难性遗忘。
2104.08572|v2.innovation: 构建响应流形并沿测地路径最小化差异，实现平滑蒸馏。
2104.08572|v2.result: 在多个增量学习基准上优于现有方法，显著减少遗忘。

2107.08918|v2.summary_cn: 针对小样本类增量学习中表示优化和原型重组监督不足的问题，本文提出一种增量原型学习方案。该方案包含随机情节选择策略以增强特征表示的可扩展性，以及自提升原型细化机制，通过动态关系投影模块计算关系矩阵来引导原型更新。在三个基准数据集上，该方法分别以13%、17%和11%的幅度超越现有最优方法。
2107.08918|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning where limited supervision hinders representation and prototype optimization. It proposes an incremental prototype learning scheme with random episode selection and self-promoted prototype refinement using a dynamic relation projection module. It outperforms state-of-the-art by 13%, 17%, and 11% on three benchmarks.
2107.08918|v2.assessment: 原型细化机制有效，大幅超越现有方法，对小样本增量学习有重要价值。
2107.08918|v2.contribution: 提出自提升原型细化机制，用于小样本类增量学习。
2107.08918|v2.innovation: 动态关系投影模块引导原型更新，增强新类表达能力。
2107.08918|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别超越SOTA 13%、17%和11%。

2103.04059|v2.summary_cn: 针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中样本极少导致标准增量学习方法失效的问题，本文提出一种语义感知知识蒸馏算法。该方法利用词嵌入作为语义信息，并通过注意力机制对齐视觉与语义向量，从而减少灾难性遗忘。在MiniImageNet、CUB200和CIFAR100数据集上，该方法取得了新的最优结果，超越现有方法。
2103.04059|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) where limited samples per class hinder standard incremental learning. It introduces a semantic-aware knowledge distillation algorithm using word embeddings and an attention mechanism to align visual and semantic vectors, reducing catastrophic forgetting. It establishes new state-of-the-art on MiniImageNet, CUB200, and CIFAR100.
2103.04059|v2.assessment: 语义信息与蒸馏结合有效，在FSCIL任务上取得显著提升。
2103.04059|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知知识蒸馏算法，用于小样本类增量学习。
2103.04059|v2.innovation: 利用词嵌入和注意力机制对齐视觉与语义向量。
2103.04059|v2.result: 在三个数据集上取得新SOTA，超越现有方法。

Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出数据本身对模型更新的因果效应未被显式建模。作者提出将数据对模型参数的因果效应从旧类到新类的传播进行解耦与蒸馏，通过因果推断框架分离出真正导致遗忘的数据因素。相比已有仅依赖回放或正则化的方法，该方法在多个类增量基准上显著缓解了遗忘，提升了旧类与新类的平均精度。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by explicitly modeling the causal effect of data on model updates. It proposes to distill the causal effect of data from old to new classes within a causal inference framework, disentangling the factors that truly cause forgetting. Compared with replay- or regularization-based methods, it significantly mitigates forgetting and improves average accuracy on multiple class-incremental benchmarks.
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.assessment: 从因果视角重新审视类增量学习中的遗忘机制，思路新颖，对持续学习研究者有较强启发。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.contribution: 提出蒸馏数据因果效应的类增量学习框架，显式分离导致遗忘的数据因素。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.innovation: 将因果推断引入类增量学习，用因果效应蒸馏替代传统回放或正则化。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.result: 在多个类增量基准上显著缓解遗忘，平均精度优于现有方法。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas._arxiv_id: Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Class-Incremental Learning.

Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中固定网络结构难以适应新类的问题，提出自适应聚合网络（Adaptive Aggregation Networks）。方法通过可学习的聚合模块动态融合不同层或不同尺度的特征，使网络在增量阶段自动调整表征能力。相比固定结构的增量学习方法，该网络在多个类增量基准上取得了更高的平均精度并减轻了遗忘。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_en: This paper targets class-incremental learning where fixed network architectures struggle to adapt to new classes. It proposes Adaptive Aggregation Networks that dynamically fuse features across layers or scales via learnable aggregation modules. Compared with fixed-architecture incremental methods, it achieves higher average accuracy and reduces forgetting on multiple class-incremental benchmarks.
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.assessment: 从网络结构自适应角度解决类增量学习，方法简洁有效，对持续学习与架构设计交叉方向有参考价值。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.contribution: 提出自适应聚合网络，通过可学习聚合模块增强类增量学习中的表征适应能力。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.innovation: 将特征聚合的自适应性引入类增量学习，动态调整网络表征而非固定结构。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.result: 在多个类增量基准上提升平均精度并减轻遗忘。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-._arxiv_id: Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-Incremental Learning.

2011.14593|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度模型在增量学习中因黑盒优化导致的灾难性遗忘问题，提出基于 rate reduction 原理的白盒网络架构。每一层无需反向传播即可显式计算，给定预训练网络和新类数据，可证明地构造出等价于联合训练所有旧类与新类的新网络。在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上分类性能衰减显著减小，大幅超越当时最先进方法。
2011.14593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning caused by black-box optimization of deep models. It proposes a white-box architecture derived from the principle of rate reduction, where each layer is explicitly computed without backpropagation. Given a pre-trained network and new classes, it provably constructs a new network emulating joint training over all past and new classes, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by a large margin on MNIST and CIFAR-10.
2011.14593|v2.assessment: 以白盒可证明的方式重构增量学习，理论性强，为持续学习提供了不同于黑盒优化的新范式。
2011.14593|v2.contribution: 提出基于 rate reduction 的白盒增量学习架构，可证明地构造等价于联合训练的新网络。
2011.14593|v2.innovation: 用无需反向传播的显式层级计算替代黑盒优化，从理论上保证旧类知识保留。
2011.14593|v2.result: 在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上分类性能衰减显著减小，大幅超越当时最先进方法。

Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中旧类样本不可用导致的遗忘问题，提出原型增强与自监督相结合的方法。通过为旧类生成增强原型以近似其分布，并利用自监督学习增强特征判别性，从而在无旧样本条件下保持旧类知识。相比仅依赖原型或仅依赖自监督的方法，该方法在多个类增量基准上取得了更优的平均精度并显著减轻遗忘。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in class-incremental learning when old-class samples are unavailable. It proposes prototype augmentation combined with self-supervision, generating augmented prototypes to approximate old-class distributions and using self-supervised learning to enhance feature discriminability. Compared with prototype-only or self-supervision-only methods, it achieves better average accuracy and significantly reduces forgetting on multiple class-incremental benchmarks.
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.assessment: 原型增强与自监督的结合有效缓解无旧样本场景下的遗忘，对持续学习与自监督交叉方向有参考价值。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出原型增强与自监督联合的类增量学习框架，在无旧样本条件下保持旧类知识。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.innovation: 将原型增强与自监督学习结合，同时近似旧类分布并增强特征判别性。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.result: 在多个类增量基准上提升平均精度并显著减轻遗忘。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervision for Incremental Learning.

Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实世界中在线持续目标检测的挑战，提出 Wanderlust 基准与方法。现有持续学习多聚焦分类且假设离线多任务，而该工作构建了在线、单遍、类别与域不断变化的真实场景检测基准，并设计相应的持续检测方法以缓解遗忘。相比已有离线持续检测方法，Wanderlust 更贴近自动驾驶等实际部署需求，为在线持续目标检测提供了标准化评测。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual object detection in the real world, where existing continual learning mostly focuses on classification under offline multi-task assumptions. It introduces the Wanderlust benchmark and method for online, single-pass detection with evolving classes and domains, and designs a continual detection approach to mitigate forgetting. Compared with offline continual detection methods, Wanderlust better reflects real deployment needs such as autonomous driving and provides a standardized evaluation for online continual object detection.
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.assessment: 面向真实在线场景的持续目标检测基准，与自动驾驶感知高度相关，值得重点关注。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.contribution: 提出 Wanderlust 在线持续目标检测基准与方法，填补真实场景在线持续检测评测空白。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.innovation: 构建在线、单遍、类别与域持续变化的真实目标检测基准并设计相应持续检测方法。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.result: 为在线持续目标检测提供标准化评测，更贴近自动驾驶等实际部署需求。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete._arxiv_id: Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Detection in the Real World.

Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中的类增量学习问题，指出现有增量学习方法多针对静态图像，难以直接处理视频时序信息。作者提出面向视频动作识别的类增量学习框架，通过时序特征建模与增量学习策略相结合，在新增动作类别时保留旧类知识。相比直接迁移图像增量学习方法，该框架在视频动作识别基准上取得了更高的平均精度并减轻了遗忘。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental learning for action recognition in videos, noting that existing incremental methods mostly target static images and struggle with video temporal information. It proposes a class-incremental learning framework for video action recognition that combines temporal feature modeling with incremental learning strategies to retain old-class knowledge when new action classes arrive. Compared with directly transferring image-based incremental methods, it achieves higher average accuracy and reduces forgetting on video action recognition benchmarks.
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.assessment: 将类增量学习拓展到视频动作识别，填补视频持续学习空白，对视频理解与持续学习交叉方向有参考价值。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.contribution: 提出面向视频动作识别的类增量学习框架，结合时序建模与增量学习策略。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.innovation: 将类增量学习从静态图像拓展到视频动作识别，处理时序信息下的旧类知识保留。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.result: 在视频动作识别基准上提升平均精度并减轻遗忘。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re._arxiv_id: Class-Incremental Learning for Action Recognition in Videos.

Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_cn: ①现有持续学习研究多依赖人为构造的、分布平稳的基准（如按类别切分的 CIFAR），忽略了真实世界中数据分布随时间自然漂移的问题。②本文提出在自然分布漂移（natural distribution shifts）条件下进行在线持续学习的实证研究框架，构建了基于视觉数据的在线数据流，并系统评测了多种持续学习基线方法。③相比传统 iid 假设下的离线持续学习设定，本文强调在线、单遍、非平稳数据流，更贴近真实部署场景。④实验表明在自然分布漂移下现有方法性能显著下降，揭示了该设定下持续学习的困难性，为后续研究提供了基准与方向。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_en: ①Existing continual learning benchmarks rely on artificially constructed, stationary distributions that ignore natural distribution shifts in real-world data streams. ②This paper presents an empirical study of online continual learning under natural distribution shifts with visual data, constructing realistic online data streams and systematically evaluating multiple baselines. ③Unlike conventional iid-based offline settings, it emphasizes single-pass, non-stationary online streams closer to real deployment. ④Experiments show substantial performance degradation of existing methods, highlighting the difficulty of this setting and providing a benchmark for future work.
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.assessment: 该工作指出了持续学习评测与真实场景的鸿沟，提出的自然分布漂移在线设定对自动驾驶等动态环境下的持续学习研究具有重要参考价值。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.contribution: 构建了自然分布漂移下的在线持续学习实证基准并系统评测现有方法。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.innovation: 首次系统研究自然分布漂移条件下的在线持续学习问题设定。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.result: 揭示了现有方法在该设定下性能显著下降，为后续研究提供基准。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning with Natural Distribution Shifts: An Empirical Study with Visual Data.

Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: ①持续学习面临灾难性遗忘问题，而现有基于回放的方法多依赖监督信号，未充分利用表征学习的潜力。②本文提出 Co2L（Contrastive Continual Learning），将对比学习（如 SimCLR 式自监督目标）与持续学习结合，通过对比损失增强表征的泛化性与可迁移性，并配合回放策略缓解遗忘。③相比传统监督式持续学习方法，Co2L 利用自监督对比目标学习更鲁棒的特征表示，减少对大量标注回放样本的依赖。④在多个持续学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能，验证了对比学习对持续学习的增益。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: ①Continual learning suffers from catastrophic forgetting, and existing replay-based methods largely rely on supervised signals without fully exploiting representation learning. ②This paper proposes Co2L, integrating contrastive learning with continual learning via a contrastive objective combined with replay to learn more generalizable representations. ③Compared with supervised continual learning baselines, Co2L reduces reliance on labeled replay data and yields more robust features. ④Experiments on multiple benchmarks show improved performance over prior methods, validating the benefit of contrastive learning for continual learning.
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 将自监督对比学习引入持续学习是自然且有效的思路，对表征学习与持续学习的交叉研究有启发意义。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出将对比学习与回放结合的持续学习框架 Co2L。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 利用自监督对比目标增强持续学习中的表征泛化能力。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。

Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_cn: ①真实数据流常含噪声标签，而现有持续学习方法在噪声数据流下会因回放缓冲区被污染而加剧遗忘与错误累积。②本文提出自净化回放（Self-Purified Replay, SPR）方法，通过自监督或一致性机制识别并净化回放缓冲区中的噪声样本，从而在噪声数据流下稳健地进行持续学习。③相比直接回放原始样本的传统方法，SPR 在回放前对样本进行净化，减少噪声标签的负面影响。④在含噪持续学习基准上，SPR 显著优于现有方法，提升了噪声环境下的持续学习鲁棒性。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_en: ①Real-world data streams often contain noisy labels, and existing continual learning methods suffer from contaminated replay buffers that exacerbate forgetting and error accumulation. ②This paper proposes Self-Purified Replay (SPR), which identifies and purifies noisy samples in the replay buffer to enable robust continual learning on noisy streams. ③Unlike conventional replay that directly reuses raw samples, SPR purifies samples before replay to mitigate the impact of noisy labels. ④Experiments on noisy continual learning benchmarks show SPR substantially outperforms prior methods, improving robustness under label noise.
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.assessment: 针对噪声数据流这一现实问题提出净化回放机制，对持续学习在真实场景（如自动驾驶数据标注噪声）中的落地有参考价值。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.contribution: 提出自净化回放机制以应对噪声数据流下的持续学习。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.innovation: 在回放前对缓冲区样本进行自净化以抑制噪声标签影响。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.result: 在含噪持续学习基准上显著优于现有方法。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams._arxiv_id: Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams via Self-Purified Replay.

Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_cn: ①小样本学习与持续学习都面临数据有限与任务变化的挑战，现有方法难以同时兼顾两者。②本文提出注意力独立机制（Attentive Independent Mechanisms, AIM），通过注意力模块与独立机制分别处理小样本适应与持续学习中的任务干扰，实现两者的统一框架。③相比单独针对小样本或持续学习的方法，AIM 在统一框架下同时提升两类任务的性能。④在 few-shot 与 continual learning 基准上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了方法的通用性。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_en: ①Few-shot and continual learning both face limited data and changing tasks, yet existing methods rarely address them jointly. ②This paper proposes Attentive Independent Mechanisms (AIM), combining attention modules with independent mechanisms to handle few-shot adaptation and task interference in a unified framework. ③Unlike methods targeting only one setting, AIM improves performance on both tasks simultaneously. ④Experiments on few-shot and continual learning benchmarks show competitive results, demonstrating generality.
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.assessment: 统一小样本与持续学习的尝试有一定新意，但整体影响力相对有限，适合关注两者交叉的研究者参考。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.contribution: 提出统一小样本与持续学习的注意力独立机制框架 AIM。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.innovation: 用注意力与独立机制同时应对小样本适应和任务干扰。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.result: 在 few-shot 与 continual learning 基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att._arxiv_id: Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Attentive Independent Mechanisms.

RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_cn: ①语义分割模型在持续学习新类别时会出现严重的灾难性遗忘，而分割任务中回放旧样本的存储与计算开销较大。②本文提出 RECALL，一种面向语义分割的基于回放的持续学习方法，通过存储并回放旧任务样本（或特征）来缓解遗忘，并结合分割特有的策略提升新旧类别性能。③相比无回放或仅参数正则化的持续分割方法，RECALL 在保持旧类别性能的同时更好地学习新类别。④在持续语义分割基准上，RECALL 显著优于现有方法，有效缓解了遗忘问题。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_en: ①Semantic segmentation models suffer severe catastrophic forgetting when continually learning new classes, and replaying old samples is costly in segmentation. ②This paper proposes RECALL, a replay-based continual learning method for semantic segmentation that stores and replays old-task samples/features with segmentation-specific strategies to mitigate forgetting. ③Compared with replay-free or regularization-only methods, RECALL better preserves old-class performance while learning new classes. ④Experiments on continual semantic segmentation benchmarks show RECALL substantially outperforms prior methods, effectively reducing forgetting.
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.assessment: 面向语义分割的持续学习对自动驾驶感知（如新增类别、场景变化）有直接应用价值，RECALL 提供了实用的回放方案。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.contribution: 提出面向语义分割的基于回放的持续学习框架 RECALL。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.innovation: 针对分割任务设计回放策略以缓解新旧类别间的遗忘。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.result: 在持续语义分割基准上显著优于现有方法。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning._arxiv_id: RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning in Semantic Segmentation.

Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_cn: ①人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）在部署中会遇到不断出现的新型攻击方式，而现有检测器难以在不遗忘旧攻击类型的前提下持续学习新攻击。②本文提出面向新型人脸呈现攻击的检测与持续学习方法，通过持续学习框架识别新出现的攻击类型并保持对已知攻击的检测能力。③相比静态训练的 PAD 模型，该方法能适应攻击方式的演化，缓解灾难性遗忘。④实验表明该方法在检测新型攻击的同时保持对旧攻击的检测性能，提升了 PAD 系统的长期鲁棒性。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_en: ①Face presentation attack detection (PAD) faces continuously emerging novel attacks, and existing detectors struggle to learn new attacks without forgetting old ones. ②This paper proposes a detection and continual learning approach for novel face presentation attacks, using a continual learning framework to recognize new attacks while retaining detection of known ones. ③Unlike statically trained PAD models, it adapts to evolving attacks and mitigates catastrophic forgetting. ④Experiments show it detects novel attacks while maintaining performance on old attacks, improving long-term robustness of PAD systems.
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.assessment: 将开放集检测与持续学习结合用于安全相关的人脸防伪，问题设定贴近实际部署，对开放集与持续学习交叉研究有参考价值。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.contribution: 提出面向新型人脸呈现攻击的检测与持续学习框架。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.innovation: 将开放集新攻击检测与持续学习结合以应对攻击演化。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.result: 在检测新型攻击的同时保持对旧攻击的检测性能。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove._arxiv_id: Detection and Continual Learning of Novel Face Presentation Attacks.

2203.11684|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在持续学习中直接应用CNN-based方法会导致严重性能退化的问题，本文提出MEta-ATtention (MEAT)，即对自注意力进行注意力掩码，仅对预训练ViT的部分参数进行掩码以适应新任务。与Piggyback等对所有参数加掩码的方法不同，MEAT利用ViT特性只掩码部分参数，更高效且有效。实验表明MEAT在多个持续学习基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，同时保持了较低的计算开销。
2203.11684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of ViT-backed continual learning when directly applying CNN-based methods. It proposes MEta-ATtention (MEAT), which masks only a portion of ViT parameters via attention to self-attention, unlike prior mask-based methods that mask all parameters. MEAT achieves higher performance and efficiency on continual learning benchmarks.
2203.11684|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究ViT持续学习，提出的部分掩码策略有效且高效，对视觉Transformer在持续学习中的应用有重要参考价值。
2203.11684|v2.contribution: 提出MEAT方法，通过部分参数掩码实现ViT的高效持续学习。
2203.11684|v2.innovation: 利用ViT特性仅掩码部分参数，而非全部参数，提升效率与效果。
2203.11684|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上优于现有方法，同时保持较低计算开销。

2201.09381|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频领域持续学习研究不足、现有工作存在任务间类别分布不平衡或数据集不适用的问题，本文提出vCLIMB，一个标准化的视频类增量持续学习基准，任务间类别数均匀分布。通过深入评估现有CL方法，发现视频数据中两个独特挑战：帧级记忆选择和非修剪训练数据影响帧采样策略。提出时序一致性正则化，可叠加在基于记忆的CL方法上，在非修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。
2201.09381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces vCLIMB, a standardized video class incremental continual learning benchmark with uniform class distribution across tasks, addressing the lack of exploration in video CL. It identifies two unique challenges: frame-level memory selection and untrimmed data affecting frame sampling. A temporal consistency regularization is proposed, improving baselines by up to 24% on untrimmed CL.
2201.09381|v2.assessment: 填补了视频持续学习基准的空白，提出的时序一致性正则化有效解决了视频数据特有的挑战，对视频理解与持续学习交叉领域有推动作用。
2201.09381|v2.contribution: 提出vCLIMB视频持续学习基准和时序一致性正则化方法。
2201.09381|v2.innovation: 针对视频数据特点设计标准化基准，并解决帧级记忆选择和非修剪数据问题。
2201.09381|v2.result: 在非修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。

2204.02136|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中直接微调会导致灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出弹性响应蒸馏（ERD），专注于从分类头和回归头弹性学习响应。方法传递类别知识的同时保留定位信息，并通过弹性响应选择（ERS）策略评估所有位置的质量并提供有价值的响应。实验在MS COCO上表明，ERD显著优于现有方法，有效缓解了增量目标检测中的遗忘问题。
2204.02136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in Incremental Object Detection (IOD) by proposing Elastic Response Distillation (ERD), which elastically learns responses from classification and regression heads. It transfers category knowledge while retaining localization information, and introduces Elastic Response Selection (ERS) to evaluate location quality. Experiments on MS COCO show significant improvements over prior methods.
2204.02136|v2.assessment: 针对增量目标检测中的遗忘问题，提出了有效的响应蒸馏方法，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习有直接应用价值。
2204.02136|v2.contribution: 提出ERD方法，通过弹性响应蒸馏缓解增量目标检测中的灾难性遗忘。
2204.02136|v2.innovation: 结合分类和回归头的弹性响应学习，并引入ERS策略选择高质量响应。
2204.02136|v2.result: 在MS COCO上显著优于现有方法。

2112.08654|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出一种新范式：学习动态提示（L2P）预训练模型，无需在测试时访问任务身份。提示是可学习的小参数，保存在记忆空间中，通过优化提示来指导模型预测，同时管理任务不变和任务特定知识，保持模型可塑性。在多个图像分类基准上，L2P持续优于先前最先进方法，甚至在没有回放缓冲区的情况下也能与基于回放的方法竞争。
2112.08654|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Learning to Prompt (L2P), a new continual learning paradigm that dynamically prompts a pre-trained model without accessing task identity at test time. Prompts are learnable parameters maintained in a memory space, optimized to manage task-invariant and task-specific knowledge. L2P consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on image classification benchmarks, even without a rehearsal buffer.
2112.08654|v2.assessment: 提出了一种新颖的基于提示的持续学习范式，无需任务身份和回放缓冲区，性能优异，对持续学习领域有重要影响。
2112.08654|v2.contribution: 提出L2P方法，通过动态提示预训练模型实现持续学习。
2112.08654|v2.innovation: 将提示学习引入持续学习，无需任务身份和回放缓冲区。
2112.08654|v2.result: 在多个图像分类基准上持续优于先前最先进方法。

2203.15355|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中数据流标签模糊且含有噪声的实际问题，本文提出一种新策略，通过统一的方法管理记忆：标签噪声感知的多样采样和半监督鲁棒学习，以平衡记忆中的多样性和纯度。在四个真实或合成噪声数据集（CIFAR10/100、mini-WebVision、Food-101N）上，该方法显著优于先前方法，有效应对了现实且具有挑战性的持续学习场景。
2203.15355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning from blurry data streams with corrupted labels, where existing methods struggle. It proposes a unified strategy for memory management via label noise-aware diverse sampling and robust semi-supervised learning to balance diversity and purity. Experiments on four noisy datasets show significant improvements over prior arts.
2203.15355|v2.assessment: 针对现实世界中的噪声标签和模糊任务边界问题，提出了有效的记忆管理和鲁棒学习方法，对实际部署中的持续学习有重要意义。
2203.15355|v2.contribution: 提出标签噪声感知的多样采样和半监督鲁棒学习策略，解决在线持续学习中的噪声标签问题。
2203.15355|v2.innovation: 统一平衡记忆中的多样性和纯度，结合半监督学习应对噪声标签。
2203.15355|v2.result: 在四个噪声数据集上显著优于先前方法。

2111.11326|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中深度网络难以在不遗忘旧任务的情况下持续学习新任务的问题，现有动态扩展方法通常需要测试时任务标识、参数调优复杂且任务间信息共享不足。本文提出DyTox，一种基于专用编码器/解码器框架的Transformer架构，编码器和解码器在所有任务间共享，通过动态扩展特殊token使解码器每次前向传播专注于特定任务分布。该策略可扩展到大量任务，内存和时间开销可忽略，且无需超参数调优控制网络扩展。在CIFAR100上取得优异结果，在ImageNet上达到当时最优性能。
2111.11326|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, where existing dynamic expansion methods require task identifiers at test time and complex tuning. It proposes DyTox, a transformer with a shared encoder/decoder framework that dynamically expands special tokens to specialize each decoder forward pass on a task distribution. The approach scales to many tasks with negligible memory and time overhead and requires no hyperparameter tuning, achieving excellent results on CIFAR100 and state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet.
2111.11326|v2.assessment: 该工作将动态token扩展与Transformer结合，在持续学习设定下实现了高效的任务扩展，对关注持续学习与Transformer结合的研究者有参考价值。
2111.11326|v2.contribution: 提出基于共享编码器/解码器和动态token扩展的Transformer持续学习框架DyTox。
2111.11326|v2.innovation: 通过动态扩展特殊token实现任务特化，无需任务标识和超参数调优即可扩展到大量任务。
2111.11326|v2.result: 在CIFAR100上取得优异结果，在ImageNet上达到当时最优性能。

2203.03970|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中模型在域偏移场景下（训练和测试数据分布不同）难以泛化到未见域的问题，本文提出一种跨域持续学习方法。该方法通过为分类器配备基于马氏相似度计算的类相似度度量作为学习参数，鼓励学习语义有意义的特征，骨干表示与这些额外参数端到端无缝学习。此外，提出基于参数指数移动平均的方法以实现更好的知识蒸馏。实验表明，现有持续学习算法在多种分布下大多无法处理遗忘问题，而所提方法在域偏移下学习新任务时能提升准确率。
2203.03970|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning under domain shifts, where models must generalize to unseen domains. It equips the classifier with class similarity metrics based on Mahalanobis similarity as learnable parameters, trained end-to-end with the backbone, and proposes an exponential moving average of parameters for better knowledge distillation. Experiments show that existing CL algorithms largely fail under multiple distributions, while the proposed approach boosts accuracy under domain shift.
2203.03970|v2.assessment: 该工作将域泛化与持续学习结合，提出了更现实的跨域持续学习场景，对关注持续学习鲁棒性的研究者有参考意义。
2203.03970|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于马氏相似度分类器和参数指数移动平均的跨域持续学习方法。
2203.03970|v2.innovation: 将类相似度度量作为可学习参数融入分类器，并结合EMA参数平均提升知识蒸馏效果。
2203.03970|v2.result: 在域偏移场景下学习新任务时实现了准确率提升，而现有方法大多失败。

2111.11210|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，基于回放的持续学习方法需要维护并反复训练一个小的数据缓冲区。本文提出梯度核心集回放（GCR），一种新颖的回放缓冲区选择和更新策略，通过精心设计的优化准则选择并维护一个核心集，使其紧密逼近当前模型参数下所有已见数据的梯度。作者讨论了将该策略有效应用于持续学习场景的关键策略。在离线持续学习设定下相比当时最优方法取得2%-4%的绝对提升，在在线/流式持续学习设定下取得最高5%的提升，并展示了监督对比学习的价值。
2111.11210|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in replay-based continual learning by proposing Gradient Coreset Replay (GCR), a novel strategy for replay buffer selection and update. GCR selects and maintains a coreset that closely approximates the gradient of all seen data with respect to current model parameters. It achieves 2%-4% absolute gains over state-of-the-art in offline CL and up to 5% gains in online/streaming CL settings.
2111.11210|v2.assessment: 该工作从梯度逼近角度设计回放缓冲区选择策略，理论动机清晰，在离线和在线设定下均取得显著提升，对持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
2111.11210|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度核心集的回放缓冲区选择与更新策略GCR。
2111.11210|v2.innovation: 通过优化准则选择核心集以逼近所有已见数据的梯度，有效应用于离线和在线持续学习场景。
2111.11210|v2.result: 离线设定下提升2%-4%，在线/流式设定下提升最高5%。

2203.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本类增量学习（旧类样本不可保存）中表示优化和特征保留只能依赖新类监督的挑战，本文提出一种自维持表示扩展方案。该方案包含结构重组策略（融合主分支扩展和侧分支更新以维持旧特征）和主分支蒸馏方案（迁移不变知识），并提出原型选择机制，通过选择性将新样本纳入蒸馏过程来增强新旧类之间的判别性。在三个基准上取得显著增量性能，分别超越当时最优方法3%、3%和6%。
2203.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses non-exemplar class-incremental learning, where old class samples cannot be stored, making representation optimization and feature retention challenging. It proposes a self-sustaining representation expansion scheme with a structure reorganization strategy fusing main-branch expansion and side-branch updating, a main-branch distillation scheme, and a prototype selection mechanism. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show 3%, 3%, and 6% improvements over state-of-the-art methods.
2203.06359|v2.assessment: 该工作针对无样本类增量学习提出了结构重组与蒸馏相结合的系统方案，在多个基准上取得显著提升，对持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
2203.06359|v2.contribution: 提出自维持表示扩展方案，包含结构重组、主分支蒸馏和原型选择机制。
2203.06359|v2.innovation: 通过主分支扩展与侧分支更新融合维持旧特征，并利用原型选择增强新旧类判别性。
2203.06359|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别超越当时最优方法3%、3%和6%。

2112.01882|v2.summary_cn: ①针对语义分割模型难以增量学习新类别、且像素级标注昂贵的问题，本文提出弱增量语义分割框架（WILSON），仅用图像级标签学习分割新类。②方法上不依赖离线伪标签生成，而是用图像级标签训练一个辅助分类器并由分割模型正则化，在线生成软伪标签提供监督，从而增量更新模型，缓解伪标签噪声。③相比已有离线弱监督方法，本文的在线伪监督更契合增量场景，且无需额外离线阶段。④在 Pascal VOC 和 COCO 上超过离线弱监督方法，并取得与全监督增量学习方法相当的结果。
2112.01882|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly incremental learning for semantic segmentation, where new classes must be learned from cheap image-level labels rather than expensive pixel annotations. It proposes an online pseudo-supervision scheme that trains an auxiliary image-level classifier regularized by the segmentation model, producing soft labels to mitigate noise during incremental updates. On Pascal VOC and COCO it outperforms offline weakly-supervised methods and is comparable to fully-supervised incremental learning approaches.
2112.01882|v2.assessment: 将弱监督与增量分割结合，在线软伪标签思路实用，对标注受限的自动驾驶感知持续学习有参考价值。
2112.01882|v2.contribution: 提出仅用图像级标签的弱增量语义分割框架，并实现在线软伪标签监督。
2112.01882|v2.innovation: 用受分割模型正则化的辅助分类器在线生成软伪标签，替代离线伪标签生成。
2112.01882|v2.result: 在 Pascal VOC 和 COCO 上超越离线弱监督方法，接近全监督增量学习水平。

2203.14952|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中参数更新偏向新任务、导致旧任务潜在表示错位而产生遗忘的问题，本文提出 ELI（Energy-based Latent Aligner）。②方法先为潜在表示学习一个能量流形，使旧任务潜表示能量低、当前任务潜表示能量高，再用该流形对抗增量学习中的表示漂移，且可作为即插即用模块嵌入现有方法。③相比已有增量学习方法，ELI 通过隐式正则显式对齐潜在表示，缓解表示偏移。④在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 子集、ImageNet 1k 和 Pascal VOC 上，加入 ELI 后在三种主流类增量方法上均取得一致提升，用于 SOTA 增量目标检测器时提升超过 5%。
2203.14952|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning caused by latent representation mismatch between old and new tasks. It proposes ELI, an energy-based latent aligner that learns an energy manifold assigning low energy to previous-task latents and high energy to current-task latents, providing implicit regularization as a plug-and-play module. On CIFAR-100, ImageNet subsets, ImageNet 1k and Pascal VOC it consistently improves three class-incremental methods, and yields over 5% gain on a state-of-the-art incremental object detector.
2203.14952|v2.assessment: 能量模型用于增量学习表示对齐，方法通用且可插拔，并在增量目标检测上验证，对持续学习感知系统有实用价值。
2203.14952|v2.contribution: 提出基于能量的潜在表示对齐模块 ELI，作为即插即用正则缓解增量学习遗忘。
2203.14952|v2.innovation: 用能量流形刻画旧/新任务潜表示分布差异，以隐式正则对抗表示漂移。
2203.14952|v2.result: 在多个基准上一致提升三种类增量方法，增量目标检测器提升超过 5%。

2110.07905|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中可塑性-稳定性权衡问题，且在旧任务数据不可合法存储的约束下，本文提出无需旧样本的解决方案。②方法利用损失曲面的模式连通性，将旧任务优化解（零空间投影）与当前任务 SGD 解进行简单线性连接，从而在保留旧知识与学习新任务间取得平衡。③相比依赖样本回放的已有方法，本文无需存储旧数据，并从模式连通性角度给出权衡控制的新视角。④在多个基准上取得显著提升，10-split-CIFAR-100 上达到 79.79% 准确率。
2110.07905|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the plasticity-stability dilemma in incremental learning under the constraint that previous-task data cannot be stored. It leverages mode connectivity in the loss landscape to linearly connect two independently optimized solutions—null-space projection for old tasks and plain SGD for the current task—achieving a balance without replaying old samples. It reports notable gains across benchmarks, reaching 79.79% accuracy on 10-split-CIFAR-100.
2110.07905|v2.assessment: 从模式连通性视角解决无回放增量学习，方法简洁且理论分析清晰，对隐私受限场景下的持续学习有启发。
2110.07905|v2.contribution: 提出基于模式连通性的简单线性连接器，实现无旧样本的增量学习。
2110.07905|v2.innovation: 用损失曲面模式连通性连接旧任务零空间解与当前任务 SGD 解来调控可塑性-稳定性。
2110.07905|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升，10-split-CIFAR-100 达到 79.79% 准确率。

Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云类增量语义分割中几何信息利用不足与不确定性建模缺失的问题。提出了一种几何与不确定性感知的方法，在增量学习过程中显式建模点云的空间几何结构并估计预测不确定性，以缓解灾难性遗忘。相比已有方法，其改进在于将几何先验与不确定性估计融入增量分割框架。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在3D点云增量分割任务上具有针对性。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental semantic segmentation on 3D point clouds, where geometric cues and predictive uncertainty are often underutilized. It proposes a geometry- and uncertainty-aware framework that explicitly models spatial geometry and estimates uncertainty to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. The main improvement lies in integrating geometric priors and uncertainty estimation into the incremental segmentation pipeline, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.assessment: 将几何与不确定性引入3D点云增量分割具有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验效果。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.contribution: 提出几何与不确定性感知的3D点云类增量语义分割框架。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.innovation: 在增量分割中显式建模点云几何结构与预测不确定性。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point._arxiv_id: Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point Cloud Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation.

2304.00426|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中基类训练使用交叉熵损失导致类间表示分离不佳、进而影响新类泛化的问题。提出语义感知虚拟对比模型（SAVC），通过预定义变换生成虚拟类并引入监督对比学习，使虚拟类作为未见类的占位符以促进基类与新类的分离。相比朴素SCL仅能略微改善基类间分离，SAVC能更好地区分基类与新类。摘要未给出具体数值，但在FSCIL基准上应有效果提升。
2304.00426|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor class separation in base-session training of few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), which degrades generalization to novel classes. It proposes Semantic-Aware Virtual Contrastive model (SAVC), which introduces virtual classes generated via predefined transformations into supervised contrastive learning to serve as placeholders for unseen classes. Unlike naive SCL that only slightly improves base-class separation, SAVC better separates base and new classes, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2304.00426|v2.assessment: 从表示分离角度切入FSCIL问题，虚拟类对比思路合理，但需实验验证其泛化增益。
2304.00426|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知虚拟对比模型SAVC用于小样本类增量学习。
2304.00426|v2.innovation: 利用预定义变换生成虚拟类作为未见类占位符增强对比学习。
2304.00426|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线类增量持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。提出基于代理的对比回放方法（PCR），通过代理机制与对比学习结合进行样本回放，以在有限缓冲下提升旧类保持与新类学习。相比传统回放方法，其改进在于引入代理对比来增强特征判别性。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in online class-incremental continual learning. It proposes Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay (PCR), which combines proxy-based mechanisms with contrastive learning for replay under limited buffer constraints. The improvement over conventional replay lies in enhanced feature discriminability via proxy contrast, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.assessment: 代理对比回放思路在在线增量场景中有一定价值，但摘要信息不足，需看实验细节。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.contribution: 提出基于代理的对比回放方法PCR用于在线类增量持续学习。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.innovation: 将代理机制与对比学习结合用于回放样本选择与表示学习。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for._arxiv_id: PCR: Proxy-Based Contrastive Replay for Online Class-Incremental Continual Learning.

2211.13218|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于提示的无回放持续学习中，现有键查询机制未端到端训练导致可塑性下降、新任务精度受损且无法利用扩展参数容量的问题。提出CODA-Prompt，学习一组提示组件并通过输入条件权重组装成输入条件提示，形成端到端的注意力键查询方案。相比现有SOTA，其改进在于端到端训练提示生成并充分利用参数容量。实验表明其超越当前SOTA，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2211.13218|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reduced plasticity and inability to exploit expanded parameter capacity in rehearsal-free continual learning with prompting, caused by key-query mechanisms not being trained end-to-end. It proposes CODA-Prompt, which learns a set of prompt components assembled with input-conditioned weights to produce input-conditioned prompts via an end-to-end attention-based key-query scheme. Experiments show it outperforms the current state of the art, though specific numbers are not given in the abstract.
2211.13218|v2.assessment: 端到端提示组件学习在无回放持续学习中具有较强实用性与创新性，值得关注。
2211.13218|v2.contribution: 提出CODA-Prompt端到端注意力提示方法用于无回放持续学习。
2211.13218|v2.innovation: 通过输入条件权重组装提示组件实现端到端键查询提示生成。
2211.13218|v2.result: 实验表明超越当前SOTA，摘要未给出具体数值。

2304.10177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中基于回放的方法在样本选择时仅最大化当前轮效用、忽略连续选择轮次间干扰的问题。基于影响函数框架剖析顺序选择步骤的交互，识别出一类二阶影响会逐渐放大回放缓冲中的偶然偏差并损害选择过程。提出一种新的选择目标来正则化二阶效应，并与两种广泛采用的准则建立联系，同时给出高效实现。在多个持续学习基准上实验表明优于SOTA方法。
2304.10177|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the overlooked interference between successive replay sample selection rounds in continual learning, where existing schemes only maximize the utility of the ongoing selection. Built on influence functions, it identifies a new class of second-order influences that amplify incidental bias in the replay buffer and compromise selection. A novel selection objective is proposed to regularize these effects, with clear connections to two widely adopted criteria and an efficient implementation. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate superiority over state-of-the-art methods.
2304.10177|v2.assessment: 从影响函数角度分析回放选择中的二阶效应，理论扎实且实验充分，对持续学习回放策略有重要参考价值。
2304.10177|v2.contribution: 提出正则化二阶影响的回放样本选择目标用于持续学习。
2304.10177|v2.innovation: 基于影响函数识别并正则化连续选择轮次间的二阶干扰。
2304.10177|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于SOTA方法。

CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_cn: 该论文针对语义分割与全景分割中的持续学习问题，即模型在连续学习新类别时对旧类别的灾难性遗忘。提出CoMFormer方法，旨在统一处理语义与全景分割的增量学习。相比已有工作，其改进在于同时覆盖语义和全景分割两种任务设置。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning in semantic and panoptic segmentation, where models suffer catastrophic forgetting of old classes when learning new ones sequentially. It proposes CoMFormer to handle incremental learning for both semantic and panoptic segmentation in a unified manner. The improvement lies in covering both task settings, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.assessment: 统一语义与全景分割的持续学习具有一定挑战性，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体方法设计。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.contribution: 提出CoMFormer用于语义与全景分割的持续学习。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.innovation: 统一处理语义分割与全景分割的增量学习任务。

2304.03931|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中数据呈非欧几里得几何结构、欧氏空间难以刻画的问题，本文提出从数据几何角度研究持续学习。方法利用混合曲率空间，通过增量搜索方案动态扩展底层空间几何以匹配新数据产生的几何结构，并引入角度正则化损失和邻域鲁棒性损失分别约束全局与局部几何结构的变化。相比欧氏空间中的基线方法，该方法在非平稳数据流上取得更好性能，有效缓解遗忘。
2304.03931|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning from a data geometry perspective, arguing that Euclidean space cannot capture the non-Euclidean geometric structures of non-stationary data streams. It dynamically expands the geometry of the underlying mixed-curvature space via an incremental search scheme and introduces angular-regularization and neighbor-robustness losses to penalize changes in global and local geometric structures. Experiments show improved performance over Euclidean-space baselines.
2304.03931|v2.assessment: 从几何视角切入持续学习遗忘问题较有新意，混合曲率空间的增量扩展思路值得关注，但实验规模与对比深度有限。
2304.03931|v2.contribution: 提出基于混合曲率空间几何扩展的持续学习框架，用几何结构保持替代传统欧氏约束。
2304.03931|v2.innovation: 用增量搜索动态扩展空间几何并配合角度正则与邻域鲁棒损失来同时保持全局和局部几何结构。
2304.03931|v2.result: 在非平稳数据流上优于欧氏空间设计的基线方法。

2303.14595|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，现有特征空间知识蒸馏方法直接约束新特征匹配旧特征，忽视了可塑性需求。本文提出 Backward Feature Projection (BFP)，允许新特征在旧特征的可学习线性变换范围内变化，从而在保持旧类线性可分性的同时允许新特征方向出现以容纳新类。BFP 可与现有经验回放方法结合并显著提升性能，同时帮助学习更好的表示空间，使线性探测在持续学习过程中保持高分类精度。
2303.14595|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting, this paper proposes Backward Feature Projection (BFP), which allows new features to change up to a learnable linear transformation of old features, rather than directly constraining them to match. BFP preserves the linear separability of old classes while permitting new feature directions for new classes, and can be integrated with experience replay to boost performance significantly. It also yields a representation space where linear probing achieves high accuracy throughout continual learning.
2303.14595|v2.assessment: BFP 对稳定性-可塑性权衡给出了简洁有效的几何解释，与回放方法兼容且提升明显，代码开源，实用性强。
2303.14595|v2.contribution: 提出 Backward Feature Projection，通过可学习线性变换约束新特征以保持旧类线性可分性。
2303.14595|v2.innovation: 将特征蒸馏从直接匹配改为允许线性变换，兼顾稳定性与可塑性。
2303.14595|v2.result: 与经验回放结合后性能显著提升，线性探测在持续学习中保持高精度。

2305.14657|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出类增量学习中除灾难性遗忘外还存在跨任务类判别（CTCD）挑战，即在新任务与旧任务类之间建立决策边界。回放方法虽隐式部分处理该问题，但本文认为回放存在动态训练偏差，降低了回放数据解决 CTCD 的有效性。为此提出一种带梯度自适应方法的新优化目标，在在线持续学习过程中动态处理该问题。实验表明新方法取得明显更好的结果。
2305.14657|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies cross-task class discrimination (CTCD) as an additional challenge in class-incremental learning beyond catastrophic forgetting, namely establishing decision boundaries between new and old classes without old data. It argues that replay-based methods suffer from a dynamic training bias that limits their effectiveness for CTCD, and proposes a novel optimization objective with a gradient-based adaptive method to address it online. Experiments show substantially better results.
2305.14657|v2.assessment: 对回放方法动态训练偏差的分析有洞察力，CTCD 视角补充了持续学习研究的盲点，方法针对性强。
2305.14657|v2.contribution: 提出跨任务类判别问题并设计带梯度自适应的新优化目标来动态解决该问题。
2305.14657|v2.innovation: 揭示回放方法的动态训练偏差并据此设计自适应优化目标。
2305.14657|v2.result: 实验结果显示新方法在在线持续学习上明显优于对比方法。

2303.09483|v2.summary_cn: 针对神经网络持续学习中稳定性-可塑性权衡仍未解决且机理不清的问题，本文提出 Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL)，为以稳定性为主的持续学习模型引入一个促进可塑性的辅助网络。该框架具体实现为一个在可塑性与稳定性之间自然插值的正则项，在任务增量和类增量场景中均超越强基线。通过对 ANCL 解的深入分析，作者还揭示了稳定性-可塑性权衡背后的一些基本原则。
2303.09483|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL), which augments a stability-focused continually learned model with an auxiliary network that promotes plasticity. The framework materializes as a regularizer that naturally interpolates between plasticity and stability, surpassing strong baselines on both task-incremental and class-incremental scenarios. Extensive analyses reveal essential principles underlying the stability-plasticity trade-off.
2303.09483|v2.assessment: ANCL 用辅助网络显式解耦稳定性与可塑性，正则化插值设计优雅，且对权衡机理的分析有理论价值。
2303.09483|v2.contribution: 提出 ANCL 框架，通过辅助网络与插值正则项改善稳定性-可塑性权衡。
2303.09483|v2.innovation: 用辅助网络促进可塑性并以正则项在稳定性与可塑性间自然插值。
2303.09483|v2.result: 在任务增量和类增量场景中均超越强基线。

Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的异构性问题，即不同任务或数据分布差异较大时模型难以兼顾旧知识保持与新任务适应。作者提出了异构持续学习框架，通过解耦任务特定与任务共享参数或采用异构结构来缓解灾难性遗忘。相比传统持续学习方法假设任务同质，该工作更贴近现实场景中数据分布多样化的挑战。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法思路对自动驾驶多场景持续感知有参考价值。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses heterogeneous continual learning, where tasks or data distributions differ significantly, making it hard to balance old knowledge retention and new task adaptation. The authors propose a framework that decouples task-specific and shared parameters or adopts heterogeneous architectures to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Unlike traditional CL methods assuming homogeneous tasks, it better reflects real-world diversity, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 该工作关注持续学习中的异构性，对自动驾驶多场景感知有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其有效性。

Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出双边记忆巩固机制，模拟生物记忆巩固过程来平衡新旧知识。方法可能通过双路径或双阶段记忆重放与正则化来增强模型对旧任务的保持能力。相比单一记忆巩固策略，双边机制有望更有效地缓解遗忘。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但思路对自动驾驶持续感知有借鉴意义。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a bilateral memory consolidation mechanism inspired by biological memory consolidation. The method likely employs dual-path or dual-stage memory replay and regularization to balance old and new knowledge. Compared to single-sided consolidation, the bilateral approach may better alleviate forgetting, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.assessment: 双边记忆巩固思路新颖，对持续学习有理论贡献，但缺乏实验数据支撑，需进一步评估。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.contribution: 提出了双边记忆巩固机制用于持续学习。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.innovation: 模拟生物记忆巩固的双边过程来缓解遗忘。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti._arxiv_id: Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Continual Learning.

2303.11165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习在实际应用中受计算预算限制而非存储限制的问题，重新审视了计算受限场景下的持续学习。作者构建了大规模基准，在ImageNet2K和Continual Google Landmarks V2上评估了多种采样策略、蒸馏损失和部分微调方法，涵盖数据增量、类增量和时间增量设定，总计超过1500 GPU小时。实验发现，在计算受限下，传统持续学习方法无一例外地无法超越一个简单的最小基线，揭示了计算预算对持续学习有效性的关键影响。
2303.11165|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits continual learning under computational budget constraints rather than storage constraints, which is more realistic for in-the-wild applications. The authors build a large-scale benchmark and evaluate various sampling strategies, distillation losses, and partial fine-tuning on ImageNet2K and Continual Google Landmarks V2 across data-incremental, class-incremental, and time-incremental settings, totaling over 1500 GPU-hours. They find that under compute-constrained settings, traditional CL approaches fail to outperform a simple minimal baseline, highlighting the critical role of computational budget.
2303.11165|v2.assessment: 该工作通过大规模基准揭示了计算预算对持续学习的关键影响，对实际部署有重要指导意义，实验充分。
2303.11165|v2.contribution: 构建了计算受限持续学习的大规模基准并揭示了传统方法的失效。
2303.11165|v2.innovation: 首次系统研究计算预算约束下的持续学习性能。
2303.11165|v2.result: 传统持续学习方法在计算受限下均无法超越简单基线。

2212.04842|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频持续学习问题，即模型需在不显著遗忘旧类的前提下学习新类。作者提出PIVOT方法，利用图像域预训练模型的丰富知识，通过提示机制进行持续学习，无需域内预训练，从而减少可训练参数和遗忘。相比先前方法，PIVOT首次有效利用提示机制进行持续学习。在20任务ActivityNet设定上，PIVOT比现有最优方法提升了27%。
2212.04842|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning for video data, where models must learn new classes without significantly forgetting old ones. The authors propose PIVOT, which leverages pre-trained image models via prompting mechanisms for continual learning without in-domain pre-training, reducing trainable parameters and forgetting. PIVOT is the first to effectively use prompting for CL and improves state-of-the-art by 27% on the 20-task ActivityNet setup.
2212.04842|v2.assessment: PIVOT将提示机制引入视频持续学习，显著提升性能，对视频理解与持续学习交叉领域有重要参考价值。
2212.04842|v2.contribution: 提出了基于提示的视频持续学习方法PIVOT。
2212.04842|v2.innovation: 首次将提示机制有效用于无域内预训练的视频持续学习。

MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的腐败鲁棒性问题，即模型在遇到数据腐败时性能下降。作者提出MetaMix方法，通过时间自适应数据变换来增强模型对腐败的鲁棒性。相比传统持续学习方法未考虑腐败影响，MetaMix在数据变换层面进行元学习以适应不同任务。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但思路对自动驾驶中恶劣天气等腐败场景有参考价值。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_en: This paper addresses corruption-robust continual learning, where models degrade under data corruption. The authors propose MetaMix, which uses temporally self-adaptive data transformation to enhance robustness against corruption. Unlike traditional CL methods that ignore corruption, MetaMix applies meta-learning at the data transformation level to adapt across tasks. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract, but the idea is relevant to autonomous driving under adverse conditions.
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.assessment: MetaMix关注持续学习中的腐败鲁棒性，对自动驾驶恶劣环境感知有潜在价值，但缺乏实验数据。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.contribution: 提出了时间自适应数据变换的MetaMix方法用于腐败鲁棒持续学习。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.innovation: 将元学习与数据变换结合以提升持续学习中的腐败鲁棒性。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti._arxiv_id: MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Continual Learning with Temporally Self-Adaptive Data Transformation.

VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉问答中的持续学习问题，提出了VQACL新设定，即模型需在连续学习新视觉问答任务时不遗忘旧任务。作者可能构建了相应的基准和评估协议，并分析了现有VQA模型在持续学习下的表现。相比传统VQA假设所有数据可见，VQACL更贴近实际应用。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但为VQA与持续学习交叉领域提供了新方向。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_en: This paper introduces VQACL, a novel continual learning setting for visual question answering, where models must sequentially learn new VQA tasks without forgetting old ones. The authors likely build a benchmark and evaluation protocol, and analyze existing VQA models under continual learning. Unlike traditional VQA assuming all data available, VQACL is more realistic. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract, but it opens a new direction at the intersection of VQA and CL.
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.assessment: VQACL将持续学习引入VQA，拓展了多模态持续学习的研究范围，但摘要信息有限。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.contribution: 提出了视觉问答持续学习的新设定VQACL。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.innovation: 首次将持续学习设定引入视觉问答任务。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering._arxiv_id: VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering Continual Learning Setting.

Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习（Continual Learning）中稳定性与可塑性难以兼顾的核心矛盾，现有梯度投影方法仅在参数空间约束更新方向，导致旧任务特征被破坏或新任务学习受限。②本文提出在特征空间对稳定性与可塑性进行解耦（Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling），通过显式分离用于保持旧知识的稳定子空间与用于学习新任务的可塑子空间，缓解梯度投影中的方向冲突。③相比传统梯度投影（如GPM、Adam-NSCL）只在参数梯度层面做正交约束，本文把约束迁移到特征表示空间，使新旧任务的特征表达互不干扰。④在标准类增量/任务增量基准上取得优于梯度投影基线的精度，并显著降低遗忘率（具体数值摘要未给出）。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_en: This paper tackles the stability-plasticity dilemma in continual learning, where existing gradient projection methods constrain updates only in parameter space and thus either damage old-task features or restrict new-task learning. It proposes decoupling stability and plasticity in feature space, explicitly separating a stable subspace for preserving old knowledge from a plastic subspace for acquiring new tasks. Compared with parameter-space gradient projection baselines, the feature-space decoupling reduces interference between old and new representations, yielding higher accuracy and lower forgetting on standard continual learning benchmarks.
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.assessment: 从特征空间而非参数空间重新审视梯度投影，为持续学习中的稳定性/可塑性权衡提供了新视角，对做增量学习与模型遗忘的研究者有参考价值。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.contribution: 提出在特征空间解耦稳定性与可塑性的持续学习框架，突破传统参数空间梯度投影的局限。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.innovation: 将梯度投影的正交约束从参数梯度空间迁移到特征表示空间，实现新旧任务子空间的显式分离。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.result: 在标准持续学习基准上精度优于梯度投影基线，遗忘率明显下降。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual._arxiv_id: Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual Learning: Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling.

Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习（Task-Incremental Learning）中学习新任务与记住旧任务相互干扰的问题，现有方法难以在有限内存下同时保证可塑性与记忆保持。②本文提出一种双层记忆框架（Bilevel Memory Framework）并引入知识投影（Knowledge Projection），将“学习”与“记忆”在结构上解耦，通过双层优化分别优化新知识获取与旧知识保持。③相比单一记忆回放或正则化方法，该框架用知识投影把旧任务知识映射到共享表示中，减少任务间冲突。④在任务增量学习基准上取得优于回放与正则化基线的性能（具体数值摘要未给出）。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_en: This paper addresses interference between learning new tasks and remembering old ones in task-incremental learning under limited memory. It proposes a bilevel memory framework with knowledge projection that structurally decouples learning from remembering via bilevel optimization. Compared with replay- or regularization-based methods, the knowledge projection maps old-task knowledge into a shared representation to reduce inter-task conflict, achieving improved performance on task-incremental benchmarks.
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.assessment: 双层优化与知识投影的结合为任务增量学习提供了清晰的解耦思路，对关注持续学习架构设计的研究者有借鉴意义。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.contribution: 提出解耦学习与记忆的双层记忆框架，并引入知识投影缓解任务间干扰。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.innovation: 用双层优化将新任务学习与旧任务记忆分离，并通过知识投影实现跨任务知识共享。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.result: 在任务增量学习基准上优于回放与正则化基线。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B._arxiv_id: Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a Bilevel Memory Framework with Knowledge Projection for Task-Incremental Learning.

Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_cn: ①针对基于样本回放的类增量学习（Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning）中批归一化（BatchNorm）统计量被新任务数据主导、导致旧类特征分布偏移的问题。②本文分析发现回放样本与新任务样本在批次中数量不平衡会使 BN 的均值/方差偏向新类，提出对批归一化进行再平衡（Rebalancing Batch Normalization），通过校正 BN 统计量或调整其估计方式恢复旧类分布。③相比直接使用标准 BN 的增量学习方法，该策略无需额外网络结构即可缓解任务间分布漂移。④在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 等类增量基准上取得一致的精度提升（具体数值摘要未给出）。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_en: This paper identifies that in exemplar-based class-incremental learning, batch normalization statistics are dominated by new-task samples due to imbalanced replay batches, biasing old-class feature distributions. It proposes rebalancing batch normalization to correct BN statistics and restore old-class distributions without architectural changes. The method consistently improves accuracy over standard-BN incremental learning baselines on class-incremental benchmarks such as CIFAR-100 and ImageNet.
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.assessment: 从归一化统计量这一被忽视的角度切入类增量学习，方法轻量且即插即用，对做增量学习与分布偏移的研究者很实用。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.contribution: 揭示并解决类增量学习中批归一化统计量被新任务主导的问题。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.innovation: 提出对 BatchNorm 统计量进行再平衡的即插即用策略，无需改变网络结构。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 等类增量基准上取得一致的精度提升。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem._arxiv_id: Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中知识迁移不足、新旧任务特征难以共享的问题。②本文提出多样化知识迁移 Transformer（DKT, Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer），在 Transformer 架构中设计多样化的知识迁移机制，使不同任务的知识通过多条迁移路径交互，增强表示的可迁移性。③相比单一提示或单一适配器的增量 Transformer 方法，DKT 通过多样化迁移模块提升了对新任务的泛化并抑制遗忘。④在类增量学习基准上取得优于现有 Transformer 类增量方法的性能（具体数值摘要未给出）。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_en: This paper targets insufficient knowledge transfer in class-incremental learning, where old and new task features are hard to share. It proposes the Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer (DKT), which introduces diverse knowledge transfer mechanisms within a Transformer to let task knowledge interact through multiple transfer paths. Compared with single-prompt or single-adapter incremental Transformers, DKT improves generalization to new tasks while suppressing forgetting, outperforming prior Transformer-based class-incremental methods on standard benchmarks.
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.assessment: 将 Transformer 与多样化知识迁移结合用于类增量学习，契合当前增量学习与 ViT 结合的趋势，值得关注。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.contribution: 提出多样化知识迁移 Transformer 框架用于类增量学习。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.innovation: 在 Transformer 中设计多条多样化知识迁移路径以增强跨任务表示共享。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.result: 在类增量学习基准上优于现有 Transformer 类增量方法。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor._arxiv_id: DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer for Class Incremental Learning.

Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中模型容量固定、难以在持续学习新类的同时保持旧类性能的问题。②本文提出稠密网络扩展（Dense Network Expansion），在增量过程中动态扩展网络容量，并通过稠密连接让新扩展模块与已有模块充分交互，兼顾可塑性与稳定性。③相比固定容量或简单加宽/加分支的增量方法，稠密扩展使新旧特征在扩展模块间高效复用，减少参数冗余与遗忘。④在类增量学习基准上取得优于固定容量与扩展式基线的精度（具体数值摘要未给出）。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses the fixed-capacity limitation in class-incremental learning, where models struggle to learn new classes while retaining old ones. It proposes Dense Network Expansion, which dynamically grows network capacity during incremental steps and densely connects new modules with existing ones to balance plasticity and stability. Compared with fixed-capacity or naive expansion baselines, dense expansion enables efficient feature reuse across modules, reducing redundancy and forgetting, and achieves higher accuracy on class-incremental benchmarks.
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.assessment: 网络扩展与稠密连接的结合为增量学习中的容量分配提供了新方案，对关注持续学习与网络结构设计的研究者有参考价值。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.contribution: 提出稠密网络扩展方法，在类增量学习中动态扩展并复用网络容量。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.innovation: 将稠密连接引入增量网络扩展，实现新旧模块间的高效特征复用。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.result: 在类增量学习基准上优于固定容量与扩展式基线。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm._arxiv_id: Dense Network Expansion for Class Incremental Learning.

ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_cn: 针对视频-语言模型在持续学习场景下缺乏统一评测基准的问题，本文提出了 ViLCo-Bench，一个面向视频语言持续学习的基准。该基准构建了多任务的视频-语言持续学习评测协议，涵盖视频检索、视频问答等任务，并系统评估了现有持续学习方法在该设定下的表现。相比以往仅关注单模态或静态图像的持续学习基准，ViLCo-Bench 首次将视频时序信息与语言监督结合进行持续学习评测。实验揭示了现有方法在视频-语言持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，为后续研究提供了标准化平台。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_en: This paper introduces ViLCo-Bench, a benchmark for continual learning in video-language models. It defines multi-task evaluation protocols spanning video retrieval and video question answering, and systematically assesses existing continual learning methods under this setting. Unlike prior benchmarks focused on unimodal or static-image settings, it is the first to integrate video temporal information with language supervision for continual learning evaluation, exposing severe catastrophic forgetting and providing a standardized platform.
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.assessment: 该工作填补了视频-语言持续学习评测的空白，对多模态持续学习研究者具有参考价值，但方法层面的创新有限。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.contribution: 提出了首个面向视频-语言持续学习的标准化评测基准 ViLCo-Bench。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.innovation: 将视频时序信息与语言监督结合，构建多任务持续学习评测协议。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.result: 揭示了现有持续学习方法在视频-语言任务上的严重遗忘问题，提供了统一评测平台。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le._arxiv_id: ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual learning Benchmark.

Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型在持续学习中灾难性遗忘严重的问题，本文提出基于混合专家（MoE）适配器的方法来提升持续学习能力。该方法在预训练视觉-语言模型中引入 MoE 适配器，通过专家路由机制为不同任务分配不同专家，从而在保持预训练知识的同时学习新任务。相比传统单一适配器或提示学习方法，MoE 适配器能更有效地缓解任务间干扰。实验表明该方法在多个持续学习基准上显著优于现有方法，在保持零样本能力的同时提升了增量任务性能。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning of vision-language models by proposing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) adapters. The method introduces MoE adapters into pretrained VLMs with expert routing to allocate task-specific experts, mitigating inter-task interference while preserving pretrained knowledge. Experiments show substantial improvements over existing methods on multiple continual learning benchmarks while maintaining zero-shot capability.
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.assessment: 将 MoE 适配器引入视觉-语言持续学习是合理且有效的思路，实验充分，对多模态持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.contribution: 提出基于混合专家适配器的视觉-语言模型持续学习方法。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.innovation: 利用 MoE 路由机制为不同任务分配专家，缓解任务间干扰并保留预训练知识。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.result: 在多个持续学习基准上显著优于现有方法，同时保持零样本能力。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La._arxiv_id: Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models via Mixture-of-Experts Adapters.

Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶运动预测模型在持续学习中遗忘旧场景的问题，本文提出基于元表示学习和最优记忆缓冲保留策略的持续学习方法。该方法通过元学习获取可迁移的表示，并设计最优记忆缓冲保留策略来选择最具代表性的样本进行回放。相比传统回放方法，该策略能更高效地利用有限缓冲空间，减少对旧场景预测能力的退化。实验表明该方法在运动预测持续学习任务上有效缓解了遗忘，提升了新旧场景的综合预测性能。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in continual learning for autonomous driving motion prediction by proposing meta-representation learning and an optimal memory buffer retention strategy. The method learns transferable representations via meta-learning and selects representative samples for replay to efficiently use limited buffer capacity. Experiments demonstrate reduced forgetting and improved overall prediction performance across old and new scenarios.
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.assessment: 将持续学习应用于运动预测是自动驾驶领域较新颖的方向，方法设计合理，对自动驾驶感知与预测研究者有参考价值。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.contribution: 提出结合元表示学习与最优记忆缓冲策略的运动预测持续学习方法。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.innovation: 通过元学习获取可迁移表示，并设计最优缓冲保留策略高效回放代表性样本。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.result: 有效缓解运动预测中的灾难性遗忘，提升新旧场景综合预测性能。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction._arxiv_id: Continual Learning for Motion Prediction Model via Meta-Representation Learning and Optimal Memory Buffer Retention Strategy.

Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中表示学习受限于特征空间角度分布不均的问题，本文提出学习等角表示（Equi-Angular Representations）的方法。该方法通过约束特征在超球面上的角度分布，使不同类别的表示更加均匀可分，从而提升在线持续学习的分类性能。相比以往仅关注特征范数或距离的方法，等角表示从角度维度改善了类间可分性。实验表明该方法在多个在线持续学习基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of uneven angular feature distributions in online continual learning by learning Equi-Angular Representations. The method constrains feature angular distributions on a hypersphere to make class representations more uniformly separable, improving classification performance. Experiments show consistent gains over existing methods on multiple online continual learning benchmarks.
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.assessment: 从角度分布角度改进在线持续学习表示具有一定新意，但整体影响范围较窄，主要面向持续学习社区。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.contribution: 提出等角表示学习方法以改善在线持续学习中的特征可分性。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.innovation: 通过约束超球面上特征的角度分布，从角度维度提升类间可分性。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上优于现有方法。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo._arxiv_id: Learning Equi-Angular Representations for Online Continual Learning.

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中模型可塑性下降的问题，本文提出通过协同学习（Collaborative Learning）提升可塑性的方法。该方法引入协同学习机制，在训练过程中促进模型对新任务的适应能力，缓解因过度稳定而导致的塑性损失。相比传统仅关注稳定性-可塑性权衡的方法，该工作从协同学习角度直接增强塑性。实验表明该方法在多个在线持续学习基准上提升了新任务学习能力，同时保持了对旧任务的性能。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses the declining plasticity in online continual learning by proposing a Collaborative Learning approach. The method introduces collaborative learning mechanisms to enhance adaptation to new tasks, mitigating plasticity loss caused by excessive stability. Experiments show improved new-task learning while maintaining old-task performance on multiple online continual learning benchmarks.
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.assessment: 从协同学习角度切入可塑性问题具有一定新意，对在线持续学习研究者有参考价值。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.contribution: 提出基于协同学习的在线持续学习可塑性提升方法。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.innovation: 通过协同学习机制直接增强模型对新任务的适应能力，缓解塑性损失。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上提升新任务学习能力并保持旧任务性能。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual._arxiv_id: Improving Plasticity in Online Continual Learning via Collaborative Learning.

BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_cn: 针对持续学习模型面临的数据投毒安全问题，本文提出 BrainWash，一种使持续学习模型遗忘特定知识的投毒攻击方法。该方法通过向训练数据中注入精心设计的投毒样本，诱导模型在持续学习过程中遗忘目标类别或知识。相比以往针对静态模型的投毒攻击，该工作首次系统研究了持续学习场景下的遗忘攻击。实验表明该方法能有效使模型遗忘指定知识，揭示了持续学习系统的安全脆弱性。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_en: This paper proposes BrainWash, a poisoning attack that induces forgetting in continual learning models. By injecting carefully crafted poisoned samples into training data, the method causes the model to forget targeted classes or knowledge during continual learning. Experiments demonstrate effective targeted forgetting, revealing security vulnerabilities of continual learning systems.
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.assessment: 从安全攻击角度研究持续学习遗忘问题较为新颖，对持续学习鲁棒性研究者有参考价值，但应用面相对较窄。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.contribution: 提出首个针对持续学习模型的定向遗忘投毒攻击方法 BrainWash。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.innovation: 通过注入投毒样本诱导持续学习模型遗忘指定知识，揭示其安全脆弱性。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.result: 实验表明该方法能有效使模型遗忘目标知识。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget._arxiv_id: BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget in Continual Learning.

Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_cn: 针对无回放持续学习（rehearsal-free CL）中提示（prompt）学习易受任务间干扰、旧任务提示漂移的问题，本文提出一致性提示（Consistent Prompting, CPrompt）框架。方法通过任务不变提示与任务特定提示的解耦，并引入提示一致性约束，使共享提示在序列任务中保持稳定。相比既有 prompt-based CL 方法，CPrompt 在不存储旧样本的前提下显著缓解了灾难性遗忘。在多个标准 CL 基准上取得 SOTA 或接近 SOTA 的性能，尤其在长任务序列下优势明显。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_en: This paper addresses prompt drift and inter-task interference in rehearsal-free continual learning. It proposes Consistent Prompting (CPrompt), which decouples task-invariant and task-specific prompts and enforces a consistency constraint on shared prompts. Compared with prior prompt-based CL methods, it mitigates catastrophic forgetting without storing old samples, achieving state-of-the-art or competitive results on standard CL benchmarks, especially over long task sequences.
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.assessment: 该工作切中 prompt-based 持续学习的关键痛点，方法简洁且与现有 prompt 框架兼容，对关注持续学习与视觉基础模型结合的研究者有参考价值。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.contribution: 提出一致性提示框架，通过任务不变/特定提示解耦与一致性约束实现无回放持续学习。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.innovation: 将提示一致性约束引入无回放 CL，缓解共享提示在任务序列中的漂移。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.result: 在多个 CL 基准上达到 SOTA 或接近 SOTA，长序列场景下遗忘显著降低。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free._arxiv_id: Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning.

Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_cn: 针对无样本持续学习（exemplar-free CL）中旧类因缺乏旧数据而严重遗忘的问题，本文提出用新数据“复活”旧类（Resurrecting Old Classes）的方法。核心思想是利用新任务数据中与旧类相关的语义/特征信息，通过类原型重建或生成式回放来恢复旧类判别能力。相比传统无样本方法仅靠正则化或参数隔离，该方法更主动地恢复旧类表征。在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 等基准上显著提升旧类准确率，缓解了稳定性-可塑性失衡。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_en: This paper tackles severe forgetting of old classes in exemplar-free continual learning. It proposes to resurrect old classes using new data by reconstructing class prototypes or leveraging semantic/feature cues from new-task samples. Unlike regularization- or isolation-based exemplar-free methods, it actively restores old-class representations, improving old-class accuracy on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet and alleviating the stability-plasticity trade-off.
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.assessment: 该工作提出了一种主动恢复旧类表征的新视角，对无样本 CL 的遗忘问题有实质推进，实验较充分。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.contribution: 提出利用新数据复活旧类的无样本持续学习方法。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.innovation: 从新任务数据中挖掘旧类语义/特征信息以重建旧类判别能力。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet 等基准上旧类准确率显著提升。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f._arxiv_id: Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data for Exemplar-Free Continual Learning.

ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_cn: 针对全景分割（panoptic segmentation）持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与计算开销问题，本文提出 ECLIPSE，一种基于视觉提示微调（Visual Prompt Tuning, VPT）的高效持续学习方法。方法在冻结主干的前提下，为每个任务学习轻量提示并设计提示选择/融合机制，避免全参数微调带来的遗忘与成本。相比既有全景分割 CL 方法，ECLIPSE 在保持分割精度的同时大幅降低可训练参数与训练时间。在 ADE20K、Cityscapes 等基准上取得优于或媲美全微调方法的性能。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and computational cost in continual panoptic segmentation. It proposes ECLIPSE, an efficient continual learning method based on Visual Prompt Tuning, which learns lightweight per-task prompts over a frozen backbone with a prompt selection/fusion mechanism. Compared with prior panoptic CL methods, it reduces trainable parameters and training time while maintaining accuracy, achieving performance comparable to or better than full fine-tuning on ADE20K and Cityscapes.
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.assessment: 将 VPT 引入全景分割持续学习，兼顾效率与精度，对自动驾驶场景下的增量感知有直接参考价值。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.contribution: 提出基于视觉提示微调的高效全景分割持续学习框架 ECLIPSE。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.innovation: 在冻结主干上用轻量任务提示实现全景分割的持续学习，降低遗忘与开销。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.result: 在 ADE20K、Cityscapes 上性能媲美或优于全微调，参数与训练时间大幅减少。

InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中低秩适配（LoRA）因参数更新相互干扰导致旧任务性能下降的问题，本文提出 InfLoRA（Interference-Free Low-Rank Adaptation）。方法通过分析 LoRA 子空间与旧任务特征子空间的重叠，设计无干扰的低秩更新方向，使新任务学习不破坏旧任务的关键子空间。相比直接堆叠 LoRA 的 CL 方法，InfLoRA 在理论上保证干扰最小化。在多个 CL 基准与预训练模型上取得更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_en: This paper addresses interference among low-rank updates in continual learning with LoRA. It proposes InfLoRA, which analyzes the overlap between LoRA subspaces and old-task feature subspaces and designs interference-free low-rank update directions so that learning new tasks does not corrupt critical old-task subspaces. Compared with naive LoRA stacking, InfLoRA provides theoretical interference minimization and achieves a better stability-plasticity trade-off on multiple CL benchmarks.
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.assessment: 将参数高效微调与持续学习结合并给出干扰分析，方法有理论支撑，对基于大模型的增量学习有启发。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.contribution: 提出无干扰低秩适配 InfLoRA，用于持续学习中的参数高效微调。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.innovation: 通过子空间重叠分析设计无干扰的 LoRA 更新方向。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.result: 在多个 CL 基准上取得更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap._arxiv_id: InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning.

Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_cn: 针对视觉持续学习中分类器偏向新类、旧类判别不足的问题，本文提出用语言引导的监督（Language-Guided Supervision）增强持续学习。方法利用 CLIP 等视觉-语言模型为旧类生成语义文本监督，约束分类器保持旧类语义一致性，从而缓解遗忘。相比仅用交叉熵或知识蒸馏的 CL 方法，该方法引入跨模态语义先验，提升旧类可分性。在多个 CL 基准上取得一致提升，尤其在类别数多的场景下效果显著。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_en: This paper tackles classifier bias toward new classes in visual continual learning. It proposes language-guided supervision that leverages vision-language models such as CLIP to generate semantic text supervision for old classes, constraining the classifier to preserve old-class semantics and thus mitigating forgetting. Compared with cross-entropy or distillation-only CL methods, it introduces cross-modal semantic priors and consistently improves performance, especially with many classes.
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.assessment: 将视觉-语言模型的语义监督引入持续学习，思路新颖且与当前多模态趋势契合，实用性强。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.contribution: 提出语言引导监督的视觉持续学习方法。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.innovation: 利用 CLIP 等 VLM 的文本语义约束分类器以缓解旧类遗忘。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.result: 在多个 CL 基准上一致提升，类别数多时增益更明显。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with._arxiv_id: Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with Language-Guided Supervision.

Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_cn: 针对视觉-惯性里程计（VIO）在环境变化、传感器漂移下泛化能力下降的问题，本文提出 Adaptive VIO，将在线持续学习引入深度 VIO。方法在推理过程中根据新场景数据在线更新网络参数，并设计防遗忘与稳定性机制以避免灾难性遗忘和漂移累积。相比固定权重的深度 VIO，Adaptive VIO 能适应新环境与传感器配置。在多个公开 VIO 基准与真实场景上取得更低的轨迹误差，验证了在线持续学习的有效性。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_en: This paper addresses degraded generalization of visual-inertial odometry under environmental changes and sensor drift. It proposes Adaptive VIO, which introduces online continual learning into deep VIO, updating network parameters on the fly with anti-forgetting and stability mechanisms to avoid catastrophic forgetting and drift accumulation. Compared with fixed-weight deep VIO, it adapts to new environments and sensor setups, achieving lower trajectory errors on public benchmarks and real-world scenes.
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.assessment: 将在线持续学习用于自动驾驶 VIO，问题真实且与自动驾驶感知/定位强相关，实验覆盖多场景，值得关注。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.contribution: 提出带在线持续学习的深度视觉-惯性里程计 Adaptive VIO。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.innovation: 在 VIO 推理中在线更新网络并设计防遗忘与稳定性机制。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.result: 在多个公开基准与真实场景上轨迹误差低于固定权重深度 VIO。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome._arxiv_id: Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odometry with Online Continual Learning.

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_cn: 针对持续学习模型在任务序列中难以兼顾快速适应与长期稳定性的问题，本文提出交互式持续学习框架，将认知科学中的快慢思考机制引入模型更新。方法上设计快思考模块负责快速拟合新任务，慢思考模块通过记忆回放与推理巩固旧知识，二者交互协同。相比单一更新策略的已有方法，该框架在多个持续学习基准上缓解了灾难性遗忘并提升了新任务适应速度。摘要未给出具体数值，但实验表明在标准类增量与域增量设置下均取得更优的平均精度。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between fast adaptation and long-term stability in continual learning by introducing an interactive framework inspired by fast and slow thinking. A fast module rapidly fits new tasks while a slow module consolidates old knowledge via replay and reasoning, and their interaction mitigates catastrophic forgetting. Experiments on standard class- and domain-incremental benchmarks show improved average accuracy over single-strategy baselines.
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.assessment: 将认知双系统理论引入持续学习，思路新颖，对关注增量学习稳定-可塑性平衡的研究者有参考价值。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.contribution: 提出快慢思考交互的持续学习框架，统一快速适应与长期记忆巩固。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.innovation: 把认知科学的双过程理论形式化为可训练的持续学习模块交互机制。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.result: 在多个持续学习基准上缓解遗忘并提升新任务适应精度。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and._arxiv_id: Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and Slow Thinking.

Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中预训练模型微调易遗忘且提示学习受限于固定模板的问题，本文提出卷积提示与语言模型结合的持续学习方法。方法利用卷积网络生成动态提示，并借助语言模型提供语义先验，使提示随任务自适应演化。相比固定提示或纯视觉提示的已有工作，该方法在类增量学习基准上显著提升精度并减少遗忘。摘要未列出具体数值，但实验显示在多个数据集上优于提示类持续学习基线。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in continual learning with pre-trained models by combining convolutional prompting with language models. Convolutional prompts are dynamically generated and enriched with semantic priors from a language model, allowing task-adaptive prompt evolution. Compared with fixed or vision-only prompting baselines, it achieves higher accuracy and less forgetting on class-incremental benchmarks.
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.assessment: 将语言模型语义先验引入卷积提示，为提示式持续学习提供了新思路，值得关注。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.contribution: 提出卷积提示与语言模型协同的持续学习框架。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.innovation: 用语言模型语义先验驱动卷积提示的动态生成与演化。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.result: 在类增量基准上优于现有提示式持续学习方法。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M._arxiv_id: Convolutional Prompting meets Language Models for Continual Learning.

Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_cn: 针对联邦持续学习中客户端数据异构且更新过程难以审计的问题，本文提出可追溯联邦持续学习框架。方法在联邦聚合中引入可追溯机制，记录并验证各客户端的持续学习更新，以检测异常或恶意贡献。相比传统联邦持续学习仅关注性能，该工作兼顾了更新来源的可验证性与模型可靠性。摘要未给出具体数值，但实验表明在保持精度的同时提升了异常检测能力。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_en: This paper addresses heterogeneous client data and unauditable updates in federated continual learning by proposing a traceable framework. A traceability mechanism records and verifies client updates during aggregation to detect anomalous or malicious contributions. Beyond performance, it improves update verifiability and model reliability, with experiments showing maintained accuracy and better anomaly detection.
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.assessment: 将可追溯性引入联邦持续学习，对关注联邦学习安全与可靠性的研究者有参考意义。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.contribution: 提出可追溯的联邦持续学习框架，实现更新来源验证。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.innovation: 在联邦持续学习中引入可追溯机制以检测异常客户端更新。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.result: 在保持模型精度的同时提升异常更新检测能力。

Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中数据流非平稳且模型易遗忘的问题，本文提出多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的在线持续学习框架。方法通过多层次监督信号协调不同粒度的知识保持，并利用反向自蒸馏将旧模型知识回传以稳定更新。相比现有在线持续学习方法，该框架在快速适应新数据的同时更好地保留旧知识。摘要未列出具体数值，但实验显示在在线类增量基准上取得更优的精度-遗忘权衡。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_en: This paper targets non-stationary data streams and forgetting in online continual learning via multi-level supervision and reverse self-distillation. Multi-level supervision preserves knowledge at different granularities, while reverse self-distillation transfers old-model knowledge to stabilize updates. It achieves a better accuracy-forgetting trade-off than existing online continual learning methods on class-incremental benchmarks.
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.assessment: 多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的组合对在线持续学习有实用价值，值得关注。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.contribution: 提出多层次监督与反向自蒸馏的在线持续学习框架。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.innovation: 用反向自蒸馏将旧知识回传以稳定在线更新。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.result: 在在线类增量基准上取得更优的精度-遗忘权衡。
