2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体声音频中的声源定位问题，即通过估计双耳时间差（ITD）来确定声音方向，核心难点在于需要在两个麦克风信号之间建立对应关系。作者借鉴视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（contrastive random walk）方法，将其适配到无标签立体声音频上，学习循环一致的表示，并进一步提出一种多模态对比学习模型，在给定人脸视觉表示的条件下估计多说话人混合中特定人物的时间延迟。相比依赖标注数据的监督方法，该方法在"in the wild"互联网录音上达到了与监督方法相当的性能。该工作主要面向音频-视觉多模态学习领域，与自动驾驶感知（目标检测、BEV、3D检测等）几乎无直接关联。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sound source localization in stereo audio by estimating interaural time delay (ITD), which requires establishing correspondences between the two microphone signals. The authors adapt the contrastive random walk from visual tracking to learn cycle-consistent representations from unlabeled stereo sounds, and further propose a multimodal contrastive learning model that estimates the time delay for a specific person in a multi-speaker mixture given a visual representation of their face. The self-supervised approach performs on par with supervised methods on in-the-wild internet recordings, but the work is largely orthogonal to autonomous driving perception.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该工作将视觉自监督跟踪技术成功迁移到音频领域，方法有一定新意，但与自动驾驶视觉感知研究领域关联度极低，对目标检测、BEV、3D检测等方向的研究者参考价值有限。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出将对比随机游走自监督框架应用于立体声时间延迟估计，并扩展到视觉引导的多说话人定位任务。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 首次将视觉跟踪中的循环一致对比学习迁移到无标签立体声音频的对应关系学习，并实现视觉引导的声源定位。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在"in the wild"互联网录音上，自监督方法达到与监督方法相当的声源定位性能。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: 针对3D点云单目标跟踪中现有方法仅依赖目标自身特征、忽略场景上下文导致在稀疏点云和遮挡下跟踪不稳定的问题，本文提出CXTrack，通过挖掘目标与周围环境的上下文信息来增强跟踪鲁棒性。方法上设计了上下文感知的特征提取与融合模块，将局部目标特征与全局场景上下文联合建模，并用于目标定位与状态估计。相比已有仅关注目标模板匹配的工作，CXTrack在稀疏和遮挡场景下显著提升了跟踪精度。在KITTI和nuScenes等3D跟踪基准上取得了领先性能，具体指标在摘要中未给出。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of 3D point cloud tracking caused by relying solely on target-specific features while ignoring scene context, especially under sparsity and occlusion. It proposes CXTrack, which exploits contextual information between the target and its surroundings via a context-aware feature extraction and fusion module for joint target-scene modeling. Compared with prior template-matching-only approaches, CXTrack achieves superior tracking accuracy on sparse and occluded scenes, attaining state-of-the-art results on 3D tracking benchmarks such as KITTI and nuScenes.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 该工作将上下文建模引入3D点云跟踪，思路清晰且对稀疏点云场景有实际价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体实验数据与泛化性。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出利用场景上下文增强3D点云单目标跟踪的CXTrack框架。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 将目标与周围环境的上下文信息联合建模用于3D点云跟踪。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes等3D跟踪基准上取得领先性能。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中时空连续性建模不足、长期遮挡下易丢失目标的问题，本文提出端到端框架PF-Track，强调时空连续性并同时利用过去与未来推理。方法基于tracking-by-attention框架，用object queries连贯表示跟踪实例，Past Reasoning模块通过交叉注意力融合历史帧和其他目标的query来精炼轨迹与特征，Future Reasoning模块预测鲁棒的未来轨迹，并在长期遮挡时维持目标位置、结合运动预测实现重关联。在nuScenes上AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches相比已有方法减少90%，达到数量级的改善。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This work tackles insufficient spatio-temporal continuity and identity loss under long-term occlusion in multi-camera 3D MOT by proposing PF-Track, an end-to-end framework that jointly performs past and future reasoning. Built on tracking-by-attention with object queries, its Past Reasoning module cross-attends to previous-frame and other-object queries to refine tracks, while Future Reasoning predicts robust future trajectories and maintains object positions for re-association during long occlusions. On nuScenes, it substantially improves AMOTA and reduces ID-Switches by 90% compared to prior methods.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: PF-Track在nuScenes上以90%的ID-Switches降幅展示了双向时序推理的威力，对多相机3D MOT的遮挡问题提供了优雅解法，值得重点关注。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出融合过去与未来推理的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架PF-Track。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 通过Past/Future Reasoning模块实现双向时序建模与长期遮挡下的重关联。
2302.03802|v2.result: 在nuScenes上AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches较已有方法减少90%。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: 针对端到端多目标跟踪（如MOTR）因query语义不明确导致检测性能弱、依赖额外训练技巧的问题，本文提出MOTRv2，通过引入预训练目标检测器来引导端到端跟踪。方法将检测器产生的proposals作为query初始化或锚点，与MOTR的track query机制结合，从而在保持端到端关联的同时获得强检测能力。相比原始MOTR，MOTRv2无需复杂辅助训练即可显著提升检测与跟踪精度。在DanceTrack等基准上取得了当时领先的HOTA/MOTA表现。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the weak detection capability and reliance on auxiliary training tricks in end-to-end MOT (e.g., MOTR) caused by ambiguous query semantics, and proposes MOTRv2, which bootstraps end-to-end tracking with a pretrained object detector. Detector proposals are used to initialize or anchor the track queries, combining strong detection with end-to-end association. Compared with MOTR, MOTRv2 substantially improves detection and tracking accuracy without complex auxiliary training, achieving leading HOTA/MOTA on benchmarks such as DanceTrack.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: MOTRv2以简洁的检测器引导思路解决了端到端MOT的检测短板，工程价值高，是MOT方向的重要参考。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出用预训练目标检测器引导端到端多目标跟踪的MOTRv2框架。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 将检测器proposals与track query机制结合，兼顾强检测与端到端关联。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.result: 在DanceTrack等基准上取得领先的HOTA/MOTA表现。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: 针对SORT类方法在遮挡和长时间丢失后因卡尔曼滤波噪声累积和缺乏观测更新导致跟踪失败的问题，本文提出Observation-Centric SORT（OC-SORT），重新审视SORT的鲁棒性。方法引入以观测为中心的动量建模和轨迹恢复机制，利用观测方向修正状态估计，并在目标重新出现时通过虚拟轨迹进行重关联。相比原始SORT及其变体，OC-SORT在遮挡和复杂运动场景下显著降低ID-Switches并提升MOTA。在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得了当时领先的跟踪性能。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper revisits the robustness of SORT and identifies that Kalman-filter noise accumulation and lack of observation updates during occlusion cause tracking failures. It proposes Observation-Centric SORT (OC-SORT), which introduces observation-centric momentum modeling and trajectory recovery, using observation direction to correct state estimation and virtual trajectories for re-association. Compared with SORT variants, OC-SORT significantly reduces ID-Switches and improves MOTA under occlusion and complex motion, achieving leading performance on MOT17, MOT20, and DanceTrack.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: OC-SORT以极简改动大幅提升SORT鲁棒性，思路深刻且实用，是MOT领域被广泛引用的经典工作。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出以观测为中心的OC-SORT，解决SORT在遮挡下的噪声累积与重关联问题。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 引入观测动量建模与虚拟轨迹恢复机制实现鲁棒重关联。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.result: 在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上显著降低ID-Switches并取得领先MOTA。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中目标非线性运动和长期遮挡导致轨迹预测不准、ID切换频繁的问题，本文提出MotionTrack，学习鲁棒的短期与长期运动建模。方法设计了短期运动模块捕捉相邻帧的局部运动，长期运动模块通过交互网络建模目标间关系以预测被遮挡目标的运动，并融合两者进行关联。相比已有仅依赖线性运动模型的方法，MotionTrack在非线性运动和长期遮挡下显著提升跟踪鲁棒性。在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得了领先的MOTA/HOTA表现。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate trajectory prediction and frequent ID switches in MOT caused by non-linear motion and long-term occlusion, and proposes MotionTrack to learn robust short-term and long-term motion. A short-term module captures local inter-frame motion, while a long-term module models inter-object relations via an interaction network to predict occluded targets' motion; both are fused for association. Compared with linear-motion-only methods, MotionTrack substantially improves robustness under non-linear motion and long occlusion, achieving leading MOTA/HOTA on MOT17, MOT20, and DanceTrack.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: MotionTrack将短期与长期运动建模结合，对复杂运动场景下的MOT有实质改进，方法设计合理且实验充分。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出融合短期与长期运动建模的多目标跟踪框架MotionTrack。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 通过交互网络建模目标间关系以预测长期遮挡下的运动。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得领先的MOTA/HOTA表现。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中外观特征区分度不足、相似目标易混淆导致ID切换的问题，本文提出关注细节的多样化细粒度表示方法。方法通过设计细粒度特征提取模块，从多个局部区域和尺度挖掘具有判别力的细节表示，并用于数据关联。相比已有仅使用全局外观特征的方法，该方法在拥挤和相似外观场景下提升了关联准确性。在MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪性能，具体指标摘要中未给出。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper targets insufficient discriminability of appearance features in online MOT, where similar targets are easily confused and cause ID switches, and proposes diverse fine-grained representations that focus on details. A fine-grained feature extraction module mines discriminative local and multi-scale details for data association. Compared with global-appearance-only methods, it improves association accuracy in crowded scenes with similar appearances, achieving competitive tracking performance on MOT benchmarks.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该工作从细粒度表示角度切入MOT关联问题，思路有价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其与ReID类方法的差异与实验规模。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出面向在线多目标跟踪的多样化细粒度表示方法。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 通过多局部区域与多尺度细节挖掘提升外观特征判别力。

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 现有 MOT 方法主要依赖类别标签或外观特征进行关联，缺乏对目标指代性语义（如"穿红衣服的人"）的理解能力。本文提出 Referring Multi-Object Tracking（RMOT）新任务，要求根据自然语言指代表达式跟踪特定目标，并构建了 Refer-KITTI 数据集及配套基线方法。相比传统 MOT，该方法需同时处理语言理解与多目标关联，在 Refer-KITTI 上验证了语言引导跟踪的可行性。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT), a new task that tracks targets specified by natural language referring expressions rather than category labels. The authors construct the Refer-KITTI dataset and propose a baseline framework that integrates language comprehension with multi-object association. Experiments demonstrate the feasibility of language-guided tracking on the proposed benchmark.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 开辟了语言引导多目标跟踪的新方向，对自动驾驶中基于自然语言指令的感知有潜在价值。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出 Referring Multi-Object Tracking 新任务并构建 Refer-KITTI 数据集与基线方法。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将自然语言指代理解引入多目标跟踪，实现语言引导的目标关联。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.result: 在 Refer-KITTI 上验证了语言引导跟踪的可行性，为后续研究建立基准。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: 现有多目标跟踪方法通常将检测、特征提取和关联分为独立模块，导致身份信息在模块间传递时丢失。本文提出 UTM 统一跟踪模型，通过身份感知特征增强模块将检测与 ReID 特征联合优化，实现端到端的多目标跟踪。相比分离式方案，UTM 在保持检测精度的同时提升了身份关联的鲁棒性。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: Existing MOT methods typically separate detection, feature extraction, and association into independent modules, causing identity information loss. This paper proposes UTM, a unified tracking model with an identity-aware feature enhancement module that jointly optimizes detection and ReID features in an end-to-end manner. UTM improves identity association robustness while maintaining detection accuracy.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 统一框架思路合理，但创新性相对有限，适合关注 MOT 端到端方案的读者。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出统一的多目标跟踪模型 UTM，通过身份感知特征增强实现检测与关联的联合优化。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 设计身份感知特征增强模块，在统一框架中弥合检测与 ReID 之间的信息鸿沟。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.result: 在保持检测精度的同时提升了身份关联的鲁棒性。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: 自由运动动物的 2D-3D 无标记跟踪通常需要大量人工标注，成本高昂且难以规模化。本文提出 3D-POP 自动化标注方法，利用基于标记的运动捕捉数据自动生成无标记跟踪的训练标注，实现鸟类自由运动的 2D-3D 跟踪。该方法大幅降低了标注成本，为动物行为研究提供了可扩展的跟踪方案。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: Markerless 2D-3D tracking of freely moving animals typically requires costly manual annotation. This paper presents 3D-POP, an automated annotation approach that leverages marker-based motion capture data to generate training labels for markerless tracking of freely moving birds. The method significantly reduces annotation cost and enables scalable tracking for animal behavior studies.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 自动化标注思路巧妙，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，方法可迁移性有限。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出利用标记运动捕捉数据自动生成无标记跟踪标注的 3D-POP 方法。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 将基于标记的运动捕捉数据转化为无标记 2D-3D 跟踪的自动监督信号。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.result: 实现了鸟类自由运动的无标记 2D-3D 跟踪，大幅降低标注成本。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉跟踪方法多采用判别式范式，将跟踪视为逐帧分类或回归问题，缺乏对目标运动轨迹的序列建模能力。本文提出自回归视觉跟踪框架，将跟踪重新表述为自回归序列生成任务，逐步预测目标状态。相比判别式方法，自回归范式能更好地建模时序依赖，在多个跟踪基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: Existing visual tracking methods predominantly adopt a discriminative paradigm, treating tracking as per-frame classification or regression without explicit sequence modeling. This paper proposes an autoregressive visual tracking framework that reformulates tracking as an autoregressive sequence generation task, predicting target states step by step. The autoregressive paradigm better captures temporal dependencies and achieves competitive performance on multiple tracking benchmarks.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 将自回归生成范式引入视觉跟踪，思路新颖，对跟踪领域的范式创新有启发意义。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出自回归视觉跟踪框架，将跟踪任务重新表述为序列生成问题。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 首次将自回归序列生成范式系统性地引入视觉目标跟踪。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上取得有竞争力的性能，验证了自回归范式的有效性。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: 衣物等可变形物体的类别级位姿跟踪因大范围非刚性形变而极具挑战，且缺乏大规模数据集。本文提出完整解决方案：VR-Garment 录制系统、VR-Folding 大规模数据集以及端到端在线跟踪框架 GarmentTracking，从点云序列预测规范空间和任务空间中的完整衣物位姿。实验表明 GarmentTracking 在衣物大幅非刚性形变下仍表现优异，速度和精度均超越基线方法。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: Category-level garment pose tracking is challenging due to large non-rigid deformation and the lack of large-scale datasets. This paper presents a complete solution comprising a VR-based recording system (VR-Garment), a large-scale dataset (VR-Folding), and an end-to-end online tracking framework (GarmentTracking) that predicts complete garment pose in both canonical and task spaces from point cloud sequences. GarmentTracking outperforms the baseline in both speed and accuracy even under large non-rigid deformation.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 数据集和系统贡献扎实，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，方法思路可借鉴。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提出包含录制系统、大规模数据集和端到端跟踪框架的完整衣物位姿跟踪方案。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 构建 VR 驱动的衣物操作数据集并设计规范空间与任务空间联合位姿预测框架。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在衣物大幅非刚性形变下速度和精度均超越基线方法。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: 3D 单目标跟踪因遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化而极具挑战。本文提出 MBPTrack，采用记忆机制利用历史帧信息，并基于首帧给定的框先验以由粗到细的方式定位目标：以带目标性掩码的历史帧作为外部记忆，通过 Transformer 模块传播目标线索，先经 Hough 投票预测中心，再自适应采样参考点聚合稠密特征图进行精定位。在 KITTI、nuScenes 和 Waymo Open Dataset 上均取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: 3D single object tracking remains challenging due to appearance variation from occlusion and size differences. This paper proposes MBPTrack, which employs a memory mechanism to leverage past frames and formulates localization in a coarse-to-fine scheme using box priors from the first frame. A transformer-based module propagates target cues from memory, followed by Hough voting for center prediction and adaptive reference point sampling for dense feature aggregation. MBPTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Open Dataset.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 记忆机制与框先验的结合有效解决了 3D 跟踪中的遮挡和尺度变化问题，在三大数据集上验证充分，值得关注。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出融合记忆网络与框先验的 3D 点云单目标跟踪框架 MBPTrack。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 利用带目标性掩码的历史帧作为外部记忆，并结合首帧框先验进行由粗到细的自适应定位。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在 KITTI、nuScenes 和 Waymo Open Dataset 上均取得 state-of-the-art 性能。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后出现的新类别物体的问题，本文提出了一种多模态自动标注流水线，无需3D人工标注即可生成开放集类别的amodal 3D边界框和轨迹片段。该方法利用点云序列中的运动线索与免费获取的2D图像-文本对，结合提出的视觉-语言知识蒸馏，识别并跟踪所有交通参与者，同时输出开放词汇语义标签。相比此前只能提供限于运动物体的类别无关自动标注的工作，本方法可无监督地处理静态和运动物体。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该方法在多项无监督3D感知任务上显著超越先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inadequacy of closed-set 3D perception models for autonomous driving, where novel object categories may appear after deployment. It presents a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D bounding boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without 3D human labels, exploiting motion cues in point cloud sequences and freely available 2D image-text pairs via vision-language knowledge distillation. Unlike prior work limited to class-agnostic labels for moving objects, the method handles both static and moving objects and outputs open-vocabulary semantic labels. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show significant improvements over prior work on various unsupervised 3D perception tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该工作将2D视觉-语言蒸馏与点云运动线索结合，解决了开放集3D感知的自动标注难题，对自动驾驶感知的扩展性和安全性有重要价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出了一种无需3D人工标注、可生成开放词汇amodal 3D框和轨迹的多模态自动标注流水线。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 利用2D图像-文本对进行视觉-语言知识蒸馏，结合点云运动线索，实现静态与运动物体的无监督开放集3D感知。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上，多项无监督3D感知任务显著超越先前工作。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于Transformer的视觉跟踪器速度慢、难以部署在计算受限设备上的问题，本文提出了HiT，一系列高效跟踪模型。其核心是Bridge Module，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，为跟踪头提供更好的特征；同时提出双图像位置编码技术，同时编码搜索区域和模板图像的位置信息。HiT在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，在LaSOT基准上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前的高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the low speed of Transformer-based visual trackers that hinders deployment on computationally limited devices. It proposes HiT, a family of efficient tracking models centered on a Bridge Module that incorporates high-level deep features into shallow large-resolution features, along with a dual-image position encoding that jointly encodes search region and template positions. HiT runs at 61 fps on an Nvidia Jetson AGX edge device and achieves 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing all previous efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该工作为高效视觉跟踪提供了实用的轻量级Transformer架构，在边缘设备上实现了速度与精度的良好平衡，对实时跟踪应用有参考价值。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出了轻量级分层视觉跟踪器HiT，包含Bridge Module和双图像位置编码。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: Bridge Module将深层高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，双图像位置编码同时编码搜索区域和模板位置。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在Jetson AGX上达61 fps，LaSOT上64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中缺乏标签监督、且易受物体相互干扰和遮挡影响的问题，本文探索了跨视频帧样本特征的潜在一致性，提出了无监督对比相似性学习方法UCSL，包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比三个模块。自对比通过帧内直接和帧间间接对比最大化自相似性以获得判别性表示；交叉对比对齐跨帧和连续帧匹配结果，缓解遮挡带来的持续负面影响；歧义对比通过隐式方式匹配歧义物体以提高后续关联的确定性。在现有基准上，该方法仅需少量ReID头辅助即超越现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised multiple object tracking, which suffers from mutual interference and occlusion without label supervision. It proposes UCSL, an unsupervised contrastive similarity learning method with three modules: self-contrast, cross-contrast, and ambiguity contrast. Self-contrast uses intra-frame direct and inter-frame indirect contrast for discriminative representations; cross-contrast aligns cross- and continuous-frame matching to mitigate occlusion; ambiguity contrast matches ambiguous objects to increase association certainty. On existing benchmarks, UCSL outperforms existing unsupervised methods with only limited ReID head help and even surpasses many fully supervised methods.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该工作通过多模块对比学习有效提升了无监督MOT的性能，甚至超越部分全监督方法，对降低跟踪标注成本有重要意义。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出了包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比的无监督对比相似性学习框架UCSL。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 利用跨帧特征一致性设计三种对比模块，隐式处理遮挡和歧义物体，提升无监督关联确定性。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在现有基准上超越现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）中目标外观相似、遮挡和运动模糊导致的身份混淆是长期难题。该论文提出DeconfuseTrack，通过设计去混淆机制（如混淆感知的特征学习或关联策略）来缓解跟踪中的身份切换问题。相比已有工作，其改进点在于显式建模并处理混淆样本，而非仅依赖更强的外观特征。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文确认在MOT17/MOT20等基准上的提升幅度。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: Identity confusion caused by similar appearances, occlusions, and motion blur remains a long-standing challenge in multi-object tracking (MOT). This paper proposes DeconfuseTrack, which explicitly models and mitigates confusion via dedicated deconfusion mechanisms in feature learning or association. Unlike prior work that mainly relies on stronger appearance features, it directly addresses confusing samples; quantitative results on standard MOT benchmarks are not provided in the abstract.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对MOT中身份混淆这一核心痛点提出显式建模思路，方向有价值，但需正文验证其实际增益。

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.innovation: 将混淆样本的建模与处理作为跟踪关联的核心环节而非附属问题。

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪模型在跨域场景下泛化能力不足，现有方法多在单一数据集上训练评估，难以适应新场景。该论文面向可泛化的多目标跟踪，提出提升跨域泛化的方法（如域泛化训练策略或特征解耦）。相比已有工作，其改进点在于将泛化性作为明确目标而非仅追求同域精度。摘要未提供具体数值，需正文确认在跨数据集评测中的提升。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: Existing multi-object tracking models generalize poorly across domains, as they are typically trained and evaluated on a single dataset. This paper targets generalizable MOT and proposes methods to improve cross-domain generalization, such as domain-generalization training strategies or feature disentanglement. The key improvement is treating generalization as an explicit objective rather than only optimizing in-domain accuracy; quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.assessment: 跨域泛化是MOT走向实用的关键问题，选题切中要害，但需正文验证方法有效性。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.contribution: 提出面向跨域泛化的多目标跟踪方法。

Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_cn: 低光照/夜间场景下多目标跟踪性能显著下降，现有跟踪器多针对正常光照设计。该论文研究暗光环境下的多目标跟踪，提出适应低照度图像的方法（如光照增强与跟踪联合优化）。相比已有工作，其改进点在于专门针对暗光退化建模，而非直接套用白天模型。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，需正文确认在暗光MOT基准上的提升。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking degrades severely under low-light/nighttime conditions, while most existing trackers are designed for normal illumination. This paper studies MOT in the dark and proposes methods tailored to low-light imagery, such as joint illumination enhancement and tracking optimization. The improvement lies in explicitly modeling dark-scene degradation instead of directly applying daytime models; quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.assessment: 暗光MOT是自动驾驶夜间感知的实际需求，选题有应用价值，需正文验证方法增益。

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: Visual tracking struggles to balance template updating and appearance variation, often underusing historical information. This paper proposes HIPTrack, which leverages historical prompts to guide tracking and adapt to appearance changes by aggregating cues from past frames. The improvement lies in a prompt-based mechanism that effectively exploits historical context rather than relying solely on the current template; quantitative results are not given in the abstract.

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: Hand pose tracking often lacks biomechanical constraints, producing anatomically implausible poses. This paper proposes MS-MANO, which incorporates biomechanical constraints into hand pose tracking to yield anatomically valid hand motion. The improvement lies in explicitly modeling joint range-of-motion and other biomechanical limits. This work targets hand pose estimation rather than autonomous driving perception, and no quantitative results are given in the abstract.

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: 基于注意力的跟踪（TBA）在3D跟踪中潜力大，但长期落后于跟踪-检测（TBD）方法，原因不明。该论文提出基于LiDAR的联合检测跟踪器JDT3D，分析TBA落后的原因，并提出轨迹采样增强与基于置信度的查询传播两种通用方法弥合差距。在nuScenes数据集上，JDT3D在测试集取得0.574 AMOTA，超过所有现有LiDAR-based TBA方法6%以上。论文还讨论了现有TBA模型公式的潜在挑战。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: Tracking-by-attention (TBA) has potential but consistently lags behind tracking-by-detection (TBD) in 3D tracking for unclear reasons. This paper introduces JDT3D, a LiDAR-based joint detector and tracker, analyzes the causes of the gap, and proposes two generalizable methods—track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation—to bridge it. On nuScenes, JDT3D achieves 0.574 AMOTA on the test set, outperforming all existing LiDAR-based TBA approaches by over 6%, and further discusses challenges in current TBA formulations.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 系统分析TBA落后TBD的原因并提出有效改进，在nuScenes上大幅刷新LiDAR-based TBA性能，对3D跟踪研究有重要参考价值。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出LiDAR联合检测跟踪器JDT3D及两种弥合TBA与TBD差距的通用方法。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 通过轨迹采样增强与置信度查询传播，并系统剖析TBA性能落后的原因。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在nuScenes测试集取得0.574 AMOTA，超过所有现有LiDAR-based TBA方法6%以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）依赖密集框标注和实例ID标注、监督成本极高的问题，本文提出首个自监督跟踪器Walker，仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需任何跟踪标签。方法上构建准稠密时序物体外观图，提出多正样本对比目标优化图上随机游走以学习实例相似度，并引入互斥连通性约束优化图拓扑；推理时基于运动约束双向游走的最大似然转移状态将检测关联到轨迹段。在MOT17、DanceTrack和BDD100K上达到与监督方法可比的自监督性能，标注需求最多减少400倍仍超越此前自监督跟踪器。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive annotation cost of multiple object tracking by introducing Walker, the first self-supervised tracker that learns from videos with only sparse bounding-box annotations and no tracking labels. It builds a quasi-dense temporal object appearance graph, optimizes random walks on it via a multi-positive contrastive objective, and enforces mutually-exclusive connectivity across instances; inference associates detections to tracklets via max-likelihood transitions under motion-constrained bidirectional walks. Walker achieves competitive results on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K, outperforming prior self-supervised trackers while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 首次将自监督学习成功扩展到MOT并达到与监督方法可比的性能，标注效率提升显著，对降低自动驾驶数据标注成本有直接价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅用稀疏框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督多目标跟踪框架Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 准稠密时序外观图上的多正样本对比随机游走目标与互斥连通性约束，配合运动约束双向游走关联。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上达到自监督最优，标注需求减少最多400倍仍超越先前自监督方法。

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪（3D SOT）中类别专用模型参数冗余、难以跨类别泛化的问题，本文首次提出统一模型，用单一共享参数网络同时跟踪所有类别目标。方法上显式编码不同类别的属性差异（主要来自点云目标尺寸与形状差异，如大而方的车辆 vs 小而细长的人），设计继承Transformer架构的AdaFormer点集表示学习网络，自适应编码跨类别动态变化的形状与尺寸信息，并将已知模板目标的尺寸形状先验融入模型输入与学习目标。改进点在于以统一网络替代多类别专用模型，减少冗余参数并提升跨类别适应性。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the parameter redundancy and limited applicability of category-specific 3D single object tracking models by introducing the first unified model that tracks all categories with a single shared-parameter network. It explicitly encodes category-specific attributes—primarily size and shape variations in point clouds—via AdaFormer, a transformer-based point set representation learning network that adaptively encodes dynamically varying shape and size, and incorporates template-derived size/shape priors into inputs and objectives. The unified design reduces redundant parameters while adapting to cross-category data.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究3D SOT的类别统一问题，AdaFormer对跨类别形状尺寸的自适应编码思路清晰，对统一化3D感知模型有参考价值。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 提出首个跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型及AdaFormer点集表示网络。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 显式编码类别属性差异并将模板尺寸形状先验融入Transformer式点云表示学习。
2401.11204|v2.result: 以单一共享参数网络实现跨类别3D SOT，减少冗余参数并提升跨类别适应性。

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端Transformer跟踪器在异构场景训练中存在的负干扰（学习到冲突的场景特定参数）和域泛化差（需昂贵微调）问题，本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）与模块化深度学习（MDL）。方法上定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT专家模块，并在参数空间组合这些模块，从而系统化泛化到新域且不增加推理时间。在MOTSynth上大量实验及MOT17、PersonPath22零样本评估表明，由精心选择模块构建的跟踪器超越单体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles negative interference and poor domain generalization in end-to-end transformer trackers trained on heterogeneous scenarios by proposing PASTA, a framework combining parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and modular deep learning. It defines key scenario attributes (e.g., camera viewpoint, lighting) and trains specialized PEFT modules per attribute, combining them in parameter space to generalize to new domains without extra inference cost. Experiments on MOTSynth and zero-shot evaluations on MOT17 and PersonPath22 show that a tracker composed of selected modules surpasses its monolithic counterpart.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 将PEFT与模块化学习引入MOT以解决异构场景负干扰和域泛化，思路新颖且不增加推理开销，对多场景自动驾驶跟踪部署有实用价值。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出结合PEFT与模块化深度学习的场景专用跟踪框架PASTA。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 按场景属性训练PEFT专家模块并在参数空间组合，实现无额外推理开销的域泛化。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在MOTSynth及MOT17、PersonPath22零样本评估中，模块化组合跟踪器超越单体模型。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言（VL）跟踪器因依赖人工文本标注（常含模糊描述）而性能逊于SoTA纯视觉跟踪器的问题，本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的世界知识生成高质量语言描述以提升跟踪性能。方法上提出基于反思的提示优化模块，结合跟踪反馈迭代精炼模糊、不准确的目标描述；并设计简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块同时增强VL与纯视觉跟踪器。实验表明该方法能有效提升跟踪性能。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inferiority of vision-language trackers relative to state-of-the-art visual trackers, attributing it to their reliance on manual textual annotations that are often ambiguous. It proposes ChatTracker, which leverages the world knowledge of a multimodal large language model to generate high-quality language descriptions, using a reflection-based prompt optimization module that iteratively refines descriptions with tracking feedback. A simple plug-and-play VL tracking framework boosts both VL and visual trackers, with experiments demonstrating improved tracking performance.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 用MLLM自动生成并迭代优化语言描述替代人工标注，为VL跟踪提供了可插拔的增强方案，对多模态跟踪研究有启发。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM生成高质量语言描述并即插即用增强跟踪器的ChatTracker框架。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 基于反思的提示优化模块结合跟踪反馈迭代精炼目标语言描述。
2411.01756|v2.result: 实验表明ChatTracker可有效提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器的性能。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中目标小、遮挡严重、背景杂乱，且RGB跟踪器依赖颜色纹理等空间外观线索在航拍视角下易失效的问题，论文提出首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT。该基准包含125段视频序列、超过48.8万条标注、覆盖8个类别，涵盖极小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战，并提供精确的有向标注以支持航拍视角下的准确定位。作者进一步提出多光谱跟踪方法以更好提取光谱特征并利用有向标注。相比已有RGB基准，MMOT通过像素级光谱反射信息增强了退化空间条件下的目标可判别性。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the degradation of RGB-based UAV multi-object tracking caused by small targets, severe occlusions, and cluttered backgrounds, where spatial appearance cues become unreliable. It introduces MMOT, the first drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking benchmark with 125 sequences, over 488.8K annotations across eight categories, and precise oriented annotations. A multispectral tracking method is further proposed to exploit spectral features and oriented annotations, improving discriminability under degraded spatial conditions.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 作为首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准，MMOT填补了该方向的数据空白，对多光谱感知与航拍跟踪研究者具有较高参考价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT并提出配套多光谱跟踪方法。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 将像素级光谱反射信息引入无人机多目标跟踪，并结合有向标注提升航拍视角下的定位与判别能力。
2510.12565|v2.result: 基准包含125段视频、48.8万+标注、8个类别，覆盖极小目标、高密度与严重遮挡等挑战。

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像360°视场下多目标跟踪中现有针孔相机算法难以适用、且全景畸变（分辨率损失、几何形变、光照不均）导致性能显著下降的问题，论文提出全景多目标跟踪框架OmniTrack。该框架包含Tracklet Management引入时序线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于目标定位与关联、以及CircularStatE模块缓解图像与几何畸变，从而支持全景视场下即使传感器快速运动时的跟踪。为弥补全景MOT数据集缺失，作者构建了由四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集，涵盖全景视场、剧烈运动和复杂环境等挑战。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles omnidirectional multi-object tracking, where pinhole-based MOT algorithms fail under 360° panoramic distortion such as resolution loss, geometric deformation, and uneven lighting. It proposes OmniTrack, integrating Tracklet Management for temporal cues, FlexiTrack Instances for localization and association, and the CircularStatE module to mitigate image and geometric distortions. A panoramic dataset QuadTrack collected by a quadruped robot is introduced to address the lack of panoramic MOT benchmarks.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: OmniTrack系统性地解决了全景MOT的畸变与关联难题，并配套新数据集，对全景感知与跟踪研究者有较高参考价值。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出全景多目标跟踪框架OmniTrack并构建四足机器人采集的QuadTrack全景数据集。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 通过CircularStatE模块与FlexiTrack Instances联合缓解全景畸变并支持快速运动下的目标关联。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在全景视场与剧烈运动场景下实现有效跟踪，并提供了新的全景MOT评测基准。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机单目标跟踪中目标小、遮挡严重导致RGB跟踪器性能受限的问题，论文提出首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250段覆盖多样环境与挑战的视频序列。同时提出跟踪框架UNTrack，从光谱提示、初始模板和序列搜索中编码统一的光谱、空间与时间特征，采用带光谱背景消除机制的非对称Transformer进行关系建模，并通过持续更新光谱提示的编码器精化跟踪。实验表明UNTrack优于现有最先进无人机跟踪器，兼顾精度与效率。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses UAV single object tracking under small targets and occlusions, where RGB trackers are limited, by introducing MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 video sequences. It proposes UNTrack, which encodes unified spectral, spatial, and temporal features from spectrum prompts, initial templates, and sequential searches, using an asymmetric transformer with a spectral background elimination mechanism and a continuously updated spectrum prompt encoder. Experiments show UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers in both accuracy and efficiency.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: MUST数据集与UNTrack框架共同推进了多光谱无人机跟踪研究，光谱提示更新机制设计合理，实验对比充分。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 构建首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST并提出UNTrack跟踪框架。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 采用带光谱背景消除机制的非对称Transformer与持续更新的光谱提示编码器实现光谱-空间-时间统一建模。
2503.17699|v2.result: 在MUST数据集上UNTrack优于现有最先进无人机跟踪器，同时提升精度与效率。

Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_cn: ①在线多目标跟踪中，现有方法往往将检测与关联解耦，且对轨迹级时序线索利用不足，导致身份切换和漏跟。②本文提出以轨迹为中心（Focusing on Tracks）的在线MOT框架，将轨迹作为建模与优化的核心单元，强化轨迹内与轨迹间的特征聚合与关联推理。③相比以检测框为中心的传统范式，该方法更充分地利用历史轨迹信息来指导当前帧的关联决策。④摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文确认在MOT17/MOT20等基准上的MOTA/IDF1提升幅度。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses online multi-object tracking by shifting the modeling focus from detections to tracks, aiming to better exploit trajectory-level temporal cues for association. It proposes a track-centric framework that aggregates and reasons over trajectory features to guide frame-by-frame association. Compared with detection-centric paradigms, it more effectively leverages historical track information, though quantitative results are not available in the provided abstract.
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.assessment: 以轨迹为中心的建模思路对在线MOT的关联鲁棒性有潜在价值，但需正文数据验证其相对SOTA的实际增益。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.contribution: 提出以轨迹为核心的在线多目标跟踪建模范式。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.innovation: 将轨迹而非检测框作为特征聚合与关联推理的基本单元。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，效果有待正文实验验证。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje._arxiv_id: Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Object Tracking.

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: ①现有一流跟踪器多采用one-stream范式，用单一ViT联合做模板与搜索区域的特征提取和关系建模，但不同图像块间的关系建模差异大（背景需抑制注意力、前景边界需强化），单模型难以兼顾。②本文提出SPMTrack，设计面向跟踪的混合专家模块TMoE，用多个专家灵活处理多样化的关系建模，并将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文。③TMoE同时作为参数高效微调手段，大幅减少可训练参数，使不同规模的SPMTrack可高效训练并保留预训练模型的泛化能力。④摘要未给出具体基准数值，但强调在参数量仅小幅增加下提升跟踪精度。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of one-stream trackers where a single ViT struggles to handle heterogeneous patch relations (background suppression vs. foreground boundary emphasis). It proposes SPMTrack with a tracking-specific mixture-of-experts (TMoE) that flexibly models diverse relations and extends relation modeling from image pairs to spatio-temporal context. TMoE also serves as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning scheme, reducing trainable parameters while preserving pretrained generalization.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 将MoE与参数高效微调结合用于跟踪关系建模，思路新颖，对跟踪器规模化与泛化性有参考价值。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出面向视觉跟踪的混合专家模块TMoE及SPMTrack跟踪器。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 用多专家处理异构关系建模，并将关系建模扩展到时空上下文且作为PEFT手段。
2503.18338|v2.result: 在参数量小幅增加下提升跟踪精度，具体数值需见正文。

Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_cn: ①视觉跟踪中标注数据有限，如何通过自监督预训练获得强泛化的跟踪表征是关键问题。②本文提出自回归序列预训练（Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining）用于视觉跟踪，通过序列化的自回归目标学习时序一致的跟踪特征。③相比通用图像或视频自监督预训练，该方法更贴合跟踪任务对时序建模与目标定位的需求。④摘要未提供具体数据集与数值，需正文验证在LaSOT/GOT-10k等基准上的增益。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.summary_en: This paper targets the limited-annotation problem in visual tracking by proposing an autoregressive sequential pretraining paradigm to learn temporally consistent tracking representations. Unlike generic image or video self-supervised pretraining, the objective is tailored to tracking's temporal modeling and localization needs. Quantitative gains on standard benchmarks are not reported in the provided abstract.
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.assessment: 自回归预训练用于跟踪的思路与当前自监督视觉趋势契合，但需实验数据支撑其有效性。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.contribution: 提出面向视觉跟踪的自回归序列预训练方法。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.innovation: 将自回归序列建模引入跟踪预训练以学习时序一致表征。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，效果待正文验证。
Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining fo._arxiv_id: Autoregressive Sequential Pretraining for Visual Tracking.

Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_cn: ①RGBE（RGB+事件）视觉跟踪中，如何有效利用历史信息并融合两种模态是提升鲁棒性的关键。②本文探索历史信息在RGBE跟踪中的作用，并引入Mamba状态空间模型进行高效时序建模与多模态融合。③相比基于Transformer的时序建模，Mamba在长序列上具线性复杂度，更适合处理事件相机的高时间分辨率数据。④摘要未给出具体基准数值，需正文确认在RGBE跟踪数据集上的精度与效率表现。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.summary_en: This paper investigates how to exploit historical information for RGB-Event (RGBE) visual tracking and introduces Mamba for efficient temporal modeling and multimodal fusion. Compared with Transformer-based temporal modeling, Mamba offers linear complexity, better suited to the high temporal resolution of event cameras. Concrete benchmark numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.assessment: 将Mamba引入RGBE跟踪是较新的尝试，对事件相机多模态跟踪方向有参考意义。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.contribution: 提出基于Mamba并利用历史信息的RGBE视觉跟踪方法。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.innovation: 用状态空间模型Mamba进行RGBE跟踪的时序建模与模态融合。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，效果待正文验证。
Exploring Historical Information for RGB._arxiv_id: Exploring Historical Information for RGBE Visual Tracking with Mamba.

GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_cn: ①类别级衣物姿态跟踪需同时处理衣物形变与三维几何，现有方法多将2D形变与3D重建分离处理，难以保持一致。②本文提出GaPT-DAR，将2D形变跟踪与3D重建集成到统一框架中实现类别级衣物姿态跟踪。③相比分离式流程，该方法通过2D形变与3D重建的联合建模提升姿态估计的时空一致性。④摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，需正文验证在衣物跟踪基准上的精度。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking, where existing methods treat 2D deformation and 3D reconstruction separately, causing inconsistency. It proposes GaPT-DAR, integrating 2D deformation tracking and 3D reconstruction in a unified framework. Quantitative results on garment tracking benchmarks are not reported in the abstract.
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低，但对可变形物体跟踪与3D重建结合有方法参考价值。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.contribution: 提出集成2D形变与3D重建的类别级衣物姿态跟踪框架GaPT-DAR。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.innovation: 将2D形变跟踪与3D重建统一建模以提升时空一致性。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，效果待正文验证。
GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose T._arxiv_id: GaPT-DAR: Category-level Garments Pose Tracking via Integrated 2D Deformation and 3D Reconstruction.

TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_cn: ①3D点云跟踪中，类别特定模型难以泛化到新类别，且从零训练代价高，如何迁移预训练3D模型实现类别统一跟踪是难点。②本文提出TrackAny3D，将预训练3D模型迁移到类别统一的3D点云跟踪任务，通过适配预训练表征实现跨类别跟踪。③相比类别特定的跟踪器，该方法借助预训练模型的知识实现类别统一与更强泛化。④摘要未给出具体基准数值，需正文确认在NuScenes/Waymo等3D跟踪基准上的AMOTA提升。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_en: This paper tackles category-unified 3D point cloud tracking, where category-specific models generalize poorly and training from scratch is costly. It proposes TrackAny3D, transferring pretrained 3D models to category-unified 3D tracking by adapting pretrained representations. Compared with category-specific trackers, it achieves unified category handling and stronger generalization, though quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.assessment: 将预训练3D模型迁移到点云跟踪的思路契合当前基础模型趋势，对3D感知与跟踪方向有较高参考价值。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.contribution: 提出迁移预训练3D模型的类别统一3D点云跟踪框架TrackAny3D。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.innovation: 利用预训练3D模型表征实现跨类别的统一点云跟踪。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，效果待正文验证。

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）数据集类别少、模态单一、规模有限的问题，本文提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个物体类别，每个序列同时提供点云、RGB图像和深度三种模态。所有序列经过多轮人工精细标注，支持单模态点云跟踪以及RGB-PC、RGB-D多模态3D跟踪任务，是迄今最大的通用3D目标跟踪基准。作者评估了8个代表性点云跟踪模型，发现这些模型在GSOT3D上性能严重下降，表明通用鲁棒的3D跟踪仍有很大研究空间。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild, comprising 620 sequences with 123K frames across 54 object categories, each with point cloud, RGB, and depth modalities. All sequences are manually annotated with multi-round inspection, supporting single-modal and multi-modal 3D tracking tasks. Evaluation of eight representative point cloud-based trackers reveals severe performance degradation, highlighting the need for more robust and generic 3D tracking methods.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了通用3D单目标跟踪数据缺乏的空白，多模态标注和大规模类别覆盖对推动3D跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大、类别最丰富的多模态通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，并系统评估了现有方法。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供涵盖54类、多模态（点云/RGB/深度）且支持多种3D跟踪任务的大规模基准。
2412.02129|v2.result: 8个代表性点云跟踪模型在该基准上性能大幅下降，揭示了现有方法在通用3D跟踪上的不足。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中现有方法过度依赖实例级检测与关联、忽略轨迹信息的问题，本文提出TRACT跟踪器，利用轨迹信息同时提升关联稳定性和分类准确率。具体包括轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略以增强目标身份与类别一致性，以及即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，其集成轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和轨迹语义丰富（TSE）策略。该方法在遮挡和类别模糊场景下显著提升了对新类别的适应能力。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OV-MOT) by proposing TRACT, a tracker that leverages trajectory information to improve both association and classification. It introduces a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement (TCR) strategy and a plug-and-play trajectory classification module TraCLIP with Trajectory Feature Aggregation and Trajectory Semantic Enrichment. The method enhances adaptability to novel classes, especially under occlusion and category ambiguity.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 将轨迹信息显式引入开放词汇跟踪是一个合理且有效的方向，TraCLIP的即插即用设计便于集成到现有框架。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出利用轨迹信息增强关联与分类的开放词汇多目标跟踪器TRACT及轨迹分类模块TraCLIP。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 通过轨迹一致性强化和轨迹语义丰富策略，将轨迹信息用于开放词汇跟踪的关联与分类。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提升了关联稳定性和分类准确率，增强了对新类别的适应能力。

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目跟踪器存在深度模糊和遮挡问题、现有多相机方法需要20个以上相机且需逐序列优化的问题，本文提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，使用实用数量的相机（如4个）直接预测3D对应关系，实现鲁棒的在线跟踪。方法在已知相机位姿和多视角深度下，将多视角特征融合为统一点云，结合k近邻关联和基于Transformer的更新来估计长程3D对应。在5K合成Kubric序列上训练，在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，并可泛化到1-8个视角、24-150帧的视频。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that tracks arbitrary points in dynamic scenes using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four), addressing depth ambiguity and occlusion in monocular trackers and the need for over 20 cameras in prior multi-camera methods. It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and applies k-NN correlation with a transformer-based update for long-range 3D correspondence. Trained on 5K synthetic Kubric sequences, it achieves median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, generalizing to 1-8 views and 24-150 frames.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作首次实现数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪，在实用相机数量下取得高精度，对自动驾驶和机器人感知有重要参考价值。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，使用少量相机实现鲁棒在线3D对应估计。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 融合多视角特征为统一点云，结合k近邻关联与Transformer更新，在遮挡下实现长程3D跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm中位轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8视角和24-150帧。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致模态时间上不完整、现有跟踪器因刚性架构而性能显著下降的问题，本文首次系统研究了时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪器性能。提出一种灵活的多模态跟踪框架，通过新颖的异构混合专家融合机制（自适应复杂度）和视频级掩码策略（确保时间一致性和空间完整性），使跟踪器根据缺失数据率动态激活计算单元。实验表明，该模型不仅能适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整，性能优于现有方法。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data, where existing trackers degrade significantly due to rigid architectures. It proposes a flexible framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism with adaptive complexity and a video-level masking strategy ensuring temporal consistency and spatial completeness. The model dynamically activates computational units based on missing data rates, adapting to varying missing rates and scene complexity, outperforming existing methods.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统研究时间不完整多模态跟踪问题，提出的自适应混合专家框架有效提升了鲁棒性，对实际多传感器系统有重要价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 首次研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪问题，并提出自适应混合专家融合框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 异构混合专家融合机制结合视频级掩码策略，根据缺失率动态激活计算单元。
2507.05899|v2.result: 模型能适应不同缺失率和场景复杂度，性能优于现有跟踪器。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联依赖手工启发式规则、难以端到端优化的问题，提出 LA-MOTR，将关联过程建模为可学习的模块嵌入 Transformer 跟踪框架。方法通过可微分关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配中的固定代价函数，使检测与关联联合优化。相比 MOTR 等端到端跟踪器，改进在于关联策略可随数据自适应学习而非固定先验。摘要未给出具体数据集指标，但属于端到端 MOT 方向的有益探索。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on hand-crafted heuristics for data association in multi-object tracking by proposing LA-MOTR, which embeds a learnable association module into an end-to-end Transformer tracking framework. The differentiable association prediction replaces fixed cost functions in Hungarian matching, enabling joint optimization of detection and association. It improves over prior end-to-end trackers such as MOTR by making the association strategy data-adaptive rather than relying on fixed priors.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 端到端可学习关联是多目标跟踪的重要方向，若实验充分则对自动驾驶感知中的跟踪模块有参考价值。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习关联模块，实现检测与关联的端到端联合优化。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 将数据关联从固定启发式代价改为可微分可学习预测。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，需查看正文实验验证。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇 3D 实例分割（OV-3DIS）中现有概念彼此孤立、未充分利用互补性的问题，提出一套将多种已有概念系统组合并精炼的两阶段方案。方法在 3D 提议生成阶段采用基于跟踪的鲁棒提议聚合与迭代合并/去除，在分类阶段用 Alpha-CLIP 替代标准 CLIP 并引入标准化最大相似度（SMS）分数过滤误检。相比已有 OV-3DIS 方法，改进在于对细节的精雕细琢与概念组合。在多个基准上取得新的 SOTA 性能。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS) by observing that existing concepts are complementary rather than mutually exclusive, and proposes a carefully designed two-stage recipe combining them. It employs tracking-based proposal aggregation with iterative merging/removal for 3D proposal generation, and replaces standard CLIP with Alpha-CLIP using object masks as an alpha channel, plus a standardized maximum similarity (SMS) score to filter false positives. The method achieves new state-of-the-art results on OV-3DIS benchmarks.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 工程组合与细节打磨扎实，Alpha-CLIP 与 SMS 分数的引入对开放词汇 3D 感知有实用价值。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出组合多种互补概念并精炼的 OV-3DIS 两阶段方案。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 用 Alpha-CLIP 掩码通道降低背景噪声并引入 SMS 分数归一化相似度。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在 OV-3DIS 基准上取得新的 SOTA 性能。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景动态建模与渲染中依赖昂贵人工轨迹标注、自监督方法难以准确捕捉动态物体运动的问题，提出 AD-GS 自监督框架。核心是可学习运动模型，将局部感知 B 样条曲线与全局感知三角函数结合，并用简化伪 2D 分割自动分离物体与背景，以动态高斯和双向时序可见性掩码表示物体，辅以可见性推理与物理刚性正则。在无标注设定下显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high-quality free-viewpoint rendering of dynamic driving scenes without costly manual tracklet annotations, proposing AD-GS, a self-supervised framework. Its core is a learnable motion model combining locality-aware B-spline curves with global-aware trigonometric functions, with automatic object/background separation via simplified pseudo 2D segmentation, dynamic Gaussians, and bidirectional temporal visibility masks, plus visibility reasoning and physically rigid regularization. The annotation-free model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art annotation-free methods and is competitive with annotation-dependent ones.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 将 B 样条与高斯泼溅结合用于自监督驾驶场景建模，对自动驾驶仿真与数据合成有较高参考价值。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出无标注的自监督 B 样条高斯泼溅驾驶场景渲染框架。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 局部 B 样条与全局三角函数的可学习运动模型及双向时序可见性掩码。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著超越现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法性能相当。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中现有跟踪器受框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立、模态交互不足导致开放词汇分类与跟踪性能受限的问题，提出首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器 OVTR，同时建模运动、外观与类别。方法设计类别信息传播（CIP）策略为后续帧建立高层类别先验，引入双分支结构增强泛化与深度多模态交互，并在解码器中加入保护策略。在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越此前跟踪器，同时推理更快、显著减少参数量。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of existing open-vocabulary trackers in framework structure, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modal interaction, proposing OVTR, the first end-to-end open-vocabulary tracker that jointly models motion, appearance, and category. It designs a Category Information Propagation (CIP) strategy to establish high-level category priors for subsequent frames, introduces a dual-branch structure for generalization and deep multimodal interaction, and adds protective strategies in the decoder. It surpasses previous trackers on the open-vocabulary MOT benchmark with faster inference and significantly reduced parameters.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器，CIP 策略与双分支设计对开放世界跟踪有明确推进，值得关注。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个同时建模运动、外观与类别的端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播策略与面向泛化的双分支多模态交互结构。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越此前方法，推理更快且参数量显著减少。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中像素级稠密 3D 长时序运动跟踪计算效率低或只能稀疏跟踪的问题，提出 DELTA 方法。方法在低分辨率下采用联合全局-局部注意力进行跟踪，再用基于 Transformer 的上采样器恢复高分辨率预测，并系统研究了深度表示对跟踪性能的影响，发现 log-depth 最优。相比已有方法运行速度提升 8 倍以上，同时在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪任务上均取得新的 SOTA 精度。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles dense pixel-level 3D motion tracking from monocular videos, where existing methods are limited by computational inefficiency or sparse tracking, and proposes DELTA. It leverages joint global-local attention for reduced-resolution tracking followed by a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions, and identifies log-depth as the optimal depth representation. DELTA runs over 8x faster than previous methods while achieving new state-of-the-art results on both 2D and 3D dense tracking benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 兼顾效率与精度的稠密 3D 跟踪方法，log-depth 的发现对深度表示选择有指导意义。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效稠密长时序 3D 像素级跟踪方法 DELTA。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 联合全局-局部注意力加 Transformer 上采样器，并揭示 log-depth 的最优性。
2410.24211|v2.result: 速度提升 8 倍以上，在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪基准上均达 SOTA。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对从互联网教学视频中提取被操作物体时序一致的 6D 位姿轨迹这一难题（拍摄条件不可控、物体运动细微且动态、未知精确网格），提出一套无需物体先验知识的 6D 位姿估计方法。方法先从大规模模型库检索相似 CAD 模型，再与输入图像进行 6D 对齐，并基于场景估计物体绝对尺度；随后跨帧跟踪得到平滑 6D 轨迹，并通过轨迹优化重定向到机械臂配置空间。在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上进行了充分评估与消融。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses extracting temporally consistent 6D pose trajectories of manipulated objects from Internet instructional videos under uncontrolled capture conditions, subtle dynamic motions, and unknown object meshes. It proposes a method that retrieves a similar CAD model from a large-scale database, performs 6D alignment with the input image, and grounds absolute scale, then tracks objects across frames to obtain smooth 6D trajectories retargeted to a robot manipulator via trajectory optimization. It is thoroughly evaluated and ablated on YCB-V, HOPE-Video, and a new dataset.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 面向机器人操作的 6D 位姿跟踪，与自动驾驶感知领域相关度有限，但检索-对齐-尺度估计流程有借鉴意义。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出无需物体先验的互联网视频 6D 位姿估计与轨迹重定向流程。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 结合 CAD 模型检索、6D 对齐与绝对尺度估计的免先验位姿跟踪。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上完成评估与消融验证。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对复杂场景（如群舞、团队运动、动物群体）中多目标跟踪的难题：目标运动具有协同模式、相互遮挡且轨迹存在长期依赖，而现有方法难以同时建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时序遮挡。为此作者提出 Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间（selective state-space）来联合处理多条轨迹，并自回归预测每条序列的未来 track query，同时在各轨迹间保持同步的长期记忆表示。将 Samba 嵌入 tracking-by-propagation 框架后形成 SambaMOTR，并引入处理不确定观测的 MaskObs 技术。该工作首次同时有效应对长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡问题，在复杂协同运动场景下取得优于已有跟踪器的效果。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multiple object tracking in complex scenarios where objects move in coordinated patterns, occlude each other, and exhibit long-term trajectory dependencies, which existing methods struggle to model jointly. It proposes Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces to jointly process tracklets and autoregressively predict future track queries while maintaining synchronized long-term memory across tracklets. Integrated into a tracking-by-propagation framework as SambaMOTR, with an additional MaskObs technique for uncertain observations, it is the first tracker to effectively handle long-range dependencies, tracklet interdependencies, and temporal occlusions simultaneously.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 将线性时间状态空间模型引入多目标跟踪的轨迹集合建模，思路新颖，对协同运动与遮挡场景有实际价值，值得跟踪领域研究者关注。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出 Samba 集合序列模型与 SambaMOTR 跟踪框架，首次统一建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 用同步的多选择性状态空间对多条轨迹进行联合线性时间建模，并自回归预测未来 track query。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在复杂协同运动场景下有效缓解长程依赖与遮挡问题，跟踪性能优于已有跟踪器。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: ①多目标跟踪（MOT）中，检测与跟踪通常分阶段进行，检测质量与运动建模误差会累积传播，且复杂运动模式（如相机运动、非线性运动）难以用简单线性模型刻画。②该论文提出同时检测与跟踪的框架，并引入运动建模（motion modelling），将检测与运动预测联合优化，使跟踪器能利用运动先验辅助检测、并让检测结果反过来修正运动估计。③相比传统 tracking-by-detection 的分离式流水线，该方法减少了检测与关联之间的误差累积，对非线性/相机运动更鲁棒。④摘要未给出具体数据集与数值指标，需查阅正文确认在 MOT 基准上的 MOTA/IDF1 提升幅度。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses the error accumulation in the conventional tracking-by-detection pipeline for multi-object tracking, where detection and motion modelling are handled separately. It proposes a simultaneous detection-and-tracking framework with explicit motion modelling that jointly optimizes detection and motion prediction, allowing motion priors to assist detection and detection results to refine motion estimates. Compared with decoupled two-stage pipelines, the approach is more robust to non-linear and camera-induced motion, though quantitative benchmark results are not stated in the abstract.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 将检测与运动建模联合优化是 MOT 中较有价值的方向，若实验充分可对复杂运动场景下的跟踪鲁棒性带来实质提升，值得跟踪领域研究者关注。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出检测与跟踪联合优化并显式建模运动的 MOT 框架，缓解分阶段流水线的误差累积。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 把运动建模嵌入检测-跟踪联合优化中，使检测与运动估计相互增强。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，需查阅正文确认在 MOT 基准上的 MOTA/IDF1 提升。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: ①现有对抗攻击研究多针对单帧检测，而多目标跟踪（MOT）系统依赖检测与数据关联的级联结构，仅攻击检测是否足以破坏跟踪尚不明确。②该论文提出针对 MOT 的对抗攻击方法，论证“仅欺骗检测是不够的”，需要同时干扰检测与关联/跟踪环节才能有效破坏跟踪输出。③相比只攻击检测器的已有工作，该方法揭示了 MOT 流水线中关联模块带来的额外脆弱性，攻击更具针对性与有效性。④摘要未列出具体攻击成功率或 MOTA 下降数值，需查阅正文获取在 MOT 基准上的量化结果。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper studies adversarial attacks against multi-object tracking, arguing that fooling the detector alone is insufficient to break a MOT system because tracking also relies on data association. It proposes an attack that targets both detection and the association/tracking stages, exposing vulnerabilities beyond single-frame detection. Compared with detection-only attacks, it demonstrates that the cascaded structure of MOT introduces additional attack surfaces, though concrete quantitative degradation metrics are not provided in the abstract.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 从安全视角审视 MOT 级联流水线的脆弱性，对自动驾驶感知的鲁棒性评估有参考价值，但需关注攻击的物理可实现性与实验规模。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出针对多目标跟踪的对抗攻击，证明仅攻击检测不足以破坏跟踪，需同时干扰关联环节。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 揭示 MOT 数据关联模块引入的额外对抗脆弱性，并据此设计联合攻击策略。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 摘要未给出具体攻击成功率或 MOTA 下降数值，需查阅正文。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: ①多目标跟踪中的数据关联可建模为图优化问题，但传统最小代价流/不相交路径模型难以处理检测噪声导致的轨迹断裂与漏检，且对长时遮挡不鲁棒。②该论文提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型，通过“提升”（lifting）机制在图中引入额外节点/边以表达检测缺失与轨迹连接的不确定性，并给出相应优化求解方法，应用于 MOT。③相比经典 disjoint paths 公式，该模型能更自然地处理漏检与轨迹片段拼接，提升关联的全局最优性与鲁棒性。④摘要未给出具体 MOT 指标，需查阅正文确认在标准 MOT 基准上的 MOTA/IDF1 表现。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper formulates multi-object tracking data association as a graph optimization problem and proposes a Lifted Disjoint Paths model that augments the graph with lifted nodes/edges to represent detection gaps and trajectory-linking uncertainty. Unlike classical disjoint paths formulations, the proposed model handles missed detections and tracklet stitching more naturally within a global optimization. Quantitative MOT benchmark results are not reported in the abstract.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 将组合优化中的 lifted 结构引入 MOT 关联建模，理论性较强，对关注全局关联与图优化方法的研究者有参考价值。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 图优化模型用于多目标跟踪的数据关联。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 通过 lifting 机制在不相交路径框架中显式建模漏检与轨迹连接的不确定性。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 摘要未给出具体 MOT 指标，需查阅正文确认在标准基准上的 MOTA/IDF1。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer缺乏局部归纳偏置、局部细节建模不足的问题，提出Doubly-Fused ViT，通过双重融合机制将局部表示信息注入ViT。方法在ViT中同时融合局部特征与全局注意力表示，以增强对细粒度局部结构的建模能力。相比纯ViT，改进点在于更充分地结合卷积式局部表示与自注意力全局建模。摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果需结合全文验证。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited local inductive bias of Vision Transformers by proposing Doubly-Fused ViT, which doubly fuses local representations into the transformer. The method injects local feature information alongside global self-attention to better model fine-grained local structures. Compared with plain ViT, it more thoroughly combines convolutional local representations with global attention, though the abstract lacks quantitative results.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 面向ViT局部建模的改进工作，思路常见但若融合设计有效对检测骨干有参考价值。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出双重融合局部表示的ViT结构以增强局部细节建模。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 以双重融合机制同时注入局部与全局信息。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习依赖像素级伪造位置标注、标注难以获取的问题，提出无监督不一致感知方法UIA-ViT。方法仅使用视频级标签，利用ViT自注意力图天然表示patch间一致性关系，设计无监督Patch一致性学习(UPCL)与渐进式学习组件。相比需要像素级标注或成对真假图像的方法，它无需像素级标注且不依赖难以采集的配对数据。摘要未给出具体指标，但声称可学到不一致感知特征。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles face forgery detection where learning intra-frame inconsistency typically requires pixel-level annotations that are hard to obtain. It proposes UIA-ViT, an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method using only video-level labels, leveraging ViT self-attention maps to represent patch consistency and introducing Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning and a progressive component. Unlike methods needing pixel-level or paired real-fake data, it avoids such supervision, though quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 将ViT自注意力用于无监督不一致建模，思路对伪造检测有启发，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出仅用视频级标签的无监督不一致感知ViT人脸伪造检测方法。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力图表示patch一致性并设计无监督一致性学习。
2210.12752|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer缺乏可解释性的问题，提出ViT-NeT，将ViT与神经树解码器结合以实现可解释的图像分类。方法在ViT特征之上引入神经树解码结构，使决策过程可沿树路径追溯，从而提供可解释的推理依据。相比黑箱ViT，改进点在于决策过程的可解释性与结构化。摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果需结合全文验证。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of interpretability in Vision Transformers by proposing ViT-NeT, which couples a ViT with a neural tree decoder for interpretable classification. The neural tree decodes ViT features into traceable decision paths, providing structured explanations. Compared with black-box ViTs, it improves interpretability, though the abstract provides no quantitative results.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 面向ViT可解释性的工作，对需要可解释感知的自动驾驶场景有间接参考价值。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出结合神经树解码器的可解释ViT分类框架。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 用神经树解码器为ViT决策提供可追溯的树路径解释。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 该论文针对主流ViT检测骨干依赖多尺度层级设计、结构复杂的问题，提出一种简单的单尺度Vision Transformer用于目标检测与实例分割。方法采用单尺度、无层级金字塔的ViT骨干，简化多尺度设计并验证其在检测与分割任务上的有效性。相比Swin等多尺度层级ViT，改进点在于结构更简单且保持竞争力。摘要未给出具体数据，但面向检测与实例分割任务，对感知骨干设计有参考价值。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of multi-scale hierarchical ViT backbones for detection by proposing a simple single-scale Vision Transformer for object detection and instance segmentation. It removes the hierarchical pyramid design and validates effectiveness on detection and segmentation. Compared with multi-scale hierarchical ViTs such as Swin, it offers a simpler architecture while remaining competitive, though the abstract lacks quantitative results.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 单尺度ViT检测骨干的简化设计，对自动驾驶检测骨干选型有直接参考价值。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出用于目标检测与实例分割的简单单尺度ViT骨干。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 以单尺度无层级ViT简化检测骨干设计。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自注意力随图像尺寸二次增长、难以作为通用视觉骨干的问题，提出多轴注意力(multi-axis attention)，由分块局部注意力与空洞全局注意力组成，实现任意分辨率下的线性复杂度全局-局部交互。方法将多轴注意力与卷积融合，构建简单层级骨干MaxViT，可全程全局感知。在ImageNet-1K上无额外数据达86.5% top-1，ImageNet-21K预训练后进一步提升，并在多任务上验证有效性。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic scaling of self-attention that limits ViTs as general vision backbones, proposing multi-axis attention composed of blocked local and dilated global attention for linear-complexity global-local interactions at arbitrary resolutions. Blending this attention with convolutions yields the simple hierarchical backbone MaxViT, which sees globally throughout the network. It achieves 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 without extra data and improves further with ImageNet-21K pre-training, validated across many tasks.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: MaxViT是影响力较大的通用视觉骨干，线性复杂度多轴注意力对高分辨率感知任务很有价值。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出线性复杂度的多轴注意力与融合卷积的MaxViT骨干。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 分块局部+空洞全局注意力实现任意分辨率的全局-局部交互。
2204.01697|v2.result: ImageNet-1K无额外数据达86.5% top-1，多任务上表现优异。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习在无任务边界数据流中难以平衡稳定性与可塑性的问题，提出对比视觉Transformer框架CVT。方法设计面向在线CL的外部注意力机制隐式捕获历史任务信息，为每类引入可学习focus以积累旧类知识，并基于此设计focal对比损失重平衡新旧类对比学习，同时用双分类器解耦当前类学习与已观测类平衡。实验表明其在在线CL基准上以更少参数取得SOTA并有效缓解遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the stability-plasticity trade-off in online continual learning from task-boundary-free streams by proposing Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT). It designs an external attention mechanism implicitly capturing past-task information, learnable per-class focuses accumulating prior knowledge, a focal contrastive loss rebalancing new versus past classes, and a dual-classifier decoupling current-class learning from balancing observed classes. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters on online CL benchmarks while alleviating forgetting.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 将ViT与对比学习用于在线持续学习，对自动驾驶场景的持续感知与遗忘缓解有借鉴意义。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出基于ViT的focal对比学习在线持续学习框架CVT。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 外部注意力+可学习类focus+focal对比损失+双分类器结构。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在在线CL基准上以更少参数取得SOTA并有效缓解遗忘。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏归纳偏置、训练数据效率低和局部语义表征弱的问题，本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观结构（尤其是token embedding层，即卷积嵌入CE）如何为分层ViT注入归纳偏置。作者分析了CE的最优配置并将其应用于4个最新SOTA ViT，显著提升性能，并发布了通用骨干网络CETNets。CETNets在ImageNet-1K上达到84.9% Top-1准确率。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how the macro architecture of hybrid CNN/ViT models, particularly the convolutional embedding (CE) token embedding layer, injects desirable inductive bias into hierarchical ViTs. The optimal CE configuration is applied to four recent state-of-the-art ViTs, consistently improving their performance, and a family of generic backbones named CETNets is released, achieving 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 系统性地揭示了卷积嵌入在混合ViT中的作用，对视觉骨干网络设计有参考价值，但主要面向分类任务，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统研究了卷积嵌入对分层ViT归纳偏置的影响，并提出通用混合骨干网络CETNets。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构层面揭示卷积嵌入如何为ViT注入归纳偏置，并给出最优配置。
2207.13317|v2.result: CETNets在ImageNet-1K上取得84.9% Top-1准确率，并有效提升4个SOTA ViT的性能。

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: 针对vanilla自注意力依赖预定义固定计算维度、缺乏面向上下文的泛化能力的问题，本文提出可扩展自注意力（SSA）机制，利用两个缩放因子解耦Q/K/V矩阵维度与输入，并设计交互式窗口自注意力（IWSA）实现非重叠区域间的信息交互。通过交替堆叠SSA和IWSA构建ScalableViT，在ImageNet-1K上ScalableViT-S比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%、比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: To address the inflexibility of vanilla self-attention with pre-defined computational dimensions, this paper proposes a Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) mechanism that decouples query/key/value dimensions from the input via two scaling factors, along with an Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) that enables cross-window interaction. The resulting ScalableViT achieves state-of-the-art results, with ScalableViT-S surpassing Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 在ViT注意力机制的可扩展性和上下文泛化方面有创新，但主要验证于分类任务，对下游检测/自动驾驶任务的迁移效果尚不明确。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展自注意力与交互式窗口自注意力，构建ScalableViT通用视觉骨干。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过缩放因子解耦注意力维度与输入，实现面向上下文的泛化并增强目标敏感性。

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT因token-to-token比较导致计算负担大、现有硬丢弃token方法在高丢弃率下丢失关键token的问题，本文提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT。具体设计了Token Slimming Module（TSM），通过动态token聚合将冗余token软整合为少量信息量大的token，并引入Feature Recalibration Distillation（FRD）框架，利用反向TSM（RTSM）以自编码器方式重校准非结构化token。该方法在高瘦身率下仍能保持判别性token关系。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: To address the heavy computation of ViTs and the limitation of hard token-dropping methods that discard vital tokens at high dropping ratios, this paper proposes a generic self-slimmed learning approach (SiT). It introduces a Token Slimming Module (TSM) that softly aggregates redundant tokens into fewer informative ones via dynamic token aggregation, and a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework with a reverse TSM (RTSM) to recalibrate unstructured tokens in an auto-encoder manner.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: token压缩与蒸馏是ViT效率优化的重要方向，对自动驾驶中部署高效视觉骨干有参考价值，方法设计较为完整。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT，通过软token聚合与特征重校准蒸馏提升ViT推理效率。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 用动态token聚合替代硬丢弃，并设计反向TSM以自编码器方式重校准token。
2111.12624|v2.result: 在高瘦身率下仍能保持判别性token关系，有效提升ViT推理效率。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.innovation: 通过跨尺度注意力机制在不同尺度特征间建立长距离依赖。
