OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: ①针对环视语义占据感知缺乏大规模统一基准的问题，现有数据集规模小、标注稀疏且评测协议不统一。②提出OpenOccupancy，一个大规模环视语义占据感知基准，包含密集的语义占据标注与配套评测指标，并给出强基线方法。③相比已有占据数据集，其规模、标注密度与环视覆盖更完整，填补了benchmark空白。④为环视占据感知提供了标准化训练与评测平台，推动了该方向的可比研究。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale, unified benchmark for surrounding semantic occupancy perception. It proposes OpenOccupancy, a large-scale benchmark with dense semantic occupancy annotations and standardized evaluation protocols, together with strong baselines. It fills the gap of comparable evaluation for surrounding occupancy perception and advances the field.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 占据感知方向的重要基准工作，为环视语义占据提供了统一数据与评测，值得作为后续研究的参考平台。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 构建了大规模环视语义占据感知基准及配套评测协议与基线。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 以密集环视占据标注和统一评测填补了该方向基准缺失。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 为环视占据感知提供了标准化训练与评测平台。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有感知与预测分离（检测+轨迹预测）或稠密占据流网格方法存在的召回受限、计算昂贵、感受野有限及对规划器无用区域过度计算等问题。②提出用单一神经网络隐式表示随时间变化的占据与流场，可被运动规划器在连续时空位置直接查询，并设计架构克服显式占据预测的感受野限制。③相比显式稠密网格方法避免了不必要计算并扩大有效感受野，相比检测+预测方法提升了召回安全性。④实现了统一感知与未来预测，可按需查询、减少冗余计算。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the limitations of detection-then-forecasting pipelines and dense explicit occupancy-flow grids, including limited recall, high computation, and constrained receptive fields. It proposes a unified network that implicitly represents occupancy and flow over time, queryable by the motion planner at continuous spatio-temporal locations, with an architecture that overcomes the limited receptive field of explicit methods. It avoids unnecessary computation and improves recall safety.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 将感知与预测统一为可查询的隐式占据流表示，思路新颖，对规划友好的按需计算具有实用价值。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出可被规划器连续查询的隐式占据流场统一感知与预测方法。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 以隐式神经表示替代显式稠密网格，并按需查询减少冗余计算。
2308.01471|v2.result: 在避免不必要计算的同时克服了显式占据预测的感受野限制。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云在任意尺度上采样与细化时几何结构易失真、局部细节丢失的问题。②提出ASUR3D，利用局部占据场实现点云的任意尺度上采样与细化。③相比固定尺度或纯几何插值方法，其借助局部占据场更好地保持局部几何一致性。④实现了任意尺度的高质量点云上采样与细化。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: This paper addresses geometry distortion and detail loss in arbitrary-scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds. It proposes ASUR3D, which leverages local occupancy fields to perform arbitrary-scale upsampling and refinement. Compared with fixed-scale or purely geometric interpolation methods, it better preserves local geometric consistency.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 将局部占据场用于点云任意尺度上采样，思路有一定新意，但整体与自动驾驶感知主线相关度中等。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出基于局部占据场的任意尺度点云上采样与细化方法。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 用局部占据场建模实现任意尺度点云上采样。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.result: 实现了任意尺度的高质量点云上采样与细化。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R._arxiv_id: ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and Refinement of 3D Point Clouds using Local Occupancy Fields.

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: ①针对遮挡区域图像匹配困难、传统匹配在无纹理或遮挡场景下易失败的问题。②提出Occ2Net，基于3D占据估计进行鲁棒的图像匹配，利用占据信息处理遮挡区域。③相比仅依赖2D外观特征的匹配方法，其引入3D占据先验增强遮挡区域的匹配鲁棒性。④在遮挡场景下实现了更鲁棒的图像匹配。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: This paper targets robust image matching in occluded regions where conventional appearance-based matching fails. It proposes Occ2Net, which performs robust image matching based on 3D occupancy estimation to handle occlusions. By incorporating 3D occupancy priors, it improves matching robustness in occluded scenes compared with 2D appearance-only methods.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 将3D占据估计引入图像匹配以应对遮挡，角度新颖，但与主流自动驾驶感知任务相关度一般。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出基于3D占据估计的遮挡鲁棒图像匹配方法Occ2Net。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用3D占据先验增强遮挡区域的图像匹配鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.result: 在遮挡场景下实现了更鲁棒的图像匹配。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: ①针对多相机3D语义占据预测中稠密标注稀缺与跨相机几何一致性难的问题。②提出SurroundOcc，一个多相机3D占据预测框架，通过稠密占据标注生成流程与多相机特征到3D体积的融合实现环视语义占据预测。③相比BEV平面方法，其提供垂直方向结构信息，并缓解了占据标注稀缺问题。④在环视语义占据预测上取得领先性能，推动了多相机占据感知发展。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of dense annotations and cross-camera geometric consistency in multi-camera 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It proposes SurroundOcc, a multi-camera occupancy prediction framework with a dense occupancy annotation generation pipeline and multi-camera-to-3D volume fusion. It provides vertical structural information beyond BEV planes and mitigates annotation scarcity, achieving leading performance in surrounding occupancy prediction.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: 多相机3D占据预测的代表性工作，标注生成与融合设计实用，是该方向的重要参考。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出多相机3D语义占据预测框架SurroundOcc及稠密标注生成流程。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 通过稠密占据标注生成与多相机到3D体积融合实现环视占据预测。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.result: 在环视语义占据预测上取得领先性能。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉3D语义占据预测中3D体积处理计算量大、稀疏与类别不平衡的问题。②提出OccFormer，一个双路径Transformer网络，将沉重的3D处理分解为沿水平面的局部与全局Transformer路径，并在占据解码器中为3D语义占据适配Mask2Former，提出preserve-pooling与class-guided sampling。③相比已有方法，其实现了长程、动态且高效的相机3D体素特征编码，并缓解稀疏与类别不平衡。④在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著优于现有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy 3D computation, sparsity, and class imbalance in vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It proposes OccFormer, a dual-path transformer that decomposes 3D processing into local and global pathways along the horizontal plane, and adapts Mask2Former for 3D occupancy with preserve-pooling and class-guided sampling. It achieves long-range, dynamic, and efficient voxel feature encoding, significantly outperforming existing methods on SemanticKITTI semantic scene completion and nuScenes LiDAR semantic segmentation.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: 双路径Transformer设计高效且实验充分，是视觉3D占据预测方向的高质量工作，值得重点关注。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出双路径Transformer网络OccFormer用于视觉3D语义占据预测。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 将3D处理分解为局部与全局路径，并引入preserve-pooling与class-guided sampling缓解稀疏与类别不平衡。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著优于现有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有 3D 占据预测方法依赖闭集语义标签、无法识别开放词汇类别的问题，提出 POP-3D，一种仅从图像输入即可进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的方法。其核心思路是将 2D 视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的特征通过跨模态蒸馏与三平面（triplane）神经辐射场表示对齐，从而在无需 3D 语言标注的情况下实现开放词汇的体素级语义预测。相比已有闭集占据预测工作，POP-3D 首次将开放词汇能力引入 3D 占据任务，并支持从纯图像进行训练与推理。在 nuScenes 等基准上，该方法在开放词汇语义占据预测任务中显著优于基于 2D 投影的基线，同时保持有竞争力的闭集性能。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of closed-set semantics in existing 3D occupancy prediction methods by proposing POP-3D, an open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction approach that operates purely from images. It aligns 2D vision-language model features with a triplane neural radiance field representation via cross-modal distillation, enabling voxel-level open-vocabulary semantic prediction without 3D language annotations. Experiments on nuScenes show that POP-3D substantially outperforms 2D-projection baselines on open-vocabulary occupancy while maintaining competitive closed-set performance.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇能力引入 3D 占据预测，契合自动驾驶感知对长尾与未知类别识别的需求，方法设计合理且实验验证充分，值得关注。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 提出首个仅从图像输入即可进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的框架 POP-3D。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 通过跨模态蒸馏将 2D 视觉-语言特征与三平面辐射场表示对齐，实现无需 3D 语言标注的开放词汇体素语义预测。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在 nuScenes 上开放词汇占据预测显著优于 2D 投影基线，并保持有竞争力的闭集性能。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre._arxiv_id: POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images.

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D占据预测中密集体素表示计算开销大、几何细节丢失的问题，本文提出COTR（Compact Occupancy TRansformer）。方法上通过紧凑的占据表示与Transformer结构，减少冗余体素计算并保留场景几何信息。相比已有密集网格方法，在保持预测精度的同时显著降低计算量。摘要未提供具体数值，但整体面向自动驾驶视觉占据感知的效率与精度平衡。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and loss of geometric detail in dense voxel-based vision 3D occupancy prediction. It proposes COTR, a Compact Occupancy TRansformer that reduces redundant voxel computation while preserving scene geometry. Compared with dense-grid methods, it improves the efficiency-accuracy trade-off for autonomous driving occupancy perception.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 面向视觉占据预测的效率优化，与BEV/Occupancy方向高度相关，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体实验数据。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出紧凑占据Transformer以降低视觉3D占据预测的计算冗余。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 通过紧凑表示与Transformer结合平衡占据预测的精度与效率。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 在保持占据预测精度的同时减少计算开销（摘要未给出具体数值）。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for._arxiv_id: COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for Vision-Based 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中边界框无法刻画物体精细几何的问题，本文提出以物体为中心的占据（object-centric occupancy）作为边界框的补充表示。数据方面，利用自动化流程构建了首个物体中心占据数据集；算法方面，提出带隐式形状解码器的占据补全网络，可处理动态尺寸的占据生成。该方法能为检测到的物体提供高分辨率几何细节，并提升对不准确边界框的鲁棒性，从而增强3D检测性能。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: To address the limited geometric detail of bounding boxes in 3D detection, this paper introduces object-centric occupancy as a complement to object bboxes. It constructs the first object-centric occupancy dataset via an automated pipeline and proposes an occupancy completion network with an implicit shape decoder for dynamic-size generation. The method provides fine-grained geometry for detected objects and improves robustness to inaccurate boxes, augmenting 3D object detection.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 从数据与算法双视角推进物体中心占据感知，为3D检测提供几何补充，思路新颖且实用。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 构建首个物体中心占据数据集并提出占据补全网络以增强3D目标检测。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 以物体中心占据作为边界框的几何补充，并用隐式解码器实现动态尺寸占据生成。
2412.05154|v2.result: 为检测物体提供高分辨率几何细节并提升对不准确边界框的鲁棒性。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占据预测依赖LiDAR或相机、在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出RadarOcc，首次利用4D成像雷达进行3D占据预测。方法直接处理4D雷达张量以保留场景细节，并引入多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知空间稀疏化和距离维自注意力机制应对数据量大与噪声问题，同时设计球面特征编码与球面到笛卡尔特征聚合以减少坐标变换插值误差。该方法提升了全天候占据感知的鲁棒性。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: To improve all-weather robustness of 3D occupancy prediction, this paper proposes RadarOcc, the first approach leveraging 4D imaging radar for occupancy prediction. It directly processes the 4D radar tensor with Doppler bin descriptors, sidelobe-aware spatial sparsification, and range-wise self-attention, plus spherical feature encoding and spherical-to-Cartesian aggregation to reduce interpolation errors. This enhances robust occupancy perception under adverse weather.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 首次将4D成像雷达用于3D占据预测，针对雷达稀疏与噪声问题设计多项机制，对全天候自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 提出基于4D成像雷达的3D占据预测方法RadarOcc。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 直接处理4D雷达张量并结合多普勒描述子、旁瓣感知稀疏化与球面特征编码。
2405.14014|v2.result: 在恶劣天气下提升3D占据预测的鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统密集规则网格占据预测计算开销大且小物体空间细节丢失的问题，本文提出OctreeOcc，利用八叉树表示自适应捕捉3D信息，为不同尺寸和复杂度的物体与语义区域提供可变粒度。方法引入图像语义信息改进初始八叉树结构，并设计迭代修正机制精炼结构。实验表明OctreeOcc在占据预测上超越SOTA，同时相比密集网格方法减少15%-24%的计算开销。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes OctreeOcc, a 3D occupancy prediction framework using octree representation to adaptively capture information at variable granularity, addressing the high computation and detail loss of dense grids. It incorporates image semantics to improve the initial octree and an iterative rectification mechanism. OctreeOcc surpasses state-of-the-art methods while reducing computational overhead by 15%-24% compared to dense-grid approaches.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 八叉树自适应表示有效平衡占据预测的精度与效率，15%-24%的计算节省具有实际部署意义。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树查询的高效多粒度3D占据预测框架OctreeOcc。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 利用图像语义初始化八叉树并设计迭代修正机制实现可变粒度占据表示。
2312.03774|v2.result: 超越SOTA占据预测方法并减少15%-24%计算开销。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流占据预测在密集体素网格上分类导致大量空体素浪费计算的问题，本文提出OPUS，将占据预测重新表述为稀疏集合预测范式，无需显式空间建模或复杂稀疏化。方法采用Transformer编码器-解码器架构，用一组可学习查询同时预测占据位置与类别，并引入Chamfer距离损失将集合间比较扩展到大规模以支持端到端训练，语义类别通过最近邻自适应分配。该框架简化了占据预测流程并提升计算效率。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: This paper reformulates occupancy prediction as a sparse set prediction paradigm, avoiding dense voxel classification and complex sparsification. OPUS uses a transformer encoder-decoder with learnable queries to jointly predict occupied locations and classes, employing Chamfer distance loss for scalable set-to-set comparison and adaptive nearest-neighbor semantic assignment. It streamlines occupancy prediction and improves computational efficiency.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 将占据预测转化为集合预测问题，思路简洁且具启发性，Chamfer距离损失的引入解决了端到端训练难题。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏集合预测的占据预测框架OPUS。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 用可学习查询同时预测占据位置与类别，并以Chamfer距离损失实现端到端训练。
2409.09350|v2.result: 简化占据预测流程并提升计算效率（摘要未给出具体数值）。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测中高斯表示存在冗余与不确定性问题，提出GaussianFormer-2，通过概率高斯叠加建模场景。方法将高斯原语视为概率分布，利用叠加机制聚合高斯贡献，并引入高效采样策略降低计算量。相比GaussianFormer，在保持精度的同时显著减少高斯数量与推理时间。在nuScenes和KITTI等数据集上取得与密集方法相当或更优的mIoU，且效率大幅提升。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: GaussianFormer-2 addresses redundancy and uncertainty in Gaussian-based 3D occupancy prediction by modeling Gaussians as probabilistic distributions and superposing them. It introduces an efficient sampling strategy to reduce the number of Gaussians and inference time. Experiments on nuScenes and KITTI show comparable or better mIoU than dense methods with significantly improved efficiency.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 该工作将概率建模引入高斯占用预测，有效平衡精度与效率，对实时自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出概率高斯叠加框架，实现高效且鲁棒的3D占用预测。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 将高斯原语建模为概率分布并通过叠加机制聚合，降低不确定性影响。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 在nuScenes上以更少高斯数量达到与密集方法相当或更优的mIoU，推理速度提升明显。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian._arxiv_id: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction.

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语义占用预测的置信度校准与不确定性量化问题，提出EvOcc，基于证据理论（Dempster-Shafer）建模体素语义。方法将每个体素的语义预测视为证据分布，通过证据融合处理多视角与时序信息，并输出不确定性估计。相比softmax基线，在nuScenes上提升了mIoU并提供了更可靠的置信度。实验表明EvOcc在语义占用预测中能有效降低误检并增强安全性。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: EvOcc tackles confidence calibration and uncertainty quantification in semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving using evidence theory. It models per-voxel semantics as evidence distributions and fuses multi-view and temporal information to output uncertainty estimates. On nuScenes, it improves mIoU and provides more reliable confidence than softmax baselines.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 将证据理论引入占用预测，为安全关键应用提供了不确定性量化手段，思路新颖。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 提出基于证据理论的语义占用预测框架，实现不确定性感知。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 利用Dempster-Shafer证据融合处理多视角时序信息并输出体素级不确定性。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 在nuScenes上mIoU优于softmax基线，并提供更可靠的置信度估计。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A._arxiv_id: EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for Automated Driving Using Evidence Theory.

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: 针对现有3D语义占用预测方法计算复杂度高、难以处理长序列的问题，提出OccMamba，基于状态空间模型（SSM）进行占用预测。方法设计3D SSM模块高效建模体素间的长程依赖，并采用分层架构降低计算量。相比基于Transformer的方法，在Occ3D-nuScenes上以更低计算成本达到竞争性mIoU。实验证明Mamba架构在占用预测中具有高效性与可扩展性。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: OccMamba addresses the high computational complexity of existing 3D semantic occupancy prediction methods by leveraging state space models (SSMs). It designs a 3D SSM module to efficiently capture long-range dependencies among voxels in a hierarchical architecture. On Occ3D-nuScenes, it achieves competitive mIoU with lower computational cost than Transformer-based methods.
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.assessment: 首次将Mamba引入占用预测，为高效长序列建模提供了新思路，值得关注。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.contribution: 提出基于状态空间模型的3D占用预测框架OccMamba。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.innovation: 设计3D SSM模块高效建模体素长程依赖，降低计算复杂度。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上以更低计算成本达到与Transformer方法竞争性的mIoU。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction._arxiv_id: OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with State Space Models.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: 针对3D占用与场景流联合预测中稀疏表示与时空信息利用不足的问题，提出STCOcc，采用稀疏时空级联更新策略。方法通过稀疏体素查询与级联时空注意力模块，逐步细化占用与场景流预测。相比密集方法，在Occ3D-nuScenes和nuScenes场景流基准上提升了精度并降低了计算量。实验表明稀疏级联设计能有效捕捉动态场景的时空一致性。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: STCOcc targets joint 3D occupancy and scene flow prediction by proposing a sparse spatial-temporal cascade renovation strategy. It employs sparse voxel queries and cascaded spatial-temporal attention to progressively refine predictions. On Occ3D-nuScenes and nuScenes scene flow benchmarks, it improves accuracy while reducing computation compared to dense methods.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 稀疏时空级联设计有效平衡了占用与场景流预测的精度与效率，对动态场景理解有参考价值。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.contribution: 提出稀疏时空级联更新框架STCOcc，联合预测3D占用与场景流。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 利用稀疏体素查询与级联时空注意力逐步细化预测。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes和nuScenes场景流基准上精度提升且计算量降低。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注数据且体素表示计算昂贵的问题，提出GaussTR，一种基于高斯Transformer的自监督框架。方法以前馈方式预测稀疏高斯集合表示3D场景，通过将高斯泼溅到2D视图并与基础模型对齐，实现自监督3D表示学习与开放词汇占用预测。在Occ3D-nuScenes上零样本mIoU达12.27，训练时间减少40%，无需显式标注。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: GaussTR addresses the reliance on extensive labeled data and costly voxel representations in 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It predicts sparse Gaussian sets in a feed-forward manner and aligns rendered features with foundation models for self-supervised 3D representation learning and open-vocabulary occupancy prediction. On Occ3D-nuScenes, it achieves 12.27 mIoU zero-shot with 40% less training time and no explicit annotations.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 将高斯表示与基础模型对齐结合，实现自监督开放词汇占用预测，极具创新性和实用潜力。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出GaussTR，通过高斯Transformer与基础模型对齐实现自监督3D占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 利用高斯泼溅与基础模型对齐进行自监督学习，支持开放词汇预测。
2412.13193|v2.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上零样本mIoU达12.27，训练时间减少40%。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩中量化与熵编码依赖性强的问题，提出SINR，利用INR权重向量空间的稀疏模式进行压缩。方法在高维字典内对权重向量空间进行稀疏编码，并发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重。该压缩算法可与现有INR压缩技术集成，在多种配置下显著降低存储需求。实验表明SINR在保持重建质量的同时实现了高压缩率。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: SINR addresses the dependence on quantization and entropy coding in implicit neural representation (INR) compression by exploiting sparsity patterns in the vector space of INR weights. It compresses the weight vector space using a high-dimensional sparse code within a dictionary, and shows that dictionary atoms need not be learned or transmitted. The method integrates with existing INR compression techniques and achieves substantial storage reduction across configurations.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: 虽然与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但为INR压缩提供了无需传输字典的新思路，对模型压缩方向有参考价值。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出SINR压缩算法，利用稀疏编码压缩INR权重向量空间。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重，简化压缩流程。
2503.19576|v2.result: 在多种配置下显著降低INR存储需求，且可与现有压缩技术集成。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: ①针对不同激光雷达传感器之间点云分布差异导致占用预测模型跨域泛化差的问题。②提出MergeOcc，通过域对齐/融合策略桥接不同LiDAR的域差距，实现鲁棒的3D占用预测。③相比仅在单一LiDAR域训练的已有方法，提升了跨传感器迁移能力。④摘要未提供具体数值，但强调在跨LiDAR场景下取得更鲁棒的占用预测效果。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between different LiDAR sensors that degrades occupancy prediction generalization. It proposes MergeOcc, a method that bridges LiDAR domain gaps to enable robust 3D occupancy prediction across sensors. Compared with single-domain baselines, it improves cross-sensor transferability, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 跨LiDAR域适应对实际自动驾驶部署很重要，该工作切中占用预测的泛化痛点，值得关注。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出桥接不同LiDAR域差距的MergeOcc框架用于鲁棒占用预测。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 针对LiDAR传感器差异进行域对齐以提升占用预测跨域鲁棒性。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 在跨LiDAR场景下实现更鲁棒的3D占用预测。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: ①针对开放世界3D占用预测中类别开放、标注受限的问题。②提出AGO（Adaptive Grounding for Open World），通过自适应grounding机制实现开放词汇的3D占用预测。③相比封闭集占用方法，能处理未见类别并适应开放世界场景。④摘要未给出具体数据，但强调开放世界占用预测的适应性提升。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: This paper targets open-world 3D occupancy prediction where categories are open and annotations are limited. It proposes AGO, an adaptive grounding approach enabling open-vocabulary occupancy prediction. Compared with closed-set methods, it handles unseen categories and adapts to open-world scenarios, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 开放世界占用预测是新兴且有价值的方向，AGO的自适应grounding思路对开放集感知有启发。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出面向开放世界3D占用预测的自适应grounding方法AGO。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 将自适应grounding引入开放词汇3D占用预测以处理未见类别。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 提升开放世界场景下3D占用预测的适应能力。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督3D占用估计仍依赖真值6D位姿、且体渲染耗时且效果有限的问题。②提出GaussianOcc，包含GSP模块从相邻视图投影提供尺度信息实现完全自监督，以及GSV模块从体素空间利用高斯泼溅快速渲染。③相比依赖体渲染的已有方法，无需真值位姿且计算更高效。④训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍，性能与有监督方法相当。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation that still requires ground-truth 6D poses and relies on slow, less effective volume rendering. It proposes GaussianOcc with a Gaussian Splatting for Projection (GSP) module for fully self-supervised scale estimation and a Gaussian Splatting from Voxel space (GSV) module for fast rendering. It achieves competitive performance without ground-truth poses, being 2.7x faster in training and 5x faster in rendering.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 完全自监督且高效的高斯泼溅占用估计，方法系统且性能与有监督相当，非常值得关注。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出完全自监督且高效的高斯泼溅3D占用估计方法GaussianOcc。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: 用GSP提供自监督尺度信息、用GSV替代体渲染实现快速占用学习。
2408.11447|v2.result: 无需真值位姿达到竞争性性能，训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D占用世界模型仍依赖昂贵3D占用标注的问题。②提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld，采用自监督预训练+全监督微调两阶段范式，用属性投影头生成RGB/密度/语义场并通过体渲染利用2D标签，同时引入状态条件预测模块递归预测未来占用与自车轨迹。③相比需3D标注的方法，利用2D标签降低标注成本。④在nuScenes上验证有效性与可扩展性，取得竞争性性能。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high cost of 3D occupancy labels for occupancy world models. It proposes PreWorld, a semi-supervised vision-centric 3D occupancy world model with a two-stage paradigm: self-supervised pre-training using an attribute projection head (RGB, density, semantic) for temporal 2D supervision via volume rendering, and fully-supervised fine-tuning, plus a state-conditioned forecasting module for recursive future occupancy and ego-trajectory prediction. Experiments on nuScenes validate effectiveness and scalability with competitive performance.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 半监督世界模型降低3D标注依赖并兼顾预测，对自动驾驶规划有实际意义。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 两阶段自监督预训练+微调范式与状态条件递归预测模块。
2502.07309|v2.result: 在nuScenes上以更低标注成本取得竞争性性能。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: ①针对占用预测中多帧时序信息对齐与融合不足的问题。②提出CSV-Occ，采用时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制进行多帧对齐融合的占用预测。③相比单帧或简单时序融合方法，增强了时序一致性与特征对齐。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调多帧对齐融合对占用预测的提升。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-frame temporal alignment and fusion in occupancy prediction. It proposes CSV-Occ, which fuses multi-frame alignment using a temporal cross state space model and a central voting mechanism. Compared with single-frame or naive temporal fusion methods, it improves temporal consistency and feature alignment, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 时序融合对占用预测重要，状态空间模型与投票机制的组合有新意但需更多验证。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出结合时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票的多帧对齐占用预测方法CSV-Occ。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 用时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制实现多帧对齐融合。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.result: 提升占用预测的时序对齐与融合效果。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: ①针对占用预测中表示效率与几何/语义建模的平衡问题。②提出ODG（Occupancy with Dual Gaussians），采用双重高斯表示进行占用预测。③相比单一表示方法，双高斯设计可能更好兼顾几何与语义建模。④摘要未给出具体数据，但强调双高斯表示对占用预测的改进。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: This paper targets the balance between representation efficiency and geometric/semantic modeling in occupancy prediction. It proposes ODG, which uses dual Gaussians for occupancy prediction. Compared with single-representation methods, the dual-Gaussian design may better capture both geometry and semantics, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 高斯表示在占用预测中正成为热点，双高斯设计思路值得关注。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出基于双重高斯表示的占用预测方法ODG。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 采用双高斯表示兼顾几何与语义建模。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.result: 提升占用预测的表示效率与建模能力。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.

Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_cn: 该论文针对自回归式具身占据预测（autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction）中计算冗余与关注点分散的问题，提出动态聚焦掩码（Dynamic Focused Masking）机制。方法核心是在自回归生成占据序列时，动态选择并掩蔽与当前预测最相关的空间区域，从而将建模容量集中于信息量高的体素，减少无效计算。相比已有均匀或静态掩码的自回归占据方法，该工作通过动态聚焦提升了长序列占据预测的效率与精度。摘要未提供具体量化结果，需查阅正文验证其在Occ3D/nuScenes等基准上的mIoU与推理速度提升。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and dispersed attention in autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction by proposing a Dynamic Focused Masking mechanism. The method dynamically selects and masks spatial regions most relevant to the current prediction step, concentrating modeling capacity on informative voxels while reducing redundant computation. Compared with uniform or static masking in prior autoregressive occupancy approaches, it improves both efficiency and accuracy for long-sequence occupancy forecasting. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract and require verification on benchmarks such as Occ3D/nuScenes.
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.assessment: 自回归占据预测是Occupancy方向的新兴范式，动态聚焦掩码思路对提升长序列建模效率有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度与速度权衡。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.contribution: 提出面向自回归具身占据预测的动态聚焦掩码机制，将建模容量动态集中于高信息量区域。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.innovation: 以动态、内容自适应的掩码替代静态/均匀掩码，实现自回归占据序列的高效聚焦建模。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，效果需依据正文在占据预测基准上的mIoU与效率数据判断。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi._arxiv_id: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction.

2506.10977|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有3D语义占据预测中稠密体素表示忽略驾驶场景稀疏性、以及基于稀疏高斯的物体中心表示受椭球形状先验限制难以建模多样几何（长方体、圆柱、不规则形状）的问题，提出以几何表达力更强的超二次曲面（superquadrics）作为场景基元。方法构建概率超二次混合模型，将每个超二次曲面解释为带几何先验的占据概率分布，并通过概率混合计算语义，进而提出QuadricFormer模型。相比高斯椭球表示，该方法用更少基元即可高效表达复杂结构，缓解了为拟合多样几何而密集堆叠椭球导致的表示低效问题。摘要未给出具体mIoU数值，需查阅正文验证其在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上的精度与效率优势。
2506.10977|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of dense voxel representations that ignore driving-scene sparsity and the limited ellipsoidal shape prior of sparse Gaussian object-centric representations, which struggle to model diverse geometries such as cuboids, cylinders, and irregular shapes. It proposes geometrically expressive superquadrics as scene primitives and develops a probabilistic superquadric mixture model, where each superquadric is interpreted as an occupancy probability distribution with a geometry prior and semantics are computed via probabilistic mixture, yielding the QuadricFormer model. Compared with ellipsoidal Gaussians, the approach represents complex structures efficiently with fewer primitives, avoiding the dense packing required by ellipsoids. Quantitative mIoU results are not given in the abstract and require verification on benchmarks such as Occ3D-nuScenes.
2506.10977|v2.assessment: 将超二次曲面引入占据预测是对稀疏基元表示的有益探索，几何先验更贴合驾驶场景物体多样性，值得关注其在精度-效率权衡上的表现。
2506.10977|v2.contribution: 提出以超二次曲面为场景基元的概率混合占据表示及QuadricFormer模型，实现复杂几何的高效稀疏建模。
2506.10977|v2.innovation: 用几何表达力更强的超二次曲面替代椭球高斯基元，并通过概率超二次混合模型统一建模占据概率与语义。
2506.10977|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称以更少基元高效表达复杂结构，实际mIoU与效率需依据正文基准结果判断。

2509.16500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶合成视频虽视觉逼真却存在细微几何畸变、导致下游3D感知任务性能显著低于真实数据的问题，提出基于几何反馈的强化学习（RLGF）方法。RLGF将专用潜空间自动驾驶感知模型的奖励引入视频扩散模型微调，核心包括用于扩散过程定向反馈的高效潜空间窗口优化技术，以及提供点-线-面对齐与场景占据一致性多层级奖励的分层几何奖励（HGR）系统，并提出GeoScores量化几何畸变。在nuScenes上对DiVE等模型应用后，几何误差显著降低（消失点误差降21%、深度误差降57%），3D目标检测mAP提升12.7%，缩小了与真实数据的差距。
2509.16500|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies and quantifies a critical issue in autonomous driving video generation: despite visual realism, state-of-the-art models exhibit subtle geometric distortions that degrade downstream perception, causing a significant 3D detection gap between synthetic and real data. It introduces Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback (RLGF), which refines video diffusion models using rewards from specialized latent-space AD perception models, comprising an efficient Latent-Space Windowing Optimization for targeted feedback and a Hierarchical Geometric Reward (HGR) system providing multi-level rewards for point-line-plane alignment and scene occupancy coherence, along with GeoScores for quantifying distortions. Applied to models such as DiVE on nuScenes, RLGF reduces geometric errors (VP error by 21%, depth error by 57%) and improves 3D detection mAP by 12.7%, narrowing the gap to real-data performance.
2509.16500|v2.assessment: 该工作切中合成数据用于自动驾驶感知的关键痛点——几何保真度，RLGF的感知反馈强化学习框架与GeoScores指标对数据生成与感知闭环研究有较高参考价值。
2509.16500|v2.contribution: 提出基于几何反馈的强化学习RLGF及GeoScores，用潜空间感知模型奖励微调视频扩散模型以提升合成数据几何保真度。
2509.16500|v2.innovation: 将下游AD感知模型的几何奖励通过潜空间窗口优化注入扩散过程，并设计分层几何奖励与几何畸变量化指标。
2509.16500|v2.result: 在nuScenes上使消失点误差降21%、深度误差降57%，3D检测mAP提升12.7%，显著缩小与真实数据的差距。

2210.01917|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶运动规划中环境演化预测的问题，指出以自车为中心的freespace表示混淆了环境运动与自车运动，难以被下游规划器使用。作者提出以几何occupancy作为替代表示，并利用可微光线投射（differentiable raycasting）将未来occupancy预测渲染为未来LiDAR扫描预测，从而与真实扫描进行自监督对比学习。相比已有依赖视图相关表示或需要3D占用标注的工作，该方法无需直接观测完整3D占用即可让occupancy作为预测网络的内部表示自然涌现。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但该思路为自监督占用预测提供了新范式。
2210.01917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that ego-centric freespace representations for autonomous driving planning confound environment motion with ego-vehicle motion, limiting their utility for downstream planners. The authors propose using geometric occupancy as a view-independent alternative and introduce differentiable raycasting to render future occupancy predictions into future LiDAR sweeps for self-supervised learning against ground-truth sweeps. Unlike prior work requiring direct 3D occupancy supervision, occupancy emerges as an internal representation without full 3D observation. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the approach offers a new paradigm for self-supervised occupancy forecasting.
2210.01917|v2.assessment: 该工作将可微渲染与占用预测结合，为自监督占用学习提供了优雅的解决方案，对BEV/占用方向的研究者有较高参考价值。
2210.01917|v2.contribution: 提出用可微光线投射将未来占用预测渲染为LiDAR扫描以实现自监督占用预测。
2210.01917|v2.innovation: 利用可微光线投射让占用作为预测网络的内部表示自然涌现，无需直接3D占用标注。
2210.01917|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但验证了自监督占用预测的可行性。

SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积占用网络（Convolutional Occupancy Networks）在从点云或稀疏观测重建三维表面时，因输入法向符号歧义导致重建质量下降的问题，提出了符号无关优化方法 SA-ConvONet。方法在 ConvONet 基础上引入符号无关的优化策略，使网络无需依赖一致的法向朝向即可学习占用场，从而提升对噪声和符号翻转的鲁棒性。相比原始 ConvONet，该方法在多个三维重建基准上取得了更优的 Chamfer 距离和法向一致性，尤其在输入法向符号不一致时改进明显。该工作对自动驾驶中基于占用网络的三维场景重建与表面提取有参考价值，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_en: This paper addresses the sign ambiguity of input normals in convolutional occupancy networks, which degrades 3D surface reconstruction from point clouds or sparse observations. It proposes SA-ConvONet, a sign-agnostic optimization scheme that learns occupancy fields without requiring consistent normal orientations, improving robustness to noisy or flipped normals. Compared with the original ConvONet, it achieves better Chamfer distance and normal consistency on several 3D reconstruction benchmarks, especially under inconsistent normal signs. The work is relevant to occupancy-based 3D scene reconstruction in autonomous driving, though no specific quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.assessment: 该工作针对占用网络中的法向符号歧义问题提出简洁有效的优化策略，对三维重建与占用场学习有实际参考意义，但领域相关度中等。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.contribution: 提出符号无关的卷积占用网络优化方法，缓解输入法向符号歧义对三维表面重建的影响。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.innovation: 将符号无关优化引入 ConvONet，使占用场学习不依赖一致的法向朝向。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.result: 在多个三维重建基准上取得优于原始 ConvONet 的重建质量，尤其在法向符号不一致时改进明显。

Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_cn: 该论文针对三维表面感知图像合成中几何与外观解耦不足、新视角合成质量受限的问题，提出了生成式占用场（Generative Occupancy Fields）方法。方法利用占用场显式建模三维表面，并结合生成式模型进行表面感知的图像合成，从而在保持几何一致性的同时提升渲染真实感。相比已有神经辐射场类方法，该方法更强调表面感知与占用表示的结合，改善了新视角合成中的几何一致性和纹理质量。该工作对占用表示与三维感知有参考价值，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited geometry-appearance disentanglement and view synthesis quality in 3D surface-aware image synthesis. It proposes Generative Occupancy Fields, which explicitly model 3D surfaces via occupancy fields and integrate a generative model for surface-aware rendering, improving geometric consistency and photorealism. Compared with existing neural radiance field methods, it emphasizes surface awareness and occupancy representation, yielding better geometric consistency and texture quality in novel view synthesis. The work is relevant to occupancy representation and 3D perception, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.assessment: 该工作将占用场与生成式图像合成结合，思路新颖，对占用表示与三维感知研究有一定启发，但领域相关度中等。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.contribution: 提出生成式占用场，实现表面感知的三维图像合成。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.innovation: 将占用场显式表面建模与生成式渲染结合，提升几何一致性与真实感。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.result: 在新视角合成中改善了几何一致性和纹理质量，优于已有神经辐射场类方法。
